question_sw: Nimesikia kwamba kuna mpango wa NSSF wa asilimia 15/5 — ni kweli?
answer_sw: Mpango wa kawaida wa NSSF ni asilimia 10 mwajiri + asilimia 10 mfanyakazi = asilimia 20. Kuna mipango ya hiari ya pensheni ya ziada (occupational pension schemes) ambapo mgawanyo unaweza kutofautiana, lakini hizi ni mipango ya ziada ya hiari — si mbadala wa NSSF ya lazima. Kiwango cha lazima cha msingi cha NSSF ni asilimia 10+10 = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Kwa mwongozo wa mipango ya ziada, wasiliana na NSSF au mshauri wa pensheni.
question_en: I heard there is an NSSF scheme of 15%/5% — is this true?
answer_en: The standard NSSF scheme is 10% employer + 10% employee = 20%. There are voluntary supplementary occupational pension schemes where the split may differ, but these are voluntary additional schemes — not a substitute for mandatory NSSF. The mandatory minimum NSSF rate is 10%+10% = 20% of gross wage. For guidance on supplementary schemes, contact NSSF or a pension consultant.

question_sw: Posho ya makazi (housing allowance) haizingatiwi kama mapato ya PAYE — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Posho ya makazi kwa ujumla inajumuishwa kama mapato yanayotoza PAYE. Isipokuwa kama nyumba inatolewa moja kwa moja na mwajiri (sio posho ya pesa), kuna ufupisho maalum. Lakini posho ya makazi inayolipwa kwa pesa nyingi moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi inatoza PAYE kwa kawaida.
question_en: Housing allowance is not considered PAYE taxable income — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Housing allowance is generally included as PAYE-taxable income. Unless housing is provided directly by the employer (not as a cash allowance), specific provisions apply. But a housing allowance paid as cash directly to the employee is normally subject to PAYE.

instruction: Ninafungua biashara mpya — EFD ninapata wapi na inagharimu kiasi gani?
output: EFD inaweza kupatikana kutoka: (1) Wauzaji wa EFD walioidhinishwa na TRA (orodha ya wauzaji ipo kwenye tra.go.tz); (2) Aina za EFD: ECR (Electronic Cash Register), POS (Point of Sale terminal), na ETS (Electronic Tax Stamps) kwa bidhaa maalum. Bei ya EFD inategemea aina na muuzaji — inategemea aina ya kifaa na muuzaji aliyeidhinishwa na TRA. Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD moja kwa moja kwa bei za sasa, au angalia orodha ya wauzaji walioidhinishwa kwenye tra.go.tz. TRA inahitajika kusajili EFD yako rasmi kabla ya kuanza kutumia — hii inafanywa kwa TRA moja kwa moja. Isipokuwa TRA imeidhinisha, EFD haifanyi kazi kama fiscal device. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Kama mwajiri, gharama zangu za ziada juu ya mshahara wa chini ni nini?
answer_sw: Juu ya mshahara wa chini, mwajiri analipa: NSSF asilimia 10 ya mshahara, SDL asilimia 3.5 (kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi), na WCF asilimia 0.5. Kwa hivyo gharama halisi ni mshahara + asilimia 14 (au asilimia 10.5 kwa biashara ndogo chini ya wafanyakazi 10).
question_en: As an employer, what additional costs do I pay on top of the minimum wage?
answer_en: On top of the minimum wage an employer pays: NSSF 10% of salary, SDL 3.5% (for employers with 10 or more staff), and WCF 0.5%. Total employer cost is salary + ~14% (or ~10.5% for small businesses under 10 staff).

instruction: WCF inafunika magonjwa ya kazini — mfanyakazi anayepata ugonjwa kutokana na kazi anafanyaje?
output: Mfanyakazi aliyepata ugonjwa wa kazini (occupational disease) anachukua hatua hizi: (1) Pata utambuzi wa daktari unaothibitisha ugonjwa unatokana na kazi; (2) Mwajiri alazimike kutoa taarifa WCF ndani ya siku 7 za kazi baada ya utambuzi; (3) Daktari wa WCF anakagua na kuthibitisha kama ugonjwa unatokana na hali ya kazi; (4) Kama unathibitishwa — WCF inalipa fidia ya matibabu na/au fidia ya kipato ikiwa mfanyakazi hawezi kufanya kazi. Magonjwa yanayofunikwa ni pamoja na: ugonjwa wa mapafu kutokana na vumbi, poisoning ya kemikali, na magonjwa mengine yanayotambulika ya kazini. Thibitisha na wcf.go.tz.

question_sw: Kodi ya stempu kwenye mkataba wa kukodi nyumba (tenancy/lease agreement) inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: Kodi ya stempu kwenye mkataba wa kukodi nyumba au ardhi ni asilimia 1 ya kodi ya mwaka iliyowekwa (annual reserved rent) — hii inatumika kwa mikataba yote ya kukodi bila kujali muda. Kwa mfano, kodi ya TZS 500,000 kwa mwezi = kodi ya mwaka TZS 6,000,000. Kodi ya stempu = 1% × 6,000,000 = TZS 60,000. Mkataba lazima upigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kutiwa saini, vinginevyo adhabu inatumika.
answer_en: Stamp duty on a tenancy or lease agreement is 1% of the annual reserved rent — this applies to all lease agreements regardless of duration. For example, rent of TZS 500,000 per month = annual rent TZS 6,000,000. Stamp duty = 1% × 6,000,000 = TZS 60,000. The agreement must be stamped within 30 days of signing, otherwise a penalty applies.
question_en: How is stamp duty on a tenancy/lease agreement calculated?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — lease schedule

question_sw: TRA inakagua nini wakati wa ukaguzi wa EFD?
answer_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa EFD, TRA inakagua: (1) EFD imesajiliwa ipasavyo na TIN sahihi; (2) Risiti zote zinatolewa na zinapelekwa kwenye seva ya TRA; (3) Z-reports za kila siku zinatolewa na zinawasilishwa; (4) Hesabu za VAT kwenye returns zinalingana na taarifa za EFD kwenye seva ya TRA; (5) Hakuna tofauti kati ya mauzo kwenye hesabu na mauzo kwenye EFD; (6) EFD haijaharisiwa au kubadilishwa.
question_en: What does TRA check during an EFD audit?
answer_en: During an EFD audit, TRA checks: (1) EFD is properly registered with the correct TIN; (2) All receipts are being issued and transmitted to TRA's server; (3) Daily Z-reports are generated and submitted; (4) VAT calculations on returns match EFD data on TRA's server; (5) No discrepancy between accounting sales figures and EFD sales data; (6) EFD has not been tampered with or modified.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu ameuliza kwa nini SDL imekatwa kwenye payslip yake — ni sahihi kuikata?
answer_sw: Hapana — si sahihi kuikata SDL kutoka kwa mfanyakazi. SDL ni ushuru wa mwajiri, si mfanyakazi. Ikiwa SDL imekatwa kwenye payslip ya mfanyakazi, hiyo ni kosa. Mwajiri anapaswa kuirudisha fedha kwa mfanyakazi na kulipa SDL mwenyewe.
question_en: My employee asked why SDL was deducted from their payslip — is it correct to deduct it?
answer_en: No — it is not correct to deduct SDL from the employee. SDL is the employer's levy, not the employee's. If SDL appears as a deduction on an employee's payslip, that is an error. The employer should refund the amount to the employee and pay SDL themselves.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: WHT kwa riba (interest) ni asilimia ngapi kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa riba ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na pia asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Kiwango hiki kinatumika kwa malipo ya riba yanayolipwa na benki, makampuni, au watu binafsi.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on interest for residents and non-residents?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on interest is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. This rate applies to interest payments made by banks, companies, or individuals.

question_sw: Mtu anayepokea gawio la asilimia 10 WHT — ana haki ya kupata cheti cha WHT?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu yeyote ambaye amehusika na kukatwa WHT ana haki ya kupokea cheti cha WHT kutoka kwa mlipaji. Cheti hiki kinathibitisha WHT iliyokatwa na kinatumika kama mkopo wa kodi dhidi ya kodi ya mwaka wa mpokeaji. Mlipaji analazimika kutoa cheti ndani ya siku 30 za kukata.
question_en: A person who has had 10% WHT deducted on dividends — are they entitled to a WHT certificate?
answer_en: Yes. Any person who has had WHT deducted is entitled to receive a WHT certificate from the payer. This certificate confirms the WHT deducted and serves as a tax credit against the recipient's annual tax. The payer must issue the certificate within 30 days of deduction.

question_sw: Muhtasari: mfanyabiashara wa Tanzania anapaswa kujua nini kuhusu VAT refund?
answer_sw: VAT refund — mambo makuu: (1) Inatokea wakati input VAT > output VAT; (2) Exporters (zero-rated) wana haki ya kawaida kwa sababu output VAT = 0; (3) Omba refund kwa TRA na hati kamili (EFD risiti, VAT invoices, export docs); (4) TRA inafanya ukaguzi kabla ya kulipa; (5) Unaweza kubeba credit mbele badala ya kudai pesa; (6) Lipa VAT returns kwa wakati kila mwezi (tarehe 20) kujenga historia nzuri ya madai.
question_en: Summary: what does a Tanzanian business need to know about VAT refunds?
answer_en: VAT refund — key points: (1) Arises when input VAT > output VAT; (2) Exporters (zero-rated) regularly qualify because output VAT = 0; (3) Apply to TRA with complete documentation (EFD receipts, VAT invoices, export docs); (4) TRA audits before paying; (5) You can carry the credit forward instead of claiming cash; (6) File VAT returns on time every month (by the 20th) to build a good claims history.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: B2C e-payment VAT Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Finance Act 2025 ilipanga kiwango cha VAT kwa malipo ya kidijitali ya B2C (mtumiaji binafsi) kuwa asilimia 16, kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025 — kanuni za utekelezaji bado zinangojewa kutangazwa na Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Hii ni kwa aina maalum ya muamala wa kidijitali (B2C e-payment) peke yake. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT kwa biashara za kawaida bado ni asilimia 18.
question_en: What is the B2C e-payment VAT rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: Finance Act 2025 set the VAT rate for B2C (business-to-consumer) digital payments at 16%, effective 1 September 2025 — implementation rules are still awaited from the Commissioner General of TRA. This applies to that specific digital transaction category only. The standard VAT rate for regular business transactions remains 18%.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya yenye wafanyakazi 15 Tanzania inahitaji kusajili OSHA na WCF wakati mmoja au hatua kwa hatua?
answer_sw: Kampuni mpya yenye wafanyakazi 15 Tanzania inahitaji kusajili VYOMBO VYOTE haraka iwezekanavyo. Mpangilio wa vitendo: (1) BRELA + TIN (kwanza), (2) NSSF (wakati wa kuajiri wafanyakazi wa kwanza), (3) WCF (wakati wa kuajiri wafanyakazi wa kwanza — mwajiri mwenye hata mfanyakazi 1 anahitaji WCF), (4) OSHA (mara idadi ya wafanyakazi ifikia 10). Usisimame mpaka wafanyakazi 15 kusajili OSHA — usajili unatakiwa mapema unapofikia kizingiti cha 10.
question_en: Does a new company with 15 employees in Tanzania need to register with OSHA and WCF at the same time or step by step?
answer_en: A new company with 15 employees in Tanzania needs to register with ALL bodies as quickly as possible. Practical sequence: (1) BRELA + TIN (first), (2) NSSF (when hiring the first employee), (3) WCF (when hiring the first employee — even an employer with 1 worker needs WCF), (4) OSHA (once the employee count reaches 10). Do not wait until 15 employees to register with OSHA — registration is required as soon as you hit the threshold of 10.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act or WCF Act amendment

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi wanaolipwa kwa wakati na wanaolipwa kwa kipande — wote wanalipwa NSSF?
output: Kwa ujumla, wafanyakazi wote wanaoajiriwa na kampuni — iwe wanalipwa kwa wakati au kwa kipande — wana haki ya NSSF. Msingi wa hesabu ni malipo halisi wanayopokea. Kwa hali maalum ya aina tofauti za malipo na jinsi ya kuhesabu NSSF, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz) au mshauri wa HR ili kuhakikisha unazingatia sheria vizuri.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: WHT na VAT withholding ni tofauti — kampuni inaweza kuchanganya?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, hizi ni ushuru tofauti kabisa. WHT (Withholding Tax) inahusu kodi ya mapato kwenye malipo ya huduma, gawio, na riba. VAT withholding (3%/6% kuanzia Julai 2025) inahusu VAT inayopitiwa kwa wakala wa serikali. Kampuni inapaswa kuhesabu na kuripoti kila moja tofauti — kutafsiriwa pamoja ni kosa la kisheria.
question_en: WHT and VAT withholding are different — can a company confuse them?
answer_en: Yes, these are completely different taxes. WHT (Withholding Tax) covers income tax on service payments, dividends, and interest. VAT withholding (3%/6% from July 2025) covers VAT channelled through government agencies. A company must calculate and report each separately — confusing them is a legal error.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act WHT and VAT amendment

question_sw: Biashara ya Tanzania inaweza kuomba EFD maalum ya kupokea malipo ya kadi za benki (POS terminal) inayofanya kazi kama EFD pia?
answer_sw: Baadhi ya suluhisho za kisasa za POS (point of sale) zinazounganisha EFD na malipo ya kadi zinaweza kukubalika na TRA kama mfumo mmoja. Hata hivyo, mfumo huo lazima uidhiniwe rasmi na TRA. POS terminal ya benki peke yake (bila idhini ya TRA kama EFD) haiwezi kutumika kama mbadala wa EFD. Angalia TRA na msambazaji wako kwa mifumo ya pamoja ya POS+EFD.
question_en: Can a Tanzania business apply for a special EFD that also accepts bank card payments (POS terminal) working as an EFD too?
answer_en: Some modern POS solutions that combine EFD and card payment acceptance may be acceptable to TRA as a single system. However, such a system must be formally TRA-approved. A bank POS terminal alone (without TRA approval as an EFD) cannot serve as an EFD substitute. Check TRA and your supplier for combined POS+EFD systems.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD integrated POS approval update

question_sw: TRA inazuia VAT gani kwa malipo ya bidhaa na kwa malipo ya huduma?
answer_sw: VAT withholding ya Tanzania (Finance Act 2025, kuanza Julai 2025): BIDHAA — asilimia 3 ya VAT inazuiwa; HUDUMA — asilimia 6 ya VAT inazuiwa. Tofauti: kiwango cha bidhaa (3%) ni nusu ya kiwango cha huduma (6%). Kumbuka: hizi si viwango vya VAT vyenyewe (ambayo ni 18%) — ni sehemu tu ya VAT inayozuiwa na qualifying buyer kabla ya kufikia msambazaji.
question_en: What VAT withholding rate does TRA apply to goods payments and services payments?
answer_en: Tanzania VAT withholding (Finance Act 2025, effective July 2025): GOODS — 3% VAT is withheld; SERVICES — 6% VAT is withheld. The difference: the goods rate (3%) is half the services rate (6%). Note: these are not the VAT rates themselves (which are 18%) — they are only the portion of VAT withheld by the qualifying buyer before it reaches the supplier.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT withholding rates

question_sw: Adhabu ya biashara isiyosajiliwa VAT inayokusanya VAT ni nini?
answer_sw: Biashara isiyosajiliwa inayokusanya VAT inaweza kukabiliwa na adhabu kama vile: (1) kurudisha VAT yote iliyokusanywa kwa TRA bila kupewa mkopo wowote wa pembejeo; (2) faini za kodi za ziada kwa ukiukaji wa makusudi; (3) kuzuiwa kwa biashara hadi kusajilishwa. Pia: wateja waliodai input VAT kutoka biashara isiyosajiliwa wanaweza kukabiliwa na marekebisho ya kodi — TRA inaweza kukataa madai yao.
question_en: What is the penalty for an unregistered business that collects VAT?
answer_en: An unregistered business collecting VAT may face penalties such as: (1) remitting all collected VAT to TRA without receiving any input VAT credit; (2) additional tax penalties for deliberate violation; (3) business closure until registration. Also: customers who claimed input VAT from the unregistered business may face tax assessments — TRA may reject their claims.

question_sw: SDL ni nini na nani analazimika kulipa?
answer_sw: SDL ni Skills Development Levy — ushuru wa maendeleo ya ujuzi. Ni mchango unaolipwa na mwajiri kwa TRA kila mwezi kwa ajili ya mfuko wa mafunzo ya ujuzi nchini Tanzania. SDL inalipwa na waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Waajiri wenye wafanyakazi chini ya 10 hawajumuishwi kwa kawaida. Thibitisha kama biashara yako inahitimu na TRA kwenye tra.go.tz.
question_en: What is SDL and who is required to pay it?
answer_en: SDL is the Skills Development Levy — a skills training tax. It is a monthly contribution paid by employers to TRA for Tanzania's workforce skills development fund. SDL is paid by employers with 10 or more employees. Employers with fewer than 10 employees are generally not included. Confirm whether your business qualifies with TRA at tra.go.tz.
primary_source_name: Tanzania Revenue Authority — Skills Development Levy

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayehamia kazi nyingine Tanzania — NSSF yake inabaki au inaanza upya na mwajiri mpya?
answer_sw: NSSF ya mfanyakazi HAIANZI UPYA anapobadilisha mwajiri. Nambari ya NSSF ya mfanyakazi inabaki sawa, na michango yake yote iliyochangiwa na waajiri wote wa awali inajumlishwa kwenye akaunti yake moja ya NSSF. Mfanyakazi anapaswa kumpa mwajiri mpya nambari yake ya NSSF ili mwajiri mpya aendelee kuchangia kwenye akaunti ile ile — sio kuanza akaunti mpya.
question_en: A worker moving to a new job in Tanzania — does their NSSF start over or continue with the new employer?
answer_en: An employee's NSSF does NOT start over when they change employer. The worker's NSSF number stays the same, and all contributions paid by all previous employers are added to their single NSSF account. The worker should give their new employer their NSSF number so the new employer continues contributing to the same account — not starting a new one.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

instruction: Dereva wangu wa kibinafsi ni mfanyakazi wa nyumbani au wa biashara — NSSF tofauti?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Haijalishi kama dereva ni 'wa nyumbani' au 'wa biashara' — kama yeye ni mfanyakazi wako wa kawaida, ana haki ya NSSF. NSSF Act inajumuisha wafanyakazi wote wa biashara NA wafanyakazi wa nyumbani. Wajibu wako: sajili dereva wako kwa NSSF na lipa 10% yako + kata 10% yake kila mwezi.

question_sw: Je, raia wa kigeni anaweza kufanya biashara ya rejareja (retail) Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Biashara ya rejareja (retail trade) imepigwa marufuku kwa raia wa kigeni chini ya GN 487A kuanzia 28 Julai 2025. Hii inajumuisha maduka ya rejareja ya aina mbalimbali. Adhabu kwa raia wa kigeni wanaokiuka: faini ya chini ya TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa. Adhabu kwa raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia raia wa kigeni kukiuka sheria hii: faini ya TZS milioni 5 au kifungo cha miezi 3. Thibitisha na wakili au Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Can a non-citizen operate a retail trade business in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Retail trade is prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A from 28 July 2025. This covers retail shops of various types. Penalties for non-citizens who violate this: minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. Penalties for a Tanzanian citizen who assists a non-citizen to violate this law: TZS 5 million fine or 3 months imprisonment. Confirm with a lawyer or the Immigration Services Department.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi 8 — naweza kudai sina SDL kwa sababu sijafika 10?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa sasa biashara yenye wafanyakazi 8 haijafika kizingiti cha SDL cha wafanyakazi 10 kwa Tanzania Bara. Hivyo bado hauhusiki na SDL. Hata hivyo, mara idadi ya wafanyakazi wako ikiwa 10 au zaidi — wa kudumu, wa mkataba, au wa muda — SDL itaanza kulipwa mara moja. Fuatilia idadi kila mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA kwenye tra.go.tz/page/skills-development-levy-sdl.
question_en: My business has 8 employees — can I claim I have no SDL obligation because I have not reached 10?
answer_en: Yes, currently a business with 8 employees has not reached the SDL threshold of 10 employees for Tanzania Mainland, so you are not yet subject to SDL. However, as soon as your employee count reaches 10 or more — permanent, contract, or casual — SDL becomes payable immediately. Monitor your employee count every month. Confirm with TRA at tra.go.tz/page/skills-development-levy-sdl.
primary_source_name: Tanzania Revenue Authority — Skills Development Levy

question_sw: Niambie jinsi ya kulipa ushuru wa uagizaji wa bidhaa kutoka China kupitia EAC.
answer_sw: Mchakato wa ushuru wa uagizaji kutoka China unahusisha forodha ya TRA na kanuni za EAC — hii ni eneo maalum zaidi ya VAT na kodi za ndani ninazoshughulikia. Kwa mchakato wa uagizaji na forodha, wasiliana na: TRA Customs na Excise (tra.go.tz), Freight forwarder wa Tanzania, Tanzania Bureau of Standards (TBS) kwa vipimo. Je, kuna swali la kodi ya ndani kama VAT au SDL ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: Tell me how to pay import duty on goods from China through EAC.
answer_en: The import duty process from China involves TRA customs and EAC rules — this is a more specialised area beyond the VAT and domestic taxes I handle. For import/customs processes, contact: TRA Customs and Excise (tra.go.tz), a Tanzanian freight forwarder, Tanzania Bureau of Standards (TBS) for standards. Is there a domestic tax question like VAT or SDL I can help with?

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zingine (zisizoorodheshwa DSE) ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zisizoorodheshwa DSE ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Kama kampuni inayopokea gawio inamiliki zaidi ya asilimia 25 ya hisa — kiwango ni asilimia 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. If the recipient company holds 25%+ of shares — the rate is 5%. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Nilichelewa annual return BRELA kwa miezi 3 — ninapaswa kulipa kiasi gani?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Thibitisha ada halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz). Thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA kwani yanaweza kutumia mwezi wowote wa sehemu kama mwezi kamili.

question_sw: Mtu anasema GN 487A ni vibali vya kazi vipya kwa wageni — kweli au uongo?
answer_sw: Uongo kabisa. GN 487A haina uhusiano na vibali vya kazi (work permits). Vibali vya kazi — Class A hadi G — vinasimamia mtu anayefanya kazi kama MWAJIRIWA. GN 487A inasimamia aina za biashara ambazo raia wa kigeni hawezi KUMILIKI au KUENDESHA. Ni sheria mbili tofauti kabisa zenye masharti tofauti.
question_en: Someone says GN 487A is new work permits for foreigners — true or false?
answer_en: Completely false. GN 487A has no connection to work permits. Work permits — Class A through G — govern a person working as an EMPLOYEE. GN 487A governs the types of businesses a non-citizen cannot OWN or OPERATE. They are two completely separate laws with different requirements.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: EFD yangu imetoa risiti nyingi za mazoezi (practice receipts) bila mauzo halisi — hii ni tatizo?
output: Ndiyo — risiti za mazoezi (test receipts) ambazo hazijaambatana na mauzo halisi zinaweza kuonekana kama rekodi zisizolingana na mauzo halisi. TRA inaweza kukagua orodha ya risiti zote na kuzilinganisha na malipo halisi yaliyopokelewa. Unashauriwa: (1) Epuka kutoa risiti za mazoezi baada ya EFD imesajiliwa rasmi; (2) Kama ulitoa risiti za mazoezi wakati wa kuanzisha, rekodi hizo na ueleze ipasavyo; (3) Wasiliana na TRA au muuzaji wa EFD kwa mwongozo wa jinsi ya kurejesha hali baada ya mazoezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: GN 605A inaathiri SDL na VAT — vipi?
output: GN 605A (ongezeko la mshahara wa chini, 1 Januari 2026) inaathiri zote kwa njia tofauti: SDL: inaathiriwa moja kwa moja — mishahara inayoongezeka inaongeza SDL base (3.5% ya mishahara). Mfanyakazi aliyepata mshahara mdogo sasa anapata zaidi → SDL inaongezeka. VAT: haihusiani moja kwa moja na mishahara — VAT inategemea mapato ya mauzo ya bidhaa/huduma. Lakini kama mwajiri anapandisha bei za bidhaa/huduma zake kwa wateja kujaza gharama za mishahara → mapato yanaweza kuongezeka → kizingiti cha VAT kinakaribiwa. Kwa muhtasari: GN 605A → mishahara juu → SDL juu (moja kwa moja); VAT inategemea uamuzi wa bei za biashara. Thibitisha na TRA na GN 605A.

instruction: Kampuni yangu haijafanya annual return kwa miaka 3 — inaweza kufutwa BRELA?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Miaka 3 ya kukosa annual return ni hali hatari sana. Kwa miaka 2 na zaidi, BRELA ina mamlaka ya kufuta kampuni kwenye orodha (deregister). Hatua ya haraka: wasiliana na BRELA moja kwa moja kubadilisha hali ya kampuni yako kabla ya kufutwa.

instruction: Kampuni yangu inanunua bidhaa na baadaye inalipa kwa awamu — withholding inatokea lini?
output: VAT withholding inatokea wakati malipo yanafanywa — kila awamu ya malipo inachukua 3% (bidhaa) au 6% (huduma) ya kiasi kinacholipwa. Kwa mfano: mlipaji hulipa TZS 1,000,000 mwezi wa kwanza na TZS 500,000 mwezi wa pili: withholding ya mwezi 1 = 3% × 1,000,000 = TZS 30,000; withholding ya mwezi 2 = 3% × 500,000 = TZS 15,000. Kila awamu ina withholding certificate yake. Muuzaji anapokea kila malipo pungufu ya withholding. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mwongozo wa malipo ya awamu.

question_sw: Usajili wa VAT na usajili wa TIN — ni usajili mmoja au tofauti?
answer_sw: Ni usajili MBILI TOFAUTI ingawa zinahusiana. TIN registration: inayohitajika kwa kila mlipa kodi — biashara, mtu binafsi, au shirika. Inafanywa mara moja. VAT registration: inayohitajika pale biashara inafikia kizingiti cha TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6. Inafanywa baada ya kufikia kizingiti. Biashara nyingi zina TIN lakini hazina usajili wa VAT (bado hazijafika kizingiti).
question_en: VAT registration and TIN registration — are they the same or different?
answer_en: They are TWO DIFFERENT registrations although related. TIN registration: required for every taxpayer — business, individual, or organization. Done once. VAT registration: required when a business reaches the TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6-month threshold. Done after reaching the threshold. Many businesses have a TIN but no VAT registration (they have not yet reached the threshold).

instruction: Nataka kujua — BRELA inasajili ushirika wa kilimo (agricultural cooperative)?
output: Ushirika wa kilimo (agricultural cooperative) hausajiliwa na BRELA — unasajiliwa chini ya Cooperatives Act kupitia Msajili wa Vyama vya Ushirika. BRELA inashughulikia aina TATU peke yake: BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Kwa ushirika, wasiliana na Ofisi ya Msajili wa Vyama vya Ushirika.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa huduma ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa usambazaji wa huduma na wakala wa zuio (qualifying buyer) ni asilimia 6, kulingana na Kifungu cha 5(5) cha Sheria ya VAT. Hii ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on services in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT withholding obligation on supply of services by the Withholding Agent under Section 5(5) of the VAT Act is 6%, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Biashara ndogo Tanzania inaweza kutumia mfumo wa 'lump sum tax' badala ya kuhesabu kodi halisi ya mapato?
answer_sw: Tanzania haina mfumo rasmi wa 'lump sum tax' kwa biashara ndogo kwa ujumla. Hata hivyo, kuna mfumo wa kodi ndogo ya mauzo (minimum turnover tax) ya asilimia 1 kwa biashara zisizofanya faida. Baadhi ya LGA zinaweza kuwa na mifumo rahisi ya kodi ya biashara ndogo (presumptive tax) lakini hizi ni za eneo, si za TRA ya kitaifa. Angalia TRA na LGA yako kwa chaguo zilizopo.
question_en: Can a small Tanzania business use a 'lump sum tax' system instead of calculating actual income tax?
answer_en: Tanzania does not have a general formal 'lump sum tax' system for small businesses. However, there is a minimum turnover tax system at 1% for businesses that do not make a profit. Some LGAs may have simplified small business tax systems (presumptive tax) but these are local, not national TRA. Check with TRA and your LGA for available options.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutokuwasilisha taarifa ya kodi kwa TRA ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Adhabu ya kutowasilisha taarifa ya kodi (failure to file return) inategemea aina ya kodi. Kwa kawaida ni faini ya kiasi maalum au asilimia ya kodi inayodaiwa, kulingana na aina ya kodi na muda wa ucheleweshaji. Angalia Sheria ya Usimamizi wa Kodi au wasiliana na TRA kwa kiwango maalum cha aina yako ya kodi.
question_en: What is the penalty rate for not filing a tax return with TRA?
answer_en: The penalty for failure to file a tax return depends on the type of tax. It is generally a specified fixed amount or a percentage of the tax owed, depending on the tax type and duration of delay. Refer to the Tax Administration Act or contact TRA for the specific rate for your tax type.

question_sw: Mwajiri ameacha kulipa PAYE ya mfanyakazi mgeni — mfanyakazi huyo ana hatari gani?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anaweza kukabiliwa na deni la kodi la kibinafsi kwa PAYE isiyolipwa hata kama mwajiri ndiye aliyekosea. Unashauriwa: (1) Wasiliana na TRA kuripoti tatizo; (2) Hifadhi ushahidi wa mshahara wako na makato yoyote (payslips); (3) Omba msaada wa kisheria kama inabidi. Usitegemea kwamba TRA itamchukulia mwajiri tu.
question_en: An employer has stopped paying PAYE for a foreign employee — what risk does the employee face?
answer_en: The employee may face a personal tax liability for unpaid PAYE even if it was the employer's fault. You are advised to: (1) Contact TRA to report the issue; (2) Keep evidence of your salary and any deductions (payslips); (3) Seek legal help if needed. Do not assume TRA will only pursue the employer.

question_sw: Mzungumzo wa mshahara (CBA) unaweza kuleta mshahara wa juu kuliko GN 605A?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Makubaliano ya pamoja ya mishahara (CBA) yanaweza kuweka viwango vya juu zaidi kuliko GN 605A — na hivyo ni bora kwa mfanyakazi. Lakini hayawezi kuweka viwango vya chini kuliko GN 605A. GN 605A ni sakafu ya chini, si dari la juu.
question_en: Can a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) set wages higher than GN 605A?
answer_en: Yes. A CBA can set rates higher than GN 605A — which benefits the employee. But it cannot set rates below GN 605A. GN 605A is a floor, not a ceiling.

instruction: Je, ninaweza kutoa risiti ya mkono badala ya EFD kwa wateja wanaotaka haraka?
output: Hapana. Kama biashara yako iko kwenye kiwango kinachohitaji EFD (mauzo TZS 11M+ au umesajiliwa VAT), lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala. Risiti za mkono hazikubaliwi kama mbadala wa EFD. Kutoza bila EFD ni ukiukwaji wa sheria hata kama mauzo ni madogo na mteja anataka haraka. Kama EFD haifanyi kazi, ripoti kwa msambazaji na omba ruhusa ya sementara kutoka TRA.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. instruction: Malipo ya Tigo Pesa yanarekodi kwenye akaunti yangu ya simu — hii inatosha badala ya EFD?
output: Malipo ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) yanahitaji risiti ya EFD kama malipo ya kawaida. Njia ya malipo haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti — kila muamala wa mauzo lazima upate risiti ya EFD. Rekodi ya Tigo Pesa kwenye akaunti yako ya simu haitoshi — TRA inahitaji risiti ya EFD ambayo inaunganishwa moja kwa moja na TIMS. Rekodi za simu za pesa hazitumii kama nyaraka za kodi zinazolingana na EFD.

instruction: Vifaa vya ujenzi kama saruji na chuma vinavyoingizwa Tanzania — ushuru wa forodha ni kiasi gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa kuingiza vifaa vya ujenzi (construction materials import duty) ni mada ya Customs and Excise inayohitaji utaalamu maalum wa forodha. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT ya ndani, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara. Wasiliana na TRA Idara ya Forodha kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa forodha aliyehitimu.

instruction: Ninasambazo pembejeo za malighafi kwa viwanda. Je, viwanda vikubwa vinaweza kunikata VAT?
output: Ndiyo, kama viwanda hivyo vimeteuliwa na TRA kama withholding agents, vinaweza kukata VAT yako. Hii inakuathiri kwa cash flow — utalipwa kidogo kuliko invoice yako — lakini certificate ya withholding inakupa haki ya kudai pembejeo ya VAT kwenye return yako. Thibitisha kwa mbia wako mkubwa kama ana hadhi ya withholding agent.

question_sw: TRA inaweza kukamata mali za kampuni kama kodi haijalipiwa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka ya kisheria ya kuchukua hatua za makusanyo kwa kodi isiyolipwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na: kuzuia akaunti za benki, kukamata mali, na mauzo ya mali kwa minada. Hatua hizi zinaelekea kufuata notisi za onyo. Makubaliano ya malipo yanaweza kuzuia hatua hizi.
question_en: Can TRA seize company assets if tax is not paid — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. TRA has legal authority to take collection action for unpaid tax, including: freezing bank accounts, seizing assets, and auctioning property. These steps typically follow warning notices. A payment arrangement can prevent these actions.

instruction: SDL — kama mwajiri anasahau kulipa mwezi mmoja, faini ni nini?
output: Kushindwa kulipa SDL kwa wakati (7 ya mwezi unaofuata) kunasababisha: (1) Faini ya 2.5% ya kiasi kisicholipwa kwa kila mwezi wa kuchelewa (kama PAYE late penalty); (2) Riba ya kuchelewa — inaongezeka kila mwezi; (3) Hatari ya ukaguzi wa TRA wa miezi ya nyuma. Kwa mfano: SDL ya TZS 175,000 isiyolipwa kwa mwezi 1 — faini inaweza kuwa TZS 4,375 (2.5% × 175,000). Mwezi 2 — faini inaongezeka tena. Kulipa haraka iwezekanavyo kupunguza mkusanyiko wa faini. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa hesabu sahihi za faini.

instruction: Ni aina gani za biashara zinazosajiliwa na BRELA Tanzania Bara?
output: BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Kila aina ina mahitaji tofauti ya usajili, ada, na utaratibu wa kuwasilisha taarifa. Tembelea brela.go.tz kwa maelezo kamili.

instruction: OSHA na WCF — ni tofauti gani?
output: OSHA na WCF vinafanana (zote zinahusu usalama wa wafanyakazi) lakini ni tofauti kabisa: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): inalenga KUZUIA ajali — kanuni za usalama, ukaguzi wa mahali pa kazi, safety officer, mafunzo ya usalama. Ni taasisi ya udhibiti (regulator). WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): inalenga KULIPA FIDIA baada ya ajali kutokea — bima ya ajali za kazi kwa wafanyakazi. Ni mfuko wa bima. Aina za wajibu: OSHA → usajili wa mahali pa kazi, kufuata kanuni; WCF → kulipa 0.5% ya mishahara kila mwezi. Zote mbili ni tofauti na NSSF (pensheni) na SDL (mafunzo ya taaluma). Thibitisha na osha.go.tz na wcf.go.tz.

question_sw: Kamati ya usalama inahitajika kwa biashara zenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kamati ya usalama inahitajika kwa biashara zenye wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi — si 10. Kiwango cha 10 ni kwa USAJILI wa OSHA. Kiwango tofauti cha wafanyakazi 20 kinatumika kwa UUNDWAJI WA KAMATI ya usalama.
question_en: A safety committee is required for businesses with 10 or more employees — is this true?
answer_en: No. A safety committee is required for businesses with 20 or more employees — not 10. The threshold of 10 is for OSHA REGISTRATION. The separate threshold of 20 applies to establishing a SAFETY COMMITTEE.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Adhabu za kutotumia EFD au kutotoa risiti ya EFD Tanzania ni zipi?
answer_sw: Adhabu za kukiuka sheria za EFD Tanzania ni kali: (1) faini ya kiasi kikubwa kwa kutotoa risiti ya EFD, (2) kufungwa kwa biashara kwa muda — TRA ina mamlaka ya kufunga biashara inayokiuka sheria za EFD, (3) ukaguzi wa kina wa biashara yako na TRA, (4) hatari ya tathmini ya kodi kwa kipindi kilichopita. Faini na adhabu zinaweza kuwa TZS 1M-5M au zaidi kulingana na ukiukwaji.
question_en: What are the penalties for not using an EFD or not issuing an EFD receipt in Tanzania?
answer_en: Penalties for EFD law violations in Tanzania are severe: (1) large fines for not issuing an EFD receipt, (2) temporary business closure — TRA has authority to close a business that violates EFD rules, (3) detailed TRA audit of your business, (4) risk of tax assessment for past periods. Fines and penalties can be TZS 1M-5M or more depending on the violation.

instruction: Kampuni ina wafanyakazi wazigo na wasaidizi -- je, wote wanajumuishwa kwenye kizingiti cha 10 cha SDL?
output: Ndiyo. Kizingiti cha wafanyakazi 10 kwa SDL kinajumuisha wafanyakazi wote waliolipwa mishahara na mwajiri huyo -- wa kudumu, wa muda mfupi, wa sehemu, au wazigo. Pia wafanyakazi wa muda wote na wasaidizi wanaolipwa na kampuni wanahesabiwa. Thibitisha hali maalum ya wafanyakazi wako na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Jirani yangu ananikopa pesa lakini hayarudishi — naweza fanya nini?
output: Sina uhakika ni mshauri bora kwa tatizo hili la kisheria la kibinafsi — hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya biashara na kodi. Kwa madai ya fedha kati ya watu binafsi, chaguzi lako ni: (1) wasiliana na Mahakama ya Mwanzo ya wilaya yako kwa madai madogo; (2) omba msaada wa mwanasheria wa madai ya kiraia. Kwa masuala ya biashara na kodi, mimi naweza kusaidia — lakini madai ya kibinafsi si eneo langu.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya duka ndogo mwenye wafanyakazi 2 — inahitaji usajilishaji wa OSHA?
output: Ndiyo. OSHA inatumika kwa WOTE wanaomiliki mahali pa kazi na wafanyakazi — hakuna kizingiti cha chini cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Duka lako lenye wafanyakazi 2 linalazimika kuzingatia OHS Act Na. 5 wa 2003. Usajilishaji, tathmini ya hatari, na kuhakikisha usalama ni wajibu wako kama mwajiri. Wasiliana na OSHA (osha.go.tz) kwa hatua za usajilishaji.

instruction: Mlinzi wa usiku wangu (security guard) ni wa kampuni ya usalama — NSSF yangu?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Kama unamlipa kampuni ya usalama (security company): kampuni hiyo ndiyo mwajiri — wao wanalipa NSSF ya mlinzi. Kama unamlipa mlinzi moja kwa moja kwa mkataba wako binafsi: wewe ndiyo mwajiri — lazima ulipe NSSF. Njia ya kulinda: wasiliana na kampuni ya usalama kuhusu hali ya NSSF ya mlinzi wako.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi mgeni anaweza kuwasilisha kodi binafsi (personal income tax return) Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kama mtu anapokea mapato nje ya ajira (kama mapato ya kukodisha nyumba, mapato ya biashara, au mapato mengine ya Tanzania), inaweza kuhitajika kuwasilisha kodi ya mapato binafsi. Hata hivyo, kwa mfanyakazi wa kawaida ambaye PAYE yake yote imetolewa vizuri na mwajiri, kuwasilisha kodi ya binafsi si lazima daima. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can a foreign employee file a personal income tax return in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. If a person receives income outside employment (such as rental income, business income, or other Tanzania-sourced income), they may need to file a personal income tax return. However, for a regular employee whose PAYE has been fully and correctly deducted by the employer, filing a personal return may not always be required. Verify with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kuomba mwajiriwa wake 'ajiandikishe mwenyewe NSSF' ili kuepuka wajibu wa mwajiri — je, inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: Hapana. NSSF ni WAJIBU WA MWAJIRI — si mwajiriwa. Mwajiriwa hawezi 'kusajili mwenyewe' badala ya mwajiri wake. Mwajiri ndiye anayepaswa: (1) kusajili kampuni kwa NSSF, (2) kusajili kila mfanyakazi, (3) kukata mchango wa mfanyakazi (10%), (4) kuongeza mchango wa mwajiri (10%), na (5) kuwasilisha jumla (20%) na NSSF kila mwezi. Mwajiri anayekataa kufanya hivi anakiuka Sheria ya NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer ask their employee to 'register themselves with NSSF' to avoid the employer's obligations — is this permitted?
answer_en: No. NSSF is the EMPLOYER'S OBLIGATION — not the employee's. An employee cannot 'self-register' on behalf of their employer. The employer must: (1) register the company with NSSF, (2) register each employee, (3) deduct the employee contribution (10%), (4) add the employer contribution (10%), and (5) remit the total (20%) to NSSF monthly. An employer who refuses to do this is in violation of the NSSF Act.

instruction: Je, biashara inayouza bidhaa za zero-rated inaweza kudai VAT ya pembejeo kwenye gharama zake?
output: Ndiyo. Bidhaa za zero-rated zinatozwa VAT ya asilimia 0 -- bado ni usambazaji wa VAT. Kwa hivyo msambazaji wa bidhaa za zero-rated ANAWEZA kudai VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) kwenye manunuzi yanayohusiana. Hii ni tofauti muhimu kati ya zero-rated na exempt. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 110M katika miezi 6 lakini TZS 160M kwa miezi 12. Je, lazima nisajili VAT?
answer_sw: NDIYO — lazima usajili VAT. Hata kama mauzo ya miezi 12 (TZS 160M) hayajafika kizingiti cha TZS 200M, mauzo yako ya miezi 6 (TZS 110M) yamezidi kizingiti cha TZS 100M. Viwango viwili vinafanya kazi kwa UHURU — kuzidi kimoja kimoja kunafanya usajili kuwa wa lazima mara moja. Katika hali yako, kizingiti cha miezi 6 kimezidiwa — usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima leo.
question_en: My sales are TZS 110M in 6 months but TZS 160M over 12 months. Must I register for VAT?
answer_en: YES — you must register for VAT. Even if the 12-month sales (TZS 160M) have not reached the TZS 200M threshold, your 6-month sales (TZS 110M) have exceeded the TZS 100M threshold. The two thresholds work INDEPENDENTLY — exceeding either one individually makes registration immediately mandatory. In your situation the 6-month threshold has been exceeded — VAT registration is mandatory today.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya kampuni ya binafsi (private limited) na kampuni ya umma (public limited) Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya BINAFSI: idadi ya wanahisa imepunguzwa (kawaida hadi 50), hisa haziwezi kuuzwa hadharani, na AGM inaweza kuwa rahisi zaidi. Kampuni ya UMMA: hisa zinaweza kuuzwa hadharani (ikiwa ni pamoja na kwenye DSE), idadi ya wanahisa isio na kikomo, na mahitaji ya uwazi na utawala wa shirika ni magumu zaidi.
question_en: What is the difference between a private limited company and a public limited company in Tanzania?
answer_en: PRIVATE company: restricted number of shareholders (usually up to 50), shares cannot be offered to the public, AGM can be less formal. PUBLIC company: shares can be offered to the public (including on DSE), unlimited shareholder numbers, and corporate governance and transparency requirements are stricter.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: VAT return iwasilishwe lini na itajazaje?
output: VAT return iwasilishwe ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata — kwa mfano, VAT ya Januari iwasilishwe ifikapo tarehe 20 Februari. Return inaweza kuwasilishwa mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa TRA (iTax au mfumo wa sasa). Kujaza return: taja jumla ya mauzo yaliyostahili VAT, output VAT uliyokusanya, input VAT uliyodai, na tofauti (VAT inayolipwa au kurejeshewe). Msaada wa wahasibu unapendekezwa kwa biashara mpya.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu Zanzibar inasajiliwa na TRA au ZRA?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya Zanzibar inasajiliwa na Zanzibar Revenue Authority (ZRA) kwa masuala ya kodi za Zanzibar — si TRA ya Mainland. Kwa usajili wa biashara, unaweza kuhitaji BRELA Tanzania na/au Registrar of Companies wa Zanzibar kulingana na aina ya biashara. Ninashughulikia mfumo wa TRA wa Tanzania Bara tu. Kwa Zanzibar, wasiliana na ZRA moja kwa moja.
question_en: Should my Zanzibar company register with TRA or ZRA?
answer_en: A Zanzibar company registers with the Zanzibar Revenue Authority (ZRA) for Zanzibar tax matters — not Mainland TRA. For business registration, you may need BRELA Tanzania and/or the Zanzibar Registrar of Companies depending on business type. I only handle the TRA Mainland Tanzania system. For Zanzibar, contact ZRA directly.

question_sw: Kampuni inayolipa ada za kitaalamu kwa daktari au mwanasheria wa nje (freelance) ya Tanzania haishikili kodi yoyote — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Malipo ya ada za kitaalamu kwa mtu wa Tanzania (daktari, mwanasheria, mhasibu wa kujitegemea) yanashikiliwa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 5 (WHT kwa mkazi). Kampuni inayolipa ada hizi ina wajibu wa kushikilia WHT kabla ya kulipa na kuwasilisha na TRA ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa mwezi. Kushindwa kushikilia kunafanya kampuni iwajibike kwa kodi, riba, na adhabu.
question_en: A company paying professional fees to a freelance Tanzanian doctor or lawyer does not withhold any tax — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Payments of professional fees to a Tanzania person (doctor, lawyer, independent accountant) are subject to 5% withholding tax (WHT for resident). The company paying these fees has an obligation to withhold WHT before paying and remit to TRA within 7 days after month end. Failing to withhold makes the company liable for the tax, interest, and penalties.

question_sw: PAYE tofauti na kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) ni nini?
answer_sw: PAYE inahusu mapato ya ajira tu — mwajiri anakata na kulipa kila mwezi. Kodi ya zuio inahusu malipo mengine kama vile gawio (dividends), riba, ada za ushauri, na pango — wakala mwingine (mtu anayetoa malipo) anakata na kulipa. Viwango na tarehe za malipo zinatofautiana. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between PAYE and withholding tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE relates only to employment income — the employer deducts and remits monthly. Withholding tax covers other payments such as dividends, interest, consultancy fees, and rent — the paying party deducts and remits. Rates and deadlines differ. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Shirika la madini linanipa mrabaha (royalty) — kiwango cha kodi ya mrabaha ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya mrabaha wa madini (mining royalties) ni eneo maalum la uchumi wa madini Tanzania — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Viwango vya mrabaha vya madini vinasimamiwa na Sheria ya Madini na vinatofautiana kulingana na aina ya madini (dhahabu, almasi, makaa ya mawe, nk). Muona mhesabu wa kodi aliyebobea katika sekta ya madini au Wizara ya Madini Tanzania moja kwa moja.
question_en: A mining company is giving me royalties — what is the royalty tax rate?
answer_en: Mining royalty tax is a specialised area of Tanzania's mining economy — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Mining royalty rates are governed by the Mining Act and vary depending on the type of mineral (gold, diamonds, coal, etc.). Consult a tax accountant specialised in the mining sector or the Tanzania Ministry of Minerals directly.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya kibali cha kazi Darasa A na Darasa B ni nini?
answer_sw: Darasa A ni kwa mwekezaji au mtu anayefanya biashara yake mwenyewe Tanzania — anapanga na kuwekeza mtaji wake mwenyewe. Darasa B ni kwa mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa na kampuni Tanzania — mwajiri (kampuni) ndiye anayeomba kibali kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi huyo. Darasa A linahitaji ushahidi wa uwekezaji; Darasa B linahitaji mkataba wa ajira na ushahidi wa ujuzi wa kipekee.
question_en: What is the difference between Class A and Class B work permits?
answer_en: Class A is for an investor or person running their own business in Tanzania — they invest their own capital. Class B is for an employee hired by a Tanzania company — the employer (company) applies for the permit on the worker's behalf. Class A requires proof of investment; Class B requires an employment contract and evidence of specialist skills.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kutekeleza GN 605A ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: Mwajiri alipaswa kutekeleza GN 605A kuanzia malipo ya kwanza ya mishahara ya Januari 2026. Utekelezaji haukuwa na kipindi cha mpito — ufanisi ulianza moja kwa moja tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: When must an employer implement GN 605A?
answer_en: Employers were required to implement GN 605A from the first payroll of January 2026. There was no transition period — the order took effect immediately on 1 January 2026. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 bado inatumika Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 ilifutwa rasmi kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2026 wakati GN 605A ilipoanza kutumika. Mwajiri anayendelea kulipa kwa viwango vya 2022 anakiuka sheria. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Is the 2022 wage order still valid in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. The 2022 wage order was formally revoked from 1 January 2026 when GN 605A came into force. An employer continuing to pay at 2022 rates is violating the law. Confirm with MLYWF.

instruction: Biashara yangu haikufanya ukaguzi wa OSHA kwa miaka 3 -- ninafanya nini sasa?
output: Wasiliana na OSHA mara moja (osha.go.tz au +255-22-2760548) ili kupanga ukaguzi na kufanya upya wa leseni yako. question_sw: Kampuni yangu inalipa mishahara ya jumla ya TZS 5,000,000 kwa mwezi kwa wafanyakazi 15. SDL ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara. Hesabu: TZS 5,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi. Hii inalipwa na mwajiri peke yake — haikatwi kutoka mshahara. Iwasilishwe TRA ifikapo siku ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, pamoja na PAYE.
question_en: My company pays total monthly wages of TZS 5,000,000 to 15 employees. How much is SDL?
answer_en: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is 3.5% of total payroll. Calculation: TZS 5,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 175,000 per month. This is paid by the employer only — not deducted from salaries. Remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month, together with PAYE.

question_sw: Je, WCF inamaliza kulipia mfanyakazi baada ya mwaka mmoja wa ulemavu?
answer_sw: Hapana. WCF inaendelea kulipia mfanyakazi mwenye ulemavu wa kudumu kwa muda wote wa ulemavu wake kulingana na hali ya tathmini ya daktari na sheria. Manufaa ya ulemavu wa kudumu yanaweza kuendelea kwa muda mrefu. Muda wa kulipa unategemea kiwango cha ulemavu kilichothibitishwa na daktari wa WCF.
question_en: Does WCF stop paying an employee after one year of disability?
answer_en: No. WCF continues to pay an employee with permanent disability for the full period of their disability according to the medical assessment and the law. Permanent disability benefits can continue for a long period. The payment duration depends on the degree of disability certified by the WCF medical officer.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Baada ya kuzidi kizingiti cha VAT, ninaweza kuendelea kufanya biashara wakati wa kusubiri TRA kunisajili?
answer_sw: Unaweza kuendelea na biashara LAKINI lazima uanze kutunza kumbukumbu za mauzo yako vizuri kuanzia siku uliyozidi kizingiti. Kwa vitendo: huwezi kukusanya VAT rasmi kutoka kwa wateja mpaka usajili ukamilike — lakini unastahili kufanya hivyo baada ya usajili. TRA inaweza kukuambia ulipe VAT ya kipindi chote tangu ulipozidi kizingiti hata kabla ya usajili rasmi. Inashauriwa: funga mauzo mapya mpya baada ya kusajilishwa.
question_en: After exceeding the VAT threshold, can I continue trading while waiting for TRA to register me?
answer_en: You may continue trading BUT you must start keeping careful sales records from the day you exceeded the threshold. Practically: you cannot formally collect VAT from customers until registration is complete — but you should do so after registration. TRA may ask you to pay VAT for the entire period since you exceeded the threshold even before formal registration. Advisable: apply proper VAT from the date of registration.

question_sw: Faida ya bima ya afya ya mfanyakazi inayolipwa na mwajiri haitozi PAYE kamwe — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. Malipo ya bima ya afya yanayolipwa na mwajiri kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi yanaweza kuwa sehemu ya mapato yanayotoza PAYE kulingana na hali na kiwango. Kwa umakini, waajiri wanahitaji tathmini ya kila hali na mshauri wa kodi ili kujua kama bima ya afya inajumuishwa kwenye mapato ya PAYE au la.
question_en: Medical insurance premiums paid by an employer for an employee are never subject to PAYE — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. Employer-paid medical insurance premiums for an employee can be part of PAYE-taxable income depending on the circumstances and the amount. Employers need a case-by-case assessment with a tax adviser to determine whether health insurance contributions are included in PAYE income.

instruction: Ninataka kununua EFD machine mpya. Ninachagua vipi msambazaji sahihi?
output: Chagua msambazaji ambaye ana idhini rasmi ya TRA. Usinunue kutoka kwa muuzaji asiyejulikana — EFD ya msambazaji asiyeidhinishwa haitawashwa na TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni ya kigeni (foreign company) inaweza kusajiliwa Tanzania — je, mchakato ni gani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni ya kigeni inaweza kusajiliwa Tanzania kama tawi (branch). Mchakato unajumuisha: kuwasilisha nyaraka za kampuni mama (Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association), kuwasilisha maombi ya BRELA, kulipa ada ya USD 750 kwa usajili wa hati zilizothibitishwa na USD 220 kwa ufunguzi wa faili (thibitisha bei za sasa kwenye brela.go.tz), na kupata Cheti cha Usajili wa Kampuni ya Kigeni. question_en: Can a foreign company register in Tanzania — what is the process?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign company can register in Tanzania as a branch. The process includes: submitting parent company documents (Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles), filing BRELA application, paying a fee of USD 750 (certified copy registration) plus USD 220 (document filing) — verify current fees at brela.go.tz, and receiving a Foreign Company Registration Certificate. TRA registration, BRELA business permit, and other licences are also required.

question_sw: Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ana muda gani kuamua pingamizi langu?
answer_sw: Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ana miezi 6 kuamua pingamizi. Kama hatajibu ndani ya miezi 6, pingamizi linachukuliwa kama limekataliwa kisheria na mlipaji kodi anaweza kukata rufaa kwa Bodi ya Rufaa ya Mapato ya Kodi (TRAB) — hata bila uamuzi rasmi.
question_en: How long does the TRA Commissioner General have to decide my objection?
answer_en: The TRA Commissioner General has 6 months to decide an objection. If they fail to respond within 6 months the objection is deemed rejected by law and the taxpayer can appeal to the Tax Revenue Appeals Board (TRAB) — even without a formal determination.

instruction: Kiwango cha juu zaidi cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni TZS ngapi na ni kwa sekta gani?

Hii si wastani — ni kiwango cha juu kabisa katika orodha yote ya GN 605A. Kumbuka: wastani wa sekta zote ni TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi — ambayo ni tofauti kabisa na kiwango cha juu kabisa cha TZS 765,900. question_sw: Ikiwa mfanyakazi ameumia kazini, ninapaswa kuripoti lini na wapi?
answer_sw: Ajali kubwa au ya kifo lazima iripotiwe kwa OSHA ndani ya masaa 24. Mwajiri pia ana wajibu wa kuripoti kwa WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ndani ya siku saba (7) za kazi. Kuchelewesha kuripoti ni kosa la kisheria.
question_en: If a worker is injured at work when and where do I report it?
answer_en: A serious or fatal accident must be reported to OSHA within 24 hours. The employer also has an obligation to report to the WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) within 7 working days. Late reporting is a legal offence.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: SDL na WCF — tofauti yao kuu nini na zinalipwa wapi?
answer_sw: SDL (Skills Development Levy, 3.5%): ushuru wa mafunzo ya ujuzi — inalipwa TRA na mwajiri, kwa wafanyakazi ≥10. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund, 0.5%): bima ya ajali za kazi — inalipwa WCF (taasisi tofauti), kwa wafanyakazi wote (kizingiti kinategemea sekta). Walipwa: TRA vs WCF. Lengo: mafunzo vs bima ya ajali. Viwango: 3.5% vs 0.5%.
question_en: SDL and WCF — what is their key difference and where are they paid?
answer_en: SDL (Skills Development Levy, 3.5%): a skills training levy — paid to TRA by the employer, for ≥10 employees. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund, 0.5%): workplace accident insurance — paid to WCF (a separate institution), for all employees (threshold depends on sector). Recipients: TRA vs WCF. Purpose: training vs accident insurance. Rates: 3.5% vs 0.5%.

question_sw: Kampuni ya dawa au kliniki ya kibinafsi inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kliniki ya kibinafsi na duka la dawa vinahitaji: idhini ya kufungua (facility licence) kutoka Wizara ya Afya au Bodi ya Madawa Tanzania (Medical Council of Tanganyika), usajili wa daktari/mfamasia kutoka Baraza la Madawa (MCT) au Baraza la Wauguzi, leseni ya TMDA kwa biashara za dawa, leseni ya LGA ya halmashauri husika, na usajili wa BRELA. Ukaguzi wa TMDA hufanywa kabla ya kufungua na mara kwa mara baada ya kufungua. Kufungua bila idhini ni kosa zito la jinai.
answer_en: A private clinic and pharmacy require: a facility operating licence from the Ministry of Health or Medical Council of Tanganyika (MCT), individual registration of the doctor/pharmacist from MCT or Nursing Council, a TMDA licence for pharmaceutical businesses, an LGA licence from the relevant council, and BRELA registration. TMDA inspection is conducted before opening and periodically thereafter. Opening without authorisation is a serious criminal offence.
question_en: What licence does a pharmaceutical company or private clinic need in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TMDA + MCT + BRELA — medical facility licensing

question_sw: Mwajiri analipa PAYE kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi mgeni — je, thamani ya kodi hiyo pia inabeba PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wakati mwajiri analipa PAYE kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi (tax equalization au tax gross-up), thamani ya PAYE hiyo inakuwa manufaa ya ziada ya ajira — ambayo yenyewe pia inabeba PAYE. Hii inasababisha athari ya 'PAYE juu ya PAYE' (cascading tax). Mahesabu ya tax equalization ni ngumu na mara nyingi yanahitaji mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: An employer pays PAYE on behalf of a foreign employee — does the value of that tax also carry PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. When the employer pays PAYE on behalf of the employee (tax equalization or tax gross-up), the value of that PAYE becomes an additional employment benefit — which itself also carries PAYE. This creates a 'PAYE on PAYE' cascading effect. Tax equalization calculations are complex and often require a tax advisor.

output: Mfumo wa VAT withholding ulianza rasmi tarehe 1 Julai 2025 chini ya Finance Act 2025 -- si Januari 2025 wala tarehe nyingine. Finance Act Tanzania kwa kawaida inaanza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai ya kila mwaka. Thibitisha tarehe sahihi na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: NSSF inatoa mafao ya kifo — familia yangu itanufaika vipi?
output: Ndiyo. NSSF inatoa mafao ya kifo (death benefits) kwa familia ya mwanachama aliyefariki. Mafao yanaweza kujumuisha: malipo ya mkupuo kwa wahusika walioorodheshwa, msaada wa mazishi, na pensheni kwa watoto au mwenzi. Kiasi na masharti ya mafao yanategemea muda wa uanachama na michango iliyolipwa. Kwa maelezo kamili ya mafao ya kifo na jinsi ya kudai, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).

instruction: VAT inaathiri nani — mwuzaji au mnunuzi?
output: Kimsingi VAT ni mzigo wa MNUNUZI (consumer) — analipa VAT juu ya bei ya bidhaa au huduma. Hata hivyo, mwuzaji aliyesajiliwa VAT ndiye MKUSANYAJI (collector) wa VAT kwa niaba ya TRA: Mwuzaji anakusanya VAT (18%) kutoka mnunuzi, anazidisha na input VAT (VAT alipolipa kwa manunuzi yake), na analipa NET VAT kwa TRA. Kwa hivyo: mwuzaji ni wakala wa ukusanyaji wa kodi kwa TRA — pesa si yake. Mnunuzi analipa VAT lakini kama ni biashara aliyosajiliwa VAT, anaweza kudai input VAT credit. Mlipaji wa mwisho wa VAT ni MTUMIAJI WA MWISHO (final consumer) asiyesajiliwa VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kumfukuza mfanyakazi bila kumpa onyo kabla?
answer_sw: Masuala ya kufukuza kazi (dismissal) yanajumuisha Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) na mchakato maalum — lakini hii ni ushauri wa kina wa kisheria unaohitaji mwanasheria wa kazi. Ninaweza kukuambia kwamba GN 605A inasimamia viwango vya chini vya mshahara, na kwamba NSSF na SDL lazima zisimame vizuri wakati wa kumaliza ajira. Kwa mchakato wa kufukuza, wasiliana na mwanasheria wa kazi au Ofisi ya Kazi.
question_en: Can I dismiss an employee without giving them a warning first?
answer_en: Dismissal matters involve the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) and a specific process — but this is detailed legal advice that requires a labour lawyer. I can tell you that GN 605A governs minimum wages, and that NSSF and SDL obligations must be properly settled at termination. For the dismissal process itself, contact a labour lawyer or the Labour Office.

instruction: Sijui kama mbia wangu ni withholding agent. Nifanye nini?
output: Angalia: je, mbia wako ni wizara ya serikali, benki, kampuni ya simu, au taasisi ya umma? Hawa mara nyingi ni wanunuzi wanaohitimu kama withholding agents. Kama huna uhakika, uliza TRA moja kwa moja au angalia tra.go.tz. Kujua hili ni muhimu kwa sababu itaathiri jinsi unavyoandaa VAT return yako.

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa ndani ya muda gani baada ya mwisho wa mwezi?
answer_sw: Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12, mchango wa NSSF unapaswa kulipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja (within one month) baada ya mwisho wa mwezi husika. Thibitisha tarehe halisi na NSSF kwani sheria inaweza kusomwa tofauti na mazoea ya vitendo.
question_en: Within what period must NSSF contributions be paid after the end of the month?
answer_en: Under the NSSF Act Section 12, contributions must be paid within one month after the end of the relevant month. Confirm the exact deadline with NSSF as the law may be interpreted differently from practical arrangements.

question_sw: Mshahara mdogo zaidi kwa mfanyakazi wa kawaida ni shilingi ngapi sasa hivi?
answer_sw: Kwa mfanyakazi wa kawaida, mshahara wa chini ni karibu Shilingi 175,000 kwa mwezi kuanzia Januari 2026. Huyu ni mfanyakazi wa chini kabisa katika ngazi ya sekta — sekta za madini ya kimataifa zinaweza kufikia Shilingi 765,900. Angalia jedwali la GN 605A kwa sekta yako.
question_en: What is the minimum wage for a general worker now?
answer_en: For a general worker the minimum wage floor is approximately TZS 175,000 per month from January 2026. This is the lowest tier — international mining/energy can reach TZS 765,900. Check the GN 605A schedule for your specific sector.

question_sw: Mpango mbadala wa NSSF (15%/5%) unafanya kazi vipi?
answer_sw: Badala ya mgawanyo wa kawaida wa 10%/10%, mwajiri anaweza kulipa asilimia 15 na mfanyakazi asilimia 5. Jumla bado ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi. Mpango huu unaruhusiwa chini ya Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How does the alternative NSSF arrangement (15%/5%) work?
answer_en: Instead of the standard 10%/10% split, the employer may pay 15% and the employee 5%. The total remains 20% of gross wage. This arrangement is permitted under the NSSF Act Section 12. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Je, kampuni yenye mfuko wa pensheni wake inalazimika pia kulipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — kwa ujumla, NSSF ni wajibu wa lazima bila kujali kama kampuni ina mfuko wa pensheni wa ndani (occupational pension fund). NSSF na mifuko ya pensheni ya biashara ni mifumo tofauti. Hata hivyo, kwa kampuni zenye mifuko iliyoidhinishwa na Social Security Regulatory Authority (SSRA), mazingira ya kutolipa NSSF na badala yake kulipa kwenye mfuko wa pensheni ulioathirishwa yanawezekana — wasiliana na SSRA kwa mwongozo.
question_en: Must a company with its own pension fund also pay NSSF?
answer_en: Yes — in general, NSSF is a mandatory obligation regardless of whether the company has an internal occupational pension fund. NSSF and occupational pension schemes are separate systems. However, for companies with funds approved by the Social Security Regulatory Authority (SSRA), exemption arrangements where contributions go to the approved fund instead of NSSF may be possible — contact SSRA for guidance.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kudai msaada (subsidy) kutoka WCF ikiwa ananunua vifaa vya usalama kwa wafanyakazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: WCF Tanzania kwa kawaida si chombo cha kutoa ruzuku ya vifaa vya usalama — hilo ni jukumu la OSHA au programu za serikali za usalama wa kazi. WCF inashughulikia malipo ya fidia ya ajali baada ya kutokea. Hata hivyo, WCF inaweza kuwa na programu za kuzuia ajali au mafunzo ya usalama kwa waajiri waliojisajili vizuri. Angalia WCF na OSHA kwa programu zozote zinazosaidia kupunguza ajali za mahali pa kazi.
question_en: Can an employer claim a subsidy from WCF if they buy safety equipment for workers in Tanzania?
answer_en: WCF Tanzania is generally not a body that provides safety equipment subsidies — that is the domain of OSHA or government workplace safety programmes. WCF handles accident compensation payments after they occur. However, WCF may have accident prevention programmes or safety training for well-registered employers. Check WCF and OSHA for any programmes that help reduce workplace accidents.

question_sw: Duka la mtandaoni linalonunua kutoka China na kuuza Tanzania — VAT ya ununuzi inashughulikiwa vipi?
answer_sw: Kwa ununuzi wa bidhaa kutoka China (importation): ushuru wa forodha na VAT ya uingizaji inatumika. Kwa mauzo ya bidhaa kwa wateja Tanzania: VAT ya kawaida ya 18% inatumika kama umefikia kizingiti cha usajili. Hizi ni shughuli mbili tofauti za kodi. Thibitisha taratibu zote na mshauri wa kodi au TRA.
question_en: An online shop buying from China and selling in Tanzania — how is the VAT on purchases handled?
answer_en: For purchases of goods from China (importation): import duties and import VAT apply. For sales of goods to Tanzanian customers: standard 18% VAT applies if you have reached the registration threshold. These are two separate tax transactions. Confirm all procedures with a tax advisor or TRA.

question_sw: BRELA ni nini na inashughulikia nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) ni shirika la serikali linalosimamiwa na Wizara ya Viwanda na Biashara. Inashughulikia: usajili wa majina ya biashara, uanzishwaji wa kampuni, usajili wa kampuni za kigeni, uandishi wa hati muhimu za biashara, na utunzaji wa rejesta ya biashara Tanzania.
question_en: What is BRELA and what does it handle in Tanzania?
answer_en: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) is a government agency under the Ministry of Industry and Trade. It handles: business name registration, company incorporation, foreign company registration, filing of key business documents, and maintenance of Tanzania's business registry.

question_sw: NSSF inaweza kukatiwa mfanyakazi kwa ombi la mwajiri — mwajiri anaweza kusimamisha akaunti ya NSSF ya mfanyakazi wake — je, inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: Hapana kabisa. Mwajiri HAWEZI kusimamisha, kufunga, au kuathiri akaunti ya NSSF ya mfanyakazi kwa njia yoyote. Akaunti ya NSSF ni ya mfanyakazi mwenyewe — si ya mwajiri. Mwajiri tu ana wajibu wa kuwasilisha michango. Mfanyakazi peke yake ndiye anayeweza kuomba manufaa, kubadilisha taarifa za kibinafsi, au kushughulikia akaunti yake ya NSSF.
question_en: Can a worker's NSSF be suspended at the employer's request — can an employer freeze a worker's NSSF account — is this permitted?
answer_en: Absolutely not. An employer CANNOT suspend, close, or affect a worker's NSSF account in any way. The NSSF account belongs to the worker — not the employer. The employer only has a duty to submit contributions. Only the worker themselves can apply for benefits, change personal details, or manage their NSSF account.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

instruction: PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF — vyote vinalipwa tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata?
output: Si vyote vina tarehe sawa: PAYE → TRA: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata (tarehe ngumu — 7th); SDL → TRA: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata (pamoja na PAYE kwa kawaida); WHT → TRA: VAT withholding inalipwa TRA tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata — siku ile ile ya VAT return ya kawaida. Si siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz. (si tarehe 7 maalum); NSSF: tarehe ya mwisho wa mwezi unaofuata (si lazima 7th — angalia NSSF moja kwa moja); WCF: malipo ya mwezi yanafanywa ndani ya mwezi huo au unaofuata (angalia WCF kwa tarehe halisi); VAT → TRA: tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kwa hivyo ratiba ya malipo ni: 7th (PAYE+SDL+WHT), mwisho wa mwezi (NSSF), 20th (VAT). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na taasisi husika kwa tarehe za sasa.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa majaribio (probationary employee) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi katika kipindi cha majaribio ana haki ya angalau kiwango cha chini cha GN 605A cha sekta husika. Muda wa majaribio haupunguzi haki ya mshahara wa chini. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Is a probationary employee entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: Yes. An employee on probation is entitled to at least the GN 605A minimum wage for their sector. The probation period does not reduce the right to minimum pay. Confirm with MLYWF.

instruction: Mwajiri alipata wafanyakazi 10 kwa mara ya kwanza Machi 2026 -- anatakiwa kuwasilisha SDL ya Machi ifikapo lini?
output: SDL ya Machi 2026 inawasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 Aprili 2026. Kwa sababu mwajiri sasa ana wafanyakazi 10 (kizingiti cha SDL), analazimika kulipa SDL kwa mwezi wote wa Machi -- haijalishi mfanyakazi wa 10 aliajiriwa tarehe ngapi ndani ya Machi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: VAT withholding certificate lazima itolewa lini?
answer_sw: Cheti cha VAT withholding (VAT withholding certificate) lazima kitolewa siku VAT inakuwa inadaiwa — si tarehe ya 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Tarehe ya 20 ni mwisho wa kuwasilisha return ya VAT — hizi ni wajibu tofauti mbili. Cheti cha VAT withholding kinatolewa wakati wa muamala, sio baadaye.
question_en: When must a VAT withholding certificate be issued?
answer_en: A VAT withholding certificate must be issued by the day the VAT becomes payable — not by the 20th of the following month. The 20th is the VAT return filing deadline — these are two separate obligations. The withholding certificate is issued at the time of the transaction, not later.

question_sw: Mchakato wa kuomba kibali cha kazi Darasa B Tanzania unachukua muda gani?
answer_sw: Mchakato wa kuomba kibali cha kazi Darasa B unachukua kwa kawaida wiki 4 hadi 8 kutoka tarehe ya kuwasilisha maombi kamili. Hatua ni: (1) mwajiri anawasilisha maombi na nyaraka zote kwa Idara ya Uhamiaji, (2) Idara inakagua na kutathmini, (3) kibali kinatolewa au kukataliwa. Maombi yaliyokosekana nyaraka yanachelewesha mchakato.
question_en: How long does the Class B work permit application process take in Tanzania?
answer_en: The Class B work permit application typically takes 4 to 8 weeks from the date of a complete submission. Steps are: (1) employer submits application and all documents to the Immigration Department, (2) the Department reviews and assesses, (3) permit is issued or refused. Incomplete applications cause delays.

instruction: Faini ya kuchelewa SDL ni ngapi?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Faini na riba ya kuchelewa SDL inashughulikiwa na TRA chini ya Tax Administration Act. TRA inaweza kutoza: faini ya kuchelewa + riba ya kila siku au mwezi wa kuchelewa. Wasiliana na TRA moja kwa moja kujua kiasi halisi cha faini — au lipa mapema kuliko kuchelewesha.

question_sw: Tofauti kuu kati ya SDL, NSSF, WCF ni nini?
answer_sw: SDL (3.5%, mwajiri tu, ≥10 wafanyakazi): ushuru wa mafunzo ya ujuzi, kwenda TRA. NSSF (10%+10%, mwajiri na mfanyakazi): pensheni na bima ya jamii, kwenda NSSF. WCF (0.5%, mwajiri tu): bima ya ajali za kazi, kwenda WCF. Ni mifumo mitatu tofauti ya kisheria.
question_en: What are the main differences between SDL, NSSF, and WCF?
answer_en: SDL (3.5%, employer only, ≥10 employees): levy for skills training, goes to TRA. NSSF (10%+10%, employer and employee): pension and social security, goes to NSSF. WCF (0.5%, employer only): workplace accident insurance, goes to WCF. They are three separate legal frameworks.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ushuru wa stempu na ushuru wa usajili wa ardhi (land registration fee) Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Hizi ni ada mbili tofauti zinazolipwa wakati wa kununua ardhi Tanzania. Ushuru wa stempu (1% ya thamani) unalipwa kwa TRA na unahusiana na hati ya kisheria. Ada ya usajili wa ardhi ni ada tofauti inayolipwa kwa Msajili wa Ardhi (Registrar of Titles / MLHHSD) kwa kusajili hati hiyo kwenye rejista ya ardhi. Zote mbili zinahitajika kwa uhamishaji kamili wa kisheria wa ardhi.
question_en: What is the difference between stamp duty and land registration fee in Tanzania?
answer_en: These are two separate charges paid when buying land in Tanzania. Stamp duty (1% of value) is paid to TRA and relates to the legal instrument. The land registration fee is a separate fee paid to the Registrar of Titles (MLHHSD) to register that instrument in the land register. Both are required for full legal transfer of land.

question_sw: Je, bonasi na motisha zinapaswa kulipwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Bonasi, motisha (incentives), na malipo ya kipekee yote yanajumuishwa katika mapato yanayostahili PAYE. Yanalipwa mwezi yanayotolewa na PAYE inacheswa kwa msingi wa mwezi huo. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Are bonuses and incentives subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Bonuses, incentives, and one-off payments are all included in PAYE-liable income. They are taxed in the month paid, with PAYE calculated on the total income for that month. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi Tanzania kinadumu kwa muda gani?
answer_sw: Kibali cha makazi daraja C kawaida kinatolewa kwa kipindi cha hadi miaka 2, kinachoweza kuhuishwa. Kibali cha daraja A (mwekezaji — self-employed) kinaweza kutolewa kwa hadi miaka 5. Thibitisha muda halisi wa aina yako ya kibali na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: How long is a work permit valid in Tanzania?
answer_en: A Class C residence permit is typically issued for up to 2 years, renewable. A Class A (investor — self-employed) permit may be issued for up to 5 years. Confirm the exact duration for your permit type with the Immigration Department.

instruction: Kama kampuni yangu imekuwa dormant (haifanyi biashara) kwa miaka 2 — bado inahitaji annual return BRELA?
output: Ndiyo — kampuni iliyosajiliwa BRELA inahitaji kuwasilisha annual returns bila kujali kama inafanya biashara au la (dormant). Annual return inathibitisha kampuni bado ipo hai kisheria na inatoa taarifa za hali ya sasa. Kutokuwasilisha — hata kwa kampuni ya dormant — kunasababisha faini ya TZS 2,500/mwezi na hatimaye kufutwa orodha. Kama kampuni haifanyi kazi na hutaifufua, inashauriwa kuifuta rasmi (voluntary dissolution/winding up) ili kuepuka mkusanyiko wa faini. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, mkurugenzi wa kampuni analipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Mkurugenzi anayepokea mshahara (executive director) analipa NSSF kama mfanyakazi yeyote — mwajiri 10% + mkurugenzi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Mkurugenzi asiyepokea mshahara (non-executive director) ambaye hapokei mishahara ya kawaida hawezi kuwa na wajibu wa NSSF kwa msingi wa mshahara. Kwa mwongozo wa hali maalum za wakurugenzi, wasiliana na NSSF.
question_en: Does a company director pay NSSF?
answer_en: An executive director who receives a salary pays NSSF like any other employee — employer 10% + director 10% = 20% of gross wage. A non-executive director who does not receive regular wages may not have an NSSF obligation on a wage basis. For guidance on specific director arrangements, contact NSSF.

question_sw: Gawio linalolipwa kwa mwanahisa asiye mkazi (non-resident) lina kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 10 — sawa na mkazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kodi ya zuio kwenye gawio kwa mwanahisa asiye mkazi (non-resident) ni asilimia 10 pia, lakini angalia mikataba ya DTA. Tanzania ina mikataba ya kuepuka kodi mara mbili na nchi kadhaa (kama Uswizi, Uingereza, India) ambayo inaweza kupunguza kiwango hadi asilimia 5 au zaidi. Kagua DTA inayohusika kwa kiwango halisi kinachotumika.
question_en: Dividends paid to a non-resident shareholder carry a 10% withholding tax — same as for a resident — is this correct?
answer_en: The base rate for withholding tax on dividends to a non-resident is also 10%, but check applicable DTA agreements. Tanzania has double tax treaties with several countries (such as Switzerland, UK, India) which may reduce the rate to 5% or more. Check the applicable DTA for the actual rate that applies.

instruction: Tofauti kati ya BRELA na COSOTA kuhusu milki ya kiakili ni nini?
output: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) inasimamia: alama za biashara (trademarks), hataza (patents), na miundo ya viwanda (industrial designs). COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania) inasimamia: hakimiliki (copyright) na haki jirani (neighbouring rights) -- hizi ni kwa wasanii, waandishi, na wabunifu wa ubunifu. Kila aina ya milki ya kiakili inasajilishwa na taasisi tofauti. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

instruction: Je, kufungua kampuni Tanzania kama mgeni (non-citizen) ni halali?

GN487A inakataza raia wa kigeni kufanya baadhi ya shughuli za biashara moja kwa moja — kama jumla/rejareja, ukarabati wa simu, n.k. Lakini kuwa mwanahisa au mkurugenzi wa kampuni halisi ni tofauti. Thibitisha hali yako maalum na mwanasheria wa biashara kabla ya kuanza.
