instruction: SDL rate ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kiwango cha SDL ni 3.5% ya jumla ya mishahara yote. Hakuna kiwango kingine — si 5%, si 4%, si 3%. Ni 3.5% peke yake. Chanzo: Finance Act na kanuni za TRA.

instruction: Usajili wa haki za ubunifu (copyright) Tanzania unafanywa na taasisi gani?
output: Usajili wa hakimiliki (copyright) na haki jirani (neighbouring rights) Tanzania unafanywa na COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania) -- si BRELA. COSOTA ndiyo mamlaka ya hakimiliki Tanzania. BRELA inasimamia alama za biashara, hataza, na miundo ya viwanda -- si hakimiliki. Thibitisha na COSOTA au BRELA (brela.go.tz) kulingana na aina ya ulinzi unaohitajika.

question_sw: Je, kumwambia mgeni 'tumia jina langu kwenye biashara' ni msaada wa kisheria?
answer_sw: Hapana — hii ni mfano wa kawaida wa 'kuwezesha' (facilitating) kwa maana ya GN 487A. Kuruhusu mgeni kutumia jina lako kusajili biashara au kuendesha biashara inayofanywa kweli na mgeni kunakufanya 'msaidizi' chini ya GN 487A. Adhabu yako kama msaidizi: hadi TZS 5,000,000 AU kifungo hadi miezi 3. Mbinu hii ya 'dawa ya siri' ni maarufu lakini ni kosa la kisheria.
question_en: Is telling a non-citizen 'use my name for the business' legal assistance?
answer_en: No — this is a classic example of 'facilitating' within the meaning of GN 487A. Allowing a non-citizen to use your name to register a business or run a business actually operated by a non-citizen makes you a 'facilitator' under GN 487A. Your penalty as a facilitator: up to TZS 5,000,000 OR imprisonment up to 3 months. This 'secret medicine' method is popular but is a criminal offence.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: WCF mchango unalipwa TRA au WCF moja kwa moja?
answer_sw: Mchango wa WCF unalipwa moja kwa moja kwa WORKERS COMPENSATION FUND (WCF) — si kwa TRA. WCF ni shirika lake tofauti linalosimamiwa na Wizara ya Kazi. Usajili, malipo ya mchango, na madai yote yanashughulikiwa na WCF, si TRA.
question_en: Is the WCF contribution paid to TRA or directly to WCF?
answer_en: The WCF contribution is paid directly to the WORKERS COMPENSATION FUND (WCF) — not to TRA. WCF is a separate organisation managed by the Ministry of Labour. Registration, contribution payments, and all claims are handled by WCF, not TRA.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anaweza kufanya kazi kwa masaa ya ziada nje ya masaa ya mkataba wake — je, kinaathiri kibali chake?
answer_sw: Masaa ya ziada ya mfanyakazi wa kigeni kwa mwajiri WAKE MWENYEWE hayaathiri kibali chake — ni sehemu ya mkataba wake wa ajira na mwajiri aliyetajwa kwenye kibali. Tatizo linatokea ikiwa 'overtime' ni kwa mwajiri WA PILI — hiyo itahitaji ruhusa ya ziada ya uhamiaji.
question_en: Can a foreign worker do overtime outside their contract hours — does it affect their permit?
answer_en: Overtime for the foreign worker's OWN employer does not affect their permit — it is part of their employment relationship with the employer named on the permit. The problem arises if the 'overtime' is for a SECOND employer — that would require additional immigration authorisation.

question_sw: EFD inatumika kwa mauzo ya bidhaa zilizo huru ya VAT (exempt) Tanzania — au EFD ni kwa mauzo ya VAT tu?
answer_sw: EFD inatumika kwa mauzo YOTE ya biashara iliyolazimika kutumia EFD — ikiwa ni pamoja na mauzo ya bidhaa zilizo huru ya VAT (exempt) na mauzo ya kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated). Biashara lazima iingie muamala wote kwenye EFD na iuainishe ipasavyo (standard rate, zero-rated, exempt). Kuchagua tu mauzo ya VAT kwenye EFD na kuacha mauzo ya exempt ni kosa la uzingatiaji wa EFD.
question_en: Is an EFD used for exempt VAT sales in Tanzania — or is an EFD only for VAT sales?
answer_en: An EFD is used for ALL sales of a business required to use an EFD — including exempt VAT sales and zero-rated sales. The business must enter all transactions in the EFD and categorise them correctly (standard rate, zero-rated, exempt). Entering only VAT sales in the EFD and leaving out exempt sales is an EFD compliance error.

instruction: Nikiongeza mwenzi mpya katika biashara yangu ya jina — ninahitaji kubadilisha nini BRELA?
output: Kuongeza mwenzi katika biashara ya jina kunabadilisha muundo wa kisheria — tayari sio sole trader bali ni ubia (partnership). Unapaswa: (1) Kufuta au kusasisha usajili wa biashara ya jina kwenye BRELA kuonyesha muundo mpya; (2) Kuandika mkataba wa ubia (partnership agreement) kwa wakili; (3) Kwa ubia rasmi, BRELA usajili upya unaweza kuhitajika. Njia nyingine bora zaidi: badala ya ubia, anzisha kampuni ya hisa ambapo wote mnawe hisa — hii inalinda mali za kibinafsi vizuri zaidi. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: TRA inachukua muda gani kusindika refund ya VAT?
answer_sw: Sheria inaelekeza TRA kusindika VAT refund ndani ya kipindi maalum baada ya kupokea ombi kamili. Hata hivyo, mazoea ya vitendo yanaweza kutofautiana — ukaguzi wa kina unaweza kuchukua muda mrefu zaidi hasa kwa madai makubwa. Exporters mara nyingi hupata kipaumbele. Thibitisha muda wa sasa na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: How long does TRA take to process a VAT refund?
answer_en: The law directs TRA to process VAT refunds within a specified period after receiving a complete application. However, practical experience may vary — a thorough audit can take longer especially for large claims. Exporters often receive priority. Confirm current timelines with TRA or a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: GN 487A ina msamaha kwa wageni wanaofanya biashara kubwa (zaidi ya TZS milioni 100)?
output: Hapana — GN 487A haijatoa msamaha wowote kulingana na ukubwa wa biashara au kiasi cha mtaji. Sheria inazuia shughuli zote 15 kwa raia wote wa kigeni bila kizingiti cha mapato, mtaji, au ukubwa wa biashara. Mwekezaji mkubwa wa kigeni (TZS bilioni 10 iliyowekwa) bado anakabiliwa na marufuku ikiwa anafanya rejareja, saluni, au shughuli nyingine yoyote katika orodha ya 15. Kwa mwekezaji mkubwa wa kigeni, shughuli zilizoruhusiwa zaidi ni uwekezaji wa kilimo, viwanda, utalii, na maeneo ya uzalishaji — si rejareja au saluni. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na BRELA.

question_sw: Je, usajili wa VAT Tanzania unahitaji nini?
answer_sw: Usajili wa VAT Tanzania unahitaji: (1) Namba ya Utambulisho wa Mlipa Kodi (TIN) iliyopo; (2) Akaunti ya benki ya biashara; (3) Anwani halisi ya biashara; (4) Rekodi za mauzo zinazoonyesha kizingiti kimefikiwa (TZS 200M/12mo au 100M/6mo); (5) Fomu ya usajili wa VAT iliyojazwa (VAT Form 102). Wasiliana na ofisi ya TRA karibu nawe au tumia mfumo wa IDRAS.
question_en: What does VAT registration in Tanzania require?
answer_en: VAT registration in Tanzania requires: (1) An existing Tax Identification Number (TIN); (2) A business bank account; (3) A physical business address; (4) Sales records showing the threshold has been reached (TZS 200M/12mo or 100M/6mo); (5) Completed VAT registration form (VAT Form 102). Contact your nearest TRA office or use the IDRAS system.

instruction: Kwa nini mwajiri hawezi kutumia viwango vya mshahara wa 2022 tena?
output: Kwa sababu amri ya 2022 ilifutwa kikamilifu na GN605A. Kuanzia Januari 1, 2026, viwango vya 2022 havina nguvu ya kisheria — ni kana kwamba havijaandikwa. GN605A ndiyo mamlaka pekee inayohusika na viwango vya mshahara wa chini ya sekta binafsi Tanzania. Wafanyakazi wana haki ya kudai malipo yaliyobaki (backpay) tangu Januari 2026 kama walilipwa kwa viwango vya amri iliyofutwa.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya usajili wa OSHA na usajili wa WCF ni nini?
answer_sw: Usajili wa OSHA unahusu USALAMA mahali pa kazi — ukaguzi, viwango vya usalama, na cheti cha OSHA. Usajili wa WCF unahusu BIMA ya ajali — malipo ya mfanyakazi aliyeumia. Zote mbili zinahitajika lakini zina taratibu tofauti, ada tofauti, na mashirika tofauti.
question_en: What is the difference between OSHA registration and WCF registration?
answer_en: OSHA registration is about workplace SAFETY — inspections, safety standards, and OSHA certificate. WCF registration is about accident INSURANCE — payments to injured workers. Both are required but have separate processes, separate fees, and separate organisations.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Kizingiti cha usajilishaji wa VAT Tanzania ni ngapi kwa sasa hivi?
output: Kizingiti cha usajilishaji wa VAT ni TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka (miezi 12 inayozunguka) AU TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6 yoyote mfululizo. Mauzo yoyote yanayozidi kizingiti hiki — kwa kipindi chochote kinachozunguka — yanalazimisha usajilishaji. Thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: EFD inahitajika kwa mauzo ya mtandaoni (online sales) Tanzania?
answer_sw: TRA inashughulikia aina za EFD kwa mauzo ya kidijitali Tanzania. Mauzo ya mtandaoni yanayofanywa na biashara zilizosajili VAT bado yanahitaji ufuatiliaji wa kielelezo cha fedha. TRA inaweza kutoa mwongozo mahususi kwa biashara za mtandaoni kuhusu jinsi ya kufuata sheria za EFD kwa miamala ya kidijitali. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa hali ya EFD kwa biashara yako ya mtandaoni.
question_en: Is an EFD required for online sales in Tanzania?
answer_en: TRA is addressing EFD compliance for digital sales in Tanzania. Online sales made by VAT-registered businesses still require fiscal tracking. TRA may issue specific guidance for online businesses on how to comply with EFD requirements for digital transactions. Check TRA directly for the EFD position for your online business.

question_sw: Kampuni isiyofanya biashara (dormant company) bado ina wajibu wowote wa BRELA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni iliyolala (dormant company) bado ina wajibu wa kisheria wa: kuwasilisha ripoti ya kila mwaka (annual return) kwa BRELA kila mwaka, kulipa ada ya ripoti ya kila mwaka, na kudumisha mkurugenzi aliyesajiliwa na anwani ya makao makuu. Kutowasilisha ripoti ya kila mwaka hata kampuni ikiwa haifanyi biashara kunasababisha faini na hatimaye kufutwa kwa jina na BRELA. Ikiwa hutaki kulipa ada hizi kila mwaka, fikiria kufuta usajili wa kampuni rasmi.
answer_en: Yes. A dormant (inactive) company still has legal obligations to: file an annual return with BRELA every year, pay the annual return fee, and maintain a registered director and registered office address. Failing to file the annual return even when the company is inactive attracts fines and eventually striking off by BRELA. If you do not want to pay these fees annually, consider formally deregistering the company.
question_en: A company that is not trading (dormant company) — does it still have any BRELA obligations?

question_sw: Kampuni yetu ni designated VAT withholding agent. Je, tunazuia kiasi gani kwenye invoice ya huduma ya TZS 1,000,000 ya VAT?
answer_sw: Kwenye invoice ya huduma yenye VAT ya asilimia 18: VAT ya jumla = TZS 1,000,000 × 18% = TZS 180,000. Kama kampuni yako ni designated withholding agent, unazuia asilimia 6 ya VAT = TZS 180,000 × 6/18 = TZS 60,000. Msambazaji anapokea TZS 120,000 (asilimia 12/18 ya VAT). Unalipa TRA TZS 60,000 kama VAT iliyozuiwa na msambazaji analipa TRA TZS 120,000 iliyobaki.
question_en: Our company is a designated VAT withholding agent. How much do we withhold on a services invoice with TZS 1,000,000 VAT?
answer_en: On a services invoice with 18% VAT: Total VAT = TZS 1,000,000 × 18% = TZS 180,000. As a designated withholding agent, you withhold 6% of VAT = TZS 180,000 × 6/18 = TZS 60,000. The supplier receives TZS 120,000 (12/18 of VAT). You remit TZS 60,000 to TRA as withheld VAT and the supplier remits the remaining TZS 120,000.

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kulipa kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) TRA ni ipi?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio lazima ilipwe TRA ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa kila mwezi wa kalenda. Kwa mfano, kodi ya zuio iliyokatwa Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax remittance deadline in Tanzania?
answer_en: Withholding tax must be remitted to TRA within 7 days after the end of each calendar month. For example, withholding tax deducted in January is due by 7 February. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, SDL na NSSF ni tofauti gani katika suala la ni nani analipa?
answer_sw: NSSF: mwajiri hulipa 10% NA mfanyakazi huchangia 10% — jumla 20% ya mshahara (kila mmoja 10%). SDL: mwajiri hulipa 3.5% peke yake — mfanyakazi hachangii chochote. Ni tofauti muhimu: NSSF ni mchango wa pamoja, SDL ni ushuru wa mwajiri tu.
question_en: What is the difference between SDL and NSSF in terms of who pays?
answer_en: NSSF: the employer pays 10% AND the employee contributes 10% — a combined 20% of salary (10% each). SDL: the employer alone pays 3.5% — the employee contributes nothing. The key difference: NSSF is a joint contribution, SDL is an employer-only levy.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Kampuni ya usafirishaji inayopeleka bidhaa Kenya — VAT yake ya mafuta ya gari inastahili refund?
answer_sw: Inategemea muundo wa biashara. Kama kampuni ya usafirishaji imesajiliwa VAT na inafanya huduma za zero-rated (usafirishaji wa nje ya nchi), input VAT ya mafuta (kama ilinunuliwa kutoka msambazaji aliyesajiliwa VAT na kupata risiti ya EFD) inaweza kudaiwa kama input VAT. Thibitisha muundo wako na mshauri wa kodi au TRA.
question_en: A transport company carrying goods to Kenya — does the VAT on its diesel qualify for refund?
answer_en: It depends on the business structure. If the transport company is VAT-registered and performs zero-rated services (international transport), input VAT on fuel (if purchased from a VAT-registered supplier with an EFD receipt) may be claimable as input VAT. Confirm your structure with a tax advisor or TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: GN 605A ni nini na inaweza kuathiri biashara yangu vipi?
answer_sw: GN 605A ni Agizo la Serikali linaloweka kiwango cha chini cha mshahara kwa sekta mbalimbali Tanzania. Agizo hili lilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Kama mwajiri, lazima ulipe wafanyakazi wako angalau kiwango kilichowekwa kwa sekta yako — kutolipa ni kosa la kisheria.
question_en: What is GN 605A and how does it affect my business?
answer_en: GN 605A is a Government Notice setting the minimum wage across sectors in Tanzania. It took effect on 1 January 2026. As an employer you must pay at least the floor set for your sector — failure to comply is a legal offence.

question_sw: Wateja wanaolipa pesa taslimu — naweza kutotoa risiti ya EFD kwa sababu ni pesa taslimu tu?
answer_sw: Hapana. Aina ya malipo haibadilishi wajibu wa kutoa risiti ya EFD. Sheria ya VAT Tanzania inaitaka risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala — pesa taslimu, mobile money, benki, au njia nyingine yoyote. TRA inafanya ukaguzi wa ghafla na wateja wanaweza kuripoti biashara ambazo hazitoi risiti. Kila muamala, toa risiti ya EFD. Thibitisha na TRA kwenye tra.go.tz.
question_en: My customers pay cash — can I skip the EFD receipt because it is cash only?
answer_en: No. The payment method does not change the obligation to issue an EFD receipt. Tanzania's VAT law requires an EFD receipt for every transaction — cash, mobile money, bank transfer, or any other method. TRA conducts surprise inspections and customers can report businesses that skip receipts. Every transaction, issue an EFD receipt. Confirm with TRA at tra.go.tz.

instruction: Leseni ya OSHA inafanywa upya kila wakati gani?
output: Leseni ya utiifu wa OSHA inafanywa upya kila mwaka. Ukaguzi wa kila mwaka unahakikisha mahali pa kazi unakidhi viwango vya usalama na afya kazini. Thibitisha tarehe na utaratibu sahihi wa upya wa leseni na OSHA moja kwa moja (osha.go.tz) kwani mahitaji yanaweza kubadilika.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: biashara ya kawaida VS fani iliyodhibitiwa — tofauti yao katika VAT ni nini?
answer_sw: Tofauti kuu: BIASHARA YA KAWAIDA — usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima tu ukifika kizingiti cha TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100M kwa miezi 6. FANI ZILIZODHIBITIWA (wakili, CPA, mhandisi, daktari, msanifu majengo) — usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima MARA MOJA ukipata leseni ya kitaalamu, bila kujali mauzo. Hakuna kizingiti cha mauzo kwa fani zilizodhibitiwa — zinahitaji kusajiliwa mapema.
question_en: Summary: ordinary business VS regulated profession — what is the difference for VAT?
answer_en: Key difference: ORDINARY BUSINESS — VAT registration is mandatory only when reaching TZS 200M per 12 months or TZS 100M per 6 months threshold. REGULATED PROFESSIONS (lawyer, CPA, engineer, doctor, architect) — VAT registration is mandatory IMMEDIATELY upon obtaining a professional licence, regardless of income. There is no income threshold for regulated professions — they must register early.

question_sw: Nnataka kuingiza bidhaa kutoka nje ya nchi na kuzisambaza Tanzania. Ninahitaji leseni ya uingizaji bidhaa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uingizaji wa bidhaa Tanzania unahitaji: TIN iliyosajiliwa na TRA, nambari ya msimbo wa biashara (TIN-based importer code) kutoka TRA, na wakati mwingine leseni maalum ya bidhaa fulani — kwa mfano, dawa (TMDA), chakula (TMDA), silaha (Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani). Bidhaa zote zinazoingia Tanzania zinapita forodha na zinaweza kukaguliwa. Ikiwa unaingiza zaidi ya TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka, ulazimishwa kusajili VAT. Angalia pia orodha ya bidhaa zilizopigwa marufuku au zinazohitaji vibali maalum.
answer_en: Yes. Importing goods to Tanzania requires: a TIN registered with TRA, an importer code (TIN-based) from TRA, and sometimes a specific product licence — for example, medicines (TMDA), food (TMDA), weapons (Ministry of Interior). All goods entering Tanzania pass through customs and may be inspected. If you import more than TZS 200,000,000 per year, VAT registration is required. Also check the list of prohibited goods or goods requiring special permits.
question_en: I want to import goods from abroad and distribute them in Tanzania. Do I need an import licence?

instruction: Mgeni anasimamia tu (manager) biashara ya Mtanzania — si mmiliki — GN 487A bado inahusika?
output: GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya biashara au kuendesha shughuli katika orodha ya 15. Kusimamia biashara kama mkurugenzi mtendaji au meneja mkuu — hata bila umiliki — kunaweza kuchukuliwa kama kufanya biashara kisheria. Idara ya Uhamiaji wanaweza kuchunguza mtu anayedhibiti operesheni halisi ya biashara, si tu jina katika hati. Kama mgeni ni meneja lakini anadhibiti maamuzi yote — hali hii iko katika hatari ya kisheria. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Kwa mazoezi ya wafanyakazi wapya, tunaweza kupiga risiti za 'mazoezi' kwenye EFD halisi?
output: HAPANA — risiti za mazoezi (test receipts) kwenye EFD halisi ni hatari sana. Kila risiti inayopigwa kwenye EFD halisi inaenda kwenye TIMS ya TRA — risiti za mazoezi zinaweza kuonekana kama mauzo halisi na kuleta tatizo la kodi. Kwa mafunzo: tumia EFD ya ziada (dummy device) au omba TRA kwa utaratibu rasmi wa mafunzo.

instruction: OSHA inashughulikia malalamiko ya wafanyakazi kuhusu usalama mahali pa kazi?
output: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wanaweza toa malalamiko ya usalama moja kwa moja kwa OSHA (osha.go.tz) — hata bila taarifa ya mwajiri kwanza. Malalamiko yanaweza kusababisha ukaguzi wa ghafla. Kama mwajiri, kushughulikia malalamiko ya usalama kwa uzito na haraka ni bora — kusubiri OSHA ikuje kunaweza kusababisha adhabu kubwa. Anzisha njia ya ndani ya malalamiko ya usalama ili kutatua matatizo mapema.

question_sw: Mwajiri mgeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania — analipa SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri yeyote anayeendesha biashara Tanzania na kulipa mishahara kwa wafanyakazi Tanzania analipa SDL kama ana wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Uraia wa mwajiri (mgeni au raia) hauthiri wajibu wa SDL.
question_en: A foreign employer operating in Tanzania — do they pay SDL?
answer_en: Yes. Any employer operating a business in Tanzania and paying salaries to Tanzania-based employees pays SDL if they have 10 or more employees. The citizenship of the employer (foreign or citizen) does not affect the SDL obligation.

question_sw: Simplified Customs Document (SCD) ni rahisi kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SCD ni fomu rahisi ya forodha iliyoundwa maalum kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo wa STR. Ina sehemu chache zaidi na lugha rahisi zaidi kuliko fomu ya kawaida ya forodha. Lengo lake ni kupunguza ugumu wa karatasi kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo ambao wengi hawana elimu ya juu ya biashara.
question_en: How simplified is the Simplified Customs Document (SCD)?
answer_en: The SCD is a simplified customs form designed specifically for small STR traders. It has fewer sections and simpler language than the standard customs form. Its purpose is to reduce paperwork complexity for small traders, many of whom may not have advanced business education.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini wa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa ni Shilingi 400,000 — je, namba hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati, kiwango cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni karibu Shilingi 765,900 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 400,000. Hii ndiyo kiwango cha juu zaidi katika agizo lote.
question_en: The minimum wage for international mining is TZS 400,000 — is this figure correct?
answer_en: No. For the international mining and energy sector the GN 605A minimum wage floor is approximately TZS 765,900 per month — not TZS 400,000. This is the highest rate in the entire order.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kuendelea kufanya biashara wakati kesi ya kodi iko TRAB — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa kawaida. Kesi ya kodi inayoendelea mbele ya TRAB haizuii kampuni kuendelea kufanya biashara. Hata hivyo, TRA inaweza kuchukua hatua za makusanyo kwa kiasi kisichopingwa au kisicholipwa. Cheti cha utii wa kodi kinaweza kuathirika.
question_en: Can a company continue to operate while a tax case is before TRAB — is this true?
answer_en: Yes, generally. A pending TRAB tax case does not stop a company from continuing to operate. However, TRA can take collection action for undisputed or unpaid amounts. A tax clearance certificate may be affected.

question_sw: OSHA inaweza kutozwa kwa mwajiri ambaye mfanyakazi wake aliumia nje ya saa za kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, OSHA na WCF zinashughulikia majeraha YA MAHALI PA KAZI na wakati wa kazi. Majeraha yanayotokea nje ya saa za kazi na mahali pa kazi (kama mfanyakazi alianguka nyumbani kwake) kwa kawaida HAYASHUGHULIKIW na WCF kama jeraha la kazini. Hata hivyo, kama jeraha lilitokea wakati mfanyakazi alikuwa akifanya shughuli inayohusiana na kazi (kama safari ya biashara), WCF inaweza kutumika.
question_en: Can OSHA impose liability on an employer if a worker was injured outside working hours in Tanzania?
answer_en: Generally, OSHA and WCF deal with injuries AT THE WORKPLACE and during working hours. Injuries occurring outside working hours and the workplace (such as a worker falling at their home) are generally NOT treated by WCF as a workplace injury. However, if the injury occurred while the worker was performing a work-related activity (such as a business trip), WCF may apply.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act or WCF Act amendment

instruction: Biashara yangu ya mpya inatazamia mapato ya TZS 300M kwa mwaka wa kwanza — ninaweza kusajili VAT mapema (voluntary registration)?
output: Ndiyo — TRA inaruhusu usajili wa hiari wa VAT (voluntary registration) hata kabla ya kufika kizingiti. Faida za usajili wa mapema: (1) Unaweza kudai input VAT kwa manunuzi yako ya awali (vifaa, vifaa vya biashara); (2) Wateja wako wa VAT wanaweza kudai input VAT — inakufanya mvutia zaidi kwa makampuni makubwa; (3) Unapata TRA VRN (VAT Registration Number) mapema. Hasara ndogo: unaanza wajibu wa kuwasilisha VAT return kila mwezi. Kwa biashara inayotazamia mapato makubwa, usajili wa mapema unashauriwa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Nini tofauti kati ya usajili wa biashara BRELA na leseni ya biashara ya serikali ya mtaa?
answer_sw: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) inasajili biashara kisheria — yaani inazipa hadhi ya kisheria ya kufanya biashara Tanzania kama kampuni au jina la biashara. Leseni ya biashara ya serikali ya mtaa (LGA) ni ruhusa ya kufanya shughuli mahususi katika eneo la mtaa fulani — inatolewa na Halmashauri husika. Biashara nyingi zinahitaji ZOTE mbili: usajili wa BRELA kwanza, kisha leseni ya LGA ya eneo unakofanya biashara. Ni wajibu tofauti mbili za kisheria.
answer_en: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) legally registers a business — giving it a legal identity to operate in Tanzania as a company or business name. The Local Government Authority (LGA) business licence is a permit to conduct specific activities in a particular area — issued by the relevant council. Most businesses need BOTH: BRELA registration first, then an LGA licence for the area where they operate. They are two separate legal obligations.
question_en: What is the difference between BRELA business registration and a local government business licence?
primary_source_name: BRELA — business registration vs LGA licensing

instruction: BRELA inasajili aina ngapi za biashara Tanzania?
output: BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Kwa usajili au maswali zaidi, tembelea brela.go.tz.

question_sw: Usajili wa BRELA unalinda dhidi ya GN 487A — kweli au uongo?
answer_sw: Uongo. Usajili wa BRELA ni hitaji la msingi la kisheria kwa biashara yoyote, lakini haumruhusu mwenye hisa mgeni kufanya biashara yoyote iliyokatazwa. GN 487A inabaki kuzuia shughuli 15 bila kujali hali ya usajili wa BRELA. Hata ukisajili kampuni yako vizuri BRELA, bado huwezi kuendesha duka la rejareja kama mgeni.
question_en: Does BRELA registration protect against GN 487A — true or false?
answer_en: False. BRELA registration is a basic legal requirement for any business, but does not allow a foreign shareholder to conduct any prohibited activity. GN 487A still blocks the 15 activities regardless of BRELA registration status. Even if you register your company properly with BRELA, you still cannot run a retail shop as a non-citizen.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kufanya biashara bila EFD kwa siku chache hadi ifike mbadala?
answer_sw: Kwa muda mfupi wa uharibika, unaweza kutumia stakabadhi za mkono zilizochapishwa awali (pre-printed manual receipt book) iliyoidhinishwa na TRA — hii inaruhusiwa kisheria kama njia ya dharura. Hata hivyo, lazima ufanye mambo mawili: (1) Utaarififu TRA ndani ya masaa 24; (2) Urejeshe EFD haraka iwezekanavyo. Kutumia stakabadhi za mkono bila kutaarififu TRA au kwa muda mrefu bila sababu ya kweli kunaweza kusababisha adhabu.
question_en: Can I conduct business without EFD for a few days until a replacement arrives?
answer_en: For a short breakdown period, you may use TRA-approved pre-printed manual receipt books — this is legally permitted as an emergency measure. However, you must do two things: (1) Notify TRA within 24 hours; (2) Restore the EFD as quickly as possible. Using manual receipts without notifying TRA or for an extended period without genuine reason may result in penalties.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi mgeni anahitaji TIN Tanzania kwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kila mtu anayepokea mapato Tanzania — raia au mgeni — anahitaji TIN (Tax Identification Number) ya TRA. TIN inahitajika kwa mwajiri kuwasilisha PAYE returns na kwa mfanyakazi kuwasilisha kodi zake binafsi. Omba TIN kwa mfanyakazi mgeni wako mapema iwezekanavyo baada ya kuanza kazi.
question_en: Does a foreign employee need a Tanzania TIN for PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. Every person receiving income in Tanzania — citizens and foreigners — needs a TRA TIN (Tax Identification Number). The TIN is required for the employer to file PAYE returns and for the employee to file personal taxes. Apply for a TIN for your foreign employee as early as possible after they start work.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, mwajiri anaweza kupunguza malipo ya ziada kama posho ya usafiri kutoka mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A lazima ulipwe kamili — posho za ziada kama usafiri, chakula, au makazi hazihesabiwi kama sehemu ya mshahara wa chini isipokuwa sheria inaruhusu hilo moja kwa moja. Mwajiri hawezi kutumia posho kupunguza mshahara wa msingi.
question_en: Can an employer deduct transport allowances from the minimum wage payment?
answer_en: No. The GN 605A minimum wage must be paid in full — additional allowances like transport, food, or housing do not count as part of the minimum wage unless the law explicitly permits it. An employer cannot use allowances to reduce the basic salary below the floor.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana haki ya kupata nakala ya ripoti ya uchunguzi wa ajali?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi aliyeathiriwa na ajali, au wawakilishi wake, wana haki ya kupata nakala ya ripoti ya uchunguzi wa ajali iliyofanywa na mwajiri au OSHA. Uwazi huu ni sehemu ya haki za mfanyakazi chini ya Sheria ya OSHA.
question_en: Does a worker have the right to obtain a copy of an accident investigation report?
answer_en: Yes. An affected worker, or their representatives, has the right to obtain a copy of the accident investigation report prepared by the employer or OSHA. This transparency is part of workers' rights under the OSHA Act.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Je, OSHA ni sawa na bima ya wafanyakazi (WCF)?
answer_sw: Hapana. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inashughulikia USALAMA na KINGA mahali pa kazi — usajili wa usalama na ukaguzi. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) inashughulikia BIMA ya ajali — malipo ya fidia baada ya mfanyakazi kuumia. Waajiri wote wanawajibika kwa zote mbili.
question_en: Is OSHA the same as workers compensation insurance (WCF)?
answer_en: No. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) deals with workplace SAFETY and PREVENTION — safety registration and inspections. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) deals with accident INSURANCE — compensation payments after a worker is injured. All employers are liable to both.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Adhabu ya raia wa Tanzania aliyeruhusu mgeni kutumia jina lake kufungua duka — ni nini hasa?
output: Raia wa Tanzania anayewezesha mgeni kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa chini ya GN 487A anakabiliwa na: faini ya TZS milioni 5 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 3 — si zote mbili pamoja. Hii ni adhabu tofauti kabisa na ile ya mgeni (ambaye anaadhibiwa zaidi: TZS milioni 10 AU miezi 6, PAMOJA NA kufutwa kwa visa). Raia wa Tanzania hawezi kufutwa visa kwa sababu ana uraia — lakini adhabu ya jinai bado inatumika. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

instruction: Mgeni wa kigeni alikuwa ni mshirika wa kimya tu (silent partner) katika duka la rejareja — je, GN 487A inamhusu?
output: Ndiyo — GN 487A inazuia pia 'kuwezesha' mgeni kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa. Mshirika wa kimya anayeweka mtaji au kupata faida kutoka biashara iliyokatazwa anaweza kushughulikiwa kama mwenye uhusiano na ukiukwaji. Hii inaweza kuhusisha pia Mtanzania aliyekubali kuwa mshirika wa kimya. Adhabu ya mgeni (faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6) PAMOJA NA kufutwa kwa visa inaweza kutumika. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Je, kuna tofauti ya ada kati ya kusajili kampuni ya ndani na kampuni ya kigeni (foreign company)?
output: Ndiyo, ada za usajilishaji wa kampuni ya kigeni (foreign company) ni tofauti na za kampuni za ndani — mara nyingi ni za juu zaidi. Kwa ada za sasa za aina zote za usajilishaji, angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz au mfumo wa ORS (ors.brela.go.tz). Usitegemee takwimu za ada zilizotolewa na vyanzo visivyo rasmi kwani zinaweza kuwa za zamani.

question_sw: Tanzania ina mkataba wa kuzuia kodi mara mbili (double taxation treaty) na India — inaathiri nini biashara yangu?
answer_sw: Mikataba ya kuzuia kodi mara mbili (double taxation treaties) ni eneo la kisheria la kimataifa linaloenda zaidi ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Tanzania ina mikataba kadhaa na nchi mbalimbali. Athari kwa biashara yako mahususi inategemea muundo wako wa kimataifa na aina ya mapato. Muona wakili wa kodi ya kimataifa au mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu.
question_en: Tanzania has a double taxation treaty with India — how does it affect my business?
answer_en: Double taxation treaties are an international legal area that goes beyond my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Tanzania has several treaties with various countries. The effect on your specific business depends on your international structure and income types. Consult an international tax lawyer or qualified tax accountant.

question_sw: Nithibitishe kiwango cha mshahara wa chini wa sekta yangu — niende wapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha mshahara wa chini kwa sekta yako kinapatikana: (1) Tovuti ya MLYWF (mlywf.go.tz) au ofisi yoyote ya kazi; (2) TanzLII (tanzlii.org) — tafuta 'GN 605A'; (3) Shirika la wafanyakazi au chama cha waajiri cha sekta yako. Thibitisha kiwango halisi kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: How do I verify the minimum wage for my specific sector under GN 605A?
answer_en: The minimum wage for your sector is available at: (1) MLYWF website (mlywf.go.tz) or any labour office; (2) TanzLII (tanzlii.org) — search 'GN 605A'; (3) Your sector's trade union or employers' association. Confirm the exact rate before processing payroll.

instruction: Je, bidhaa na huduma vina kiwango sawa cha VAT withholding?
output: Hapana. Bidhaa na huduma vina viwango tofauti vya VAT withholding — kiwango cha bidhaa ni tofauti na kile cha huduma. Kwa hesabu sahihi ya kiasi kinachokatwa kwenye invoice yako, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Usitegemee bidhaa na huduma kuwa sawa.

question_sw: Mgahawa wangu wa karibu na soko unapata TZS 250,000,000 kwa mwaka. Je, ninalazimika na EFD?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mauzo ya TZS 250,000,000 kwa mwaka yanazidi kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT (TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12). Lazima ujisajili kwa VAT na baada ya usajili, unahitaji EFD au VFD. Ukichelewa kusajili VAT na EFD, unaweza kukabili adhabu za malimbikizo ya VAT. Hatua: (1) Jisajili kwa VAT na TRA; (2) Pata EFD au VFD kutoka kwa muuzaji aliyeidhinishwa; (3) Anza kutoa risiti za EFD.
question_en: My restaurant near the market earns TZS 250,000,000 per year. Am I required to have EFD?
answer_en: Yes. Sales of TZS 250,000,000 per year exceed the VAT registration threshold (TZS 200,000,000 in 12 months). You must register for VAT and after registration, you need EFD or VFD. Delaying VAT and EFD registration may result in backdated VAT penalties. Steps: (1) Register for VAT with TRA; (2) Get an EFD or VFD from an approved supplier; (3) Start issuing EFD receipts.

instruction: Adhabu ya kutumia EFD isiyoidhinishwa na TRA ni nini?
output: Kutumia EFD isiyoidhinishwa au iliyonunuliwa kutoka kwa msambazaji asiye na idhini ya TRA ni ukiukwaji mkubwa. Biashara inaweza kukabiliwa na: kufungwa kwa biashara, faini kubwa, na uwezekano wa mashtaka ya udanganyifu wa kodi. EFD isiyoidhinishwa pia haiwezi kupeleka data kwa TRA — miamala yote itaonekana kama imefichwa. Nunua EFD kutoka msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa TRA pekee.

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutotumia EFD Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Kutotumia EFD kwa biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT kunaweza kusababisha: adhabu ya kutotoa risiti kwa kila muamala uliokosekana, kusimamishwa kwa leseni ya biashara, kusimamishwa kwa usajili wa VAT, tathmini ya VAT ya malimbikizo kwa kipindi chote, na adhabu za ziada za kodi. TRA inaweza pia kuwasilisha kesi ya jinai kwa ukwepaji wa kodi unaoendelea. Mfumo wa EFD ulioundwa kuzuia ukwepaji — adhabu zake ni kali.
question_en: What are the penalties for not using EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: Failure to use EFD for a VAT-registered business may result in: penalties per missed receipt transaction, suspension of business licence, suspension of VAT registration, backdated VAT assessments for the entire period, and additional tax penalties. TRA may also file criminal charges for ongoing tax evasion. The EFD system was designed to prevent evasion — its penalties are severe.

instruction: Nilipiwa faini kwa kuchelewa kusajiliwa VAT. Je, faini ni ngapi?
output: Adhabu kwa kushindwa kusajiliwa VAT kwa wakati ni: faini ya hadi TZS 200,000 NA/AU kifungo cha miezi 2 hadi 12 PAMOJA NA riba kwenye VAT yote iliyostahili kukusanywa na kutolipwa. Kumbuka: kuchelewa kusajiliwa ni tofauti na kuchelewa kulipa VAT — zote mbili zina adhabu. Kama una tatizo la usajilishaji uliochelewa, wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kodi haraka.

instruction: Ikiwa ninaajiri wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, lazima nilipe SDL peke yake au WCF pia?
output:
Ukiwa na wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, lazima ulipe ZOTE MBILI — SDL na WCF. Hata hivyo, kuna tofauti muhimu ya kizingiti:

SDL = 3.5% ya mishahara ya fedha — inalipwa TRA — mafunzo ya ujuzi — inahitaji wafanyakazi 10+.
WCF = 0.5% ya mishahara ya fedha — inalipwa Mamlaka ya WCF — fidia ya majeruhi wa kazi — inahitajika mara tu unapoajiri mfanyakazi MMOJA (hata kabla ya kufikia 10).

Kwa hivyo: WCF inatumika kuanzia mfanyakazi wa kwanza — si kutoka 10. SDL inatumika ukiwa na wafanyakazi 10+. Hazilipwi pamoja kwa mtu mmoja — TRA inapokea SDL na Mamlaka ya WCF inapokea WCF tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz na Mamlaka ya WCF kupitia wcf.go.tz.

instruction: Tofauti ya biashara ya jina, ubia, na kampuni ya hisa ni nini kwa BRELA?
output: BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Biashara ya jina (sole trader): mmiliki mmoja, anahusika kikamilifu kwa madeni. Ubia (partnership): wamiliki wawili au zaidi, wanashiriki faida na madeni. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company): chombo huru kisheria, wanahisa wana dhamana ndogo tu.

instruction: Je, GN605A ina kiwango kimoja cha mshahara kwa wafanyakazi wote Tanzania?
output: Hapana. GN605A haina kiwango kimoja cha wote — ina sekta 16 na subsekta nyingi, kila moja ikiwa na kiwango chake maalum. Viwango vinatofautiana sana kati ya sekta: kutoka TZS 80,000 (wafanyakazi wa nyumbani fulani) hadi TZS 765,900 (nishati ya kimataifa). Kila mwajiri lazima atumie kiwango cha sekta yake — si wastani wa taifa. Thibitisha kiwango cha sekta yako kwa kupitia GN605A kwenye tanzlii.org.

question_sw: Adhabu kwa mwajiri anayelipa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayelipa chini ya kiwango cha mshahara wa chini anaweza kukabili: malimbikizo ya tofauti ya mshahara, faini chini ya ELRA, au kesi ya kisheria iliyowasilishwa na mfanyakazi. Ukaguzi wa MLYWF unaweza kuanzisha hatua za kisheria. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: What is the penalty for an employer paying below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: An employer paying below the minimum wage may face: back-payment of wage shortfalls, fines under ELRA, or legal proceedings filed by the employee. MLYWF labour inspectors can initiate enforcement action. Confirm with a legal adviser.

question_sw: Biashara mpya iliyosajili VAT ina muda gani wa kupata na kusajili EFD Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara inayosajili VAT Tanzania inapaswa kupata na kusajili EFD haraka iwezekanavyo — kwa kawaida ndani ya muda mfupi wa kuanza kufanya mauzo ya VAT. TRA inaweza kutoa mwongozo mahususi wa muda wa kupata EFD baada ya usajili wa VAT. Kufanya mauzo ya VAT bila EFD (baada ya kulazimishwa) ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT na EFD.
question_en: A new VAT-registered business — how much time does it have to obtain and register an EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: A business registering for VAT in Tanzania should obtain and register an EFD as quickly as possible — generally within a short period of starting to make VAT sales. TRA may provide specific timing guidance on EFD acquisition after VAT registration. Making VAT sales without an EFD (after being required to) is a violation of VAT and EFD law.

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje (foreign company) inaweza kumiliki duka la reja reja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana chini ya GN 487A. Biashara ya reja reja ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni. Kampuni inayomilikiwa na wageni haiwezi kufanya biashara ya reja reja Tanzania Bara. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TIC.
question_en: Can a foreign-owned company own a retail shop in Tanzania?
answer_en: No under GN 487A. Retail trade is one of the 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens. A company owned by foreigners cannot conduct retail business in Tanzania Mainland. Confirm with the Immigration Department and TIC.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: SSRA ni nini na inahusiana vipi na NSSF?
answer_sw: SSRA (Social Security Regulatory Authority) ni msimamizi wa mifuko yote ya hifadhi ya jamii Tanzania — ikiwemo NSSF, PPF, GEPF, na LAPF. SSRA inaweka viwango vya utawala, haki za washiriki, na miongozo ya uwekezaji kwa mifuko yote. NSSF yenyewe ni mfuko mkubwa zaidi wa hifadhi ya jamii Tanzania, unaoshughulikia sekta kubwa ya binafsi. Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla.
question_en: What is SSRA and how does it relate to NSSF?
answer_en: SSRA (Social Security Regulatory Authority) is the regulator of all social security funds in Tanzania — including NSSF, PPF, GEPF, and LAPF. SSRA sets governance standards, member rights, and investment guidelines for all funds. NSSF itself is Tanzania's largest social security fund, covering most of the private sector. NSSF contribution rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage.

question_sw: EFD inaweza kusaidia kupambana na wizi wa wafanyakazi (staff theft) kwenye biashara ya rejareja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa njia fulani. EFD inarekodia kila muamala na inaweza kuonyesha takwimu za mauzo kwa kila kasher au saa. Meneja anaweza kulinganisha mauzo ya EFD na stoo iliyokuwepo ili kutambua tofauti. Hata hivyo, EFD imeundwa kwa madhumuni ya kodi ya TRA — si mfumo wa kudhibiti wizi hasa. Biashara zinazohitaji udhibiti mkali wa ulinzi wa ndani zinapaswa kutumia mifumo ya akaunti ya ndani ya ziada.
question_en: Can an EFD help prevent staff theft in a retail business in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes, to some extent. An EFD records every transaction and can show sales figures per cashier or per hour. A manager can compare EFD sales against stock held to identify discrepancies. However, the EFD is designed for TRA tax purposes — not specifically as a theft control system. Businesses needing strict internal security controls should use additional internal accounting systems.

question_sw: Mgeni anafanya kazi kama CEO wa kampuni kubwa ya biashara ya jumla. Je, ana tatizo la GN 487A?
answer_sw: Mgeni kama CEO (mfanyakazi wa ajira) wa kampuni inayomilikiwa halisi na Watanzania — hali hii ni tofauti na kufanya biashara mwenyewe. GN 487A inazuia wageni kufanya biashara zilizoorodheshwa — si kwa lazima kufanya kazi kama mfanyakazi wa kampuni ya Watanzania. Hata hivyo: ikiwa mgeni ni CEO na pia mmiliki wa hisa nyingi — inaweza kuzingatiwa kufanya biashara, si kufanya kazi tu. Mstari huu mwembamba unahitaji ushauri wa kisheria kwa hali mahususi.
question_en: A non-citizen works as CEO of a large wholesale trading company. Do they have a GN 487A problem?
answer_en: A non-citizen as CEO (employed worker) of a company genuinely owned by Tanzanians — this situation differs from personally conducting a business. GN 487A prohibits non-citizens from conducting the listed businesses — not necessarily from working as an employee of a Tanzanian-owned company. However: if the non-citizen is CEO AND also majority shareholder — it may be treated as conducting business, not merely working. This fine line requires legal advice for the specific situation.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or related case law

instruction: Adhabu ya kutotoa risiti ya EFD ni nini?
output: Adhabu kwa kukosa kutoa risiti ya EFD ni pamoja na: faini ya pesa, kufungwa kwa biashara kwa muda, na uwezekano wa mashtaka ya udanganyifu wa kodi. TRA ina mamlaka ya kufika bila taarifa (surprise inspection) na kukagua miamala. Epuka adhabu hizi kwa kutoa risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala bila ubaguzi. Kwa kiasi halisi cha faini, thibitisha na TRA kwa maelekezo ya sasa.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: OSHA na WCF ni shirika moja tu — ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. OSHA na WCF ni mashirika tofauti kabisa yanayofanya kazi tofauti. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inasimamia USALAMA kazini. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) inasimamia BIMA ya ajali za kazi. Waajiri wanalazimika kusajiliwa na ZOTE MBILI kwa namna tofauti.
question_en: OSHA and WCF are just one organisation — is this true?
answer_en: No. OSHA and WCF are completely separate organisations with different functions. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) oversees workplace SAFETY. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) administers workplace accident INSURANCE. Employers must register with BOTH separately.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Serikali ya Tanzania (Wizara) inanunua bidhaa kutoka kampuni yangu — je, wizara ni qualifying buyer wa VAT withholding?
output: Ndiyo — wizara za serikali ya Tanzania zinazowekea mapato yao mwenyewe (those retaining own revenue) ni qualifying buyers wa VAT withholding moja kwa moja. Pia: Wizara ya Fedha ni qualifying buyer moja kwa moja. Taasisi za serikali zilizo katika orodha ya CG-designated qualifying buyers pia zinashiriki. Kwa bidhaa: Wizara inachukua 3% ya VAT kama withholding na kutuma TRA (si kwa muuzaji). Kwa huduma: Wizara inachukua 6%. Muuzaji wa kampuni ya kawaida anayeuza kwa Wizara anatarajia kupokea VAT pungufu ya withholding. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mtu lazima asajili VAT ndani ya muda gani baada ya kufikia kizingiti?
answer_sw: Mtu anayehitajika kusajiliwa VAT lazima afanye maombi kwa Kamishna Mkuu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kufikia kizingiti. Kukosa kusajili kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha usajili wa lazima na faini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Within what time must a business register for VAT after reaching the threshold?
answer_en: A person required to register for VAT must apply to the Commissioner General within 30 days of reaching the threshold. Failing to register on time may result in compulsory registration and penalties. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu inafunza wanafunzi (apprentices) chini ya mpango wa serikali. Je, hii inaathiri wajibu wa SDL?
answer_sw: Hali ya wanafunzi wa mafunzo na SDL inategemea muundo wa mpango: ikiwa mwanafunzi analipwa posho ya mafunzo (training allowance) tu — si mshahara kamili wa ajira — posho hiyo inaweza kutolewa kwenye msingi wa SDL. Ikiwa mwanafunzi anachukuliwa kama mfanyakazi kamili na analipwa mshahara, SDL inatumika. Mipango ya mafunzo iliyoidhinishwa na serikali inaweza kuwa na masharti tofauti — thibitisha na VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na TRA kabla ya kuamua jinsi ya kuhesabu.
answer_en: The SDL treatment of apprentices depends on the programme structure: if the apprentice receives only a training allowance — not a full employment salary — that allowance may be excluded from the SDL base. If the apprentice is treated as a full employee and paid a salary, SDL applies. Government-approved training programmes may have different conditions — confirm with VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and TRA before deciding how to calculate.
question_en: My company trains apprentices under a government scheme. Does this affect the SDL obligation?
next_review_trigger: VETA Act amendment or TRA circular on apprenticeship SDL

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kutumia EFD moja kwa biashara yangu ya jumla na biashara ya rejareja tofauti?
answer_sw: Hapana — EFD moja inasajiliwa kwa TIN moja na eneo moja la biashara. Biashara ya jumla (wholesale) na ya rejareja (retail) zinazofanya kazi kama biashara tofauti (TIN tofauti) zinahitaji EFD tofauti. Hata kama TIN ni moja, ikiwa mauzo yanafanyika maeneo tofauti (anwani tofauti), kila eneo linahitaji EFD yake. Wasiliana na TRA kwa hali yako maalum.
question_en: Can I use one EFD for my separate wholesale and retail businesses?
answer_en: No — one EFD is registered to one TIN and one business location. Wholesale and retail businesses operating as separate businesses (different TINs) need separate EFDs. Even with one TIN, if sales occur at different locations (different addresses), each location needs its own EFD. Contact TRA for your specific situation.

instruction: Kampuni ya kigeni inayoingia Tanzania — inahitaji nini kutoka BRELA?
output: Kampuni ya kigeni inayofanya kazi Tanzania inapaswa kusajili TAWI (branch) kwa BRELA chini ya Sehemu XII ya Companies Act. Ada za tawi la kigeni: USD 750 (nakala iliyothibitishwa ya hati za kampuni mama) + USD 220 (kufungua faili na kusajili hati). Faini ya kuchelewa kwa tawi la kigeni ni USD 25/mwezi. Mbadala: kuanzisha kampuni mpya ya Tanzania (subsidiary) badala ya tawi. Tawi na kampuni ya Tanzania zina mifumo tofauti ya kisheria na kodi. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: EFD ya zamani (model ya zamani) inaweza kubadilishwa na EFD mpya — ni lazima kusajili tena?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ikiwa unabadilisha EFD machine na machine mpya, lazima: (1) fungua EFD ya zamani rasmi kupitia mfumo wa TRA na msambazaji wako, (2) sajili EFD mpya kwa biashara yako na TIN yako, (3) uhakikishe data ya zamani imehamishwa ipasavyo au imehifadhiwa. Usianza tu kutumia EFD mpya bila kufunga ya zamani na kusajili mpya — hii ni ukiukwaji wa mfumo wa TRA.
question_en: An old EFD machine is being replaced with a new one — must it be re-registered?
answer_en: Yes. When you replace an EFD machine with a new one, you must: (1) formally close the old EFD through the TRA system and your supplier, (2) register the new EFD to your business and TIN, (3) ensure old data is properly transferred or preserved. Do not simply start using a new EFD without closing the old one and registering the new one — this is a violation of TRA's system.

question_sw: Je, GN 487A inatumika Zanzibar pia?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika. Sheria za Serikali ya Muungano na Serikali ya Mapinduzi Zanzibar (SMZ) zina mipaka tofauti — biashara nyingi za ndani ni suala la SMZ peke yake. Thibitisha na Ofisi ya Msajili wa Biashara Zanzibar au mwanasheria anayejua sheria za Zanzibar.
question_en: Does GN 487A also apply in Zanzibar?
answer_en: I am not certain. Laws of the Union Government and the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar (RGZ) have different jurisdictions — many internal business matters fall solely under RGZ. Verify with the Zanzibar Business Registrar's Office or a lawyer familiar with Zanzibar law.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unaweza kurejeshwa (refund) ikiwa muamala haukufanikia?
answer_sw: Ikiwa muamala wa ardhi haukukamilika (kwa mfano, mkataba ulifutwa rasmi kabla ya kutekelezwa), inaweza kuwa na utaratibu wa kuomba kurejesha ushuru wa stempu uliolipwa Tanzania. Utaratibu huu kwa kawaida unahitaji ushahidi wa kufutwa kwa muamala na maombi rasmi kwa TRA ndani ya muda fulani. Angalia TRA kwa masharti na tarehe za mwisho za maombi ya kurejesha.
question_en: Can Tanzania stamp duty be refunded if a transaction does not go through?
answer_en: If a property transaction is not completed (for example, the contract was formally cancelled before execution), there may be a procedure to apply for a refund of paid stamp duty in Tanzania. This process usually requires evidence of transaction cancellation and a formal application to TRA within a certain period. Check TRA for conditions and deadlines for refund applications.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or Tax Administration Act update

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi kinaweza kuhamishiwa kampuni nyingine bila kuomba upya?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, kibali cha kazi Tanzania hakim transfer otomatiki kwa kampuni nyingine. Mabadiliko ya mwajiri yanahitaji mchakato rasmi wa uhamiaji — ama kuomba kibali kipya au marekebisho ya kibali kilichopo kupitia Idara ya Uhamiaji. Omba ushauri kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa hali maalum.
question_en: Can a work permit be transferred to a different company without reapplying?
answer_en: Generally, a Tanzania work permit does not transfer automatically to another company. A change of employer requires a formal immigration process — either a new permit application or an amendment to the existing permit through the Immigration Department. Seek guidance from the Immigration Department for specific circumstances.

instruction: OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa muda gani — na kama itakuta tatizo, inafanya nini?
output: Ukaguzi wa OSHA unaweza kuchukua saa chache hadi siku kadhaa kulingana na ukubwa wa biashara. Wakaguzi wa OSHA wanakagua: mazingira ya kazi, vifaa vya usalama, usafi, hewa, taa, nishati ya umeme, kemikali hatari, na kama safety officer yupo (kwa biashara 50+). KAMA TATIZO LINAPATIKANA: (1) Notisi ya marekebisho (improvement notice) — inaweza kutoa muda wa kurekebisha; (2) Kama tatizo ni hatari ya papo hapo — wanaweza kusimamisha kazi mara moja; (3) Kutopata tatizo baada ya notisi → faini, mashtaka ya kisheria; (4) Wakurugenzi wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa matatizo makubwa ya usalama. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz.

question_sw: Muuzaji wa jumla kutoka India ana ghala la bidhaa Dar — je, GN 487A inamhusu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, GN 487A inamhusu moja kwa moja. Biashara ya jumla (wholesale trade) ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuendesha ghala la bidhaa na kuuza kwa wingi. Muuzaji huyu kutoka India lazima asimamishe shughuli hii au ahamishie umiliki kwa raia wa Tanzania kwa njia inayokubalika kisheria. Kutofuata amri hii kunaweza kusababisha faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Anashauriwa kupata ushauri wa kisheria haraka.
question_en: A wholesale trader from India has a warehouse in Dar — does GN 487A apply to him?
answer_en: Yes, GN 487A directly applies to him. Wholesale trade is one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens, including operating a product warehouse and selling in bulk. This trader from India must cease the activity or transfer ownership to a Tanzanian citizen through a legally compliant structure. Non-compliance may result in a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. He is advised to seek legal advice urgently.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Msambazaji anapata nini baada ya mnunuzi anayehitimu kukata VAT withholding?
output: Msambazaji anapata: (1) bei yote ya bidhaa au huduma yake, na (2) sehemu ya VAT iliyobaki baada ya withholding kukatwa. Pia anapata certificate ya withholding kama uthibitisho kwamba mnunuzi anayehitimu alipeleka sehemu ya VAT TRA moja kwa moja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Hati ya mauzo iliyoandikwa vizuri bila kulipwa ushuru wa stempu bado ni hati halali ya kisheria Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana kwa ujumla. Hati inayohitaji ushuru wa stempu lakini haijalipwa inaweza kukosa nguvu ya kisheria au kukataliwi na mahakama. Hata kama hati imeandikwa vizuri — ina pande zote mbili, masharti wazi, na sahihi za kisheria — kukosa ushuru wa stempu kunaweza kuifanya hati hiyo isitekelezwe kisheria. Lipa ushuru wa stempu mara baada ya kusaini.
question_en: A well-written sale instrument without stamp duty paid is still a legally valid document in Tanzania?
answer_en: Generally no. An instrument requiring stamp duty but unpaid may lack legal force or be rejected by courts. Even if the instrument is well-written — has both parties, clear terms, and legal signatures — missing stamp duty can make the instrument unenforceable in law. Pay stamp duty promptly after signing.

instruction: Rafiki yangu alisema sole trader asiohitaji BRELA ni huyo anayetumia jina lake — ukweli ni upi?
output: Rafiki yako alikosea. Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Ukweli: sheria haifanyi ubaguzi wowote kulingana na jina unalotumia. Kila mfanyabiashara Tanzania Bara anahitaji usajili wa BRELA.

question_sw: Je, SDL na PAYE ni kodi moja?
answer_sw: Hapana, ni kodi mbili tofauti. PAYE (Pay As You Earn) ni kodi ya mapato inayokatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi na mwajiri anapeleka TRA. SDL ni Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inayolipwa na mwajiri peke yake kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara. Zinawasilishwa pamoja siku ya 7 lakini ni malipo tofauti.
question_en: Are SDL and PAYE the same tax?
answer_en: No, they are two different levies. PAYE (Pay As You Earn) is an income tax deducted from the employee's salary and remitted by the employer to TRA. SDL is the Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — paid by the employer only at 3.5% of gross payroll. Both are submitted together on the 7th but are separate payments.

question_sw: Mgeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania anahitaji kibali gani?
answer_sw: Mgeni anayeajiriwa na kampuni Tanzania anahitaji Kibali cha Makazi daraja C (Residence Permit Class C) — kibali cha kufanya kazi. Kibali hutolewa na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Mgeni lazima awe na mwajiri rasmi kabla ya kuomba kibali. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What permit does a foreign national employed in Tanzania need?
answer_en: A foreign national employed by a company in Tanzania needs a Class C Residence Permit — a work permit. It is issued by the Immigration Department. The foreigner must have a formal employer before applying. Confirm with the Immigration Department.
next_review_trigger: GN 487A enforcement update or immigration regulation change

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana hisa za kampuni anayofanyia kazi. Anapopata hisa au dividendi — anatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Hisa zinazotolewa kama sehemu ya fidia ya ajira (employee share scheme) zinatozwa PAYE kwa thamani ya soko wakati wa kupewa. Dividendi zinazolipwa kwa hisa hizo baadaye zinatozwa kodi ya kizuizi ya 5% (kwa wakazi wa Tanzania) — si PAYE. Kwa mipango tata ya hisa au options, thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi — muda na thamani ya utozaji unaweza kutofautiana. Rekodi sahihi za thamani ya hisa ni muhimu.
answer_en: Shares granted as part of employment compensation (employee share scheme) are subject to PAYE at market value at the time of grant. Dividends paid on those shares subsequently are subject to 5% withholding tax (for Tanzania residents) — not PAYE. For complex share schemes or options, confirm with a tax consultant — the timing and value of taxation can vary. Accurate records of share values are essential.
question_en: An employee holds shares in the company they work for. When they receive shares or dividends — are they subject to PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — share schemes and dividends

question_sw: Mwajiri mkuu anapaswa kulipa NSSF nzima ikiwa mfanyakazi ana kazi nyingine?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kila mwajiri analipa NSSF kwa sehemu ya mshahara wake peke yake — si jumla ya mishahara yote. Mwajiri wa kwanza analipa 10% ya mshahara wake (na kukata 10% ya mfanyakazi kutoka mshahara wake). Mwajiri wa pili anafanya vivyo hivyo kwa mshahara wake. Hakuna wajibu wa mwajiri mmoja kulipa NSSF kwa mshahara unaotoka kwa mwajiri mwingine. Msingi wa hesabu ni mshahara mkubwa wa jumla kutoka kwa mwajiri husika.
question_en: Must the main employer pay full NSSF if an employee also has another job?
answer_en: No. Each employer pays NSSF on their own portion of salary only — not the combined total. The first employer pays 10% of their salary (and deducts the employee's 10% from that salary). The second employer does the same on their salary. No employer has an obligation to pay NSSF on wages paid by another employer. The calculation base is the gross wage from that specific employer.

question_sw: Mgeni anafundisha darasa lake la lugha ya Kiingereza — GN 487A inasimamia?
answer_sw: Huduma za elimu na mafunzo hazipo kwenye orodha ya 15 ya GN 487A. Mgeni anayeendesha shule ya lugha au darasa la binafsi hana vizuizi vya GN 487A. Hata hivyo, bado anahitaji kibali cha kazi kinachofaa kufundisha Tanzania.
question_en: A non-citizen teaches their own English language class — does GN 487A apply?
answer_en: Education and training services are not on GN 487A's list of 15 prohibited activities. A non-citizen running a language school or private tutoring class faces no GN 487A restrictions. However, they still need an appropriate work permit to teach in Tanzania.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: SDL ya mfanyakazi wa migodi — kuna kiwango maalum au ni 3.5% ile ile?
output: SDL kwa sekta yoyote, ikiwa ni pamoja na migodi na madini, ni 3.5% ya mishahara ya fedha ya wafanyakazi wote — kiwango kimoja kinachotumika kwa sekta zote. Hakuna kiwango maalum cha SDL kwa migodi. Hata hivyo, sekta ya migodi ina mifumo tofauti ya kodi nyingine (kama royalties, ring-fencing taxation, na mikataba maalum ya madini) — lakini SDL ni 3.5% kwa kawaida. Kumbuka: kizingiti cha wafanyakazi 10 bado kinatumika — kampuni ya mgodi yenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi inalipa SDL ya 3.5%. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: PAYE inafanya kazi vipi — inatumika kwenye mshahara wote au kwa bendi?
answer_sw: PAYE inafanya kazi KWA BENDI (progressive taxation) — si kwenye mshahara wote kwa kiwango kimoja. Mfano wa mshahara wa TZS 600,000: Bendi 1 (0-270,000): TZS 0 kodi; Bendi 2 (270,001-520,000): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000; Bendi 3 (520,001-600,000): TZS 80,000 × 20% = TZS 16,000; Jumla ya PAYE: TZS 36,000. Kumbuka: PAYE Tanzania haina punguzo la kibinafsi tofauti la kila mwezi linalotakiwa kukatwa — kiwango cha sifuri hadi TZS 270,000 ndiyo ruhusa pekee iliyojengwa ndani ya mfumo. Kwa mahesabu ya mshahara mahususi tumia TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz). Tafadhali tumia TRA IDRAS kwa mahesabu sahihi ya mshahara wako.
question_en: How does PAYE work — does it apply to the full salary or by band?
answer_en: PAYE works BY BAND (progressive taxation) — not on the full salary at one rate. Example for TZS 600,000 salary: Band 1 (0-270,000): TZS 0 tax; Band 2 (270,001-520,000): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000; Band 3 (520,001-600,000): TZS 80,000 × 20% = TZS 16,000; Total PAYE: TZS 36,000. Note: Tanzania's PAYE has no separate monthly personal relief deduction — the zero-rate up to TZS 270,000 is the only built-in allowance. For specific salary calculations use TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz). Please use TRA IDRAS for accurate calculations for your specific salary.

question_sw: Je, kampuni ya madini lazima ilipe SDL kwa wafanyakazi wake?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — kampuni ya madini inayofanya kazi Tanzania Bara na yenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi inalazimika kulipa SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara. Hii ni swali la SDL ambalo ninaweza kulisaidia. Hata hivyo, kwa maswali ya royalty ya madini, permits za uchimbaji, na Sheria ya Madini, wasiliana na TMAA au Wizara ya Madini.
question_en: Must a mining company pay SDL for its employees?
answer_en: Yes — a mining company operating on Mainland Tanzania with 10 or more employees must pay SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) at 3.5% of total gross payroll. This is an SDL question I can help with. However, for mining royalty questions, drilling permits, and the Mining Act, contact TMAA or the Ministry of Minerals.

question_sw: BRELA ya kampuni iliyosajiliwa inaweza kuona taarifa zake na mtu yeyote — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Rejesta ya BRELA ni ya umma. Mtu yeyote anaweza kufanya utafutaji kwenye tovuti ya BRELA ili kuona: jina la kampuni, tarehe ya uanzishwaji, wakurugenzi walioorodheshwa, na hali ya usajili. Utafutaji huu ni wa bure au wa ada ndogo.
question_en: Can anyone view the details of a BRELA-registered company — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. The BRELA register is public. Anyone can search the BRELA website to see: company name, incorporation date, listed directors, and registration status. This search is free or for a small fee.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Mnunuzi anayehitimu katika mfumo wa VAT withholding ni nani hasa?
output: Mnunuzi anayehitimu ni: (a) Wizara ya Fedha; (b) taasisi ya serikali inayohifadhi mapato yake yenyewe (retention fund); au (c) mtu aliyeteuliwa rasmi na Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Mnunuzi huyu ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kukata sehemu ya VAT na kuipeleka TRA moja kwa moja -- tofauti na mnunuzi wa kawaida. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mfanyakazi alijeruhiwa kazini. Je, fidia inatoka NSSF au WCF?
answer_sw: Fidia ya majeraha ya kazini inatoka WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — si NSSF. WCF inashughulikia: gharama za matibabu ya majeraha ya kazi, fidia ya ulemavu wa muda au wa kudumu, na fidia ya kifo kazini. NSSF inashughulikia: pensheni ya uzee, faida za matibabu za muda mrefu, faida za uzazi. Kwa fidia ya jeraha la kazi, mwajiri anapaswa kuwasiliana na WCF na kuwasilisha fomu za madai.
question_en: An employee was injured at work. Does compensation come from NSSF or WCF?
answer_en: Compensation for work injuries comes from WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — not NSSF. WCF covers: medical costs for work injuries, temporary or permanent disability compensation, and death-at-work compensation. NSSF covers: old-age pension, long-term medical benefits, maternity benefits. For a work injury claim, the employer should contact WCF and submit claim forms.

instruction: Amri ya zamani ya mishahara ya chini ya sekta binafsi ilifanyiwa nini?
output: Amri ya zamani ya mishahara ya sekta binafsi (ya mwaka 2022) ILIFUTWA rasmi kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Ilichukuliwa mahali pake na GN 605A (Government Notice 605A), ambayo ilitangazwa rasmi tarehe 13 Oktoba 2025 na kuanza kutumika 1 Januari 2026. Muhtasari: AMRI YA 2022 = imefutwa, si halali tena. GN 605A = mpya, halali, inayotumika. Kumbuka muhimu: GN 605A yenyewe HAIJAFUTWA — inafanya kazi. Thibitisha na MLYWF au TanzLII.

question_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kuwasilisha nyaraka zipi kuomba Darasa B?
answer_sw: Nyaraka za kawaida zinazohitajika kwa ombi la Darasa B ni: (1) fomu ya ombi iliyojazwa, (2) nakala ya pasipoti ya mombaji, (3) nakala ya vyeti vya elimu na uzoefu wa kazi (zilizothibitishwa), (4) mkataba wa ajira uliosainwa, (5) hati za kampuni (certificate of incorporation, TIN), (6) ushahidi wa jaribio la kuajiri Mtanzania kwanza, na (7) picha za pasipoti.
question_en: What documents must an employer submit to apply for a Class B permit?
answer_en: Standard documents required for a Class B application include: (1) completed application form, (2) copy of applicant's passport, (3) certified copies of educational certificates and work experience, (4) signed employment contract, (5) company documents (certificate of incorporation, TIN), (6) evidence of attempting to hire a Tanzanian first, and (7) passport photos.

instruction: VAT kwa huduma za ujenzi (construction services) — ni 18% ya kawaida?
output: Ndiyo — huduma za ujenzi Tanzania zinalipa VAT ya kawaida ya 18%. Hata hivyo, kuna mambo muhimu ya kuzingatia: Bidhaa za ujenzi (saruji, nondo, matofali) = bidhaa — zinaweza kuwa na withholding ya 3% kwa qualifying buyer. Huduma za ujenzi (kazi ya ujenzi, usanifu, usimamizi) = huduma — withholding ya 6% kwa qualifying buyer. Katika ujenzi mkubwa (government contracts), mara nyingi serikali (qualifying buyer) inakata 6% ya VAT kwenye malipo ya huduma za kontrakta. Kwa hivyo kontrakta anatarajia kupokea malipo pungufu ya 6% withholding. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, TRA inaweza kutekeleza GN 487A wakati wa ukaguzi wa kodi?
answer_sw: TRA inashughulikia masuala ya kodi — si utekelezaji wa amri za leseni za biashara kama GN 487A. Utekelezaji wa GN 487A ni kazi ya Idara ya Uhamiaji. Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kodi, TRA inaweza RIPOTI tuhuma kwa Uhamiaji, lakini hana mamlaka ya kutekeleza GN 487A wenyewe.
question_en: Can TRA enforce GN 487A during a tax audit?
answer_en: TRA handles tax matters — not enforcement of business licensing orders like GN 487A. GN 487A enforcement is the responsibility of the Immigration Services Department. During a tax audit, TRA may REFER suspicions to Immigration, but TRA does not have authority to enforce GN 487A independently.
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Je, biashara ndogo yenye mauzo ya TZS 50 milioni kwa mwaka inalazimika kulipa VAT?
answer_sw: Hapana — mauzo ya TZS 50,000,000 kwa mwaka yako chini ya kizingiti cha lazima cha usajili wa VAT (TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100M kwa miezi 6). Biashara yako haihitajiwi kujisajili kwa VAT kwa lazima. Unaweza kuchagua kujisajili kwa hiari ikiwa unataka kudai input VAT. Kiwango cha VAT — ukisajiliwa — ni asilimia 18.
question_en: Must a small business with TZS 50 million annual sales pay VAT?
answer_en: No — sales of TZS 50,000,000 per year are below the mandatory VAT registration threshold (TZS 200M in 12 months or TZS 100M in 6 months). Your business is not required to register for VAT. You may choose voluntary registration if you want to claim input VAT. The VAT rate — if registered — is 18%.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari — kanuni ngumu tatu za VAT ambazo kila mfanyabiashara lazima azijue.
answer_sw: Kanuni tatu ngumu (hard rules) za VAT Tanzania: (1) EXEMPT = HAKUNA input VAT — ukitoa huduma/bidhaa za exempt, huwezi kudai input VAT inayohusiana nazo, bila ubaguzi; (2) USAJILI WA LAZIMA MARA MOJA — ukizidi kizingiti cha TZS 200M/miezi 12 au TZS 100M/miezi 6, wasiliana na TRA leo — usichelewesha; (3) BIASHARA ISIYOSAJILIWA HAIKUSANYI VAT — ni kinyume cha sheria kuweka VAT kwenye invoice kama hujasajiliwa.
question_en: Summary — three hard VAT rules every business person must know.
answer_en: Three hard rules of Tanzanian VAT: (1) EXEMPT = NO input VAT — if you supply exempt services/goods, you cannot claim related input VAT, no exceptions; (2) MANDATORY IMMEDIATE REGISTRATION — if you exceed TZS 200M/12 months or TZS 100M/6 months threshold, contact TRA today — do not delay; (3) UNREGISTERED BUSINESS DOES NOT CHARGE VAT — it is against the law to put VAT on invoices if you are not registered.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini wa sekta ya umma ni Shilingi 400,000 kutoka Julai 2025 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mshahara wa chini wa sekta ya umma ni Shilingi 500,000 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 400,000. Rais Samia alitangaza Shilingi 500,000 mnamo tarehe 1 Mei 2025, kuanzia Julai 2025. Namba ya Shilingi 400,000 si sahihi.
question_en: The public sector minimum wage is TZS 400,000 from July 2025 — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The public sector minimum wage is TZS 500,000 per month — not TZS 400,000. President Samia announced TZS 500,000 on 1 May 2025, effective July 2025. The figure of TZS 400,000 is incorrect.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: OSHA inaweza kunifungia biashara yangu?
output: Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). Ndio — OSHA ina mamlaka ya kufunga biashara au maeneo yenye hatari ya mara moja (imminent danger). Ukaguzi wa OSHA ukipata: Hatari ya mara moja kwa maisha → OSHA inaweza kusimamisha kazi mara moja. Ukiukaji wa kawaida → OSHA inatoa onyo na muda wa kurekebisha. Kutofuata amri ya OSHA → faini na hatua za kisheria zaidi.

question_sw: Kampuni ambayo haikufanya biashara mwaka mzima hailazimiki kuwasilisha tamko la kodi ya kampuni kwa TRA — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kampuni iliyosajiliwa Tanzania lazima iwasilishe tamko la kodi ya kampuni (annual return) kwa TRA kila mwaka wa fedha, hata kama haikufanya shughuli yoyote au haikupata mapato. Tamko hili linaonyesha kwamba kampuni bado ipo na haijafutiwa. Kushindwa kuwasilisha kunaweza kusababisha adhabu hata kama kodi halisi ni sifuri.
question_en: A company that did no business for the whole year does not need to file a corporate tax return with TRA — is this correct?
answer_en: No. A registered Tanzania company must file an annual tax return with TRA for every financial year, even if it conducted no activities or earned no income. This return demonstrates the company is still active and not struck off. Failure to file can result in penalties even if the actual tax liability is zero.

instruction: Kiwango cha juu zaidi cha mshahara wa chini Tanzania kwa sekta gani na ni ngapi?
output: Kulingana na GN605A, kiwango cha juu zaidi kilichothibitishwa ni kwa sekta ya nishati (energy) ya makampuni ya kimataifa — TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi. Kiwango hiki kilianza Januari 2026 baada ya GN605A kubatilisha amri ya 2022 iliyokuwa na viwango vya chini zaidi.
