question_sw: Jinsi gani ya kusimamia usahihi wa mishahara katika biashara yangu?
answer_sw: Weka rekodi sahihi za malipo kwa kila mfanyakazi: tarehe ya malipo, kiasi, na uthibitisho wa malipo. Tengeneza payslip kwa kila mfanyakazi kila mwezi. Hakikisha kiasi cha kila mfanyakazi ni angalau kiwango cha chini cha GN 605A kwa sekta yako.
question_en: How do I manage minimum wage compliance in my business?
answer_en: Keep accurate payment records for each employee: payment date, amount, and proof of payment. Issue a payslip to every employee each month. Verify each amount is at least the GN 605A minimum for your sector.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: VAT return inawasilishwa online au ni lazima nifike ofisini TRA?
output: VAT return inaweza kuwasilishwa kupitia mifumo miwili: ONLINE (inashauriwa): Kupitia TRA portal ya IDRAS (Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System) — biashara zinazosajiliwa zina akaunti ya online; Faida: haraka, rekodi zinabaki, hakuna foleni; Malipo yanaweza pia kufanywa online kupitia benki zilizounganishwa. OFISINI: Kwa biashara ndogo au ambazo hazina ufikiaji wa mtandao — zinaweza kwenda ofisi ya TRA ya karibu; Hata hivyo, TRA inazidi kushukiza biashara zote kutumia mfumo wa online. Usajili wa IDRAS unafanywa mara tu unapopata TIN yako. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na IDRAS.

question_sw: Je, kuna msamaha wowote wa kodi ya stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kuna baadhi ya misamaha ya kodi ya stempu chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu, ikiwa ni pamoja na: hati zinazofanywa na au kwa ajili ya Serikali ya Tanzania, hati zinazohusiana na mazingira ya dharura ya umma, na hati maalum zilizoorodheshwa kwenye jedwali la msamaha wa sheria. Wakati wa shaka kuhusu kama hati yako inastahili msamaha, wasiliana na Afisa wa Stempu wa TRA au ofisi ya TRA iliyo karibu nawe.
answer_en: Yes. There are some stamp duty exemptions under the Stamp Duty Act, including: instruments made by or for the Government of Tanzania, instruments relating to public emergency circumstances, and specific instruments listed in the exemption schedule of the Act. When in doubt about whether your document qualifies for an exemption, contact the TRA Stamp Duty Officer or your nearest TRA office.
question_en: Are there any stamp duty exemptions in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — exemptions
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to stamp duty exemptions

instruction: GN 487A na usajili wa TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) — je, mwekezaji wa kigeni mwenye TIC anaweza kufanya biashara ya rejareja?
output: Hapana — usajili wa TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) unaruhusu wawekezaji wa kigeni kuwekeza katika sekta zilizobainishwa (kama kilimo, viwanda, utalii) kwa masharti maalum. Lakini biashara ya rejareja, saluni, ukarabati wa simu, na shughuli zingine 14 za GN 487A hazijaidhinishwa na TIC kwa wageni — hazipo katika orodha ya sekta zinazoruhusiwa na TIC kwa wawekezaji wa kigeni. GN 487A na TIC ni mifumo miwili tofauti: TIC inasimamia uwekezaji mkubwa katika sekta maalum; GN 487A inazuia shughuli ndogo ndogo kwa wageni wote. Thibitisha na TIC (tic.go.tz) na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji TIN kabla ya kumwomba mfanyakazi mgeni kibali cha kazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni lazima iwe na TIN iliyotolewa na TRA na iwe imesajiliwa kisheria Tanzania kabla ya kuomba kibali cha kazi kwa mfanyakazi mgeni. Idara ya Uhamiaji inataka uthibitisho wa usajili wa kampuni na hali ya kodi. Thibitisha na TRA na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Does an employer need a TIN before sponsoring a foreign work permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. The company must have a TRA-issued TIN and be legally registered in Tanzania before applying for a work permit for a foreign employee. The Immigration Department requires proof of company registration and tax compliance. Confirm with TRA and the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Kama tawi moja linaharibika EFD, je matawi mengine yanaendelea kufanya biashara?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. EFD ya kila tawi inafanya kazi kwa kujitegemea — uharibika wa EFD ya tawi moja haukuathiri matawi mengine. Tawi lenye EFD iliyoharibika linapaswa: (1) Kutaarififu TRA ndani ya masaa 24; (2) Kutumia stakabadhi za mkono kwa muda; (3) Kurekebisha EFD haraka. Matawi mengine yanaendelea kwa kawaida.
question_en: If one branch's EFD breaks down, do other branches continue operating?
answer_en: Yes. Each branch's EFD operates independently — a breakdown at one branch does not affect other branches. The branch with the broken EFD must: (1) Notify TRA within 24 hours; (2) Use manual receipts temporarily; (3) Repair the EFD quickly. Other branches continue operating normally.

question_sw: Kampuni inataka kubadilisha jina lake. Inafuata mchakato gani wa BRELA?
answer_sw: Kubadilisha jina la kampuni kunahitaji: kupitisha azimio maalum (special resolution) la wanahisa wenye asilimia 75 ya kura kuunga mkono mabadiliko ya jina, kuomba kuidhinishwa kwa jina jipya na BRELA kwa ajili ya uthibitisho wa upatikanaji, kuwasilisha maombi rasmi ya mabadiliko ya jina kwa BRELA na ada, na kupata cheti kipya cha usajili kikiwa na jina jipya. Baada ya mabadiliko ya jina, lazima usasishe nyaraka zote za kisheria, akaunti za benki, na leseni nyingine zote.
answer_en: Changing a company name requires: passing a special resolution by shareholders holding at least 75% of votes supporting the name change, applying to BRELA to approve the new name for availability confirmation, submitting a formal name change application to BRELA with fees, and receiving a new registration certificate with the new name. After the name change, you must update all legal documents, bank accounts, and all other licences.
question_en: A company wants to change its name. What BRELA process does it follow?

instruction: Kampuni yangu inaagiza huduma kutoka kampuni mama yake Dubai — bei ya baina ni nini kwa kodi Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Utaratibu wa bei za uhamishaji (transfer pricing) kwa muamala wa baina ya kampuni zinazohusiana ni mada ya kodi ya kimataifa — arm's length principle, documentation requirements, na taratibu maalum za TRA — zote ziko nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Wasiliana na TRA au mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: Kama mnunuzi anayehitimu hakukata VAT withholding -- nani anabeba hatari ya kisheria?
output: Mnunuzi anayehitimu (withholding agent) ndiye anayebeba wajibu wa kisheria wa kukata na kupeleka withholding TRA. Kushindwa kufanya hivyo kunaweza kusababisha TRA kudai kiasi kilichopaswa kukatwa pamoja na adhabu za kuchelewa. Thibitisha na wakili wa kodi na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: PAYE haihusiani na SDL na NSSF — kila moja inalipwa kwa shirika tofauti kabisa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. PAYE, SDL, na NSSF zote tatu zinahusiana na payroll ya mfanyakazi na zinashughulikia kwa wakati mmoja. PAYE inalipwa TRA, SDL inalipwa TRA, na NSSF inalipwa NSSF. Ingawa shirika la kupokea linatofautiana, mwajiri huzihesabu na kuzilipa zote kama sehemu ya mzunguko mmoja wa mishahara.
question_en: PAYE has nothing to do with SDL and NSSF — each is paid to an entirely different agency — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely. PAYE, SDL, and NSSF are all linked to the employee payroll and handled simultaneously. PAYE goes to TRA, SDL goes to TRA, and NSSF goes to NSSF. While the receiving agency differs, the employer calculates and pays all of them as part of one payroll cycle.

question_sw: Mchakato wa kupata EFD Tanzania ni upi?
answer_sw: Kupata EFD Tanzania: (1) Kuwa na TIN na usajili wa VAT; (2) Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD aliyeidhinishwa na TRA (approved supplier); (3) Nunua EFD au usainiwe mkataba wa VFD; (4) Muuzaji atasajili EFD yako na TRA na kuiunganisha na seva ya TRA; (5) Pokea namba ya uzalishaji (device serial number) na uthibitisho wa usajili kutoka TRA; (6) Anza kutumia. Gharama za EFD zinabebwa na mwenye biashara.
question_en: What is the EFD registration process in Tanzania?
answer_en: To get an EFD in Tanzania: (1) Have a TIN and VAT registration; (2) Contact a TRA-approved EFD supplier; (3) Purchase an EFD or sign a VFD agreement; (4) The supplier will register your EFD with TRA and connect it to TRA's server; (5) Receive the device serial number and registration confirmation from TRA; (6) Begin using. EFD costs are borne by the business owner.

question_sw: Je, kununua kutoka msambazaji asiyesajiliwa VAT kunaathiri haki yangu ya kudai input VAT?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kununua kutoka msambazaji asiyesajiliwa VAT kunamaanisha hakuna VAT ya kisheria iliyotozwa kwenye ununuzi huo — hivyo hakuna input VAT ya kudai. Hata kama bei ya msambazaji huyo ni ya juu, hutapata input VAT credit. Kwa madhumuni ya VAT, kununua kutoka wasambazaji waliosajilistwaa VAT ni muhimu.
question_en: Does buying from a non-VAT-registered supplier affect my right to claim input VAT?
answer_en: Yes. Buying from a non-VAT-registered supplier means no legitimate VAT was charged on that purchase — so there is no input VAT to claim. Even if that supplier charges a higher price, you will not get an input VAT credit. For VAT purposes, buying from VAT-registered suppliers is important.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: Takwimu rasmi ya ongezeko la wastani la mishahara ya chini chini ya GN 605A ni asilimia 33.4 — kwa nini si 33.5?
output: Asilimia 33.4 ni takwimu rasmi iliyotolewa na PKF Eastern Africa kulingana na wastani wa viwango vyote vya GN 605A kwa sekta zote 16. Hii ni takwimu ya wastani uliopimwa kwa sekta zote — si hesabu ya moja kwa moja kati ya wastani wa zamani na mpya tu. Tumia 33.4% kama takwimu rasmi — si 33.5%. Mshahara wa wastani ulipanda kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: Ninachimba shaba (copper) Tanzania — royalty ya shaba inatofautiana na ya dhahabu?
output: Royalties za madini zinasimamiwa na Sheria ya Madini Tanzania na zinategemea aina ya madini yanayochimbwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Viwango vya royalty kwa madini mbalimbali (dhahabu, shaba, almasi) vinatofautiana na vinashughulikiwa chini ya Sheria ya Madini — inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au Wizara ya Madini. Wasiliana pia na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu kwenye hati za mkopo (mortgage) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Hati za mkopo au rehani (mortgage) Tanzania zina ushuru wa stempu. Kiwango kinategemea Jedwali la Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu — kawaida ni kiasi kidogo cha kawaida au asilimia ya kiasi cha mkopo. Angalia TRA kwa jedwali la hali ya sasa kwani viwango vinaweza kutofautiana kulingana na aina ya mkopo (rehani ya ardhi, mkopo wa biashara, n.k.).
question_en: What is the stamp duty rate on mortgage documents in Tanzania?
answer_en: Mortgage or loan security documents in Tanzania carry stamp duty. The rate depends on the Stamp Duty Act schedule — typically a small fixed amount or a percentage of the loan amount. Check TRA for the current schedule as rates can vary by type of mortgage (land mortgage, business loan, etc.).

question_sw: Mwajiri asiye na TIN hawezi kuomba kibali cha kazi kwa mfanyakazi wake wa kigeni — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, hii ni kweli kwa sababu sahihi. Mwajiri Tanzania lazima awe amesajiliwa kisheria (na BRELA na TRA) kabla ya kuomba kibali cha kazi kwa mfanyakazi wa kigeni. Ushahidi wa usajili wa kisheria wa kampuni na TIN ni sehemu ya nyaraka za ombi la kibali cha kazi. Kampuni isiyosajiliwa haiwezi kuwa mwajiri halisi wa mfanyakazi wa kigeni.
question_en: An employer without a TIN cannot apply for a work permit for their foreign worker — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes, this is correct for good reason. A Tanzania employer must be legally registered (with BRELA and TRA) before applying for a work permit for a foreign employee. Evidence of company legal registration and TIN is part of the work permit application documents. An unregistered company cannot be a lawful employer of a foreign worker.

instruction: Leseni yangu ya biashara inaisha mwezi ujao — naweza kuomba upya kama mgeni?
output: GN 487A ya 28 Julai 2025 ina kipengele cha mpito (transitional provision): mgeni aliyekuwa na leseni halisi kabla ya tarehe ya kufanya kazi ya GN 487A anaweza kuendelea na shughuli hiyo hadi leseni yake inaisha — lakini hawezi kuomba upya (renewal) wa leseni hiyo. Kama shughuli yako ipo kwenye orodha ya marufuku ya GN 487A: HUWEZI kuomba upya (renewal) — GN 487A inazuia renewal kwa shughuli zilizokatazwa. Hatua ya haraka: wasiliana na wakili wa uhamiaji KABLA leseni haijafika mwisho kujua chaguzi lako (mabadiliko ya biashara, ubia na raia wa Tanzania, au kufunga biashara).

instruction: Ninaajiri wafanyakazi wa kilimo shambani — OSHA inawashughulikia?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). Wafanyakazi wa kilimo (shamba, bustani, misitu) wanashughulikiwa na OSHA. Hatari za kilimo zinazoshughulikiwa na OSHA: viuatilifu (pesticides), jua kali, vifaa vya kilimo, nyoka, na hali ngumu za mazingira. WCF pia inashughulikia wafanyakazi wa kilimo kwa fidia za ajali. Sajili maeneo yako ya kilimo na OSHA na WCF.

question_sw: Posho ya nyumba na posho ya usafiri — zinajumuishwa kwenye SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kwa ujumla, posho za mara kwa mara kama posho ya nyumba na usafiri zinajumuishwa kwenye jumla ya mishahara inayotumika kuhesabu SDL. Inahusisha malipo yote ya kawaida ya mwajiri kwa mwajiriwa. Thibitisha muundo maalum na mshauri wako wa kodi.
question_en: Housing allowance and transport allowance — are they included in SDL?
answer_en: Yes. Generally, regular allowances such as housing and transport allowances are included in the total payroll used to calculate SDL. This covers all regular employer payments to employees. Confirm your specific structure with your tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Je, Tanzania ina ushuru wa carbon au ushuru wa mazingira?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa mazingira (environmental levy, carbon tax) na mfumo wake wa kisheria Tanzania ni mada tofauti kabisa nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Mazingira, TRA, au mshauri wa mazingira aliyehitimu kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapata adhabu ya asilimia 10 mara moja kwa kuchelewa kulipa PAYE — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Adhabu ya PAYE ni asilimia 2.5 kwa kila MWEZI wa ucheleweshaji — si asilimia 10 mara moja. Kwa hivyo baada ya miezi 4, jumla ya adhabu inakuwa asilimia 10, lakini inakua kwa mwezi. Kiwango cha asilimia 10 mara moja si sahihi chini ya sheria ya Tanzania.
question_en: An employer receives a one-time 10% penalty for late PAYE payment — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The PAYE penalty is 2.5% for each MONTH of delay — not a one-time 10%. After 4 months of delay the cumulative penalty reaches 10%, but it accrues monthly. A one-time flat 10% rate is incorrect under Tanzania law.

question_sw: SDL inalipwa lini kwa mwezi — tarehe 7 au 20?
answer_sw: SDL inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata — si tarehe 20. Tarehe ya 20 ni ya VAT return. SDL na PAYE zinalipwa kabla ya tarehe 7, na VAT kabla ya tarehe 20. Zisije zikachanganywa.
question_en: When is SDL paid each month — by the 7th or the 20th?
answer_en: SDL is paid by the 7th of the following month — not the 20th. The 20th is the VAT return deadline. SDL and PAYE are paid before the 7th, and VAT before the 20th. Do not confuse them.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Duka la mitumba (used clothes) — VAT inatumika?
answer_sw: Duka la mitumba lenye mauzo ya chini ya TZS 200M kwa mwaka halijafika kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT — kwa hivyo VAT haihitajiki. Hata hivyo, usajili wa biashara na halmashauri na TIN zinahitajika. Kama mauzo yanafika TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6, usajili wa VAT unakuwa lazima.
question_en: A second-hand clothes shop (mitumba) — does VAT apply?
answer_en: A mitumba shop with sales below TZS 200M per year has not reached the VAT registration threshold — so VAT is not required. However, business registration with the local council and a TIN are still required. Once sales reach TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6 months, VAT registration becomes mandatory.

question_sw: WCF inashughulikia matukio ya dharura tu — kama maumivu ya kawaida, mfanyakazi hana haki — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. WCF inashughulikia majeraha na magonjwa yanayotokana na KAZI — sio matukio ya dharura tu. Maumivu ya kawaida yanayotokana na kazi (kama maumivu ya mgongo kutokana na kuketi muda mrefu, au maumivu ya mkono kutokana na kujirudiarudia) yanaweza kustahili madai ya WCF.
question_en: WCF only covers emergency incidents — for normal aches, the employee has no rights — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. WCF covers injuries and WORK-CAUSED conditions — not just emergency incidents. Common work-related pains (such as back pain from prolonged sitting, or hand strain from repetitive movements) can qualify for WCF claims.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: WHT yote inawasilishwa TRA pamoja kwenye fomu moja — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, WHT zote za mwezi inawasilishwa TRA kupitia fomu moja ya WHT return ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Fomu inaonyesha kila aina ya malipo, kiasi kilichokatwa, na maelezo ya mpokeaji. TRA inaweza kukagua kila aina tofauti katika ukaguzi.
question_en: All WHT is submitted to TRA together on one form — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes. All WHT deductions for the month are submitted to TRA on a single WHT return by the 7th of the following month. The form shows each type of payment, amount deducted, and recipient details. TRA can audit each category separately during an examination.

instruction: Kama TRA iligundua biashara yangu haikutoa risiti za EFD kwa miaka 2 -- adhabu zinaweza kuwa ngapi?
output: Adhabu inaweza kuwa kubwa sana: faini kwa kila muamala ambao haukupata risiti ya EFD, riba kwa VAT iliyokosekana, faini za ziada za ukwepaji wa kodi, na uwezekano wa kusimamishwa au kufungwa kwa biashara. Kiasi maalum kinategemea idadi ya miamala na ukaguzi wa TRA. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kodi mara moja ili kutatua hali hii.

question_sw: EFD inasaidia biashara kuhesabu jumla ya VAT inayodaiwa kwa wateja au inalipwa kwa wasambazaji Tanzania vipi?
answer_sw: EFD inasaidia kwa mwelekeo mmoja wa VAT — inahesabu OUTPUT VAT (VAT inayodaiwa kwa wateja kwenye mauzo). Kwa INPUT VAT (VAT inayolipwa kwa wasambazaji kwenye manunuzi), biashara lazima ihifadhi risiti za EFD na ankara za VAT za wasambazaji wake na kuziingiza kwenye tamko lake la VAT la kila mwezi. EFD ya biashara yako HAIREKORDI manunuzi yako — unahitaji mfumo wa akaunti wa ndani kwa hilo.
question_en: How does an EFD help a business calculate total VAT charged to customers or paid to suppliers in Tanzania?
answer_en: An EFD helps with one direction of VAT — it calculates OUTPUT VAT (VAT charged to customers on sales). For INPUT VAT (VAT paid to suppliers on purchases), the business must keep EFD receipts and VAT invoices from its suppliers and enter them in its monthly VAT return. Your business EFD does NOT record your purchases — you need an internal accounting system for that.

instruction: Biashara yangu iko Zanzibar -- sheria za kodi za Zanzibar ni tofauti na Tanzania Bara?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Wasiliana na ZRA (zra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyesajiliwa Zanzibar kwa maswali ya kodi ya Zanzibar.

question_sw: Msimamizi wa mgahawa wa kijiji (kama mfanyakazi) — mwajiri wake analazimika kulipa nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri wa msimamizi wa mgahawa analazimika: (1) PAYE — kukata na kuwasilisha TRA tarehe 7; (2) NSSF — 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi; (3) WCF — 0.5% ya mshahara (bima ya ajali); (4) SDL — 3.5% kama mwajiri ana wafanyakazi 10+; (5) Kufuata GN 605A — kulipa mshahara wa chini unaofaa kwa sekta. Hizi zinatumika hata kwa mgahawa mdogo wa kijiji.
question_en: A village restaurant manager (as an employee) — what must their employer pay?
answer_en: The employer of a restaurant manager must: (1) PAYE — deduct and remit to TRA by the 7th; (2) NSSF — 10% employer + 10% employee; (3) WCF — 0.5% of salary (accident insurance); (4) SDL — 3.5% if employer has 10+ employees; (5) Follow GN 605A — pay minimum wage applicable to the sector. These apply even for a small village restaurant.

instruction: Ninafanya biashara ya online na watu wanalipa Airtel Money — EFD inahusika?
output: Malipo ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) yanahitaji risiti ya EFD kama malipo ya kawaida. Njia ya malipo haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti — kila muamala wa mauzo lazima upate risiti ya EFD. Biashara za online hazina msamaha wa EFD. Kwa biashara za mtandaoni, TRA inaweza kuhitaji EFD ya mtandaoni (online EFD/virtual EFD). Wasiliana na TRA kujua mfumo unaofaa kwa biashara yako ya mtandaoni.

question_sw: Hati ya usawa wa ardhi (land valuation certificate) inahitajika kabla ya kulipa ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, thamani ya ardhi lazima ithibitishwe ili TRA iweze kukokotoa ushuru wa stempu sahihi. TRA inaweza kuhitaji tathmini (valuation) ya rasmi kutoka mtaalamu wa tathmini aliyeidhinishwa, hasa kwa miamala ya thamani kubwa au pale ambapo bei ya mauzo inaweza kutofautiana sana na thamani ya soko. Tathmini hii inasaidia kuhakikisha ushuru unahesabiwa kwa kiwango kikubwa zaidi.
question_en: Is a land valuation certificate required before paying stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes, the land value must be verified so TRA can calculate the correct stamp duty. TRA may require a formal valuation from an authorised valuer, especially for high-value transactions or where the sale price may differ significantly from market value. The valuation helps ensure the duty is calculated on the higher amount.

instruction: Kampuni mama yetu inatupandia gharama za pamoja (shared costs) za IT na masoko — TRA inatambua gharama hizi vipi?
output: Kanuni ya msingi ya transfer pricing Tanzania ni arm's length principle katika Income Tax Act Sehemu 33 — miamala kati ya kampuni zinazohusiana lazima ifanane na bei za soko. Kwa uchambuzi wa kesi yako: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Utambuzi wa gharama za pamoja za kimataifa kati ya kampuni zilizounganishwa ni suala la transfer pricing na kodi ya kimataifa inayohitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: NSSF rate ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Kiwango: 10% kwa mwajiri + 10% kwa mfanyakazi = 20% ya jumla. Hakuna kiwango kingine — si 5%, si 15%, si 7.5%. Chanzo: NSSF Act na kanuni za NSSF (nssf.go.tz).

instruction: Tofauti kati ya VAT withholding na output VAT ya kawaida ni nini?
output: VAT ya kawaida (output VAT) unalipa mwenyewe TRA baada ya kukusanya kutoka kwa wateja wako. VAT withholding ni ambapo mnunuzi anayehitimu (kama serikali) anakata VAT moja kwa moja kutoka malipo yako kabla ya kukupa pesa na anapeleka TRA kwa niaba yako. Tofauti kuu: withholding inapunguza kiasi unachopokea, lakini certificate inakupa haki ya kudai pembejeo ya VAT hiyo.

question_sw: Biashara inaweza kuomba muda wa ziada wa kuwasilisha tamko la kodi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiriwa wa kodi (taxpayer) anaweza kuomba ugani (extension) wa muda wa kuwasilisha tamko la kodi kwa TRA. Ombi linapaswa kuwasilishwa KABLA ya tarehe ya mwisho ya asili. TRA inaweza kukubaliana au kukataa ombi. Riba ya kuchelewa inaweza bado kuendelea hata wakati wa ugani ulioombwa. Ugani si uhakika — omba mapema na toa sababu za msingi.
question_en: Can a business apply for an extension to file a tax return in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. A taxpayer can apply for an extension of time to file a tax return with TRA. The application must be submitted BEFORE the original deadline. TRA may agree or refuse the application. Late interest may still accrue even during a requested extension. An extension is not guaranteed — apply early and provide solid reasons.

instruction: Je, OSHA inaweza kufunga biashara kwa sababu ya ukiukwaji wa usalama?
output: Ndiyo. OSHA ina mamlaka ya kutoa amri za dharura za kusimamisha au kufunga sehemu ya mahali pa kazi inayosababisha hatari ya papo hapo kwa wafanyakazi. Adhabu nyingine ni: faini, amri za kurekebisha, na kesi za jinai. Thibitisha mamlaka kamili ya OSHA ya utekelezaji na OSHA (osha.go.tz) au wakili wa kazi.

instruction: Kama nimesajiliwa VAT, ninalazimika kutoa invoice ya VAT kwa kila muamala?
output: Ndiyo. Biashara iliyosajiliwa VAT lazima itoe invoice ya VAT (tax invoice) kwa kila muamala wa biashara. Invoice lazima iwe na: nambari ya usajilishaji wa VAT, TIN, maelezo ya bidhaa/huduma, kiasi cha VAT kilichotengwa, na tarehe. Kutoa invoice isiyo na maelezo ya VAT ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT. Biashara nyingi zinatekeleza hii kupitia mfumo wa EFD.

instruction: Kiwango cha stamp duty kwa ununuzi wa ardhi Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Stamp duty inatumika kwa uhamisho wa mali Tanzania. Viwango na taratibu halisi vinategemea aina ya mali na thamani yake inayotathminiwa na mthamini aliyesajiliwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Viwango vya stamp duty kwa ardhi na mali vinashughulikiwa na Ofisi ya Ardhi na TRA, na vinaweza kutofautiana kulingana na aina ya mali na hali ya mnunuzi. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kama na ofisi ndogo ya wafanyakazi 5, bado nahitaji kufuata sheria ya OSHA?
answer_sw: Ingawa usajili rasmi wa OSHA unatakiwa kwa wafanyakazi 10+, masharti ya msingi ya usalama ya OSHA yanatumika kwa biashara zote. Hii inajumuisha: mazingira salama ya kazi, hewa safi, taa ya kutosha, na msaada wa kwanza. Usalama wa wafanyakazi ni wajibu wa kisheria bila kujali saizi.
question_en: If I have a small office of 5 employees do I still need to follow OSHA law?
answer_en: Although formal OSHA registration is required for 10+ employees, the basic OSHA safety requirements apply to all businesses. This includes: safe working environment, adequate ventilation, sufficient lighting, and first aid. Employee safety is a legal duty regardless of size.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: OSHA cheti kinaombwa wapi na jinsi gani?
answer_sw: Cheti cha OSHA kinaombwa kupitia tovuti ya OSHA (osha.go.tz) au ofisi ya OSHA ya mkoa. Unahitaji fomu ya maombi, ada ya usajili, na taarifa za mahali pa kazi kama idadi ya wafanyakazi na aina ya shughuli. Cheti kinahuishwa kila mwaka.
question_en: Where and how is an OSHA certificate applied for?
answer_en: An OSHA certificate is applied for through the OSHA website (osha.go.tz) or the regional OSHA office. You need an application form, the registration fee, and workplace details such as employee count and type of activity. It is renewed annually.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority
next_review_trigger: OSHA fee schedule or process update

question_sw: Mfanyakazi yuko likizo bila malipo (unpaid leave) kwa mwezi mzima. Je, NSSF inalipwa?
answer_sw: Wakati mfanyakazi yuko likizo bila malipo, hakuna mshahara unaolipwa — na kwa hivyo hakuna msingi wa NSSF ya kulipiwa. NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa mshahara mkubwa wa jumla uliolipwa. Kama hakuna mshahara, hakuna michango ya NSSF inayohitajika kwa kipindi hicho. Kumbuka: mwezi huo hauhesabiwi kama mwezi wa mchango kwa madhumuni ya faida za NSSF.
question_en: An employee is on unpaid leave for a whole month. Is NSSF paid?
answer_en: When an employee is on unpaid leave, no wages are paid — and therefore there is no NSSF base to calculate on. NSSF is calculated on actual gross wages paid. If no wages are paid, no NSSF contributions are required for that period. Note: that month will not count as a contribution month for NSSF benefit purposes.

instruction: Risiti za EFD zinatumiaje kupambana na udanganyifu wa kodi Tanzania?
output: EFD machines zinapeleka taarifa za miamala moja kwa moja kwenye seva za TRA kwa wakati halisi (real-time). Hii inamaanisha TRA wanaona mauzo yako bila kukuomba taarifa za ziada. Mfumo huu unazuia udanganyifu wa kodi kwa sababu biashara haiwezi kuficha miamala. Kupita kwa risiti za EFD, TRA wanaweza kulinganisha mauzo yaliyotangazwa na ya kweli moja kwa moja.

question_sw: Kampuni iliyofutwa kwenye rejesta ya BRELA bado ina madeni yake — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kufutwa kwenye rejesta ya BRELA hakuondoi madeni ya kampuni. Wakurugenzi wanaweza kubaki na wajibu wa kibinafsi kwa baadhi ya madeni kulingana na hali. Wadai wanaweza kuomba mahakamani kurejesha kampuni kwenye rejesta ili kulipa madeni. Kufutwa ni hatua ya usajili tu — si uamuzi wa kisheria wa madeni.
question_en: A company struck off the BRELA register still has its debts — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. Strike off from the BRELA register does not extinguish the company's debts. Directors may remain personally liable for some debts depending on circumstances. Creditors can apply to court to restore the company to the register to recover debts. Strike off is a registration step only — not a legal settlement of debts.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mgeni mwenye kibali cha makazi daraja C anaweza kufanya shughuli zilizopigwa marufuku na GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A inaweka marufuku ya aina ya shughuli — hata kibali cha kazi halimruhusu mgeni kufanya shughuli zilizoorodheshwa kwenye amri. Sheria hizi mbili zinatumika pamoja. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: Can a non-citizen with a Class C residence permit conduct activities prohibited by GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A restricts the type of activity — even a work permit does not authorise a non-citizen to conduct activities listed in the order. Both laws apply concurrently. Confirm with the Immigration Department and a legal adviser.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inayopata hasara kwa mwaka wa kwanza inaweza kupata refund ya kodi ya awali (provisional tax) iliyolipwa — je, inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ikiwa kampuni ilipiga makokotoo ya kodi ya awali lakini hatimaye ikakuta faida ni ndogo au kuna hasara, inaweza kudai refund ya sehemu ya kodi ya awali iliyolipwa kupita. Mchakato: wasilisha tamko la mwaka, TRA itathibitisha kiasi cha kodi sahihi, na tofauti inarejeshwa au inabebwa kama mkopo wa kodi kwa mwaka ujao.
question_en: A new company that makes a loss in its first year can get a refund of provisional tax paid — is this permitted?
answer_en: Yes. If a company calculated provisional tax but ultimately found actual profit was lower or there was a loss, it can claim a refund of the overpaid provisional tax. Process: file the annual return, TRA confirms the correct tax amount, and the difference is refunded or carried as a tax credit to the following year.

instruction: Adhabu ya mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A ni nini hasa?
output: Adhabu ya mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A ni: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 (au zaidi) AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 AU vyote viwili, pamoja na uwezekano wa kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha makazi. Hizi ni adhabu kali zilizowekwa ili kuzuia wageni kufanya biashara zilizokatazwa. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara.

instruction: Je, kukosa kutoa risiti ya EFD kwa mteja ni udanganyifu wa kodi?
output: Ndiyo, TRA inaweza kuainisha kukosa kutoa risiti ya EFD kama udanganyifu wa kodi (tax evasion) kwa sababu miamala inayokosekana kwenye mfumo wa EFD haionekani kwa TRA. Hii ni ukiukwaji mkubwa ambao unaweza kusababisha: faini kubwa, uchunguzi wa kodi, au hatua za kisheria. Toa risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala bila ubaguzi.

instruction: Biashara inaajiri wafanyakazi 5 tu kwa PAYE na wafanyakazi 7 wengine kwa wakala wa kuajiri — je, jumla ni wafanyakazi 12 kwa SDL?
output: Inategemea muundo wa kisheria wa wakala wa kuajiri: Kama wafanyakazi 7 wa wakala wana mwajiri wa kisheria ni WAKALA (agency) — si biashara yako. Biashara yako ina wafanyakazi 5 tu wa moja kwa moja — SDL haihitajiki (chini ya 10). Kama wafanyakazi 7 wa wakala kwa vitendo wanafanya kazi yako na wanakutegemea wewe (kama de facto employees) — TRA inaweza kuchukulia wote 12 kama wafanyakazi wako na kuhitaji SDL ya 3.5% kwa jumla ya mishahara 12. Hali hii ni ngumu kisheria — inahitaji uchambuzi wa hali halisi ya mkataba wa ajira. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kazi.

instruction: Je, kuna tofauti ya tarehe kati ya kulipa SDL na kulipa PAYE TRA?
output: Hapana -- tarehe ni moja. SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinapaswa kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa malipo ya mishahara. Ni fomu tofauti kupitia ITAX/IDRAS lakini deadline moja ya tarehe 7. Thibitisha tarehe za sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwani zinaweza kubadilika.

instruction: Biashara yangu inauzwa TZS 250M kwa mwaka — lazima nisajili VAT?
output: Ndio — TZS 250M inazidi kizingiti cha TZS 200M/mwaka. Lazima usajili VAT. Hatua: (1) Fikia TRA mara moja (au tra.go.tz). (2) Wasilisha maombi ya usajili wa VAT ndani ya siku 30 ya kupita kizingiti. (3) Nunua EFD. (4) Anza kutoa risiti za VAT kwa wateja wako. Kuchelewa kusajili kunasababisha faini za TRA.

question_sw: Mke wangu ni raia wa Ethiopia, anataka kufungua saluni Dar es Salaam — je, anaweza?
answer_sw: Hapana. Chini ya GN 487A (2025), huduma za saluni, kinyozi, na urembo ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania. Mke wako hawezi kumiliki wala kuendesha saluni kama biashara yake binafsi. Adhabu ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza yake. Unaweza fikiria chaguo la ubia ambapo raia wa Tanzania ndiye mmiliki rasmi, lakini hata hivyo mhusika anapaswa kupata ushauri wa kisheria kwanza ili kuhakikisha muundo wa ubia ni halali.
question_en: My wife is an Ethiopian citizen and wants to open a salon in Dar es Salaam — can she?
answer_en: No. Under GN 487A (2025), salon, barbershop, and beauty services are one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens. Your wife cannot own or operate a salon as her own business. Penalties are a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. You may consider a partnership arrangement where a Tanzanian citizen is the registered owner, but even then she should seek legal advice first to ensure the partnership structure is lawful.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Hospitali isiyolipa VAT kwenye huduma zake za matibabu (exempt) inaweza kudai VAT ya pembejeo kwenye vifaa vyake?
output: Hapana. Kwa sababu huduma za matibabu ni exempt (zilizosamehewa VAT), hospitali HAIWEZI kudai VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) kwenye vifaa, dawa, au gharama nyingine zinazohusiana na huduma hizo. Exempt inamaanisha si usambazaji wa VAT kabisa -- hakuna haki ya kudai input VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutosajilisha mfanyakazi kwa NSSF ni nini?
answer_sw: Kutosajilisha mfanyakazi kwa NSSF kunaweza kusababisha: adhabu ya usajili wa kuchelewa, madeni ya michango ya malimbikizo kwa kiwango cha 10%+10% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla, riba ya ucheleweshaji (5% kwa mwezi kwa michango isiyolipwa), na hatua za kisheria. NSSF inspectors wanaweza kufanya ukaguzi. Usajili wa mapema unalinda mwajiri na mfanyakazi.
question_en: What is the penalty for not registering an employee with NSSF?
answer_en: Failure to register an employee with NSSF may result in: a late registration penalty, backdated contribution arrears at 10%+10% of gross wage, interest on late payments (5% per month on unpaid contributions), and legal action. NSSF inspectors may conduct audits. Early registration protects both employer and employee.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kupunguza mshahara wa mfanyakazi ili kufidia mchango wa NSSF wa mwajiri — je, inaruhusiwa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mchango wa mwajiri wa NSSF (asilimia 10) ni GHARAMA YA MWAJIRI — HAIWEZI kukatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi au kupunguza mshahara wake. Mfanyakazi analipa sehemu yake (asilimia 10) ambayo inakatwa kutoka mshahara wake, lakini sehemu ya mwajiri (asilimia 10) inalipwa na MWAJIRI mwenyewe kwa gharama zake. Mwajiri anayepunguza mshahara wa mfanyakazi kulipa mchango wake wa NSSF anakiuka sheria ya kazi na NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer reduce a worker's salary to compensate for the employer's NSSF contribution — is this permitted in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. The employer's NSSF contribution (10%) is the EMPLOYER'S COST — it cannot be deducted from the employee's salary or reduce their wage. The employee pays their share (10%) which is deducted from their salary, but the employer's share (10%) is paid by the EMPLOYER themselves from their own funds. An employer who reduces a worker's salary to pay their NSSF contribution violates labour law and NSSF law.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Biashara yangu ilikuwa exempt VAT — sasa imekuwa taxable. Ninaweza kudai VAT ya vifaa vilivyonunuliwa awali?
answer_sw: Hali hii ya mabadiliko ya hali ya VAT (exempt kwenda taxable) ina kanuni maalum. Kwa ujumla, input VAT iliyolipwa kipindi cha exempt haiwezi kudaiwa kwa wakati wa mabadiliko. Hata hivyo, kwa vifaa na mali ambazo bado zinatumika, inawezekana kudai sehemu ya input VAT — lakini hii ni ngumu. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: My business was VAT-exempt — it is now taxable. Can I claim VAT on goods bought earlier?
answer_en: This situation of changing VAT status (exempt to taxable) has specific rules. Generally, input VAT paid during the exempt period cannot be claimed at the time of change. However, for capital assets and equipment still in use, it may be possible to claim a portion of input VAT — but this is complex. Verify with TRA or a tax advisor.

instruction: Ninaweza kusajili VAT hata kama mauzo yangu ni TZS 50M tu kwa mwaka?
output: Ndio — usajili wa hiari wa VAT unaruhusiwa hata chini ya kizingiti. TRA inakuruhusu kusajili VAT kwa hiari iwapo biashara yako imesajiliwa kisheria. Faida kuu: unaweza kudai VAT ya manunuzi yako (input VAT) kama rejareja. Omba usajili wa hiari wa VAT kupitia tra.go.tz au ofisi ya TRA karibu nawe.

instruction: Je, wizara ya serikali lazima isajiliwe TRA kama withholding agent?
output: Ndiyo. Wizara na taasisi za serikali zinazofanya manunuzi kutoka wasambazaji waliosailiwa VAT lazima ziwe na hadhi ya withholding agent iliyothibitishwa na TRA. Bila usajilishaji huo, hana ruhusa ya kisheria ya kukata VAT ya msambazaji. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa utaratibu sahihi.

instruction: Z-report na X-report tofauti gani?
output: X-report: ripoti ya muda (inaweza kupigwa mara nyingi siku moja — inakupa muhtasari wa mauzo bila kufunga siku). Z-report: ripoti ya kufunga siku — inapigwa MARA MOJA mwishoni mwa siku. Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Baada ya Z-report kupigwa, EFD inaanza upya kwa siku mpya. X-report haifungi siku — inaweza kupigwa wakati wowote bila athari.

question_sw: Huduma za wingu (cloud storage/computing) — kodi gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Huduma za wingu (cloud storage, cloud computing) zinachukuliwa kama huduma zinazokabiliwa na VAT Tanzania na possibly withholding tax. Kwa watoa wa ndani: VAT 18% + EFD. Kwa watoa wa nje ya nchi: withholding tax 6% inaweza kutumika kwa mlipaji wa Tanzania. Thibitisha muundo wako mahususi na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Cloud services (cloud storage/computing) — what taxes apply in Tanzania?
answer_en: Cloud services are treated as services subject to Tanzania VAT and possibly withholding tax. For domestic providers: 18% VAT + EFD. For foreign-based providers: 6% withholding tax may apply for the Tanzanian payer. Confirm your specific structure with a tax advisor.

instruction: Ninaununua huduma za IT (programming) kutoka kampuni nyingine — kiwango cha VAT withholding ni ngapi?
output: Huduma za IT kama programming, usanidi wa mifumo, na ushauri wa teknolojia ni HUDUMA — kwa hivyo VAT withholding ni 6% (si 3%). Kanuni ya msingi: BIDHAA → 3%; HUDUMA → 6%. Hii ni sawa kwa huduma zote kama ushauri, uhasibu, ujenzi wa programu, na kadhalika. Finance Act 2025 ilianzisha mfumo huu wa 3%/6% kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Mnunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying buyer) anakata 6% ya VAT kutoka bei ya huduma na kutuma TRA. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: OSHA ukaguzi unapatikana lini — kampuni inaweza kupanga tarehe yake mwenyewe?
output: OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa aina mbili: (1) UKAGUZI WA KAWAIDA (routine inspection): unaopangwa na OSHA kulingana na ratiba yao — kampuni haifahamishwi mapema wakati mwingine (hii ni ukaguzi wa kweli); (2) UKAGUZI MAALUM (special inspection): unaofuatia malalamiko ya mfanyakazi, ajali iliyotokea, au ombi la kampuni. Kampuni inaweza KUOMBA OSHA waje kufanya ukaguzi wa usalama (self-requested audit) kujaribu mahali pake pa kazi — hii inaonyesha nia njema ya kuzingatia kanuni. Ukaguzi wa kawaida si wa kupanga na kampuni — OSHA wanakuja wakitaka. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa kigeni anaweza kutoa mchango wake wa NSSF atakapoondoka Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anaondoka Tanzania anaweza kudai sehemu ya faida ya NSSF kulingana na miaka ya michango. Ikiwa wamechangia chini ya miezi 180 (miaka 15), wanaweza kupata faida za muda mfupi. Upatikanaji wa faida unategemea makubaliano ya hifadhi ya jamii kati ya Tanzania na nchi ya asili ya mfanyakazi. Kwa maelezo ya upatikanaji wa faida kwa wafanyakazi wa kigeni, wasiliana na NSSF moja kwa moja.
question_en: Can a foreign employee withdraw their NSSF contributions when leaving Tanzania?
answer_en: A foreign employee leaving Tanzania may claim NSSF benefits depending on their years of contribution. If they have contributed for fewer than 180 months (15 years), they may be eligible for short-term benefits. Access to benefits depends on any social security bilateral agreements between Tanzania and the employee's home country. For details on benefit access for foreign employees, contact NSSF directly.

question_sw: Mnunuzi wa nyumba Tanzania anahitaji kulipa ushuru wa stempu na VAT kwenye ununuzi huo — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: VAT na ushuru wa stempu ni makodi tofauti na yanaweza yakatumika wakati mmoja kwenye ununuzi wa mali. VAT kwa kawaida inatumika ikiwa muuzaji ni msajiliwa wa VAT na mauzo yanastahili VAT (kwa mfano, mali mpya kutoka msanidi aliyesajiliwa). Ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1 unatumika kwenye uhamishaji wenyewe wa hati. Ni muhimu kuelewa kila moja kando na mwanasheria au mtaalamu wa mali.
question_en: A Tanzania home buyer needs to pay both stamp duty and VAT on the purchase — is this true?
answer_en: VAT and stamp duty are separate taxes and both can apply simultaneously to a property purchase. VAT generally applies if the seller is VAT-registered and the sale is taxable (for example, new property from a registered developer). The 1% stamp duty applies to the transfer instrument itself. It is important to understand each separately with a lawyer or property specialist.

instruction: Nimeambiwa SDL ni 5% — sahihi?
output: Hapana — SDL si 5%. SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kiwango cha 5% haikuwa sahihi — inaweza kuchanganywa na kiwango kingine kama NSSF (10%+10%). SDL ni 3.5% peke yake, inalipwa na mwajiri tu.

question_sw: Je, EFD inasajiliwa na TRA au na muuzaji wa EFD?
answer_sw: EFD inasajiliwa na muuzaji aliyeidhinishwa na TRA kwa niaba ya mwenye biashara. Muuzaji ndiye anayeshughulikia mchakato wa usajili na TRA, kuunganisha EFD kwenye seva ya TRA, na kusanidi EFD kwa TIN ya biashara. Mwenye biashara ana wajibu wa kuhakikisha EFD yake imesajiliwa ipasavyo. Baada ya usajili, risiti zote zinazotolewa zinapelekwa moja kwa moja kwenye mfumo wa TRA.
question_en: Is the EFD registered with TRA or with the EFD supplier?
answer_en: The EFD is registered through a TRA-approved supplier on behalf of the business owner. The supplier handles the TRA registration process, connects the EFD to TRA's server, and configures the EFD with the business's TIN. The business owner has the obligation to ensure their EFD is properly registered. After registration, all issued receipts are transmitted directly to TRA's system.

question_sw: Je, bendi za PAYE zinabadilika kila mwaka au zinakaa sawa?
answer_sw: Bendi za PAYE zinaweza kubadilika kila mwaka kupitia Finance Act inayotangazwa kila Julai. Mwaka 2025/2026, bendi ni: Bendi 1 (0-270K): 0%; Bendi 2 (270K-520K): 8%; Bendi 3 (520K-760K): 20%; Bendi 4 (760K-1M): 25%; Bendi 5 (zaidi ya 1M): 30%. Kizingiti cha mapato yasiyotozwa kodi: TZS 3,240,000/mwaka (TZS 270,000/mwezi kwa 0% — imejengwa ndani ya Bendi 1, hakuna punguzo tofauti la kila mwezi)./mwezi. Angalia Finance Act mpya kila Julai au wasiliana na TRA kuthibitisha bendi za sasa. Usitegemee viwango vya zamani bila kuthibitisha.
question_en: Do PAYE bands change every year or do they remain the same?
answer_en: PAYE bands may change annually through the Finance Act published each July. For 2025/2026, the bands are: Band 1 (0-270K): 0%; Band 2 (270K-520K): 8%; Band 3 (520K-760K): 20%; Band 4 (760K-1M): 25%; Band 5 (above 1M): 30%. Annual tax-free threshold: TZS 3,240,000/year (TZS 270,000/month at 0% — built into Band 1, no separate monthly relief)./month. Check the new Finance Act every July or contact TRA to confirm current bands. Do not rely on old rates without verifying.

instruction: Je, SDL na mshahara wa chini wa GN605A vinaunganika vipi?
output: Vina uhusiano wa moja kwa moja: mshahara wa chini wa GN605A unabainisha malipo ya chini kabisa kwa wafanyakazi — SDL (Skills Development Levy) ya 3.5% inakokotolewa kutoka jumla ya malipo hayo halisi. Kwa mfano, kama mwajiri analipa mshahara wa TZS 175,000 (kiwango cha kilimo) kwa mfanyakazi, SDL ni 3.5% ya TZS 175,000. Viwango vya GN605A vikiongezeka, msingi wa SDL nao unaongezeka. SDL inatumika kwa wajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi.

question_sw: Mkataba wa biashara ambao pande mbili zinasaini Tanzania unahitaji ushuru wa stempu kiotomatiki?
answer_sw: Si kila mkataba wa biashara unahitaji ushuru wa stempu Tanzania. Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu inaorodhesha nyaraka MAALUM zinazohitaji kupigwa stempu — kama hati za uhamishaji wa ardhi, dhamana, na mikataba maalum. Mikataba ya kawaida ya utoaji wa huduma au bidhaa kati ya makampuni mawili inaweza isihitaji ushuru wa stempu. Angalia jedwali la Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu kwa aina yako ya mkataba.
question_en: Does a business contract signed by two parties in Tanzania automatically require stamp duty?
answer_en: Not every business contract requires stamp duty in Tanzania. The Stamp Duty Act lists SPECIFIC instruments that need to be stamped — such as land transfer deeds, securities, and specified contracts. Ordinary service or goods contracts between two companies may not require stamp duty. Check the schedule of the Stamp Duty Act for your type of contract.

question_sw: Orodha yote ya makundi 15 ya GN 487A ipo wapi ili nione?
answer_sw: Orodha kamili ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa ipo katika maandiko rasmi ya GN 487A. Unaweza kuipata bure kwenye TanzLII.org (Tanzania Legal Information Institute): https://tanzlii.org/akn/tz/act/gn/2025/487a/eng@2025-07-28. Tovuti hii inaonyesha nakala kamili ya amri kama ilivyosajiliwa kwenye Gazeti la Serikali. Makampuni ya kisheria kama Bowmans, Dentons, DLA Piper, na VELMA Law pia yamechapisha muhtasari wa orodha kwenye tovuti zao — hizi ni muhimu kwa uelewa wa haraka, ingawa ni bora soma amri yenyewe ili kupata orodha kamili na sahihi.
question_en: Where can I find the full list of all 15 GN 487A categories?
answer_en: The complete list of the 15 prohibited categories is in the official text of GN 487A. You can access it free of charge at TanzLII.org (Tanzania Legal Information Institute): https://tanzlii.org/akn/tz/act/gn/2025/487a/eng@2025-07-28. This website shows the full text of the Order as gazetted. Law firms such as Bowmans, Dentons, DLA Piper, and VELMA Law have also published summaries of the list on their websites — these are useful for a quick overview, but it is best to read the Order itself for the complete and accurate list.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Je, ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unatumika kwa hati za kidijitali (e-contracts/digital agreements) zilizosainiwa mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu Tanzania (Stamp Duty Act) iliandikwa kabla ya enzi ya mikataba ya kidijitali. Hati za kidijitali au mikataba iliyosainiwa mtandaoni kwenye mazingira ya Tanzania yanaweza bado kuhitaji ushuru wa stempu ikiwa yanashughulikia aina za miamala zilizoorodheshwa kwenye sheria. Mfumo wa kisheria wa Tanzania wa e-transactions (e-Transactions Act) unasimamia hati za kidijitali. Angalia TRA au mwanasheria kwa hali yako.
question_en: Does Tanzania stamp duty apply to digital instruments (e-contracts/digital agreements) signed online?
answer_en: The Tanzania Stamp Duty Act was written before the era of digital contracts. Digital instruments or contracts signed online in Tanzania may still require stamp duty if they deal with listed transaction types. Tanzania's electronic transactions legal framework (e-Transactions Act) governs digital instruments. Check TRA or a lawyer for your specific situation.
next_review_trigger: e-Transactions Act or Stamp Duty Act update

question_sw: Mwajiri anayolipa mfanyakazi posho za chakula na usafiri anahitaji kujumuisha posho hizi katika msingi wa NSSF Tanzania?
answer_sw: Msingi wa michango ya NSSF Tanzania unategemea 'mshahara wa jumla' (gross wage). Posho za chakula na usafiri zinazolipwa kwa kawaida na mara kwa mara kama sehemu ya mfuko wa mishahara ZINAWEZA kujumuishwa kwenye msingi wa NSSF kulingana na jinsi zinavyofafanuliwa. Posho za hiari au zisizo za kawaida zinaweza kuepuka NSSF. Angalia NSSF na mwanasheria wa ajira kwa hali yako mahususi ya posho za mfanyakazi.
question_en: An employer paying food and transport allowances — must these be included in the NSSF base in Tanzania?
answer_en: The NSSF contribution base in Tanzania depends on 'gross wage'. Food and transport allowances paid regularly and consistently as part of the remuneration package MAY be included in the NSSF base depending on how they are defined. Discretionary or irregular allowances may escape NSSF. Check NSSF and an employment lawyer for your specific allowance situation.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act or gross wage definition update

question_sw: Ushonaji wa nguo — umekatazwa kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Ushonaji wa nguo (tailoring and garment making) haukutajwa moja kwa moja kama kategoria tofauti katika Ratiba ya GN 487A. Unaweza kuangukia chini ya Kategoria 15 'Umiliki na uendeshaji wa viwanda vidogo na vidogo sana (micro and small industries)' kama unafanywa kama biashara ya viwanda vidogo. Kwa sababu haukutajwa wazi, thibitisha hali yako mahususi na Idara ya Uhamiaji au wakili kabla ya kuhitimisha kama umejumuishwa au la., pamoja na biashara nyingine kama rejareja, jumla, uhamisho wa pesa, ukarabati wa simu, salon, na kinyozi. Wageni wanaofanya kazi ya ushonaji kama biashara ya kibiashara wanakiuka GN 487A.
question_en: Is tailoring/garment making prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: Tailoring and garment making is not explicitly named as a separate category in the GN 487A Schedule. It may fall under Category 15 'Ownership and operation of micro and small industries' if operated as a small industrial activity. If you operate a tailoring business as a micro or small industry, it is likely covered. However, since it is not explicitly named, verify your specific situation with the Immigration Department or a lawyer before assuming it is or is not covered., alongside other businesses such as retail, wholesale, mobile money transfers, phone repair, hair salons, and barbershops. Non-citizens conducting tailoring as a commercial business are violating GN 487A.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A prohibited category list

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anafariki kabla ya kustaafu. Familia yake inapata mafao gani ya NSSF?
answer_sw: Familia ya mfanyakazi aliyefariki inastahili mafao ya maisha (survivor benefits) kutoka NSSF. Wategemezi wa kisheria (mke/mume, watoto chini ya miaka 18, na wazazi wanaotegemea) wanaweza kudai: mafao ya kifo (death grant) — malipo ya mara moja — na mafao ya urithi (survivors pension) kwa wategemezi. Kuomba mafao haya, familia inapaswa: kwenda ofisi ya NSSF na cheti cha kifo, hati za utambulisho wa wategemezi, cheti cha ndoa, na cheti cha kuzaliwa kwa watoto. Madai lazima yafanyike ndani ya muda maalum.
answer_en: The family of a deceased employee is entitled to survivor benefits from NSSF. Legal dependants (spouse, children under 18, and dependent parents) may claim: a death grant (lump sum payment) and a survivor's pension for dependants. To claim these benefits, the family must: go to an NSSF office with a death certificate, identification documents of dependants, a marriage certificate, and birth certificates of children. Claims must be made within a specific time period.
question_en: An employee dies before retirement. What NSSF benefits does their family receive?
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment to survivor benefits

question_sw: Posho ya usafiri inapaswa kulipwa PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Inategemea: posho ya usafiri inayolipwa kupita kiasi cha gharama halisi za kazi (reimbursement ya kweli) inastahili PAYE. Posho inayolipwa kama nyongeza ya mshahara — bila kuhusiana na safari ya kazi — inastahili PAYE kamili. Thibitisha mtiririko halisi na TRA.
question_en: Is a transport allowance subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: It depends: transport allowance paid beyond actual business travel costs (genuine reimbursement) is subject to PAYE. Allowances paid as a salary top-up — not related to business travel — are fully subject to PAYE. Confirm the actual arrangement with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inayoanza (intending trader) inaweza kusajili VAT bila kuwa na mapato bado?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu anayekusudia kufanya biashara (intending trader) anaweza kuomba usajili wa VAT 'wakati wowote' mradi atoe ushahidi wa kutosha kama vile mikataba, zabuni, mipango ya ujenzi, mipango ya biashara, au ufadhili wa benki. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can a new start-up (intending trader) register for VAT with no revenue yet?
answer_en: Yes. An intending trader can apply for VAT registration 'at any time' provided they present sufficient evidence such as contracts, tenders, building plans, business plans, or bank financing. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Ikiwa sekta yangu haipo kwenye jedwali la GN 605A, ninatumia kiwango gani?
answer_sw: Ikiwa sekta yako haipo moja kwa moja kwenye jedwali la GN 605A, tumia kiwango cha jumla (general) cha karibu Shilingi 175,000 kwa mwezi kama kiwango cha chini. Inashauriwa kushauriana na Wizara ya Kazi kwa ufafanuzi.
question_en: If my sector is not listed in the GN 605A schedule, which rate applies?
answer_en: If your sector is not directly listed in the GN 605A schedule, apply the general minimum rate of approximately TZS 175,000 per month as the floor. It is advisable to consult the Ministry of Labour for clarification.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: SDL na OSHA — ni sheria zinazoathiriana?
answer_sw: Hapana moja kwa moja. SDL (Skills Development Levy) ni ushuru wa TRA unaohusiana na mafunzo ya ujuzi wa kazi. OSHA inasimamia usalama na afya mahali pa kazi. Ni sheria mbili tofauti zenye madhumuni tofauti. Kufuata OSHA hakukuondolei wajibu wa SDL, na kinyume chake.
question_en: SDL and OSHA — are they interconnected laws?
answer_en: Not directly. SDL (Skills Development Levy) is a TRA levy related to job skills training. OSHA governs occupational health and safety. They are two different laws with different purposes. OSHA compliance does not remove your SDL obligation, and vice versa.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: TRA inanikagua EFD. Wana mamlaka ya kuangalia rekodi zangu za miamala ya nyuma?
output: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka kamili ya kukagua rekodi zote za miamala zilizohifadhiwa kwenye mfumo wa EFD, ikiwa ni pamoja na miamala ya miaka ya nyuma. Rekodi za EFD zinapelekwa moja kwa moja kwenye seva za TRA (real-time reporting). Hakikisha miamala yote ya biashara yako imefanywa kupitia EFD na kutoa risiti. Ikiwa kuna kasoro, TRA inaweza kutoa tathmini ya ziada ya kodi (additional assessment).

instruction: VAT withholding kwa bidhaa ni asilimia ngapi chini ya Finance Act 2025?
output: VAT withholding kwa bidhaa ni asilimia 3, kuanzia tarehe 1 Julai 2025 chini ya Finance Act 2025. Kumbuka: thibitisha msingi sahihi wa hesabu (kiasi cha VAT au thamani yote ya invoice) moja kwa moja na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwani vyanzo vinatoa tafsiri tofauti.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri analazimika kuwa na huduma ya msaada wa kwanza (first aid) kazini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Waajiri wanalazimika kutoa vifaa vya msaada wa kwanza mahali pa kazi na kuhakikisha kuwa wafanyakazi waliofunzwa msaada wa kwanza wako kazini. Idadi ya mafundi wa msaada wa kwanza inategemea saizi ya mahali pa kazi.
question_en: Is an employer required to have first aid facilities at work?
answer_en: Yes. Employers must provide first aid equipment at the workplace and ensure trained first aiders are available. The number of first aiders required depends on the size of the workplace.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Ninaweza kusajili kampuni Zanzibar badala ya Tanzania Bara kwa faida za kodi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa masuala ya Zanzibar. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia Tanzania Bara peke yake. Uamuzi wa kusajili kampuni Zanzibar dhidi ya Tanzania Bara unahusisha mifumo tofauti ya kodi na kisheria — ZRB inasimamiwa tofauti na TRA. Wasiliana na ZRB kupitia zrb.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu kwa uamuzi huu. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

instruction: EFD na VAT — zinahusiana vipi? Mtu asiye na VAT bado anahitaji EFD?
output: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Mahusiano: EFD inaweza kuhitajika KABLA ya usajili wa VAT (kuanzia TZS 11M). VAT registered → EFD ni lazima bila shaka yoyote. Si VAT registered + mauzo TZS 11M+ → EFD bado inaweza kuhitajika kwa amri ya TRA. Usijitegemee kwamba kutokuwa na VAT kunamaanisha huhitaji EFD.

question_sw: Je, BRELA inaweza kufuta kampuni bila idhini ya wamiliki wake Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. BRELA inaweza kufuta kampuni kwenye rejista yake (administrative strike-off) ikiwa: (1) kampuni imeshindwa kuwasilisha annual return kwa miaka miwili au zaidi, (2) kuna ushahidi kwamba kampuni haifanyi tena shughuli. BRELA kawaida inatoa notisi kabla ya kufuta. Wamiliki wanaweza kupinga au kurudisha kampuni ikiwa kufutwa kulifanywa kwa kosa. Kampuni iliyofutwa na BRELA haina nguvu ya kisheria.
question_en: Can BRELA deregister a company without the owners' consent in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. BRELA can administratively strike off a company from its register if: (1) the company has failed to file annual returns for two or more years, (2) there is evidence the company is no longer operating. BRELA usually gives notice before striking off. Owners can object or restore the company if the strike-off was done in error. A company struck off by BRELA has no legal force.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Companies Act or BRELA administrative policy update

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina capital gains tax kwa uuzaji wa mali isiyohamishika?
answer_sw: Maswali ya capital gains tax kwa mali isiyohamishika (real estate) yako nje ya upeo wangu wa sasa. Ninashughulikia kodi za biashara za kawaida: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD. Kwa maswali ya kodi kwa uuzaji wa ardhi au majengo, wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyeandikishwa Tanzania. Hili ni tatizo la kisheria linalohitaji ushauri wa kitaalamu.
question_en: Does Tanzania have capital gains tax on real estate sales?
answer_en: Questions about capital gains tax on real estate are outside my current scope. I handle routine business taxes: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD. For tax questions on land or building sales, contact TRA (tra.go.tz) or a registered Tanzanian tax consultant. This is a legal matter requiring professional advice.

question_sw: Je, VAT withholding inatumika kwa wote Tanzania au kwa makampuni maalum tu?
answer_sw: VAT withholding inatumika kwa makampuni maalum tu — wale waliopewa leseni ya 'designated withholding agent' na TRA. Si makampuni yote. Kawaida ni taasisi za serikali na makampuni makubwa ya sekta binafsi yaliyochaguliwa na TRA. Kama hujapewa leseni hiyo, huhitajiwi kuzuia VAT. Kiwango cha VAT kwako bado ni asilimia 18 ya kawaida.
question_en: Does VAT withholding apply to everyone in Tanzania or only specific companies?
answer_en: VAT withholding applies only to specific companies — those designated as 'withholding agents' by TRA. Not all companies. Typically these are government institutions and selected large private sector companies chosen by TRA. If you have not been designated as a withholding agent, you are not required to withhold VAT. Your VAT rate remains the standard 18%.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kusaidia mwajiriwa wake kulipa kodi yake ya PAYE kama sehemu ya mfuko wa mishahara — kampuni inalipa kodi badala ya mwajiriwa — je, inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kampuni inaweza kubeba mzigo wa PAYE ya mwajiriwa — lakini thamani ya PAYE inayolipwa na mwajiri inaonekana kama manufaa ya ziada ya mwajiriwa (benefit in kind) na lazima ijumuishwe tena kwenye mshahara wa mwajiriwa kwa madhumuni ya kodi. Hii inasababisha 'gross-up' ya mshahara. Ni halali lakini inahitaji makokotoo sahihi ya mhasibu.
question_en: A company can pay an employee's PAYE on their behalf as part of the salary package — the company pays tax instead of the employee — is this allowed?
answer_en: Yes, a company can bear an employee's PAYE burden — but the PAYE paid by the employer is treated as an additional employee benefit (benefit in kind) and must be grossed back into the employee's salary for tax purposes. This causes a 'gross-up' of the salary. It is legal but requires accurate calculations by an accountant.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu ana ulemavu — anapaswa kulipwa SDL?
answer_sw: Swali hili linachanganya mambo mawili tofauti. SDL si malipo ya wafanyakazi wenye ulemavu — ni ushuru wa mwajiri. Mwajiri analipa SDL kwa TRA kwa kiwango cha 3.5% ya mishahara yote, bila kujali hali ya kiafya ya wafanyakazi. Mfanyakazi mwenye ulemavu ana haki zake tofauti chini ya ELRA na WCF, lakini hizo hazihusiani na SDL.
question_en: My employee has a disability — should they be paid SDL?
answer_en: This question confuses two different things. SDL is not a payment to disabled employees — it is an employer levy. The employer pays SDL to TRA at 3.5% of total gross payroll, regardless of employees' health status. An employee with a disability has separate rights under ELRA and WCF, but those are unrelated to SDL.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: BRELA inasajili biashara ngapi — nimesikia kuna zaidi ya kumi?
output: Hapana — BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Nambari 16 au nyingine kubwa inaweza kutoka chanzo kisicho sahihi. Thibitisha kila wakati na brela.go.tz.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kusajilisha biashara yangu na wafanyakazi wake na NSSF?
answer_sw: Hatua za kusajilisha na NSSF ni: 1) Tembelea ofisi ya NSSF iliyo karibu nawe au tovuti nssf.go.tz. 2) Wasilisha fomu ya usajilishaji wa mwajiri pamoja na nakala ya certificate ya BRELA, TIN, na vitambulisho vya wafanyakazi. 3) Kila mfanyakazi atasajiliwa na kupewa nambari yake ya NSSF. 4) Baada ya usajilishaji, utapewa akaunti ya kulipa michango kila mwezi. Thibitisha nyaraka zinazohitajika na NSSF kwenye nssf.go.tz kabla ya kwenda.
question_en: How do I register my business and employees with NSSF?
answer_en: Steps to register with NSSF: 1) Visit your nearest NSSF office or the website nssf.go.tz. 2) Submit an employer registration form along with copies of your BRELA certificate, TIN, and employees' identification. 3) Each employee will be registered and assigned their own NSSF number. 4) After registration, you will be given an account for monthly contribution payments. Confirm the required documents with NSSF at nssf.go.tz before going.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.go.tz before training

question_sw: Shule au chuo binafsi chenye walimu 20 — je, kinalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Shule na vyuo binafsi vinavyofanya kazi kama biashara binafsi vinaweza kutakiwa kulipa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — ikiwa vina wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Msamaha unategemea hali ya usajili (NGO, taasisi ya kidini, au kampuni ya biashara). Kama chuo kiliposajiliwa kama NGO au taasisi ya kidini, tafuta uthibitisho wa msamaha kutoka TRA. La sivyo, lipa SDL kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
question_en: A private school or college with 20 teachers — does it pay SDL?
answer_en: Private schools and colleges operating as private businesses may be required to pay SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — if they have 10 or more employees. Exemption depends on registration status (NGO, religious institution, or commercial company). If the institution is registered as an NGO or religious body, seek written exemption confirmation from TRA. Otherwise, pay SDL at 3.5% of total gross payroll.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya jumla (wholesale) — inahitaji kutoa risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala wa biashara-kwa-biashara (B2B)?
output: Ndiyo. Biashara yote — B2C (biashara kwa mtumiaji wa mwisho) na B2B (biashara kwa biashara) — zinazofuata kizingiti cha EFD (TZS 11M+ au zilizosajiliwa VAT) lazima zitoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala. Muamala wa B2B hausamehewi. Kila muamala lazima uingie kwenye mfumo wa EFD na risiti itolewe.
