instruction: SDL inakokotolewa kwa mshahara wa jumla (gross salary) peke yake — au inajumuisha faida zisizo za fedha kama nyumba na gari?
output: SDL inakokotolewa kwa MALIPO YA FEDHA TU — si faida zisizo za fedha. Faida zisizo za fedha (benefits in kind) kama nyumba ya kampuni, gari la kampuni, bima ya afya iliyolipiwa na mwajiri — HAZIJUMUISHWI kwenye SDL base. SDL base ni jumla ya mishahara ya FEDHA ya wafanyakazi wote — pesa inayolipwa mkononi au benki tu. Thibitisha utaratibu sahihi wa SDL base na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Nina bidhaa zinazozalishwa Tanzania lakini hazipo kwenye Common List — ninaweza kutumia STR?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ingawa bidhaa zako zinazalishwa Tanzania (originating status ✓), kama hazipo kwenye Common List, hazistahili manufaa ya STR. Lazima masharti yote mawili yakidhiwe. Kwa bidhaa zisizopo kwenye Common List, utaratibu wa kawaida wa forodha na ushuru unaotumika.
question_en: I have goods produced in Tanzania but not on the Common List — can I use STR?
answer_en: No. Although your goods are produced in Tanzania (originating status ✓), if they are not on the Common List, they do not qualify for STR benefits. Both conditions must be met. For goods not on the Common List, the standard customs process and applicable duties apply.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Je, mgeni anaweza kulipa faini na kuendelea na duka lake — kama leseni ya adhabu?
answer_sw: Hapana. Faini si leseni ya kuendelea. Baada ya kulipa faini, biashara bado inabaki kuwa haramu kwa raia wa kigeni, na visa inafutwa. Mtu anaweza kulazimishwa kuondoka Tanzania kabisa. Kulipa faini hakupi haki ya kuendelea.
question_en: Can a non-citizen pay the fine and keep the shop open — like a penalty licence?
answer_en: No. The fine is not a licence to continue. After paying the fine, the business remains illegal for the non-citizen to operate, and the visa is revoked. The person may be required to leave Tanzania entirely. Paying the fine does not grant the right to continue.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: mfanyabiashara wa Tanzania anapaswa kujua nini kuhusu kodi za huduma za kidijitali?
answer_sw: Mambo makuu: (1) VAT ya kawaida ni 18% — bado inatumika kwa bidhaa/huduma nyingi; (2) VAT ya 16% kwa B2C e-payments kuanzia 1 Sep 2025; (3) Withholding tax 6% kwa huduma (ikiwa ni pamoja na kidijitali) kuanzia 1 Jul 2025; (4) EFD inahitajika kwa mauzo ya mtandaoni pia; (5) Watoa huduma wa nje wanaweza kuwa na wajibu wa VAT Tanzania. Thibitisha maelezo ya utekelezaji na TRA kwa sababu kanuni fulani bado zinaandaliwa.
question_en: Summary: what does a Tanzanian business need to know about digital services taxes?
answer_en: Key points: (1) Standard VAT is 18% — still applies to most goods/services; (2) 16% VAT on B2C e-payments from 1 Sep 2025; (3) 6% withholding tax on services (including digital) from 1 Jul 2025; (4) EFD is required for online sales too; (5) Foreign service providers may have Tanzania VAT obligations. Verify implementation details with TRA as some rules are still being finalized.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Cheti cha WHT (WHT certificate) kinatumika kwa nini?
answer_sw: Cheti cha WHT kinathibitisha kwamba mwajiri alilipa WHT kwa niaba ya mpokeaji. Mpokeaji anaweza kutumia cheti hiki kama mkopo wa kodi dhidi ya kodi yake ya mwisho ya mwaka (tax credit). Kampuni inayowasilisha taarifa ya kodi ya kampuni inaweza kupunguza kodi yake kwa kiasi cha WHT iliyokatwa na kuonyeshwa kwenye cheti.
question_en: What is a WHT certificate used for?
answer_en: A WHT certificate confirms that the payer remitted WHT on behalf of the recipient. The recipient can use this certificate as a tax credit against their final annual tax liability. A company filing a corporate income tax return can reduce its tax liability by the WHT amount shown on the certificate.

question_sw: Msambazaji wa nje ya nchi (exporter) anaweza kudai refund ya VAT — kwa nini?
answer_sw: Exports (mauzo nje ya nchi) zinabeba kiwango cha VAT cha 0% (zero-rated). Hii inamaanisha exporter hakusanyi VAT kutoka kwa wateja wake wa nje — output VAT = 0. Lakini exporter bado ananunua bidhaa/huduma Tanzania na kulipa input VAT ya kawaida (18%). Kwa hivyo input VAT > output VAT, na exporter ana haki ya kudai refund ya input VAT iliyolipwa.
question_en: An exporter can claim a VAT refund — why?
answer_en: Exports carry a 0% VAT rate (zero-rated). This means the exporter does not collect VAT from foreign customers — output VAT = 0. But the exporter still buys goods/services in Tanzania and pays regular input VAT (18%). Therefore input VAT > output VAT, and the exporter is entitled to claim a refund of the input VAT paid.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Deadline ya kuwasilisha VAT return nchini Tanzania ni lini?
answer_sw: VAT return inatakiwa iwasilishwe TRA ifikapo siku ya 20 ya mwezi unaofuata baada ya kipindi cha ripoti. Kwa mfano, VAT return ya Januari iwasilishwe ifikapo 20 Februari. Ucheleweshaji unaweza kusababisha faini na riba. Thibitisha ratiba hii na TRA kwani inaweza kubadilika baada ya Finance Act.
question_en: What is the deadline for filing a VAT return in Tanzania?
answer_en: VAT returns must be submitted to TRA by the 20th of the month following the reporting period. For example, the January VAT return must be filed by 20 February. Late filing can result in penalties and interest charges. Confirm this schedule with TRA as it may change after each Finance Act.

instruction: Mbia wangu wa biashara ni mgeni — GN 487A inaathiri ubia wetu vipi?
output: GN 487A ya 28 Julai 2025 ina kipengele cha mpito (transitional provision): mgeni aliyekuwa na leseni halisi kabla ya tarehe ya kufanya kazi ya GN 487A anaweza kuendelea na shughuli hiyo hadi leseni yake inaisha — lakini hawezi kuomba upya (renewal) wa leseni hiyo. Ubia (partnership) wenye mgeni kama mshirika: Kama mgeni ana hisa na pia anafanya kazi ya uendeshaji wa biashara iliyokatazwa, GN 487A inaweza kutumika. Adhabu pia zinawafikia WATANZANIA wanaowasaidia wageni kukwepa GN 487A: faini ya TZS 5M au kifungo cha miezi 3. Muundo salama: Mtanzania ndiye mmiliki na mwendeshaji — mgeni anaweza kuwa mwekezaji tu.

question_sw: Biashara zipi Tanzania zinalazimishwa kutumia EFD?
answer_sw: TRA inaweza kutoa amri ya EFD kwa aina yoyote ya biashara. Kwa sasa, EFD ni lazima kwa: (1) biashara zote zilizosajili VAT (bila kujali ukubwa), (2) biashara zilizoteuliwa na TRA hata kama hazisajili VAT. TRA imetoa orodha ya sekta zinalazimika kutumia EFD — ikiwa ni pamoja na maduka ya rejareja, hoteli, hospitali za kibinafsi, na sekta nyingine. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa orodha ya hali ya sasa ya sekta zinazolazimika.
question_en: Which businesses in Tanzania are required to use an EFD?
answer_en: TRA can issue an EFD directive to any business type. Currently, EFD is mandatory for: (1) all VAT-registered businesses (regardless of size), (2) businesses designated by TRA even if not VAT-registered. TRA has published a list of sectors required to use EFD — including retail shops, hotels, private hospitals, and other sectors. Check TRA directly for the current list of mandatory sectors.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa ngazi ya juu (senior manager) anahitaji kujumuishwa kwenye NSSF Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa ngazi ya juu — ikiwa ni pamoja na wasimamizi wakuu, wakurugenzi waliochukuliwa kazi rasmi, na wafanyakazi wengine wa mishahara ya juu — wanalazimishwa kusajiliwa NSSF kama wafanyakazi wengine wote. Sheria ya NSSF HAINA msamaha wa ngazi ya kazi au kiwango cha mshahara. Mfanyakazi anayepata mshahara mkubwa bado analipa michango ya NSSF bila kikomo cha juu kwa kawaida (angalia NSSF kwa kiwango cha juu ikiwa kinatumiwa).
question_en: Does a senior manager need to be included in NSSF in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. A senior manager — including managing directors, formally employed directors, and other high-salary staff — is required to register with NSSF like all other employees. The NSSF Act has NO exemption for job level or salary amount. A worker earning a large salary still pays NSSF contributions without a ceiling in most cases (check NSSF for whether a ceiling applies).
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Kuna uhusiano gani kati ya BRELA, TRA, OSHA, na NSSF — wanashiriki taarifa?
answer_sw: Vyombo vya serikali vya Tanzania vina uhusiano wa kushirikiana taarifa unaoendelea kukua. TRA inashirikiana na BRELA — usajili wa kampuni BRELA mara nyingi unahusishwa na mfumo wa TIN moja kwa moja. TRA inaweza kupata taarifa za ajira kutoka NSSF ili kutathmini PAYE na SDL. OSHA na WCF wanaweza pia kushiriki taarifa na TRA. Hii inamaanisha biashara isiyofuata sheria moja inaweza kugunduliwa kupitia chombo kingine.
question_en: What is the relationship between BRELA, TRA, OSHA, and NSSF — do they share information?
answer_en: Tanzania government agencies have a growing data-sharing relationship. TRA cooperates with BRELA — company registration at BRELA is often linked directly to the TIN system. TRA can obtain employment data from NSSF to assess PAYE and SDL. OSHA and WCF may also share data with TRA. This means a business that fails to comply with one agency can be discovered through another.

instruction: Kampuni yangu haikuwasilisha annual return BRELA kwa mwaka mmoja — nini kitatokea?
output: Kushindwa kuwasilisha annual return BRELA kunasababisha: (1) Faini ya TZS 2,500 kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi wa kuchelewa — zinakusanyika kila mwezi; (2) Hatari ya kampuni kufutwa orodha (deregistration) — BRELA ina uwezo wa kufuta kampuni isiyozingatia; (3) Hatari ya kampuni kuonekana 'dormant' au inactive kwenye rekodi rasmi; (4) Vikwazo vya biashara — benki na wadau wa biashara wanaweza kukataa kufanya nao biashara bila uthibitisho wa hali ya sasa. Ada ya kawaida ya annual return ni TZS 22,000 pamoja na faini. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz.

instruction: Mke na mume wanaofanya biashara pamoja — ni bora kuwa partnership au kampuni?
output: Kwa mke na mume wanaofanya biashara pamoja, chaguzi kuu: UBIA (partnership) kati ya wao: rahisi kuanzisha, lakini kila mwenzi anashikiliwa kibinafsi kwa madeni yote. Tatizo: madeni ya biashara yanaweza kuathiri mali zote za familia. KAMPUNI YA HISA (wakiwa wanahisa wawili): inatoa ulinzi wa mali za kibinafsi (limited liability), kampuni inabaki hata mmoja akifariki, rahisi zaidi kuomba mkopo wa biashara kwa benki. BRELA usajili wa kampuni: min TZS 95,000, annual returns TZS 22,000/mwaka. Familia nyingi wanachagua kampuni kwa ulinzi na ukuaji wa muda mrefu. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Biashara inayopokea ufadhili (grant) kutoka shirika la kimataifa — mpokeaji wa grant analipa VAT na anahitaji EFD Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ufadhili (grant) kutoka shirika la kimataifa kwa kawaida si mauzo ya kibiashara yanayostahili VAT — ni mapato ya hiari, si malipo kwa bidhaa/huduma. Kwa hivyo, grant yenyewe kwa kawaida HAILIPISHI VAT wala haihitaji EFD. Hata hivyo, ikiwa shirika la kimataifa linakununulia bidhaa au huduma (yaani unauza kwake), hizo ni mauzo ya kawaida zinazostahili VAT na EFD. Angalia mwanasheria wa kodi kwa muundo maalum wa ufadhili wako.
question_en: A business receiving a grant from an international organisation — does the grant recipient pay VAT and need an EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: A grant from an international organisation is generally not a commercial sale subject to VAT — it is gratuitous income, not payment for goods/services. Therefore, the grant itself generally does NOT attract VAT or require an EFD. However, if the international organisation is buying goods or services from you (i.e., you are selling to them), those are regular taxable sales requiring VAT and an EFD. Consult a tax lawyer for your specific grant structure.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kuepuka matatizo ya ukaguzi wa VAT wakati wa kudai refund?
answer_sw: Kuepuka matatizo ya ukaguzi wa VAT: (1) Hifadhi kumbukumbu zote za VAT kwa miaka 5 angalau; (2) Hakikisha risiti zote za EFD zimewekwa vizuri; (3) Oanisha VAT returns na kumbukumbu za uhasibu; (4) Nunua kutoka wasambazaji waliosajilistwaa VAT tu; (5) Epuka madai ya input VAT yasiyohusiana na biashara; (6) Wasilisha VAT returns kwa wakati na kwa usahihi. Kumbukumbu nzuri = ukaguzi rahisi.
question_en: How to avoid audit problems when claiming a VAT refund?
answer_en: To avoid VAT audit problems: (1) Keep all VAT records for at least 5 years; (2) Ensure all EFD receipts are properly filed; (3) Reconcile VAT returns with accounting records; (4) Buy only from VAT-registered suppliers; (5) Avoid input VAT claims unrelated to business; (6) File VAT returns on time and accurately. Good records = easier audit.

instruction: GN 487A ilitekelezwa na kupitishwa na nani — ni amri ya Rais au ya Waziri?
output: GN 487A ni Government Notice (Tangazo la Serikali) lililotolewa chini ya Sheria ya Leseni za Biashara (Business Licensing Act) — inaweza kutolewa na Waziri mwenye dhamana bila kuhitaji kupita Bungeni. Ni amri ya kiutawala (ministerial order) yenye nguvu ya kisheria sawa na sheria. Hii ni tofauti na Sheria ya Bunge ambayo inahitaji kupita hatua za Bunge. Kwa hivyo GN 487A inaweza kubadilishwa au kufutwa na tangazo jipya la serikali bila kupita Bungeni — lakini bado ina nguvu kamili ya kisheria kwa sasa hivi. Thibitisha na tangazo rasmi la Serikali na TanzLII.

question_sw: Nini kinatokea nikichelewa kujisajili kwa VAT baada ya kufika kizingiti?
answer_sw: Uchelewaji wa usajili wa VAT una adhabu kali. TRA inaweza: (1) Kukuandalia VAT ya malimbikizo kwa kipindi chote cha uchelewaji kwa kiwango cha asilimia 18; (2) Kutoza faini ya usajili wa kuchelewa; (3) Kutozea riba kwa VAT iliyodaiwa. Jisajili mapema iwezekanavyo ukifika kizingiti — siku 30 ni kikomo cha kisheria.
question_en: What happens if I delay registering for VAT after reaching the threshold?
answer_en: Delayed VAT registration carries serious penalties. TRA may: (1) Assess backdated VAT for the entire period of delay at 18%; (2) Impose a late registration penalty; (3) Charge interest on the VAT assessed. Register as soon as possible once you reach the threshold — 30 days is the legal deadline.

instruction: BRELA inashughulikia usajili wa aina gani za biashara?
output: BRELA inashughulikia: usajili wa kampuni (companies), ushirikiano (partnerships), majina ya biashara (business names), milki za biashara moja (sole proprietorships), na milki ya kiakili (alama za biashara, hataza, miundo ya viwanda). BRELA si mamlaka ya leseni za sekta maalum (kama madawa au utalii) -- hizo zina mamlaka zake tofauti. Thibitisha aina ya usajili unaohitajika na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

instruction: Dawa za binadamu zinaingizwa Tanzania — je, zina VAT au exemption?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Hali ya VAT kwa dawa za binadamu — kama zimesamehewa, zero-rated, au zinaapply msamaha maalum — ni mada inayohusisha Jedwali la VAT Act la Tanzania ambapo baadhi ya dawa zimeorodheshwa tofauti. Hii inahitaji uchambuzi wa kina wa kisheria nje ya wigo wangu wa biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi wa sekta ya afya kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Gari la kampuni linalotumika na mfanyakazi kwa matumizi ya kibinafsi — PAYE inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Manufaa ya gari la kampuni yanayotumiwa kwa matumizi ya kibinafsi (personal use of company car) yanachukuliwa kama mapato yanayolazimika PAYE. TRA ina njia ya kuhesabu thamani ya manufaa haya. Matumizi ya gari kwa ajili ya biashara tu hayajumuishwi.
question_en: Company car used by an employee for personal use — does PAYE apply?
answer_en: Yes. The benefit of a company car used for personal use is treated as taxable employment income. TRA has a prescribed method for valuing this benefit. Use strictly for business purposes is not included.

question_sw: VAT inalipwa kwa muda gani na msajiliwa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Msajiliwa wa VAT analipa VAT kupitia return ya VAT ya kila mwezi. Return na malipo yanatolewa ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa biashara. Thibitisha tarehe na TRA.
question_en: When does a VAT registrant file and pay VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: A VAT registrant pays VAT through a monthly VAT return. The return and payment are due by the 20th of the month following the trading month. Confirm the deadline with TRA.

instruction: Je, EFD machine iliyoharibika inatoa msamaha wa kutoa risiti?
output: Hapana -- EFD iliyoharibika haifai kama udhuru wa kutotoa risiti. Biashara inapaswa kuwasiliana na TRA na msambazaji wa EFD mara moja ili kurekebisha au kubadilisha machine. Wakati wa ukarabati, biashara inaweza kutumia risiti za kawaida za muda mfupi kama TRA imeruhusu -- lakini hii inahitaji idhini ya awali kutoka TRA. Thibitisha utaratibu wa dharura na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Daktari binafsi aliye na kliniki ndogo — anahitaji kusajili VAT?
output: Huduma za afya (medical services) nyingi zimesamehewa VAT (exempt) Tanzania. Hata hivyo, daktari aliyeidhinishwa anapaswa kuthibitisha na TRA: (1) Je, huduma zake ni exempt au standard rated? (2) Je, ana wajibu wowote wa usajili kama mtaalamu aliyeidhinishwa? Thibitisha hali yako maalum na TRA kwa sababu sekta ya afya ina kanuni maalum za VAT.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya ya Tanzania haihitaji kulipa kodi ya mapato kwa miaka mitatu ya kwanza ya biashara — je, hii ni sera ya serikali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Hakuna msamaha wa jumla wa kodi ya kampuni kwa miaka mitatu kwa kampuni mpya. Kampuni zote za Tanzania zinaanza kulipa kodi ya kampuni mara zinapoanza kufanya faida. Msamaha wa kodi mahususi unaweza kutolewa kwa sekta fulani (kama uwekezaji wa TIC), lakini hauitumiki kwa biashara zote mpya kwa ujumla.
question_en: A new Tanzania company does not need to pay income tax for the first three years — is this government policy?
answer_en: No. There is no general three-year corporate tax exemption for new companies. All Tanzania companies begin paying corporate tax as soon as they make a profit. Specific tax exemptions may be granted for certain sectors (such as TIC investments), but these do not apply to all new businesses generally.

instruction: Ninaweza kusimama usajilishaji wa VAT (deregister) kama mauzo yangu yameshuka?
output: Ndiyo. Unaweza kuomba kusimamishwa usajilishaji wa VAT (deregistration) kwa Kamishna wa TRA kama mauzo yako yameshuka chini ya kizingiti (TZS 200M kwa mwaka) kwa muda wa kutosha. Mchakato wa kusimama ni rasmi — lazima uombe kwa Kamishna na uweke hoja. Huwezi kusimama mwenyewe bila idhini ya TRA. Pata msaada wa wahasibu au mshauri wa kodi kufanya ombi hili vizuri.

instruction: Mabadiliko ya SDL yanayotokana na GN 605A — yalianza kulipwa kutoka Septemba 2025?
output: Hapana — mabadiliko ya SDL yanayotokana na GN 605A yalianza kutumika tarehe 1 JANUARI 2026, si Septemba 2025. Septemba 2025 ni tarehe ya jambo tofauti — mabadiliko ya VAT ya B2C chini ya Finance Act 2025, si GN 605A. GN 605A ilianza 1 Januari 2026, hivyo SDL inayohusiana na ongezeko la mishahara ya GN 605A pia inaanza kutoka malipo ya Januari 2026 — yaani SDL ya Januari inalipwa ifikapo 7 Februari 2026. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Je, mauzo ya bidhaa za zero-rated yanajumuishwa katika kizingiti cha kusajiliwa VAT?
output: Ndiyo. Mauzo ya bidhaa za zero-rated yanajumuishwa katika kuhesabu kizingiti cha kusajiliwa VAT (TZS milioni 200 kwa mwaka au TZS milioni 100 kwa miezi 6). Kwa sababu zero-rated bado ni usambazaji wa VAT (hata kama kwa asilimia 0). Mauzo ya bidhaa za exempt yanajumuishwa pia kwa madhumuni fulani -- thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa hali yako maalum.

instruction: GN605A ni nini hasa na linianza kutumika?
output: GN605A ni Amri ya Mshahara wa Chini ya Sekta Binafsi iliyotangazwa rasmi Oktoba 13, 2025. Ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Amri hii inabainisha viwango vya mshahara wa chini kwa sekta 16 na subsekta nyingi. question_sw: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) usajili unagharimu kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Usajili wa WCF hauna ada ya usajili ya moja kwa moja — gharama kuu ni mchango wa kila mwaka (annual premium) unaohesabiwa kwa asilimia 0.5% ya jumla ya mishahara ya mwaka. Kwa mfano, kampuni yenye mishahara ya TZS 100M kwa mwaka italipa TZS 500,000 kwa WCF kwa mwaka. Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 1+ Tanzania analazimika kusajili WCF. Angalia portal.wcf.go.tz kwa mchakato wa usajili.
question_en: How much does WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) registration cost?
answer_en: WCF registration has no direct registration fee — the main cost is the annual premium calculated at 0.5% of total annual payroll. For example, a company with TZS 100M annual payroll pays TZS 500,000 per year to WCF. Employers with 1+ workers in Tanzania are required to register with WCF. Check portal.wcf.go.tz for the registration process.

instruction: Nilinunua hisa za kampuni mwaka 2020 kwa TZS 5M, sasa ninaziuza kwa TZS 20M — kodi ni ngapi?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa hisa (TZS 15M katika mfano huu) inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango cha kodi halisi, msamaha wowote unaotumika, na tarehe ya kuwasilisha kwa TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Daktari anasema: 'Huduma za afya zimesamehewa VAT — kwa hivyo sijasajilishwa.' Je, hoja hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hoja hii ina nuance muhimu. Kweli fulani: huduma za afya za msingi (basic health services) zinaweza kuwa exempt au zero-rated kwa VAT. Lakini: hii haimaanishi daktari hauhitaji KUSAJILIWA VAT. Hata kama huduma zako ziko exempt, unastahili kusajiliwa kama fani iliyodhibitiwa. Pia, si huduma zote za madaktari ni exempt — huduma za kibinafsi za hali ya juu, huduma za urembo, na zingine zinaweza kuwa taxable.
question_en: A doctor says: 'Health services are VAT-exempt — so I have not registered.' Is this argument correct?
answer_en: This argument has an important nuance. Partly true: basic health services may be exempt or zero-rated for VAT. But: this does not mean a doctor does not need to BE REGISTERED for VAT. Even if your services are exempt, you are still required to register as a regulated profession. Also, not all doctors' services are exempt — high-end private services, cosmetic services, and others may be taxable.

instruction: Kwa nini biashara ya zero-rated ni nzuri zaidi kuliko biashara ya exempt kwa upande wa VAT?
output: Biashara ya zero-rated inaweza kudai VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) kwenye gharama zake -- hata kama haitozwi VAT kwenye mauzo yake (0%). Hii inamaanisha inaweza kupata VAT iliyolipwa kwenye manunuzi kurudishwa na TRA. Biashara ya exempt haiwezi kudai input VAT -- gharama hizo zinaongeza bei za uendeshaji. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mgeni anayeishi Tanzania kwa miaka 20 ana haki maalum chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A inategemea URAIA, si muda wa makazi. Mtu anayeishi Tanzania kwa miaka 20 bila kupata uraia wa Tanzania bado anachukuliwa kuwa raia wa kigeni chini ya amri hii. Muda wa makazi haumpi msamaha wowote.
question_en: Does a non-citizen living in Tanzania for 20 years have special rights under GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A is based on CITIZENSHIP, not length of residence. A person who has lived in Tanzania for 20 years without obtaining Tanzanian citizenship is still considered a non-citizen under this order. Length of residence provides no exemption.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya ujenzi — serikali ni mbia mkubwa wangu. Nieleze mchakato wa VAT withholding.
output: Mchakato kwa mbia wa serikali katika ujenzi: (1) toa invoice yako ikijumuisha VAT ya 18%; (2) serikali (mnunuzi anayehitimu) itakata sehemu ya VAT; (3) serikali italipa kiasi kilichobakia; (4) serikali itatoa certificate ya withholding inayoonyesha details kamili; (5) tumia certificate kudai pembejeo ya VAT kwenye return yako ifikapo tarehe 20. Kwa hesabu ya kiasi kinachokatwa, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Usajili wa VAT unafanywa kupitia mfumo gani wa TRA?
answer_sw: Maombi ya usajili wa VAT yanafanywa kupitia Lango la Walipa Kodi (IDRAS — Taxpayer Portal) kwenye tovuti ya TRA baada ya mteja kuingia kwenye akaunti yake. Thibitisha mahitaji ya sasa na TRA.
question_en: Which TRA system is used to apply for VAT registration?
answer_en: VAT registration applications are made through TRA's Taxpayer Portal (IDRAS) on the TRA website after the applicant logs into their account. Confirm current requirements with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni inayolipa ada za usimamizi (management fees) kwa kampuni mama ya nje ya nchi haihitaji kushikilia kodi ya zuio Tanzania — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ada za usimamizi (management fees) au ada za huduma za kiufundi (technical service fees) zinazolipwa kwa mtu asiye mkazi zinakatwa kodi ya zuio Tanzania. Kiwango kwa kawaida ni asilimia 15 kwa ada za usimamizi. Kushindwa kushikilia kodi hii kunafanya mlipaji (kampuni ya Tanzania) awajibike kulipa kodi hiyo pamoja na riba na adhabu.
question_en: A company paying management fees to a foreign parent company does not need to withhold tax in Tanzania — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Management fees or technical service fees paid to a non-resident attract withholding tax in Tanzania. The rate is generally 15% on management fees. Failing to withhold makes the payer (the Tanzania company) liable to pay the tax together with interest and penalties.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya pango la kibiashara (commercial rent) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya pango la kibiashara ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on commercial rent in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on commercial rent is 10% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Je, NSSF na PPF (Parastatal Pensions Fund) ni tofauti — wafanyakazi wa sekta gani wanakwenda wapi?
output: Ndiyo, ni tofauti: NSSF inahudumia wafanyakazi wa sekta binafsi Tanzania. PPF inahudumia wafanyakazi wa mashirika ya umma (parastatal) na serikali. Wafanyakazi wa sekta binafsi wanachangia NSSF — si PPF. Kama mfanyakazi anasogea kati ya sekta binafsi na serikali, anachangia shirika linalolingana na mwajiri wake wa wakati huo. Kwa shaka kuhusu shirika gani, thibitisha na mwajiri wako au NSSF/PPF moja kwa moja.

Kuendelea bila ruhusa ni kosa la kisheria.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana mapato mawili — mshahara wa kampuni ya A na kazi ya sehemu kwa kampuni ya B. Je, kila mwajiri anakata PAYE kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kila mwajiri anakata PAYE kwenye mshahara wake peke yake kwa kutumia jedwali la kawaida. Tatizo ni kwamba mfanyakazi anapata msamaha wa TZS 270,000/mwezi mara mbili — moja kwa kila mwajiri — wakati anapaswa kupata mara moja tu. Mwishoni mwa mwaka, mfanyakazi anaweza kulazimika kulipa PAYE ya ziada ikiwa jumla ya mapato kutoka pande zote mbili inasababisha kodi ya juu zaidi. Mfanyakazi anapaswa kuripoti hali hii kwa TRA kupitia kujaza return ya mtu binafsi.
answer_en: Each employer withholds PAYE on their own salary payment using the normal tax bands. The problem is that the employee receives the TZS 270,000/month personal relief twice — once from each employer — when they are entitled to it only once. At year end, the employee may owe additional PAYE if combined income from both sources falls into a higher tax band. The employee should report this situation to TRA by filing an individual income tax return.
question_en: An employee has two incomes — a salary from Company A and part-time work at Company B. How much PAYE does each employer deduct?

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara wa mpakani wa Tunduma — GN 487A inamsimamia?
answer_sw: Kama mfanyabiashara ni raia wa Tanzania, GN 487A haimsimamia — inalinda raia wa Tanzania katika sekta zilizokatazwa kwa wageni. Kama mfanyabiashara ni raia wa kigeni (Zambia, au nchi nyingine), GN 487A inaweza kutumika kama anafanya shughuli zilizo kwenye orodha ya 15 (kama biashara ya rejareja). Uraia ndio kigezo.
question_en: A border trader at Tunduma — does GN 487A apply to them?
answer_en: If the trader is a Tanzanian citizen, GN 487A does not apply to them — it protects Tanzanian citizens in sectors prohibited to foreigners. If the trader is a non-citizen (Zambian, or from another country), GN 487A may apply if they are conducting activities on the list of 15 (like retail trade). Citizenship is the criterion.

question_sw: WHT kwa ada za usimamizi na huduma za kitaalamu (management/professional fees) kwa wakazi ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha WHT kwa ada za usimamizi na huduma za kitaalamu kwa wakazi ni asilimia 5. Kwa wasio wakazi, kiwango ni asilimia 15. Tofauti hii kati ya wakazi na wasio wakazi ni muhimu kwa makampuni yanayolipa ada kwa wataalam wa kigeni.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on management and professional service fees for residents?
answer_en: The WHT rate on management and professional service fees for residents is 5%. For non-residents the rate is 15%. This difference between residents and non-residents is important for companies paying fees to foreign experts.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu unapunguzwa ikiwa ardhi inahamishwa kama zawadi (gift) kati ya familia — je, kuna msamaha?
answer_sw: Tanzania inaweza kuwa na masharti maalum ya ushuru wa stempu kwa uhamisho wa zawadi (gift) kati ya wanafamilia wa karibu — lakini hii inategemea Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu na masharti yake. Sio msamaha wa kawaida unaotumika moja kwa moja. Angalia TRA au mwanasheria wa mali kwa hali yako mahususi kwani masharti yanaweza kuhitajika.
question_en: Is stamp duty reduced when land is transferred as a gift between family members — is there an exemption?
answer_en: Tanzania may have specific stamp duty provisions for gift transfers between close family members — but this depends on the Stamp Duty Act and its conditions. It is not a blanket exemption that applies automatically. Check TRA or a property lawyer for your specific situation as conditions may be required.

question_sw: Nina mahindi kutoka Tanzania yanayokwenda Kenya — mahindi yote ya Tanzania yanapata STR?
answer_sw: Lazima masharti mawili yakidhiwe. Kwanza: mahindi lazima yawe kwenye Common List — ndiyo, mahindi kwa ujumla yako. Pili: mahindi lazima yathibitishwe kuzalishwa Tanzania (originating status) kupitia SCO. Kama masharti yote mawili yanakidhiwa na thamani haitazidi USD 2,000, basi unapata manufaa ya STR.
question_en: I have Tanzanian maize going to Kenya — do all Tanzanian maize get STR benefits?
answer_en: Two conditions must both be met. First: maize must be on the Common List — yes, maize is generally on it. Second: maize must be certified as produced in Tanzania (originating status) via an SCO. If both conditions are met and value does not exceed USD 2,000, then you get STR benefits.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: Ninasajili kampuni BRELA — je, hiyo inamaanisha nimesajili kwa kodi TRA pia?
output: Hapana — usajili wa BRELA na usajili wa kodi TRA ni mambo TOFAUTI kabisa na yanafanywa kwa taasisi tofauti. BRELA: inakupa certificate ya usajili wa biashara (certificate of incorporation au certificate of registration) — huthibitisha kampuni au biashara yako ipo kisheria. TRA: inakupa TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) — huhitajika kulipa kodi na kufanya shughuli za kodi. Unahitaji VYOTE VIWILI: usajili wa BRELA na TIN ya TRA kabla ya biashara yako kufanya kazi rasmi. Vivyo hivyo, NSSF, WCF, na OSHA ni usajili tofauti zaidi. Thibitisha na brela.go.tz na tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa PAYE kwa wakati ni ipi?
answer_sw: Faini ya kuchelewsha PAYE ni asilimia 2.5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi, pamoja na riba. TRA pia inaweza kufunga akaunti za benki za mwajiri anayekosea. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the penalty for late PAYE remittance in Tanzania?
answer_en: The late PAYE penalty is 2.5% of the unpaid amount per month or part thereof, plus interest. TRA can also freeze bank accounts of non-compliant employers. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: EFD inahitajika kwa biashara ndogo — threshold ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Biashara zilizosajiliwa kwa VAT ni lazima zitumie EFD — bila kujali ukubwa wa biashara. Kizingiti cha usajili wa EFD kinafuata kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT: TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6. Ukisajiliwa kwa VAT, lazima utumie EFD au VFD. Biashara zisizosajiliwa kwa VAT hazilazimishwi na EFD — lakini TRA inaweza kubadilisha hii.
question_en: Is EFD required for small businesses — what is the threshold?
answer_en: Businesses registered for VAT must use EFD — regardless of business size. The EFD registration threshold follows the VAT registration threshold: TZS 200,000,000 in 12 months or TZS 100,000,000 in 6 months. Once registered for VAT, you must use an EFD or VFD. Non-VAT-registered businesses are not required to use EFD — but TRA may change this.

question_sw: Kiwango cha usajili wa OSHA ni wafanyakazi 5 au zaidi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango sahihi cha usajili wa OSHA ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi — si 5. Kiwango cha wafanyakazi 5 si cha kisheria na hakipo katika Sheria ya OSHA ya 2003. Biashara zinazopata wafanyakazi 10 ndizo zinazolazimika kusajiliwa.
question_en: The OSHA registration threshold is 5 or more employees — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The correct OSHA registration threshold is 10 or more employees — not 5. A threshold of 5 is not statutory and does not appear in the OSHA Act 2003. Businesses reaching 10 employees are the ones required to register.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Mafunzo ya usalama kwa wafanyakazi ni ya lazima chini ya OSHA?
output: Ndiyo. OHS Act inamtaka mwajiri kutoa mafunzo ya usalama na afya kazini kwa wafanyakazi -- hasa wapya na wanaofanya kazi zenye hatari. Mafunzo haya yanashughulikia: hatari za mahali pa kazi, matumizi ya vifaa vya usalama, na taratibu za dharura. Thibitisha mahitaji maalum ya mafunzo kwa sekta yako na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: Kiwango cha PAYE Kenya ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Sijui kuhusu PAYE Kenya — ninashughulikia maswali ya Tanzania Bara tu. Kwa taarifa za PAYE Kenya, wasiliana na KRA (kra.go.ke) au mshauri wa kodi wa Kenya. Je, unataka kujua kuhusu PAYE Tanzania? Bendi ya kwanza ya PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 0 hadi TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi.
question_en: What is the PAYE rate in Kenya?
answer_en: I do not cover Kenya PAYE — I handle Tanzania Mainland questions only. For Kenya PAYE information, contact KRA (kra.go.ke) or a Kenyan tax adviser. Would you like to know about Tanzania PAYE? The first Tanzania PAYE band is 0% up to TZS 270,000 per month.

question_sw: Ninasikia certificate ya VAT withholding inatakiwa ifikishwe siku ya 20 — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana — hii si kweli. Siku ya 20 ni deadline ya kuwasilisha VAT return, si deadline ya certificate ya VAT withholding. Certificate ya VAT withholding inatakiwa itolewe siku ile VAT inapostahili kulipwa, si tarehe nyingine. Ni muhimu kujua tofauti hii: return ya VAT → siku ya 20 ya mwezi unaofuata; certificate ya withholding → siku VAT inapostahili. Thibitisha ratiba hii na TRA.
question_en: I hear the VAT withholding certificate must be delivered by the 20th — is that correct?
answer_en: No — that is not correct. The 20th is the VAT return filing deadline, not the withholding certificate deadline. The VAT withholding certificate must be issued on the day VAT becomes payable, not on a later date. The distinction matters: VAT return → 20th of the following month; withholding certificate → the day VAT falls due. Confirm this timeline with TRA.

question_sw: Ni lini mwajiri analazimika kuunda kamati ya usalama (safety committee)?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi analazimika kuunda kamati ya usalama na afya kazini. Kamati hii lazima ikutane mara kwa mara na kuhakikisha usalama mahali pa kazi unashughulikiwa.
question_en: When is an employer required to establish a safety committee?
answer_en: An employer with 20 or more employees must establish an occupational safety and health committee. The committee must meet regularly and ensure workplace safety matters are addressed.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Withholding certificate ya VAT — lazima itolewe lini hasa?
output: Withholding certificate ya VAT lazima itolewe siku VAT inakuwa ya kulipwa — ambayo ni wakati malipo yanafanywa au bidhaa/huduma zinapopokelewa, ikijua ni kipi kinachokuja kwanza. Kumbuka tofauti muhimu: tarehe ya mwisho ya withholding certificate = siku VAT inapaswa kulipwa (tarehe ya muamala). Tarehe ya 20 ya mwezi = tarehe ya mwisho ya kuwasilisha VAT RETURN — hiyo ni wajibu tofauti kabisa. Makosa ya kawaida: kutoa withholding certificate tarehe 20 badala ya siku ya muamala. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: WHT inatumika kwa malipo ya ndani ya Tanzania peke yake — malipo kwa nchi za nje hayatozi WHT — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. WHT inatumika kwa MALIPO YA AINA ZOTE — ya ndani na ya nje. Kwa kweli, malipo ya nje (kwa wasio wakazi) mara nyingi yanatoza WHT ya kiwango cha JUU zaidi kuliko malipo ya ndani. Kwa mfano, ada za usimamizi kwa wasio wakazi ni asilimia 15 ikilinganishwa na asilimia 5 kwa wakazi.
question_en: WHT only applies to domestic Tanzania payments — payments abroad are not subject to WHT — is this true?
answer_en: No. WHT applies to ALL PAYMENT TYPES — both domestic and cross-border. In fact, cross-border payments (to non-residents) often attract HIGHER WHT rates than domestic payments. For example, management fees for non-residents are 15% compared to 5% for residents.

instruction: Shughuli 15 za GN 487A — je, ni zile tu zilizoorodheshwa au sheria ina uhuru wa kuongeza nyingine?
output: GN 487A ya tarehe 28 Julai 2025 inaorodhesha kwa wazi shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni. Shughuli ambazo hazipo katika orodha ya 15 hazizuiwi na GN 487A peke yake (ingawa sheria nyingine za biashara na uhamiaji bado zinatumika). Kama serikali inataka kuongeza shughuli nyingine, itahitaji kutangaza Tangazo Jipya la Serikali (Government Notice) lingine. Orodha ya sasa ni: 1.rejareja 2.jumla 3.saluni 4.ukarabati simu 5.uhamishaji pesa 6.usafi 7.ushonaji 8.upigaji picha 9.usafirishaji mdogo 10.delivery 11.uchapishaji 12.udhibiti wadudu 13.mitumba 14.machinga 15.boda boda/bajaj.

instruction: EFD yangu haikutoa risiti kwa muamala mmoja kwa sababu ya tatizo la mfumo. Niripoti wapi?
output: Ripoti tatizo hilo kwa msambazaji wako aliyeidhinishwa na TRA haraka iwezekanavyo. Msambazaji atawasiliana na TRA kwa niaba yako au akuelekezee TRA moja kwa moja. Hifadhi kumbukumbu ya muamala huo kwa mkono. Kutoa taarifa mapema kunakuonyesha TRA nia njema — kutotoa taarifa kunaweza kuonekana kama kukusudia ukiukwaji.

question_sw: Muuzaji wa samaki sokoni — ana haja ya EFD machine?
answer_sw: Muuzaji wa samaki mdogo wa sokoni kwa kawaida hahitaji EFD kama yeye mwenyewe hajalazimishwa kusajiliwa VAT (yaani mauzo yake ni chini ya TZS 200M kwa mwaka). EFD inahitajika tu kwa biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT. Hata hivyo, usajili wa biashara na halmashauri (leseni) na TIN bado zinahitajika.
question_en: A fish seller at the market — do they need an EFD machine?
answer_en: A small fish seller at the market generally does not need an EFD if they are not required to be VAT-registered (i.e., their sales are below TZS 200M per year). EFD is only required for VAT-registered businesses. However, business registration with the local council (licence) and a TIN are still needed.

question_sw: Je, risiti ya karatasi ya kawaida (hand-written) inakubaliwa badala ya EFD?
answer_sw: Hapana — biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT na EFD haiwezi kutoa risiti ya mkono (hand-written) au risiti ya kawaida kama mbadala wa EFD. Risiti ya EFD ndiyo pekee inayokubaliwa kisheria. Hata hivyo, kama EFD imeharibika, TRA inaruhusu kutumia stakabadhi zilizochapishwa awali (pre-printed manual receipt book) kwa muda mfupi — na lazima urejeshe EFD haraka iwezekanavyo na utaarifiShe TRA.
question_en: Is a regular hand-written receipt acceptable instead of EFD?
answer_en: No — a business registered for VAT with EFD cannot issue a hand-written or regular receipt as a substitute for EFD. An EFD receipt is the only legally accepted document. However, if the EFD breaks down, TRA allows the use of pre-printed manual receipt books temporarily — and you must restore the EFD as quickly as possible and notify TRA.

question_sw: Je, wafanyakazi wa Zanzibar wanajumuishwa kwenye kuhesabu wafanyakazi 10 wa SDL ya Tanzania Bara?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL ya TRA (Mainland) inatumika tu kwa wafanyakazi wa Tanzania Bara. Wafanyakazi waliopo Zanzibar si sehemu ya hesabu ya SDL ya Mainland. Ikiwa una wafanyakazi 8 Mainland na 4 Zanzibar, unaweza kutolazimika kulipa SDL ya TRA (Mainland 8 < 10). Zanzibar ina mfumo wake tofauti kupitia ZRA.
question_en: Are Zanzibar-based employees included in the 10-employee count for Mainland Tanzania SDL?
answer_en: No. TRA's SDL (Mainland) applies only to employees based on Mainland Tanzania. Zanzibar-based employees are not part of the Mainland SDL calculation. If you have 8 Mainland employees and 4 Zanzibar employees, you may not be liable for TRA SDL (Mainland 8 < 10). Zanzibar has its own separate system through ZRA.

question_sw: Thamani ya nyumba ya kampuni inajumuishwa katika PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Kama mwajiri anatoa nyumba kwa mfanyakazi, thamani ya nyumba hiyo inajumuishwa katika mapato ya mfanyakazi kwa madhumuni ya PAYE. Thamani inahesabiwa kulingana na kanuni za TRA — kwa kawaida ni asilimia ya mshahara wa msingi au kodi ya soko. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is employer-provided housing included in PAYE calculation?
answer_en: If an employer provides housing to an employee, the value of that housing is included in the employee's income for PAYE purposes. The value is calculated according to TRA rules — typically a percentage of basic salary or market rent. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: EAC STR na COMESA STR — ni tofauti au mfumo mmoja?
answer_sw: EAC STR na COMESA STR ni mifumo inayofanana na inayounganishwa — si tofauti kabisa. Nchi nyingi za EAC pia ni wanachama wa COMESA, na wanaheshimu mifumo yote miwili. Masharti ya msingi (USD 2,000, Common List) yanafanana sana. Mabadiliko madogo yanaweza kuwepo kwa nchi maalum — thibitisha na ofisi ya forodha.
question_en: EAC STR and COMESA STR — are they different or the same framework?
answer_en: EAC STR and COMESA STR are similar and interconnected frameworks — not completely separate. Many EAC countries are also COMESA members, and they honor both frameworks. The core conditions (USD 2,000, Common List) are very similar. Minor variations may exist for specific countries — verify with the customs office.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: SDL na NSSF — zinafanana vipi?
output: SDL na NSSF zinafanana kwa kuwa zote ni malipo yanayohusiana na wafanyakazi — lakini ni tofauti kabisa: SDL (→ TRA): 3.5% ya mishahara ya fedha; MWAJIRI peke yake; inaenda mfuko wa mafunzo; kizingiti: wafanyakazi 10+. NSSF (→ NSSF Fund): 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi = 20% jumla; wote wanashiriki; inaenda mfuko wa pensheni; hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Tofauti muhimu: SDL ni mwajiri peke yake, NSSF ni mwajiri + mfanyakazi. SDL ni kwa waajiri wenye 10+ wafanyakazi; NSSF ni kwa waajiri WOTE. Vyote vinachangia usafi wa biashara lakini kwa madhumuni tofauti kabisa. Thibitisha na TRA na nssf.go.tz.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wa nyumbani (mama/baba wa mtoto) — mwajiri wake analazimika kuwasilisha NSSF?
output: Ndiyo — wafanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic workers) kama wasaidizi wa nyumba, walinzi, na mama za watoto wanafunikwa na NSSF Tanzania. Mwajiri (mmiliki wa nyumba) ana wajibu wa: (1) Kusajili mfanyakazi wa nyumbani kwa NSSF ndani ya siku 30 ya kuajiri; (2) Kutuma michango kila mwezi: 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi wa mshahara. Kutokuwasilisha NSSF ya mfanyakazi wa nyumbani ni ukiukwaji wa sheria — hata kama mfanyakazi hajui haki zake. Faini ya kuchelewa ni 5%/mwezi. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, VAT inastahili kwa bidhaa na huduma zote Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. VAT inastahili kwa usambazaji unaostahili (taxable supply) peke yake unaofanywa na mtu msajiliwa katika mwendo wa shughuli za kiuchumi. Usambazaji fulani una kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated) au umeachiliwa (exempt). Thibitisha hali ya bidhaa/huduma yako na TRA.
question_en: Does VAT apply to all goods and services in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. VAT applies only to taxable supplies made by a registered person in the course of economic activities. Some supplies are zero-rated or exempt. Confirm the status of your goods/services with TRA.

question_sw: Amri ya kuzuia (prohibition notice) kutoka OSHA inatofautiana vipi na notisi ya uboreshaji?
answer_sw: Notisi ya uboreshaji inakupa muda wa kurekebisha tatizo. Amri ya kuzuia, kinyume chake, inahitaji kazi kusimamishwa MARA MOJA kwa sababu kuna hatari ya haraka ya kifo au majeraha makubwa. Mwajiri hawezi kuendelea na shughuli mpaka hatari isimamishwe.
question_en: How does a prohibition notice from OSHA differ from an improvement notice?
answer_en: An improvement notice gives you time to fix a problem. A prohibition notice, by contrast, requires work to stop IMMEDIATELY because there is an imminent risk of death or serious injury. The employer cannot resume operations until the danger is eliminated.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Kwa muda gani lazima nihifadhi rekodi za biashara kwa madhumuni ya ukaguzi wa TRA?
answer_sw: Chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Tanzania, mlipa kodi lazima ahifadhi rekodi zake za uhasibu kwa angalau miaka 5 baada ya mwaka wa mapato unaoathirika. Hii inahusisha: vitabu vya uhasibu, risiti za mauzo na manunuzi, orodha za mishahara (payroll), return za kodi zilizotumwa, maelezo ya benki, mikataba, na nyaraka zote za kuhusiana na biashara. Kwa udanganyifu uliodhibitiwa, TRA inaweza kufungua ukaguzi kwa miaka ya nyuma zaidi ya 5. Hifadhi rekodi za kidijitali na karatasi zote kwa usalama — hasara ya rekodi wakati wa ukaguzi inaweza kusababisha tathmini kubwa.
answer_en: Under Tanzania's Income Tax Act, a taxpayer must keep their accounting records for at least 5 years after the relevant year of income. This includes: accounting books, sales and purchase receipts, payroll records, filed tax returns, bank statements, contracts, and all business-related documents. For confirmed fraud cases, TRA may open investigations beyond 5 years. Keep all digital and paper records securely — loss of records during an audit may result in a large assessment.
question_en: For how long must I keep business records for TRA audit purposes?
primary_source_name: TRA — record keeping requirements ITA Cap.332
next_review_trigger: ITA amendment on record keeping period

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina kodi ya uchafuzi wa mazingira (environmental tax)?
answer_sw: Ushuru au kodi ya mazingira Tanzania ni eneo maalum zaidi ya mipaka ya msaada wangu wa sasa — ninashughulikia kodi kuu za biashara: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD, GN 487A. Kwa masuala ya ushuru wa mazingira na kanuni za mazingira, wasiliana na National Environment Management Council (NEMC) au Wizara ya Mazingira. Je, kuna swali la kodi ya kawaida ya biashara ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: Does Tanzania have an environmental pollution tax?
answer_en: Environmental levies or taxes in Tanzania are a more specialised area beyond my current scope — I handle main business taxes: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD, GN 487A. For environmental levies and regulations, contact the National Environment Management Council (NEMC) or the Ministry of Environment. Is there a routine business tax question I can help with?

question_sw: Mkulima anayeuza miti (timber) kutoka msitu wake — ana wajibu gani wa kodi?
answer_sw: Uuzaji wa miti kutoka misitu una mfumo maalum wa usimamizi wa mazingira na kodi. Inaweza kuhusisha: leseni za ukataji wa misitu (TFS — Tanzania Forest Service), kodi za mazao ya misitu, na pengine kodi ya mapato. Sina uhakika wa masharti yote ya sasa. Thibitisha na TFS na TRA.
question_en: A farmer selling timber from their forest — what tax obligations do they have?
answer_en: Selling timber from forests has a specialized environmental management and tax framework. This may involve: timber harvesting licences (TFS — Tanzania Forest Service), forest produce levies, and possibly income tax. I am not certain of all current requirements. Verify with TFS and TRA.

instruction: Nikipewa mkopo na benki — agreement ya mkopo (loan agreement) ina stamp duty?
output: Mikataba ya mikopo (loan agreements) kutoka benki na taasisi za fedha inaweza kuwa na wajibu wa stamp duty chini ya Stamp Duty Act Tanzania. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango maalum, jinsi inavyohesabika kwa mikopo ya thamani tofauti, na nani analipa. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mwajiri asiye na OSHA lakini ana WCF — anafuata sheria Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 10+ analazimika kusajili OSHA NA WCF. Kusajili WCF tu bila OSHA (kwa mwajiri anayestahili OSHA) ni uzingatiaji wa sehemu tu — si kamili. OSHA na WCF zinafanya kazi tofauti: WCF inashughulikia bima ya fidia baada ya ajali; OSHA inashughulikia kuzuia ajali na usalama wa kila siku. Kusajili WCF PEKE YAKE hakumaanishi kwamba mwajiri amefuata sheria ya OSHA.
question_en: An employer with WCF but without OSHA — are they compliant in Tanzania?
answer_en: An employer with 10+ employees is required to register with BOTH OSHA AND WCF. Registering with WCF only without OSHA (for an employer who qualifies for OSHA) is only partial compliance — not full. OSHA and WCF do different things: WCF handles accident compensation insurance after an injury; OSHA handles accident prevention and daily safety. Having WCF ALONE does not mean an employer has complied with OSHA law.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

instruction: Biashara yangu inatoa huduma za ushauri (consultancy) — je, inahitaji EFD?
output: Ndiyo — biashara za huduma (service businesses) kama ushauri, uhasibu, sheria, na kadhalika zinahitaji EFD kama zimesajiliwa VAT au iko katika orodha ya TRA. VAT kwa huduma za ushauri: kama biashara imesajiliwa VAT (mapato ya zaidi ya TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6), au kama ni mwanachama wa taaluma inayolazimishwa (CPA, wakili), itahitaji EFD. Risiti ya EFD kwa huduma inatoa TAX INVOICE — muhimu kwa mteja anayetaka kudai VAT input credit. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu hali yako maalum.

question_sw: Je, kuna adhabu kali zaidi kwa mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A mara ya pili?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa masharti maalum ya marudio ya makosa (recidivism) ndani ya GN 487A. Amri inaeleza adhabu za msingi: TZS 10M na hadi miezi 6 gerezani. Kwa hali ya ukiukaji wa mara ya pili, thibitisha na mwanasheria au Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Are there enhanced penalties for a non-citizen violating GN 487A a second time?
answer_en: I am not certain of specific recidivism provisions within GN 487A. The order specifies basic penalties: TZS 10M and up to 6 months imprisonment. For the specific situation of a second violation, verify with a lawyer or the Immigration Services Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII

instruction: Ninaweza kupata mkopo wa serikali kupitia Mfuko wa Maendeleo ya Ujasiriamali?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya kina kuhusu programu za mikopo ya serikali. Mifuko mbalimbali ya serikali kama SIDO, NEDF, au TIB inaweza kutoa mikopo kwa wajasiriamali. Wasiliana na shirika husika moja kwa moja au Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu (ikihusiana na programu za uwezeshaji wananchi) kwa maelezo ya programu za sasa.

question_sw: Thamani ya ardhi yangu inakadiriwa vipi kwa ajili ya stamp duty Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mbinu ya kukadiri thamani ya ardhi kwa ajili ya stamp duty inahitaji ujuzi wa kitaalamu wa tathmini ya mali — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Ninajua kwamba stamp duty inahesabiwa kwenye thamani ya soko ya mali lakini njia ya kufikia thamani hiyo (tathmini rasmi, njia ya soko, tathmini ya serikali) inahitaji mtaalam wa mali isiyohamishika (registered valuer) au mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: How is the value of my land assessed for stamp duty purposes in Tanzania?
answer_en: The methodology for valuing land for stamp duty requires specialist property valuation expertise — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. I know that stamp duty is calculated on the market value of property but the way to arrive at that value (formal valuation, market approach, government assessment) requires a registered property valuer or legal adviser.

question_sw: Mkulima anayeuza mazao yake sokoni mwenyewe — PAYE inahitajika?
answer_sw: Hapana kwa kawaida. Mkulima anayeuza mazao yake mwenyewe si mfanyakazi wa mtu mwingine — kwa hivyo PAYE haihusiki. PAYE ni kwa wafanyakazi waliohiriwa tu. Kama mkulima ana wafanyakazi wake, ndipo anaweza kuwa na wajibu wa PAYE kwa wafanyakazi hao.
question_en: A farmer who sells their own produce at the market — is PAYE required?
answer_en: Generally no. A farmer selling their own produce is not an employee of someone else — so PAYE does not apply to them. PAYE is only for hired employees. If the farmer has hired workers, then they may have PAYE obligations for those workers.

question_sw: Kiwango cha asilimia ya riba ya kisheria ya TRA kwenye kodi iliyochelewa ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Riba ya kisheria ya TRA kwenye kodi iliyochelewa imewekwa kwa kiwango cha asilimia 5 kwa mwezi (au kiwango kinachotangazwa mara kwa mara). Hii inaendelea kukusanyika kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji. Ni muhimu kulipa kodi kwa wakati ili kuepuka mrundikano wa riba.
question_en: What is the TRA statutory interest rate on overdue tax?
answer_en: TRA statutory interest on overdue tax is set at 5% per month (or the rate periodically announced). This continues to accrue for every month of delay. It is important to pay tax on time to avoid accumulating interest charges.

question_sw: Ninafanya kazi nje ya nchi (UK) na kupata mshahara hapo — lazima nilipe PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: PAYE ya mapato ya watu wanaoishi au kufanya kazi nje ya Tanzania ni eneo ngumu la sheria ya mapato ya kimataifa — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Suala hili linahusisha hali ya makazi ya kodi (tax residency), mikataba ya kuzuia kodi mara mbili, na sheria ya ndani ya Tanzania. Muona mhesabu wa kodi wa kimataifa aliyehitimu.
question_en: I work abroad (UK) and earn a salary there — must I pay PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE on income for people living or working outside Tanzania is a complex area of international income tax law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. This issue involves tax residency status, double taxation treaties, and Tanzania's domestic law. Consult a qualified international tax accountant.

instruction: Kampuni ya Tanzania inanunua programu (software license) kutoka kampuni ya nje ya nchi — kuna withholding yoyote?
output: Malipo ya software license kwa kampuni ya kigeni yanaweza kuhusisha: (1) WHT (Withholding Tax) ya 15% kwa royalties — software licenses zinaweza kuchukuliwa royalties kisheria; (2) VAT withholding ya 6% kwa huduma — kama programu ni huduma ya kidijitali inayotolewa na mtu anayehitimu. Kwa kampuni ya Tanzania inayolipa kampuni ya kigeni: Ikiwa kampuni ya kigeni ina daftari la TRA — kawaida mfumo wa kawaida wa VAT unatumika. Ikiwa kampuni ya kigeni haina daftari la TRA — unaweza kulazimika kukaa na mfumo wa 'reverse charge' au withholding. Mada hii ni ngumu — thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa.

question_sw: SDL inamaanisha nini kwa Kiswahili? Jibu mfupi.
answer_sw: SDL ni Skills Development Levy. Kwa Kiswahili: Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi. Inalipwa na mwajiri kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara, kwa makampuni yenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi kwenye Tanzania Bara.
question_en: What does SDL stand for in Swahili? Short answer.
answer_en: SDL is the Skills Development Levy. In Swahili: Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi. Paid by the employer at 3.5% of total payroll, for companies with 10 or more employees on Mainland Tanzania.

instruction: Msambazaji wangu aliyenipa EFD amefilisika. EFD yangu bado inatumika?
output: EFD yako iliyoanzishwa (activated) tayari kwenye mfumo wa TRA itaendelea kufanya kazi. Tatizo ni matengenezo na msaada wa kiufundi. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) kupata maelekezo kuhusu jinsi ya kupata msambazaji mpya aliyeidhinishwa akuchukue. TRA inaweza kukuunganisha na msambazaji mwingine aliyeidhinishwa atakayehudumia EFD yako.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina matawi matatu Dar es Salaam. Je, kila tawi linahitaji EFD yake?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kila tawi la biashara linahitaji EFD iliyosajiliwa yake — moja kwa moja na TRA na inayoonyesha jina la tawi na anwani yake. Huwezi kutumia EFD moja kwa matawi matatu. Kila tawi linatoa risiti zake tofauti na kupeleka taarifa zake tofauti kwa seva ya TRA. VAT returns zinaweza kuwasilishwa kwa pamoja (consolidated) ikiwa TRA inaruhusu, lakini EFD za kimwili lazima ziwe tofauti kwa kila tawi.
question_en: My company has three branches in Dar es Salaam. Does each branch need its own EFD?
answer_en: Yes. Each business branch requires its own registered EFD — individually registered with TRA showing the branch name and address. You cannot use one EFD for three branches. Each branch issues its own receipts and transmits its own data to TRA's server. VAT returns may be submitted consolidated if TRA permits, but physical EFDs must be separate for each branch.

question_sw: Mwajiriwa anayedai fidia ya WCF lazima apitie mahakama — WCF haiwezi kulipa moja kwa moja — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WCF ina utaratibu wa kudai fidia moja kwa moja BILA mahakama kwa hali nyingi za kawaida za ajali za kazi. Mfanyakazi au mwajiri anaweza kuwasilisha madai kupitia mfumo wa WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz) au ofisi ya WCF moja kwa moja. Mahakama inahitajika tu ikiwa dawa imekataliwa na WCF na mwathiriwa anataka kupinga uamuzi huo. Kwa ajali za kawaida, WCF ina mchakato wa malipo ya moja kwa moja.
question_en: A worker claiming WCF compensation must go through court — WCF cannot pay directly — is this correct?
answer_en: No. WCF has a direct claim procedure WITHOUT court for most ordinary workplace accident cases. A worker or employer can file claims through the WCF system (portal.wcf.go.tz) or WCF office directly. Court is only needed if a claim is rejected by WCF and the claimant wants to challenge that decision. For ordinary accidents, WCF has a direct payment process.

instruction: Ninaweza kulipa SDL mapema kabla ya tarehe 7 — au lazima nisubiri hadi tarehe 7 hasa?
output: Unaweza kulipa SDL mapema kabla ya tarehe 7 — hii ni vyema na haipingwi na TRA. Tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata ni tarehe ya MWISHO (deadline), si tarehe ya lazima ya kulipa. Malipo ya mapema yanakuepusha na faini ya kuchelewa. Hata hivyo, SDL na PAYE zote zinatakiwa kulipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 — kulipa SDL mapema lakini PAYE baadaye bado kunafanya PAYE kuwa na ucheleweshaji. Thibitisha tarehe za malipo na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Je, ongezeko la mshahara wa GN605A linaathiri PAYE?
output: Ndiyo. Ongezeko la mishahara kutokana na GN605A linaongeza msingi wa PAYE. Kama ulifanya mahesabu ya PAYE kwa viwango vya zamani (amri ya 2022), lazima uhesabu upya kwa viwango vipya vya GN605A tangu Januari 2026. Mabadiliko makubwa ya mshahara yanaweza kumvusha mfanyakazi kwa mkanda mwingine wa PAYE na kulazimika kulipa kodi zaidi. Fanya ukaguzi wa malipo yako ya PAYE na mshauri wa kodi.

instruction: Nimesajili biashara BRELA lakini sijapata TIN bado — ninaweza kuanza kupokea malipo?
output: Kisheria, kuanza kupokea malipo ya biashara bila TIN kunaweza kuwa tatizo la kodi. TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) ya TRA inahitajika kwa shughuli zote za biashara za kodi — VAT, PAYE, SDL, na malipo ya kodi yoyote. Biashara nyingi za Tanzania zinahitaji TIN kwa: kufungua akaunti ya benki, kutoa invoice rasmi, kusajili EFD, na kuwasilisha marudisho ya kodi. BRELA inakusajili kisheria kama chombo — TRA inakusajili kwa kodi. Omba TIN haraka iwezekanavyo kupitia TRA (tra.go.tz au ofisi ya karibu). Thibitisha na TRA.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya kiwango cha usajili wa OSHA (wafanyakazi 10) na kiwango cha kamati ya usalama (wafanyakazi 20) ni nini?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha 10 ni kwa USAJILI rasmi wa biashara yako na OSHA — kupata cheti cha OSHA. Kiwango cha 20 ni kwa KUUNDA KAMATI ya usalama ndani ya biashara. Kwa hivyo biashara yenye wafanyakazi 10-19 inasajiliwa na OSHA lakini haihitaji kamati ya usalama. Biashara yenye wafanyakazi 20+ inahitaji vyote viwili.
question_en: What is the difference between the OSHA registration threshold (10 employees) and the safety committee threshold (20 employees)?
answer_en: The threshold of 10 is for formal OSHA REGISTRATION of your business — obtaining an OSHA certificate. The threshold of 20 is for ESTABLISHING A SAFETY COMMITTEE inside the business. So a business with 10-19 employees registers with OSHA but doesn't need a safety committee. A business with 20+ needs both.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Fomu ya P45 inatumika Tanzania wakati mfanyakazi anaondoka kazini — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Fomu ya P45 ni fomu ya Uingereza (UK) na HAIPO Tanzania. Tanzania inatumia Hati ya Kuondoka (Leaving Certificate) na fomu ya P9 (taarifa ya mwaka ya PAYE). Mwajiri hutoa Hati ya Kuondoka kwa mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi, si P45.
question_en: Form P45 is used in Tanzania when an employee leaves employment — is this true?
answer_en: No. Form P45 is a UK form and DOES NOT EXIST in Tanzania. Tanzania uses a Leaving Certificate and the P9 form (annual PAYE return). An employer issues a Leaving Certificate to a departing employee, not a P45.

instruction: Mfanyakazi aliyeachishwa kazi ghafla — NSSF pensheni yake inafanywa nini?
output: Mfanyakazi aliyeachishwa kazi HAAPOTEZI michango yake ya NSSF iliyochangiwa. Michango inabaki kwenye akaunti yake ya NSSF hadi atakapokuwa na haki ya kupata: (1) PENSHENI ya uzeeni (baada ya umri wa miaka 60, au 55 kwa wachimbaji/mapema) na angalau miezi 180 ya michango; (2) MAFAO YA MAPEMA kama ni mlemavu wa kudumu; (3) MAFAO YA KIFO kwa familia yake. Hata kama alichangia miaka 5 tu — pesa hizo ziko salama NSSF. Akitaka kujua salio la akaunti yake, anaweza kuwasiliana na NSSF moja kwa moja. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.

question_sw: Tangu lini GN 605A ilianza kutumika na ilifanyaje kwa amri ya mishahara ya mwaka 2022?
answer_sw: GN 605A ilitangazwa rasmi tarehe 13 Oktoba 2025 na ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Amri hii ilifuta na kubadilisha amri ya mishahara ya 2022 moja kwa moja. Mwajiri yeyote aliyeendelea kulipa viwango vya 2022 baada ya tarehe 1 Januari 2026 alikuwa anakiuka sheria hata kama mkataba wa ajira uliendelea kutaja viwango vya zamani. Viwango vipya viliongezeka kwa wastani wa asilimia 33.4: kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi kwa sekta nyingi za sekta binafsi.
question_en: When did GN 605A take effect and what happened to the 2022 wage order?
answer_en: GN 605A was gazetted on 13 October 2025 and took effect on 1 January 2026. This order revoked and replaced the 2022 wage order entirely. Any employer still paying 2022 rates after 1 January 2026 was in violation of the law even if employment contracts still referenced the old rates. The new rates represent an average increase of 33.4%: from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322 per month across most private sector sub-sectors.

instruction: Ninaweza kuwekeza kwenye Bitcoin au cryptocurrency Tanzania — ni salama?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya utaalamu wa biashara na kodi za Tanzania. question_sw: Kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara chini ya GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha chini kabisa kwa sekta ya jumla ni karibu TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi. Viwango vinafikia hadi TZS 765,900 kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Thibitisha kiwango halisi cha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: What is the lowest minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: The lowest minimum wage for the general sector is approximately TZS 175,000 per month. Rates reach up to TZS 765,900 for the international mining and energy sector. Confirm your sector's exact rate with MLYWF.

question_sw: EFD ya biashara moja inaweza kutumika kwa biashara nyingine ya mwenye biashara huyo huyo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kila EFD machine inasajiliwa kwa biashara MAALUM na TIN yake mahususi. EFD iliyosajiliwa kwa biashara moja haiwezi kutumika kisheria kwa biashara nyingine, hata kama mwenye biashara ni mtu mmoja. Kila biashara lazima iwe na EFD yake iliyosajiliwa kwa TIN yake mwenyewe.
question_en: Can an EFD machine for one business be used for another business owned by the same person in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Each EFD machine is registered to a SPECIFIC business and its particular TIN. An EFD registered for one business cannot legally be used for another business, even if the same person owns both. Each business must have its own EFD registered to its own TIN.

question_sw: Mshahara wa TZS 520,000 hasa — PAYE ni ngapi kwa mujibu wa bendi za kodi?
answer_sw: Mahesabu ya PAYE ya mshahara mahususi yako nje ya mipaka yangu - hii ni huduma ya TRA IDRAS. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Tumia kikokotoo cha TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz) kwa jibu sahihi.
question_en: Salary of exactly TZS 520,000 — how much is the PAYE according to the tax bands?
answer_en: Calculating PAYE for a specific salary is outside my coverage - this is a TRA IDRAS service. This topic is outside my current scope. Confirm with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Use the TRA IDRAS calculator (taidras.tra.go.tz) for an accurate answer.
