question_sw: Vibali 15 vya shughuli vilivyopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A ni vipi?
answer_sw: GN 487A (iliyoanza Julai 2025) inapiga marufuku wageni kufanya: biashara ya jumla/reja reja, uhamishaji wa pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, saluni na ususi, na shughuli 11 nyingine zilizoorodheshwa kwenye amri. Biashara ya usambazaji mdogo inajumuishwa. Thibitisha orodha kamili na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What are the 15 business activities prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: GN 487A (effective July 2025) prohibits non-citizens from conducting: wholesale/retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, salon and hairdressing business, and 11 other activities listed in the order. Small distribution business is included. Confirm the full list with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Kodi ya stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa ardhi au nyumba (property transfer) ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa ardhi au nyumba ni asilimia 1 ya thamani ya malipo au thamani ya soko. Kwa mfano, mali inayouzwa kwa TZS 500,000,000 inalipa kodi ya stempu ya TZS 5,000,000. Zaidi ya hilo, uhamishaji wa ardhi na nyumba unaweza pia kuathiriwa na Kodi ya Faida ya Mtaji (Capital Gains Tax). Thibitisha mahesabu na mshauri wa kodi kwa miamala mikubwa ya mali isiyohamia.
answer_en: Stamp duty on transfer of land or buildings is 1% of the consideration or market value. For example, property sold for TZS 500,000,000 pays stamp duty of TZS 5,000,000. Additionally, transfer of land and buildings may also attract Capital Gains Tax. Confirm calculations with a tax consultant for large immovable property transactions.
question_en: What is the stamp duty rate on a land or building transfer (property transfer)?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — property exchange schedule

instruction: Ninanunua mitambo (machinery) kwa kampuni yangu — stamp duty inatumika kwenye mkataba wa ununuzi?
output: Mikataba ya ununuzi wa mitambo na bidhaa inaweza kuwa na wajibu wa stamp duty chini ya Stamp Duty Act Tanzania kulingana na aina ya hati na thamani yake. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango halisi na aina za mikataba inayostahili au kusamehewa stamp duty. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Mimi ni Mariamu Juma — ninauza chakula kwa jina 'Mariamu Juma Foods'. Lazima BRELA?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. 'Mariamu Juma Foods' ni jina la biashara — hata kama linajumuisha jina lako, lazima lisajiliwe kwa BRELA kama biashara ya jina. Faida ya usajili: umiliki wa kisheria wa jina hilo.

instruction: Kizingiti cha VAT ni kwa bidhaa tu au huduma pia?
output: Kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/12 miezi au TZS 100M/6 miezi) kinahusika kwa: Mauzo ya bidhaa, Utoaji wa huduma, Mchanganyiko wa bidhaa na huduma. Aina ya biashara haiathiri kizingiti — inathiri tu KIWANGO cha VAT (18% standard, 16% B2C digital, 0% exports, au exempt). Mauzo yote yanajumuishwa kufikia kizingiti.

question_sw: Biashara yenye wafanyakazi 5 tu Tanzania hailazimiki kusajili OSHA — je, kizingiti ni wafanyakazi wangapi?
answer_sw: OSHA Act Tanzania inaitaji mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 10 AU ZAIDI kwenye Mainland Tanzania kusajili OSHA. Biashara yenye wafanyakazi 5 tu HAIHITAJIKI kusajili OSHA kisheria. Hata hivyo, hata biashara ndogo zinazidi kizingiti bado zinatakiwa kufuata kanuni za msingi za usalama mahali pa kazi.
question_en: A business with only 5 workers in Tanzania doesn't need to register with OSHA — how many employees is the threshold?
answer_en: The OSHA Act in Tanzania requires an employer with 10 OR MORE employees on Mainland Tanzania to register with OSHA. A business with only 5 workers is NOT legally required to register with OSHA. However, even smaller businesses that exceed the threshold are still required to follow basic workplace safety rules.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: WCF 0.5% ya mishahara inalipwa kwa pamoja na michango ya NSSF — mwajiri analipa kila mmoja kwa nguzo tofauti — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, mwajiri analipa NSSF na WCF kwa njia tofauti na mifumo tofauti: NSSF inalipwa kwa NSSF moja kwa moja kupitia mfumo wa NSSF au benki iliyoidhinishwa, tarehe 10 ya kila mwezi. WCF inalipwa kwa WCF moja kwa moja kupitia mfumo wa WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz). Kila chombo cha serikali kina kumbukumbu yake na tarehe zake za malipo. Hakuna malipo ya pamoja ya NSSF+WCF kwenye dirisha moja.
question_en: The WCF 0.5% of payroll is paid together with NSSF contributions — the employer pays each to a different account — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes, an employer pays NSSF and WCF through different channels and systems: NSSF is paid directly to NSSF through the NSSF system or an approved bank, by the 10th of each month. WCF is paid directly to WCF through the WCF system (portal.wcf.go.tz). Each government body has its own records and payment dates. There is no combined NSSF+WCF payment at one window.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania
next_review_trigger: NSSF or WCF payment system update

question_sw: Mtu mmoja mmoja anayepokea tathmini ya kodi ya kibinafsi anaweza kupinga vipi?
answer_sw: Mtu mmoja mmoja anayepokea tathmini ya kodi ya kibinafsi (Personal Income Tax) anafuata mchakato ule ule wa pingamizi: (1) wasilisha pingamizi kwa Kamishna Mkuu ndani ya siku 30, (2) lipa 1/3 ya kiasi kinachodaiwa, na (3) subiri uamuzi wa Kamishna. Haki hizi zinatumika kwa watu binafsi na kampuni.
question_en: How can an individual who receives a personal income tax assessment object?
answer_en: An individual receiving a personal income tax assessment follows the same objection process: (1) file an objection with the Commissioner General within 30 days, (2) pay 1/3 of the disputed amount, and (3) await the Commissioner's determination. These rights apply to both individuals and companies.

question_sw: Biashara ya B2C ya malipo ya kidijitali ina VAT ya asilimia ngapi kuanzia Septemba 2025?
answer_sw: Shughuli za B2C za malipo ya kidijitali (e-payment) zinalipwa VAT ya asilimia 16 kuanzia tarehe 1 Septemba 2025. Kanuni za utekelezaji zingali zinasubiriwa kutoka kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Thibitisha hali ya sasa na TRA.
question_en: What VAT rate applies to B2C digital payment transactions from September 2025?
answer_en: B2C e-payment transactions are subject to 16% VAT from 1 September 2025. Implementation rules are pending a notice from the TRA Commissioner General. Confirm the current status with TRA.

question_sw: Mtu anayepata kipato tu kutoka njia moja ya mwajiri wake halazimiki kuwasilisha tamko la kodi ya mwaka — PAYE inatosha — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla ndiyo — ikiwa kipato chake chote kinakatwa PAYE sahihi na mwajiri mmoja, mwajiriwa wa kawaida anaweza asihitajike kuwasilisha tamko la kibinafsi la kodi. PAYE inafanya kazi kama kodi ya mwisho kwa wafanyakazi wengi. Hata hivyo, mwajiriwa LAZIMA awasilishe tamko la mwaka ikiwa: ana vyanzo vingi vya kipato, anataka kudai gharama zinazopunguzwa, au ana hasara za awali zinazobebwa.
question_en: A person earning income only from one employer does not need to file an annual tax return — PAYE is sufficient — is this correct?
answer_en: Generally yes — if all income is correctly deducted at source by one employer, a regular employee may not need to file an individual tax return. PAYE acts as a final tax for most employees. However, an employee MUST file an annual return if: they have multiple income sources, want to claim deductible expenses, or have prior losses to carry.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wangu wa EPZ wanalipa PAYE kama wafanyakazi wa kawaida Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Wajibu wa PAYE kwa wafanyakazi wa kampuni za EPZ unashughulikiwa chini ya EPZ Act na mkataba wa EPZA na TRA — masharti yanaweza kuwa na tofauti muhimu na mfumo wa kawaida. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Sekta ya benki za biashara — mshahara wa chini kwa GN605A ni ngapi?
output: Kulingana na GN605A, viwango vilivyothibitishwa kwa sekta ya benki za biashara (commercial banks) ni TZS 733,000 kwa mwezi. Kiwango hiki kilianza Januari 2026. Ikiwa una wafanyakazi wa benki, hakikisha mshahara wao wa chini hauteremki chini ya kiwango hiki. Kwa subsekta maalum za benki, thibitisha kwenye GN605A yenyewe.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kulalamika kwa TRA dhidi ya adhabu ya EFD isiyokuwa ya haki?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ikiwa unaamini adhabu ya EFD au tathmini ya TRA si sahihi, una haki ya kulalamika (objection) na TRA ndani ya siku 30 za kupokea tathmini. Mchakato ni: (1) Wasilisha barua ya hiari ya kukataa tathmini (Notice of Objection) ndani ya siku 30; (2) Lipa kiasi kisichopingwa AU theluthi moja ya kiasi kilichotathminiwa ndani ya siku 15; (3) Subiri uamuzi wa Kamishna ndani ya miezi 6; (4) Kama bado haujaridhika, piga rufaa kwa TRAB.
question_en: Can I complain to TRA against an unfair EFD penalty?
answer_en: Yes. If you believe a TRA EFD penalty or assessment is incorrect, you have the right to file an objection with TRA within 30 days of receiving the assessment. Process: (1) Submit a Notice of Objection within 30 days; (2) Pay the undisputed amount OR one-third of the assessed amount within 15 days; (3) Await the Commissioner's decision within 6 months; (4) If still unsatisfied, appeal to TRAB.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inaweza kuanza kufanya biashara siku ile ile ya kusajiliwa BRELA?
answer_sw: Kisheria, kampuni inaweza kuanza baadhi ya shughuli za maandalizi mara baada ya kusajiliwa BRELA. Hata hivyo, kwa biashara kamili ya kisheria, bado unahitaji: TIN (unaweza kuomba wakati huo huo na BRELA), leseni ya LGA kwa eneo lako (inachukua siku kadhaa hadi wiki), NSSF/WCF usajili ikiwa una wafanyakazi. Kuanza kupokea malipo ya biashara bila TIN au leseni ya LGA kunaweza kukuletea matatizo ya kisheria.
question_en: Can a new company start doing business the same day it is registered at BRELA?
answer_en: Legally, a company can begin some preparatory activities immediately after BRELA registration. However, for full lawful business operation you still need: TIN (can be applied for simultaneously with BRELA), LGA licence for your area (takes several days to weeks), NSSF/WCF registration if you have employees. Starting to receive business payments without a TIN or LGA licence can create legal problems.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Kampuni ya NGO inayopokea ardhi kama mchango wa bure (donation) inalipa ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: NGO inayopokea ardhi kama mchango inaweza kuhitaji ushuru wa stempu kwenye hati ya uhamishaji, hata kama hakuna malipo ya pesa. Kwa hati za kawaida za uhamishaji, ushuru wa stempu unahesabiwa kwa kuzingatia thamani ya soko ya ardhi (si bei ya mauzo ya sifuri). Angalia TRA kwa masharti mahususi ya NGO zilizosajiliwa rasmi — inaweza kuwa na msamaha katika hali fulani.
question_en: A registered NGO receiving land as a free donation — does it pay stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: An NGO receiving land as a donation may still require stamp duty on the transfer instrument, even with no cash payment. For standard transfer instruments, stamp duty is calculated based on the market value of the land (not the zero sale price). Check TRA for specific provisions for formally registered NGOs — there may be an exemption in certain situations.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or NGO fiscal framework update

question_sw: EFD inahusiana vipi na VAT — VAT inaonekana kwenye risiti ya EFD vipi?
answer_sw: EFD inashughulikia VAT kiotomatiki kwenye kila muamala: (1) inahesabu kiasi cha VAT (18%) kwenye bei ya mauzo inayostahili, (2) inaonyesha bei kabla ya VAT, kiasi cha VAT, na jumla inayojumuisha VAT kwenye risiti, (3) inarekodia data ya VAT moja kwa moja kwa mfumo wa TRA ili kuandaa tamko la VAT la kila mwezi. Hii inamaanisha data ya tamko lako la VAT inatoka moja kwa moja kwenye rekodi za EFD.
question_en: How does an EFD relate to VAT — how does VAT appear on an EFD receipt?
answer_en: An EFD handles VAT automatically on every transaction: (1) it calculates the VAT amount (18%) on the taxable sale price, (2) it shows the pre-VAT price, VAT amount, and VAT-inclusive total on the receipt, (3) it records VAT data directly to TRA's system to prepare the monthly VAT return. This means your VAT return data comes directly from EFD records.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act VAT or EFD system update

question_sw: Je, ninahitaji EFD mpya kwa kila bidhaa mpya ninayouza?
answer_sw: Hapana. EFD moja inatosha kwa biashara moja bila kujali idadi ya bidhaa unazouza. EFD inaweza kusanidiwa kuonyesha aina nyingi za bidhaa na huduma. Unahitaji EFD mpya (au VFD nyingine) tu ikiwa unafungua tawi jipya au biashara mpya tofauti. Biashara moja, eneo moja = EFD moja.
question_en: Do I need a new EFD for each new product I sell?
answer_en: No. One EFD is sufficient for one business regardless of the number of products sold. The EFD can be configured to display many types of goods and services. You only need a new EFD (or additional VFD) if you open a new branch or a completely separate business. One business, one location = one EFD.

question_sw: PAYE inalipwa na mfanyakazi mwenyewe kwa TRA moja kwa moja — mwajiri hana wajibu wa kukata?
answer_sw: Hapana. PAYE ni mfumo wa PAYE-AS-YOU-EARN ambapo MWAJIRI ndiye anayelazimika KUKATA PAYE kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi na kuipeleka TRA. Mfanyakazi hajalazimishwa kulipa moja kwa moja kwa TRA isipokuwa katika hali maalum (kama ana mapato ya ziada). Wajibu mkubwa ni wa mwajiri.
question_en: PAYE is paid directly to TRA by the employee themselves — the employer has no deduction obligation?
answer_en: No. PAYE is a Pay-As-You-Earn system where the EMPLOYER is required to DEDUCT PAYE from the employee's salary and remit it to TRA. The employee is not required to pay directly to TRA unless in special circumstances (such as having additional income). The primary obligation rests with the employer.

question_sw: Biashara ndogo (SME) yenye mauzo chini ya Shilingi 100M lazima ipigie WHT?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wajibu wa WHT hauhusiani na ukubwa wa biashara au mauzo. Kampuni yoyote inayofanya malipo yanayotoza WHT — iwe kubwa au ndogo — inalazimika kukata na kulipa WHT. SME zenye mauzo madogo bado zina wajibu wa WHT kwenye malipo kama royalties, gawio, na ada za ushauri.
question_en: Does a small business (SME) with sales below TZS 100M have to withhold WHT?
answer_en: Yes. The WHT obligation is not linked to business size or turnover. Any company making payments subject to WHT — large or small — must deduct and remit WHT. SMEs with low turnover still have WHT obligations on payments such as royalties, dividends, and consulting fees.

question_sw: GN 605A ilianza kutumika Julai 2025 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 JANUARI 2026 — si Julai 2025. Julai 2025 ndiyo tarehe ambayo ongezeko la sekta ya umma (Shilingi 500,000) lilianza — hizi ni hatua mbili tofauti. GN 605A ni ya sekta binafsi na ilianza Januari 2026.
question_en: GN 605A took effect in July 2025 — is this correct?
answer_en: No. GN 605A took effect on 1 JANUARY 2026 — not July 2025. July 2025 was the date the public sector raise (TZS 500,000) took effect — these are two separate actions. GN 605A governs the private sector and started January 2026.

question_sw: Hati ya uhamishaji wa gari (motor vehicle transfer) ina ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Uhamishaji wa gari Tanzania una ada za kusajilisha gari (registration transfer fee) zinazolipwa kwa Mamlaka ya Usimamizi wa Usafiri wa Nchi Kavu (SUMATRA) au TANROADS — hizi si ushuru wa stempu kwa njia ya kawaida. Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unajumuisha zaidi hati za ardhi, mkopo, na mikataba maalum. Angalia SUMATRA/TRA kwa ada zinazohusika na magari.
question_en: Does a motor vehicle transfer instrument attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Motor vehicle transfers in Tanzania involve registration transfer fees paid to SUMATRA or TANROADS — these are not stamp duty in the conventional sense. Tanzania stamp duty primarily covers land instruments, loans, and specified contracts. Check SUMATRA/TRA for fees applicable to vehicles.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or vehicle registration fee update

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina viwango vitatu vya VAT: asilimia 0, asilimia 5, na asilimia 18?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania ina viwango viwili tu vya VAT: asilimia 18 (kiwango cha kawaida) na asilimia 0 (zero-rated). Kuna pia bidhaa na huduma zilizo exempt (zimesamehewa) ambazo hazilipwi VAT kabisa. Hakuna kiwango cha asilimia 5 katika mfumo wa VAT wa Tanzania Bara.
question_en: Does Tanzania have three VAT rates: 0%, 5%, and 18%?
answer_en: No. Tanzania has only two VAT rates: 18% (standard rate) and 0% (zero-rated). There are also exempt supplies which are not subject to VAT at all. There is no 5% VAT rate in Tanzania Mainland's VAT system.

instruction: EFD lazima iwe na QR code kwenye risiti — kwa nini QR code inahitajika?
output: QR code kwenye risiti ya EFD (kama EFD ina uwezo huo au TIMS inainua) ina madhumuni makubwa: (1) Inawezesha mteja kuthibitisha risiti ni halali kwa kuiscan na app ya TRA au tovuti — kama risiti si ya kweli QR haithibitishi; (2) Inaunganisha risiti moja kwa moja na database ya TRA — ukaguzi wa haraka; (3) Inazuia risiti bandia — risiti bandia haina QR inayothibitika; (4) Inasaidia mteja kudai VAT input credit kwa uhakika. Biashara zinazotoa risiti za EFD zenye QR code zinasaidia wateja wao kupata input VAT credit haraka. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu mahitaji ya QR code kwa EFD yako.

instruction: Wizara ya Elimu Tanzania inatoza ada maalum ya mafunzo — je, TRA pia inahusika?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Michango au ada za wizara maalum za serikali kwa programu za mafunzo ni mada tofauti ya kanuni za sekta inayohusika nje ya wigo wangu wa kodi za TRA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na wizara husika au mshauri wa sekta ya elimu kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya tarehe ya 20 (VAT return) na tarehe ya hati ya zuio la VAT?
answer_sw: Tarehe MBILI tofauti: (1) TAREHE YA 20 ya kila mwezi: hii ni mwisho wa kuwasilisha return ya VAT (VAT return) na kulipa VAT unayodaiwa. Inahusu biashara yoyote iliyosajiliwa VAT. (2) TAREHE YA KUTOA HATI YA ZUIO: hii ni siku ambayo VAT inastahili kulipwa — si mwishoni mwa mwezi. Inahusu manunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying buyer) anayezuia VAT. Kufanya kazi kama qualifying buyer na kutoa hati tarehe ya 20 ni kuchelewa — lazima itolewa mara tu wakati wa zuio.
question_en: What is the difference between the 20th (VAT return) and the VAT withholding certificate date?
answer_en: TWO different dates: (1) THE 20TH of each month: this is the deadline for submitting a VAT return and paying the VAT owed. It applies to any VAT-registered business. (2) VAT WITHHOLDING CERTIFICATE DATE: this is the day the VAT becomes payable — not at month end. It applies to a qualifying buyer who withholds VAT. Operating as a qualifying buyer and issuing certificates on the 20th is late — they must be issued immediately at the time of withholding.

instruction: Je, biashara ndogo (wafanyakazi 3) inahitaji kusajiliwa OSHA?
output: Ndiyo. Sheria ya Usalama na Afya Kazini (OHS Act) inatumika kwa mahali pa kazi YOTE Tanzania -- bila kizingiti cha chini cha wafanyakazi kwa kusajiliwa. Biashara yenye wafanyakazi 1 au zaidi inastahili kuzingatia mahitaji ya OSHA. Thibitisha mahitaji kamili ya usajili kwa biashara ndogo na OSHA moja kwa moja (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi kinahitajika kwa mwanachama wa familia ya mtu mwenye kibali?
answer_sw: Mwanafamilia tegemezi (mke/mume, watoto) wa mtu mwenye kibali cha kazi anaweza kuomba kibali cha Darasa E (tegemezi). Kibali cha Darasa E kinaruhusu kukaa Tanzania lakini mara nyingi hakiidhinishi kufanya kazi. Ikiwa mwanafamilia anataka kufanya kazi, anahitaji kibali chake mwenyewe cha kazi cha darasa linalofaa.
question_en: Is a work permit required for a family member of a permit holder?
answer_en: A dependent family member (spouse, children) of a work permit holder can apply for a Class E (dependant) permit. A Class E permit allows residence in Tanzania but typically does not authorise employment. If the family member wishes to work, they need their own separate work permit of the appropriate class.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kupinga tathmini ya VAT tofauti na PAYE — inafanywa vipi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kila aina ya tathmini inaweza kupingwa. Mchakato ni sawa kwa aina zote — wasilisha pingamizi kwa Kamishna Mkuu ndani ya siku 30 na ipe 1/3 ya kiasi kinachodaiwa. Tathmini tofauti (VAT, PAYE, kodi ya mapato) zinapiganwa tofauti na kila moja ina muda wake wa pingamizi.
question_en: Can a company dispute a VAT assessment separately from a PAYE assessment — how is this done?
answer_en: Yes, each type of assessment can be disputed. The process is the same for all types — file an objection with the Commissioner General within 30 days and pay 1/3 of the disputed amount. Different assessments (VAT, PAYE, income tax) are disputed separately, each with its own objection timeline.

question_sw: GN 605A kwa sekta binafsi na ongezeko la sekta ya umma la Shilingi 500,000 ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: Ni hatua mbili tofauti: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta BINAFSI (sekta 16, sekta ndogo 46) kuanzia Januari 2026, na kiwango cha wastani cha Shilingi 358,322. Ongezeko la Shilingi 500,000 ni la sekta ya UMMA tu, lililotangazwa na Rais Samia kuanzia Julai 2025. Waajiri wa sekta binafsi wanafuata GN 605A; serikali inafuata tangazo la Rais.
question_en: What is the difference between GN 605A for the private sector and the TZS 500,000 public sector raise?
answer_en: These are two separate actions: GN 605A covers the PRIVATE sector (16 sectors, 46 sub-sectors) from January 2026 with an average floor of TZS 358,322. The TZS 500,000 raise applies to the PUBLIC sector only, announced by President Samia from July 2025. Private employers follow GN 605A; government follows the Presidential announcement.

question_sw: BRELA inaweza kusaidia kuthibitisha kampuni ya Tanzania kwa mbia wa kigeni — mchakato gani?
answer_sw: Kuthibitisha kampuni kwa mbia wa kigeni, BRELA inaweza kutoa: Certificate of Compliance (Form 23), nakala iliyothibitishwa ya Cheti cha Uanzishwaji, na matokeo ya utafutaji wa rejesta. Hati hizi zinaweza kuhitaji kuthibitishwa na apostille au ushauri wa kisheria kwa nchi husika. Angalia mahitaji maalum ya nchi ya mbia wako.
question_en: How can BRELA help verify a Tanzania company for a foreign partner — what is the process?
answer_en: To verify a company for a foreign partner, BRELA can provide: a Certificate of Compliance (Form 23), a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, and register search results. These documents may need apostille certification or legal notarisation for the relevant country. Check the specific requirements of your partner's country.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Tofauti kati ya VAT withholding na VAT ya kawaida ni nini?
output: VAT ya kawaida (asilimia 18) inalipwa na msambazaji kwenye mauzo yake yote yanayostahili, kupitia VAT return tarehe 20. VAT withholding (asilimia 3 kwa bidhaa, asilimia 6 kwa huduma) ni sehemu ndogo ya VAT inayokatwa na mnunuzi anayehitimu na kupelekwa TRA moja kwa moja -- si kupitia return ya msambazaji. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Kodi ya mapato ya biashara ya kilimo Tanzania iko chini ya kodi ya kawaida ya biashara — kilimo kina mfumo maalum wa kodi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Shughuli fulani za kilimo Tanzania zina msamaha au mfumo maalum wa kodi. Kwa mfano, mapato ya kilimo ya mzalishaji mdogo yanaweza kusamehewa kodi ya mapato. Hata hivyo, kampuni kubwa za kilimo na mauzo ya mazao kwa biashara (commercial agriculture) zinalipishwa kodi ya kawaida. Angalia TRA na mwanasheria wa kodi kwa sekta yako mahususi ya kilimo.
question_en: Tanzania agricultural business income tax is lower than regular business tax — agriculture has a special tax framework — is this true?
answer_en: Certain agricultural activities in Tanzania have exemptions or special tax treatment. For example, agricultural income of small-scale producers may be exempt from income tax. However, large agricultural companies and commercial crop sales are subject to standard tax. Check with TRA and a tax adviser for your specific agricultural sector.

question_sw: Mwajiri ana wafanyakazi 10 wa kudumu na 3 wa muda — SDL inahesabiwa kwa wote?
answer_sw: SDL inahesabiwa kwa wafanyakazi WOTE wanaolipwa mshahara — wakudumu NA wa muda. Kizingiti cha '10 wafanyakazi' kinategemea jumla ya wafanyakazi wote, si wakudumu peke yao. Mishahara ya wote inajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa SDL.
question_en: An employer has 10 permanent employees and 3 temporary ones — is SDL calculated on all?
answer_en: SDL is calculated on ALL employees receiving a salary — permanent AND temporary. The threshold of '10 employees' is based on total headcount, not permanent employees alone. All their salaries are included in the SDL base.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Biashara mpya ndogo ya Tanzania inahitaji kusajiliwa wapi kwanza?
answer_sw: Biashara mpya ndogo ya Tanzania inaanza kwa: (1) BRELA — kusajili jina la biashara au kampuni (TZS 50,000 kwa hifadhi ya jina, TZS 95,000+ kwa uanzishaji wa kampuni), (2) TRA — kupata TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) bila ada, (3) TRA — kusajili VAT ikiwa mauzo yanazidi TZS 200M/mwaka, (4) LGA ya eneo lako — leseni ya biashara. Mpangilio huu wa usajili unafuatwa kwa kawaida.
question_en: Where does a new small Tanzania business need to register first?
answer_en: A new small Tanzania business starts with: (1) BRELA — register the business name or company (TZS 50,000 for name reservation, TZS 95,000+ for company incorporation), (2) TRA — get a TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) at no fee, (3) TRA — register for VAT if turnover exceeds TZS 200M/year, (4) Local Government Authority (LGA) — business licence. This registration sequence is the standard path.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: BRELA fee update or LGA fee change

instruction: SDL inalipwa tarehe ngapi kila mwezi — na je, ni tofauti na PAYE?
output: SDL inalipwa tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata — SAWA NA PAYE. Hakuna tofauti ya tarehe kati ya SDL na PAYE. SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinawasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfano: kodi zote mbili za Desemba zinawasilishwa ifikapo 7 Januari. Kukumbuka rahisi: SDL na PAYE = tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, bila ubaguzi. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Ninafanya kazi ya uhuru (freelance) kwa jina langu — BRELA inajishughulisha nami?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Wafanyakazi huru (freelancers) wanaofanya biashara Tanzania Bara wanahitaji usajili wa BRELA. Usajili unakusaidia pia kupata TIN ya biashara na kufungua akaunti ya benki ya biashara.

question_sw: Risiti ya EFD lazima itolewa kwa manunuzi yote — ikiwa ni pamoja na manunuzi madogo ya TZS 500 Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sheria ya EFD inaitaji risiti itolewe kwa kila muamala bila kujali kiasi chake. Hata kwa nunuzi ndogo ya TZS 500, biashara iliyolazimika kutumia EFD lazima itoe risiti ya EFD. Hakuna kizingiti cha chini cha kiasi ambacho kinakuruhusu kutotoa risiti ya EFD.
question_en: Must an EFD receipt be issued for all purchases — including small purchases of TZS 500 in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. EFD law requires a receipt to be issued for every transaction regardless of amount. Even for a small TZS 500 purchase, a business required to use an EFD must issue an EFD receipt. There is no minimum amount threshold that allows you to skip issuing an EFD receipt.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu unaweza kulipwa kwa Mpesa au Tigo Pesa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa sasa, malipo ya ushuru wa stempu Tanzania kwa kawaida yanafanywa kupitia mfumo wa TRA (PRN) kupitia benki zilizoidhinishwa au e-payment ya TRA. Malipo ya moja kwa moja kwa pesa ya simu (mobile money) kama M-Pesa kwa ushuru wa stempu yanaweza hayajakubaliwa rasmi kwenye mfumo wa TRA. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja au tovuti yake kwa njia za malipo zilizoidhinishwa za hali ya sasa.
question_en: Can stamp duty be paid via M-Pesa or Tigo Pesa in Tanzania?
answer_en: Currently, stamp duty payments in Tanzania are generally made through the TRA system (PRN) via authorised banks or TRA e-payment. Direct payment via mobile money (M-Pesa) for stamp duty may not yet be formally accepted in the TRA system. Check TRA directly or on its website for currently authorised payment methods.

question_sw: EFD machine inagharimu kiasi gani Tanzania na mwajiri analipa au TRA?
answer_sw: EFD machine nchini Tanzania inagharimu kati ya TZS 250,000 hadi TZS 500,000 au zaidi kulingana na aina na mzalishaji. MWAJIRI (biashara) ndiye anayenunua EFD — si TRA. Hata hivyo, TRA inaidhinisha wasambazaji wa EFD na inahitaji kwamba EFD inunuliwa kutoka kwa msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa na kuunganishwa kwenye mfumo wa TRA. Ada ya uunganisho na matengenezo ya kila mwaka inaweza kuwa ya ziada.
question_en: How much does an EFD machine cost in Tanzania and does the employer or TRA pay?
answer_en: An EFD machine in Tanzania costs between TZS 250,000 and TZS 500,000 or more depending on type and manufacturer. The EMPLOYER (business) buys the EFD — not TRA. However, TRA approves EFD suppliers and requires that the EFD is purchased from an approved supplier and connected to the TRA system. Connection and annual maintenance fees may be additional.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD fee or supplier update

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ya bima — kiwango cha ushuru wa malipo ya bima (insurance premium levy) Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa malipo ya bima (insurance premium levy) ni eneo la Mamlaka ya Udhibiti wa Bima Tanzania (TIRA) na sheria za bima — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Kiwango cha ushuru na mahitaji yake yanategemea aina ya bima (maisha, gari, afya, nk). Wasiliana na TIRA (tira.go.tz) au mhesabu wa kodi aliyebobea katika sekta ya bima.
question_en: My insurance company — what is the insurance premium levy rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: Insurance premium levy falls under the Tanzania Insurance Regulatory Authority (TIRA) and insurance laws — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. The levy rate and requirements depend on the type of insurance (life, motor, health, etc.). Contact TIRA (tira.go.tz) or a tax accountant specialised in the insurance sector.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kutunza rekodi gani za usalama wa mahali pa kazi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri lazima atunze: rejesta ya ajali na matukio, rekodi za mafunzo ya usalama, rekodi za uchunguzi wa afya wa wafanyakazi, matokeo ya ukaguzi wa usalama, na nakala za notisi za OSHA. Rekodi hizi zinaweza kukaguliwa na inspekta wa OSHA.
question_en: What safety records must an employer keep at the workplace?
answer_en: An employer must maintain: an accident and incident register, safety training records, employee health surveillance records, safety inspection results, and copies of OSHA notices. These records can be inspected by an OSHA inspector.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: OSHA inahitajika kwa wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi nyumbani (home workers) Tanzania — usajili ni lazima?
answer_sw: Kwa wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi nyumbani kwao, hali ya OSHA inategemea ikiwa nyumba hiyo inachukuliwa 'mahali pa kazi' (workplace) kwa maana ya kisheria. Wafanyakazi wa nyumba ambao mwajiri anawatembelea au kutoa vifaa kazi vinaweza kuathiriwa na sheria za OSHA. Kwa wafanyakazi wa kujitegemea wanaofanya kazi nyumbani kwao wenyewe, OSHA inaweza kutotumika kwa njia ile ile. Omba mwongozo wa OSHA kwa hali yako.
question_en: Is OSHA registration required for home workers in Tanzania?
answer_en: For workers working from their own home, the OSHA position depends on whether the home is considered a 'workplace' in the legal sense. Home workers whose employer visits them or provides work equipment may be affected by OSHA law. For truly self-employed people working from their own home, OSHA may not apply in the same way. Seek OSHA guidance for your specific situation.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act home working guidance update

instruction: Kama sina wafanyakazi — nafanya kazi peke yangu — OSHA bado inanishughulikia?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Kwa mfanyabiashara peke yake (sole trader bila wafanyakazi): Kanuni za OSHA zinaweza kutumika kwa eneo lako la kazi hata kama wewe ni mfanyakazi peke yako. Lengo la OSHA ni usalama wa ENEO LA KAZI — si tu usalama wa wafanyakazi. Thibitisha mahitaji yako maalum na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: Mwajiri alipuka (liquidation) — je, SDL inaendelea kulipwa?
answer_sw: Katika mchakato wa ufilisi (liquidation), mdhamini (liquidator) analipa madeni ya serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na SDL iliyobakia. SDL iliyokwisha kulipwa ni faida kwa wafanyakazi — ilikwenda kwa VETA/TRA. SDL inayobakia ni deni la awali (priority debt) katika ufilisi.
question_en: An employer goes into liquidation — does SDL continue to be paid?
answer_en: During liquidation, the liquidator pays government debts including outstanding SDL. SDL already paid was for the benefit of employees — it went to VETA/TRA. Outstanding SDL is a priority debt in the liquidation process.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: VAT withholding inatekelezwa na nani — TRA au qualifying buyer?
output: VAT withholding INATEKELEZWA NA QUALIFYING BUYER — si TRA moja kwa moja. Mchakato: (1) Qualifying buyer (kama wizara) anafanya ununuzi wa bidhaa au huduma; (2) Anakata 3% (bidhaa) au 6% (huduma) ya VAT kutoka malipo; (3) Anatuma kiasi kilichokatwa TRA ndani ya muda uliowekwa; (4) Anatoa withholding certificate kwa muuzaji — siku ya muamala. TRA haihusiki moja kwa moja katika kila muamala wa withholding — inategemea qualifying buyer kufanya hii kwa niaba yake. TRA inakagua utiifu baadaye. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mgeni ana kinyozi na pia anafundisha kukata nywele. Kufundisha pia kunakatazwa?
answer_sw: Kinyozi (barbershop) kama biashara ya uendeshaji imekatazwa wazi. Kufundisha (training/shule ya ufundi) ni swali tofauti — GN 487A inazuia biashara za uendeshaji zilizoorodheshwa, si kila aina ya shughuli inayohusiana. Hata hivyo, kama 'kufundisha' ni njia ya kukwepa kinyozi kilichokatazwa (mnunuzi wa huduma ni mteja wa kinyozi), inaweza bado kuzingatiwa ukiukaji. Wasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa ufafanuzi.
question_en: A non-citizen runs a barbershop and also teaches haircutting. Is the teaching also prohibited?
answer_en: A barbershop as an operational business is explicitly prohibited. Teaching (training/vocational school) is a separate question — GN 487A prohibits the listed operational businesses, not every related activity. However, if the 'teaching' is a way to disguise a prohibited barbershop (the service recipient is effectively a barber customer), it may still be considered a violation. Consult the Immigration Department for clarification.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Mgeni ana biashara ya boda boda 5 zilizosajiliwa kwa jina lake — je, adhabu ya GN 487A ni mara moja au kwa kila boda boda?
output: GN 487A inazuia kufanya biashara ya boda boda kwa mgeni. Kwa boda boda 5 zilizosajiliwa kwa jina lake — hii ni biashara moja ya usafirishaji (hata kama vifaa ni 5) au inaweza kuchukuliwa kama vitendo vingi vya ukiukwaji. Kwa kawaida: ikiwa biashara ni moja (kampuni moja ya usafirishaji yenye boda boda 5) — kesi moja ya GN 487A; ikiwa kila boda boda ina usajili tofauti kama biashara tofauti — vinaweza kuwa vitendo tofauti. Korti itaamua — lakini adhabu ya chini ni TZS milioni 10 kwa kila kosa, kufutwa kwa visa ni lazima. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari — tofauti kuu tatu kati ya adhabu ya mgeni na adhabu ya msaidizi Mtanzania chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Tofauti tatu kuu: (1) KIASI — mgeni angalau TZS 10M (chini), msaidizi hadi TZS 5M (juu); (2) MUUNDO — mgeni: faini NA kifungo NA visa (zote tatu), msaidizi: faini AU kifungo (moja tu); (3) VISA — mgeni anapoteza visa, msaidizi hapotezi kitu cha aina hiyo. Kwa kifupi: mgeni anapewa adhabu kali zaidi, msaidizi anapewa adhabu nyepesi zaidi.
question_en: Summary — what are the three main differences between a non-citizen's penalty and a Tanzanian facilitator's penalty under GN 487A?
answer_en: Three key differences: (1) AMOUNT — non-citizen at least TZS 10M (floor), facilitator up to TZS 5M (ceiling); (2) STRUCTURE — non-citizen: fine AND imprisonment AND visa (all three), facilitator: fine OR imprisonment (one only); (3) VISA — non-citizen loses visa, facilitator loses nothing of that kind. In short: non-citizen receives a harsher penalty, facilitator receives a lighter one.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Madawa ya hospitali yana VAT ya asilimia 5 au asilimia 0?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Madawa mengi ya hospitali (dawa muhimu) yanaweza kuwa zero-rated (0% VAT — unaweza kudai input VAT) au exempt (huna wajibu wa VAT lakini pia huwezi kudai input VAT) — si 5%. Hizi ni hali tofauti kisheria — thibitisha hali ya dawa maalum na orodha rasmi ya TRA (tra.go.tz). Tanzania haina kiwango cha 5% kabisa. Thibitisha hali ya dawa maalum na orodha ya TRA.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini unahusu tu wafanyakazi wa kudumu — wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi hawafunikwi?
answer_sw: Hapana, hii si kweli. GN 605A inafunika wafanyakazi wote — wa kudumu, wa muda mfupi, wa muda, na wa msimu. Kwa wafanyakazi wasio wa kudumu, kiwango kinahesabiwa kwa uwiano. Hakuna msamaha kwa aina yoyote ya mkataba wa ajira.
question_en: The minimum wage only covers permanent employees — temporary workers are not covered?
answer_en: No, this is false. GN 605A covers all workers — permanent, short-term, fixed-term, and seasonal. For non-permanent workers the rate is calculated proportionally. There is no exemption for any type of employment contract.

question_sw: Mimi ni wakala wa zuio la VAT. Ninaweza kupunguza VAT niliyoizuia kutoka kwa wasambazaji dhidi ya VAT ninayodaiwa mimi mwenyewe?
answer_sw: Hapana. VAT ya zuio unayoizuia kutoka kwa msambazaji wako hailipwi kama mkopo dhidi ya deni lako la VAT. Wewe kama wakala wa zuio unalipa kiasi hicho moja kwa moja TRA kwa niaba ya msambazaji. Msambazaji wako ndiye anayeidai kama mkopo wa VAT (input VAT) kwenye return yake. Lazima utoe hati ya zuio la VAT kwa msambazaji siku ambayo VAT inastahili kulipwa — si tarehe ya 20.
question_en: I am a designated VAT withholding agent. Can I offset the VAT I withheld from suppliers against my own VAT liability?
answer_en: No. The VAT you withhold from your suppliers cannot be offset against your own output VAT liability. As the withholding agent you remit the withheld amount directly to TRA on behalf of your supplier. Your supplier claims it as input VAT on their own return. You must issue the VAT withholding certificate to your supplier on the day the VAT becomes payable — not on the 20th.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT withholding rules

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini kwa sekta ya umma ni Shilingi ngapi?
answer_sw: Kwa sekta ya umma, Rais Samia alitangaza mshahara wa chini wa Shilingi 500,000 kwa mwezi kuanzia Julai 2025. Hii ni tofauti kabisa na GN 605A ambayo inashughulikia sekta binafsi.
question_en: What is the minimum wage for the public sector?
answer_en: For the public sector, President Samia announced a minimum wage of TZS 500,000 per month effective July 2025. This is separate from GN 605A which governs the private sector.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi wa msimu (seasonal) kwa miezi 3 tu — SDL inakokotolewa vipi?
output: SDL inakokotolewa KILA MWEZI ambapo biashara ina wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, bila kujali kama ni wa msimu au wa kudumu. Kwa mfano: kama una wafanyakazi wa msimu 15 kwa miezi 3 (Januari–Machi), SDL inalipwa kwa miezi 3 ile ile tu. Miezi mingine (Aprili–Desemba) ukiwa na chini ya wafanyakazi 10 — hakuna SDL. Kila mwezi unakokotolewa kwa hali ya wafanyakazi na mishahara ya MWEZI HULE — si wastani wa mwaka. Kwa hivyo biashara za msimu zinalipa SDL miezi inayofanya kazi tu. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Adhabu kwa mwajiri anayelipa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayelipa chini ya kiwango cha mshahara wa chini anaweza kukabili: malimbikizo ya tofauti ya mshahara, faini chini ya ELRA, au kesi ya kisheria iliyowasilishwa na mfanyakazi. Ukaguzi wa MLYWF unaweza kuanzisha hatua za kisheria. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: What is the penalty for an employer paying below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: An employer paying below the minimum wage may face: back-payment of wage shortfalls, fines under ELRA, or legal proceedings filed by the employee. MLYWF labour inspectors can initiate enforcement action. Confirm with a legal adviser.

question_sw: Wakurugenzi wa pekee (sole directors) wanaofanya kazi peke yao — je, wana wajibu wa NSSF?
answer_sw: Mkurugenzi wa pekee anayejilipa mshahara katika kampuni yake ana wajibu wa NSSF — kampuni (kama mwajiri) inalipa 10% na mkurugenzi (kama mfanyakazi) analipa 10% = jumla 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Ikiwa mkurugenzi anachukua gawio (dividends) badala ya mshahara, hali inaweza kutofautiana. Kwa mwongozo wa hali hii maalum, wasiliana na NSSF moja kwa moja.
question_en: Sole directors who work alone in their company — do they have NSSF obligations?
answer_en: A sole director who pays themselves a salary in their company has NSSF obligations — the company (as employer) pays 10% and the director (as employee) pays 10% = total 20% of gross wage. If the director takes dividends instead of a salary, the situation may differ. For guidance on this specific arrangement, contact NSSF directly.

question_sw: OSHA inaweza kufunga biashara kwa sababu ya ukiukwaji wa usalama Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA ina mamlaka ya kutoa amri ya kusimamisha shughuli (stop order) au kufunga mahali pa kazi ikiwa panahatarisha usalama wa wafanyakazi kwa kiwango kikubwa. Mkaguzi wa OSHA anaweza kutoa: notisi ya kuboresha (improvement notice) kwa ukiukwaji mdogo, amri ya kusimamisha (prohibition notice) kwa hatari ya haraka, au kusimamisha shughuli hadi hatari itakapoondolewa. Kufunga kwa OSHA si suala la uhasibu — ni suala la usalama wa mwili.
question_en: Can OSHA close a business for safety violations in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. OSHA has authority to issue a stop order or close a workplace if it poses a major threat to worker safety. An OSHA inspector can issue: an improvement notice for minor violations, a prohibition notice for immediate danger, or suspend operations until the hazard is removed. OSHA closure is not an accounting matter — it is a physical safety matter.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu unaweza kusamehewa kwa hati za biashara za kikanda (EAC) — je, EAC inatoa msamaha?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, hati zinazohusiana na biashara ya EAC au STR zinaweza kuwa na masharti maalum lakini msamaha wa ushuru wa stempu wa Tanzania kwa miamala ya EAC si moja kwa moja. Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania ni wa ndani — EAC inashughulikia zaidi ushuru wa forodha (customs duties). Angalia TRA kwa masharti mahususi ya hati za kibiashara za kikanda.
question_en: Can stamp duty be exempted for EAC (East African Community) regional business instruments — does EAC provide an exemption?
answer_en: Generally, instruments relating to EAC trade or the STR may have special provisions but Tanzania stamp duty exemption for EAC transactions is not automatic. Tanzania stamp duty is a domestic tax — EAC primarily deals with customs duties. Check TRA for specific provisions on regional trade instruments.
next_review_trigger: EAC treaty or Stamp Duty Act update

question_sw: Withholding tax (WHT) na PAYE — kila moja inatumika lini?
answer_sw: PAYE: inatumiwa kwa WAFANYAKAZI WALIOHIRIWA (employed persons) — mwajiri anakata na kuwasilisha TRA. WHT: inatumiwa kwa MALIPO KWA WASIO WAFANYAKAZI (payments to contractors, non-residents, directors) — mlipaji anakata na kuwasilisha TRA. Kama mtu ana mkataba wa ajira = PAYE. Kama analipwa kwa ankara ya huduma au ni mgeni asiye mwajiriwa = WHT. Angalia muundo wa uhusiano.
question_en: Withholding tax (WHT) and PAYE — when does each apply?
answer_en: PAYE: applies to HIRED EMPLOYEES (employed persons) — employer deducts and remits to TRA. WHT: applies to PAYMENTS TO NON-EMPLOYEES (payments to contractors, non-residents, directors) — the payer deducts and remits to TRA. If a person has an employment contract = PAYE. If paid by service invoice or is a non-employed non-resident = WHT. Check the relationship structure.

question_sw: Muda wa kuwasilisha hoja ya pingamizi ya kodi TRA ni siku 30. Je, muda huu unaweza kuongezwa?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla muda wa siku 30 ni mgumu kuongezwa. Sheria ya Mapato ya Kodi (Tax Revenue Appeals Act) inaweka muda huu kama masharti ya awali — kushindwa kuwasilisha ndani ya siku 30 kunaweza kusababisha hoja yako kutokubalika. Hata hivyo, kwa hali za kipekee za nguvu ya lazima (force majeure) au ushahidi wa thabiti kwamba haikuwezekana kuwasilisha kwa wakati, Kamishna anaweza kwa hiari kuruhusu upanuzi. Omba ndani ya siku 7 kabla ya kumalizika kwa siku 30. Kamishna anaweza kutoa nyongeza ya hadi siku 30 zaidi ikiwa sababu ni nzuri. Hii ni haki iliyoko kisheria — si bahati.
answer_en: Generally the 30-day period is very difficult to extend. The Tax Revenue Appeals Act treats this period as a condition precedent — failing to file within 30 days may result in your objection being rejected as inadmissible. However, in exceptional cases of genuine force majeure or strong evidence that filing was genuinely impossible, the Commissioner may at discretion allow an extension. Apply within 7 days before the 30-day limit expires. The Commissioner may grant up to 30 additional days if reasonable grounds exist. This is a statutory right — not a matter of luck.
question_en: The deadline for filing a TRA tax objection is 30 days. Can this period be extended?

instruction: Ninaunda na kuuza NFT Tanzania — hizi zinatozwa kodi vipi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kodi ya NFT (Non-Fungible Tokens) Tanzania bado haijafafanuliwa rasmi kisheria — ni mada mpya inayohitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz, na BoT kupitia bot.go.tz.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa muda wa majaribio (probationary) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kipindi cha majaribio hakimzuii mfanyakazi kupata mshahara wa chini. GN 605A inatumika tangu siku ya kwanza ya ajira, bila kujali kama mfanyakazi yuko katika kipindi cha majaribio au la.
question_en: Does a probationary employee get the minimum wage?
answer_en: Yes. The probationary period does not exempt the employer from paying the minimum wage. GN 605A applies from day one of employment, regardless of whether the employee is on probation.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ripoti ya ajali ya OSHA na WCF ni ipi?
answer_sw: Mifumo miwili tofauti: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — mwajiri anaripoti ajali kupitia portal.wcf.go.tz ndani ya siku 7 za kazi baada ya ajali. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) — OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa mahali pa kazi; kikosi cha ukaguzi kinaweza kutoa notisi ya uboreshaji au ya kuzuia. Mwajiri analazimika kuwasilisha kwa OSHA pia maelezo ya ajali kubwa. Mifumo hii ni ya ziada — tekeleza yote mawili. Thibitisha na WCF na OSHA.
question_en: What is the difference between OSHA and WCF accident reporting in Tanzania?
answer_en: Two separate systems: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — employer reports the accident via portal.wcf.go.tz within 7 working days after the accident. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) — OSHA conducts workplace inspections; an inspector may issue an improvement notice or a prohibition notice. Employers must also report major accidents to OSHA separately. These systems are complementary — comply with both. Confirm with WCF and OSHA.
primary_source_name: OSHA - Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act amendment or new WCF regulations

question_sw: Kampuni yangu inalipa NSSF kubwa sana kwa sababu ya mishahara ya juu. Je, kuna njia ya kupunguza?
answer_sw: Hapana njia ya kisheria ya kupunguza mchango wa NSSF kwa mishahara halisi. NSSF ni wajibu wa kisheria: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla, bila kikomo cha juu. Kubadilisha muundo wa malipo ili kupunguza NSSF (kwa mfano, kulipa sehemu kubwa kama gawio au posho) kunaweza kukabiliwa na ukaguzi wa TRA/NSSF. Shirika linastahili kulipa NSSF kamili kwa mishahara yote.
question_en: My company pays a large NSSF amount due to high salaries. Is there a way to reduce it?
answer_en: There is no lawful way to reduce NSSF contributions on actual salaries. NSSF is a legal obligation: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage, with no upper ceiling. Restructuring pay to reduce NSSF (for example, by paying part as dividends or allowances) may be challenged by TRA/NSSF audit. Companies are expected to pay full NSSF on all wages.

question_sw: GN 487A ilianzishwa kwa sababu gani — ni sheria ya uhamiaji au ya kiuchumi?
answer_sw: GN 487A ni amri ya kiuchumi inayolinda biashara ndogo za Watanzania — si sheria ya uhamiaji. Lengo lake ni kuhifadhi sekta fulani za kiuchumi kwa ajili ya raia wa Tanzania. Uhamiaji unatekeleza amri hii kwa sababu inahusu uraia wa wafanyabiashara, lakini msingi wake ni kiuchumi, si udhibiti wa uhamiaji.
question_en: Why was GN 487A created — is it an immigration law or an economic law?
answer_en: GN 487A is an economic order protecting Tanzanian small businesses — not an immigration law. Its purpose is to reserve certain economic sectors for Tanzanian citizens. Immigration enforces the order because it involves the citizenship status of business operators, but the underlying basis is economic, not immigration control.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Mkataba wa kukodisha (lease) kwa miaka miwili au chini ya miaka miwili una ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mkataba wa kukodisha wa muda mfupi (kawaida chini ya miaka mitatu) unaweza kuwa na ushuru wa stempu wa chini au kusamehewa kulingana na Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu Tanzania. Mikataba ya kukodisha ya muda mrefu (kawaida miaka mitatu au zaidi) ina ushuru wa stempu unaohesabiwa kwa kuzingatia muda wa mkataba na kiwango cha pango. Angalia TRA kwa jedwali la hali ya sasa.
question_en: Does a lease contract for two years or less attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: A short-term lease (generally less than three years) may attract lower stamp duty or be exempt depending on the Tanzania Stamp Duty Act. Long-term leases (generally three years or more) carry stamp duty calculated based on the duration and rent amount. Check TRA for the current schedule.

instruction: Nimeambiwa annual return ya BRELA inaisha 30 Septemba — ni kweli?
output: Hapana, si kweli. Hakuna tarehe maalum ya 30 Septemba kwa annual returns za BRELA — tarehe inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni yako. Annual return inapaswa kuwasilishwa kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni yako (anniversary date) — si lazima mwaka wa kifedha. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa tarehe yako halisi. Tarehe ya 30 Septemba haikuwa sahihi — haipo kwenye sheria ya Companies Act ya Tanzania. Usijaribu na tarehe hii — thibitisha na BRELA kwa tarehe yako maalum.

question_sw: Kama mfanyakazi anakataa kufanya kazi kwa sababu ya hatari ya usalama, ana haki?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wana haki ya kukataa kufanya kazi yenye hatari ya haraka na ya kweli ya kifo au majeraha makubwa. Mwajiri haruhusiwi kumfuta mfanyakazi kwa kukataa kufanya kazi hatari. Haki hii inalindwa na Sheria ya OSHA.
question_en: If a worker refuses to work due to a safety hazard do they have the right?
answer_en: Yes. Workers have the right to refuse to perform work that poses an imminent and genuine risk of death or serious injury. An employer may not dismiss an employee for refusing to perform dangerous work. This right is protected under the OSHA Act.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa kodi ya zuio kwa wakati Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Wakala wa zuio ambaye hakulipa kwa wakati anakabili: faini ya asilimia 5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu yake, pamoja na riba. TRA pia inaweza kudai malipo moja kwa moja kutoka kwa wakala. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the penalty for late withholding tax remittance in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding agent who pays late faces: a 5% penalty on the overdue amount per month or part thereof, plus interest. TRA can also claim the payment directly from the agent. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kama mwajiri amewasilisha NSSF kwa miaka 10 bila kukosea — ana haki ya kupata 'clean record' inayothibitishwa na NSSF?
answer_sw: NSSF Tanzania inaweza kutoa taarifa ya uzingatiaji (compliance statement) au cheti cha ukaguzi wa malipo kinachoonyesha historia ya malipo ya mwajiri. Hati hii inaweza kuhitajika kwa: kuthibitishwa na TRA wakati wa ukaguzi, maombi ya mikopo ya benki, zabuni za serikali, au ukaguzi wa washirika wa biashara. Angalia NSSF kwa jinsi ya kupata taarifa hii rasmi.
question_en: If an employer has remitted NSSF for 10 years without error — do they have a right to a 'clean record' certificate from NSSF?
answer_en: NSSF Tanzania can issue a compliance statement or payment audit certificate showing an employer's payment history. This document may be required for: verification by TRA during audits, bank loan applications, government tenders, or business partner due diligence. Check NSSF for how to obtain this formal statement.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Nataka kufungua biashara ya kuuza nguo — ninahitaji nini BRELA?
answer_sw: Kwa biashara ya nguo, unahitaji kusajili jina la biashara au kampuni na BRELA. Hatua ni: (1) chagua jina na lilithbitishe BRELA halijachukuliwa, (2) wasilisha fomu ya usajili na ada (karibu Shilingi 20,000-50,000), (3) pata cheti cha usajili. Kisha nenda TRA kwa TIN na leseni ya biashara ya manispaa.
question_en: I want to start a clothes selling business — what do I need from BRELA?
answer_en: For a clothes business you need to register a business name or company with BRELA. The steps are: (1) choose a name and confirm with BRELA it is not taken, (2) submit the registration form and fee (approximately TZS 20,000-50,000), (3) receive your registration certificate. Then go to TRA for a TIN and the municipal trading licence.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni analipa kwa kiwango gani cha PAYE — kina tofauti na raia?
answer_sw: Kwa wafanyakazi wa kawaida wa ajira (employees), viwango vya PAYE ni sawa kwa raia na wageni wanaofanya kazi Tanzania. Viwango vya PAYE vya Tanzania (mwaka 2025/2026) ni vya kijumla: 0% kwa chini ya TZS 270,000/mwezi, 8%-30% kwa viwango vya juu zaidi. Tofauti inaweza kuwepo kwa watu wa hali maalum kama wasio na makazi (non-residents) — thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Does a foreign employee pay PAYE at a different rate from a citizen?
answer_en: For regular employees, PAYE rates are the same for citizens and foreigners working in Tanzania. Tanzania PAYE rates (2025/2026) are graduated: 0% below TZS 270,000/month, 8%-30% for higher brackets. Differences may exist for persons with special status like non-residents — verify with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini Tanzania anapata kiasi gani cha fidia kutoka WCF?
answer_sw: Kiasi cha fidia ya WCF Tanzania kinategemea: aina ya jeraha au ulemavu, asilimia ya ulemavu iliyoamuliwa na daktari wa WCF, na mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Fidia kwa ulemavu wa kudumu wa asilimia 100 ni miaka fulani ya mshahara (kiwango kilichowekwa na Workers Compensation Act). Fidia ya kifo cha mfanyakazi inajumuisha malipo ya mkupuo na malipo ya mwenzi/watoto. Angalia WCF kwa jedwali la fidia la hali ya sasa.
question_en: How much compensation does an injured Tanzanian worker receive from WCF?
answer_en: The amount of WCF compensation in Tanzania depends on: the type of injury or disability, the percentage of disability assessed by a WCF-appointed doctor, and the worker's wage. Compensation for 100% permanent disability is a set number of years of wages (amount prescribed by the Workers Compensation Act). Death compensation includes a lump sum payment and spouse/children payments. Check WCF for the current compensation schedule.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya NSSF na WCF ni nini?
answer_sw: NSSF (National Social Security Fund) ni hifadhi ya jamii ya muda mrefu — pensheni, faida za matibabu, faida za uzazi. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni fidia ya mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini — inahusu majeraha ya mahali pa kazi, ulemavu wa kazi, na kifo kazini. Kiwango: mwajiri peke yake asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Zote mbili ni lazima na zinalipwa kwa mwajiri, lakini zinaenda taasisi tofauti.
question_en: What is the difference between NSSF and WCF?
answer_en: NSSF (National Social Security Fund) is long-term social security — pension, medical benefits, maternity benefits. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is compensation for work-related injuries — it covers workplace injuries, work-related disability, and death at work. Rate: employer only at 0.5% of gross wage. Both are mandatory and paid by the employer, but go to different institutions.

question_sw: TRA imetoa tathmini ya kodi ambayo ninaona ni makosa. Ninaweza kupinga vipi na ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: MUHIMU: Kabla ya kuwasilisha hoja ya pingamizi, lazima ulipe kiwango kikubwa kati ya: (a) kodi isiyobishaniwa AU (b) theluthi moja (1/3) ya kodi iliyotathminiwa — ndani ya siku 15 baada ya kupokea tathmini. Bila malipo haya hoja haitakubaliwa na TRA. Unaweza kupinga tathmini ya TRA kwa kuwasilisha hoja ya pingamizi rasmi (notice of objection) kwa Kamishna wa TRA ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kupokea tathmini. Hoja lazima iwe kwa maandishi na ieleze kwa undani sababu za kisheria za kupingana na tathmini, ikiambatana na ushahidi wa kutosha (rekodi za uhasibu, risiti, mikataba). Kamishna atapitia hoja na kutoa uamuzi ndani ya miezi 6 kutoka tarehe ya kukubali hoja. Muhimu: Siku 30 za kuwasilisha hoja ni muda wa kisheria usiopanuliwa kwa urahisi — usipoteze muda.
answer_en: IMPORTANT: Before filing the objection, you must pay the higher of: (a) undisputed tax OR (b) one-third (1/3) of the assessed tax — within 15 days of receiving the assessment. Without this payment TRA will not admit the objection. You can dispute a TRA assessment by submitting a formal notice of objection to the TRA Commissioner General within 30 days of receiving the assessment. The objection must be in writing and explain in detail the legal grounds for disputing the assessment, accompanied by sufficient evidence (accounting records, receipts, contracts). The Commissioner will review the objection and issue a decision within 6 months from the date of admission of the objection. Important: the 30-day period for filing an objection is a statutory deadline not easily extended — do not waste time.
question_en: TRA has issued a tax assessment that I believe is wrong. How can I dispute it and within what time?

question_sw: Tikiti ya ndege ya kwenda nchi ya asili — ni manufaa yanayolazimika PAYE?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, tikiti za ndege zinazolipwa na mwajiri kwa ajili ya likizo ya mfanyakazi au safari za kibinafsi zinachukuliwa kama manufaa yanayolazimika PAYE. Hata hivyo, tikiti za safari za biashara (business travel) hazijumuishwi. Thibitisha hali ya tikiti maalum na mshauri wa kodi ili kuepuka kosa.
question_en: A return flight ticket to home country — is it a taxable employment benefit?
answer_en: Generally, flight tickets paid by the employer for an employee's vacation or personal travel are treated as taxable employment benefits. However, business travel tickets are not included. Verify the status of specific tickets with a tax advisor to avoid errors.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Kampuni iliyofutwa orodha BRELA — direkta wake anaweza kuanzisha kampuni mpya haraka?
output: Wakurugenzi wa kampuni iliyofutwa orodha wanaweza kuanzisha kampuni mpya, lakini wanapaswa kuzingatia: (1) Madeni ya kampuni iliyofutwa orodha yanabaki — wadai wanaweza kufuatilia wakurugenzi kibinafsi kwa vitendo vya ulaghai; (2) Madeni ya kodi ya TRA yanaweza kufuatwa hadi kwa wakurugenzi kibinafsi; (3) BRELA inaweza kuuliza historia ya kampuni za awali wakati wa usajili mpya. Kampuni mpya si njia ya kufuta madeni ya kampuni ya zamani. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Mwajiri mpya anahitaji kusajili wafanyakazi wake wa zamani (waliokuwepo kabla ya kuanzishwa kwake) NSSF?
answer_sw: Wakati biashara mpya inachukua (acquires) biashara nyingine na wafanyakazi wake, wajibu wa NSSF unategemea muundo wa muamala. Ikiwa ni ununuzi wa biashara (asset purchase) na wafanyakazi wanaajiriwa upya, mwajiri mpya anasajili wafanyakazi wake upya na NSSF. Ikiwa ni ununuzi wa hisa (share purchase), kampuni inabaki sawa na NSSF na wafanyakazi wake — mwajiri mpya (wanaohisa) wanachukua majukumu ya NSSF ya kampuni.
question_en: Does a new employer need to register employees who were there before their acquisition with NSSF?
answer_en: When a new business acquires another business and its employees, the NSSF obligation depends on the transaction structure. If it is an asset purchase with employees re-hired, the new employer re-registers the employees with NSSF. If it is a share purchase, the company remains the same with NSSF and its employees — the new employer (shareholders) takes over the company's NSSF obligations.
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act or employment transfer law update

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ilikata PAYE kidogo sana kwa mfanyakazi kwa makosa ya hesabu. Ninafanyaje marekebisho?
answer_sw: Unahitaji kuwasilisha TRA return ya marekebisho (amended return) kwa mwezi husika. Lipa tofauti ya PAYE iliyokosekana pamoja na riba ya kisheria inayowekwa na TRA (thibitisha kiwango cha sasa). Taarisha TRA kupitia barua yenye maelezo ya kosa. Ikiwa kosa linagundulika kabla ya muda wa ukaguzi, kujisalimisha kwa hiari (voluntary disclosure) kunaweza kupunguza adhabu. Wasiliana na TRA service desk au ofisi ya karibu nawe.
answer_en: You need to file an amended PAYE return with TRA for the affected month. Pay the shortfall plus statutory interest at the rate set by TRA (confirm current rate). Notify TRA in writing with an explanation of the error. If the error is discovered before an audit, voluntary disclosure may reduce penalties. Contact the TRA service desk or nearest TRA office.
question_en: Our company deducted too little PAYE from an employee due to a calculation error. How do we correct this?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — amended return and voluntary disclosure

instruction: Je, OSHA inaweza kufunga biashara yangu bila taarifa ya awali?
output: Ndiyo. OSHA ina mamlaka ya kufunga biashara mara moja (prohibition notice) kama wanaona hatari ya dharura kwa usalama wa wafanyakazi. Kufungwa kunaweza kutokea bila taarifa ya awali kama hali ya hatari ipo. Hatua za kawaida za ukaguzi wa kawaida — ambazo si dharura — mara nyingi hukuja na taarifa na muda wa kurekebisha. Kuzingatia mahitaji yote ya OSHA ndiyo njia pekee ya kuepuka hatua kali.

question_sw: BRELA inasajili mashirika ya kiraia (NGO) pia?
answer_sw: Hapana kwa ujumla. Mashirika ya kiraia (NGO) yanasajiliwa na Msajili wa NGO chini ya Ofisi ya Makamu wa Rais au wizara husika — si BRELA. BRELA inasajili kampuni za faida (for-profit companies) na majina ya biashara. Walakini, NGO inayoendesha shughuli za biashara ya ziada inaweza kuhitaji usajili wa BRELA pia.
question_en: Does BRELA also register civil society organisations (NGOs)?
answer_en: Generally no. Civil society organisations (NGOs) register with the NGO Registrar under the Vice President's Office or relevant ministry — not BRELA. BRELA registers for-profit companies and business names. However, an NGO conducting ancillary commercial activities may also need BRELA registration.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: NGO Act or Companies Act update

instruction: Naweza kuomba mkopo wa nyumba (home loan) kutoka benki — unisaidie kuomba.
output: Nje ya maarifa yangu ya ushauri wa biashara na kodi. Maombi ya mkopo wa nyumba na ushauri wa fedha za kibinafsi ni nje ya wigo wangu. Kwa msaada wa mkopo wa nyumba, wasiliana na benki moja kwa moja — NMB, CRDB, NBC, au benki nyingine zina mawakala wa mkopo wanaoweza kukusaidia kikamilifu. Mshauri wa benki ndiye mtu sahihi kwa swali hili.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mmoja analipwa TZS 800,000 kwa mwezi. SDL ya mfanyakazi huyu peke yake ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — haihesabiwi kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mmoja. Inatolewa kwa msingi wa jumla ya mishahara yote ya kampuni. Ikiwa kampuni ina wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, SDL = jumla ya mishahara yote × 3.5%. Kwa mfano: wafanyakazi 10 wote wanaolipwa TZS 800,000 kila mmoja = jumla TZS 8,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 280,000 SDL kwa mwezi.
question_en: One employee earns TZS 800,000 per month. What is the SDL for this employee alone?
answer_en: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is not calculated per individual employee. It is based on the company's total gross payroll. If the company has 10 or more employees, SDL = total payroll × 3.5%. Example: 10 employees each earning TZS 800,000 = total TZS 8,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 280,000 SDL per month.

instruction: Biashara yangu inaendesha mgahawa na duka la nguo. SDL inakokotolewa kwa jumla au kila biashara tofauti?
output: Kama mtu mmoja ndiye mmiliki wa biashara zote mbili (mgahawa na duka), SDL inakokotolewa kwa jumla ya wafanyakazi wote wa biashara zote — si kila biashara tofauti. Kizingiti cha wafanyakazi 10 kinaangalia wafanyakazi WOTE wa mmiliki. Kwa mfano: mgahawa una wafanyakazi 6, duka una 5 = jumla 11 — SDL inatumika kwa 11 wote. Malipo ya SDL: 3.5% ya jumla ya mishahara yote ya wafanyakazi 11. Hata hivyo, kama kila biashara ina TIN tofauti na inafanya kazi kwa uhuru — hali inaweza kuwa tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa hali yako maalum.

instruction: Mwajiri alipewa faini ya TZS milioni 5 kwa OSHA -- ni kwa jinsi ya ukiukwaji gani inaweza kutokea hivyo?
output: Faini ya juu ya TZS milioni 5 kwa OSHA inaweza kutokea kwa ukiukwaji mkubwa kama: kushindwa kusajili mahali pa kazi, kushindwa kurekebisha hatari iliyoamriwa na OSHA, au kusababisha ajali mbaya kwa kukosa kufuata viwango vya usalama. Adhabu za TZS milioni 1-5 zinategemea ukali wa ukiukwaji. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).
