question_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa ushuru wa stempu kwa wakati Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa ushuru wa stempu kwa wakati Tanzania inajumuisha: riba kwenye kiasi kilichochelewa, adhabu ya ziada inayoweza kuhesabiwa kama asilimia ya ushuru uliochelewa. Pia hati inaweza kukosaushuru wa kutosha na kuathiri nguvu yake ya kisheria. Kulipa mapema na kupata hati kupigiwa muhuri ni njia ya kuzuia adhabu hizi.
question_en: What is the penalty for not paying stamp duty on time in Tanzania?
answer_en: The penalty for late stamp duty payment in Tanzania includes: interest on the overdue amount, and an additional penalty which may be calculated as a percentage of the overdue duty. Also the instrument may be insufficiently stamped and its legal force affected. Paying promptly and having the instrument stamped is the way to avoid these penalties.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or Tax Administration Act update

instruction: QR code kwenye risiti ya EFD — wateja wangu wanaweza kuitumia vipi?
output: QR code kwenye kila risiti ya EFD inaweza kuscanwa na mteja yeyote kwa simu yake. Inampeleka kwenye portal ya TRA ambayo inathibitisha kwamba risiti hiyo ni halisi — si bandia. Faida kwa wateja: wanaweza kuthibitisha kwamba unalipa kodi na kutoa risiti halisi. Faida kwako kama mfanyabiashara: hujui risiti za bandia zikiwa zimetumika kwa jina lako.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wawili analipa NSSF mara mbili?
answer_sw: Inategemea: kila mwajiri anapaswa kulipa NSSF kwa mfanyakazi wake. Kama mfanyakazi ana waajiri wawili, NSSF inalipwa na kila mwajiri kwa kipande cha mshahara kinachohusika. Thibitisha mpangilio sahihi na NSSF.
question_en: Does an employee working for two employers pay NSSF twice?
answer_en: It depends: each employer must pay NSSF for their employee. If an employee has two employers, each pays NSSF on their respective portion of wages. Confirm the correct arrangement with NSSF.

question_sw: Kampuni inayounza mali zake (mali isiyohamishika) haishikili kodi yoyote — mwunuzi ndiye anayepaswa kulipa kodi ya ununuzi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla si sahihi. Faida ya mtaji (capital gain) kutoka mauzo ya mali isiyohamishika na biashara inalipishwa kodi ya mapato kwenye mauzo. Pia, ikiwa muuzaji ni asiye mkazi, mwunuzi ana wajibu wa kushikilia kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 10 kwenye bei ya mauzo. Kwa muuzaji mkazi anayefanya biashara, faida inalipishwa kodi ya mapato. Zote mbili, mwunuzi na muuzaji, wana majukumu ya kodi.
question_en: A company selling its property does not withhold any tax — the buyer is responsible for purchase taxes — is this correct?
answer_en: Generally not correct. Capital gain from sale of real property by a business is subject to income tax on disposal. Also, if the seller is a non-resident, the buyer has an obligation to withhold 10% on the sale price. For a resident business seller, the profit is subject to income tax. Both buyer and seller have tax obligations.

question_sw: Je, OSHA na NSSF ni tofauti?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ni tofauti kabisa. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inashughulikia USALAMA mahali pa kazi — ukaguzi, viwango vya usalama, na usajili wa mahali pa kazi. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) inashughulikia BIMA YA JAMII — pensheni, matibabu, na manufaa ya kijamii. Zote mbili zinahitaji kufuata na mwajiri.
question_en: Are OSHA and NSSF different?
answer_en: Yes, they are entirely different. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) deals with workplace SAFETY — inspections, safety standards, and workplace registration. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) deals with SOCIAL SECURITY — pension, medical, and social benefits. Both require employer compliance.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Nchi mbili zinazo DTA na Tanzania — mgeni kutoka nchi hiyo ana msamaha wa GN 487A?
output: Hapana — Double Taxation Agreements (DTA) ni makubaliano ya KODI TU — yanazuia kulipwa kodi mara mbili kwa nchi mbili. Hazina uhusiano wowote na haki za biashara chini ya GN 487A. Mgeni kutoka nchi yenye DTA na Tanzania bado anakabiliwa na GN 487A kikamilifu kwa shughuli zote 15 zilizokatazwa. DTA haizungumzii haki za biashara, uraia, wala kibali cha kufanya shughuli fulani. Kwa hiyo hata mgeni kutoka Uingereza, India, au Marekani (nchi zenye DTA na Tanzania) — bado ana vizuizi vya GN 487A. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Kampuni yangu inanunua mchanganyiko wa bidhaa (IT laptop) na huduma (ufungaji wa programu) pamoja — withholding ni ngapi?
output: Kwa mchanganyiko wa bidhaa na huduma, withholding inatumika kwa vipande tofauti: SEHEMU YA BIDHAA (laptop) → 3% withholding; SEHEMU YA HUDUMA (ufungaji wa programu/installation) → 6% withholding. Ikiwezekana, omba muuzaji atoe invoice tofauti au ahesabu wazi kiasi cha bidhaa na huduma — ili uweze kutumia kiwango sahihi kwa kila sehemu. Kama muuzaji hakutofautisha, kushauriana na mshauri wa kodi kunashauriwa. Pia withholding certificate lazima itolewa kwa wakati unaofaa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: EFD yangu inachapisha risiti lakini haipeleki data TRA. Je, ninajua vipi?
answer_sw: Dalili kwamba EFD haipeleki data TRA ni pamoja na: taa ya 'offline' au 'no connection' kwenye EFD, risiti zinazotolewa bila Fiscal Receipt Number ya mfululizo sahihi, au taarifa za makosa kwenye kiolesura cha EFD. Ukigundua EFD yako haipeleki data: (1) Angalia muunganiko wa intaneti; (2) Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD; (3) Taarifa TRA ndani ya masaa 24. Biashara inaweza kuendelea lakini tatizo lazima litatatuliwe haraka.
question_en: My EFD is printing receipts but not transmitting data to TRA. How do I know?
answer_en: Signs that EFD is not transmitting data to TRA include: 'offline' or 'no connection' indicator light on the EFD, receipts issued without correct sequential Fiscal Receipt Numbers, or error messages on the EFD interface. If you discover your EFD is not transmitting: (1) Check the internet connection; (2) Contact the EFD supplier; (3) Notify TRA within 24 hours. Business may continue but the issue must be resolved quickly.

question_sw: Nambari ya rejesta ya malipo (PRN) ya TRA ni nini na ninaipata wapi?
answer_sw: PRN (Payment Reference Number) ni nambari ya kipekee inayotolewa na mfumo wa TRA baada ya kuwasilisha return au kutoa ombi la malipo. PRN inathibitisha kwamba malipo yanakwenda kwenye akaunti sahihi ya kodi sahihi. Unapata PRN kwa: kuwasilisha return yako kwenye IDRAS au portal ya TRA, ambapo PRN itatolewa moja kwa moja baada ya kuthibitisha return. Kisha unalipa kupitia GePG kwa kutumia PRN hiyo. Kila PRN ina muda wa kuisha (thibitisha muda halisi na TRA) — lipa kabla haijakwisha. Bila PRN sahihi, malipo yanaweza kutokwenda kwenye akaunti yako ya kodi.
answer_en: A PRN (Payment Reference Number) is a unique number issued by the TRA system after filing a return or making a payment request. The PRN confirms that payment is going to the correct tax account. You obtain a PRN by: filing your return on IDRAS or the TRA portal, where a PRN is generated automatically after confirming the return. You then pay via GePG using that PRN. Each PRN has an expiry period (confirm current duration with TRA) — pay before it expires. Without the correct PRN, payment may not reach your tax account.
question_en: What is a TRA payment reference number (PRN) and where do I get it?

question_sw: TRA ina muda gani wa kisheria wa kutoa tathmini ya kodi baada ya mwaka wa kodi kupita?
answer_sw: Chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato na sheria za kodi nyingine Tanzania, TRA kwa ujumla ina miaka 5 kuanzia tarehe ya mwisho ya kuwasilisha return ya kodi kuwasilisha tathmini dhidi ya mlipa kodi ambaye aliwasilisha return. Kwa mlipa kodi ambaye hakuwasilisha return kabisa, TRA inaweza kutoa tathmini wakati wowote — hakuna kikomo cha muda. Kwa udanganyifu au ukwepaji wa makusudi, muda huo unaweza kuwa mrefu zaidi. Hifadhi rekodi zako za uhasibu kwa angalau miaka 5 ili kujibu tathmini yoyote ndani ya muda huo.
answer_en: Under the Income Tax Act and other Tanzanian tax laws, TRA generally has 5 years from the date of the final deadline for filing a tax return to issue an assessment against a taxpayer who filed a return. For a taxpayer who did not file a return at all, TRA may issue an assessment at any time — there is no time limit. For fraud or deliberate evasion, the period may be longer. Keep your accounting records for at least 5 years to be able to respond to any assessment within this period.
question_en: What is the statutory time limit for TRA to issue a tax assessment after the tax year has passed?
primary_source_name: TRA — limitation period for tax assessments
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to limitation period

question_sw: Je, kampuni ya utalii (safari company) ina mfumo maalum wa VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kampuni za utalii zinaweza kuwa na mfumo maalum wa VAT — hasa kwa huduma za utalii zinazotolewa kwa wageni (inbound tourism). Inaweza kustahili zero-rating kwa baadhi ya huduma. Sina uhakika wa kanuni za sasa maalum. Thibitisha na TRA au Tanzania Tourism Board (TTB).
question_en: Does a safari/tourism company have a special VAT framework in Tanzania?
answer_en: Tourism companies may have a special VAT framework — especially for tourism services provided to foreign visitors (inbound tourism). Some services may qualify for zero-rating. I am not certain of current specific rules. Verify with TRA or Tanzania Tourism Board (TTB).

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi (part-time) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa msingi wa pro-rata. Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A kuhesabiwa kwa idadi ya masaa aliyofanya kazi ikilinganishwa na masaa ya kawaida ya wiki ya kazi. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Does a part-time worker have the right to the minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: Yes, on a pro-rata basis. A part-time worker is entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage calculated according to the hours worked compared to the normal working week. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kuomba vibali vingi vya kazi kwa wakati mmoja?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni inaweza kuwasilisha maombi mengi ya vibali vya kazi kwa wakati mmoja kwa wafanyakazi tofauti wa kigeni. Hata hivyo, kila ombi linashughulikia mfanyakazi mmoja mmoja na linahitaji nyaraka kamili. Idadi ya vibali vya jumla iko chini ya kikwazo cha uwiano wa wafanyakazi wa kampuni.
question_en: Can a company apply for multiple work permits simultaneously?
answer_en: Yes. A company can submit multiple work permit applications at the same time for different foreign workers. However, each application covers one individual worker and requires complete documentation. The total number of permits is subject to the company's employee ratio quota.

instruction: VAT withholding agent ni nani hasa? Biashara yangu inaandaa kupeleka zabuni serikalini.
output: Mnunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying withholding agent) ni mtu au taasisi iliyoteuliwa na TRA kukata sehemu ya VAT ya msambazaji wakati wa malipo. Wanunuzi wanaohitimu mara nyingi ni wizara za serikali, taasisi za umma, na watu wengine walioidhinishwa rasmi na Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Ili kujua kama biashara yako inaweza kuwa withholding agent, wasiliana na TRA moja kwa moja (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Kiwango cha VAT Zanzibar ni sawa na Tanzania Bara — asilimia 18?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa masuala ya Zanzibar. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia Tanzania Bara peke yake. Zanzibar ina mfumo wake wa kodi kupitia ZRB (Zanzibar Revenue Board) — viwango vya VAT Zanzibar vinaweza kutofautiana na Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na ZRB kupitia zrb.go.tz kwa habari sahihi. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz kwa masuala ya Tanzania Bara.

instruction: Certificate ya VAT withholding inatakiwa itolewe tarehe gani hasa?
output: Certificate ya VAT withholding lazima itolewe si baadaye ya tarehe VAT inakuwa payable — kawaida tarehe ya kukamilika kwa muamala (supply date). Hii si tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Tarehe 20 ni deadline ya kuwasilisha VAT return na kupeleka VAT iliyokatwa TRA. Hizi ni wajibu mbili tofauti zenye tarehe tofauti.

instruction: EFD inafungwa lini? Lazima nifunge kila usiku?
output: EFD haijalazimika kufungwa kila usiku — inafanya kazi daima inapohitajika. Hata hivyo, kuna wajibu wa Z-Report: Z-Report lazima ipigwe mwishoni mwa kila siku ya biashara — inafanya muhtasari wa mauzo yote ya siku na kutuma data TRA. Z-Report inapaswa kupigwa KABLA ya kufunga biashara usiku — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Kushindwa kupiga Z-Report ni kosa la kodi. TRA inaweza kukagua rekodi za Z-Reports kuthibitisha wako updated. EFD yenyewe inaweza kubaki imewashwa usiku — inazima yenyewe ikiwa inahitajika. Thibitisha na TRA.

instruction: Je, mchango wa NSSF unaweza kukatwa kutoka pensheni au malipo mengine ya mwisho wa ajira?
output: Hapana — mchango wa NSSF hautolipiwa pensheni au malipo ya mwisho (end of service benefits). Mchango wa NSSF unakokotolewa kutoka mshahara wa kawaida (gross wages) tu. Malipo ya mwisho wa ajira kama vile gratuity, severance pay, au malipo ya likizo yanajumuishwa au hayajumuishwi kulingana na sheria ya kazi na mkataba — thibitisha hali maalum na mshauri wa HR au Ofisi ya Kazi.

instruction: Mikataba ya ushauri (consultancy agreements) inahitaji stamp duty Tanzania?
output: Baadhi ya mikataba ya huduma (service agreements) inaweza kuwa na wajibu wa stamp duty chini ya Stamp Duty Act Tanzania kulingana na maudhui na thamani ya mkataba. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa aina maalum za mikataba inayohusika na kiwango cha stamp duty kinachofaa. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Gharama ya usajili wa OSHA kila mwaka ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Gharama ya usajili wa OSHA inategemea sekta na saizi ya mahali pa kazi. Angalia jedwali la ada la OSHA kwa kiwango sahihi cha sekta yako — ada mbalimbali zinatumika kwa viwanda, ofisi, maduka na mahali pa kazi mengine.
question_en: How much does the annual OSHA registration fee cost?
answer_en: The OSHA registration fee depends on your sector and workplace size. Check the OSHA fee schedule for your sector's exact rate — different rates apply to factories, offices, shops, and other workplace types.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Niliweza kupata unafuu wa adhabu kutoka TRA — taratibu ni zipi?
answer_sw: TRA inaweza kutoa unafuu wa adhabu (penalty remission) kwa sababu maalum kama: janga la asili, ugonjwa mbaya, au hali ya nguvu za mazingira (force majeure). Omba unafuu kwa maandishi kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ukieleza sababu. TRA itaangalia ombi na kutoa uamuzi. Hii si ya kawaida na inategemea hali halisi.
question_en: I may be able to get penalty relief from TRA — what is the procedure?
answer_en: TRA can grant penalty remission for specific reasons such as: natural disaster, serious illness, or force majeure. Apply for remission in writing to the TRA Commissioner General explaining the reasons. TRA will review the application and issue a decision. This is uncommon and depends on the actual circumstances.

instruction: Ninalipa mshauri wa kisheria (lawyer) kwa huduma za ushauri wa biashara — VAT withholding ni ngapi?
output: Huduma za ushauri wa kisheria (legal consultancy) ni HUDUMA — kwa hivyo VAT withholding ni 6%. Hii ni sawa kwa huduma zote za kitaaluma: wakili, mhasibu, mhandisi, mshauri wa biashara, daktari anayetoa huduma za kliniki, na kadhalika. Finance Act 2025 ilipanga: bidhaa → 3%; huduma → 6%, kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Mnunuzi anayehitimu anakata 6% ya VAT ya bill na kutuma TRA. Muuzaji (wakili) anapokea bei pungufu ya 6% lakini anaweza kudai input VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Biashara yangu ilikosea kwa kutotoa risiti za EFD kwa siku chache -- ninafanya nini?
output: Wasiliana na TRA mara moja na waambie hali halisi. Kuungama kwa hiari (voluntary disclosure) kunaweza kupunguza adhabu. Lipa VAT yoyote iliyokosekana pamoja na riba. Hakikisha EFD machine yako inafanya kazi vizuri na uzinduke vizuri kutoa risiti kwa kila muamala. Thibitisha utaratibu wa kuungama hiari na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi.

question_sw: PAYE na kodi ya mapato ya makampuni (corporate tax) — ni kodi moja au tofauti?
answer_sw: Ni kodi MBILI TOFAUTI. PAYE (Pay As You Earn): kodi ya mapato ya MFANYAKAZI inayokatwa na mwajiri. Corporate tax (kodi ya mapato ya makampuni): kodi inayolipwa na KAMPUNI juu ya faida yake. Mfanyakazi analipa PAYE; kampuni inalipa corporate tax. Kampuni pia inalazimika kukusanya na kuwasilisha PAYE kwa niaba ya wafanyakazi wake.
question_en: PAYE and corporate income tax — are they the same tax or different?
answer_en: They are TWO DIFFERENT taxes. PAYE (Pay As You Earn): income tax on EMPLOYEE earnings deducted by the employer. Corporate tax: tax paid by the COMPANY on its profits. The employee pays PAYE; the company pays corporate tax. The company is also required to collect and remit PAYE on behalf of its employees.

question_sw: Jirani yangu Mtanzania alikopa leseni yake kwa mfanyabiashara wa Kichina ili aendeshe duka. Wote wawili wamekamatwa. Kila mmoja analipa nini?
answer_sw: Adhabu ni tofauti kwa kila mmoja. Mfanyabiashara wa Kichina (mgeni): faini ya ANGALAU TZS 10,000,000 PAMOJA NA kifungo hadi miezi 6 NA kufutwa kwa visa yake. Jirani Mtanzania (msaidizi): faini ya hadi TZS 5,000,000 AU kifungo hadi miezi 3 — bila kufutwa kwa visa. Kila mmoja anapata adhabu yake mwenyewe — hazigawanyiki wala hazishirikiwi.
question_en: My Tanzanian neighbour lent their licence to a Chinese businessman to run a shop. Both were arrested. What does each one pay?
answer_en: The penalties are different for each. Chinese businessman (non-citizen): fine of AT LEAST TZS 10,000,000 PLUS imprisonment up to 6 months AND visa revocation. Tanzanian neighbour (facilitator): fine of up to TZS 5,000,000 OR imprisonment up to 3 months — no visa revocation. Each receives their own separate penalty — they are not shared or split.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Je, ada za biashara za WhatsApp Business zina kodi Tanzania?
answer_sw: WhatsApp Business (toleo la bure) halitozi ada — kwa hivyo hakuna swali la kodi la moja kwa moja. WhatsApp Business API (inayotumiwa na makampuni makubwa) inaweza kuwa na ada kutoka Meta — hizi zinastahili kuzingatiwa kama huduma za kidijitali za nje ya nchi. Sina uhakika wa hali halisi ya kodi ya WhatsApp Business API Tanzania. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Are there taxes in Tanzania on WhatsApp Business fees?
answer_en: WhatsApp Business (free version) has no fees — so there is no direct tax question. WhatsApp Business API (used by large companies) may have fees from Meta — these could be considered foreign digital services and subject to withholding tax considerations. I am not certain of the exact tax status of WhatsApp Business API in Tanzania. Verify with a tax advisor.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anahamia kazi nyingine — NSSF yake inabaki au inaanza upya?
answer_sw: Namba ya NSSF inabaki — ni ya maisha yote na haibadilikwi kubadilisha mwajiri. Mfanyakazi anaendelea kutumia namba ile ile ya NSSF katika ajira zake zote. Michango yote iliyolipwa na waajiri wote inakusanywa kwenye akaunti moja hiyo. Mwajiri mpya anaomba namba ya NSSF ya mfanyakazi na kuendelea kuchangia chini ya namba hiyo. Hakuna 'mwanzo upya' — akaunti inaendelea kukua.
question_en: An employee changes jobs — does their NSSF stay or restart?
answer_en: The NSSF number stays — it is lifelong and does not change when changing employers. The employee continues using the same NSSF number in all their employment. All contributions paid by all employers accumulate in that one account. The new employer asks for the employee's NSSF number and continues contributing under that number. There is no 'fresh start' — the account continues to grow.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wangu wanafanya kazi usiku — OSHA ina mahitaji maalum?
output: Ndiyo. Kazi ya usiku ina mahitaji ya ziada ya usalama — taa ya kutosha, usalama wa mahali pake, na kuhakikisha wafanyakazi wana njia salama za kutoka. OSHA inazingatia mazingira ya kazi usiku wakati wa ukaguzi. Fanya tathmini ya hatari maalum kwa kazi ya usiku na weka hatua za usalama zinazofaa. Thibitisha mahitaji kamili na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta 12 na sekta ndogo 30 — je, namba hizi ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Namba sahihi ni sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46 — si 12 na 30. Agizo la GN 605A linashughulikia sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46 zinazojumuisha aina mbalimbali za ajira Tanzania. Namba zozote tofauti na hizi ni kosa.
question_en: GN 605A covers 12 sectors and 30 sub-sectors — are these numbers correct?
answer_en: No. The correct figures are 16 sectors and 46 sub-sectors — not 12 and 30. GN 605A covers 16 sectors and 46 sub-sectors spanning the range of employment in Tanzania. Any different numbers are wrong.

question_sw: GN 605A ni nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 605A ni Amri ya Mishahara ya Sekta ya Faragha (Wage Order) iliyotolewa chini ya ELRA. Inaweka kiwango cha chini cha mishahara (minimum wage) kwa sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46 nchini Tanzania Bara. Ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: What is GN 605A in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 605A is the Private Sector Wage Order issued under ELRA. It sets the minimum wage for 16 sectors and 46 sub-sectors in Tanzania Mainland. It came into effect on 1 January 2026. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi analipa sehemu ya mchango wa WCF — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mchango wa WCF unalipwa na MWAJIRI PEKE YAKE — hakuna sehemu inayokatwa kutoka kwa mfanyakazi. Hii ni tofauti na NSSF ambapo mwajiri na mfanyakazi kila mmoja wanachangia asilimia 10. Kwa WCF, mwajiri anabeba gharama yote ya asilimia 0.5.
question_en: The employee pays part of the WCF contribution — is this true?
answer_en: No. The WCF contribution is paid by the EMPLOYER ONLY — nothing is deducted from the employee. This differs from NSSF where both employer and employee each contribute 10%. For WCF the employer bears the full 0.5% cost.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Usajili wa alama ya biashara (trademark) nchini Tanzania hufanywa na taasisi gani?
output: Usajili wa alama za biashara (trademarks) Tanzania unafanywa na BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) -- si COSOTA wala taasisi nyingine yoyote. BRELA pia inasimamia hataza (patents) na miundo ya viwanda (industrial designs). ORT (Ofisi ya Usajilishaji wa Hati) haipo kama taasisi ya milki ya kiakili Tanzania. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

answer_sw: Kodi ya gawio (dividend withholding tax) kwa hisa za DSE na uwekezaji wa DSE kwa ujumla ni eneo linaloenda zaidi ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. answer_en: Dividend withholding tax on DSE shares and DSE investment generally is beyond my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. I know Tanzania has a withholding tax on dividends but the applicable rate for your situation (Tanzanian citizen, non-citizen, individual, company) varies. Contact DSE brokers, TRA, or a qualified investment accountant.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment on dividend WHT rates

instruction: VAT return inawasilishwa lini — ni tarehe 20 ya kila mwezi?
output: Ndiyo — VAT return lazima iwasilishwe na VAT inayolipwa TRA kabla ya au tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfano: VAT ya Januari (mapato ya Januari) → iwasilishwe kabla ya 20 Februari. Kumbuka tofauti: tarehe 20 = tarehe ya VAT RETURN na MALIPO ya VAT. Tarehe nyingine zinazohusiana na VAT: withholding certificate inatoka siku ya muamala (si tarehe 20); qualifying buyer anatuma withholding ndani ya VAT withholding inalipwa TRA tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata — siku ile ile ya VAT return ya kawaida. Si siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz.. Kama tarehe 20 ni Jumapili au sikukuu — unaweza kuwasilisha siku ya kazi inayofuata. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Biashara yangu ina mauzo ya taxable NA ya exempt pamoja. Ninaweza kudai input VAT yote?
answer_sw: Unaweza kudai input VAT ya SEHEMU YA TAXABLE tu. Kwa biashara zenye mchanganyiko wa taxable na exempt, TRA inatumia kanuni ya 'partial attribution' — unagawanya input VAT kulingana na uwiano wa mauzo ya taxable kwa mauzo yote. Mfano: kama 70% ya mauzo ni taxable na 30% exempt, unaweza kudai 70% ya input VAT yako tu. Sehemu ya 30% inayohusiana na mauzo ya exempt hairejeshwi.
question_en: My business has both taxable AND exempt sales. Can I claim all input VAT?
answer_en: You can claim input VAT for the TAXABLE PORTION only. For businesses with a mix of taxable and exempt supplies, TRA applies a 'partial attribution' rule — you apportion input VAT based on the ratio of taxable sales to total sales. Example: if 70% of sales are taxable and 30% exempt, you may claim 70% of your input VAT only. The 30% portion related to exempt supplies is not refunded.

question_sw: Mwajiriwa anayeishi mbali na hospitali ya karibu Tanzania — WCF italipia usafirishaji wake hospitalini?
answer_sw: WCF Tanzania inashughulikia gharama za matibabu za mfanyakazi aliyeumia mahali pa kazi — ikiwa ni pamoja na gharama za usafirishaji wa dharura kwa hospitali katika hali nyingi. Hata hivyo, kiasi na aina ya gharama zinazolipwa na WCF zinategemea Sheria ya Fidia ya Wafanyakazi na kanuni zake. Angalia WCF moja kwa moja kwa maelezo ya gharama zinazofunikwa kwa kesi yako mahususi.
question_en: A worker living far from the nearest hospital in Tanzania — will WCF pay for their transport to hospital?
answer_en: Tanzania's WCF handles medical expenses for a worker injured at the workplace — including emergency transport to hospital costs in many cases. However, the amounts and types of expenses covered by WCF depend on the Workers Compensation Act and its regulations. Check WCF directly for details of expenses covered for your specific case.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kutekeleza GN 605A ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: Mwajiri alipaswa kutekeleza GN 605A kuanzia malipo ya kwanza ya mishahara ya Januari 2026. Utekelezaji haukuwa na kipindi cha mpito — ufanisi ulianza moja kwa moja tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: When must an employer implement GN 605A?
answer_en: Employers were required to implement GN 605A from the first payroll of January 2026. There was no transition period — the order took effect immediately on 1 January 2026. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Ni nani anayeweza kuripoti mgeni anayefanya biashara haramu chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Mtu yeyote anaweza kuripoti — raia, mshindani wa biashara, au afisa yeyote wa serikali. Idara kuu za utekelezaji ni: Idara ya Uhamiaji, TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority), na polisi. Unaweza kuwasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji kupitia simu yao ya dharura au ofisi ya karibu nawe. Kumbuka: GN 487A yenyewe haitaji utaratibu wa kuripoti, usiri, au ulinzi wa mripoti — thibitisha utaratibu wa kuripoti na ulinzi wowote moja kwa moja na Idara ya Uhamiaji kabla ya kuripoti.
question_en: Who can report a non-citizen conducting an illegal business under GN 487A?
answer_en: Anyone can report — a citizen, a business competitor, or any government official. The main enforcement departments are: the Immigration Department, TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority), and the police. You can contact the Immigration Department through their emergency line or nearest office. Anyone can report — a citizen, business competitor, or government official. The main enforcement departments are: Immigration Department, TRA, and the police. Contact the nearest Immigration Department office. Note: GN 487A itself does not specify reporting procedures, confidentiality provisions, or whistleblower protections — verify reporting procedures and any protections directly with the Immigration Department before reporting.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Je, VAT ya chakula Tanzania ni asilimia 5?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania haina kiwango cha VAT kilichopunguzwa cha asilimia 5 wala asilimia 10. Kiwango kimoja tu cha VAT kinacho Tanzania Bara ni asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida. Bidhaa za chakula fulani zinaweza kuwa zero-rated (asilimia 0) au zimesamehewa kabisa (exempt), lakini hakuna kiwango cha kati cha asilimia 5. Thibisha hali ya kila bidhaa na TRA.
question_en: Is food VAT in Tanzania 5%?
answer_en: No. Tanzania does not have a reduced VAT rate of 5% or 10%. There is only one VAT rate on Mainland Tanzania: 18% standard rate. Some food items may be zero-rated (0%) or fully exempt, but there is no intermediate 5% rate. Confirm the status of each product with TRA.

question_sw: EFD yangu imepoteza data za wiki mbili. Je, ninaweza kuziingiza tena?
answer_sw: Upotevu wa data ya EFD ni tatizo zito. Hatua: (1) Taarifa TRA na muuzaji wa EFD haraka; (2) Angalia kama seva ya TRA (TRA server-side) ina nakala ya data — EFD za kisasa zinapeleka data mara moja na TRA inaweza kuwa na nakala; (3) Tumia rekodi za akaunti zako (bank statements, manual receipts) kurejesha taarifa; (4) Fanya marekebisho ya VAT return ikiwa inahitajika. Kutowasilisha data sahihi inaweza kusababisha tathmini ya VAT ya malimbikizo.
question_en: My EFD lost two weeks of data. Can I re-enter it?
answer_en: Data loss from EFD is a serious matter. Steps: (1) Notify TRA and the EFD supplier immediately; (2) Check if TRA's server has a copy — modern EFDs transmit data in real time and TRA may have a backup; (3) Use your accounting records (bank statements, manual receipts) to reconstruct data; (4) Make corrections to your VAT return if needed. Failing to submit accurate data may result in backdated VAT assessments.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni aliyekuwa Tanzania na sasa amerudi nyumbani — TRA inaweza kumpigia kodi baadaye?
answer_sw: Kama PAYE ilipwa vizuri wakati wa kufanya kazi Tanzania, hawezi kupigiwa kodi tena kwa mapato yale. Hata hivyo, kama kuna PAYE iliyokosekana au ukiukaji wa kodi, TRA inaweza kutaka kulipa hata baada ya kuondoka. Hii inaweza kuathiri visa ya kurudi Tanzania au mali zinazobaki Tanzania. Thibitisha usafi wa kodi kabla ya kuondoka.
question_en: A foreign employee who was in Tanzania and has now returned home — can TRA still tax them later?
answer_en: If PAYE was correctly paid during the period of work in Tanzania, they cannot be taxed again on that income. However, if there is unpaid PAYE or a tax violation, TRA may seek payment even after departure. This may affect future Tanzania visas or assets remaining in Tanzania. Verify clean tax status before departing.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mtu alisema umeme unalipwa VAT ya asilimia 10 Tanzania. Je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli. Tanzania haina kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 10. Kiwango cha VAT Tanzania Bara ni asilimia 18 peke yake — kiwango cha kawaida. Huduma za umeme zinaweza kuwa zero-rated au exempt kulingana na hali, lakini asilimia 10 haipo kabisa katika mfumo wa VAT wa Tanzania.
question_en: Someone said electricity in Tanzania is charged VAT at 10%. Is this true?
answer_en: Not true. Tanzania does not have a 10% VAT rate. The VAT rate on Mainland Tanzania is 18% only — the standard rate. Electricity services may be zero-rated or exempt depending on the circumstances, but 10% simply does not exist in Tanzania's VAT system.

question_sw: Biashara ya dawa ya duka — mgeni anaweza kumiliki?
answer_sw: Biashara ya uuzaji wa dawa kwa rejareja imeorodheshwa kati ya shughuli 15 zilizokatazwa na GN 487A. Raia wa kigeni hawezi kumiliki au kuendesha duka la dawa. Mbali na GN 487A, uuzaji wa dawa pia unasimamia na TMDA (Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority) — masharti ya ziada ya kibali yanaweza kutumika.
question_en: A pharmaceutical retail shop — can a non-citizen own it?
answer_en: Retail sale of medicines is listed among the 15 prohibited activities under GN 487A. A non-citizen cannot own or operate a pharmacy or medicine shop. In addition to GN 487A, medicine sales are also regulated by TMDA (Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority) — additional licensing requirements may apply.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Biashara ya kuuza programu za simu (mobile apps) Tanzania — VAT inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uuzaji wa programu za simu kwa wateja Tanzania unashughulikiwa kama huduma ya kidijitali na unabeba VAT inayofaa. Kama kampuni imesajiliwa VAT, lazima itoe risiti za EFD na ikusanye VAT. Kwa watoa kutoka nje ya nchi, masharti yanaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: A business selling mobile apps in Tanzania — does VAT apply?
answer_en: Yes. Selling mobile apps to Tanzanian customers is treated as a digital service and carries applicable VAT. If the company is VAT-registered, it must issue EFD receipts and collect VAT. For foreign-based providers, requirements may differ — verify with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

instruction: Biashara yangu ina mapato ya TZS 190M kwa mwaka. Mwaka ujao ninategemea TZS 210M — nisajili VAT lini?
output: Usajili wa VAT unategemea mapato HALISI yaliyofikiwa, si matarajio ya baadaye. Kwa mwaka wa sasa (TZS 190M): chini ya kizingiti cha TZS 200M — bado hujafika, si lazima sasa. Hata hivyo, angalia kizingiti cha miezi 6 (rolling): kama mapato yako yoyote ya miezi 6 mfululizo yanazidi TZS 100M — lazima usajili. TZS 190M ÷ 12 × 6 = TZS 95M kwa wastani — karibu sana na kizingiti. Mwaka ujao ukifika TZS 200M — lazima usajili ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kufika kizingiti. Usajili wa mapema (voluntary) unaweza kufanywa wakati wowote kama unataka faida za VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Biashara inafikia kizingiti cha VAT lakini haitaki kusajili — faini ni nini?
output: Kushindwa kusajili VAT ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kufika kizingiti kunasababisha: (1) Kulazimishwa kusajili na TRA wakati wowote utakapogundulika; (2) Malipo ya VAT yote iliyopaswa kukusanywa tangu kufika kizingiti — hata kama haukuikusanya kutoka wateja; (3) Adhabu ya kukataa kusajili VAT: faini ya hadi TZS 200,000 na/au kifungo cha miezi 2 hadi 12, pamoja na riba — hakuna asilimia ya kila mwezi katika Sheria ya VAT (Cap 148); (4) Ukaguzi wa nyuma wa miaka ya biashara. Tatizo kubwa: unapaswa kulipa VAT hata kama wateja hawakukulipa VAT — pesa inatoka kwako. Kusajili haraka ukifika kizingiti ni muhimu sana. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz.

instruction: Je, OSHA inashughulikia usalama wa wateja wa biashara au wafanyakazi peke yake?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inalenga hasa USALAMA WA WAFANYAKAZI katika mazingira ya kazi — si usalama wa wateja wa biashara moja kwa moja. Hata hivyo: (1) Kama mazingira hatarishi ya kazi pia yanaathiri wateja (kama duka lenye nguzo zinazoweza kuanguka), OSHA inaweza kushughulikia; (2) Usalama wa wateja kwa bidhaa na huduma unashughulikiwa na TBS (Tanzania Bureau of Standards) na TMDA (kwa dawa na vifaa vya afya); (3) Ajali za wateja katika eneo la biashara zinaweza kuhusisha wajibu wa kiraia (civil liability) wa mwajiri. Kwa usalama kamili: OSHA (wafanyakazi), TBS/TMDA (bidhaa), na bima ya biashara (wateja). Thibitisha na osha.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, ikiwa wafanyakazi wa TRA wananikatalia bila sababu — ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Kama unaamini madai yako ya VAT refund yamekataliwa bila sababu ya kisheria, una haki za kisheria. Pata maelezo ya maandishi ya sababu ya kukataliwa. Thibitisha na sheria ya VAT Tanzania. Piga rufaa kwa Kamishna wa TRA. Kama bado hujaridhika, fika TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) au mahakama. Weka kumbukumbu za mawasiliano yote.
question_en: If TRA staff are rejecting my claim without reason — what do I do?
answer_en: If you believe your VAT refund claim was rejected without legal basis, you have legal rights. Get the rejection reason in writing. Verify against Tanzania VAT law. Appeal to the TRA Commissioner. If still unsatisfied, go to TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) or courts. Keep records of all communications.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: TRA hugundua vipi biashara ambazo hazitoi risiti za EFD?
output: TRA hutumia mbinu nyingi za kugundua: (1) ukaguzi wa ghafla wa maeneo ya biashara, (2) malalamiko ya wateja kupitia simu na tovuti ya TRA, (3) uchambuzi wa data ya EFD dhidi ya rekodi za benki na mobile money, (4) tofauti kati ya mauzo yaliyoripotiwa na miamala halisi. Mbinu moja tu inatosha kufungua ukaguzi kamili. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: OSHA na WCF zote mbili zinahusu usalama wa wafanyakazi — kwa nini biashara inahitaji zote mbili?
output: OSHA na WCF zinahusu usalama wa wafanyakazi lakini kwa njia tofauti: OSHA (regulator): inazuia ajali KABLA hazijatokea — kupitia kanuni za usalama, ukaguzi, na mafunzo. OSHA haihusishi pesa za bima — ni udhibiti wa tabia. WCF (insurance fund): inasaidia BAADA ya ajali kutokea — inalipa fidia kwa mfanyakazi aliyejeruhiwa au familia yake. WCF ni bima ya lazima. Mfano: mfanyakazi anaanguka kwa sababu biashara haikuwa na reli za usalama (ukiukwaji wa OSHA) na anapata maumivu (WCF inalipa fidia). Unahitaji zote mbili: OSHA kuzuia, WCF kulipa kama kutokukuwa kuzuia. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz na wcf.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inaweza kuanza kufanya biashara kabla ya kupata Cheti cha Uanzishwaji — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kampuni haiwezi kufanya biashara kisheria kabla ya kupata Cheti cha Uanzishwaji (Certificate of Incorporation) kutoka BRELA. Mikataba iliyoingiwa kabla ya uanzishwaji inaweza kuwa batili au kuwabeba wakurugenzi kibinafsi. Subiri cheti kabla ya kuanza shughuli yoyote ya biashara.
question_en: Can a new company start trading before receiving its Certificate of Incorporation — is this true?
answer_en: No. A company cannot legally trade before receiving its Certificate of Incorporation from BRELA. Contracts entered before incorporation may be void or hold directors personally liable. Wait for the certificate before commencing any business activity.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Kodi ya ongezeko la thamani (VAT) kwa dawa ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Dawa nyingi za binadamu Tanzania zimewekwa kwenye orodha ya zero-rated — yaani VAT ni asilimia 0. Hata hivyo, kuna bidhaa za dawa ambazo zinalipwa VAT ya asilimia 18 (kiwango cha kawaida). Kiwango cha asilimia 5 au asilimia 10 haipo kabisa kwenye mfumo wa VAT Tanzania. Angalia orodha rasmi ya TRA kujua bidhaa gani za dawa ni zero-rated na zipi zinatozwa asilimia 18.
question_en: What is the VAT rate on medicines in Tanzania?
answer_en: Most human medicines in Tanzania are zero-rated — meaning the VAT rate is 0%. However, some pharmaceutical products are subject to the standard 18% VAT. A rate of 5% or 10% does not exist at all in Tanzania's VAT system. Check the official TRA list to determine which medicines are zero-rated and which attract 18%.

instruction: PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 520,000 kwa mwezi ni ngapi?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 520,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 20,000/mwezi
TZS 520,000 ni mwisho wa Bendi 2 — PAYE ya juu kabisa ya Bendi 2 bila kuingia Bendi 3.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ilitoa ardhi kama mchango kwa kampuni nyingine (contribution in kind) — capital gains tax inatumika?
output: Mchango wa mali kama ardhi kwa kampuni nyingine (contribution in kind) unaweza kuzua wajibu wa capital gains tax chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania — inategemea thamani ya mali na jinsi mchango ulivyoandikwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa hesabu ya kodi, wakati wa kulipa, na utaratibu wa TRA kwa hali hii maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Biashara ya ofisi (office work) inahitaji kusajiliwa na OSHA pia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA inatumika kwa mahali pote pa kazi Tanzania, ikiwa ni pamoja na ofisi, si viwanda tu. Ikiwa ofisi yako ina wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, lazima isajiliwe. Ofisi pia zinahitaji hewa safi, taa ya kutosha, na hali nzuri ya kufanya kazi.
question_en: Does an office business also need to register with OSHA?
answer_en: Yes. OSHA applies to all workplaces in Tanzania, including offices — not just factories. If your office has 10 or more employees it must register. Offices also require adequate ventilation, lighting, and good working conditions.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mpya anaanza kazi Aprili badala ya Januari. Mwajiri anahesabu PAYE yake vipi kwa mwaka huo?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anahesabu PAYE kuanzia mwezi wa kwanza wa ajira (Aprili). Hakuna marekebisho ya nyuma kwa miezi ya kabla ya ajira. Kwa mwaka huo, mfanyakazi anaweza kupata msamaha wa kibinafsi (personal relief) kwa miezi 9 tu (Aprili–Desemba) kupitia mwajiri. Ikiwa mfanyakazi alifanya kazi pengine kabla ya Aprili na anapaswa kulipa kodi ya ziada, atajaza return ya mtu binafsi mwishoni mwa mwaka.
answer_en: The employer calculates PAYE from the first month of employment (April). There is no retrospective adjustment for months before employment. For that year, the employee receives personal relief for only 9 months (April–December) through the employer. If the employee worked elsewhere before April and owes additional tax, they will file an individual income tax return at year end.
question_en: A new employee starts work in April instead of January. How does the employer calculate PAYE for that year?

question_sw: Malipo ya pango kwa mwenye nyumba asiye wakazi Tanzania yatatozwa WHT ya asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Malipo ya pango kwa mwenye nyumba asiye wakazi (non-resident landlord) yatatozwa WHT ya asilimia 20. Kwa mwenye nyumba mkazi, kiwango ni asilimia 10. Mpangaji (tenant) analazimika kukata WHT kabla ya kulipa pango na kulipa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: Rent paid to a non-resident landlord in Tanzania attracts WHT at what rate?
answer_en: Rent paid to a non-resident landlord attracts 20% WHT. For a resident landlord the rate is 10%. The tenant must deduct WHT before paying rent and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month.

instruction: Ningependa kujua — nini tofauti kati ya kampuni iliyofutwa (deregistered) na iliyolala (dormant) BRELA?
output: Tofauti muhimu: Kampuni iliyolala (dormant): bado ipo kwenye orodha ya BRELA, lazima bado iwasilishe annual returns (na kodi kwa TRA), lakini haifanyi shughuli za biashara. Kampuni iliyofutwa (deregistered): imefutwa kabisa kwenye orodha — haina uwezo wowote wa kisheria. Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Kampuni iliyolala lakini haijafanya annual return bado inakusanya faini ya kuchelewa.

question_sw: Gharama ya jumla ya kufuata sheria za biashara kwa miaka ya kwanza kwa biashara ndogo ya Tanzania ni kiasi gani kwa kawaida?
answer_sw: Makadirio ya gharama za kufuata sheria (compliance costs) kwa biashara ndogo mpya ya Tanzania (wafanyakazi 5-10, mauzo chini ya TZS 200M): BRELA usajili TZS 95,000-200,000 (mara moja), TIN bure, LGA leseni TZS 50,000-300,000 kwa mwaka, NSSF usajili bure (michango 20% ya mishahara), OSHA TZS 50,000-150,000 kwa mwaka, WCF 0.5% ya mishahara kwa mwaka, EFD machine TZS 250,000-500,000 ikiwa inasajili VAT. Jumla ya mara moja: ~TZS 200,000-700,000. Kila mwaka: kulingana na mishahara.
question_en: What is the typical total compliance cost in the first years for a small Tanzania business?
answer_en: Estimated compliance costs for a new small Tanzania business (5-10 employees, turnover below TZS 200M): BRELA registration TZS 95,000-200,000 (one-time), TIN free, LGA licence TZS 50,000-300,000 per year, NSSF registration free (contributions 20% of payroll), OSHA TZS 50,000-150,000 per year, WCF 0.5% of payroll per year, EFD machine TZS 250,000-500,000 if registering for VAT. One-time costs: ~TZS 200,000-700,000. Annual: depends on payroll.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Registration fee or compliance cost update

instruction: NSSF analipwa nani — mwajiri au mfanyakazi?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Wote wawili wanachangia: mwajiri 10% NA mfanyakazi 10%. Jinsi inavyofanya kazi: mwajiri anakata 10% kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi, anaongeza 10% yake mwenyewe, na analipa jumla ya 20% kwa NSSF kila mwezi. Tofauti na SDL (mwajiri peke yake 3.5%) — NSSF ni ya upande wote wawili.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi kabla ya miaka 15 ya michango anapoteza NSSF yake yote Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi kabla ya miaka 15 (miezi 180) ya michango HAPOTEZI michango yake yote. Anaweza: (1) kuomba faida ya kujitolea/kujisogeza (withdrawal benefit) kwa michango aliyochangia, au (2) kuendelea kuwa mwanachama na kuchangia kwa mwajiri mwingine hadi afikia miezi 180. Manufaa atakayopata yanategemea michango halisi aliyochangia — si sifuri.
question_en: A worker who leaves employment before 15 years of contributions loses all their NSSF in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. A worker who leaves employment before 15 years (180 months) of contributions does NOT lose all their contributions. They can: (1) apply for a withdrawal benefit for contributions paid, or (2) remain a member and contribute with a new employer until reaching 180 months. The benefits they receive depend on actual contributions paid — not zero.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: WHT kwa malipo ya bima na malipo ya riba ni sawa — asilimia 5 kwa wote — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WHT kwa malipo ya bima ni asilimia 5, lakini WHT kwa riba (interest) ni asilimia 10 — si asilimia 5. Kiwango cha asilimia 5 kwa riba si sahihi. Kiwango cha asilimia 5 kinatumika tu kwa bima na ada za huduma za wakazi.
question_en: WHT on insurance payments and interest payments is the same — 5% for both — is this correct?
answer_en: No. WHT on insurance payments is 5%, but WHT on interest is 10% — not 5%. A 5% rate on interest is incorrect. The 5% rate applies only to insurance and resident service fees.

question_sw: Je, serikali na taasisi zake zinastahili VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Serikali na taasisi zake zinaweza kuwa wasajiliwa wa VAT kama zinafanya shughuli za kiuchumi. Pia zinaweza kuwa wakala wa zuio ya VAT. Thibitisha hali halisi ya shughuli za taasisi husika na TRA.
question_en: Are government entities and institutions subject to VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: Government entities and institutions may be VAT registrants if they carry on economic activities. They may also serve as VAT withholding agents. Confirm the specific situation for the institution concerned with TRA.

question_sw: EFD machine ikivunjika au kuharibika Tanzania — biashara inafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa EFD machine inavunjika: (1) ripoti kwa TRA haraka (kupitia mfumo wa TRA au msambazaji wako wa EFD), (2) usifanye mauzo bila EFD kwa muda wowote bila ruhusa ya TRA — hii ni kosa, (3) TRA inaweza kutoa ruhusa ya muda mfupi ya kuandika risiti za mkono wakati wa kusubiri ukarabati, (4) mashine iliyoharibika lazima irekebishwe na msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa, si mtu yeyote. Hifadhi rekodi za mauzo yaliyofanywa wakati EFD haikufanya kazi.
question_en: If an EFD machine breaks down in Tanzania — what does the business do?
answer_en: If an EFD machine breaks down: (1) report to TRA promptly (via TRA system or your EFD supplier), (2) do not make sales without the EFD for any period without TRA authorisation — this is an offence, (3) TRA may grant short-term permission to write manual receipts while awaiting repair, (4) the broken machine must be repaired by an authorised supplier, not just anyone. Keep records of sales made while the EFD was not functioning.

question_sw: Adhabu gani inatumika kwa biashara inayofanya kazi bila leseni ya serikali ya mtaa?
answer_sw: Kufanya biashara bila leseni ya LGA ni kosa la kisheria nchini Tanzania. Adhabu zinaweza kujumuisha: faini za pesa, kufungwa kwa biashara hadi leseni ipatikane, na hata mashtaka ya jinai dhidi ya mmiliki wa biashara. Mwanzo kawaida ni onyo na faini la awali, lakini ufuatiliaji unaweza kusababisha kufungwa kwa biashara. Halmashauri nyingi zina maafisa wa ukaguzi wanaosafiri mara kwa mara kuangalia leseni. Usijaribu kufanya biashara bila leseni — gharama ya leseni ni ndogo ukilinganisha na adhabu.
answer_en: Operating a business without an LGA licence is a criminal offence in Tanzania. Penalties may include: monetary fines, closure of the business until a licence is obtained, and even criminal prosecution of the business owner. The initial response is typically a warning and an initial fine, but continued non-compliance can lead to business closure. Many councils have inspection officers who patrol regularly to check licences. Do not attempt to operate without a licence — the licence cost is small compared to the penalties.
question_en: What penalty applies to a business operating without a local government licence?

question_sw: Biashara yangu inatoa huduma za exempt (zisizo na VAT). Je, naweza kudai mkopo wa VAT ya pembejeo?
answer_sw: HAPANA — hii ni kanuni ngumu bila ubaguzi. Ukitoa huduma au bidhaa za EXEMPT, huwezi kudai mkopo wa VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) inayohusiana na huduma hizo. Hii ndiyo tofauti kuu kati ya exempt na zero-rated: zero-rated = unalipishwa VAT 0% LAKINI unaweza kudai input VAT; exempt = haulipishwi VAT NA huwezi kudai input VAT. Kwa biashara za exempt, gharama za VAT za pembejeo ni gharama za biashara — hazirudi.
question_en: My business provides exempt (non-VAT) services. Can I claim input VAT credits?
answer_en: NO — this is a hard rule with no exceptions. If you supply EXEMPT services or goods, you cannot claim input VAT credits related to those exempt supplies. This is the key difference between exempt and zero-rated: zero-rated = you charge 0% VAT AND you can claim input VAT; exempt = you do not charge VAT AND you cannot claim input VAT. For exempt businesses, input VAT costs are business expenses — they do not come back.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing exempt supply rules

instruction: Mgeni anamaanisha nani hasa chini ya GN 487A?
output: Mgeni chini ya GN 487A ni mtu yeyote ambaye si raia wa Tanzania kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Uraia (Tanzania Citizenship Act Cap.357 R.E.2023). Cap.357 inatambua aina tatu za uraia: kwa kuzaliwa, kwa nasaba, na kwa kuasiliwa (naturalisation). Mtu asiyekidhi mojawapo ya aina hizi tatu ni mgeni kwa madhumuni ya GN 487A. Thibitisha hali yako na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. question_sw: Mfanyakazi yuko likizo ya uzazi (maternity leave). Je, NSSF inaendelea kulipwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wakati wa likizo ya uzazi inayolipwa (paid maternity leave), mwajiri anapaswa kuendelea kulipa NSSF kwa kiwango cha kawaida kwa mshahara unaolipwa. Kiwango ni mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Ikiwa mfanyakazi yuko likizo ya uzazi bila malipo, hali inategemea kama mshahara unalipwa au la — michango ya NSSF inafuata malipo ya mshahara halisi.
question_en: An employee is on maternity leave. Does NSSF continue to be paid?
answer_en: Yes. During paid maternity leave, the employer must continue paying NSSF at the standard rate on wages paid. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. If the employee is on unpaid maternity leave, the situation depends on whether wages are being paid — NSSF contributions follow actual wage payments.

instruction: Je, TRA inaweza kusimamisha leseni ya biashara kwa sababu ya EFD?
output: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka ya kusimamisha leseni ya biashara na hata kufunga biashara kwa ukiukwaji wa mfumo wa EFD. Hatua hii inaweza kufuatia baada ya onyo la maandishi na ukaguzi. Biashara iliyofungwa kwa sababu ya EFD inaweza kushindwa kufanyia kazi wateja mpaka suala litakapotatuliwa na TRA. Thibitisha mamlaka ya sasa ya TRA na tra.go.tz.

instruction: OSHA inatumika kwa biashara za aina gani -- zote au kwa sekta maalum tu?
output: OSHA inatumika kwa mahali pa kazi YOTE Tanzania -- bila kujali sekta (viwanda, ofisi, madukani, kilimo, ujenzi, huduma za afya, nk). Hakuna sekta iliyoachwa nje ya Sheria ya OHS Act. Hata hivyo, biashara za sekta zenye hatari kubwa (migodi, kemikali, ujenzi) zinaweza kuwa na mahitaji ya ziada. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: Nani analazimika kukata WHT — mlipaji au mpokeaji wa malipo?
answer_sw: MLIPAJI (mtu anayetoa malipo) ndiye analazimika kukata WHT na kuipeleka TRA. Kwa mfano, kampuni inayolipa ada za ushauri kwa mshauri italazimika kukata WHT kabla ya kumpa mshauri malipo yaliyobaki. Mpokeaji hakati WHT — mtoaji ndiye anayebeba wajibu huu.
question_en: Who is required to deduct WHT — the payer or the recipient of the payment?
answer_en: The PAYER (the person making the payment) must deduct WHT and remit it to TRA. For example, a company paying consulting fees to a consultant must deduct WHT before giving the consultant the net payment. The recipient does not deduct WHT — the payer bears this obligation.

question_sw: Je, mteja wangu ana haki ya kudai risiti ya EFD kutoka kwangu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kabisa. Kila mteja ana haki ya kudai risiti ya EFD (fiscal receipt) kutoka kwa biashara yoyote iliyosajiliwa VAT. Kwa upande wako kama mfanyabiashara, kutoa risiti ya EFD si hiari — ni wajibu wa kisheria. TRA hata inawahimiza wateja kuripoti biashara ambazo hazitoi risiti za EFD. Kama mteja alidai risiti na ulikataa, hii inaweza kusababisha ukaguzi wa TRA.
question_en: Does my customer have the right to demand an EFD receipt from me?
answer_en: Yes, absolutely. Every customer has the right to demand an EFD fiscal receipt from any VAT-registered business. As a business owner, issuing an EFD receipt is not optional — it is a legal obligation. TRA even encourages customers to report businesses that do not issue EFD receipts. If a customer requested a receipt and you refused, this can trigger a TRA inspection.

instruction: Nilikuwa nadhani GN 605A ilianza Septemba 2025 — hii ni sahihi?
output:
Hapana — GN 605A haikuanza Septemba 2025. Tarehe sahihi za GN 605A ni:

Ilitangazwa (gazetted): 13 Oktoba 2025
Ilianza kutumika (effective): 1 JANUARI 2026

Septemba 2025 ni tarehe ya jambo tofauti kabisa — ni tarehe ya mabadiliko ya VAT kwa malipo ya kidijitali B2C (16%) chini ya Finance Act 2025. Usichanganye tarehe hizi mbili tofauti. Kwa GN 605A ya mishahara ya chini: wafanyakazi wana haki ya viwango vipya kuanzia 1 Januari 2026 peke yake. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

question_sw: Kamati ya usalama (safety committee) inafanya nini hasa?
answer_sw: Kamati ya usalama inafanya: kukagua hali ya usalama mahali pa kazi, kupitia ajali na matukio, kupendekeza maboresho ya usalama, kuhakikisha wafanyakazi wana mafunzo ya usalama, na kuwasiliana na usimamizi kuhusu masuala ya usalama. Kamati inakutana angalau mara moja kwa mwezi.
question_en: What does a safety committee specifically do?
answer_en: A safety committee: inspects workplace safety conditions, reviews accidents and incidents, recommends safety improvements, ensures workers receive safety training, and communicates safety issues to management. The committee meets at least once a month.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Ikiwa mkataba unasema malipo 'ni ya WHT inclusive', mpokeaji anachukua nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa mkataba unasema malipo 'WHT inclusive' au 'gross-up', mwajiri atalazimika kulipa zaidi ili mpokeaji apate kiasi kilichokubalika BAADA ya WHT. Mwajiri atachangia WHT kutoka kwake badala ya kuikata kutoka kwa mpokeaji. Hii huongeza gharama halisi ya mwajiri. Mkataba unapaswa kuainisha wazi.
question_en: If a contract says payments are 'WHT inclusive', what does the recipient receive?
answer_en: If a contract says 'WHT inclusive' or provides for 'gross-up', the payer must pay more so that the recipient receives the agreed amount AFTER WHT. The payer absorbs the WHT cost instead of deducting from the recipient. This increases the payer's actual cost. The contract should clearly specify.

question_sw: Mwajiri mwenye matawi mengi atalipa NSSF ofisi ipi?
answer_sw: Michango ya waajiri wenye ofisi zaidi ya mkoa mmoja inalipwa kwenye Ofisi ya NSSF ambayo mchango ulipelekwa. Ofisi za kikanda zinahitajika kushirikiana ili kuhakikisha uzingatiaji wa mwajiri mwenye matawi tofauti. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Which NSSF office does a multi-branch employer pay contributions to?
answer_en: Contributions for employers with offices in more than one region are accounted for at the NSSF office where the contribution was remitted. Regional offices must cooperate to ensure compliance of employers with different branches. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Biashara inayohifadhi kemikali hatari inahitaji vibali maalum Tanzania — au OSHA peke yake inatosha?
answer_sw: Biashara inayohifadhi au kutumia kemikali hatari Tanzania inaweza kuhitaji: (1) usajili wa OSHA na kupata idhini ya mahali pa kazi (workplace approval), (2) vibali maalum vya kemikali hatari kutoka mamlaka nyingine (kama NEMC — National Environment Management Council) kulingana na aina ya kemikali, (3) vibali vya usafirishaji wa kemikali hatari. OSHA peke yake haijatoshi — uchunguze mahitaji yote ya kisheria ya kemikali yako maalum.
question_en: A business storing hazardous chemicals needs special permits in Tanzania — or is OSHA registration alone sufficient?
answer_en: A business storing or using hazardous chemicals in Tanzania may need: (1) OSHA registration and workplace approval, (2) specific hazardous chemical permits from other authorities (such as NEMC — National Environment Management Council) depending on the type of chemical, (3) permits for transporting hazardous chemicals. OSHA alone is not sufficient — investigate all legal requirements for your specific chemicals.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA or NEMC chemical regulation update

instruction: TRA ina mamlaka gani dhidi ya biashara inayokataa kutoa risiti za EFD?
output: TRA ina mamlaka ya: kutoza faini kwa kila risiti iliyokosekana, kusimamisha uwezo wa EFD machine, kuamuru ukaguzi kamili wa rekodi za biashara, na kufunga biashara kwa ukiukwaji unaoendelea. Kukosa kutoa risiti za EFD kwa muda mrefu kunachukuliwa kama ukwepaji wa kodi. Epuka hatari hii -- toa risiti za EFD kwa kila muamala. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: BRELA inaweza kufuta usajili wa kampuni baada ya miaka mingapi bila annual return?
answer_sw: BRELA inaweza kuanzisha mchakato wa kufuta kampuni kwenye rejesta kama haikuwasilisha annual return kwa miaka miwili au zaidi. Kabla ya kufuta, BRELA inatuma notisi za onyo. Ikiwa kampuni haijibu, inafutwa kwenye rejesta rasmi. Kampuni iliyofutwa inaweza kuomba kurejesha hali yake ndani ya kipindi fulani.
question_en: After how many years without an annual return can BRELA strike off a company?
answer_en: BRELA can initiate strike off proceedings if a company has not filed an annual return for two or more years. Before striking off, BRELA sends warning notices. If the company does not respond it is removed from the official register. A struck-off company can apply for restoration within a specified period.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Ninauza biashara yangu nzima ikiwemo mali zote, dhamana, na jina la biashara — capital gains tax yake ni ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Uamuzi wa capital gains tax kwa mauzo ya biashara nzima ni mgumu na unajumuisha tathmini ya kila kipande cha mali chini ya Income Tax Act — inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa kodi ya mapato. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni inayomilikiwa na Serikali (parastatal) inalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla ndiyo — taasisi zinazomilikiwa na Serikali (parastatals) kama TANESCO, TPA, na NMB zinazolipa mishahara ya wafanyakazi zinatakiwa kulipa SDL kama mwajiri mwingine yeyote, isipokuwa zitakazokuwa zimepata msamaha maalum kutoka TRA. Waajiri wote wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi wanalipa SDL ya 3.5% ya mishahara ya jumla. Hali ya kila parastatal inaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha na TRA kwa shirika lako maalum.
answer_en: Generally yes — government-owned institutions (parastatals) such as TANESCO, TPA, and NMB that pay employee salaries are required to pay SDL like any other employer, unless they have received a specific exemption from TRA. All employers with 10 or more employees pay SDL at 3.5% of gross payroll. Each parastatal's situation may vary — confirm with TRA for your specific organisation.
question_en: Does a government-owned company (parastatal) pay SDL?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA circular

question_sw: Je, malipo ya ugawaji (redundancy pay) kwa mfanyakazi mgeni yanabeba PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa ujumla. Malipo ya ugawaji (redundancy pay) yanachukuliwa kama mapato ya ajira na yanabeba PAYE Tanzania. Hata hivyo, sheria ya Tanzania inaweza kutoa matibabu maalum kwa malipo ya kutolipwa kazi (end-of-service lump sums). Thibitisha matibabu ya kodi ya malipo yako maalum na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Does redundancy pay for a foreign employee carry PAYE?
answer_en: Generally yes. Redundancy payments are treated as employment income and carry Tanzania PAYE. However, Tanzanian law may provide special treatment for end-of-service lump sum payments. Verify the tax treatment of your specific payments with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Ninataka kulinda nembo ya biashara yangu (logo) — ninapaswa kwenda wapi?
output: Ulinzi wa nembo (logo) unaweza kufanywa kwa njia mbili — inategemea aina ya ulinzi unaouhitaji: TRADEMARK (alama ya biashara) — BRELA: kama unataka kulinda nembo yako dhidi ya wengine kuitumia biashara, usajili wa trademark kwa BRELA ndiyo njia sahihi. Hii inakupa haki ya kipekee ya kutumia nembo hiyo kibiashara Tanzania. COPYRIGHT — COSOTA: kama nembo ni kazi ya kisanaa ya asili, inaweza kulindwa pia kwa copyright (bila usajili rasmi). Kwa biashara, trademark (BRELA) hutoa ulinzi bora na wa kisheria dhidi ya washindani. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

instruction: Thamani ya nyumba yangu kwa stamp duty — TRA wanaithamini vipi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mbinu za uthamini wa mali isiyohamika (property valuation) kwa madhumuni ya stamp duty Tanzania — value assessment procedures, appeal mechanisms, na taratibu za TRA — ni mada ya kisheria ya ardhi inayohitaji utaalamu maalum nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT ya biashara, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au mtathmini wa ardhi (valuer) aliyehitimu.

question_sw: Biashara yangu inafanya mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) tu — ninaweza kudai input VAT yote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kama biashara inafanya MAUZO YA ZERO-RATED TU (si mauzo ya exempt), unaweza kudai input VAT yote. Zero-rated si sawa na exempt — zero-rated inamaanisha kiwango cha 0% lakini bado ni 'taxable supply', hivyo input VAT inaweza kudaiwa. Exempt inamaanisha nje ya mfumo wa VAT kabisa, na input VAT isiyoweza kudaiwa.
question_en: My business makes only zero-rated (export) sales — can I claim all input VAT?
answer_en: Yes. If your business makes ONLY ZERO-RATED SALES (not exempt sales), you can claim all input VAT. Zero-rated is not the same as exempt — zero-rated means a 0% rate but is still a 'taxable supply', so input VAT can be claimed. Exempt means completely outside the VAT system, and input VAT cannot be claimed.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Leseni ya biashara ya LGA inahuishwa lini na ada yake inategemeana na nini?
answer_sw: Leseni ya biashara ya LGA lazima ihuishwe kila mwaka, kawaida ifikapo tarehe 31 Machi. Kuchelewa kuhuisha kunasababisha faini za ucheleweshaji. Ada ya leseni inategemea aina ya biashara, ukubwa wake (kulingana na mapato au eneo la jengo), na halmashauri husika. Ada zinaweza kutofautiana sana kati ya halmashauri moja na nyingine. Nenda ofisi ya halmashauri yako na hati za biashara kujua ada halisi ya mwaka huu na tarehe ya mwisho ya malipo.
answer_en: The LGA business licence must be renewed annually, usually by 31 March. Late renewal attracts delay penalties. The licence fee depends on the type of business, its size (based on income or floor space), and the relevant council. Fees can vary significantly between different councils. Go to your council office with business documents to find out the exact fee for this year and the payment deadline.
question_en: When is the LGA business licence renewed and what does the fee depend on?

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa bidhaa ni asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kwa usambazaji wa bidhaa na wakala wa zuio (qualifying buyer) ni asilimia 3, kulingana na Kifungu cha 5(5) cha Sheria ya VAT. Hii ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on goods in Tanzania?
answer_en: The VAT withholding obligation on supply of goods by the Withholding Agent under Section 5(5) of the VAT Act is 3%, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Tozo za TRL (Tanzania Railways Limited) kwa mzigo — ni ngapi?
answer_sw: Tozo za usafiri wa reli (TRL) zinaathiriwa na aina ya mzigo, uzito, na umbali. Sina uhakika wa tozo za sasa. Wasiliana na TRL moja kwa moja kwa orodha ya sasa ya bei.
question_en: TRL (Tanzania Railways Limited) freight charges — how much?
answer_en: Rail freight charges (TRL) vary by cargo type, weight, and distance. I am not certain of current rates. Contact TRL directly for the current price list.

question_sw: Mteja anakataa kupokea risiti ya EFD. Je, ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Hata kama mteja anakataa kupokea risiti, LAZIMA utoe risiti. Wajibu wa kutoa risiti ni wako (mwenye biashara) — si hiari ya mteja. Ikiwa mteja anakataa risiti: (1) Toa risiti na uiweke kwa akili yako; (2) Andika kwenye kumbukumbu ya biashara kwamba risiti ilikataliwa; (3) Huwezi kutoa kiasi kidogo bila risiti kwa sababu mteja amekataa. Kutotoa risiti — hata kama mteja amekataa — ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya EFD.
question_en: A customer refuses to take the EFD receipt. What do I do?
answer_en: Even if the customer refuses to take the receipt, you MUST still issue it. The obligation to issue a receipt is yours (as business owner) — not the customer's choice. If a customer refuses the receipt: (1) Issue it and retain it yourself; (2) Note in your business records that the receipt was declined; (3) You cannot process a sale without a receipt because the customer refused. Not issuing a receipt — even if the customer refused — is a violation of EFD law.

question_sw: EFD inahusiana na mfumo wa TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System) wa TRA vipi?
answer_sw: TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System) ni mfumo mkuu wa usimamizi wa kodi wa TRA unaounganisha taarifa nyingi za kodi. EFD inaunganishwa na TIMS kwa kupeleka data ya mauzo moja kwa moja. Hii inaruhusu TRA kulinganisha data ya EFD na: tamko la VAT lililowasilishwa, PAYE, na kodi nyingine, katika mfumo mmoja wa ufuatiliaji wa uzingatiaji. Makampuni yenye EFD yanaonekana zaidi kwenye mfumo wa TRA kuliko biashara zisizo na EFD.
question_en: How does an EFD relate to TRA's TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System)?
answer_en: TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System) is TRA's central tax management system that integrates multiple tax data sources. An EFD connects to TIMS by transmitting sales data directly. This allows TRA to cross-reference EFD data against: filed VAT returns, PAYE, and other taxes, within one compliance tracking system. Companies with EFDs are more visible in TRA's system than businesses without EFDs.
next_review_trigger: TRA TIMS or EFD integration update

question_sw: Je, SDL inahusiana na mfuko wa ustawi wa wafanyakazi (WCF)?
answer_sw: Hapana, ni kodi tofauti. SDL ni Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara, kwa wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. WCF ni Workers Compensation Fund — asilimia 0.5 ya mishahara, kwa waajiri wote wenye wafanyakazi. Zinalipwa vyote kwa mwajiri lakini kwenda taasisi tofauti na kwa madhumuni tofauti.
question_en: Is SDL related to the Workers Compensation Fund (WCF)?
answer_en: No, they are different levies. SDL is the Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — 3.5% of total payroll, for employers with 10 or more employees. WCF is the Workers Compensation Fund — 0.5% of payroll, for all employers with employees. Both are paid by the employer but go to different institutions for different purposes.

question_sw: PAYE hairuhusiwi kukatwa kwa wafanyakazi wanaopata mshahara wa chini chini ya Shilingi 500,000 — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. PAYE inakatwa MARA TU mapato yanayopita Shilingi 270,000 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 500,000. Mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa Shilingi 358,322 (kiwango cha wastani cha GN 605A) tayari ana PAYE inayodaiwa: (358,322 - 270,000) × 8% = Shilingi 7,066. Kiwango cha Shilingi 500,000 si sahihi.
question_en: PAYE cannot be deducted from employees earning below TZS 500,000 — is this true?
answer_en: No. PAYE becomes deductible AS SOON AS income exceeds TZS 270,000 per month — not TZS 500,000. An employee earning TZS 358,322 (the GN 605A average minimum) already has PAYE due: (358,322 - 270,000) × 8% = TZS 7,066. The threshold of TZS 500,000 is incorrect.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana posho za nyumba (housing allowance) na chakula (meal allowance). Je, hizi zinatozwa NSSF?
answer_sw: Posho zinazolipwa kawaida kama sehemu ya mshahara (housing allowance, meal allowance) kwa ujumla zinajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa NSSF — yaani mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Hii ni kwa sababu NSSF inategemea 'gross wage' si 'basic salary'. Posho zinazolipwa mara moja au zinazorejesha gharama halisi (reimbursements) zinaweza kushughulikiwa tofauti. Wasiliana na NSSF kwa mwongozo wa aina mahususi za posho.
question_en: An employee has housing and meal allowances. Are these subject to NSSF?
answer_en: Allowances regularly paid as part of compensation (housing allowance, meal allowance) are generally included in the NSSF gross wage base. This is because NSSF is based on 'gross wage' not 'basic salary'. One-off allowances or genuine reimbursements of actual expenses may be treated differently. Contact NSSF for guidance on specific types of allowances.

instruction: Je, partnership (ushirikiano) nchini Tanzania inaweza kusajiliwa rasmi?
output: Ndiyo. Partnership (ushirikiano wa kibiashara) inaweza kusajiliwa BRELA kwa aina mbalimbali — kama business name ya pamoja au kwa njia nyingine. Mbia lazima waandike mkataba wa ushirikiano (partnership deed) ukibainisha majukumu, faida, na hasara. Kwa utaratibu wa sasa wa usajilishaji wa partnership na ada husika, thibitisha na BRELA moja kwa moja (brela.go.tz) — mahitaji yanaweza kubadilika.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: EFD inaathiri vipi tathmini ya VAT ya TRA — TRA inaweza kuona mauzo ya moja kwa moja?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfumo wa EFD unaruhusu TRA kuona data ya mauzo ya biashara MOJA KWA MOJA na kwa wakati halisi. Hii inamaanisha: (1) TRA inaweza kulinganisha data ya EFD na tamko la VAT lililowasilishwa, (2) tofauti kubwa kati ya data ya EFD na tamko inaweza kusababisha ukaguzi moja kwa moja, (3) biashara zinazojaribu kudanganya kwenye mauzo zikijua EFD ipo zinachukua hatari kubwa sana ya kugunduliwa na TRA.
question_en: How does an EFD affect TRA's VAT assessment — can TRA see sales directly?
answer_en: Yes. The EFD system allows TRA to see business sales data DIRECTLY and in real time. This means: (1) TRA can compare EFD data against the filed VAT return, (2) a large discrepancy between EFD data and the return can trigger an automatic audit, (3) businesses that try to understate sales knowing an EFD is present take a very high risk of being detected by TRA.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD real-time data system update

question_sw: Mtanzania mmiliki wa biashara anaenda likizoni na kuacha mgeni aendeshe duka kwa wiki mbili. Ni shida?
answer_sw: Inategemea mazingira. Mgeni akisimamia duka kwa muda mfupi kama msimamizi au mfanyakazi wa kawaida wakati mmiliki yuko mbali — hii kwa kawaida si ukiukaji mkubwa wa GN 487A. Lakini kama mgeni anafanya maamuzi ya biashara, kupokea mapato, na kuendesha biashara halisi — hata kwa wiki mbili — inaweza kuzingatiwa ukiukaji. Mmiliki Mtanzania anapaswa kuwa na mfanyakazi Mtanzania asimamie badala yake.
question_en: A Tanzanian business owner goes on leave and leaves a non-citizen to run the shop for two weeks. Is this a problem?
answer_en: It depends on the circumstances. A non-citizen supervising a shop briefly as a caretaker or regular employee while the owner is away — this is generally not a major GN 487A violation. But if the non-citizen is making business decisions, receiving income, and running the actual business — even for two weeks — this may be considered a violation. The Tanzanian owner should have a Tanzanian employee manage instead.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: BRELA inaweza kusimamisha biashara yangu bila hukumu ya mahakama?
output: BRELA ina mamlaka ya kufuta orodha kampuni (deregistration) kwa kutokuwasilisha annual returns — lakini hii si kusimamisha biashara kwa vitendo. Kufutwa orodha kunamaanisha kampuni haipo kisheria — si polisi wanaokuja kufunga duka. Wakati kampuni imefutwa orodha: hawezi kuingia mikataba mipya kisheria; benki inaweza kugandamiza akaunti; wadai wanaweza kupinga shughuli. TRA inaweza kuomba mahakama isimamishe biashara kwa madeni ya kodi. Ili kuepuka hali hizi, wasilisha annual returns kwa wakati. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz.

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa mshahara ghafi (gross wage) au mshahara wa msingi (basic salary)?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa mshahara ghafi (gross wage) — si mshahara wa msingi peke yake. Mshahara ghafi unajumuisha mishahara yote ya lazima kabla ya makato yoyote. Thibitisha ufafanuzi kamili wa 'mshahara wa jumla' na NSSF.
question_en: Is NSSF calculated on gross wage or basic salary in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated on gross wage — not basic salary alone. Gross wage includes all compulsory remuneration before any deductions. Confirm the full definition of 'total wage' with NSSF.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kujiunga NSSF peke yangu kama mfanyabiashara binafsi (self-employed)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. NSSF Tanzania inakubali uanachama wa hiari (voluntary membership) kwa wafanyabiashara wanaojitegemea (self-employed) na wale wasio na mwajiri rasmi. Kama mwanachama wa hiari, unaweza kuchangia peke yako na kupata haki ya mafao wakati wa kustaafu, ulemavu, au mazingira mengine. Thibitisha taratibu za uanachama wa hiari na viwango vya mchango na NSSF kwenye nssf.go.tz.
question_en: Can I join NSSF on my own as a self-employed business owner?
answer_en: Yes. Tanzania's NSSF accepts voluntary membership for self-employed individuals and those without a formal employer. As a voluntary member, you contribute independently and earn entitlement to benefits at retirement, disability, or other qualifying circumstances. Confirm voluntary membership procedures and contribution rates with NSSF at nssf.go.tz.
