question_sw: WHT kwa royalties za wakazi na wasio wakazi ni sawa — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kwa royalties, kiwango cha WHT ni sawa kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi — asilimia 15 kwa wote wawili. Hii ni tofauti na aina nyingine za malipo kama ada za usimamizi (5% kwa wakazi, 15% kwa wasio wakazi) na ada za mkurugenzi (15% kwa wote — wakazi na wasio wakazi).
question_en: WHT on royalties is the same for residents and non-residents — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. For royalties the WHT rate is the same for both residents and non-residents — 15% for both. This differs from other payment types like management fees (5% residents, 15% non-residents) and director fees (15% for both residents and non-residents).

question_sw: WHT kwa malipo ya leseni ya software kutoka kampuni ya kigeni ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Malipo ya leseni ya software kwa kampuni ya kigeni yanaweza kuainishwa kama royalties au ada za huduma za kiufundi kulingana na hali halisi ya mkataba. Ikiwa ni royalties, WHT ni asilimia 15. Ikiwa ni ada za huduma za kiufundi za mtu asiye mkazi, WHT ni asilimia 15 pia. Ni muhimu kufanya tathmini ya asili ya malipo na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on software licence payments to a foreign company?
answer_en: Software licence payments to a foreign company may be classified as royalties or technical service fees depending on the actual contract terms. If royalties, WHT is 15%. If non-resident technical service fees, WHT is also 15%. It is important to assess the nature of the payment with a tax adviser.

question_sw: Royalty ya madini Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Royalty ya madini (mining royalties) iko nje ya mipaka ya msaada wangu wa sasa — ninashughulikia kodi za biashara za kawaida kwa Tanzania Bara: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF. Royalty ya madini inajumuisha Sheria ya Madini (Mining Act) na kanuni za TMAA (Tanzania Minerals Audit Agency). Kwa maswali ya madini, wasiliana na Wizara ya Madini au TMAA. Je, una swali la kodi ya kawaida ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: What is the mining royalty rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: Mining royalties are outside my current scope — I handle routine business taxes for Mainland Tanzania: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF. Mining royalties involve the Mining Act and TMAA (Tanzania Minerals Audit Agency) regulations. For mining questions, contact the Ministry of Minerals or TMAA. Is there a routine tax question I can help with?

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutotoa risiti kwa mteja moja ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha adhabu halisi kwa kila risiti isiyotolewa kinatoka kwenye Sheria ya Kodi ya Ongezeko la Thamani na Kanuni za EFD — ambayo yanaweza kubadilika. Kwa ujumla, adhabu zinatoka katika maeneo mawili: adhabu ya kila muamala na adhabu ya siku. TRA inaweza kutoza kiasi kikubwa kwa biashara zinazoonekana kukwepa makusudi. Kwa kiwango halisi cha sasa cha adhabu, angalia sheria za sasa za TRA kwenye tra.go.tz.
question_en: What is the fine for not issuing a receipt to one customer?
answer_en: The exact penalty amount per missing receipt comes from the VAT Act and EFD Regulations — which may change. Generally, penalties come from two areas: per-transaction penalties and daily penalties. TRA may impose substantial amounts for businesses found to be deliberately evading. For the current exact penalty amounts, check the current TRA regulations at tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Ushauri wa bure wa kodi unapatikana wapi Tanzania kwa biashara ndogo?
answer_sw: Rasilimali za bure za kodi kwa biashara ndogo Tanzania ni: (1) Kituo cha Huduma za TRA (TRA Service Centre) — maofisa wa TRA wanaweza kutoa mwongozo wa msingi wa uzingatiaji bila malipo, (2) Tovuti ya TRA (tra.go.tz) ina miongozo na maswali ya kawaida, (3) Vituo vya Biashara na SME vya serikali kama SIDO Tanzania. Hata hivyo, kwa maswali magumu ya kodi, mshauri wa kodi aliyesajiliwa au mhasibu aliyeidhinishwa anashauriwa.
question_en: Where can free tax advice be found in Tanzania for small businesses?
answer_en: Free tax resources for small Tanzania businesses include: (1) TRA Service Centre — TRA officers can provide basic compliance guidance at no charge, (2) TRA website (tra.go.tz) has guides and FAQs, (3) Government SME centres like SIDO Tanzania. However, for complex tax questions, a registered tax adviser or certified accountant is recommended.

question_sw: Ninafanya rufaa kwa TRAB ndani ya siku ngapi baada ya uamuzi wa Kamishna?
answer_sw: Rufaa kwa TRAB inawasilishwa ndani ya siku 45 baada ya kupokea uamuzi wa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Ikiwa muda huu umepita bila rufaa, uamuzi wa Kamishna unakuwa wa mwisho kisheria. Ni muhimu kuzingatia muda huu kwa makini.
question_en: Within how many days of the Commissioner's decision must I appeal to TRAB?
answer_en: An appeal to TRAB must be filed within 45 days of receiving the TRA Commissioner General's decision. If this period passes without an appeal, the Commissioner's decision becomes final in law. It is critical to observe this deadline carefully.

instruction: Kampuni ya simu iliyoteuliwa na TRA inatoa certificate vipi kwa msambazaji?
output: Kampuni ya simu kama withholding agent inafanya hivi: inapokea invoice kutoka msambazaji aliyesajiliwa VAT, anakata sehemu ya VAT hiyo kulingana na kiwango kilichowekwa, analipia msambazaji kiasi kilichobakia, kisha anatoa certificate inayoonyesha kiasi alichokata. Certificate lazima itolewe siku ile ile VAT inakuwa payable — si tarehe 20. Tarehe 20 ni kwa ajili ya kupeleka withholding TRA.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutotoa risiti ya EFD ni nini?
answer_sw: Kutotoa risiti ya EFD kwa muamala wa mauzo ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT Tanzania. TRA ina mamlaka ya kutoza faini, kusimamisha leseni ya biashara, au kuchukua hatua nyingine za kisheria dhidi ya biashara inayokiuka sheria hii. Ukaguzi wa TRA (tax audit) unaweza kutokea wakati wowote, na muamala wowote usiokuwa na risiti ya EFD unaweza kutafsiriwa kama kukimbia kodi. Thibitisha kiasi halisi cha faini na TRA kwani kinaweza kubadilika baada ya Finance Act ya kila mwaka.
question_en: What is the penalty for not issuing an EFD receipt?
answer_en: Failing to issue an EFD fiscal receipt for a sales transaction is a violation of Tanzania's VAT law. TRA has the authority to impose fines, suspend business licences, or take other legal action against a non-compliant business. TRA inspections can happen at any time, and any transaction without an EFD receipt may be treated as tax evasion. Confirm the specific penalty amounts with TRA as they may change.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kusajili biashara na WCF — hatua zipi?
answer_sw: Hatua za kusajili na WCF: (1) nenda ofisi ya WCF au tovuti ya WCF, (2) jaza fomu ya usajili wa mwajiri, (3) wasilisha orodha ya wafanyakazi wote, (4) lipa ada ya usajili (kama inahitajika), na (5) pata nambari ya usajili ya WCF. Baada ya usajili, lipa mchango wa kila mwezi kwa wakati.
question_en: How do you register a business with WCF — what are the steps?
answer_en: Steps to register with WCF: (1) visit a WCF office or WCF website, (2) complete the employer registration form, (3) submit a list of all employees, (4) pay the registration fee (if required), and (5) receive your WCF registration number. After registration, pay the monthly contribution on time.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Mtu alilalamika NSSF kwa mwajiri wake ambaye hakumlipa — NSSF inafanya nini?
output: NSSF ina uwezo wa kuchunguza malalamiko ya wafanyakazi kuhusu mwajiri asiye kulipa michango: (1) NSSF inachunguza rekodi za mwajiri — wanakagua michango iliyowasilishwa dhidi ya wafanyakazi waliopo; (2) Kama uthibitisho unakutwa — NSSF inatoa notisi ya malipo kwa mwajiri; (3) Kama mwajiri halipi — NSSF inaweza kuchukua hatua za kisheria ikiwa ni pamoja na madai ya mahakama; (4) Wakurugenzi wa kampuni wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi. Mfanyakazi ana haki ya: kulalamika moja kwa moja kwa NSSF (nssf.go.tz), kulalamika kwa Mahakama ya Kazi (Labour Court), au kupitia Mkurugenzi wa Kazi (Director of Labour). Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.

question_sw: Biashara yangu inaendesha huduma za ushauri. Je, kizingiti cha VAT ni sawa kwa huduma na bidhaa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT kinatumika kwa bidhaa NA huduma: TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12, au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6 — bila kujali aina ya biashara. Huduma za ushauri zinazopita kizingiti hiki lazima zisajiliwe kwa VAT. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT ni asilimia 18. Hakuna kiwango maalum cha chini kwa huduma.
question_en: My business provides consultancy services. Is the VAT threshold the same for services as for goods?
answer_en: Yes. The VAT registration threshold applies to both goods AND services: TZS 200,000,000 in 12 months, or TZS 100,000,000 in 6 months — regardless of business type. Consultancy services that exceed this threshold must register for VAT. The standard VAT rate is 18%. There is no special lower rate for services.

question_sw: Gari la kampuni linalipwa PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anayetumia gari la kampuni kwa madhumuni ya kibinafsi anapata manufaa yanayostahili PAYE. Thamani ya manufaa inahesabiwa kulingana na sheria ya kodi ya TRA. Mwajiri analazimika kujumuisha thamani hiyo katika mshahara unaostahili PAYE. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is a company car taxed under PAYE?
answer_en: An employee who uses a company car for personal purposes receives a taxable benefit subject to PAYE. The benefit value is calculated under TRA tax rules. The employer must include this value in the PAYE-liable payroll. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: SDL inafadhili nini hasa?
answer_sw: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inafadhili mafunzo ya kitaaluma na ukuzaji wa ujuzi wa wafanyakazi nchini Tanzania, kupitia Vocational Education and Training Authority (VETA) na taasisi nyingine za mafunzo. Si kodi ya ustawi, si kodi ya huduma — ni kodi ya kukuza ujuzi hasa.
question_en: What exactly does SDL fund?
answer_en: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — funds vocational training and skills development for workers in Tanzania, through the Vocational Education and Training Authority (VETA) and other training institutions. It is not a welfare levy, not a services levy — it is specifically a skills development levy.

instruction: Malipo ya NSSF inayopelekwa lazima yawe kamili — nifanyeje kama sijaweza kulipa yote?
output: Kama huwezi kulipa NSSF yote kwa wakati, wasiliana na NSSF (nssf.go.tz) mapema — kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ikipita. NSSF inaweza kukusaidia kupanga mpango wa malipo. Kuchelewa bila taarifa kunasababisha adhabu ya asilimia 5 kwa kila mwezi wa uchelewaji wa malipo inayopelekwa. Usiache bila kutoa taarifa — NSSF inashughulika vyema zaidi na wajiri wanaowasiliana mapema.

instruction: Mwajiri wangu hakusajili NSSF tangu nilipoingia kazi — nina haki ya kudai chochote?
output: Ndiyo. Una haki ya kudai mchango wako wote wa NSSF uliokosekana. Hatua: (1) ripoti kwa NSSF (nssf.go.tz) ukitoa ushahidi wa miaka ya kazi (karatasi za mshahara, barua ya ajira, n.k.); (2) NSSF itachunguza na kuamrisha mwajiri wako kulipa mchango wote pamoja na adhabu; (3) unaweza pia wasiliana na Ofisi ya Kazi. Haki yako ya uanachama wa NSSF inalindwa kisheria — usikae kimya.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya WHT kwa malipo ya ndani na malipo ya nje ya nchi ni nini?
answer_sw: WHT kwa malipo ya NDANI (wakazi) mara nyingi ina kiwango cha chini — kwa mfano, ada za usimamizi 5%, ada za mkurugenzi 15%. WHT kwa malipo ya NJE (wasio wakazi) ina kiwango cha juu zaidi — ada za usimamizi 15%, ada za mkurugenzi 15%, kodi ya pango 20%. Gawio na riba ni sawa kwa wote (10%). Mikataba ya DTA inaweza kupunguza viwango vya wasio wakazi.
question_en: What is the difference between WHT on domestic payments and cross-border payments?
answer_en: WHT on DOMESTIC (resident) payments generally has lower rates — management fees 5%, director fees 15%. WHT on CROSS-BORDER (non-resident) payments has higher rates — management fees 15%, director fees 15%, rent 20%. Dividends and interest are the same for both (10%). Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) can reduce non-resident rates.

question_sw: Hati ya mauzo ya ardhi iliyosainiwa kabla ya sheria mpya ya ushuru wa stempu inalipa kiwango cha zamani au kipya?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, kiwango cha ushuru wa stempu kinachohusika ni kile kilichokuwepo wakati hati ilisainiwa au wakati malipo yanafanywa — kulingana na utaratibu wa Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu. Sheria mpya inaweza kuwa na masharti ya mpito yanayoathiri hati za zamani ambazo bado hazijapigwa stempu. Angalia TRA kwa mwongozo wa hali za mpito za kisheria.
question_en: Does a land sale instrument signed before a new stamp duty law use the old or new rate?
answer_en: Generally, the applicable stamp duty rate is the one in force at the time the instrument was signed or when payment is made — depending on the Stamp Duty Act procedure. New legislation may have transitional provisions affecting old unstamped instruments. Check TRA for guidance on legal transitional situations.

question_sw: Huduma za kidijitali maana yake nini kwa madhumuni ya VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Huduma za kidijitali ni huduma zinazotolewa kwa njia ya mtandao au mfumo wa kielektroniki — kama vile streaming ya video na muziki, programu za simu (apps), huduma za wingu (cloud), matangazo ya mtandaoni, na michezo ya video. Kwa madhumuni ya VAT, TRA inafuatilia huduma kama hizo zinazotolewa Tanzania.
question_en: What do digital services mean for VAT purposes in Tanzania?
answer_en: Digital services are services provided via the internet or electronic system — such as video and music streaming, mobile applications (apps), cloud services, online advertising, and video games. For VAT purposes, TRA tracks such services supplied in Tanzania.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Jirani Mtanzania alilipa TZS 5M na akafungwa miezi 3 kwa kumsaidia mgeni. Je, hii ni adhabu sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana — adhabu hii haiko sahihi. Adhabu ya msaidizi Mtanzania ni faini ya hadi TZS 5M AU kifungo hadi miezi 3 — si zote mbili pamoja. Kumlazimisha jirani alipe 5M NA kufungwa wakati huo huo ni kuvuka mipaka ya sheria. Jirani anastahili moja tu kati ya mbili: faini (hadi 5M) au kifungo (hadi miezi 3).
question_en: A Tanzanian neighbour paid TZS 5M and was also imprisoned for 3 months for facilitating a non-citizen. Is this the correct penalty?
answer_en: No — this penalty is incorrect. A Tanzanian facilitator's penalty is a fine of up to TZS 5M OR imprisonment up to 3 months — not both together. Forcing the neighbour to pay 5M AND be imprisoned simultaneously exceeds the legal limits. The neighbour is entitled to only one of the two: a fine (up to 5M) or imprisonment (up to 3 months).
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Je, kampuni inalazimika kulipa WCF na NSSF zote mbili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni inalazimika kulipa NSSF na WCF — ni wajibu tofauti mbili. NSSF: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. WCF: mwajiri peke yake asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Kwa hivyo, jumla ya mchango wa mwajiri kwa mishahara = 10% (NSSF) + 0.5% (WCF) = 10.5% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla kutoka pochi ya mwajiri.
question_en: Is a company required to pay both WCF and NSSF?
answer_en: Yes. A company is required to pay both NSSF and WCF — they are two separate obligations. NSSF: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. WCF: employer only at 0.5% of gross wage. Therefore, total employer contribution on wages = 10% (NSSF) + 0.5% (WCF) = 10.5% of gross wage from the employer's own pocket.

instruction: Hoteli yangu inatoa huduma za mkutano (conference) — je, huduma hizo zinakata VAT?
output: Ndiyo — huduma za mkutano (conference services) kama ukodishaji wa chumba cha mkutano, teknolojia ya mkutano, chakula cha mkutano, na kadhalika ni huduma zinazoweza kuwa na VAT. Kama hoteli imesajiliwa VAT, inatoza 18% VAT kwa huduma zote za mkutano. Wateja wa kampuni wanaoweza kudai input VAT wanapenda kupata tax invoice (risiti ya EFD na VAT) — kwa hivyo toa tax invoice sahihi. Kama mteja ni qualifying buyer — anaweza kukata withholding ya 6% ya VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu VAT kwa huduma maalum za hoteli yako.

question_sw: Kampuni inataka kufuta usajili wake (deregistration) rasmi. Mchakato wa BRELA ni upi?
answer_sw: Kufuta usajili wa kampuni kwa hiari (voluntary dissolution) kunahitaji: kupitisha azimio maalum la wanahisa (75%+), kuteuwa msimamizi wa likwidesheni (liquidator), kulipa madeni yote ya kampuni na kukusanya madai, kuwasilisha taarifa za mwisho za uhasibu, na kuomba kufutwa kwa jina kutoka BRELA. Mahakama inaweza pia kuagiza kufutwa kwa lazima. Utaratibu huu unaweza kuchukua miezi kadhaa. Kabla ya kufuta, hakikisha TRA, NSSF, na mashirika mengine yote yamesafirishwa na madeni yalipwa.
answer_en: Voluntary company deregistration requires: passing a special resolution by shareholders (75%+), appointing a liquidator, paying all company debts and collecting receivables, submitting final accounting statements, and applying for name removal from BRELA. A court may also order compulsory winding up. This process may take several months. Before deregistration, ensure TRA, NSSF, and all other agencies are settled and all debts are paid.
question_en: A company wants to formally deregister (dissolution). What is the BRELA process?

question_sw: Ada za mkurugenzi wa Tanzania (mkazi) zinatoza asilimia 20 ya WHT — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ada za mkurugenzi wa Tanzania mkazi zinatoza WHT ya asilimia 15 — si asilimia 20. Zaidi ya hayo, kiwango cha asilimia 15 kinatumika pia kwa wakurugenzi wasio wakazi — TRA inatumia kiwango kimoja cha asilimia 15 kwa ada za mkurugenzi (wasio mkurugenzi wa wakati wote) bila kujali wakazi au la. Kiwango cha asilimia 20 kwa ada za mkurugenzi si sahihi.
question_en: Director fees for a Tanzanian (resident) director attract 20% WHT — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Director fees for a Tanzania resident director attract 15% WHT — not 20%. Furthermore, the 15% rate also applies to non-resident directors — TRA applies a single rate of 15% for director fees (non-full-time directors) regardless of residency. A 20% rate for director fees is incorrect.

question_sw: Mtu asiye raia wa Tanzania anaweza kuwa wakala wa M-Pesa au Airtel Money?
answer_sw: Hapana. Chini ya GN 487A (2025), huduma za uhamisho wa pesa kwa simu (mobile money agent services) ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania. Mtu asiye raia hawezi kuwa wakala wa M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, au mtandao wowote wa pesa za simu kama biashara yake binafsi. Adhabu kwa ukiukwaji ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 na kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 jela, pamoja na kufutwa kwa viza. Raia wa Tanzania wanaofanya uwezeshaji wanahatarisha faini ya TZS milioni 5 au kifungo cha miezi 3.
question_en: Can a non-Tanzanian citizen become an M-Pesa or Airtel Money agent?
answer_en: No. Under GN 487A (2025), mobile money transfer agent services are one of the 15 business activities prohibited for non-citizens. A non-citizen cannot operate as an M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, or any mobile money network agent as their own business. Penalties for violation are a minimum TZS 10 million fine and up to 6 months imprisonment, plus visa revocation. Tanzanian citizens who facilitate such arrangements risk a TZS 5 million fine or 3 months imprisonment.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: SDL ya mwezi Januari inahesabiwa kwa mshahara wa Januari au Desemba?
answer_sw: SDL ya mwezi Januari inahesabiwa kwa mishahara ya Januari (mishahara iliyolipwa ndani ya mwezi huo) na inalipwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. SDL inafuata mwezi ambao mishahara inayohusika ililipwa — si mwezi wa malipo ya SDL.
question_en: Is January's SDL calculated on January's or December's payroll?
answer_en: January's SDL is calculated on January's payroll (salaries paid within that month) and is remitted to TRA by 7 February. SDL follows the month in which the relevant salaries were paid — not the month in which SDL itself is remitted.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Adhabu ya biashara inayokosa kusajili mahali pa kazi na OSHA ni nini?
output: Adhabu ya kushindwa kusajili mahali pa kazi na OSHA ni: faini ya TZS milioni 1 hadi TZS milioni 5 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 12 AU vyote viwili. Kosa linaloendelea linaongeza faini ya TZS 100,000 kwa kila siku ya kosa. Thibitisha adhabu za sasa na OSHA (osha.go.tz) kwani zinaweza kubadilika baada ya marekebisho ya sheria.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: WCF ni nini na wajibu wake kwa biashara yangu ni nini?
answer_sw: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni mfuko wa bima ya ajali za kazi wa Tanzania. Kama mwajiri, unalazimika kusajiliwa WCF na kulipa mchango wa asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara wote wa wafanyakazi wako kila mwezi. WCF inalipia mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini — matibabu, fidia, na manufaa ya ulemavu au kifo.
question_en: What is WCF and what is its obligation for my business?
answer_en: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is Tanzania's workplace accident insurance fund. As an employer you must register with WCF and pay a contribution of 0.5% of total employee wages each month. WCF pays injured workers — medical expenses, compensation, and disability or death benefits.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Kama withholding agent, siotoi certificate kwa msambazaji — kuna adhabu?
output: Ndiyo. Kutotoa certificate ya withholding ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT. TRA inaweza kuamrisha ulipe faini na riba. Msambazaji pia anaweza kudai fidia kwa sababu hana ushahidi wa pembejeo ya VAT. Lazima utoe certificate si baadaye ya tarehe VAT inakuwa payable. Thibitisha wajibu huu na TRA (tra.go.tz).

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kuacha kulipa NSSF kwa sababu biashara inazorota?
answer_sw: Hapana. NSSF ni mchango wa lazima chini ya sheria — mwajiri hawezi kuacha kulipa hata kama biashara inazorota au inakabili matatizo ya fedha. Kushindwa kulipa kunasababisha faini ya asilimia 5 kwa mwezi na madai ya kisheria. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer stop paying NSSF because the business is struggling financially?
answer_en: No. NSSF is a mandatory statutory contribution — an employer cannot stop paying even if the business is struggling financially. Failure to pay attracts a 5% monthly penalty and legal claims. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Je, biashara mpya inayonunua vifaa vya ofisi — inaweza kudai VAT refund?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ikiwa biashara imesajiliwa VAT. Ununuzi wa vifaa vya ofisi (kompyuta, samani, vifaa vya ofisi) kutoka wasambazaji waliosajilistwaa VAT unazalisha input VAT. Kama input VAT inazidi output VAT (kawaida mwanzoni mwa biashara), biashara ina haki ya kudai refund au kubeba credit mbele.
question_en: A new business buying office equipment — can it claim a VAT refund?
answer_en: Yes, if the business is VAT-registered. Purchasing office equipment (computers, furniture, office supplies) from VAT-registered suppliers generates input VAT. If input VAT exceeds output VAT (common at the start of a business), the business is entitled to claim a refund or carry the credit forward.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Je, biashara inayotoa risiti za EFD lazima iwasilishe VAT return pia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Risiti ya EFD na VAT return ni wajibu tofauti mbili: (1) Risiti za EFD: zinatoka kwa kila muamala wakati unaotokea; (2) VAT return: inawasilishwa kila mwezi, mwisho wa tarehe 20, na inajumuisha malipo ya VAT inayodaiwa. Kutoa risiti za EFD bila kuwasilisha VAT return ni ukiukaji wa wajibu wa kodi. Seva ya TRA inaweza kuona biashara zinazotoa risiti lakini hazisailishi returns — hizi zinakuwa lengwa la ukaguzi.
question_en: Must a business issuing EFD receipts also submit VAT returns?
answer_en: Yes. EFD receipts and VAT returns are two separate obligations: (1) EFD receipts: issued for every transaction as it occurs; (2) VAT return: submitted monthly, by the 20th, and includes the VAT payment owed. Issuing EFD receipts without submitting VAT returns is a tax compliance violation. TRA's server can identify businesses issuing receipts but not filing returns — these become audit targets.

question_sw: Ukaguzi wa TRA unavyopatikana ni tatizo — ninajua haki zangu wakati wa ukaguzi?
answer_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa TRA una haki ya: (1) kuomba kitambulisho cha mkaguzi, (2) kupata nakala ya hati yoyote inayochukuliwa, (3) kutumia mshauri wa kodi au wakili wakati wowote, (4) kutoa maelezo ya rekodi zako, na (5) kuomba maelezo ya matokeo ya ukaguzi kabla ya tathmini ya rasmi kutolewa.
question_en: A TRA audit is underway — what are my rights during the audit?
answer_en: During a TRA audit you have the right to: (1) request the auditor's identification, (2) receive copies of any documents taken, (3) use a tax adviser or lawyer at any time, (4) provide explanations of your records, and (5) request explanation of audit findings before a formal assessment is issued.

question_sw: Netflix, Spotify — zinatozwa VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, watoa huduma wa kidijitali wa nje ya nchi (non-resident providers) wanaotoa huduma kwa wateja Tanzania wanaweza kuwa na wajibu wa VAT Tanzania. Hata hivyo, utekelezaji halisi wa sheria hii dhidi ya makampuni makubwa ya kimataifa ni suala ngumu. Sina uhakika wa hali halisi ya sasa ya makampuni kama Netflix na Spotify dhidi ya TRA. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Netflix, Spotify — are they subject to VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: Generally, non-resident digital service providers supplying services to Tanzanian consumers may have Tanzania VAT obligations. However, the practical enforcement of this against major international companies is complex. I am not certain of the current specific status of companies like Netflix and Spotify with TRA. Verify with TRA or a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Faida za kufanya biashara ndani ya Eneo Maalum la Uchumi (Special Economic Zone — SEZ) Tanzania ni zipi?
answer_sw: Biashara zilizoidhinishwa kwenye SEZ Tanzania zinapata faida kadhaa: msamaha wa kodi ya mapato ya kampuni kwa miaka 10 ya kwanza, msamaha wa VAT na ushuru wa forodha kwenye bidhaa za uingizaji zinazotumiwa kwenye uzalishaji, msamaha wa SDL, na msamaha wa mrabaha wa ardhi. Baada ya miaka 10, kiwango cha kodi kinapungua. Usajili unafanywa kupitia Mamlaka ya Maeneo Maalum ya Uchumi Tanzania (EPZA/SEZA). Bidhaa zinazotengenezwa SEZ zinaweza kuuzwa nje ya nchi au ndani ya Tanzania (na ushuru wa forodha unaotumika kwa mauzo ya ndani).
answer_en: Businesses approved in a Tanzania SEZ receive several benefits: corporate income tax exemption for the first 10 years, VAT and customs duty exemption on imported inputs used in production, SDL exemption, and land rent exemption. After 10 years, a reduced tax rate applies. Registration is through the Tanzania Special Economic Zones Authority (EPZA/SEZA). Goods manufactured in an SEZ can be exported or sold domestically (with applicable customs duty on domestic sales).
question_en: What are the benefits of operating a business within a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: SEZ Act amendment or Finance Act

instruction: Tofauti ya kizingiti cha safety officer kwa ujenzi na sekta nyingine — kwa nini?
output: Afisa usalama (safety officer) anahitajika: Sekta ya jumla: wafanyakazi 50 au zaidi. Sekta ya ujenzi: wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi. Sababu ya kizingiti cha chini kwa ujenzi (20 badala ya 50): Ujenzi una hatari nyingi zaidi: kuanguka kutoka juu, vifaa vya nzito, kemikali, umeme. Takwimu za OSHA Tanzania zinaonyesha ajali za ujenzi ni nyingi zaidi — kwa hivyo ulinzi wa mapema (safety officer haraka zaidi) unahitajika.

instruction: Ninaandika programu ya kompyuta — ninapaswa kwenda BRELA au COSOTA kulinda?
output: Programu za kompyuta (software) zinalindwa na haki za kimwandishi (copyright) — kwa hivyo unapaswa kwenda COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania), si BRELA. COSOTA inalinda haki za kimwandishi za kazi asilia kama programu, vitabu, muziki, na filamu. BRELA inashughulikia alama za biashara (trademarks — jina au nembo la bidhaa yako), hataza (patents — uvumbuzi wa kiufundi), na michoro ya viwanda. Kama kampuni yako inaendesha programu na unataka kulinda jina la bidhaa, hiyo ni trademark ya BRELA. Thibitisha na COSOTA (cosota.or.tz) au BRELA (brela.go.tz).

question_sw: Muhtasari wa uzingatiaji wa msingi wa biashara ndogo Tanzania — hatua 10 za lazima ni zipi?
answer_sw: Hatua 10 za msingi za uzingatiaji kwa biashara ndogo Tanzania: (1) Sajili jina la biashara au kampuni BRELA, (2) Pata TIN ya TRA (bure), (3) Omba leseni ya biashara ya LGA, (4) Sajili NSSF ikiwa una wafanyakazi, (5) Sajili WCF ikiwa una wafanyakazi, (6) Sajili OSHA ikiwa una wafanyakazi 10+, (7) Angalia kama unahitaji EFD (ikiwa VAT au TRA imeamuru), (8) Sajili VAT ikiwa mauzo yanazidi TZS 200M/mwaka, (9) Wasilisha tamko la kodi la mwaka kwa TRA, (10) Huisha leseni ya LGA kila mwaka (tarehe 31 Machi).
question_en: Summary of essential small business compliance in Tanzania — what are the 10 mandatory steps?
answer_en: 10 essential compliance steps for a small Tanzania business: (1) Register business name or company at BRELA, (2) Get TIN from TRA (free), (3) Apply for LGA business licence, (4) Register with NSSF if you have employees, (5) Register with WCF if you have employees, (6) Register with OSHA if you have 10+ employees, (7) Check if you need an EFD (if VAT-registered or TRA has directed), (8) Register for VAT if turnover exceeds TZS 200M/year, (9) File annual tax return with TRA, (10) Renew LGA licence annually (by 31 March).
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mtu wa kigeni akilazimika kwenda nje ya Tanzania kwa muda mfupi — kibali chake kinaendelea kufanya kazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kibali cha kazi cha Tanzania kinaendelea kutumika kwa ujumla hata ikiwa mhusika anaondoka Tanzania kwa muda mfupi (kama safari ya biashara au familia). Hata hivyo, visas vya kuingia tena (re-entry visas) vinaweza kuhitajika kulingana na uraia wa mhusika na masharti ya eneo lake. Angalia Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa masharti ya hali yako.
question_en: If a foreigner must leave Tanzania briefly — does their work permit remain valid?
answer_en: Yes, a Tanzania work permit generally continues to be valid even if the holder leaves Tanzania briefly (such as for a business trip or family visit). However, re-entry visas may be required depending on the holder's nationality and visa conditions. Check with the Immigration Department for requirements in your specific situation.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi akifa kazini Tanzania — mwajiri ana wajibu gani wa kisheria zaidi ya WCF?
answer_sw: Mbali na WCF (ambayo inalipa fidia ya kifo kwa familia), mwajiri ana wajibu wa ziada: (1) kuarifu OSHA na polisi kuhusu kifo cha kazini ndani ya muda uliopangwa, (2) kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa OSHA wa ajali iliyosababisha kifo, (3) kulipa mshahara wote uliostahiliwa hadi tarehe ya kifo, (4) kushughulikia NSSF kwa manufaa ya kifo yanayostahili familia, (5) kuhakikisha mazingira ya kazi yanaboreshwa ili kuzuia kifo kingine kama hicho.
question_en: If an employee dies at work in Tanzania — what legal obligations does the employer have beyond WCF?
answer_en: Beyond WCF (which pays death compensation to the family), the employer has additional obligations: (1) notify OSHA and police about the workplace death within the specified time, (2) cooperate with OSHA's investigation of the fatal accident, (3) pay all wages owed up to the date of death, (4) engage with NSSF for death benefits payable to the family, (5) ensure workplace conditions are improved to prevent another similar death.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act or WCF Act amendment

instruction: Kama tarehe 7 inaangukia Jumapili au likizo — SDL nalipia lini?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kama tarehe 7 ni siku ya likizo au Jumapili, lipa SDL siku ya kazi inayofuata. Hata hivyo, usitegemee kanuni hii — lipa mapema ili kuepuka matatizo yoyote. Mazoea bora: lipa SDL kati ya tarehe 1-5 ya mwezi ili kuwa salama.

question_sw: Z-report lazima ipigwe wakati gani — usiku au asubuhi?
answer_sw: Z-report inatolewa MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — kabla EFD haijazimwa kwa usiku. Si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Utaratibu wa kawaida: (1) Funga mauzo ya mwisho wa siku; (2) Toa Z-report; (3) Hakikisha Z-report imepelekwa seva ya TRA; (4) Zima au acha EFD. Kutoa Z-report asubuhi ya siku inayofuata kunaweza kusababisha tatizo la data — muamala wa siku moja unaweza kuonekana kwenye siku nyingine.
question_en: When must the Z-report be generated — evening or morning?
answer_en: The Z-report must be generated at the END OF THE BUSINESS DAY — before powering off the EFD for the night. Not in the morning of the following day. Normal procedure: (1) Complete the last sale of the day; (2) Generate Z-report; (3) Confirm Z-report has been transmitted to TRA server; (4) Shut down or leave EFD. Generating a Z-report in the morning of the following day may cause data problems — a day's transactions may appear under a different date.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kusajili PAYE TRA lini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kusajili PAYE kabla ya kuanza kulipa mshahara wa kwanza wa mfanyakazi. Usajili unafanywa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS kwenye tovuti ya TRA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: When must an employer register for PAYE with TRA?
answer_en: An employer must register for PAYE before paying the first employee's salary. Registration is done through the IDRAS system on the TRA website. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Naona mgeni ana biashara iliyokatazwa — naridhika nani?
answer_sw: Ripoti Idara ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu nawe au ofisi ya Mkurugenzi wa Wilaya (DC). Unaweza pia kuwasiliana na Polisi. Usihatarisha usalama wako mwenyewe kwa kukabiliana na mtu mwenyewe — ripoti kwa mamlaka rasmi badala yake.
question_en: I see a non-citizen with a prohibited business — who do I report to?
answer_en: Report to the nearest Immigration Services Department office or the District Commissioner's (DC) office. You may also contact the Police. Do not put yourself at risk by confronting the person directly — report to official authorities instead.
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Serikali ilitoa GN 487A kwa sababu gani hasa?
answer_sw: Serikali ya Tanzania ilitoa GN 487A (2025) kwa lengo la kulinda fursa za kibiashara kwa raia wa Tanzania — hasa katika biashara ndogo ndogo na za kati ambazo zimekuwa zikifanywa na wageni. Amri inalenga makundi 15 ya biashara ambazo kwa miaka mingi zilikuwa zikifanywa na wageni badala ya Watanzania. Lengo ni kuwezesha wafanyabiashara wa Tanzania kupata sehemu ya kiuchumi katika sekta hizi. Hii ni sera ya sera ya uchumi shirikishi (economic empowerment) inayolenga ukuzaji wa biashara za Watanzania.
question_en: Why exactly did the government issue GN 487A?
answer_en: The Government of Tanzania issued GN 487A (2025) to protect business opportunities for Tanzanian citizens — particularly in small and medium enterprises that had been operated by non-citizens. The Order targets 15 business categories that for many years had been dominated by non-citizens rather than Tanzanians. The goal is to enable Tanzanian entrepreneurs to gain an economic share in these sectors. This is an economic empowerment policy aimed at growing Tanzanian businesses.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kuomba msamaha wa SDL vipi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayetaka msamaha wa SDL lazima aandike ombi rasmi kwa Kamishna wa TRA akitoa sababu za kisheria za msamaha, kama vile hadhi ya EPZ, hali ya shirika lisilo la faida, au msamaha mwingine uliowekwa kisheria. Ombi linapaswa kuambatanishwa na: cheti cha usajili wa shirika, hati inayothibitisha hadhi ya msamaha (k.m. cheti cha EPZA au hati ya shirika lisilo la faida), na nyaraka za BRELA. TRA itapitia ombi na kutoa uamuzi kwa maandishi. Usidai msamaha kabla ya kupata uamuzi wa TRA.
answer_en: An employer seeking SDL exemption must write a formal application to the TRA Commissioner General stating the legal grounds for exemption, such as EPZ status, non-profit organisation status, or another statutory exemption. The application should be accompanied by: the organisation's registration certificate, documentation confirming exemption status (e.g., EPZA certificate or non-profit deed), and BRELA documents. TRA will review the application and issue a written decision. Do not claim exemption before receiving TRA's written decision.
question_en: How can an employer apply for an SDL exemption?

question_sw: EFD inaweza kuratibu mifumo miwili ya VAT — standard rate (18%) na zero-rated (0%) — kwenye muamala mmoja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. EFD za kisasa ziliweza kushughulikia muamala mmoja wenye bidhaa za aina tofauti za VAT — kwa mfano, duka linalouza bidhaa za 18% na bidhaa za zero-rated pamoja. EFD inakokotoa VAT ya kila bidhaa kulingana na kategoria yake na kuonyesha muhtasari wa risiti na jumla ya VAT inayohusika. Weka programu ya EFD iliyosasishwa ili kushughulikia aina zote za VAT.
question_en: Can an EFD handle two VAT rates — standard rate (18%) and zero-rated (0%) — on one transaction in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Modern EFDs can handle a single transaction with goods of different VAT types — for example, a shop selling 18% goods and zero-rated goods together. The EFD calculates VAT for each item according to its category and shows a receipt summary with the applicable total VAT. Keep EFD software updated to handle all VAT categories.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ya kuuza bidhaa mtandaoni inatumia Jumia au platform nyingine. Je, ninahitaji leseni tofauti ya kuuza mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Hapana leseni ya ziada maalum ya mauzo ya mtandaoni peke yake. Lakini biashara yako inahitaji: usajili wa BRELA (ikiwa bado hujafanya), TIN, na leseni ya LGA ikiwa una eneo la biashara. Kama mnunuzi ni biashara iliyosajiliwa na ununuzi unazidi TZS 500,000, wanalazimika kukata kodi ya kizuizi. Ikiwa mapato yako ya jumla yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200,000,000/mwaka), lazima usajili VAT na kutoa risiti za EFD au VFD kwa malipo yote.
answer_en: No special separate licence specifically for online selling alone. But your business requires: BRELA registration (if not yet done), a TIN, and an LGA licence if you have a physical business location. If the buyer is a registered business and the purchase exceeds TZS 500,000, they are required to withhold tax. If your total income exceeds the VAT threshold (TZS 200,000,000/year), you must register for VAT and issue EFD/VFD receipts for all payments.
question_en: My business sells products online through Jumia or another platform. Do I need a special online selling licence?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA e-commerce circular

question_sw: Waajiri wa EPZ (Export Processing Zone) wanaweza kusamehewa SDL?
answer_sw: Kampuni zilizosajiliwa rasmi kwenye EPZ Tanzania zinaweza kupata msamaha wa SDL kama sehemu ya msururu wa motisha za uwekezaji. Hata hivyo, msamaha huu si wa kiotomatiki — kampuni lazima ithibitishe hadhi yake ya EPZ na EPZA na kupata idhini maalum ya msamaha kutoka TRA. Angalia hati yako ya usajili wa EPZ kwa masharti. Ikiwa hujapata msamaha rasmi, wajibu wa SDL bado upo hadi utakapopata uthibitisho wa maandishi kutoka TRA.
answer_en: Companies formally registered in a Tanzania Export Processing Zone (EPZ) may be eligible for SDL exemption as part of the investment incentive package. However, this exemption is not automatic — the company must confirm its EPZ status with EPZA and obtain a specific exemption approval from TRA. Check your EPZ registration certificate for conditions. If you have not received formal exemption, the SDL obligation remains until you receive written confirmation from TRA.
question_en: Can employers in an Export Processing Zone (EPZ) be exempted from SDL?
next_review_trigger: EPZ Act amendment or TRA SDL circular

question_sw: Kampuni inataka kuongeza mtaji wake wa hisa (share capital). Inafanyaje?
answer_sw: Kuongeza mtaji wa hisa kunahitaji: kupitisha azimio la kawaida (ordinary resolution) la wanahisa, kuwasilisha fomu ya taarifa ya mabadiliko ya mtaji kwa BRELA ndani ya muda uliowekwa, kulipa ada ya usajili inayohusiana na ongezeko la mtaji, na kusasisha Hati ya Muundo wa Kampuni (Memorandum and Articles of Association) ikiwa inahitajika. BRELA itasasisha rekodi za kampuni. Ongezeko la mtaji linaweza pia kuathiri uwiano wa umiliki wa wanahisa (dilution) — thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
answer_en: Increasing share capital requires: passing an ordinary resolution of shareholders, filing a capital change notification form with BRELA within the prescribed period, paying the associated registration fee based on the capital increase, and updating the Memorandum and Articles of Association if required. BRELA will update the company records. A share capital increase may also affect shareholder ownership proportions (dilution) — confirm with a legal adviser.
question_en: A company wants to increase its share capital. How does it do this?

question_sw: SDL na NSSF ni kitu kimoja?
answer_sw: Hapana, ni tofauti kabisa. NSSF ni mchango wa hifadhi ya jamii (asilimia 10 mwajiri + asilimia 10 mfanyakazi). SDL ni Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi — inayolipwa na mwajiri peke yake kwa kiwango cha asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla, kwa wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, mwisho siku 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: Are SDL and NSSF the same thing?
answer_en: No, they are completely different. NSSF is a social security contribution (10% employer + 10% employee). SDL is the Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi — paid by the employer only at 3.5% of gross payroll, for employers with 10 or more employees, due by the 7th of the following month.

question_sw: EFD inasaidia watu maskini wa Tanzania vipi — risiti za EFD zinawafaidia wananchi?
answer_sw: Risiti za EFD zinalinda wananchi kwa njia kadhaa: (1) biashara iliyotoa risiti ya EFD inathibitisha kwamba alilipa VAT halisi na hakudanganya bei, (2) wananchi wanaweza kutumia risiti za EFD kama ushahidi wa manunuzi kwa madhumuni ya udanganyifu wa bidhaa, (3) TRA inapata mapato zaidi ya kodi ambayo yanaweza kutumiwa kwa huduma za umma. Kampeni ya TRA ya 'Omba Risiti' inawahimiza wananchi kudai risiti za EFD.
question_en: How do EFDs help ordinary Tanzanians — do EFD receipts benefit citizens?
answer_en: EFD receipts protect citizens in several ways: (1) a business that issued an EFD receipt proves it paid the actual VAT and did not deceive on price, (2) citizens can use EFD receipts as purchase evidence for product fraud claims, (3) TRA receives more tax revenue which can be used for public services. TRA's 'Omba Risiti' (Ask for Receipt) campaign encourages citizens to demand EFD receipts.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD public awareness campaign update

question_sw: BRELA inasaidia katika kufanikisha suala la migogoro ya wanahisa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. BRELA si chombo cha utatuzi wa migogoro. Migogoro ya wanahisa inashughulikiwa kupitia mahakama ya kibiashara, usuluhishi, au mediation — si BRELA. BRELA inasimamia usajili na nyaraka za kisheria, lakini haina mamlaka ya utatuzi wa migogoro kati ya wanahisa.
question_en: BRELA helps resolve shareholder disputes — is this true?
answer_en: No. BRELA is not a dispute resolution body. Shareholder disputes are handled through the commercial court, arbitration, or mediation — not BRELA. BRELA administers registration and legal documents, but has no authority to resolve disputes between shareholders.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Companies Act or arbitration Act update

instruction: GN 487A ilisainiwa tarehe ngapi na ilianza kutumika lini?
output: GN 487A (Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order) ilianza kutumika tarehe 28 Julai 2025 — siku ile ile ilipotangazwa katika Gazeti Rasmi la Serikali (Government Gazette). Hakuna kipindi cha mazoea — sheria ilianza mara moja. Kampeni ya utekelezaji wa kwanza ilianzishwa na Idara ya Uhamiaji tarehe 11 Septemba 2025 na ilikamilika tarehe 8 Oktoba 2025. Kampeni iliisha lakini sheria yenyewe (GN 487A) ni ya kudumu — inatekelezwa kila wakati. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na tangazo rasmi la Serikali.

instruction: NSSF inahesabiwaje? Mwajiri analipa ngapi na mfanyakazi analipa ngapi?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Mfano: mshahara wa TZS 500,000 → Mwajiri: TZS 500,000 × 10% = TZS 50,000. Mfanyakazi: TZS 500,000 × 10% = TZS 50,000 (ikiwa imejumuishwa kwenye mshahara). Jumla ya mchango: TZS 100,000 kwa mwezi.

question_sw: NSSF kwa wafanyakazi wa nusu muda inawasilishwa kwa pamoja na wa muda wote au tofauti?
answer_sw: NSSF inawasilishwa pamoja kwa wafanyakazi wote — wa muda wote, nusu muda, na wa muda mfupi — kwenye orodha moja ya malipo (NSSF contribution schedule). Kila mfanyakazi anaonekana tofauti na namba yake ya NSSF, lakini malipo yote yanapelekwa pamoja kwenye NSSF. Kiwango ni 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla kwa kila mfanyakazi. Tarehe: ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: Is NSSF for part-time workers submitted together with full-time workers or separately?
answer_en: NSSF is submitted together for all employees — full-time, part-time, and casual workers — on one contribution schedule. Each employee appears separately with their NSSF number, but all payments go together to NSSF. Rate: 20% of gross wage per employee. Deadline: within one month after the salary month.

question_sw: Usajili wa BRELA unathibitisha kwamba kampuni inafanya biashara halali na kwa mujibu wa sheria — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. Usajili wa BRELA unathibitisha UWEPO WA KISHERIA wa kampuni — si kwamba inafanya biashara halali. BRELA haifanyi ukaguzi wa shughuli za biashara. Mtu anayefanya biashara na kampuni iliyosajiliwa BRELA bado anahitaji kufanya due diligence yake mwenyewe kuhusu uaminifu wa kampuni.
question_en: BRELA registration confirms that a company is operating legally and in compliance with the law — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely. BRELA registration confirms the LEGAL EXISTENCE of a company — not that it is operating lawfully. BRELA does not audit business activities. A person dealing with a BRELA-registered company still needs to conduct their own due diligence on the company's credibility.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Mgeni anafanya kazi ya delivery kwa app ya Tanzania kama Glovo au Wasoko — GN 487A inahusika?
output: Inategemea hali ya mkanganyiko: kama mgeni ni MWAJIRIWA wa kampuni ya app kama mwajiriwa wa kawaida wenye mshahara — hali hii ni tofauti na kumiliki biashara ya delivery. GN 487A inalenga wamiliki na wadhibiti wa biashara. Lakini kama mgeni ni 'gig worker' huru (self-employed) anayetoa huduma za delivery kupitia app — hii inaweza kuwa biashara ya delivery inayokatazwa (shughuli ya 10 katika orodha ya 15). Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kuhusu hali yako maalum.

instruction: Kampuni yangu haifanyi kazi tena — naweza kuiondoa kwenye rekodi za BRELA?
output: Ndiyo. Mchakato wa kufunga kampuni rasmi (striking off au winding up) unafanywa kupitia BRELA. Kwanza: kodi zote za TRA lazima zilipwe na TRA itoe uthibitisho wa kutokuwa na madeni. Kisha: omba BRELA kwa utaratibu wa striking off (kwa kampuni ndogo zisizofanya biashara) au winding up (kwa kampuni zenye madeni). Kwa fomu maalum na ada za sasa za kufunga kampuni, angalia brela.go.tz.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: P9 inawasilishwa kwa TRA kupitia ujumbe wa simu (SMS) — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. P9 (taarifa ya mwaka ya PAYE) inawasilishwa kupitia mfumo wa kielektroniki wa TRA (TRA Online/e-filing system) au ofisi ya TRA. Ujumbe wa simu peke yake haukubaliki kwa uwasilishaji rasmi wa P9. Wasilisha kupitia njia sahihi za TRA.
question_en: P9 is submitted to TRA via SMS — is this correct?
answer_en: No. P9 (annual PAYE return) is submitted through TRA's electronic system (TRA Online/e-filing) or at a TRA office. SMS alone is not accepted for formal P9 submission. Use TRA's approved submission channels.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayeumia mahali pa kazi Tanzania analipwa fidia na OSHA moja kwa moja — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Fidia ya mfanyakazi aliyeumia mahali pa kazi inalipwa na WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — SI OSHA. OSHA inasimamia usalama na afya mahali pa kazi na inachunguza ajali. WCF ndiyo inayolipa fidia kwa wafanyakazi walioumia au kufiwa. OSHA na WCF ni vyombo tofauti vya serikali vinavyofanya kazi tofauti.
question_en: A worker injured in the workplace in Tanzania is paid compensation directly by OSHA — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Compensation for a worker injured in the workplace is paid by WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) — NOT OSHA. OSHA supervises workplace safety and health and investigates accidents. WCF is what pays compensation to injured or bereaved workers. OSHA and WCF are separate government bodies doing different work.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act or WCF Act amendment

question_sw: Je, EAC Simplified Trade Regime inafanya kazi vipi kwa biashara ya mpakani?
answer_sw: Maswali ya EAC Simplified Trade Regime (STR) yanaingia katika Tier 1B ya msaada wangu — ambayo bado haijafunguliwa. Kwa sasa ninashughulikia maswali ya kodi za ndani za Tanzania Bara (Tier 1A): VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, GN 487A, EFD. Kwa STR, tembelea eac.int au wasiliana na ofisi za forodha za karibu nawe. Je, una swali la kodi ya ndani Tanzania?
question_en: How does the EAC Simplified Trade Regime work for cross-border trade?
answer_en: EAC Simplified Trade Regime (STR) questions fall under Tier 1B of my assistance — which is not yet open. I currently handle Tanzania Mainland domestic tax questions (Tier 1A): VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, GN 487A, EFD. For STR, visit eac.int or contact your nearest customs office. Do you have a Tanzania domestic tax question?

question_sw: Wakaguzi wa TRA wanaweza kuja biashara yangu lini?
answer_sw: TRA inspectors wana haki ya kutembelea biashara yoyote wakati wowote wa saa za kazi (business hours) — bila tangazo la mapema (without prior notice) kwa ukaguzi wa EFD na kodi. Wanaweza kuangalia EFD yako, kuomba Z-reports, na kukagua rekodi za akaunti. Kama unafanya biashara kwa kanuni, ukaguzi haupaswi kukuumiza. Uhifadhi bora wa rekodi na matumizi sahihi ya EFD ndiyo ulinzi bora.
question_en: When can TRA inspectors visit my business?
answer_en: TRA inspectors have the right to visit any business at any time during business hours — without prior notice — for EFD and tax inspections. They can inspect your EFD, request Z-reports, and review accounting records. If you operate by the rules, an inspection should not cause you problems. Good record keeping and proper EFD use is the best protection.

question_sw: Mwanahisa mmoja anamuuzia mwingine hisa zake. Je, BRELA inahitaji taarifa ya uhamishaji huu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uhamishaji wa hisa kati ya wanahisa lazima uripotiwe BRELA. Mchakato ni: kuandaa hati ya uhamishaji wa hisa (instrument of transfer), kupiga stempu hati hiyo (kodi ya stempu ya 1% — ona Stamp Duty Act), kuwasilisha taarifa ya mabadiliko ya wanahisa kwa BRELA, na kusasisha daftari la wanahisa (register of members) la kampuni. BRELA itasasisha rekodi na kutoa uthibitisho wa mabadiliko ya umiliki. Bila taarifa ya BRELA, uhamishaji unaweza kukosa nguvu ya kisheria dhidi ya watu wa tatu.
answer_en: Yes. Transfer of shares between shareholders must be reported to BRELA. The process is: prepare an instrument of transfer, stamp the instrument (1% stamp duty — see Stamp Duty Act), file a shareholder change notification with BRELA, and update the company's register of members. BRELA will update records and issue confirmation of the ownership change. Without BRELA notification, the transfer may lack legal effect against third parties.
question_en: One shareholder sells their shares to another. Does BRELA need to be notified of this transfer?

question_sw: NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa wafanyakazi wanaopata overtime?
answer_sw: Mshahara wa overtime unajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa mshahara mkubwa wa jumla kwa NSSF. Yaani: NSSF = (mshahara wa msingi + overtime + malipo mengine yoyote yanayolipwa kawaida) × 20%. Msingi ni mshahara mkubwa wa jumla — si mshahara wa msingi peke yake. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10%. Tarehe ya mwisho: ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: How is NSSF calculated for employees who receive overtime?
answer_en: Overtime wages are included in the gross wage base for NSSF. That is: NSSF = (basic salary + overtime + any other regularly paid allowances) × 20%. The base is total gross wage — not basic salary alone. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10%. Deadline: within one month after the salary month.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ni ya kwanza kukosea kulipa PAYE kwa mwezi mmoja tu. TRA itatoa samahani ya adhabu?
answer_sw: Walipa kodi wa mara ya kwanza (first-time offenders) wanaowasiliana na TRA kwa hiari kabla ya hatua za utekelezaji na ambao wana rekodi nzuri ya utii wa kodi wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kupata samahani au upunguzaji wa adhabu. Kwa kesi ya PAYE iliyochelewa mara moja: lipa PAYE yote ya msingi pamoja na riba ya kuchelewa, kisha omba rasmi samahani ya adhabu ukitaja historia yako nzuri ya utii. TRA inazingatia kila kesi kwa mtu binafsi. Samahani si ya lazima kisheria — ni uamuzi wa Kamishna. Kujitokeza mapema na kwa hiari ni sababu kubwa ya mafanikio ya ombi. Hii si haki ya kisheria bali ni uamuzi wa hiari wa Kamishna — hakuna uhakika wa kupata msamaha.
answer_en: First-time offenders who proactively approach TRA before enforcement steps and who have a good compliance history have a higher chance of receiving a waiver or reduction of penalties. For a single late PAYE case: pay all principal PAYE plus late payment interest, then formally apply for a penalty waiver citing your good compliance history. TRA considers each case individually. A waiver is not a legal right — it is the Commissioner's discretionary decision. Coming forward early and voluntarily is a major factor in a successful application. This is not a legal right but a discretionary decision of the Commissioner — there is no guarantee of a waiver.
question_en: My company is a first-time offender for failing to pay PAYE for just one month. Will TRA grant a penalty waiver?

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu unalipwa kwenye bei ya mauzo au thamani ya soko — lipi ni kubwa?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unahesabiwa kwa kuzingatia KIASI KIKUBWA ZAIDI kati ya (a) bei ya mauzo iliyoandikwa kwenye mkataba, au (b) thamani ya soko ya mali. Hii inazuia uwezekano wa kupunguza thamani iliyoandikwa ili kulipa ushuru mdogo zaidi. TRA inaweza kutathmini thamani ya soko yenyewe ikiwa inaamini thamani iliyoandikwa ni ndogo kupita kiasi.
question_en: Is stamp duty calculated on the sale price or market value — which is greater?
answer_en: Tanzania stamp duty is calculated on whichever is GREATER of: (a) the sale price written in the contract, or (b) the market value of the property. This prevents the possibility of understating the written value to pay less duty. TRA can assess market value itself if it believes the stated value is unreasonably low.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania hulipwa kwenye thamani ya ardhi TU au pia kwenye majengo yaliyo juu ya ardhi hiyo?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1 unahesabiwa kwenye THAMANI YA JUMLA ya uhamishaji — yaani thamani ya ardhi NA majengo yote yaliyo juu yake pamoja. Haigawanywi ardhi na majengo kwa madhumuni ya ushuru wa stempu. Thamani ya mali yote inayohamishwa (ardhi + majengo) ndiyo msingi wa kuhesabu ushuru.
question_en: Is Tanzania stamp duty paid on the land value ONLY or also on the buildings on it?
answer_en: The 1% stamp duty is calculated on the TOTAL transfer value — meaning the value of the land AND all buildings on it combined. There is no separation of land and buildings for stamp duty purposes. The value of the entire property being transferred (land + buildings) is the basis for the calculation.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyekuwa amelipwa nusu mshahara wakati wa ugonjwa — NSSF inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa mshahara uliolipwa halisi. Ikiwa mfanyakazi alilipwa nusu mshahara (50%) wakati wa ugonjwa, NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa nusu mshahara hiyo: (nusu mshahara) × 20% = NSSF. Mwajiri 10% na mfanyakazi 10% ya mshahara uliodhalilishwa. Tarehe ya mwisho inabaki ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: An employee was paid half salary during illness — how is NSSF calculated?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated on actual wages paid. If an employee was paid half salary (50%) during illness, NSSF is calculated on that half salary: (half salary) × 20% = NSSF. Employer 10% and employee 10% on the reduced salary. The deadline remains within one month after the salary month.

instruction: Biashara yangu imefungwa na TRA kwa kukosa risiti za EFD — inafunguliwa vipi?
output: Kufungwa kwa biashara na TRA kwa ukiukwaji wa EFD kunahitaji: (1) Kulipa faini zote na adhabu zilizotolewa na TRA; (2) Kuwasilisha maelezo ya jinsi utakavyozingatia sheria ya EFD siku zijazo (compliance plan); (3) Kupata idhini ya TRA ya ufunguzi tena — kwa kawaida kwa barua rasmi; (4) Kuhakikisha EFD inafanya kazi vizuri kabla ya kufungua. Mchakato mzima unaweza kuchukua siku kadhaa hadi wiki. Wakati biashara imefungwa, hakuna mauzo yanayoweza kufanywa kisheria. Wasiliana na TRA mara moja na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Mchakato halisi wa kufungua tena baada ya closure ya TRA unategemea aina ya ukiukwaji na maamuzi ya TRA. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) moja kwa moja kwa mwongozo wa kesi yako maalum. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 bado inatumika Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Amri ya mishahara ya 2022 ilifutwa rasmi kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2026 wakati GN 605A ilipoanza kutumika. Mwajiri anayendelea kulipa kwa viwango vya 2022 anakiuka sheria. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Is the 2022 wage order still valid in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. The 2022 wage order was formally revoked from 1 January 2026 when GN 605A came into force. An employer continuing to pay at 2022 rates is violating the law. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mfumo wa pension ya serikali (Government Pension Fund — GEPF) — jinsi unavyofanya kazi?
answer_sw: GEPF (Government Employees Provident Fund) ni mfumo wa pensheni kwa watumishi wa serikali. Ina kanuni tofauti na NSSF (ambayo ni kwa sekta binafsi). Sina uhakika wa masharti ya sasa ya GEPF — kutoa mchango, faida, na kanuni za kustaafu. Thibitisha na GEPF au Hazina.
question_en: The Government Pension Fund (GEPF) — how does it work?
answer_en: GEPF (Government Employees Provident Fund) is a pension scheme for government employees. It has different rules from NSSF (which covers the private sector). I am not certain of current GEPF rules — contributions, benefits, and retirement conditions. Verify with GEPF or the Treasury.

instruction: Biashara yangu imebadilisha EFD (machine mpya) — ninahitaji kusajili upya kwa TRA?
output: Ndiyo — EFD mpya inahitaji kusajiliwa upya kwa TRA kabla ya kutumika kwa madhumuni ya kodi. TRA lazima ijue kwamba EFD ya zamani imebadilishwa na mpya imewekwa — ili rekodi za TIMS zielewe mabadiliko. Hatua za kufuata: (1) Arifu TRA kwamba EFD ya zamani imeachwa; (2) Wasilisha EFD mpya kwa TRA kwa usajili; (3) Pata nambari ya usajili ya EFD mpya kabla ya kutumika; (4) Hifadhi rekodi za EFD ya zamani — TRA inaweza kuzihitaji kwa ukaguzi. Kutumia EFD mpya bila kusajili kwa TRA ni kosa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na muuzaji wa EFD.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kudai input VAT ya miaka iliyopita ambayo haikudaiwa wakati wake?
answer_sw: Kuna ukomo wa muda (time limit) wa kudai input VAT. Tanzania inatumia ukomo wa miaka 3 kwa marekebisho ya kodi kwa ujumla. Input VAT isiyodaiwa baada ya ukomo huu inaweza kupotea. Thibitisha ukomo halisi wa sasa na TRA au mshauri wa kodi — na jaribu kudai input VAT kwa wakati wake kila mwezi.
question_en: Can I claim input VAT from past years that was not claimed at the time?
answer_en: There is a time limit for claiming input VAT. Tanzania generally applies a 3-year limit for tax amendments. Unclaimed input VAT after this limit may be forfeited. Confirm the current exact limit with TRA or a tax advisor — and try to claim input VAT on time each month.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Ndani ya muda gani hati lazima ipigwe stempu baada ya kutiwa saini?
answer_sw: Hati zote zinazohitaji kodi ya stempu zilizotiwa saini Tanzania lazima zipigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 (thelathini) baada ya kutiwa saini. Kama hati imetiwa saini nje ya Tanzania lakini inahusiana na mali au jambo linalofanywa Tanzania, nayo lazima ipigwe stempu ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kuingia Tanzania. Wakati wa kupeleka hati kwa Afisa wa Stempu kwa tathmini (adjudication), siku hizo hazihesabiwi kwenye siku 30.
answer_en: All instruments requiring stamp duty that are signed in Tanzania must be stamped within 30 (thirty) days of signing. If an instrument is signed outside Tanzania but relates to property or a matter performed in Tanzania, it must also be stamped within 30 days of entering Tanzania. The time period during which the instrument is lodged with the Stamp Duty Officer for adjudication is excluded from the 30-day period.
question_en: Within what period must a document be stamped after it is signed?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — 30-day rule

question_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kuweka rekodi gani za PAYE?
answer_sw: Mwajiri lazima aweke: orodha ya wafanyakazi na TIN zao, hesabu za mishahara, hesabu za PAYE kwa kila mfanyakazi, stakabadhi za malipo ya TRA, na fomu za PAYE P9. Rekodi hizi zinahifadhiwa kwa miaka 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What PAYE records must an employer maintain?
answer_en: An employer must keep: employee list with their TINs, payroll calculations, PAYE calculations per employee, TRA payment receipts, and PAYE P9 forms. Records must be kept for 5 years. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Mwanagenzi (agent) wa bima analipwa commission — je, commission inakatwa VAT?
output: Commission ya wakala wa bima ni mapato ya huduma — kwa hivyo inaweza kukatwa VAT kama wakala amefika kizingiti cha VAT au amesajiliwa VAT. Ikiwa wakala wa bima ni mwanachama wa taaluma inayolazimishwa na TRA — inawezekana kusajili VAT hata bila kufika kizingiti cha TZS 200M. VAT kwa commission ya bima: ikiwa amesajiliwa VAT, anatoza 18% VAT kwa commission yake. Mteja anayehitimu anaweza kudai input VAT. Ikiwa bado hajafika kizingiti na si katika taaluma inayolazimishwa — bado halazimiki. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na TIRA (tira.go.tz).

instruction: Nikiwasilisha risiti ya EFD kwa malipo ya kawaida tu — malipo ya simu ninaweza kuacha?
output: Malipo ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) yanahitaji risiti ya EFD kama malipo ya kawaida. Njia ya malipo haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti — kila muamala wa mauzo lazima upate risiti ya EFD. Huwezi kuacha malipo ya simu — lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa KILA mauzo. Ukiacha malipo ya simu bila risiti ya EFD, unafanya ukiukaji wa sheria ya kodi, ambao unaweza kusababisha faini ya TRA.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya kilimo inaajiri wafanyakazi wa msimu tu (seasonal workers) — SDL inatumika vipi?
output: Kwa wafanyakazi wa msimu, SDL inatumika kwa miezi ya msimu tu — wakati wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi na idadi yao ikiwa 10 au zaidi. Kwa miezi ambapo wafanyakazi wa msimu hawafanyi kazi (idadi chini ya 10), SDL haihitajiki kwa miezi hiyo. Kwa vitendo: hesabu idadi ya wafanyakazi kila mwezi — miezi ya msimu (wafanyakazi 10 na zaidi) lipa SDL; miezi ya amani (chini ya 10) SDL haihitajiki. Thibitisha utaratibu huu na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: BRELA na halmashauri (LGA) — leseni kutoka kwa wapi?
answer_sw: Kuna leseni mbili tofauti zinazohitajika. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency): inasajili KAMPUNI au BIASHARA kwa kitaifa — unasajili jina, wamiliki, muundo wa kisheria. LGA (Halmashauri ya Wilaya): inatoa LESENI ya biashara ya kufanya shughuli katika eneo husika. BRELA inatoa usajili wa kitaifa; halmashauri inatoa leseni ya eneo. Zote mbili zinahitajika.
question_en: BRELA and local council (LGA) — which one issues a business licence?
answer_en: Two different registrations are required. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency): registers the COMPANY or BUSINESS at national level — you register the name, owners, legal structure. LGA (District Council): issues the BUSINESS LICENCE to operate in a specific area. BRELA provides national registration; the council provides area-specific licensing. Both are required.

instruction: Mhasibu (CPA) aliyesajiliwa Tanzania anahitaji kusajili VAT hata kama ana wateja wachache?
output: Ndio — wataalamu walioidhinishwa (CPA, wakili, wahandisi) mara nyingi wanazingatiwa na TRA kwa VAT bila kujali kizingiti cha mauzo. Hali ya CPA: TRA inaweza kuhitaji usajili wa VAT kulingana na aina ya huduma na hali ya leseni. Thibitisha hali yako maalum na TRA — wataalamu wanaosajiliwa wana mwongozo maalum.

question_sw: Kazi ya ziada (overtime) inalipwa PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Malipo ya kazi ya ziada yanajumuishwa katika jumla ya mapato ya mwezi na yanastahili PAYE kwa kiwango kinacholingana na kanda ya mapato. Hakuna kiwango maalum cha PAYE kwa overtime peke yake. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Is overtime pay subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Overtime pay is included in total monthly earnings and is subject to PAYE at the applicable rate band. There is no separate PAYE rate for overtime. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: GN 487A inaathiri Watanzania wote? Au ni wageni wa nchi fulani tu?
answer_sw: GN 487A inawahusu WAGENI (raia wa kigeni) WOTE — bila kujali utaifa wao. Inazuia raia wa Kenya, China, India, Uropa, na nchi yoyote nyingine kufanya biashara zilizoorodheshwa. Watanzania wote (wa asili na wenye uraia) hawaathiriwi na vikwazo vya GN 487A kwa biashara. Hivyo, utaifa si kigezo — uraia wa Tanzania ndicho kigezo.
question_en: Does GN 487A affect all Tanzanians? Or only non-citizens from certain countries?
answer_en: GN 487A applies to ALL NON-CITIZENS (foreign nationals) — regardless of their nationality. It prohibits citizens of Kenya, China, India, Europe, and any other country from conducting the listed businesses. All Tanzanians (by birth or naturalisation) are unaffected by GN 487A business prohibitions. So nationality is not the criterion — Tanzanian citizenship is the criterion.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania yenye makao makuu Mombasa Kenya — inaweza kusajiliwa Tanzania bila tawi (branch) rasmi?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya kigeni inayofanya shughuli Tanzania inahitaji kusajili tawi lake (foreign branch) kwa BRELA Tanzania. Kampuni ya Kenya inayouza bidhaa au kutoa huduma Tanzania kwa njia ya kawaida ya biashara lazima isajili tawi la Tanzania. Kampuni isiyosajili tawi inafanya shughuli nje ya sheria na inaweza kusababisha matatizo ya kodi na kisheria kwa Tanzania.
question_en: A Tanzania company with headquarters in Mombasa Kenya — can it operate in Tanzania without a formal branch?
answer_en: A foreign company conducting business in Tanzania needs to register its branch (foreign branch) with BRELA Tanzania. A Kenya company regularly selling goods or providing services in Tanzania must register a Tanzania branch. A company that does not register a branch is operating outside the law and can create tax and legal problems in Tanzania.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Companies Act or foreign branch registration update

question_sw: Je, biashara inaweza kupata msamaha wa kodi kwa kuwa biashara ya wanawake Tanzania?
answer_sw: Sheria za kodi za Tanzania hazitoi msamaha wa jumla wa kodi tu kwa sababu biashara inamilikiwa na mwanamke. Hata hivyo, kuna vitu vinavyosaidia biashara za wanawake: NMB Bank na DFI pakiti (IFC/BII) zinasaidia biashara za wanawake kwa mikopo, baadhi ya programu za maendeleo zinaweza kutoa ruzuku zisizo za kodi. Uzingatiaji wa kodi bado unahitajika kwa biashara zote.
question_en: Can a business get tax exemption for being a women-owned business in Tanzania?
answer_en: Tanzania tax laws do not provide a general tax exemption simply because a business is women-owned. However, there are things that help women-owned businesses: NMB Bank and DFI packages (IFC/BII) support women's businesses with loans, some development programmes may offer non-tax grants. Tax compliance is still required for all businesses.

question_sw: Ni wafanyakazi wa aina gani wanahitaji uchunguzi wa afya wa mara kwa mara?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi katika mazingira hatari — kemikali, vumbi la madini, kelele kali, au mionzi — wanalazimika kupata uchunguzi wa afya wa mara kwa mara. Mwajiri anawajibika kupanga na kulipa kwa uchunguzi huu.
question_en: Which workers require regular health surveillance?
answer_en: Workers in hazardous environments — chemicals, mineral dust, excessive noise, or radiation — must undergo periodic health surveillance. The employer is responsible for arranging and paying for these examinations.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: VAT withholding ni nini na kiwango chake ni kiasi gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: VAT withholding ni mfumo ambapo mnunuzi (mwenye leseni ya kuzuia VAT) anamzuia msambazaji sehemu ya VAT na kuipeleka TRA moja kwa moja. Kiwango: asilimia 3 kwa bidhaa na asilimia 6 kwa huduma, kuanzia 1 Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). VAT ya kawaida ni asilimia 18 — withholding ni sehemu tu inayozuiwa, si kiwango kipya cha VAT.
question_en: What is VAT withholding and what is its rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: VAT withholding is a system where the buyer (designated withholding agent) withholds a portion of VAT from the supplier and remits it directly to TRA. Rate: 3% on goods and 6% on services, effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Standard VAT remains 18% — withholding is a portion withheld, not a new VAT rate.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu anapata mshahara wa TZS 500,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE yake ni kiasi gani?
output:
PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 500,000 kwa mwezi inakokotolewa kwa kanda za PAYE kama ifuatavyo:

Kanda 1 (0%): TZS 0 hadi 270,000 — kodi = TZS 0
Kanda 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 hadi 500,000 — TZS 230,000 x 8% = TZS 18,400

Jumla ya PAYE = TZS 18,400 kwa mwezi.

PAYE hii inakatwa mshahara wa mfanyakazi na kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Je, GN 487A inaadhibu tu mgeni anayekiuka -- raia wa Tanzania asiye na hatari?
output: Hapana. GN 487A inaadhibu WOTE WAWILI -- mgeni NA raia wa Tanzania anayemwezesha. Mgeni anapata: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, pamoja na uwezekano wa kufutwa kwa visa. Raia wa Tanzania (msaidizi) anapata: faini ya TZS milioni 5 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 3. Kukopa jina ni kosa la kisheria. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

instruction: Kampuni mama yangu nje ya Tanzania inanipa mkopo wa TZS 500M — riba ya asilimia ngapi TRA itakubaliana nayo?
output: Kanuni ya msingi ya transfer pricing Tanzania ni arm's length principle katika Income Tax Act Sehemu 33 — miamala kati ya kampuni zinazohusiana lazima ifanane na bei za soko. Kwa uchambuzi wa kesi yako: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kiwango cha riba kinachokubalika kwa mikopo ya kimataifa kati ya kampuni zilizounganishwa ni suala la transfer pricing na kodi ya kimataifa inayohitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Z-report ya EFD inapigwa wakati gani — mwisho wa siku au asubuhi ya kesho?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Z-report inafunga muhtasari wa mauzo ya siku hiyo yote na kuutuma kwa TRA kupitia TIMS (mfumo wa mtandao). Ukiipiga asubuhi ya kesho: muhtasari wa siku moja utakosekana kwenye rekodi za TRA.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unalipwa kwa shilingi au unaweza kulipwa kwa dola za Marekani?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unalipwa kwa SHILINGI YA TANZANIA (TZS) — si dola. Hata kama muamala wenyewe ulifanywa kwa dola (kwa mfano, mauzo ya ardhi kwa USD), kiasi cha ushuru kinabadilishwa kulingana na kiwango cha ubadilishaji wa Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BoT) siku ya malipo.
question_en: Is Tanzania stamp duty paid in Tanzanian shillings or can it be paid in US dollars?
answer_en: Tanzania stamp duty is paid in TANZANIAN SHILLINGS (TZS) — not dollars. Even if the underlying transaction was in dollars (for example, a land sale in USD), the duty amount is converted at the Bank of Tanzania (BoT) exchange rate on the payment date.

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje inayofanya biashara Tanzania tu kwa mtandao — ina wajibu wa kusajiliwa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hili ni suala la kisheria la 'permanent establishment' (PE). Kampuni ya nje inayotoa huduma Tanzania kwa mtandao tu inaweza au isihitajike kusajiliwa Tanzania kulingana na PE analysis. Sina uhakika wa mwelekeo halisi wa sheria ya Tanzania kwa kesi hii. Thibitisha na mwanasheria wa biashara au TRA.
question_en: A foreign company doing business in Tanzania only via internet — must it register in Tanzania?
answer_en: This is a legal 'permanent establishment' (PE) question. A foreign company providing services in Tanzania only via internet may or may not need to register in Tanzania depending on the PE analysis. I am not certain of Tanzania's current legal position on this. Verify with a business lawyer or TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni inayofanya kazi kwenye jengo la kukodi inahitaji kupata idhini ya OSHA kwa jengo hilo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, mwajiri aliyekodi jengo ana wajibu wa kuhakikisha mazingira ya kazi yanafuata viwango vya OSHA — hata kama hajamiliki jengo. Ikiwa jengo lina hatari za kimuundo (kama umeme mbaya, paa yenye hatari, njia za dharura zilizofungwa), mwajiri anaweza kuzungumza na mmiliki wa jengo LAKINI bado ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kulinda wafanyakazi wake. OSHA inaweza kukagua mahali pa kazi bila kujali nani anamiliki jengo.
question_en: Does a company working in a rented building need to get OSHA approval for that building in Tanzania?
answer_en: Generally, an employer who rents a building has an obligation to ensure the work environment meets OSHA standards — even if they don't own the building. If the building has structural hazards (such as faulty electrics, dangerous roof, blocked emergency exits), the employer can speak to the building owner BUT still has a legal duty to protect their workers. OSHA can inspect a workplace regardless of who owns the building.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Mashirika ya kidini na ya hisani (charitable) hayalazimishwi na mchakato wa pingamizi la kodi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mashirika ya kidini na ya hisani yanayolazimishwa na kodi au yanayopokea tathmini ya kodi (hata ikiwa yanaamini wana msamaha) yalazimike kufuata mchakato ule ule wa pingamizi — yaani kuwasilisha ndani ya siku 30 na kulipa 1/3. Madai ya msamaha yanashughulikiwa kama sehemu ya maudhui ya pingamizi.
question_en: Religious and charitable organisations are not required to follow the tax objection process — is this true?
answer_en: No. Religious and charitable organisations that are assessed for tax (even if they believe they have an exemption) must follow the same objection process — filing within 30 days and paying 1/3. Exemption claims are addressed as part of the substance of the objection.

question_sw: Je, biashara ndogo (SME) inaweza kudai VAT refund bila mshauri wa kodi?
answer_sw: Technically, ndiyo — hakuna sheria inayohitaji mshauri wa kodi kudai VAT refund. Hata hivyo, kwa madai makubwa au ya ngumu, mshauri wa kodi au akaunti aliyesajiliwa anaweza kusaidia sana kupunguza makosa na kuongeza mafanikio ya madai. Kwa madai rahisi ya exporter, biashara inaweza kujaribu mwenyewe baada ya kushauriana na TRA.
question_en: Can a small business (SME) claim a VAT refund without a tax advisor?
answer_en: Technically yes — there is no law requiring a tax advisor to claim a VAT refund. However, for large or complex claims, a registered tax advisor or accountant can greatly reduce errors and increase claim success. For straightforward exporter claims, a business can try independently after consulting with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: SDL 3.5% inakokotolewa kutoka kwa mshahara gani — halisi au kiwango cha chini cha GN605A?
output: SDL ya 3.5% inakokotolewa kutoka jumla halisi ya malipo ya fedha (gross cash emoluments) unayolipa mfanyakazi — si kutoka kiwango cha chini cha GN605A. Kwa hivyo kama unalipa zaidi ya kiwango cha chini, SDL inakokotolewa kutoka mshahara halisi unaolipwa. SDL inatumika kwa wajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi kwenye Tanzania Bara. Kwa msaada wa mahesabu ya SDL, wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi au TRA (tra.go.tz).
