instruction: NSSF imesajili wafanyakazi wote lakini mwezi huu kampuni haina fedha za kulipa — inafanyaje?
output: Hali hii inahitaji hatua haraka: (1) Wasiliana na NSSF MAPEMA — kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho — eleza hali na omba muda wa ziada au mpango wa malipo (payment plan); (2) NSSF ina uwezo wa kupanga ratiba ya malipo kwa hali za dharura — lakini omba kabla ya kukosekana, si baada; (3) Faini ya 5%/mwezi itaanza kuhesabiwa siku ya kuchelewa — ukiwasiliana mapema, NSSF inaweza kupunguza faini; (4) Toa kipaumbele kwa malipo ya NSSF — ni haki za wafanyakazi, si kodi ya kawaida. Kumbuka: mwajiri anakusanya sehemu ya mfanyakazi (10%) tayari — pesa hizo si za mwajiri. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni yetu iko katika Eneo la Usindikaji wa Uuzaji Nje (EPZ). Je, tunalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Kampuni zilizo ndani ya Eneo la Usindikaji wa Uuzaji Nje (Export Processing Zone — EPZ) zina msamaha wa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kulingana na faida za EPZ. Msamaha huu ni sehemu ya vivutio vya uwekezaji vya EPZ Tanzania. Thibitisha hali yako ya msamaha na EPZ Authority na TRA kwa maandishi kabla ya kusimama kulipa SDL.
question_en: Our company is in an Export Processing Zone (EPZ). Do we pay SDL?
answer_en: Companies located within an Export Processing Zone (EPZ) are exempt from SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — as part of the EPZ investment incentives package. This exemption is part of Tanzania's EPZ investment incentives. Confirm your exemption status in writing with the EPZ Authority and TRA before stopping SDL payments.

question_sw: Mwajiri anayeomba Darasa B lazima athibitishe kwamba alitangaza kazi nchini Tanzania kwanza?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri lazima aonyeshe ushahidi kwamba alijaribu kuajiri Mtanzania wenye sifa kabla ya kuomba mfanyakazi wa kigeni. Hii mara nyingi inajumuisha: nakala za matangazo ya kazi (newspapers, job boards), rekodi za waombaji wa Tanzania waliohojiwa, na maelezo ya kwa nini hawakuwa na sifa. Hii ni sehemu muhimu ya ombi la Darasa B.
question_en: Must an employer applying for Class B prove they advertised the job in Tanzania first?
answer_en: Yes. The employer must show evidence of attempting to recruit a qualified Tanzanian before applying for a foreign worker. This typically includes: copies of job advertisements (newspapers, job boards), records of Tanzanian applicants interviewed, and explanation of why they were not qualified. This is a critical part of any Class B application.

instruction: GN 605A imeinua mishahara — je, hii inaathiri kizingiti cha VAT cha TZS 200M?
output: Hapana — kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT (TZS 200M kwa mwaka au TZS 100M kwa miezi 6) hakibadiliki kwa sababu ya ongezeko la mishahara ya GN 605A. Kizingiti cha VAT kinahesabu MAPATO ya biashara (mauzo ya bidhaa au huduma), si malipo ya wafanyakazi. GN 605A iliathiri mishahara ya wafanyakazi (ikainua mshahara wa chini) — hii inaongeza gharama za biashara na inaweza kupunguza faida — lakini haibadilishi kizingiti cha VAT. Hata hivyo, kama ongezeko la mishahara linafanya biashara kupandisha bei, na bei hizo zinaongeza mapato ya jumla hadi zaidi ya TZS 200M — ndipo kizingiti cha VAT kinahusika. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mwajiri anayetoa mshahara wa mgeni — anaweza kuficha mshahara fulani kutoka PAYE?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mwajiri anahitaji kujumuisha MAPATO YOTE ya ajira — mshahara wa msingi, posho, manufaa, na malipo mengine — kwenye hesabu ya PAYE. Kuficha sehemu ya mshahara au manufaa TRA ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya PAYE na unaweza kusababisha adhabu na deni la PAYE.
question_en: An employer paying a foreign employee — can they hide part of the salary from PAYE?
answer_en: No. The employer must include ALL employment income — basic salary, allowances, benefits, and other payments — in the PAYE calculation. Concealing part of the salary or benefits from TRA is a violation of PAYE law and can result in penalties and PAYE arrears.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Annual return ya BRELA inapaswa kuwasilishwa tarehe gani kila mwaka?
output: Annual return ya BRELA inawasilishwa kila mwaka -- kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni (anniversary date), si tarehe maalum ya kalenda inayotumika kwa kampuni zote. Kila kampuni ina tarehe yake ya kumbukumbu. Ada ya uwasilishaji ni kama TZS 22,000 -- thibitisha tarehe yako maalum na ada za sasa na BRELA (brela.go.tz au ors.brela.go.tz).

question_sw: Aina za vibali vya kazi Tanzania ni zipi?
answer_sw: Tanzania ina aina kuu za vibali vya kazi kwa wageni: Darasa A (mwekezaji/biashara binafsi), Darasa B (mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa na kampuni), Darasa C (muda mfupi/mkataba wa muda), Darasa D (utafiti/uchunguzi wa madini), Darasa E (tegemezi wa mhitimu wa kibali), na Darasa G (huduma ya umma). Kila darasa lina mahitaji na ada tofauti.
question_en: What are the classes of work permits in Tanzania?
answer_en: Tanzania has main work permit classes for foreigners: Class A (investor/self-employment), Class B (employed by a company), Class C (short-term/contract), Class D (research/prospecting), Class E (dependant of permit holder), and Class G (public service). Each class has different requirements and fees.
next_review_trigger: Immigration Act amendment or fee update

question_sw: P9 form na P9A form — ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: P9 form: hati ya muhtasari wa kodi ya kila mwaka inayotolewa na mwajiri kwa mfanyakazi — inaonyesha jumla ya mapato na PAYE iliyokatwa mwaka mzima. Inatakiwa kabla ya 31 Machi. P9A: ni toleo la zamani au fomu ya ziada kwa hali maalum — matumizi yake yanategemea kanuni za sasa za TRA. Thibitisha fomu inayohitajika sasa na TRA.
question_en: P9 form and P9A form — what is the difference?
answer_en: P9 form: an annual tax summary document issued by the employer to the employee — showing total income and PAYE deducted for the whole year. Required before 31 March. P9A: an older version or supplementary form for specific situations — its current use depends on current TRA rules. Verify the currently required form with TRA.

instruction: Ninaanzisha biashara ya kusambaza vifaa vya ujenzi na serikali ni mbia wangu mkuu. Niandae vipi?
output: Jiandae hivi: (1) Sajili VAT kama mauzo yako yanafika kizingiti (TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6); (2) Andaa mfumo wa kuhifadhi certificates za withholding utakazozipata kutoka withholding agents; (3) Panga cash flow yako kwa kuzingatia utalipwa kidogo kuliko invoice; (4) Tumia certificates kudai pembejeo ya VAT kwenye return yako ifikapo tarehe 20; (5) Thibitisha kiwango cha withholding na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

instruction: VAT Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kiwango kinachotumika zaidi ni 18% (standard rate). Kwa bidhaa na huduma zinazouzwa nje ya Tanzania: 0% (zero-rated, unastahili rejareja ya VAT). Chanzo: TRA (tra.go.tz) na Finance Act 2025.

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara asiyejua tofauti ya zero-rated na exempt anaweza kupoteza nini?
answer_sw: Anaweza kupoteza input VAT yake. Mfanyabiashara anayedhani mauzo yake ni 'exempt' (wakati yako zero-rated) anaweza kushindwa kudai input VAT anayostahili — anapoteza pesa halisi. Na kinyume chake, mfanyabiashara anayedhani mauzo yake ni 'zero-rated' (wakati yako exempt) anaweza kudai input VAT isiyostahiliwa — akabiliane na adhabu. Ujuzi wa tofauti hii ni muhimu.
question_en: What can a business lose by not knowing the difference between zero-rated and exempt?
answer_en: They can lose their input VAT. A business that thinks its sales are 'exempt' (when they are actually zero-rated) may fail to claim input VAT it is entitled to — losing real money. Conversely, a business that thinks its sales are 'zero-rated' (when they are exempt) may claim unentitled input VAT — and face penalties. Understanding this distinction is critical.

instruction: EFD — kuna leseni ya kila mwaka au ni ya kudumu baada ya kusajiliwa mara moja?
output: EFD inasajiliwa mara moja kwa TRA — si leseni ya kila mwaka. Hata hivyo, TRA inaweza kuhitaji: (1) Usasishaji (update) wa programu ya EFD kila mara inapotolewa na TRA au muuzaji; (2) Uhakika wa mfumo (compliance check) kama TRA inabadilisha mahitaji; (3) Kubadilisha EFD kama toleo la zamani linafutwa msaada. Pia kama EFD inaharibiwa au inaibiwa — inabidi kusajili upya kwa TRA. Malipo ya ziada ya kila mwaka yanaweza kuwa kwa muuzaji wa EFD kwa huduma ya matengenezo — si TRA. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na muuzaji wako wa EFD.

instruction: GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe ngapi hasa?
output:
GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 JANUARI 2026 — si Septemba 2025 wala Oktoba 2025. Tarehe mbili muhimu za kuelewa:

Tarehe 13 Oktoba 2025: GN 605A ilitangazwa rasmi (gazetted) kwenye Gazeti la Serikali.
Tarehe 1 Januari 2026: GN 605A ilianza kutumika (effective date) — viwango vipya vya mshahara wa chini vilianza kulazimika kisheria.

Tarehe za 2025 mara nyingi zinachanganywa na tarehe nyingine kama vile tarehe ya Finance Act 2025. Kumbuka: GN 605A ilianza 1 Januari 2026, si kabla ya hapo. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa, VELMA Law, au TanzLII.

instruction: NSSF inawezesha mgeni kujisajili mwenyewe kwa hiari — hii inamaanisha ana haki za kufanya biashara Tanzania?
output: Hapana — usajili wa NSSF (hiari au wa lazima) ni mfumo wa pensheni tu — hauna uhusiano wowote na haki za biashara au vibali vya kufanya kazi. Mgeni anayeweza kusajili NSSF kwa hiari (kwa sababu NSSF inaruhusu wanachama wa hiari) bado anahitaji: (1) Kibali halisi cha makazi (Class A kwa wawekezaji, Class B kwa wafanyakazi); (2) Kuzingatia GN 487A — kama anafanya biashara ya rejareja au shughuli nyingine 14 zilizokatazwa — ana tatizo. Kwa muhtasari: NSSF = haki za pensheni tu. Haki za biashara = Idara ya Uhamiaji + TIC (kama mwekezaji) + kuzingatia GN 487A. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Kampuni hakulipa kodi ya awali (provisional tax) kwa wakati. Matokeo yake ni nini?
answer_sw: Kushindwa kulipa kodi ya awali kwa wakati kunasababisha: riba ya kisheria (statutory interest) inayohesabiwaje kwa kiwango kilichowekwa na Benki Kuu na kuwa inayolipwa kama adhabu kwa TRA. Riba inakusanyika kila siku kutoka tarehe ya mwisho ya malipo iliyopita. Zaidi ya hayo, ikiwa kampuni hakulipa kodi ya awali yoyote kwa mwaka mzima na inaongeza mzigo mkubwa wa kodi mwishoni mwa mwaka, TRA inaweza kuanza hatua za utekelezaji wa kisheria. Ni muhimu kulipa awamu zote kwa wakati — Machi 31, Juni 30, Septemba 30, na Desemba 31.
answer_en: Failure to pay provisional tax on time results in: statutory interest calculated at the rate set by the Central Bank, payable as a penalty to TRA. Interest accumulates daily from the date the payment was due. Additionally, if a company pays no provisional tax at all during the year and accumulates a large tax burden at year end, TRA may initiate legal enforcement steps. It is essential to pay all instalments on time — 31 March, 30 June, 30 September, and 31 December.
question_en: A company did not pay provisional tax on time. What are the consequences?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — provisional tax late payment

question_sw: Mwajiri mdogo mwenye wafanyakazi 5 analipa SDL?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inalipwa tu na waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi kwenye Tanzania Bara. Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi chini ya 10 hatalazimika kulipa SDL. Hata hivyo, jina sahihi la kodi hii ni Skills Development Levy, si kodi ya huduma ya utoaji wala disability leave.
question_en: Does a small employer with 5 employees pay SDL?
answer_en: No. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is paid only by employers with 10 or more employees on Mainland Tanzania. An employer with fewer than 10 employees is not required to pay SDL. Regardless, the correct name of this levy is Skills Development Levy, not service delivery levy or disability leave.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya VAT 18% ya kawaida na VAT 16% ya e-payment ni ipi?
answer_sw: VAT 18%: kiwango cha kawaida kinachotumika kwa bidhaa na huduma nyingi Tanzania. VAT 16%: kiwango maalum kwa malipo ya B2C ya kielektroniki (e-payments) kuanzia 1 Sep 2025. Tofauti ni asilimia 2 — lakini maelezo ya jinsi ya kupanga hizi mbili (kuamua ni ipi inatumika) yanategemea kanuni za utekelezaji kutoka TRA. Thibitisha na TRA mara kanuni zinapatikana.
question_en: What is the difference between the standard 18% VAT and the 16% e-payment VAT?
answer_en: VAT 18%: the standard rate applying to most goods and services in Tanzania. VAT 16%: a special rate for B2C electronic payments (e-payments) from 1 Sep 2025. The difference is 2 percentage points — but the details of how to apply each (deciding which applies) depend on TRA's implementation rules. Verify with TRA once rules are available.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

instruction: EFD machine yangu imeharibika — TRA wanasema niwasiliane na msambazaji. Msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa ni nani?
output: Msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa (approved supplier) ni kampuni iliyopata idhini rasmi ya TRA kuuza na kushughulikia EFD machines Tanzania. Nunua au karabatia EFD yako kutoka kwa msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa TRA tu — kwa orodha ya sasa ya wasambazaji walioidhinishwa, angalia kwenye tra.go.tz. Msambazaji asiyeidhinishwa hawezi kuwasha (activate) EFD yako kwenye mfumo wa TRA.

question_sw: Dereva wa bodaboda — ana wajibu gani wa kodi na leseni?
answer_sw: Dereva wa bodaboda kwa kawaida anahitaji: (1) Leseni ya udereva (driving licence) ya kategoria husika; (2) Leseni ya gari (vehicle registration na bima); (3) Leseni ya biashara kutoka halmashauri kama ana duka au kituo; (4) TIN na BRELA kama biashara imekua. PAYE haitumiki kwa mwenye biashara yake mwenyewe. VAT kwa kawaida haifiki. Angalia kanuni za halmashauri yako.
question_en: A motorcycle taxi (bodaboda) rider — what tax and licence obligations do they have?
answer_en: A bodaboda rider typically needs: (1) An appropriate driving licence; (2) Vehicle registration and insurance; (3) A business licence from the local council if they have a base or station; (4) TIN and BRELA registration if the business has grown. PAYE does not apply to self-employed operators. VAT typically does not apply. Check your local council's rules.

question_sw: Kampuni ya kimataifa inayomilikiwa na mgeni ina mkurugenzi (director) Mtanzania. Je, hii inafanya biashara ya rejareja iwe halali?
answer_sw: Si kwa lazima. Kuwa na mkurugenzi Mtanzania kwenye ubao wa kampuni hakutoshi kuzuia tatizo la GN 487A kama mgeni bado ndiye mwenye nguvu za uamuzi za kweli za biashara. Idara ya Uhamiaji inaangalia: Ni nani mwenye hisa nyingi? Ni nani anayefanya maamuzi ya kila siku? Mkurugenzi Mtanzania anayefanya kazi kweli au ni jina tu? Ikiwa mkurugenzi Mtanzania ni wa bandia (nominal director), hali hii inaweza kuzingatiwa mpango wa kukwepa sheria.
question_en: An internationally owned company has a Tanzanian director. Does this make retail trade legal?
answer_en: Not necessarily. Having a Tanzanian director on the board is not sufficient to prevent a GN 487A problem if a non-citizen still holds the real decision-making power in the business. The Immigration Department looks at: Who holds the majority shares? Who makes day-to-day decisions? Is the Tanzanian director genuinely working or only a name? If the Tanzanian director is nominal (name-only), this arrangement may be treated as a scheme to circumvent the law.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyeumia anaweza kudai WCF bila kumwambia mwajiri wake — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi analazimika kumwambia mwajiri wake kuhusu jeraha la kazi haraka iwezekanavyo. Mwajiri kisha ana wajibu wa kuripoti WCF. Hata hivyo, ikiwa mwajiri anakataa kuripoti, mfanyakazi anaweza kwenda WCF moja kwa moja. Kudumisha ushahidi wa jeraha na kuripoti mapema ni muhimu kwa mafanikio ya madai.
question_en: Can an injured worker claim WCF without telling their employer — is this true?
answer_en: The worker should notify their employer of the work injury as soon as possible. The employer then has the obligation to report to WCF. However, if the employer refuses to report, the worker can approach WCF directly. Preserving evidence of the injury and reporting early is critical for a successful claim.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: PAYE inalipwa kwa mwezi mmoja ambao haukuwa na wafanyakazi — toa return?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri aliyesajiliwa PAYE lazima atoe return ya sifuri (nil return) hata kwa miezi ambayo hakuna wafanyakazi au hakuna malipo. Kushindwa kutoa nil return kunasababisha faini. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Must an employer file a PAYE return for a month with no employees?
answer_en: Yes. A PAYE-registered employer must file a nil return even for months with no employees or no payments. Failure to file a nil return attracts a penalty. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wa kujitegemea (self-employed/freelancer) — anaweza kusajili NSSF?
output: Ndiyo — watu wanaofanya kazi ya kujitegemea (self-employed) wanaweza kusajili NSSF kwa hiari (voluntary membership). Kwa wanachama wa hiari: Jumla ya michango = 20% ya mapato wanayochagua kama msingi (au kiwango cha chini kilichobainishwa na NSSF); Mwanachama wa hiari analipa 20% mzima mwenyewe — hakuna mwajiri wa kuchangia 10%. Faida: pensheni wakati wa uzeeni, mafao ya ulemavu, na mafao ya familia. Hata mwanamuziki, mkulima binafsi, au mwenye biashara ndogo anaweza kusajili NSSF kwa hiari. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz kwa utaratibu wa usajili.

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa kwa njia gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: NSSF inalipwa kupitia mfumo wa GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway). Mwajiri analazimika pia kutoa nyaraka za usaidizi (fomu NSSF/CON.05) kwenye ofisi ya NSSF mara tu baada ya malipo — kwa utoaji wa kimwili au njia ya kielektroniki. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF paid in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is paid through the GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) system. The employer must also submit supporting documents (NSSF/CON.05 form) to the NSSF office immediately after payment — by physical delivery or electronic means. Confirm with NSSF.

instruction: Je, mkaguzi wa OSHA anaweza kukuambia kufunga mashine au zana fulani?
output: Ndiyo. Mkaguzi wa OSHA ana mamlaka ya kutoa amri ya kusimamisha (improvement notice au prohibition notice) kwa mashine, zana, au mchakato wowote unaosababisha hatari kwa usalama. Mashine au eneo linaloweza kusababisha madhara lazima lisimamishwe hadi hatari imeondolewa. Kupinga amri ya OSHA ni kosa zito. Fuata maelekezo ya mkaguzi na ufanye marekebisho yanayohitajika haraka.

instruction: Kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni TZS ngapi?
output:
Kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni karibu TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi — kwa baadhi ya sekta za jumla. Muhtasari wa anuwai ya GN 605A:

KIWANGO CHA CHINI KABISA: karibu TZS 175,000 (baadhi ya sekta za jumla)
WASTANI: TZS 358,322 (sekta zote 16)
KIWANGO CHA JUU KABISA: karibu TZS 765,900 (madini ya kimataifa na nishati)

Usichukue wastani kama kiwango cha chini kabisa au cha juu kabisa. Thibitisha kiwango cha sekta yako na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

question_sw: WCF inalipia majeraha ya nje ya mahali pa kazi — kama mfanyakazi alianguka akitoka kazini — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. WCF inashughulikia majeraha YANAYOTOKANA NA KAZI peke yake — yaani yanayotokea wakati wa kufanya kazi au katika safari ya kazi inayoidhinishwa. Mfanyakazi aliyeumia nyumbani au wakati wa safari ya kibinafsi hakiwa na haki ya madai ya WCF.
question_en: WCF covers injuries outside the workplace — like a worker who fell on the way home — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. WCF covers WORK-RELATED injuries only — those occurring during the performance of work or on an authorised work journey. An employee injured at home or during a personal trip is not entitled to a WCF claim.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Je, mwanachama wa VICOBA analipa kodi kwa faida za mkopo wa VICOBA?
answer_sw: Matibabu ya kodi ya mapato ya VICOBA na faida za mkopo wake ni suala ambalo halijajadiliwa wazi katika kanuni za TRA za kawaida. VICOBA ni mfumo wa akiba wa jamii ambao mara nyingi unaonekana kama wa kibinafsi. Sina uhakika wa mwelekeo wa kodi wa sasa kwa VICOBA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Does a VICOBA member pay tax on VICOBA loan income?
answer_en: The tax treatment of VICOBA income and loan returns is a matter not clearly addressed in standard TRA regulations. VICOBA is a community savings system often treated as informal. I am not certain of the current tax position on VICOBA. Verify with TRA.

question_sw: Kodi za Zanzibar ziko sawa na Tanzania Bara — ninaweza kutumia TIN moja kwa biashara zangu zote?
answer_sw: Zanzibar ina mfumo wake wa kodi na usimamizi tofauti na Tanzania Bara — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Zanzibar ina Mamlaka ya Mapato ya Zanzibar (ZRB) tofauti na TRA ya Tanzania Bara. Suala la TIN na umoja wake kati ya mifumo miwili linahitaji ufafanuzi kutoka TRA na ZRB moja kwa moja.
question_en: Are Zanzibar taxes the same as Tanzania Mainland — can I use one TIN for all my businesses?
answer_en: Zanzibar has its own tax system and administration different from Tanzania Mainland — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Zanzibar has the Zanzibar Revenue Board (ZRB) separate from Tanzania Mainland's TRA. The question of TIN and its unity between the two systems requires clarification from TRA and ZRB directly.

question_sw: Utekelezaji wa GN 487A unafanywa na idara gani na kwa wakati gani?
answer_sw: GN 487A inatekelezwa na Idara ya Huduma za Uhamiaji. Utekelezaji mkubwa ulifanywa kati ya tarehe 11 Septemba na 8 Oktoba 2025 — mazoezi ya ukaguzi wa biashara katika maeneo ya biashara ya Tanzania. Maofisa wa uhamiaji walikuwa na mamlaka ya kukagua biashara, kuuliza hati, na kuchukua hatua dhidi ya wavunjaji.
question_en: Which department enforces GN 487A and during what period?
answer_en: GN 487A is enforced by the Immigration Services Department. A major enforcement exercise was conducted between 11 September and 8 October 2025 — a business inspection exercise at Tanzania's commercial areas. Immigration officers had authority to inspect businesses, demand documents, and take action against violators.

question_sw: Mtu anayeweka taarifa ya kodi ya uongo anaweza kuadhibiwa vipi?
answer_sw: Kutoa taarifa ya kodi ya uongo au kupotosha TRA ni kosa la jinai chini ya Sheria ya Usimamizi wa Kodi. Adhabu zinaweza kujumuisha: faini kubwa, malipo ya kodi iliyokosekana na riba, na kifungo cha jela. Mlipaji kodi anayegundua makosa na kujirekebisha kwa hiari ana uwezekano wa kupata adhabu ndogo.
question_en: What penalties can a person who files a false tax return face?
answer_en: Filing a false tax return or misleading TRA is a criminal offence under the Tax Administration Act. Penalties can include: large fines, payment of unpaid tax with interest, and imprisonment. A taxpayer who discovers errors and self-corrects voluntarily has a possibility of reduced penalties.

question_sw: Tangu GN 487A ilitangazwa, je, kuna mabadiliko yoyote au marekebisho?
answer_sw: Kulingana na taarifa za hadi Juni 2026, hakuna marekebisho rasmi ya GN 487A yaliyotangazwa kwenye Gazeti la Serikali. Amri ilibaki kama ilivyosajiliwa mwaka 2025. Operesheni ya utekelezaji ilifanyika (Septemba-Oktoba 2025) na sheria bado inafanya kazi. Inashauriwa daima kuthibitisha hali ya sasa ya GN 487A kwenye TanzLII.org au kupitia wakili wa biashara wa Tanzania, kwa sababu sheria za Tanzania zinaweza kubadilishwa au kufutwa wakati wowote kupitia Gazette.
question_en: Since GN 487A was published, are there any changes or amendments?
answer_en: According to information available up to June 2026, no official amendments to GN 487A have been published in the Government Gazette. The Order remained as gazetted in 2025. The enforcement exercise took place (September-October 2025) and the law continues to be in force. It is always advisable to verify the current status of GN 487A at TanzLII.org or through a Tanzanian business lawyer, as Tanzanian laws can be amended or revoked at any time through the Gazette.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: EFD machine inaweza kufutwa (cancelled) kwenye mfumo wa TRA — biashara inafanya hivyo lini?
answer_sw: EFD machine inafutwa kwenye mfumo wa TRA katika hali hizi: (1) biashara inafunga kabisa, (2) biashara inafunga tawi husika, (3) machine inapokelewa mbaya isiyoweza kukarabatiwa, (4) biashara inabadilisha EFD mpya. Mchakato wa kufuta lazima ufuate mwongozo wa TRA na msambazaji. Biashara KAMWE isifute EFD bila kupata uthibitisho wa TRA na data ya mwisho kutolewa ipasavyo.
question_en: An EFD machine can be deactivated on TRA's system — when does a business do this?
answer_en: An EFD machine is deactivated on TRA's system in these situations: (1) the business is closing permanently, (2) a specific branch is closing, (3) the machine is irreparably damaged, (4) the business is replacing it with a new EFD. The deactivation process must follow TRA and supplier guidance. A business must NEVER deactivate an EFD without TRA confirmation and final data properly extracted.

instruction: Mwandishi wa vitabu anahitaji kulinda kazi yake Tanzania -- anawasiliana na nani?
output: Mwandishi wa vitabu analinda hakimiliki (copyright) ya kazi yake kupitia COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania) -- si BRELA. COSOTA ndiyo mamlaka ya hakimiliki inayolinda kazi za ubunifu kama vitabu, muziki, sanaa, na filamu Tanzania. Wasiliana na COSOTA kwa maelezo ya usajili wa hakimiliki na malipo.

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara wa mpakani anahitaji hati gani kutumia STR?
answer_sw: Hati zinazohitajika kwa STR: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — kuthibitisha asili ya bidhaa; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — fomu rahisi ya forodha; (3) Utambulisho wa kibinafsi (kitambulisho cha taifa au pasipoti). Pia, orodha ya bidhaa na bei zake ni muhimu. Ofisi ya forodha itaweza kukusaidia zaidi.
question_en: What documents does a border trader need to use STR?
answer_en: Documents needed for STR: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — to prove the origin of goods; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — the simplified customs form; (3) Personal identification (national ID or passport). Additionally, a list of goods and their prices is important. The customs office can assist you further.

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi kinaweza kukataliwa — sababu za kawaida ni zipi?
answer_sw: Sababu za kawaida za kukataliwa kwa kibali cha kazi ni: (1) ujuzi uliodaiwa unapatikana kwa Watanzania, (2) mwajiri ameshindwa kuthibitisha jaribio la kuajiri Mtanzania kwanza, (3) nyaraka za ombi ni kukosekana au si sahihi, (4) kampuni haikufuata mahitaji ya uwiano wa wafanyakazi, au (5) mombaji ana historia mbaya ya ukiukwaji wa uhamiaji.
question_en: A work permit can be refused — what are the common reasons?
answer_en: Common reasons for work permit refusal include: (1) claimed skills are available from Tanzanians, (2) employer failed to demonstrate attempting to hire Tanzanians first, (3) application documents are missing or incorrect, (4) company did not meet employee ratio requirements, or (5) applicant has a history of immigration violations.

instruction: Nina wafanyakazi 8 — SDL inahusika nami?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kwa wafanyakazi 8, bado uko chini ya kizingiti cha 10 — SDL haihitajiki. Lakini ukiongeza hadi wafanyakazi 10, SDL inahitajika mara moja kwa mwezi huo. Fuatilia idadi ya wafanyakazi wako kila wakati.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ilisajiliwa BRELA tarehe 15 Machi 2023 -- annual return yangu ya mwaka 2025 inaweza kuwa lini?
output: Annual return yako ya mwaka 2025 inatarajiwa karibu na tarehe ya kumbukumbu yako ya usajili -- yaani karibu na tarehe 15 Machi 2025. Kampuni ina siku fulani baada ya tarehe hiyo kuwasilisha annual return. Thibitisha muda sahihi na ada za sasa na BRELA (brela.go.tz au ors.brela.go.tz) kwani ada na masharti yanaweza kubadilika.

instruction: Wanaohitimu kama VAT withholding agents Tanzania ni akina nani hasa?
output: Wanaohitimu kama VAT withholding agents ni pamoja na: wizara za serikali na taasisi za umma, kampuni za bima zilizoteuliwa, benki na taasisi za fedha, makampuni ya simu yaliyoteuliwa, na biashara nyingine zilizopewa hadhi rasmi na TRA. Orodha kamili inapatikana kwenye TRA. Uliza TRA kama una shaka kuhusu mbia wako.

instruction: Mwajiri anaweza kulipa SDL kabla ya mwisho wa mwezi badala ya tarehe ya 7?
output: Ndiyo — mwajiri anaweza kulipa SDL kabla ya tarehe ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kulipa mapema ni halali kabisa na hakunakiliwa kama tatizo. Faida za kulipa mapema: (1) Unahakikisha hufikwi na muda wa dharura; (2) Unaepuka kuchelewa kutokana na matatizo ya benki au mfumo wa TRA; (3) Unaonyesha ushirikiano mzuri na TRA. Hakuna faida ya ziada ya kifedha kwa kulipa mapema (hakuna riba ya SDL kwa kulipa mapema). Tarehe ya 7 ni kikomo cha juu — si siku ya lazima ya kulipa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa utaratibu wa malipo ya mapema.

question_sw: OSHA inahusiana tu na majeraha ya kimwili — magonjwa yanayosababishwa na kazi hayafunikwi?
answer_sw: Hapana. OSHA ya 2003 inashughulikia USALAMA NA AFYA zote mbili — ikiwa ni pamoja na magonjwa yanayosababishwa na kazi (occupational diseases) kama uziwi wa kelele, magonjwa ya mapafu kutokana na vumbi, na matatizo ya kemikali. Afya ya mfanyakazi kwa njia yote ni wajibu wa mwajiri.
question_en: OSHA only relates to physical injuries — work-caused diseases are not covered?
answer_en: No. OSHA 2003 covers BOTH safety and health — including occupational diseases such as noise-induced deafness, dust-related lung conditions, and chemical health issues. Employee health in all its forms is an employer obligation.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Ada ya kibali cha makazi Class C Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ada ya kibali cha makazi daraja C inaweza kutofautiana kulingana na muda na aina ya kazi. Ada zinatofautiana sana kulingana na aina ya kibali, uraia, na muda — angalia jedwali la sasa la ada kwenye immigration.go.tz
question_en: What is the fee for a Class C residence permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: The Class C residence permit fee varies depending on duration and type of employment. Fees vary widely by permit class, nationality and duration — check current schedule at immigration.go.tz

question_sw: Je, siku nisiyofanya biashara bado ninahitaji Z-report?
answer_sw: Kama EFD iko hai (powered on) na ulikuwa umefungua na kufunga biashara hiyo siku — hata hakukuwa na muamala — Z-report bado inashauriwa kutolewa. Hata hivyo, ikiwa biashara ilifungwa kabisa (EFD ilizimwa) na hakukuwa na biashara yoyote, Z-report ya siku ile inaweza kuwa haina taarifa za muamala. Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD wako kwa mwongozo wa jinsi ya kushughulikia siku za biashara iliyofungwa.
question_en: On a day when I do no business, do I still need a Z-report?
answer_en: If the EFD is powered on and you technically opened and closed business that day — even with no transactions — a Z-report is still advisable to generate. However, if the business was fully closed (EFD powered off) with no transactions at all, the Z-report for that day may have no transaction data. Consult your EFD supplier for guidance on handling days when business is fully closed.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kumfuta mfanyakazi wa kigeni bila kumrudisha nchini kwake — je, ana wajibu gani?
answer_sw: Ikiwa mfanyakazi wa kigeni (Darasa B) anafutwa kazi, mwajiri ana wajibu wa: (1) kumwarifu Idara ya Uhamiaji kuhusu mwisho wa ajira, (2) kibali cha kazi kinaomba kufutwa au kuhuishwa kwa mwajiri mpya, na (3) kuhakikisha mfanyakazi anarudi katika hali ya halali. Mwajiri anaweza pia kubeba gharama za kurudi kwake.
question_en: If an employer dismisses a foreign worker what immigration obligations apply?
answer_en: If a Class B foreign worker is dismissed, the employer must: (1) notify the Immigration Department of the end of employment, (2) the work permit needs to be cancelled or transferred to a new employer, and (3) ensure the worker returns to lawful status. The employer may also bear repatriation costs.

question_sw: Uhamishaji wa ardhi kati ya kampuni mama na tanzu yake (subsidiary) una ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa ujumla. Uhamishaji wa ardhi kati ya kampuni mbili za Tanzania — hata kama ni kampuni mama na tanzu — una ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1. Misamaha maalum ya kikundi cha kampuni (group relief) inaweza kutumika katika hali fulani, lakini si moja kwa moja. Omba ushauri wa mwanasheria wa kodi au TRA kabla ya mauzo ya ndani ya kikundi.
question_en: Does a land transfer between a parent company and its subsidiary attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes generally. A land transfer between two Tanzania companies — even parent and subsidiary — attracts 1% stamp duty. Specific group relief exemptions may apply in certain circumstances but are not automatic. Seek advice from a tax lawyer or TRA before intra-group transfers.

instruction: Msaidizi wa GN 487A anaweza kupata faini ya TZS milioni 10 kama mgeni?
output: Hapana. Adhabu za msaidizi (raia wa Tanzania) ni ndogo kuliko za mgeni. Msaidizi anapata: faini ya TZS milioni 5 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 3. Mgeni mwenyewe anapata: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 AU vyote viwili, plus uwezekano wa kufutwa kwa visa. Adhabu ni tofauti kwa pande mbili. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: EFD machine ya Tanzania inahitaji mtandao wa intaneti kufanya kazi?
answer_sw: EFD machines nyingi za Tanzania zinaweza kufanya kazi bila mtandao kwa muda mfupi na zinahifadhi data za muamala kwenye mashine. Lakini zinahitaji muunganisho wa mtandao (internet/SIM card) mara kwa mara ili: (1) kupeleka data ya muamala kwenye seva ya TRA, (2) kupata masasisho ya mfumo. EFD isiyopeleka data kwa TRA kwa muda mrefu inaweza kukiuka sheria — angalia mwongozo wa msambazaji wako kuhusu mahitaji ya muunganisho.
question_en: Does a Tanzania EFD machine need an internet connection to work?
answer_en: Most Tanzania EFD machines can operate offline briefly and store transaction data on the machine. But they need periodic internet/SIM connection to: (1) transmit transaction data to TRA's server, (2) receive system updates. An EFD that does not transmit data to TRA for a long period may be in violation — check your supplier's guidance on connectivity requirements.

instruction: Kiwango cha NSSF inayopelekwa kila mwezi kinakokotolewa vipi?
output: Kiasi cha NSSF inayopelekwa kwa NSSF kila mwezi ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa jumla wa kila mfanyakazi. Mwajiri ndiye anayewajibika kupeleka jumla yote — ikiwa ni pamoja na asilimia 10 ya mfanyakazi aliyokatwa kwenye mshahara na asilimia 10 ya mwajiri mwenyewe (mgawanyo wa kawaida). Kwa mgawanyo mwingine halali (15+5 au 20+0), jumla inayopelekwa bado ni asilimia 20. Mwajiri hupeleka malipo moja kwa moja kwa NSSF — si TRA. Thibitisha tarehe ya mwisho ya sasa kwenye nssf.go.tz.

question_sw: WHT kwa gawio kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi ni asilimia 15 — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WHT kwa gawio ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi NA kwa wasio wakazi — si asilimia 15. Kiwango cha asilimia 15 kinatumika kwa aina nyingine za malipo kama royalties na ada za mkurugenzi (wakazi). Gawio daima inatoza asilimia 10 bila kujali wakazi au la.
question_en: WHT on dividends for residents and non-residents is 15% — is this correct?
answer_en: No. WHT on dividends is 10% for both residents AND non-residents — not 15%. The 15% rate applies to other payment types such as royalties and resident director fees. Dividends always attract 10% regardless of resident status.

question_sw: Ni bora zaidi kuweka pesa benki au kununua ardhi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Uamuzi wa uwekezaji wa kibinafsi (benki vs ardhi) ni nje ya upeo wangu. Ninashughulikia kodi za biashara na usajili Tanzania Bara — si ushauri wa uwekezaji wa kibinafsi. Kwa ushauri wa uwekezaji, wasiliana na mshauri wa fedha aliyesajiliwa au Capital Markets and Securities Authority (CMSA) Tanzania kwa maswali ya masoko ya mitaji. Je, kuna swali la kodi ya biashara ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: Is it better to put money in a bank or buy land in Tanzania?
answer_en: Personal investment decisions (bank vs land) are outside my scope. I handle business taxes and registration for Mainland Tanzania — not personal investment advice. For investment advice, contact a registered financial adviser or the Capital Markets and Securities Authority (CMSA) Tanzania for capital markets questions. question_sw: Notisi ya uboreshaji (improvement notice) kutoka OSHA inamaanisha nini?
answer_sw: Notisi ya uboreshaji ni amri rasmi kutoka OSHA inayomwambia mwajiri aboreshe hali fulani ya hatari ndani ya muda maalum uliotajwa. Kukosa kufuata notisi ni kosa la jinai na kunaweza kusababisha faini au kufungwa kwa mahali pa kazi.
question_en: What does an improvement notice from OSHA mean?
answer_en: An improvement notice is a formal OSHA order requiring an employer to remedy a specific hazard within a stated time period. Failure to comply is a criminal offence and can result in fines or closure of the workplace.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Bima ya afya (health insurance) inaathiriwa na insurance premium levy kama bima ya gari?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Aina za bima zinazoshughulikiwa na insurance premium levy Tanzania inashughulikiwa na TIRA na inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TIRA kupitia tira.go.tz.

question_sw: BRELA inatoa usajili wa alama ya biashara (trademark) pia?
answer_sw: Hapana. BRELA inasajili MAJINA ya kampuni na biashara — si alama za biashara (trademarks). Alama za biashara (trademarks, patents, na haki za miliki za kiakili) zinasajiliwa na BRELA kupitia idara yake ya Intellectual Property. Ni sehemu ya BRELA lakini ni mchakato tofauti kabisa na usajili wa kampuni.
question_en: Does BRELA also register trademarks?
answer_en: No, not directly. BRELA registers company and business NAMES — not trademarks. Trademarks, patents, and intellectual property rights are registered through BRELA's Intellectual Property Department. It is part of BRELA but is a completely separate process from company registration.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Je, STR inatumika kwa bidhaa za mazao ya bahari (samaki, pweza)?
answer_sw: Bidhaa za mazao ya bahari zinaweza kuwa kwenye Common List, lakini hali inategemea aina maalum ya bidhaa. Samaki safi na bidhaa za bahari zinazozalishwa ndani ya EAC kwa ujumla zinaweza kustahili — lakini thibitisha na ofisi ya forodha kama aina yako mahususi ipo kwenye Common List ya sasa.
question_en: Does STR apply to marine products (fish, octopus)?
answer_en: Marine products may be on the Common List, but eligibility depends on the specific type. Fresh fish and marine products produced within EAC can generally qualify — but verify with the customs office whether your specific type is on the current Common List.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina mkopo kutoka kwa mwanzo wa kampuni mama — mkopo huo unahesabiwaje kwa transfer pricing?
output: Mikopo kati ya kampuni washirika (related party loans) lazima iwe na riba inayolingana na bei ya soko (arm's length rate) chini ya kanuni za transfer pricing Tanzania. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa kiwango maalum cha riba kinachokubaliwa na TRA na jinsi ya kuandika nyaraka. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Ninafanya biashara Zanzibar na Tanzania Bara — je, ninafilisi mara mbili?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants na ninashughulikia kodi na biashara za TANZANIA BARA peke yake. Biashara inayofanya kazi Zanzibar na Tanzania Bara inahusisha mifumo miwili tofauti ya kodi (TRA kwa Tanzania Bara; ZRB kwa Zanzibar) — hali hii ya pamoja iko nje ya wigo wangu. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa sehemu ya Tanzania Bara na ZRB (zrb.go.tz) kwa Zanzibar, au mshauri wa kodi anayejua mifumo yote miwili.

question_sw: BRELA na TRA ni mashirika sawa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) na TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority) ni mashirika tofauti yanayofanya kazi tofauti. BRELA inasajili kampuni na biashara. TRA inakusanya kodi. Kusajili na BRELA hakutoi TIN — lazima usajili kwa TRA tofauti kupata TIN.
question_en: BRELA and TRA are the same organisation — is this true?
answer_en: No. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) and TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority) are separate organisations with different functions. BRELA registers companies and businesses. TRA collects taxes. Registering with BRELA does not give you a TIN — you must register separately with TRA to obtain a TIN.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Je, kampuni inaweza kumrudisha nyumbani mfanyakazi wake wa kigeni bila ya kumwarifu Idara ya Uhamiaji?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ikiwa mfanyakazi wa kigeni anaondoka Tanzania (kwa hiari au kufutwa kazi), mwajiri ana wajibu wa kumwarifu Idara ya Uhamiaji. Kushindwa kumwarifu kunaweza kusababisha matatizo ya siku zijazo kwa kampuni katika maombi mengine ya vibali na inaweza kuathiri rekodi ya uzingatiaji wa uhamiaji wa kampuni.
question_en: Can a company repatriate a foreign worker without notifying the Immigration Department?
answer_en: No. When a foreign worker leaves Tanzania (whether voluntarily or through dismissal), the employer has an obligation to notify the Immigration Department. Failure to notify can cause complications for future permit applications and may affect the company's immigration compliance record.

question_sw: Gari la zamani linalouza Tanzania — ushuru wa biashara (excise duty) ni ngapi?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa biashara (excise duty) wa magari ya zamani (used vehicles) unategemea sana umri wa gari, CIF value, na HS Code. EAC Common External Tariff na excise duty schedule zinatoa viwango maalum. Sina uhakika wa viwango vya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA (Customs) au wakala wa usafirishaji.
question_en: A used car being sold in Tanzania — what is the applicable excise duty?
answer_en: Excise duty on used vehicles depends heavily on the vehicle's age, CIF value, and HS Code. The EAC Common External Tariff and excise duty schedule specify the rates. I am not certain of current rates. Verify with TRA (Customs) or a shipping/customs agent.

instruction: Mshauri wa biashara (management consultant) mwenye TZS 120M kwa mwaka — VAT?
output: TZS 120M/mwaka bado chini ya kizingiti cha TZS 200M/12 miezi — kwa kanuni ya kawaida, usajili wa VAT si lazima kiautomatiki. Lakini angalia: je, TZS 120M hiyo ilikuja ndani ya miezi 6? Kama ndiyo (TZS 100M+/6 miezi), usajili wa VAT unahitajika. Pia: kama wataalamu wa biashara wana mwongozo maalum wa TRA, thibitisha na TRA.

question_sw: Mkenya anayeendesha salon ya nywele Dar es Salaam, mkahawa mdogo, na huduma za M-Pesa — ni ipi kati ya hizi inayokiuka GN 487A?
answer_sw: ZOTE TATU zinakiuka GN 487A. (1) Salon ya nywele — ipo kwenye orodha ya biashara zilizopigwa marufuku. (2) Mkahawa mdogo wa chakula — HAIKO kwenye orodha kama kategoria iliyotajwa wazi katika GN 487A. Hata hivyo, kama inahusisha uuzaji wa bidhaa kwa rejareja inaweza kuangukia chini ya Kategoria 1 (biashara ya rejareja). Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji. (3) Wakala wa M-Pesa/huduma za uhamisho wa pesa za simu — ipo kwenye orodha. Mkenya (au mgeni yeyote asiye raia wa Tanzania) anayefanya biashara hizi tatu anakiuka GN 487A kwa makosa matatu tofauti.
question_en: A Kenyan national runs a hair salon in Dar es Salaam, a small food outlet, and M-Pesa services — which of these violates GN 487A?
answer_en: ALL THREE violate GN 487A. (1) Hair salon — is on the list of prohibited businesses. (2) Small food outlet — is NOT explicitly named in the GN 487A Schedule. However, if it involves retail sale of goods it may fall under Category 1 (retail trade). Verify with Immigration. (3) M-Pesa agent/mobile money transfer services — is on the list. A Kenyan (or any non-Tanzanian citizen) running all three of these businesses is violating GN 487A for three separate offences.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Je, TZS 358,322 ndiyo kiwango cha juu kabisa cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A?
output: Hapana — TZS 358,322 si kiwango cha juu kabisa. Ni WASTANI (average) kwa sekta zote 16 za GN 605A. Kiwango cha juu kabisa (maximum) chini ya GN 605A ni karibu TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi — kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Makosa haya — kuchukua wastani badala ya kiwango cha juu kabisa — yanaweza kupotosha upangaji wa mishahara. Hakikisha unabainisha kiwango cha sekta yako maalum kutoka orodha kamili ya GN 605A. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: Kwa nini mtu anayetumia jina lake mwenyewe bado anahitaji BRELA? Inaonekana kama faida ndogo.
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Faida za vitendo: (1) Unaweza kufungua akaunti ya benki kwa jina la biashara. (2) Unaweza kuingia mikataba rasmi. (3) Unalindwa na mtu mwingine kutumia jina lako la biashara. (4) Wateja wakubwa na serikali wanahitaji cheti cha BRELA. Usajili ni hatua ya msingi ya biashara halali.

question_sw: VAT ya uingizaji (imports) inafanyaje kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: VAT ya asilimia 18 inastahili kwa uingizaji wa bidhaa zinazostahili kutoka nje ya Tanzania Bara. Uingizaji wa huduma pia unastahili VAT. Sheria za kawaida za Forodha zinatumika. Thibitisha mahitaji ya VAT ya uingizaji na TRA na Forodha.
question_en: How does VAT on imports work in Tanzania?
answer_en: 18% VAT applies to the importation of taxable goods from outside Tanzania Mainland. Importation of services is also subject to VAT. Normal Customs laws and procedures apply. Confirm import VAT requirements with TRA and Customs.

question_sw: Mwezi huu kulipwa mishahara tu kwa wafanyakazi 10 kila mmoja TZS 358,322 (kiwango cha chini cha mshahara). SDL ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Jumla ya mishahara: 10 × TZS 358,322 = TZS 3,583,220. SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi): TZS 3,583,220 × 3.5% = TZS 125,413 (kuzungusha hadi shilingi kamili). Kumbuka: kiwango cha chini cha mshahara wa sekta ya kawaida ni TZS 358,322 kuanzia 1 Januari 2026 (GN 605A).
question_en: This month only 10 employees were paid the minimum wage of TZS 358,322 each. What is the SDL?
answer_en: Total payroll: 10 × TZS 358,322 = TZS 3,583,220. SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi): TZS 3,583,220 × 3.5% = TZS 125,413 (rounded to whole shillings). Note: the minimum wage for general private sector is TZS 358,322 from 1 January 2026 (GN 605A).

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi siku 3 kwa wiki — NSSF inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: NSSF kwa mfanyakazi wa siku chache kwa wiki inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa mshahara unaolipwa halisi (actual gross wage). Kama mfanyakazi analipwa TZS 10,000 kwa siku, siku 3 kwa wiki = TZS 120,000 kwa mwezi (kama wiki 4), basi NSSF = TZS 120,000 × 20% = TZS 24,000 (mwajiri 12,000 + mfanyakazi 12,000). Hakuna uwiano wa saa za kazi — inategemea mshahara mkubwa wa jumla uliolipwa.
question_en: An employee works 3 days per week — how is NSSF calculated?
answer_en: NSSF for a part-week worker is calculated on actual gross wages paid. If an employee is paid TZS 10,000 per day, 3 days per week = TZS 120,000 per month (assuming 4 weeks), then NSSF = TZS 120,000 × 20% = TZS 24,000 (employer TZS 12,000 + employee TZS 12,000). There is no pro-rating by hours — it depends on actual gross wages paid.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa nusu muda (part-time) analipa NSSF sawa na wa muda wote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa nusu muda analipa NSSF kwa msingi wa mshahara wake mkubwa wa jumla — bila kujali ni nusu ya muda au muda wote. Kiwango ni sawa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla wa mfanyakazi huyo. Kwa mfano: mfanyakazi wa nusu muda analipwa TZS 300,000/mwezi → NSSF = TZS 60,000 (mwajiri 30,000 + mfanyakazi 30,000).
question_en: Does a part-time worker pay NSSF the same as a full-time employee?
answer_en: Yes. A part-time worker pays NSSF on their actual gross wages — regardless of whether they are part-time or full-time. The rate is the same: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of that employee's gross wage. Example: a part-time worker paid TZS 300,000/month → NSSF = TZS 60,000 (employer TZS 30,000 + employee TZS 30,000).

instruction: Je, ORT (Ofisi ya Usajilishaji wa Hati) inasimamia milki ya akili Tanzania?
output: Hapana. ORT haipo kama taasisi inayosimamia milki ya kiakili Tanzania -- ort.go.tz haipo. Milki ya kiakili Tanzania inasimamia na: BRELA (alama za biashara, hataza, miundo ya viwanda) na COSOTA (hakimiliki na haki jirani). Hakuna taasisi inayoitwa ORT kwenye mfumo wa milki ya kiakili Tanzania. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

question_sw: Kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kizingiti cha usajili wa lazima wa VAT Tanzania ni: mauzo ya TZS 200,000,000 (shilingi milioni 200) ndani ya miezi 12, AU mauzo ya TZS 100,000,000 (shilingi milioni 100) ndani ya miezi 6. Ukifikia moja ya masharti haya, lazima ujisajili kwa VAT na TRA ndani ya siku 30. Usajili wa hiari unawezekana pia ikiwa una mauzo chini ya kizingiti.
question_en: What is the VAT registration threshold in Tanzania?
answer_en: The mandatory VAT registration threshold in Tanzania is: sales of TZS 200,000,000 (200 million shillings) in any 12-month period, OR sales of TZS 100,000,000 (100 million shillings) in any 6-month period. If you reach either condition, you must register for VAT with TRA within 30 days. Voluntary registration is also possible if your sales are below the threshold.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ya kimataifa (headquarters Dubai) ina tawi Tanzania — tawi hilo linamilikiwa 'na headquarters', si mgeni mmoja mmoja — GN 487A inatumika?
output: GN 487A inazuia pia kampuni zinazomilikiwa na raia wa kigeni au kampuni za kigeni kufanya shughuli katika orodha ya 15 Tanzania. Ingawa tawi (branch) linasajiliwa na BRELA kama chombo cha kisheria la Tanzania, kama shughuli zake zinaangukia katika orodha ya 15 na wamiliki wake ni raia wa kigeni au kampuni ya kigeni — marufuku inaweza kutumika. GN 487A haisemi wazi kuhusu 'beneficial ownership' kama kipimo. Hata hivyo mamlaka za uhamiaji na mahakama zinaweza kuchunguza udhibiti wa kweli na mnufaika halisi wa biashara kama sehemu ya uchunguzi wa ukiukwaji. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa tafsiri ya kisheria ya hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara wa Tanzania na Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa hali yako maalum.

instruction: Je, kampuni inahitaji kutoa slip ya NSSF kwa kila mfanyakazi kila mwezi?
output: Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kumwarifu mfanyakazi kuhusu mchango wake wa NSSF — mara nyingi hufanywa kupitia pay slip ya kila mwezi inayoonyesha mchango wa mfanyakazi na mwajiri. Ingawa sheria haielezi aina maalum ya taarifa, uwazi katika malipo ya NSSF ni sehemu ya haki za mfanyakazi. Fanya desturi ya kutoa pay slip inayoonyesha NSSF kwa uwazi.

instruction: Zanzibar ina VAT tofauti na Tanzania Bara — ni tofauti gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants na ninashughulikia sheria za kodi na biashara za TANZANIA BARA peke yake. Zanzibar ina mfumo wake wa kodi (Zanzibar Revenue Board — ZRB) ambao ni tofauti na wa TRA ya Tanzania Bara. Tofauti kati ya mifumo hii miwili ni nje ya wigo wangu. Wasiliana na ZRB kupitia zrb.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi wa Zanzibar kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Biashara inayofanya rejareja ya dawa (pharmacy) Tanzania inahitaji aina maalum ya EFD?
answer_sw: Maduka ya dawa (pharmacy) Tanzania yanayofanya mauzo ya dawa lazima yatumie EFD kama biashara nyingine zilizolazimishwa. Bidhaa za dawa fulani zinaweza kuwa huru ya VAT (exempt) au za kiwango cha sifuri — EFD lazima iwe na programu inayoweza kuuainisha kwa usahihi. Pia, pharmacy inaweza kuhitaji leseni maalum ya TMDA mbali na EFD ya TRA. Angalia TRA na TMDA kwa mahitaji yote yanayohusika.
question_en: Does a pharmaceutical retail business (pharmacy) in Tanzania need a special type of EFD?
answer_en: Pharmacies in Tanzania making medicine sales must use an EFD like other mandatory businesses. Certain pharmaceutical products may be VAT-exempt or zero-rated — the EFD must have software that can correctly categorise them. Also, a pharmacy may need a specific TMDA licence separate from TRA's EFD. Check TRA and TMDA for all applicable requirements.

question_sw: Mshauri wa kodi au mhasibu ni lazima kwa biashara ndogo Tanzania — au mwenye biashara anaweza kujiendesha mwenyewe?
answer_sw: Kisheria, hakuna wajibu wa kuwa na mshauri wa kodi au mhasibu kwa biashara ndogo Tanzania. Mwenye biashara anaweza kuwasilisha tamko lake la kodi mwenyewe. Hata hivyo, kwa vitendo: makosa ya kodi yanasababisha adhabu kubwa, TRA inaweza kukagua hesabu zako, na mhasibu mzuri anaweza kupunguza kodi halali kupitia makato sahihi. Gharama ya mshauri (TZS 200,000-1M+/mwaka kwa biashara ndogo) mara nyingi inazingatiwa kidogo ikilinganishwa na thamani anayoiongeza.
question_en: Is a tax adviser or accountant mandatory for a small business in Tanzania — or can the owner self-manage?
answer_en: Legally, there is no obligation to have a tax adviser or accountant for a small Tanzania business. The owner can file their own tax returns. However, practically: tax errors lead to large penalties, TRA can audit your accounts, and a good accountant can legitimately reduce tax through correct deductions. The cost of an adviser (TZS 200,000-1M+/year for a small business) is often small compared to the value they add.

question_sw: Je, NSSF inakatwa kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mchango wa lazima wa NSSF (asilimia 10 ya mfanyakazi) unakatwa mshahara ghafi na unapunguza msingi wa PAYE. Kwa mfano, mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara TZS 600,000 analipa NSSF TZS 60,000; PAYE inacheswa kwa TZS 540,000. Thibitisha na TRA na NSSF.
question_en: Is NSSF deducted before calculating PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. The mandatory employee NSSF contribution (10% of gross wage) is deducted from gross salary before calculating PAYE. For example, an employee earning TZS 600,000 pays TZS 60,000 NSSF; PAYE is calculated on TZS 540,000. Confirm with TRA and NSSF.

instruction: Bima ya maisha (life insurance) inatozwa insurance premium levy tofauti na bima za jumla (general insurance)?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Utofauti kati ya ushuru wa bima ya maisha na bima za jumla unashughulikiwa na TIRA na inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa sekta ya bima. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TIRA kupitia tira.go.tz.

question_sw: SDL inalipiwa wafanyakazi moja kwa moja au inakwenda serikalini?
answer_sw: SDL inakwenda serikalini — hasa TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority). Haiendi moja kwa moja kwa wafanyakazi. TRA inaitumia kusaidia VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na programu za mafunzo. Mfanyakazi hupata manufaa kwa njia ya mafunzo ya umma, si malipo ya moja kwa moja.
question_en: Is SDL paid directly to employees or does it go to the government?
answer_en: SDL goes to the government — specifically TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority). It is not paid directly to employees. TRA uses it to support VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and training programmes. Employees benefit through public training, not direct payments.

question_sw: Je, mimi kama mwajiri ninaweza kukokotoa PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenyewe au lazima nitumie TRA IDRAS?
answer_sw: Unaweza kukokotoa PAYE mwenyewe ukijua bendi sahihi (bendi 2 = 8%, si 9%) Kizingiti cha mapato yasiyotozwa kodi: TZS 3,240,000/mwaka (TZS 270,000/mwezi kwa 0% — imejengwa ndani ya Bendi 1, hakuna punguzo tofauti la kila mwezi).. Lakini: kwa usahihi wa hali ya juu na kuhakikisha unajumuisha makato yote yanayostahili — TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz) ni chombo rasmi na cha kuaminika zaidi. Kwa mishahara rahisi: hisabati ya mkono inawezekana. Kwa mishahara ya ngumu (makato mengi, bonasi, NSSF, nk): tumia TRA IDRAS au mhesabu wa kodi.
question_en: Can I as an employer calculate employee PAYE myself or must I use TRA IDRAS?
answer_en: You can calculate PAYE yourself if you know the correct bands (band 2 = 8%, not 9%) Annual tax-free threshold: TZS 3,240,000/year (TZS 270,000/month at 0% — built into Band 1, no separate monthly relief).. But: for high-accuracy and to ensure all eligible deductions are included — TRA IDRAS (taidras.tra.go.tz) is the official and most reliable tool. For simple salaries: manual arithmetic is possible. For complex salaries (many deductions, bonuses, NSSF, etc.): use TRA IDRAS or a tax accountant.

instruction: Ofisi yangu ina wafanyakazi 6 — OSHA ilazima kusajili?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Ndio — ofisi yoyote, iwe na wafanyakazi 2 au 200, inastahili usajili wa OSHA. Usajili unafanywa kupitia osha.go.tz. OSHA inashughulikia: hatari za kimwili, kemikali, ergonomic, na kisaikolojia mahali pa kazi. Hata ofisi ya kawaida ina hatari (umeme, vipande vya samani, mionzi ya skrini) inayoshughulikiwa na OSHA.

instruction: Bidhaa za ujenzi (cement, nondo) zina VAT ngapi Tanzania?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Bidhaa za ujenzi kama saruji (cement) na nondo mara nyingi zina VAT ya 18% (standard rate). Baadhi ya nyenzo maalum za ujenzi zinaweza kuwa na hali tofauti — thibitisha na TRA.

question_sw: Mtu anayetengeneza na kuuza asali (honey) kijijini — anahitaji usajili gani?
answer_sw: Mtengenezaji wa asali anayouza kibiashara kwa kawaida anahitaji: (1) Leseni ya biashara kutoka halmashauri; (2) TIN kama biashara inazalisha mapato ya mara kwa mara; (3) Kibali cha usafi wa chakula kutoka TFDA/TMDA au Ofisi ya Afya ya Wilaya; (4) Kama mauzo yanafika TZS 200M/mwaka, usajili wa VAT. Thibitisha masharti maalum na halmashauri na TMDA.
question_en: A person who makes and sells honey in a village — what registration is required?
answer_en: A honey producer selling commercially typically needs: (1) A business licence from the local council; (2) A TIN if the business generates regular income; (3) A food safety permit from TFDA/TMDA or the District Health Office; (4) If sales reach TZS 200M/year, VAT registration. Confirm specific requirements with the local council and TMDA.

question_sw: Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) ni nini na inapatikanaje?
answer_sw: SCO (Simplified Certificate of Origin) ni hati inayothibitisha kwamba bidhaa zimezalishwa au kutengenezwa ndani ya nchi wanachama wa EAC/COMESA. Inapatikana kutoka kwa mamlaka za forodha au ofisi za biashara nchini. SCO inahitajika kuonyesha bidhaa zinastahili kupata manufaa ya STR.
question_en: What is the Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) and how do you get one?
answer_en: An SCO (Simplified Certificate of Origin) is a document certifying that goods were produced or processed within an EAC/COMESA member state. It is obtained from customs authorities or trade offices in the country. The SCO is required to show goods qualify for STR benefits.

instruction: EFD machine yangu iliibiwa. Niwasiliane na nani kwanza?
output: Hatua za haraka: (1) Ripoti wizi kwa polisi na pata nambari ya kesi; (2) Ripoti msambazaji wako aliyeidhinishwa na TRA haraka — waajulishe nambari ya serial ya EFD iliyoibiwa; (3) Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuzuia EFD iliyoibiwa isitumike na mwizi; (4) Omba EFD mbadala haraka ili biashara iendelee. Hifadhi kumbukumbu ya muamala wote uliotokea kabla ya wizi. Kutoa taarifa mapema kulinda biashara yako dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya EFD iliyoibiwa.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wa kampuni ya EPZ Tanzania — waajiri wa EPZ wanalipa SDL kama kampuni za kawaida?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara kwa biashara za kawaida. question_sw: Leseni ya biashara ya LGA inagharimu kiasi gani na inahuishwa lini?
answer_sw: Ada ya leseni ya biashara ya Mamlaka ya Serikali za Mitaa (LGA) inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya biashara, eneo, na ukubwa. Kwa biashara ndogo za kawaida mji mkubwa, ada inaweza kuanzia TZS 50,000 hadi TZS 500,000+ kwa mwaka. Leseni huhuishwa kila mwaka — tarehe ya mwisho ni 31 Machi ya mwaka unaofuata. Kuendesha biashara bila leseni ya LGA ni kosa na kunaweza kusababisha faini au kufungwa kwa biashara.
question_en: How much does an LGA business licence cost and when is it renewed?
answer_en: The Local Government Authority (LGA) business licence fee varies by business type, location, and size. For ordinary small businesses in major cities, fees can range from TZS 50,000 to TZS 500,000+ per year. Licences are renewed annually — the deadline is 31 March of the following year. Operating without an LGA business licence is an offence and can result in fines or business closure.

instruction: SDL — mwajiri anawasilisha fomu gani na wapi?
output: SDL inawasilishwa kwa TRA pamoja na PAYE katika mfumo mmoja wa malipo ya kodi: Fomu: TRA Form PB/SD (au fomu ya sasa inayotumiwa na TRA — hii inaweza kubadilika); Mfumo: Kupitia portal ya TRA online (IDRAS — Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System) au ofisi ya TRA ya karibu; Tarehe: 7 ya mwezi unaofuata; Taarifa muhimu: idadi ya wafanyakazi, jumla ya mishahara ya fedha, kiasi cha SDL (3.5% × mishahara). Malipo yanafanywa pia kupitia benki iliyoidhinishwa au mtandao. Kama una TIN, karibu una akaunti ya TRA online. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa fomu ya sasa.

instruction: Ninanunua bidhaa za chakula kutoka Tanzania — je, VAT inakatwa?
output: Bidhaa za chakula Tanzania zina matibabu mbalimbali ya VAT kulingana na aina: Zero-rated (0% VAT): mazao ya kilimo ya msingi yasiyosindikwa (nafaka, mboga za mashamba); dawa za dawa; mauzo ya nje ya nchi (exports). Exempt (hazilipwi VAT): baadhi ya bidhaa maalum zilizoorodheshwa na sheria. Standard rate (18% VAT): chakula kilichosindikwa, bidhaa za chakula zilizopakiwa, na chakula kutoka migahawa na hoteli. Kama unanunua mazao mabichi kutoka mkulima si lazima VAT. Ukiwa unanunua chakula kilichosindikwa kutoka kampuni ya VAT — utalipa VAT 18%. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa orodha ya bidhaa.

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa kigeni ana haki za kazi sawa na Watanzania chini ya ELRA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania kwa kibali halisi cha kazi ana haki za kimsingi za kazi chini ya Sheria ya Ajira na Mahusiano ya Kazini (ELRA) — ikiwa ni pamoja na haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A, likizo ya mwaka, ulinzi dhidi ya kufutwa kazi bila sababu, na nyinginezo. Uraia wake haunyimi haki za kimsingi za kazi.
question_en: Does a foreign worker have the same employment rights as Tanzanians under ELRA?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign worker lawfully employed in Tanzania with a valid work permit has basic employment rights under the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) — including the right to GN 605A minimum wage, annual leave, protection from unfair dismissal, and others. Their foreign nationality does not strip them of basic employment rights.

instruction: NSSF hailipi kwa wakati — mkurugenzi wa kampuni anaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi?
output: Ndiyo — TRA na NSSF zote zina uwezo wa kufuatilia wakurugenzi na maafisa wa kampuni kibinafsi kwa madeni yanayotokana na makosa ya makusudi. Kwa NSSF: kama kampuni inakusanya michango ya NSSF ya wafanyakazi (10% ya mshahara wa kila mfanyakazi) lakini haitumi NSSF — hii ni fedha ya wafanyakazi iliyoibwa. Wakurugenzi wanaohusika wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa: (1) Madeni ya NSSF yote + faini ya 5%/mwezi + riba; (2) Mashtaka ya jinai ya kughafiliana na haki za wafanyakazi. Wasiliana na NSSF mapema kabla ya hali kuwa mbaya. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz.

question_sw: WCF inamlipa mfanyakazi moja kwa moja au kupitia mwajiri?
answer_sw: WCF inalipa mfanyakazi MOJA KWA MOJA baada ya madai kukubaliwa — si kupitia mwajiri. Hii inazuia mwajiri kushikilia au kupunguza malipo ya fidia. Mwajiri ana jukumu la kuripoti na kufanya uchunguzi, lakini malipo ya fidia yanakuja moja kwa moja kutoka WCF.
question_en: Does WCF pay the worker directly or through the employer?
answer_en: WCF pays the worker DIRECTLY after claims are approved — not through the employer. This prevents the employer from withholding or reducing compensation payments. The employer's role is reporting and investigation, but compensation payments come directly from WCF.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: GN 487A na PAYE — je, mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A bado analazimishwa kulipa PAYE?
output: Ndiyo — hata biashara inayokiuka GN 487A bado ina wajibu wa kodi. Ukiukwaji wa GN 487A ni kosa la biashara/uhamiaji — hauathiri wajibu wa kodi wa TRA. TRA inaweza kuhitaji: (1) Malipo ya PAYE, VAT, SDL, na kodi nyingine zilizokusanywa wakati biashara ilikuwa ikifanya kazi (hata kama ilikuwa haramu); (2) TRA haitoi msamaha wa kodi kwa sababu biashara ilikuwa haramu. Mgeni anayefungwa kwa GN 487A bado anaweza kukabiliwa na madeni ya kodi ya TRA pamoja na adhabu ya GN 487A. Kwa hivyo mgeni ana tatizo mbili tofauti: GN 487A na kodi za TRA. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TRA.

question_sw: Raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia mgeni kufanya shughuli zilizopigwa marufuku ana hatari gani?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A: raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia mgeni kufanya shughuli zilizopigwa marufuku anakabili faini ya TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo cha miezi 3 gerezani. Hata kukodisha duka au akaunti ya benki kwa mgeni kwa madhumuni hayo kunaweza kufuatwa. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: What risk does a Tanzanian citizen face for helping a non-citizen conduct prohibited business?
answer_en: Under GN 487A: a Tanzanian facilitating a non-citizen's prohibited activities faces a TZS 5,000,000 fine or 3 months imprisonment. Even renting a shop or bank account to a foreigner for such purposes may be pursued. Confirm with a legal adviser.

question_sw: Mwajiri anapaswa kutoa mafunzo ya usalama kwa kila mfanyakazi mpya kabla ya kuanza kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA Act Tanzania inataka mwajiri kutoa mafunzo ya usalama na afya mahali pa kazi kwa wafanyakazi — hasa wafanyakazi wapya kabla ya kuanza kazi au kufanya kazi kwenye mazingira ya hatari. Mafunzo lazima yashughulikie: hatari za mahali pa kazi husika, jinsi ya kutumia PPE, taratibu za dharura, na hatua za kudhibiti hatari. Mwajiri lazima ahifadhi rekodi za mafunzo hayo.
question_en: Must an employer provide safety training to every new employee before starting work in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. The Tanzania OSHA Act requires employers to provide workplace safety and health training to workers — especially new workers before starting work or before working in hazardous environments. Training must cover: specific workplace hazards, how to use PPE, emergency procedures, and hazard control measures. The employer must keep records of that training.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

instruction: Biashara yangu inaingiza mapato ya TZS 250M kwa mwaka lakini VAT register haikuwahi kufanywa — ninafanyaje?
output: Unapaswa kujisajili VAT haraka iwezekanavyo — usijaribu kuficha au kuahirisha zaidi. Hatua za kufuata: (1) Nenda TRA na uwasilishe ombi la usajili wa VAT — eleza hali yako ya biashara; (2) TRA itaamua tarehe ya usajili (inaweza kuwa nyuma — 'back-date') kuanzia ulipofika kizingiti; (3) Utahitajika kulipa VAT ya nyuma + faini + riba ya kuchelewa; (4) Anza kutoza VAT kwa wateja wote mara VRN itakapotolewa. Hali hii ya kujisajili marehemu ni nzuri kuliko kuendelea bila usajili — unoona ushirikiano na TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi kwanza. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: EFD inahitajika kwa biashara za online peke yake (e-commerce, hakuna duka la mwili)?
output: EFD ya kawaida (ya mwili) inalenga biashara za mwili, lakini TRA inasasisha sheria kujumuisha biashara za kidijitali. Kwa biashara za online Tanzania: (1) Kama biashara imesajiliwa Tanzania na ina TIN — miongozo ya EFD inatumika; (2) TRA ina mfumo wa ETS (Electronic Tax Stamps) na TIMS ambao unaweza kutumika kwa mauzo ya kidijitali; (3) Biashara za e-commerce zinaweza kuhitaji invoice ya kielektroniki yenye TRA code badala ya risiti ya kawaida ya EFD. Mfumo wa EFD kwa e-commerce Tanzania uko katika hatua za maendeleo. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mwongozo maalum wa biashara yako ya kidijitali.

question_sw: Mtoa huduma wa nje ya nchi anayetoa huduma za kidijitali Tanzania — wajibu wake wa VAT ni nini?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, sheria ya VAT Tanzania inaweza kuhitaji watoa huduma wa kidijitali wa nje ya nchi wanaotoa huduma kwa wateja Tanzania kusajiliwa kwa VAT Tanzania. Hata hivyo, masharti maalum ya kizingiti cha usajili na mchakato wa utekelezaji yanategemea kanuni za TRA. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: A non-resident digital service provider supplying services to Tanzania — what are their VAT obligations?
answer_en: Generally, Tanzania VAT law may require non-resident digital service providers supplying services to Tanzanian customers to register for Tanzania VAT. However, specific registration threshold requirements and enforcement processes depend on TRA regulations. Verify with TRA or a tax advisor.

instruction: Daktari mwenye kliniki ndogo yenye mapato ya TZS 50M — je, lazima asajili VAT?
output: Inategemea aina ya huduma: huduma za afya (medical services) nyingi ziko katika kategoria ya VAT-exempt au zero-rated — kwa hivyo mapato ya TZS 50M kutoka huduma za afya peke yake yaweza yasikufikishe kizingiti cha VAT linaloweza kushughulikiwa. Hata hivyo, sheria ya TRA inasema wanachama wa taaluma fulani (lawyers, CPAs, engineers, architects) wanaweza kulazimishwa kusajili VAT hata bila kufika kizingiti — waangalifu kama daktari yumo katika orodha hii. Kwa hali ya daktari mwenye kliniki, jibu halisi linategemea aina ya huduma na orodha ya taaluma. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa hali yako maalum.

instruction: Kama mfanyakazi alijeruhiwa mahali pa kazi -- mwajiri lazima aripoti nani?
output: Mwajiri lazima aripoti ajali ya kazini kwa: (1) WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ndani ya siku 7 za kazi kwa kupitia portal.wcf.go.tz, na (2) OSHA kwa ukaguzi wa usalama. Magonjwa ya kazini yanaripotiwa WCF ndani ya siku 7 za kazi tangu tarehe ya utambuzi. Thibitisha utaratibu kamili na WCF (wcf.go.tz) na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: Ndoa na Mtanzania inabadilisha uraia wa mgeni haraka?
answer_sw: Hapana — ndoa peke yake haibadilishi uraia wa Tanzania haraka. Mchakato wa kupata uraia wa Tanzania unahusisha: maombi rasmi kwa Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani, kipindi cha makazi ya lazima (miaka kadhaa), na idhini ya Rais wa Tanzania. Ndoa inaweza kusaidia mchakato wa kupata uraia lakini si njia ya moja kwa moja au ya haraka. Hadi uraia unapatikana rasmi, mwenza wa ndoa bado ana hadhi ya mgeni.
question_en: Does marriage to a Tanzanian quickly change a non-citizen's citizenship?
answer_en: No — marriage alone does not quickly change Tanzanian citizenship. The process of obtaining Tanzanian citizenship involves: a formal application to the Ministry of Home Affairs, a mandatory residency period (several years), and Presidential approval. Marriage may facilitate the citizenship process but is not a direct or quick path. Until citizenship is formally granted, the non-citizen spouse retains non-citizen status.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Nitakayopata kama ninachelewesha annual return ya BRELA kwa mwaka mmoja ni nini?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Thibitisha ada halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz). Kabla ya hapo, wakati wowote — wasilisha sasa kuliko kuendelea kuchelewesha.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu alianguka na kuumia dukani — WCF inasaidiaje?
answer_sw: Taarisha WCF kuhusu ajali hii ndani ya siku saba (7) za kazi. WCF italipa: gharama za hospitali na dawa, na posho ya mfanyakazi wakati wa kupumzika kutokana na majeraha. Pia taarisha OSHA kama majeraha ni makubwa — ndani ya masaa 24. Hifadhi nyaraka zote za hospitali kama ushahidi.
question_en: My employee fell and was injured in the shop — how does WCF help?
answer_en: Report the accident to WCF within 7 working days. WCF will pay: hospital and medicine costs, and an allowance for the employee during recovery. Also notify OSHA if the injuries are serious — within 24 hours. Keep all hospital documents as evidence.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Nini kinatokea ikiwa kampuni itashindwa kulipa 1/3 ya kodi inayodaiwa kwa ajili ya pingamizi?
answer_sw: Ikiwa kampuni haikuweza kulipa 1/3 ya kiasi kinachodaiwa, pingamizi lake halikubaliwa na linachukuliwa kuwa halijatumwa. Tathmini inakuwa ya mwisho baada ya siku 30 kupita. Kampuni bado inaweza kuomba makubaliano ya malipo, lakini mchakato wa pingamizi wa kisheria utakuwa umefungwa.
question_en: What happens if a company fails to pay the 1/3 of the disputed tax for an objection?
answer_en: If a company cannot pay 1/3 of the disputed amount, the objection is not accepted and is treated as not filed. The assessment becomes final after 30 days pass. The company can still seek a payment arrangement, but the formal objection process will be closed.

question_sw: TRAB ni nini na inaendeshwa vipi?
answer_sw: TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) ni Bodi ya Rufaa ya Mapato ya Kodi Tanzania. Inashughulikia rufaa dhidi ya maamuzi ya TRA yaliyofanywa baada ya pingamizi. Waheshimiwa wa kisheria na wataalam wa kodi wanasikiliza hoja zote mbili. Mlipaji kodi ana siku 45 kuwasilisha rufaa kwa TRAB baada ya kupokea uamuzi wa Kamishna.
question_en: What is TRAB and how does it operate?
answer_en: TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) is Tanzania's Tax Revenue Appeals Board. It handles appeals against TRA decisions made following an objection. Legal members and tax experts hear arguments from both sides. The taxpayer has 45 days to file an appeal with TRAB after receiving the Commissioner's decision.

question_sw: Input VAT na Output VAT — tofauti yao nini?
answer_sw: Output VAT: VAT unayokusanya kutoka kwa wateja wako unapowauzia bidhaa/huduma — inakwenda TRA. Input VAT: VAT unayolipa kwa wanaokulaz bidhaa/huduma — inaweza kupunguzwa kutoka output VAT yako. Net VAT = Output VAT - Input VAT. Kama output > input, unatuma tofauti TRA. Kama input > output, una 'VAT credit' ambayo unaweza kubeba au kudai kama refund.
question_en: Input VAT and Output VAT — what is the difference?
answer_en: Output VAT: VAT you collect from your customers when you sell goods/services — it goes to TRA. Input VAT: VAT you pay to your suppliers — it can be deducted from your output VAT. Net VAT = Output VAT - Input VAT. If output > input, you remit the difference to TRA. If input > output, you have a 'VAT credit' which you can carry forward or claim as a refund.

question_sw: Je, kampuni mpya lazima ijisajili kwa VAT mara inapofungua biashara?
answer_sw: Hapana lazima mara moja, lakini lazima ufuatilie mauzo yako. Usajili wa lazima unafuata pale unapofika kizingiti: mauzo ya TZS 200M katika miezi 12, au TZS 100M katika miezi 6. Ukifikia kizingiti, una siku 30 za kujisajili. Huna budi kujisajili siku ya kwanza ya biashara — ila kwa hiari unaweza kufanya hivyo. Kiwango cha VAT utakacho zoza ni asilimia 18.
question_en: Must a new company register for VAT as soon as it opens?
answer_en: Not necessarily on day one, but you must monitor your turnover. Mandatory registration follows when you reach the threshold: TZS 200M in 12 months, or TZS 100M in 6 months. Once reached, you have 30 days to register. You do not have to register on the first day of business — though voluntary registration is possible. The VAT rate you will charge is 18%.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya jumla — ninahesabu vipi kama nifike kizingiti cha VAT kwa miezi 6?
output: Hesabu mauzo yako ya jumla (kabla ya kodi) kwa miezi 6 mfululizo yoyote — si lazima kuanza Januari. Kama jumla ya miezi 6 mfululizo inazidi TZS 100,000,000, umefika kizingiti na lazima usajiliwe VAT. Ongezeko la mauzo kwenye mfululizo wa miezi — linachozunguka kila mwezi — ndilo kinachoangaliwa. Wasiliana na wahasibu au mshauri wa kodi kukusaidia kuhesabu kwa usahihi.
