question_sw: Kibali cha Darasa C ni kwa wawekezaji wa muda wa miaka miwili — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Darasa C ni kibali cha kazi cha MUDA MFUPI kwa wageni wanaofanya kazi ya mkataba wa muda — si kwa wawekezaji. Wawekezaji wa miaka miwili wanatumia Darasa A. Darasa C kinatumika kwa wataalam wa muda mfupi, washauri wa kimataifa, au kazi za mradi wa muda.
question_en: Class C permit is for investors on a two-year period — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Class C is a SHORT-TERM work permit for foreigners doing fixed-term contract work — not for investors. Investors on a multi-year basis use Class A. Class C is for short-term specialists, international consultants, or project-based work.

question_sw: Msajiliwa wa VAT ambaye hajafikia kizingiti anapaswa kujisajili wenyewe — je, TRA anaweza kumsajili bila ombi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ikiwa Kamishna Mkuu ameridhika kwamba mtu anahitajika kusajiliwa VAT na ana sababu nzuri — ikiwemo kulinda mapato ya serikali — anaweza kumsajili bila ombi na kumwarifu ndani ya siku 14 baada ya usajili. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Can TRA register a business for VAT without an application?
answer_en: Yes. If the Commissioner General is satisfied that a person must register for VAT and there is good reason — including protection of government revenue — they can register that person without an application and notify them within 14 days of registration. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, TRA inaweza kukataa refund ya VAT — na kwa sababu gani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA inaweza kukataa madai ya VAT refund ikiwa: (1) Hati za kuunga mkono hazikamiliki au hazionekani kuwa za kweli; (2) Input VAT inahusiana na ununuzi wa kibinafsi, si biashara; (3) Wasambazaji hawakusajiliwa VAT au hawakulipa VAT wao; (4) Kuna tofauti kati ya VAT return na hati za kimwili; (5) Dalili za ulaghai wa VAT (VAT fraud). Weka kumbukumbu nzuri za biashara.
question_en: Can TRA refuse a VAT refund — and for what reasons?
answer_en: Yes. TRA can reject VAT refund claims if: (1) Supporting documents are incomplete or appear inauthentic; (2) Input VAT relates to personal rather than business purchases; (3) Suppliers were not VAT-registered or did not pay their own VAT; (4) Discrepancies between VAT return and physical documents; (5) Indications of VAT fraud. Maintain good business records.

instruction: Ningependa kuhama biashara yangu kutoka sole trader hadi kampuni limited. Nifanye nini?
output: Huwezi tu 'kubadilisha' sole trader hadi kampuni — lazima usajili kampuni mpya kwa BRELA na kisha uhamishe shughuli za biashara kwenda kampuni. Hatua: (1) sajili kampuni mpya kupitia ORS (ors.brela.go.tz); (2) fungua akaunti ya benki ya kampuni; (3) hamisha mikataba na wateja wa biashara; (4) update usajilishaji wa TRA na kodi; (5) sole trader ya zamani inaweza kubaki au kufungwa. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi na mwanasheria kwa uhamisho salama.

instruction: Kampuni yangu iko ndani ya EPZ (Export Processing Zone) Tanzania — mapumziko ya kodi (tax holiday) ni ya miaka mingapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Masharti ya kodi kwa kampuni ndani ya EPZ/SEZ yanashughulikiwa chini ya EPZ Act na EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority) — muda wa tax holiday na masharti mengine yanategemea aina ya biashara na mkataba na EPZA. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Wakurugenzi wa kampuni wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa faini za EFD?
output: Ndiyo — TRA ina uwezo wa kufuatilia wakurugenzi na maafisa wa kampuni kibinafsi kwa makosa ya makusudi ya kodi, ikiwa ni pamoja na ukiukwaji wa EFD. Hasa: kama kampuni imeendesha biashara kwa makusudi bila EFD au kutoa risiti bandia — wakurugenzi wanaohusika wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa: (1) Madeni ya kodi + faini ya kampuni; (2) Mashtaka ya jinai ya ukwepaji wa kodi. Hata kama kampuni ni ya hisa (limited liability), ulaghai wa kodi na ukwepaji wa makusudi unaweza kuondoa ulinzi wa limited liability. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kodi.

instruction: EFD yangu ilifunga (hung) usiku bila kupiga Z-report — hatua gani?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Hatua: (1) Washa tena EFD asubuhi ya mapema. (2) Piga Z-report haraka iwezekanavyo kabla ya mauzo mapya. (3) Kama EFD hifunguki, wasiliana na msambazaji wako wa EFD mara moja. (4) Andika rekodi ya mkono (manual record) kwa mauzo yoyote hadi EFD irudi kufanya kazi.

question_sw: Je, serikali ya mtaa (manispaa) inaweza kuzuia VAT kwenye malipo yake kwa wasambazaji?
answer_sw: NDIYO — serikali za mitaa, manispaa, na taasisi za serikali zote ni 'qualifying buyers' ambazo zinaweza kuzuia VAT. Zinazuia: (a) asilimia 3 ya VAT kwenye malipo ya bidhaa, au (b) asilimia 6 ya VAT kwenye malipo ya huduma. Serikali au taasisi lazima itoe hati ya zuio la VAT kwa msambazaji siku ambayo VAT inastahili kulipwa — si tarehe ya 20 ya mwezi.
question_en: Can a local government (municipality) withhold VAT from its payments to suppliers?
answer_en: YES — local governments, municipalities, and all government institutions are 'qualifying buyers' that can withhold VAT. They withhold: (a) 3% VAT on goods payments, or (b) 6% VAT on services payments. The government or institution must issue a VAT withholding certificate to the supplier on the day the VAT becomes payable — not on the 20th of the month.

question_sw: Bendi ya juu kabisa ya PAYE (30%) inaanza lini — ni kwa mapato yote zaidi ya TZS milioni moja?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — kiwango cha 30% kinatumika kwenye sehemu ya mapato INAYOPITA TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi. Mapato ya TZS 0-1,000,000 yanapigwa kodi kwa bendi tofauti (0%, 8%, 20%, 25%). Sehemu inayozidi TZS 1,000,000 tu ndiyo inaathiriwa na 30%. Kwa hivyo mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 1,500,000 atalipa 30% kwenye TZS 500,000 tu (sehemu inayopita TZS 1M), si kwenye TZS 1.5M yote.
question_en: When does the highest PAYE band (30%) start — is it on all income above TZS one million?
answer_en: Yes — the 30% rate applies to the portion of income EXCEEDING TZS 1,000,000 per month. Income from TZS 0 to 1,000,000 is taxed at different bands (0%, 8%, 20%, 25%). Only the portion exceeding TZS 1,000,000 is affected by 30%. So an employee earning TZS 1,500,000 will pay 30% on TZS 500,000 only (the portion above TZS 1M), not on the full TZS 1.5M.

question_sw: Je, STR inatumika kwenye bandari ya Dar es Salaam au mpakani wa nchi tu?
answer_sw: STR iliundwa kimsingi kwa biashara ya mpakani (land borders) kati ya nchi za EAC/COMESA. Bandari ya Dar es Salaam inahudumia biashara ya bahari ya kimataifa ambayo inatumia utaratibu tofauti wa forodha. Kwa biashara ndogo za mpakani wa ardhini (kama Namanga, Mutukula, Tunduma), STR ndiyo mfumo unaofaa.
question_en: Does STR apply at Dar es Salaam port or only at land borders?
answer_en: STR was designed primarily for land border trade between EAC/COMESA countries. Dar es Salaam port serves international sea trade which uses a different customs process. For small land border trade (such as Namanga, Mutukula, Tunduma), STR is the appropriate framework.

instruction: Wajibu wa kumwajiri mfanyakazi mpya kuhusu OSHA ni upi?
output: Kila mwajiri anapoanza kumwajiri mfanyakazi: (1) sajili mahali pa kazi na OSHA haraka (osha.go.tz); (2) fanya tathmini ya hatari kabla ya mfanyakazi kuanza kazi; (3) mfunze mfanyakazi hatari za usalama za kazi yake maalum; (4) mpe vifaa vya usalama vinavyohitajika; (5) mhakikishie mazingira salama ya kufanyia kazi. Kushindwa kufanya hivi kunaweza kusababisha faini ya TZS 1,000,000 hadi TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo.

question_sw: TRA inaweza kukagua biashara yangu bila notisi ya awali — je, hii inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka ya kukagua biashara bila notisi ya awali katika hali fulani. Hata hivyo, kwa ukaguzi wa kawaida wa hesabu (audit), TRA mara nyingi hutoa notisi na ratiba. Wakaguzi wa TRA wana haki ya kuangalia rekodi za kodi, akaunti za benki, na hati za biashara.
question_en: Can TRA audit my business without prior notice — is this permitted?
answer_en: Yes. TRA has authority to audit a business without prior notice in certain circumstances. However, for a routine accounts audit, TRA usually provides notice and a schedule. TRA auditors have the right to examine tax records, bank accounts, and business documents.

question_sw: NSSF Tanzania ina mipaka ya chini ya mchango — je, kuna kiwango cha chini?
answer_sw: Hakuna kiwango cha chini cha shilingi kilichowekwa kisheria kwa michango ya NSSF. Mchango ni asilimia ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla — 20% (mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10%). Hata mfanyakazi anayepata mshahara mdogo sana analipa NSSF kwa asilimia hiyo hiyo. Kiwango cha chini cha mshahara (GN 605A — TZS 175,000-765,900 kulingana na sekta) kinaathiri kiwango cha chini cha mshahara, si hesabu ya NSSF.
question_en: Does NSSF have a minimum contribution floor?
answer_en: There is no legally prescribed minimum shilling amount for NSSF contributions. The contribution is a percentage of gross wage — 20% (employer 10% + employee 10%). Even an employee earning a very low wage pays NSSF at that same percentage. The minimum wage (GN 605A — TZS 175,000-765,900 by sector) affects the minimum wage payable, not the NSSF calculation.

question_sw: Je, SDL inaweza kulipwa kama sehemu ya mshahara wa mfanyakazi bila ya kumjulisha?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL ni ushuru wa mwajiri unaolipwa TRA — si sehemu ya mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Kuiingiza kwenye mshahara wa mfanyakazi bila idhini ni kosa la kisheria. Mfanyakazi ana haki ya kupata mshahara wake kamili na mwajiri analipa SDL kando.
question_en: Can SDL be paid as part of an employee's salary without informing them?
answer_en: No. SDL is an employer levy paid to TRA — it is not part of the employee's salary. Including it in the employee's payroll without consent is a legal error. The employee is entitled to their full salary and the employer pays SDL separately.

question_sw: Mwajiri mpya — lini anapaswa kusajili NSSF?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mpya anapaswa kusajili NSSF mara tu anapoanza kuajiri wafanyakazi. Usajili unafanywa kupitia Lango la Huduma la NSSF (NSSF Self Service Portal) au ofisi yoyote ya NSSF. Thibitisha tarehe na mahitaji ya usajili na NSSF.
question_en: When must a new employer register with NSSF?
answer_en: A new employer must register with NSSF as soon as they start employing workers. Registration is done through the NSSF Self Service Portal or any NSSF office. Confirm the registration timeline and requirements with NSSF.

question_sw: Je, ninahitaji kuwasilisha ripoti ya kila mwaka (annual return) kwa BRELA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Makampuni yaliyosajiliwa na BRELA yanahitajika kuwasilisha annual return kila mwaka kumpa BRELA taarifa za hivi karibuni za kampuni — ikiwa ni pamoja na majina ya wakurugenzi, anwani ya ofisi ya makao makuu, na maelezo ya wamiliki wa hisa. Kushindwa kuwasilisha annual return kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha faini au hata kufutwa kwa usajilishaji wa kampuni. Thibitisha tarehe ya kufunga (deadline) ya annual return yako na BRELA.
question_en: Do I need to file an annual return with BRELA?
answer_en: Yes. Companies registered with BRELA are required to file an annual return each year to keep BRELA's records updated — including names of directors, registered office address, and shareholder details. Failing to file the annual return on time can result in fines or even deregistration of your company. Confirm the annual return deadline with BRELA.
next_review_trigger: When Companies Act annual return requirements are amended

question_sw: Biashara ya usafirishaji (taxi, bodaboda) inahitaji EFD Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara za usafirishaji wa abiria kama bodaboda na taxi zimekuwa nje ya listi ya lazima ya EFD kwa kawaida — hasa kwa madereva wa kujitegemea wenye mauzo madogo. Hata hivyo, kampuni kubwa za usafirishaji zilizosajili VAT au zile TRA zilizotamua lazima zitumie EFD. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa ufafanuzi wa hali yako ya biashara ya usafirishaji.
question_en: Does a transport business (taxi, bodaboda) need an EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: Passenger transport businesses like bodaboda and taxis have generally been outside the mandatory EFD list — especially for independent drivers with small turnover. However, large transport companies that are VAT-registered or those directed by TRA must use an EFD. Check TRA directly for clarification for your specific transport business situation.

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi kinahuishwa mara ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Vibali vya kazi Tanzania kwa kawaida vina muda wa miaka miwili na vinahuishwa kabla ya kumalizika. Mwajiri anapaswa kuomba uhuishaji angalau miezi 3 kabla ya tarehe ya kumalizika. Kushindwa kuhuisha kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha mfanyakazi kuwa na hali ya haramu Tanzania.
question_en: How often is a work permit renewed in Tanzania?
answer_en: Tanzania work permits typically have a 2-year validity and are renewed before expiry. The employer should apply for renewal at least 3 months before the expiry date. Failure to renew on time can result in the worker becoming undocumented in Tanzania.

question_sw: NSSF return inawasilishwa kwa njia gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: NSSF return (orodha ya malipo ya michango) inawasilishwa: (1) Kwa njia ya mtandao kupitia mfumo wa NSSF Online (nssf.go.tz); (2) Ofisini — kwa kuleta fomu na malipo ya moja kwa moja; (3) Benki zilizoidhinishwa. Malipo yanaweza kufanywa kwa njia ya benki, simu za mkononi, au ofisi ya NSSF. Tarehe ya mwisho: ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla.
question_en: How is an NSSF return submitted in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF returns (contribution payment schedules) are submitted: (1) Online through the NSSF Online system (nssf.go.tz); (2) In-person — by bringing forms and direct payment to an NSSF office; (3) At authorised banks. Payments can be made by bank, mobile money, or at an NSSF office. Deadline: within one month after the salary month. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage.

question_sw: Je, raia wa kigeni anaweza kufanya biashara ya uhamisho wa pesa za simu (mobile money)?
answer_sw: Hapana. Uhamisho wa pesa za simu (mobile money transfers) ni mojawapo ya makundi 15 yaliyopigwa marufuku kwa raia wa kigeni chini ya GN 487A, kuanzia 28 Julai 2025. Biashara ya wakala wa mobile money (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa na kadhalika) inahifadhiwa kwa raia wa Tanzania tu. Raia wa kigeni anayeendelea na biashara hii anakabiliwa na faini ya chini ya TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji au wakili.
question_en: Can a non-citizen operate a mobile money transfer business in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Mobile money transfers is one of the 15 categories prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A from 28 July 2025. Mobile money agent businesses (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, etc.) are reserved for Tanzanian citizens only. A non-citizen continuing this business faces a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. Confirm with the Immigration Services Department or a lawyer.

question_sw: NSSF na NHIF — ni mifumo tofauti au moja?
answer_sw: Ni mifumo MIWILI TOFAUTI ya hifadhi ya jamii. NSSF (National Social Security Fund): pensheni na manufaa ya muda mrefu — inafadhiliwa na michango ya mwajiri (10%) na mfanyakazi (10%). NHIF (National Health Insurance Fund): bima ya afya — inafadhiliwa kwa njia tofauti. Wafanyakazi wa sekta binafsi kawaida wanchangia NSSF; watumishi wa serikali wanaweza kuchangia NHIF. Ni mifumo miwili tofauti yenye mamlaka tofauti.
question_en: NSSF and NHIF — are they different or the same scheme?
answer_en: They are TWO DIFFERENT social security systems. NSSF (National Social Security Fund): pension and long-term benefits — funded by employer (10%) and employee (10%) contributions. NHIF (National Health Insurance Fund): health insurance — funded differently. Private sector employees typically contribute to NSSF; government employees may contribute to NHIF. They are two separate systems with different authorities.

instruction: Nataka kufunga biashara yangu ya sole trader. Niwasiliane na nani?
output: Kufunga biashara ya sole trader (business name) inayohusisha kusimamisha usajilishaji wa BRELA: (1) wasiliana na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kupata fomu za kufuta usajilishaji; (2) hakikisha kodi zote za TRA zimelipwa — TRA lazima ithibitishe kutokuwa na madeni; (3) wasilisha nyaraka za kufunga BRELA; (4) pata uthibitisho wa kufutwa. Usisahau pia kusasisha leseni nyingine zozote za biashara.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: OSHA na WCF ni chombo kimoja cha serikali Tanzania — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. OSHA na WCF ni vyombo TOFAUTI vya serikali: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inasimamia usalama na afya mahali pa kazi — inakagua, inadhibiti, na inasimamia. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni mfuko wa bima ya ajali za kazi — inalipa fidia kwa wafanyakazi walioumia. Mwajiri analazimika kusajili NA OSHA NA WCF kwa madhumuni tofauti.
question_en: OSHA and WCF are the same government body in Tanzania — is this correct?
answer_en: No. OSHA and WCF are SEPARATE government bodies: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) supervises workplace safety and health — it inspects, regulates, and enforces. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is a workplace accident insurance fund — it pays compensation to injured workers. An employer must register with BOTH OSHA and WCF for different purposes.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act or WCF Act amendment

question_sw: Kodi ya mwaka ya makato ya PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa Shilingi 8,000,000 kwa mwezi inahesabiwaje?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 8,000,000 kwa mwezi, PAYE inahesabika kwa kanda kama ifuatavyo: Shilingi 0: kanda ya asilimia sifuri (hadi 270,000). Shilingi 270,001–520,000 = Shilingi 250,000 × 8% = Shilingi 20,000. Shilingi 520,001–760,000 = Shilingi 240,000 × 20% = Shilingi 48,000. Shilingi 760,001–1,000,000 = Shilingi 240,000 × 25% = Shilingi 60,000. Zaidi ya 1,000,000 = Shilingi 7,000,000 × 30% = Shilingi 2,100,000. Jumla ya PAYE = Shilingi 2,228,000 kwa mwezi.
question_en: How is monthly PAYE calculated for an employee earning TZS 8,000,000 per month?

question_sw: Kanda ya juu kabisa ya PAYE ni asilimia 35 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kanda ya juu kabisa ya PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 30 — si asilimia 35. Kiwango cha asilimia 30 kinatumika kwa mapato yanayozidi Shilingi 1,000,000 kwa mwezi. Kiwango cha asilimia 35 hakipo katika muundo wa PAYE wa Tanzania.
question_en: The top PAYE band is 35% — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The top PAYE band in Tanzania is 30% — not 35%. The 30% rate applies to income above TZS 1,000,000 per month. A 35% rate does not exist in Tanzania's PAYE structure.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zingine (zisizoorodheshwa DSE) ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya gawio kwa kampuni zisizoorodheshwa DSE ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Kama kampuni inayopokea gawio inamiliki zaidi ya asilimia 25 ya hisa — kiwango ni asilimia 5. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends from non-DSE-listed companies is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. If the recipient company holds 25%+ of shares — the rate is 5%. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: SDL na WCF — zote zinalipiwa TRA?
output: SDL = asilimia 3.5 → TRA → waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. WCF = asilimia 0.5 → Mamlaka ya WCF → WAAJIRI WOTE (hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi 1). Tofauti kubwa: WCF haina kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi — mwajiri yeyote analipa. Hapana — zinawasilishwa kwa mamlaka tofauti. SDL → TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority): tra.go.tz WCF → Mamlaka ya WCF (Workers' Compensation Fund): portal.wcf.go.tz Usipeleke WCF kwa TRA au SDL kwa WCF — ni malipo kwa taasisi tofauti kabisa.

question_sw: Gawio (dividends) linalolipwa kwa mwanachama wa kampuni mgeni — WHT ni ngapi?
answer_sw: Gawio kwa wanahisa wa nje ya nchi (non-resident dividends) linabeba withholding tax. Kiwango cha kawaida ni 10% kwa wanahisa wasio na makazi — lakini DTA inaweza kupunguza hadi chini. Sina uhakika wa viwango vyote vya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa.
question_en: Dividends paid to a foreign company shareholder — what is the WHT rate?
answer_en: Dividends to non-resident shareholders carry withholding tax. The standard rate for non-resident shareholders is typically 10% — but a DTA may reduce this. I am not certain of all current rates. Verify with TRA or an international tax advisor.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa misingi ya mkataba (contract) — mshahara wake unajumuishwa kwenye SDL?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali ya mkataba. Mfanyakazi wa mkataba anayepewa mshahara wa kawaida na mwajiri wake (employee relationship) — mshahara wake unajumuishwa kwenye SDL. Mkandarasi anayejitegemea (self-employed contractor) anayetoa ankara — mara nyingi haingii kwenye SDL. Muundo sahihi wa kisheria ndio unaotoa jibu.
question_en: A contract worker — is their salary included in SDL?
answer_en: It depends on the contract arrangement. A contract employee receiving regular salary from their employer (employee relationship) — their salary is included in SDL. An independent self-employed contractor who issues invoices — typically not included in SDL. The exact legal structure determines the answer.

question_sw: Wafanyabiashara wanaofanya biashara nyumbani (home-based business) Tanzania bado wanahitaji leseni ya LGA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa ujumla. Biashara inayofanywa nyumbani bado inachukuliwa kama biashara ya kibiashara inayohitaji leseni ya LGA ikiwa inafanya shughuli za kibiashara za mara kwa mara. Ukweli kwamba biashara inafanywa nyumbani haubadilishi wajibu wa kisheria wa biashara. Angalia LGA yako kwa taratibu maalum za leseni ya biashara ya nyumbani — baadhi ya LGA zina kategoria maalum ya bei nafuu.
question_en: Do home-based business operators in Tanzania still need an LGA licence?
answer_en: Yes generally. A home-based business is still considered a commercial business requiring an LGA licence if it conducts regular commercial activities. The fact that the business operates from home does not change business legal obligations. Check your LGA for specific home-based business licence procedures — some LGAs have special lower-cost categories.

question_sw: Mhandisi aliyepewa leseni ya kufanya kazi Tanzania — kizingiti cha TZS 200M kinamhusu?
answer_sw: Hapana — kizingiti cha TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 ni kwa biashara za kawaida, si kwa mhandisi aliyeidhinishwa (registered engineer). Mhandisi lazima asajili VAT kama sehemu ya mahitaji ya kufanya kazi kisheria Tanzania. TRA imeweka sharti hili kwa fani zinazohitaji leseni maalum za kitaalamu kwa sababu huduma zao zinazalisha mapato makubwa na zinapaswa kuwa katika mfumo wa kodi.
question_en: A licensed engineer in Tanzania — does the TZS 200M threshold apply to them?
answer_en: No — the TZS 200M per 12-month threshold is for ordinary businesses, not for a registered engineer. An engineer must register for VAT as part of the requirements to practise legally in Tanzania. TRA has set this requirement for professions requiring special professional licences because their services generate significant revenue and should be within the tax system.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT rules for professionals

question_sw: Naweza kulipa mshahara mdogo rasmi na kiasi kikubwa kwa njia nyingine ili kupunguza NSSF?
answer_sw: Hapana — hii ni ukiukwaji wa kisheria wenye hatari kubwa. NSSF na TRA wanaweza kufanya ukaguzi wa malipo yote ya wafanyakazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na mobile money na benki. Kulipa mshahara mdogo rasmi kwa makusudi ili kupunguza NSSF kunachukuliwa kuwa udanganyifu. Adhabu zinajumuisha riba, faini nzito, na uwezekano wa mashtaka ya jinai kwa wakurugenzi. Lipa NSSF kwa usahihi kila mwezi. Wasiliana na NSSF kwenye nssf.go.tz.
question_en: Can I pay a lower official salary and extra amounts through other channels to reduce NSSF contributions?
answer_en: No — this is a serious legal violation. NSSF and TRA can audit all employee payments including mobile money and bank transfers. Deliberately understating official salaries to reduce NSSF is treated as fraud. Consequences include interest, heavy fines, and potential criminal prosecution of company directors. Pay NSSF accurately every month. Contact NSSF at nssf.go.tz.

instruction: Ninaacha mfanyakazi baada ya miezi 3 — NSSF yake inaenda wapi?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. NSSF ya mfanyakazi aliyeacha kazi: michango iliyokusanyika inabaki kwenye akaunti yake ya NSSF. Mfanyakazi anaweza kudai faida za NSSF anapofika umri wa kustaafu (60 kwa kawaida). Pia anaweza kudai faida za muda wa kati kama vile matibabu (kwa makampuni fulani). Mwajiri lazima atoe hati za NSSF kwa mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi.

instruction: Mwajiri alipata faini ya SDL ya TZS 2.5% kwa kila mwezi wa kuchelewa -- hii ni sahihi?
output: Thibitisha kiwango sahihi cha adhabu moja kwa moja na TRA (tra.go.tz) -- kiwango cha asilimia 2.5 kwa mwezi kinaweza kuwa sahihi lakini lazima kithibitishwe na TRA kwani adhabu zinaweza kubadilika. Epuka kutegemea takwimu zinazosambazwa bila kuthibitisha chanzo cha msingi. Wasiliana na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyesajiliwa.

instruction: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kupeleka VAT iliyokatwa TRA ni lini?
output: Withholding agent lazima apeleke VAT iliyokatwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa manunuzi. Kwa mfano, ikiwa ulinunua mwezi Januari, malipo ya withheld VAT yanatakiwa ifikapo tarehe 20 Februari. Tarehe 20 pia ni tarehe ya kuwasilisha VAT return — wajibu hizi mbili zinafanana kwa tarehe.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ilianza 2022 na haijawahi kuwasilisha annual return — hatari gani inanisubiri?
output: Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Kuanzia 2022 hadi 2026 ni karibu miaka 4 — faini inakusanyika kwa kila mwezi. Zaidi ya miaka 2 ya kukosa, BRELA ina mamlaka ya kufuta kampuni kwenye orodha. Wasiliana na BRELA haraka kujua hali ya kampuni yako na jinsi ya kurekebisha.

question_sw: Je, biashara ya mtandaoni ya Tanzania inayouza kwa wateja nje ya Tanzania inahitaji EFD?
answer_sw: Mauzo ya nje ya Tanzania (exports) kwa wateja wa nje ya nchi yanaweza kuwa zero-rated kwa VAT — yaani VAT ya asilimia 0. Hata hivyo, biashara bado inahitaji kuandika muamala huu kwenye mfumo wake wa VAT na EFD/VFD. Taarifa za muamala wa zero-rated bado zinapelekwa TRA kupitia VFD. Risiti/invoice inatolewa kwa mteja wa nje — kwa kiwango cha asilimia 0 — na inawasilishwa kwenye VAT return kama mauzo ya zero-rated.
question_en: Does a Tanzanian online business selling to customers outside Tanzania need EFD?
answer_en: Sales outside Tanzania (exports) to foreign customers may be zero-rated for VAT — meaning 0% VAT. However, the business still needs to record these transactions in its VAT and EFD/VFD system. Zero-rated transaction data is still transmitted to TRA through the VFD. A receipt/invoice is issued to the foreign customer — at 0% — and reported on the VAT return as zero-rated sales.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu ana kazi mbili — kampuni yangu na kampuni nyingine. Je, NSSF inalipwa mara mbili?
answer_sw: Kwa mfanyakazi mwenye waajiri wawili, kila mwajiri analipa NSSF kwa sehemu ya mshahara wake: mwajiri 10% na mfanyakazi 10% = jumla 20% kwa kila chanzo cha mshahara. Kwa mfano: Kampuni A inalipa 10% ya TZS 500,000, Kampuni B inalipa 10% ya TZS 300,000 — jumla ya michango inakuwa 20% ya kila mshahara, si 20% ya jumla. Mfanyakazi anatoa namba moja ya NSSF kwa waajiri wote. Michango yote inaenda kwenye akaunti moja ya NSSF ya mfanyakazi.
question_en: My employee has two jobs — my company and another company. Is NSSF paid twice?
answer_en: For an employee with two employers, each employer pays NSSF on their portion of the salary: employer 10% plus employee 10% = total 20% from each salary source. Example: Company A pays 10% of TZS 500,000, Company B pays 10% of TZS 300,000 — contributions are 20% of each salary separately, not 20% of the combined total. The employee provides one NSSF number to all employers. All contributions go into the employee's single NSSF account.

question_sw: Shirika lisilo la faida (NGO au asasi ya kiraia) linalipa SDL?
answer_sw: NGO na asasi za kiraia zilizosajiliwa rasmi zinaweza kupata msamaha wa SDL — lakini si kwa kiotomatiki. Mashirika lazima yathibitishe hadhi yao ya msamaha kwa TRA kila mwaka. Ikiwa NGO inaajiri wafanyakazi na inalipa mishahara, na bado haina msamaha rasmi wa maandishi kutoka TRA, wajibu wa SDL unabaki. Mashirika yanayopokea msamaha lazima yathibitishe mwaka kwa mwaka kwamba bado yanastahili.
answer_en: NGOs and civil society organisations that are formally registered may qualify for SDL exemption — but not automatically. Organisations must confirm their exemption status with TRA annually. If an NGO employs staff and pays salaries, and does not yet have a formal written exemption from TRA, the SDL obligation remains. Organisations receiving exemption must confirm annually that they still qualify.
question_en: Does a non-profit organisation (NGO or civil society) pay SDL?

question_sw: OSHA inatumika tu kwa viwanda na miundombinu ya uzalishaji, si ofisi — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana, si kweli. OSHA ya 2003 inatumika kwa MAHALI POTE pa kazi Tanzania, ikiwa ni pamoja na ofisi, maduka, hospitali, shule, na mahali pengine. Sheria ya zamani ya Viwanda (1950) ilikuwa ya viwanda tu, lakini OSHA 2003 iliongeza wigo hadi mahali pa kazi yote.
question_en: OSHA only applies to factories and production facilities, not offices — is this true?
answer_en: No, this is false. OSHA 2003 applies to ALL workplaces in Tanzania including offices, shops, hospitals, schools, and other settings. The old Factories Ordinance (1950) was factory-specific, but OSHA 2003 expanded coverage to all workplaces.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: GN 487A inasema mgeni atafungwa miezi 6 — hii ni lazima au korti inaweza kutoa chini ya miezi 6?
answer_sw: Kifungo cha miezi 6 ni KIWANGO CHA JUU — si lazima. GN 487A inasema 'kisichozidi miezi 6' maana yake korti inaweza kutoa siku 1, mwezi 1, miezi 3, au hadi miezi 6 kulingana na hali. Kwa faini, GN 487A inasema 'isiyopungua TZS 10M' — hapa korti haiwezi kutoa chini ya 10M. Kwa hivyo faini ina kiwango cha chini (lazima angalau 10M) lakini kifungo hakina kiwango cha chini kilichowekwa.
question_en: GN 487A says a non-citizen will be imprisoned for 6 months — is this mandatory or can the court give less than 6 months?
answer_en: The 6-month imprisonment is a MAXIMUM — not mandatory. GN 487A says 'not exceeding 6 months' meaning a court may give 1 day, 1 month, 3 months, or up to 6 months depending on circumstances. For the fine, GN 487A says 'not less than TZS 10M' — here the court cannot give less than 10M. So the fine has a mandatory minimum (at least 10M) but imprisonment has no stated minimum.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Bidhaa zangu zinaenda Kenya — VAT inahesabiwa kwa kiwango cha ngapi?
answer_sw: Mauzo ya bidhaa nje ya Tanzania (exports) yanabeba kiwango cha VAT cha 0% (zero-rated). Hii inamaanisha haukusanyi VAT kutoka kwa mnunuzi wa Kenya. Hata hivyo, ununuzi wako wa bidhaa hizo ndani ya Tanzania ulibeba input VAT ya 18% — ambayo unaweza kudai refund yake baadaye.
question_en: My goods are going to Kenya — what VAT rate is applied?
answer_en: Sales of goods outside Tanzania (exports) carry a 0% VAT rate (zero-rated). This means you do not collect VAT from the Kenyan buyer. However, your purchase of those goods within Tanzania carried 18% input VAT — which you can claim back as a refund.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Mwajiri mwenye matawi mengi atalipa NSSF ofisi ipi?
answer_sw: Michango ya waajiri wenye ofisi zaidi ya mkoa mmoja inalipwa kwenye Ofisi ya NSSF ambayo mchango ulipelekwa. Ofisi za kikanda zinahitajika kushirikiana ili kuhakikisha uzingatiaji wa mwajiri mwenye matawi tofauti. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Which NSSF office does a multi-branch employer pay contributions to?
answer_en: Contributions for employers with offices in more than one region are accounted for at the NSSF office where the contribution was remitted. Regional offices must cooperate to ensure compliance of employers with different branches. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Wakati gani mfanyabiashara anapata haki ya kudai refund ya VAT?
answer_sw: Haki ya kudai refund ya VAT inatokea wakati INPUT VAT inazidi OUTPUT VAT kwa kipindi cha uwasilishaji (mwezi au robo mwaka). Hali hii mara nyingi hutokea kwa: (1) Wauza bidhaa nje ya nchi (exporters) — mauzo yao yana VAT 0% lakini wananunua bidhaa na VAT ya kawaida; (2) Biashara mpya inayonunua vifaa vingi kabla ya kuanza mauzo; (3) Biashara inayonunua mali ghali (kama mashine) na VAT kubwa ya awali.
question_en: When does a business become entitled to claim a VAT refund?
answer_en: Entitlement to a VAT refund arises when INPUT VAT exceeds OUTPUT VAT for a filing period (monthly or quarterly). This commonly happens for: (1) Exporters — their sales carry 0% VAT but they buy goods with regular VAT; (2) New businesses buying a lot of equipment before sales start; (3) Businesses buying expensive assets (like machinery) with a large upfront VAT.

instruction: Kwa invoice ya TZS 1,000,000 ya bidhaa, serikali itakata kiasi gani cha VAT withholding?
output: Kiasi kinachofaa kukatwa kinategemea kiwango cha withholding kilichowekwa na TRA kwa bidhaa. Kwa hesabu sahihi, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Kumbuka: VAT ya invoice ya TZS 1,000,000 kwa kiwango cha kawaida cha 18% ni TZS 180,000 — sehemu ya hiyo ndiyo inayokatwa kulingana na kiwango cha withholding. Kwa hesabu halisi, thibitisha na TRA kwa hesabu sahihi.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya VAT withholding na VAT ya kawaida ni nini?
answer_sw: VAT ya kawaida: msambazaji ananunuliwa bidhaa/huduma kwa bei pamoja na VAT ya asilimia 18, kisha yeye analipa VAT hiyo TRA kwenye return yake ya kila mwezi (mwisho wa 20). VAT withholding: mnunuzi aliyepewa leseni anazuia sehemu ya VAT (asilimia 3 kwa bidhaa, 6 kwa huduma) na kuipeleka TRA moja kwa moja — kabla msambazaji hajalipa. Kiwango cha VAT yenyewe ni asilimia 18 daima.
question_en: What is the difference between VAT withholding and normal VAT?
answer_en: Normal VAT: the supplier charges the buyer the price plus 18% VAT, then remits that VAT to TRA on their monthly return (due 20th). VAT withholding: the licensed buyer withholds a portion of VAT (3% on goods, 6% on services) and remits it directly to TRA — before the supplier pays. The VAT rate itself is always 18%.

question_sw: Ikiwa kampuni haikukata WHT inayostahili, nani atabeba adhabu — kampuni au mpokeaji?
answer_sw: KAMPUNI (mlipaji) ndiye atabeba adhabu ya kutokukata WHT. TRA inaweza kudai WHT iliyokosekana, adhabu ya ucheleweshaji (2.5% kwa mwezi), na riba ya kisheria kutoka kwa kampuni — si kwa mpokeaji. Hii ndiyo sababu ni muhimu kwa kampuni kufuatilia WHT yote kwenye malipo yanayostahili.
question_en: If a company failed to deduct required WHT, who bears the penalty — the company or the recipient?
answer_en: The COMPANY (payer) bears the penalty for failure to deduct WHT. TRA can demand the unpaid WHT, late payment penalty (2.5% per month), and statutory interest from the company — not from the recipient. This is why it is critical for companies to track all WHT on qualifying payments.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ankara ya VAT (VAT invoice) na risiti ya EFD Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Ankara ya VAT (VAT invoice) na risiti ya EFD ni nyaraka tofauti lakini zinaweza kufanya kazi pamoja: Risiti ya EFD ni uthibitisho wa malipo uliotolewa na mashine ya EFD. Ankara ya VAT ni hati ya biashara inayoonyesha maelezo ya bidhaa/huduma, kiasi cha VAT, na TIN za pande zote — inahitajika kwa madai ya input VAT. Biashara nyingi zinatoa risiti ya EFD NA ankara ya VAT pamoja kwa wateja wa biashara (B2B). Kwa wateja wa kawaida (B2C), risiti ya EFD inatosha.
question_en: What is the difference between a VAT invoice and an EFD receipt in Tanzania?
answer_en: A VAT invoice and an EFD receipt are different documents but can work together: An EFD receipt is proof of payment issued by the EFD machine. A VAT invoice is a commercial document showing details of goods/services, VAT amount, and both parties' TINs — required for input VAT claims. Most businesses issue both an EFD receipt AND a VAT invoice together for business customers (B2B). For regular customers (B2C), the EFD receipt is sufficient.

instruction: Kama mnunuzi anayehitimu, nikose kukata VAT — ninakabiliwa na nini?
output: Kushindwa kukata VAT kama withholding agent ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya VAT Act. TRA inaweza kukuamrisha kulipa kiasi kilichokosekana pamoja na riba na faini. Lazima uhakikishe mfumo wako wa malipo una withholding procedure sahihi. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi ili ujue wajibu wako kamili.

question_sw: Niliuza ardhi yangu kwa TZS 80M — capital gains tax (kodi ya mapato ya mtaji) ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) kwenye ardhi ni mada ngumu inayohitaji maarifa ya kina ya sheria ya mapato ya Tanzania — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Suala hili linahusisha: thamani ya ununuzi wa awali, muda wa umiliki, aina ya ardhi (title deed vs hati nyingine), na msamaha wa kisheria unaowezekana. Muona wakili au mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu.
question_en: I sold my land for TZS 80M — how much is the capital gains tax?
answer_en: Capital gains tax on land is a complex topic requiring detailed knowledge of Tanzanian income tax law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. This matter involves: the original purchase value, ownership period, type of land documentation, and possible legal exemptions. Consult a qualified lawyer or tax accountant.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment on capital gains

question_sw: Kiwango cha chini kabisa cha mshahara chini ya GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha chini kabisa kwa sekta ya jumla ni karibu TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi. Viwango vinafikia hadi TZS 765,900 kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Thibitisha kiwango halisi cha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: What is the lowest minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: The lowest minimum wage for the general sector is approximately TZS 175,000 per month. Rates reach up to TZS 765,900 for the international mining and energy sector. Confirm your sector's exact rate with MLYWF.

question_sw: Nakala ya GN 487A inapatikana wapi ili niisomee?
answer_sw: Nakala kamili ya GN 487A inapatikana bure kwenye TanzLII.org (Tanzania Legal Information Institute) kwa anwani: https://tanzlii.org/akn/tz/act/gn/2025/487a/eng@2025-07-28. Pia inaweza kupatikana kwenye Tanzania Government Gazette rasmi. Kwa msaada wa uhalisi, makampuni ya kisheria kama Bowmans, Dentons, DLA Piper, na VELMA Law wamechapisha muhtasari wa GN 487A kwenye tovuti zao — lakini ushauri wao si mbadala wa kusoma amri yenyewe au kupata ushauri wa wakili binafsi.
question_en: Where can I find a copy of GN 487A to read it myself?
answer_en: The full text of GN 487A is available free of charge at TanzLII.org (Tanzania Legal Information Institute) at: https://tanzlii.org/akn/tz/act/gn/2025/487a/eng@2025-07-28. It is also available in the official Tanzania Government Gazette. For practical guidance, law firms such as Bowmans, Dentons, DLA Piper, and VELMA Law have published summaries of GN 487A on their websites — but their advisories are not a substitute for reading the Order itself or getting your own legal advice.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 1,200,000 kwa mwezi — inakokotolewa vipi?
output: Mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara TZS 1,200,000/mwezi — hesabu ya PAYE: Band 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 → kodi = TZS 0. Band 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 (yaani TZS 520,000−270,000) × 8% = TZS 20,000. Band 3 (20%): TZS 240,000 (yaani TZS 760,000−520,000) × 20% = TZS 48,000. Band 4 (25%): TZS 240,000 (yaani TZS 1,000,000−760,000) × 25% = TZS 60,000. Band 5 (30%): TZS 200,000 (yaani TZS 1,200,000−1,000,000) × 30% = TZS 60,000. JUMLA ya PAYE = 0 + 20,000 + 48,000 + 60,000 + 60,000 = TZS 188,000/mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Kodi ya mapato ya kampuni inalipwa mwishoni mwa mwaka wa fedha tu — hakuna malipo ya kati ya mwaka — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kampuni za Tanzania zinalazimika kulipa kodi ya awali (provisional tax) kwa awamu NNE sawa katika mwaka wa fedha — mwishoni mwa miezi ya 3, 6, 9, na 12 kutoka mwanzo wa mwaka wa fedha. Malipo ya awali yanakokotolewa kwa asilimia 100 ya kodi ya mwaka uliopita au makadirio ya mwaka wa sasa.
question_en: Corporate income tax is only paid at the end of the financial year — no mid-year payments — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Tanzania companies are required to pay provisional tax in FOUR equal instalments during the financial year — at the end of months 3, 6, 9, and 12 from the start of the financial year. Provisional instalments are calculated at 100% of the previous year's tax or an estimate of the current year.

question_sw: Kodi ya stempu (stamp duty) ni nini na nyaraka gani zinaathirika nazo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kodi ya stempu ni ushuru unaolipwa kwa hati maalum zinazotajwa kwenye Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu (Stamp Duty Act, Cap. 189). Hati zinazohitaji kodi ya stempu ni pamoja na: mikataba ya manunuzi ya mali isiyohamia (ardhi/nyumba), makubaliano ya kukodi (lease/tenancy agreements), uhamishaji wa hisa za kampuni, makubaliano ya mikopo, hati za kuasisi ushirika, na mamlaka ya mwakilishi (power of attorney). Hati isiyopigwa stempu haiwezi kutumika kama ushahidi mahakamani.
answer_en: Stamp duty is a tax paid on specified documents listed under the Stamp Duty Act (Cap. 189). Documents requiring stamp duty include: conveyances of immovable property (land/buildings), lease and tenancy agreements, transfer of company shares, loan agreements, partnership deeds, and powers of attorney. A document without stamp duty cannot be admitted as evidence in court.
question_en: What is stamp duty and which documents are subject to it in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty — Stamp Duty Act Cap.189
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to stamp duty schedule

question_sw: TRAB na mahakama ya kawaida (High Court) vinafanana — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) ni bodi maalum ya kodi iliyoundwa chini ya Sheria ya Rufaa ya Mapato ya Kodi. Mahakama ya Juu (High Court) ni mahakama ya jumla. Rufaa za kodi lazima zianze TRAB kabla ya kwenda mahakama. Kutokupitia TRAB kwanza ni kukosa mchakato wa kawaida wa kisheria.
question_en: TRAB and the ordinary court (High Court) are the same — is this true?
answer_en: No. TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) is a specialist tax board established under the Tax Revenue Appeals Act. The High Court is a general court. Tax appeals must start at TRAB before going to court. Bypassing TRAB is a failure to follow the proper legal process.

instruction: Bonasi ya mwisho wa mwaka inalipwa kwa fedha — inaingizwa kwenye SDL base?
output: Ndiyo — bonasi inayolipwa kwa FEDHA inaingizwa kwenye SDL base kwa mwezi ilipokwa. SDL inajumuisha malipo yote ya fedha kwa wafanyakazi, ikijumuisha: mshahara wa msingi, posho za fedha (allowances), bonasi za fedha, na malipo mengine ya fedha. Bonasi ya mwisho wa mwaka inalipwa kwa fedha — hivyo inaongezwa kwenye SDL base ya mwezi huo. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Ninaendesha mkahawa mdogo na wafanyakazi 12 — OSHA inanifikiria?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mkahawa wenye wafanyakazi 12 unazidi kizingiti cha OSHA cha wafanyakazi 10. Lazima usajili mkahawa wako na OSHA na upate cheti cha OSHA. Pia unahitaji msaada wa kwanza (first aid kit) na kuhakikisha jiko na mazingira ya kazi ni salama.
question_en: I run a small café with 12 staff — does OSHA apply to me?
answer_en: Yes. A café with 12 employees exceeds the OSHA threshold of 10. You must register your café with OSHA and obtain an OSHA certificate. You also need first aid supplies and must ensure the kitchen and working environment are safe.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Mpango mbadala wa NSSF (15%/5%) unafanya kazi vipi?
answer_sw: Badala ya mgawanyo wa kawaida wa 10%/10%, mwajiri anaweza kulipa asilimia 15 na mfanyakazi asilimia 5. Jumla bado ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi. Mpango huu unaruhusiwa chini ya Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How does the alternative NSSF arrangement (15%/5%) work?
answer_en: Instead of the standard 10%/10% split, the employer may pay 15% and the employee 5%. The total remains 20% of gross wage. This arrangement is permitted under the NSSF Act Section 12. Confirm with NSSF.

instruction: EFD yangu imeharibika usiku — ninaweza kuendelea na biashara bila EFD hadi asubuhi?
output: Kuharibu kwa EFD ni tatizo linalohitaji hatua haraka: (1) Wasiliana na TRA AU muuzaji wa EFD wako HARAKA IWEZEKANAVYO — TRA inasaidia kushughulikia EFD zilizovunjika; (2) Wakati EFD iko nje ya huduma, andika rekodi za mikono za muamala wote kwa makini — orodha ya kila mauzo; (3) Unapoweza, ingiza rekodi hizo kwenye EFD mpya au iliyotengenezwa; (4) Usiendelee na biashara bila rekodi yoyote — hii itaonekana kama ukwepaji wa kodi. TRA inatoa mwongozo maalum wa jinsi ya kushughulikia EFD zilizovunjika — wasiliana nao. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mwajiriwa wa kujitegemea (self-employed contractor) anaweza kusajili NSSF peke yake Tanzania bila mwajiri?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mtu wa kujitegemea (self-employed) au mfanyabiashara ambaye si mwajiriwa wa mtu mwingine anaweza kusajili NSSF kama mwanachama anayejichangia (voluntary member). Mwanachama wa hiari analipa mchango wote mwenyewe (si kutenganishwa kati ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi). Hii inakuruhusu kupata manufaa ya NSSF ya pensheni na manufaa mengine baadaye. Angalia NSSF kwa masharti ya usajili wa hiari.
question_en: Can a self-employed contractor register with NSSF on their own in Tanzania without an employer?
answer_en: Yes. A self-employed person or business person who is not employed by someone else can register with NSSF as a voluntary contributing member. A voluntary member pays the full contribution themselves (not split between employer and employee). This allows them to access NSSF pension and other benefits later. Check NSSF for voluntary registration conditions.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

instruction: BRELA annual return — deadline ni wakati gani wa mwaka?
output: Hakuna tarehe maalum ya 30 Septemba kwa annual returns za BRELA — tarehe inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni yako. Annual return inapaswa kuwasilishwa kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni yako (anniversary date) — si lazima mwaka wa kifedha. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa tarehe yako halisi. Kila kampuni ina tarehe yake maalum inayohusiana na tarehe ya mwisho wa mwaka wake wa biashara. Mbinu bora: ingia kwenye mfumo wa BRELA online mara baada ya mwisho wa mwaka wako wa biashara.

question_sw: Ninapata mshahara wa TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi. Ni akiba gani ninayopaswa kufanya?
answer_sw: Samahani — ninashughulikia maswali ya kodi na usajili wa biashara Tanzania, si ushauri wa kibinafsi wa fedha (personal financial advice). Kwa mwongozo wa akiba na uwekezaji wa kibinafsi, wasiliana na benki yako, mshauri wa fedha aliyesajiliwa, au taasisi kama FINCA, NMB, au CRDB. Je, una swali kuhusu kodi au usajili wa biashara ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: I earn TZS 1,000,000 per month. What savings should I make?
answer_en: I am sorry — I handle Tanzania tax and business registration questions, not personal financial advice. For personal savings and investment guidance, contact your bank, a registered financial adviser, or institutions like FINCA, NMB, or CRDB. Is there a tax or business registration question I can help you with?

question_sw: WCF ya asilimia 0.5 inakatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi kila mwezi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WCF ya asilimia 0.5 HAIJATOLEWA kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Ni mchango wa MWAJIRI peke yake ambao unalipwa kutoka pochi ya mwajiri — si kutoka kwa mfanyakazi. Mfanyakazi hapotezi chochote kwenye mshahara wake kutokana na WCF.
question_en: The 0.5% WCF is deducted from the employee's monthly salary — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The 0.5% WCF is NOT deducted from the employee's salary. It is the EMPLOYER'S contribution paid entirely from the employer's own funds — not from the employee. The employee loses nothing from their salary due to WCF.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Input VAT inaweza kudaiwa kwa ununuzi wa bidhaa na huduma zote?
answer_sw: Hapana. Si input VAT yote inaweza kudaiwa. Kwa ujumla, input VAT inayodaiwa lazima iwe kwa ununuzi wa biashara tu — si matumizi ya kibinafsi. Ununuzi wa gari la kibinafsi, chakula cha kibinafsi, au matumizi yasiyohusiana na biashara haustahili input VAT credit. TRA inaweza kukataa madai ya input VAT yasiyokuwa ya biashara.
question_en: Can input VAT be claimed on all purchases of goods and services?
answer_en: No. Not all input VAT can be claimed. Generally, claimable input VAT must relate to business purchases only — not personal use. Purchasing a personal car, personal food, or expenses unrelated to business do not qualify for input VAT credit. TRA can reject input VAT claims not related to business.

instruction: Je, biashara yangu inahitaji ukaguzi wa OSHA kila mwaka?
output: Ndiyo. Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Usalama na Afya Kazini (OHS Act No.5 of 2003), OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa kila mwaka wa mahali pa kazi yote Tanzania. Hii inatumika kwa biashara zote -- bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Thibitisha mahitaji ya ukaguzi na tarehe za leseni yako na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: Biashara inaweza kudai VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) bila risiti ya EFD ya muuzaji Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, TRA inashikilia kwamba kudai input VAT kunahitaji risiti halisi ya EFD au ankara ya VAT iliyotolewa na muuzaji aliyesajili VAT. Bila risiti ya EFD au ankara halisi ya VAT, madai ya input VAT yanaweza kukataliwa na TRA wakati wa ukaguzi. Hifadhi risiti zote za EFD na ankara za VAT kutoka kwa wasambazaji wako kwa angalau miaka 5.
question_en: Can a business claim input VAT without an EFD receipt from the supplier in Tanzania?
answer_en: Generally, TRA requires that claiming input VAT be supported by a genuine EFD receipt or a VAT invoice issued by a VAT-registered supplier. Without an EFD receipt or genuine VAT invoice, input VAT claims can be rejected by TRA during audit. Keep all EFD receipts and VAT invoices from your suppliers for at least 5 years.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kutumia wakili binafsi katika kesi ya TRAB — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mlipaji kodi ana haki ya kuwakilishwa na wakili, mshauri wa kodi, au mwakilishi mwingine aliyeidhinishwa katika kesi za TRAB. TRA pia ina washauri wake. Kuwa na uwakilishi mzuri wa kisheria kunaweza kuathiri sana matokeo ya kesi.
question_en: Can a company use a private lawyer in a TRAB case — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. A taxpayer has the right to be represented by a lawyer, tax adviser, or other authorised representative in TRAB proceedings. TRA also has its own counsel. Having strong legal representation can significantly affect the outcome of a case.

question_sw: Je, WHT inaathiri mkataba wa makubaliano ya biashara (business agreement) vipi?
answer_sw: Mtu anayeingia mkataba wa biashara Tanzania anapaswa kuzingatia WHT katika mahesabu ya bei. Kwa mfano, ikiwa ada ya ushauri ni Shilingi 1,000,000 na WHT ni asilimia 5, mshauri atapokea Shilingi 950,000 na mwajiri atalipa Shilingi 50,000 TRA. Mikataba inapaswa kuainisha wazi kama bei ni kabla au baada ya WHT.
question_en: How does WHT affect a business contract agreement?
answer_en: A person entering a business contract in Tanzania must factor WHT into pricing. For example, if a consulting fee is TZS 1,000,000 and WHT is 5%, the consultant receives TZS 950,000 and the payer remits TZS 50,000 to TRA. Contracts should clearly state whether prices are gross (before) or net (after) WHT.

question_sw: Mteja alinipa malipo ya M-Pesa usiku — je, ninatoa risiti kesho asubuhi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Risiti ya EFD inapaswa kutolewa wakati wa muamala au mara baada ya kupokea malipo — si kesho. Kuchelewesha kutoa risiti kwa sababu malipo yalipokelewa usiku ni ukiukaji wa kanuni za EFD. EFD za kisasa zinaweza kutoa risiti usiku. Ikiwa EFD haikuweza kutumika usiku, tumia stakabadhi ya mkono ya dharura na uandike risiti ya EFD asubuhi ukiiingiza muamala wa usiku.
question_en: A customer sent me M-Pesa payment at night — can I issue the receipt the next morning?
answer_en: No. An EFD receipt should be issued at the time of the transaction or immediately upon receiving payment — not the following day. Delaying receipt issuance because payment was received at night is a violation of EFD rules. Modern EFDs can issue receipts at night. If the EFD was unavailable at night, use an emergency manual receipt and issue the EFD receipt in the morning, entering the night-time transaction.

question_sw: Nithibitishe kiwango cha mshahara wa chini wa sekta yangu — niende wapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha mshahara wa chini kwa sekta yako kinapatikana: (1) Tovuti ya MLYWF (mlywf.go.tz) au ofisi yoyote ya kazi; (2) TanzLII (tanzlii.org) — tafuta 'GN 605A'; (3) Shirika la wafanyakazi au chama cha waajiri cha sekta yako. Thibitisha kiwango halisi kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: How do I verify the minimum wage for my specific sector under GN 605A?
answer_en: The minimum wage for your sector is available at: (1) MLYWF website (mlywf.go.tz) or any labour office; (2) TanzLII (tanzlii.org) — search 'GN 605A'; (3) Your sector's trade union or employers' association. Confirm the exact rate before processing payroll.

question_sw: Bidhaa yangu ipo kwenye Common List lakini imezalishwa China — ninapata STR?
answer_sw: Hapana. Uhalali wa STR unahitaji ORIGINATING STATUS — bidhaa lazima izalishwe ndani ya nchi wanachama wa EAC/COMESA. Bidhaa iliyozalishwa China haistahili STR hata kama aina yake ipo kwenye Common List. Masharti yote mawili — asili ya ndani (originating) NA imo kwenye Common List — lazima yakidhiwe.
question_en: My product is on the Common List but was made in China — do I get STR benefits?
answer_en: No. STR eligibility requires ORIGINATING STATUS — goods must be produced within EAC/COMESA member states. Goods produced in China do not qualify for STR even if their category is on the Common List. Both conditions — domestic origin (originating) AND on the Common List — must be satisfied.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: WHT kwa ada za mkurugenzi (director fees) kwa wakazi ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha WHT kwa ada za mkurugenzi wa Tanzania ni asilimia 15 kwa wakazi NA wasio wakazi. TRA inatumia kiwango kimoja cha asilimia 15 kwa ada za mkurugenzi (wasio mkurugenzi wa wakati wote) — hakuna tofauti kati ya mkazi na asiye mkazi. WHT inakatwa na kampuni kabla ya kulipa mkurugenzi.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on director fees for residents?
answer_en: The WHT rate on director fees (non-full-time directors) in Tanzania is 15% for both RESIDENTS and NON-RESIDENTS. TRA applies a single rate of 15% — there is no resident/non-resident split for director fees. WHT is deducted by the company before paying the director.

question_sw: Je, lazima nitoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala, hata mdogo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara iliyosajiliwa VAT lazima itoe fiscal receipt ya EFD kwa kila muamala wa mauzo, bila kujali kiasi. Kutotoa risiti ni kosa la kisheria chini ya sheria za VAT Tanzania. Wateja wana haki ya kudai risiti ya EFD, na wewe una wajibu wa kutoa. Usisubiri mteja akuulize — toa risiti ya EFD moja kwa moja baada ya muamala kukamilika.
question_en: Must I issue an EFD receipt for every transaction, even small ones?
answer_en: Yes. A VAT-registered business must issue an EFD fiscal receipt for every sales transaction, regardless of the amount. Failing to issue a receipt is a legal offence under Tanzania's VAT laws. Customers have the right to demand an EFD receipt, and you have the obligation to provide one. Do not wait for the customer to ask — issue the EFD receipt immediately after each transaction.

instruction: OSHA inatumika kwa biashara ndogo — wafanyakazi wachache?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hata duka lenye mfanyakazi 1 linahitaji kufuata kanuni za OSHA. Mahitaji ya msingi kwa maeneo yote: Mazingira salama ya kufanyia kazi, mwanga wa kutosha, usafi, upatikanaji wa maji. Usajili na OSHA (osha.go.tz) unahitajika kwa biashara zote.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba (interest) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on interest in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on interest is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: VAT withholding ya 6% ya huduma — inalipwa TRA lini?
output: Qualifying buyer anayechukua VAT withholding ya 6% ya huduma analipa TRA VAT withholding inalipwa TRA tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata — siku ile ile ya VAT return ya kawaida. Si siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz. Hii ni tofauti na kuwasilisha VAT return ya kawaida (tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata). VAT withholding inalipwa TRA tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata — siku ile ile ya VAT return ya kawaida. Si siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz. Qualifying buyer ana wajibu mbili: (1) Kuweka withholding certificate; (2) Kutuma kiasi kilichokatwa TRA ndani ya muda uliowekwa. Kushindwa kutuma ni kosa la kodi kwa qualifying buyer. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Kiwango cha mchango wa WCF ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha mchango wa WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara wote wa wafanyakazi (gross emoluments). Mchango huu unalipwa na MWAJIRI peke yake — mfanyakazi hakatiwi chochote. Mwajiri analipa asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara yote.
question_en: What is the WCF contribution rate?
answer_en: The WCF contribution rate is 0.5% of total employee wages (gross emoluments). This contribution is paid by the EMPLOYER only — the employee has nothing deducted. The employer pays 0.5% of total payroll.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: GN 605A ya mishahara ya chini ni nini na ilianza lini?
output: GN 605A ni Agizo la Serikali (Government Notice No.605A) linaloamua viwango vya mishahara ya chini kwa sekta binafsi Tanzania. Liligazetishwa tarehe 13 Oktoba 2025 na lilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Linaghairi na kubadilisha kabisa Amri ya Mishahara ya 2022. GN 605B haipo -- amri sahihi ni GN 605A. Thibitisha na VELMA Law au PKF Eastern Africa.

question_sw: Personal relief ya PAYE inapatikana kwa wafanyakazi wageni?
answer_sw: Personal relief ya TZS 270,000/mwezi (TZS 3,240,000/mwaka) kwa kawaida inapatikana kwa wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi Tanzania — raia na wageni wenye hali ya makazi ya kawaida. Hata hivyo, hali ya personal relief kwa wasio na makazi (non-residents) inaweza kutofautiana. Thibitisha na TRA kwa hali maalum ya mfanyakazi wako.
question_en: Is the PAYE personal relief available to foreign employees?
answer_en: Personal relief of TZS 270,000/month (TZS 3,240,000/year) is generally available to employees working in Tanzania — citizens and foreigners with regular residence status. However, personal relief treatment for non-residents may differ. Verify with TRA for your employee's specific situation.

instruction: Niliuza gari langu la biashara na kupata faida — capital gains tax inatumika?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa mali za biashara kama magari inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania kulingana na hali ya mali hiyo. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa hesabu halisi, kiwango, na utaratibu wa kuripoti kwa TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Je, TRA inaweza kuangalia historia ya risiti zangu zote za EFD?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina upatikanaji wa moja kwa moja kwa seva ya TRA inayohifadhi taarifa za risiti zote za EFD ulizotoa. Kwa hivyo TRA inaweza kuangalia risiti zote za zamani, kuhesabu mauzo yako ya jumla, na kulinganisha na VAT returns ulizowahi kuwasilisha. Hii ndiyo nguvu kuu ya mfumo wa EFD — kuruhusu TRA kufanya ukaguzi wa kina bila ya lazima kuwepo ofisini kwako.
question_en: Can TRA view the history of all my EFD receipts?
answer_en: Yes. TRA has direct access to the TRA server that stores all your EFD receipt data. Therefore TRA can view all historical receipts, calculate your total sales, and compare with VAT returns you have submitted. This is the core strength of the EFD system — allowing TRA to conduct detailed audits without necessarily being physically present at your business.

instruction: Mwajiri wangu anasema atalipa NSSF yote mwenyewe — hii ni halali?
output: Ndiyo, hii ni halali. Mwajiri anaweza kulipa NSSF yote (asilimia 20) bila kukata sehemu ya mfanyakazi — hii ni mgawanyo wa 20%+0%. Sheria ya NSSF inaruhusu mgawanyo wa 10+10, 15+5, au 20+0. Mfanyakazi hapigwi marufuku kupata manufaa haya. Hata hivyo, jumla ya asilimia 20 ya mshahara lazima iwasilishwe NSSF bila kujali mgawanyo uliochaguliwa.

question_sw: Adhabu ya Mtanzania anayemsaidia mgeni kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa ni nini — ni sawa na ya mgeni?
answer_sw: Hapana — adhabu ya msaidizi Mtanzania ni TOFAUTI kabisa na ya mgeni: faini ya ISIYOZIDI TZS 5,000,000 AU kifungo kisichozidi miezi 3 — si zote mbili pamoja. Tofauti kuu tatu: (1) kiasi: 5M si 10M; (2) muundo: AU (si NA); (3) hakuna kufutwa kwa visa kwa sababu Mtanzania si mgeni.
question_en: Is the penalty for a Tanzanian who helps a non-citizen conduct a prohibited business the same as for the non-citizen?
answer_en: No — the Tanzanian facilitator's penalty is completely DIFFERENT from the non-citizen's: a fine NOT EXCEEDING TZS 5,000,000 OR imprisonment not exceeding 3 months — not both together. Three key differences: (1) amount: 5M not 10M; (2) structure: OR not AND; (3) no visa revocation because the Tanzanian is not a foreigner.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni yangu haina wafanyakazi wa kulipa mwezi huu. Je, lazima niwasilishe return ya PAYE (nil return)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Hata kama hakuna mshahara uliojulishwa mwezi huo, mwajiri aliyesajiliwa kwa PAYE lazima awasilishe return ya PAYE (nil return) ikionyesha maelezo yenye 'hakuna malipo' — yaani return inayoonyesha TZS 0 kwa mwezi huo. Kushindwa kuwasilisha nil return kunaweza kusababisha adhabu za kuchelewa kana kwamba kulikuwa na PAYE ya kulipa. Ili kuepuka adhabu hizi, wasilisha nil return kwa wakati hata wakati hakuna mshahara.
answer_en: Yes. Even if no salary was paid that month, an employer registered for PAYE must file a nil PAYE return showing 'no payments' — i.e. a return declaring TZS 0 for that month. Failure to file a nil return may attract late filing penalties as if PAYE was due. To avoid these penalties, file a nil return on time even when there is no payroll.
question_en: My company has no employees to pay this month. Must I still file a PAYE return (nil return)?

instruction: TRA inaweza kunipiga faini kwa kutokuwa na EFD wakati mauzo yangu yako TZS 15M kwa mwaka?
output: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Ndio — TRA ina mamlaka ya kukupiga faini kwa kutotumia EFD ukiwa umepitisha kizingiti cha TZS 11M. Faini za EFD zinaweza kuwa nzito: TRA inaweza kupiga faini ya kutoa risiti za uongo au kutokuwasilisha risiti kabisa. Nunua na usajili EFD haraka iwezekanavyo ukiwa umepitisha TZS 11M kwa mwaka.

instruction: Kama msambazaji niliyesajiliwa VAT, naweza kudai pembejeo ya VAT (input VAT) baada ya withholding?
output: Ndiyo. VAT iliyokatwa na mnunuzi anayehitimu inaweza kudaiwa kama pembejeo (input VAT credit) kwenye VAT return yako kwa kutumia certificate ya withholding. Serikali kama mbia wako itakupa certificate inayothibitisha kiasi kilichokatwa. Hati hii ni ushahidi wako rasmi wa pembejeo ya VAT.

question_sw: Je, biashara yangu lazima isajiliwe na OSHA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kwa mujibu wa sheria ya Tanzania, waajiri wenye mahali pa kazi (workplace) wanawajibika kusajilisha mazingira yao ya kazi na OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority). OSHA inasimamia usalama wa mahali pa kazi — usajilishaji unakupa leseni ya kufanya kazi katika mazingira yanayotimiza viwango vya usalama. Thibitisha mahitaji ya usajilishaji kwa biashara yako maalum na OSHA kwenye osha.go.tz.
question_en: Does my business need to be registered with OSHA?
answer_en: Yes. Under Tanzanian law, employers with a workplace are required to register their working environment with OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority). OSHA oversees workplace safety — registration gives you a licence to operate in an environment that meets safety standards. Confirm registration requirements for your specific business with OSHA at osha.go.tz.
primary_source_name: Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Msimbo wa kurudisha bidhaa (return/refund) kwenye EFD Tanzania unafanyaje?
answer_sw: Ikiwa mteja anarudisha bidhaa na biashara lazima imrudishie pesa, EFD ina utaratibu maalum wa kurekodi muamala wa kurudi (credit note/return transaction). Hii inapunguza jumla ya mauzo na VAT iliyorekodiwa kwa kipindi hicho. KAMWE usifute muamala uliokwisha fanywa — tumia utaratibu wa credit note wa EFD. Kufuta muamala badala ya kutumia credit note ni kosa la uzingatiaji wa EFD.
question_en: How is a product return/refund handled on an EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: If a customer returns goods and the business must refund them, the EFD has a specific procedure to record the return transaction (credit note/return transaction). This reduces the total sales and VAT recorded for that period. NEVER delete a completed transaction — use the EFD's credit note procedure. Deleting a transaction instead of using a credit note is an EFD compliance error.

question_sw: Mnunuzi wa jumla (wholesale buyer) anaomba invoice ya kawaida badala ya risiti ya EFD. Je, hii inakubalika?
answer_sw: Invoice ya biashara (commercial invoice) inaweza kutumika pamoja na risiti ya EFD — si badala yake. Kwa mauzo ya jumla, unaweza kutoa invoice ya kawaida NA risiti ya EFD kwa muamala mmoja. Risiti ya EFD bado inahitajika kwa mauzo yote yanayotozwa VAT — hata kwa biashara ya jumla. Unaweza kusanidi EFD yako kutoa 'fiscal invoice' inayojumuisha taarifa zote za invoice na risiti ya EFD pamoja.
question_en: A wholesale buyer requests a regular invoice instead of an EFD receipt. Is this acceptable?
answer_en: A commercial invoice can be used alongside an EFD receipt — not instead of it. For wholesale sales, you can issue a regular invoice AND an EFD receipt for one transaction. An EFD receipt is still required for all VAT-taxable sales — even for wholesale business. You can configure your EFD to issue a 'fiscal invoice' that combines all invoice information with the EFD receipt.

instruction: Trademark iliyosajiliwa BRELA — inalindwa Tanzania Bara tu au Zanzibar pia?
output: Trademark iliyosajiliwa BRELA inalinda Tanzania Bara peke yake — BRELA ni mamlaka ya Tanzania Bara tu. Zanzibar ina mfumo wake tofauti wa kisheria. Kwa ulinzi wa kikanda (nchi nyingi), unaweza kutumia ARIPO inayojumuisha Tanzania Bara na nchi nyingine. Kwa biashara inayofanya kazi Zanzibar pia, wasiliana na mamlaka za Zanzibar kuhusu ulinzi wa IP. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

question_sw: EFD ina tofauti gani na mfumo wa POS wa kawaida wa kompyuta wa duka?
answer_sw: POS (Point of Sale) ya kawaida ya kompyuta ni mfumo wa biashara wa ndani unaosaidia kusimamia mauzo, stoo, na wateja — lakini haupeleki data moja kwa moja kwa TRA. EFD ni kifaa kilichoidhinishwa na TRA kinachounganishwa moja kwa moja na mfumo wa TRA na kurekodia data ya kodi. Biashara nyingi zinatumia mifumo MIWILI: POS ya biashara kwa usimamizi wa biashara, NA EFD ya TRA kwa uzingatiaji wa kodi.
question_en: What is the difference between an EFD and a regular computer POS system in a shop?
answer_en: A regular computer POS (Point of Sale) is an internal business system that helps manage sales, stock, and customers — but it does not transmit data directly to TRA. An EFD is a TRA-approved device connected directly to TRA's system that records tax data. Many businesses use TWO systems: a business POS for business management, AND a TRA EFD for tax compliance.

instruction: Mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara TZS 1,200,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE yake ni ngapi?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 1,200,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000
Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 240,000 × 25% = TZS 60,000
Bendi 5 (30%): TZS 200,000 × 30% = TZS 60,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 188,000/mwezi
TZS 200,000 ya ziada juu ya TZS 1,000,000 iko Bendi 5 (30%) = TZS 60,000.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kulipa mchango wote wa NSSF 20% bila kukata sehemu ya mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri anaweza kuchagua kulipa mchango wote wa asilimia 20 bila kukata sehemu ya mfanyakazi (asilimia 10) kutoka mshahara wake. Hii ni chaguo la mwajiri — si lazima lakini inaruhusiwa na Sheria ya NSSF. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: Can an employer pay the full 20% NSSF contribution without deducting the employee's share?
answer_en: Yes. An employer may choose to remit the full 20% contribution without deducting the employee's share (10%) from their wage. This is the employer's option — not mandatory but permitted under the NSSF Act. Confirm with NSSF.

instruction: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kupeleka malipo ya NSSF ni lini kila mwezi?
output: Malipo ya NSSF inayopelekwa lazima ifikapo mwishoni mwa mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa malipo ya mishahara. Kwa mfano, mishahara ya Januari — NSSF inayopelekwa ifikapo mwishoni mwa Februari. Kwa tarehe halisi ya mwisho ya sasa, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz) moja kwa moja kwani tarehe inaweza kubadilika.

question_sw: EAC free trade area na STR — ni nini tofauti?
answer_sw: EAC Free Trade Area (FTA): inafuta ushuru wa forodha kati ya nchi wanachama kwa bidhaa zinazotimiza masharti ya asili (rules of origin) — mfumo wa kimataifa wa biashara. EAC/COMESA STR (Simplified Trade Regime): mfumo maalum kwa wafanyabiashara WADOGO (threshold USD 2,000, bidhaa ~370) zinazokusudia kupunguza urasimu wa forodha kwa biashara ndogo. FTA ni kwa biashara yoyote; STR ni kwa biashara ndogo maalum.
question_en: EAC free trade area and STR — what is the difference?
answer_en: EAC Free Trade Area (FTA): eliminates customs duties between member states for goods meeting rules of origin — a general international trade framework. EAC/COMESA STR (Simplified Trade Regime): a special scheme for SMALL traders (USD 2,000 threshold, ~370 goods) designed to reduce customs bureaucracy for small trade. FTA is for any business; STR is specifically for small traders.

question_sw: Mchango wa WCF ni asilimia 1 ya mshahara wa mfanyakazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango sahihi cha mchango wa WCF ni asilimia 0.5 — si asilimia 1. Asilimia 0.5 inakokotolewa kutoka kwa jumla ya mshahara wote wa wafanyakazi (gross emoluments). Kiwango cha asilimia 1 ni kosa — si sahihi chini ya sheria.
question_en: The WCF contribution is 1% of employee salary — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The correct WCF contribution rate is 0.5% — not 1%. The 0.5% is calculated on total gross employee wages (gross emoluments). A rate of 1% is incorrect under the law.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya certificate ya BRELA na TIN kutoka TRA ni nini?
answer_sw: Hizi ni nyaraka tofauti kabisa, na biashara yako inahitaji zote mbili. Certificate ya BRELA: inathibitisha biashara yako imesajiliwa kisheria Tanzania — inakupa haki ya kufanya biashara rasmi. TIN (Tax Identification Number) kutoka TRA: nambari yako ya mlipakodi wa kodi — inatumika kulipa kodi (PAYE, VAT, SDL na kadhalika) na kuwasilisha returns zako. BRELA inasajilisha biashara yenyewe; TRA inasajilisha biashara yako kwa ajili ya kodi. Usisajilishe moja na uache nyingine.
question_en: What is the difference between a BRELA certificate and a TIN from TRA?
answer_en: These are two completely different documents, and your business needs both. BRELA certificate: confirms your business is legally registered in Tanzania — it gives you the right to trade formally. TIN (Tax Identification Number) from TRA: your tax registration number — used to pay taxes (PAYE, VAT, SDL, etc.) and file your returns. BRELA registers the business entity itself; TRA registers it for tax purposes. Do not register with one and skip the other.

question_sw: Uganda ina kizingiti gani cha usajili wa VAT?
answer_sw: Samahani, sijui kuhusu mfumo wa VAT Uganda. Ninasaidia maswali ya Tanzania Bara tu. Kwa Uganda, wasiliana na Uganda Revenue Authority (URA) kwa ura.go.ug. Je, una swali kuhusu VAT Tanzania? Kizingiti cha VAT Tanzania ni TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6.
question_en: What is the VAT registration threshold in Uganda?
answer_en: I am sorry, I do not cover Uganda's VAT system. I assist with Mainland Tanzania questions only. For Uganda, contact the Uganda Revenue Authority (URA) at ura.go.ug. Do you have a question about Tanzania VAT? Tanzania's threshold is TZS 200,000,000 per 12 months or TZS 100,000,000 per 6 months.

question_sw: Kampuni ndogo isiyolipa kodi kwa wakati inapata adhabu ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Adhabu za kuchelewa kwa Tanzania zinategemea aina ya kodi: PAYE: asilimia 2.5 kwa mwezi wa kiasi kilichochelewa. VAT: asilimia 2 kwa mwezi + faini ya mara moja ya asilimia 25. NSSF: asilimia 5 kwa mwezi. SDL: adhabu kama PAYE. Adhabu hizi zinaendelea kujilimbikiza kila mwezi hadi kiasi kimelipwa. Kutofungua faili kabisa kunaweza kusababisha ukaguzi wa TRA na tathmini za kodi.
question_en: What penalties does a small company face for late tax payment in Tanzania?
answer_en: Late payment penalties in Tanzania depend on the tax type: PAYE: 2.5% per month of the overdue amount. VAT: 2% per month plus a one-time 25% penalty. NSSF: 5% per month. SDL: penalties similar to PAYE. These penalties compound every month until the amount is paid. Failing to file at all can trigger a TRA audit and tax assessments.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or Tax Administration Act update

question_sw: PAYE na withholding tax (WHT) kwa wasomi wa nje — ni nini tofauti?
answer_sw: PAYE: kodi ya mapato ya ajira inayokatwa na MWAJIRI kwa MFANYAKAZI aliyehiriwa (employed person). WHT ya nje: kodi inayokatwa kwenye malipo ya huduma (consulting fees, management fees, royalties) kwa MKANDARASI asiyehiriwa au mtu wa nje ya nchi. PAYE = ajira; WHT = huduma/bidhaa kutoka nje. Ni mifumo miwili tofauti.
question_en: PAYE and withholding tax (WHT) for foreign professionals — what is the difference?
answer_en: PAYE: income tax on employment earnings deducted by the EMPLOYER from a HIRED EMPLOYEE (employed person). WHT on foreigners: tax deducted on payments for services (consulting fees, management fees, royalties) to an INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR or non-resident. PAYE = employment; WHT = services/goods from abroad. They are two separate frameworks.

instruction: Thamani ya ardhi yangu inakadiriwa vipi kwa ajili ya stamp duty Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kuhusu utaratibu wa ukadiriaji wa thamani ya ardhi. Ukadiriaji wa thamani ya ardhi kwa ajili ya stamp duty unahitaji mthamini (valuer) aliyesajiliwa na Bodi ya Usajili wa Wathamini (Valuers Registration Board). Wasiliana na mthamini aliyesajiliwa au TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa maelezo ya utaratibu wa ukadiriaji.

instruction: Je, benki au taasisi ya fedha inahitaji kusajiliwa VAT Tanzania?
output: Huduma nyingi za benki na taasisi za fedha zipo katika kundi la exempt (isiyostahili VAT). Hata hivyo, benki zinatoa baadhi ya huduma zinazostahili VAT, kama vile huduma za usimamizi au ushauri. Benki zilizofanya mauzo yanayostahili VAT zaidi ya kizingiti cha usajilishaji lazima zisajiliwe VAT. Kwa hali maalum ya taasisi ya fedha, thibitisha na Kamishna wa TRA au wahasibu waliobobea katika sekta ya fedha.
