question_sw: Mfanyakazi anawezaje kuangalia historia ya michango yake ya NSSF?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anaweza kuangalia historia ya michango yake ya NSSF kwa njia zifuatazo: kupitia portal ya NSSF mtandaoni kwenye nssf.go.tz kwa kutumia nambari yake ya uanachama, kutembelea ofisi yoyote ya NSSF na kadi ya utambulisho, au kupiga simu ya huduma kwa wateja wa NSSF. Kauli ya michango (contribution statement) inaweza kuombwa na inakuonyesha kila mchango uliofanywa na mwajiri wako. Ikiwa michango haikuingia kwenye akaunti yako ijapokuwa mwajiri anasema amelipa, piga kengele mara moja.
answer_en: An employee can check their NSSF contribution history through: the NSSF online portal at nssf.go.tz using their membership number, visiting any NSSF office with identification, or calling the NSSF customer service line. A contribution statement can be requested and shows every contribution made by your employer. If contributions are not appearing in your account despite the employer claiming to have paid, raise the issue immediately.
question_en: How can an employee check their NSSF contribution history?

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayefanya kazi kwa waajiri wawili analipa PAYE vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi mwenye waajiri wawili au zaidi lazima ataarifu kila mwajiri kuhusu vyanzo vingine vya mapato. Mwajiri mkuu (primary employer) hutumia viwango vya kawaida; waajiri wengine wanatumia kiwango cha juu zaidi (top rate) au makubaliano maalum na TRA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE calculated for an employee with two employers?
answer_en: An employee with two or more employers must notify each employer of the other income sources. The primary employer uses the normal tax bands; secondary employers apply the highest rate or a special TRA arrangement. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutolipa kodi ya zuio kwa wakati Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Wakala wa zuio ambaye hakulipa kwa wakati anakabili: faini ya asilimia 5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu yake, pamoja na riba. TRA pia inaweza kudai malipo moja kwa moja kutoka kwa wakala. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the penalty for late withholding tax remittance in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding agent who pays late faces: a 5% penalty on the overdue amount per month or part thereof, plus interest. TRA can also claim the payment directly from the agent. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Ninaoa mwanawake wa China — baada ya ndoa ninaweza kufanya biashara ya rejareja kwa haki zake za ndoa?
answer_sw: Hapana — ndoa na raia wa Tanzania haibadilishi hadhi ya kisheria ya mwenza wa ndoa chini ya GN 487A. Mwanawake wa China anabaki 'mgeni' (non-citizen) hata baada ya ndoa na Mtanzania. GN 487A inaangalia URAIA wa biashara, si hali ya ndoa. Njia pekee ya kubadilisha hadhi ni kupata uraia wa Tanzania kupitia mchakato wa kisheria — si kupitia ndoa haraka.
question_en: I am marrying a Chinese woman — after marriage can she conduct retail trade using her marriage rights?
answer_en: No — marriage to a Tanzanian citizen does not change a spouse's legal status under GN 487A. A Chinese woman remains a 'non-citizen' even after marrying a Tanzanian. GN 487A looks at CITIZENSHIP for business, not marital status. The only way to change status is to obtain Tanzanian citizenship through the legal process — not through marriage alone.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Waajiri hawana adhabu ya kweli kwa kulipa chini ya mshahara wa chini — ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana, si kweli. Kulipa chini ya mshahara wa chini ni kosa la kisheria chini ya ELRA. Adhabu zinajumuisha malimbikizo ya malipo tofauti, faini ya Shilingi 300,000 hadi 3,000,000, na uwezekano wa mashitaka ya jinai. Inspekta wa Kazi wana mamlaka kamili ya kutekeleza sheria hii.
question_en: Employers face no real penalties for paying below the minimum wage — is this true?
answer_en: No, this is false. Paying below the minimum wage is a criminal offence under ELRA. Penalties include back-pay liability, fines of TZS 300,000 to 3,000,000, and possible criminal prosecution. Labour Inspectors have full authority to enforce this law.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Katika ununuzi wa ardhi Tanzania — mnunuzi au muuzaji ndiye analayepaswa kulipa stamp duty?
output: Stamp duty inatumika kwa uhamisho wa mali Tanzania. Viwango na taratibu halisi vinategemea aina ya mali na thamani yake inayotathminiwa na mthamini aliyesajiliwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wajibu wa kulipa stamp duty katika uhamisho wa ardhi unashughulikiwa chini ya Sheria ya Stamp Duty na unategemea masharti ya mkataba wa ununuzi — inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Ninataka kubadilisha biashara yangu ya mmiliki mmoja (sole trader) na kuifanya kampuni ya kikomo cha dhima (limited company). Ninafanyaje?
answer_sw: Kubadilisha biashara ya mmiliki mmoja kuwa kampuni ya kikomo cha dhima si 'kubadilisha' rasmi — ni kuanzisha kampuni mpya na BRELA. Mchakato ni: jaza fomu za usajili wa kampuni mpya ya kikomo cha dhima, lipa ada ya usajili, pata nambari ya TIN mpya kwa kampuni, hamisha mali na mikataba ya biashara ya zamani kwenye kampuni mpya (kwa kuzingatia mambo ya kodi na kisheria), na unaweza kuacha biashara ya mmiliki mmoja ikifunga. Pata ushauri wa mshauri wa kisheria au mhasibu kabla ya kubadilisha ili kuelewa athari za kodi.
answer_en: Converting a sole trader business to a limited company is not a formal 'conversion' — it is registering a new company with BRELA. The process is: complete new limited company registration forms with BRELA, pay the registration fee, obtain a new TIN for the company, transfer the assets and contracts of the old business to the new company (considering tax and legal implications), and you may close the sole trader business. Seek advice from a legal adviser or accountant before switching to understand the tax implications.
question_en: I want to convert my sole trader business into a limited company. How do I do this?
primary_source_name: BRELA — sole trader to limited company conversion

question_sw: Serikali inaweza kutoa muda wa mpito kwa waajiri wadogo kushindwa kulipa mshahara wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: Hapana muda maalum wa mpito uliotangazwa. GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026 bila muda wa mpito kwa saizi ya biashara. Waajiri wote wanatarajiwa kufuata tarehe hiyo bila kujali ukubwa wa biashara.
question_en: Has the government given small employers a transition period for GN 605A compliance?
answer_en: No specific transition period was announced. GN 605A took effect on 1 January 2026 without a size-based transition period. All employers were expected to comply from that date regardless of business size.

instruction: NSSF haijalipiwa kwa miezi mitatu — adhabu ni nini?
output: Adhabu ya kutolipa NSSF kwa wakati ni asilimia 5 kwa kila mwezi wa uchelewaji wa malipo. Adhabu hukusanyika kila mwezi — uchelewaji wa miezi mitatu unaweza kuwa na adhabu ya asilimia 15 ya kiasi kilichokosekana. Zaidi ya hayo, NSSF inaweza kufungua kesi dhidi ya mwajiri. Lipa malipo yote pamoja na adhabu haraka iwezekanavyo na wasiliana na NSSF kupanga mpango wa ulipaji kama haiwezekani kulipa mara moja.

question_sw: NSSF inakataa kulipa pensheni ikiwa mfanyakazi amestaafu mapema kwa hiari — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. Mfanyakazi anayestaafu mapema kwa hiari (voluntary early retirement) anaweza bado kudai manufaa ya NSSF, lakini kiasi kitategemea: miezi ya michango aliyochangia (lazima angalau 60 kwa manufaa yaliyopunguzwa), umri wake, na aina ya manufaa anayodai. Anastaafu kabla ya miaka 60 anaweza kupata manufaa yaliyopunguzwa au kulazimishwa kusubiri hadi umri wa kawaida wa pensheni. Wasiliana na NSSF moja kwa moja kwa hali yako.
question_en: NSSF refuses to pay pension if a worker retired early voluntarily — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely true. A worker who voluntarily takes early retirement can still claim NSSF benefits, but the amount will depend on: months of contributions paid (must be at least 60 for reduced benefits), their age, and the type of benefit claimed. Retiring before age 60 may result in reduced benefits or being required to wait until normal pension age. Contact NSSF directly for your situation.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Posho ya usafiri ya TZS 50,000 kwa mwezi inayolipwa kwa mfanyakazi — inatozwa PAYE au la?
answer_sw: Inategemea jinsi inavyolipwa. Ikiwa ni posho ya jumla (flat allowance) bila kuhitajika risiti — inatozwa PAYE. Ikiwa ni malipo ya gharama halisi za usafiri wa biashara yanayolipwa dhidi ya risiti — hayatozwi PAYE. Posho nyingi za usafiri zinazolipwa kwa wafanyakazi wa Tanzania zinachukuliwa kama sehemu ya mapato ya ajira na zinatozwa PAYE. Hakikisha una sera ya gharama wazi inayoelezea msingi wa malipo.
answer_en: It depends on how it is paid. If it is a flat allowance without requiring receipts — it is subject to PAYE. If it is reimbursement of actual business travel costs against receipts — it is not subject to PAYE. Most transport allowances paid to employees in Tanzania are treated as part of employment income and are subject to PAYE. Ensure you have a clear expenses policy explaining the basis of payment.
question_en: A transport allowance of TZS 50,000 per month paid to an employee — is it subject to PAYE or not?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or TRA circular on allowances

question_sw: WHT inatumika kwa malipo ya gani — orodhesha aina kuu za malipo yanayotoza WHT?
answer_sw: Aina kuu za malipo yanayotoza WHT Tanzania ni: gawio (dividends) 10%, riba (interest) 10%, kodi ya pango (rent) 10%/20%, royalties 15%, ada za usimamizi na kitaalamu 5%/15%, ada za mkurugenzi 15% (wakazi na wasio wakazi) (wakazi na wasio wakazi), bima 5%, na mapato ya rasilimali za asili 15%. Kiwango kinatofautiana kati ya wakazi na wasio wakazi.
question_en: What payments does WHT apply to — list the main categories subject to WHT?
answer_en: The main payment categories subject to WHT in Tanzania are: dividends 10%, interest 10%, rent 10%/20%, royalties 15%, management and professional fees 5%/15%, director fees 15% (residents and non-residents), insurance premiums 5%, and natural resource income 15%. Rates differ between residents and non-residents.

question_sw: Biashara inayofanya kazi usiku tu haihitaji OSHA kwa sababu inspekta wanafanya kazi mchana tu?
answer_sw: Hili ni wazo potofu. OSHA inatumika kwa wakati wote wa kazi bila kujali muda wa siku au usiku. Ingawa ukaguzi mara nyingi hufanywa mchana, wajibu wa OSHA unaendelea muda wote wa shughuli. Usajili unahitajika na viwango vya usalama lazima vifuatwe wakati wote.
question_en: A business operating only at night doesn't need OSHA because inspectors only work during the day?
answer_en: This is a misconception. OSHA applies during all working hours regardless of day or night. Although inspections often occur during daylight, OSHA obligations continue throughout all operational hours. Registration is required and safety standards must be met at all times.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Je, ukaguzi wa EFD unaweza kusababisha uchunguzi wa jumla wa kodi za biashara yangu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ukaguzi wa EFD unaonyesha tofauti kati ya taarifa za EFD na VAT returns unaweza kuanzisha uchunguzi wa kina zaidi wa kodi zote za biashara — PAYE, SDL, kodi ya mapato ya shirika, na nyingine. TRA inaweza kutumia taarifa za EFD kama 'mlango wa kuingia' wa ukaguzi mpana zaidi. Hii ni sababu nyingine ya kutunza rekodi sahihi na kutumia EFD ipasavyo.
question_en: Can an EFD audit trigger a full tax investigation of my business?
answer_en: Yes. An EFD audit that reveals discrepancies between EFD data and VAT returns may trigger a broader investigation of all business taxes — PAYE, SDL, corporate income tax, and others. TRA can use EFD data as a 'gateway' into a wider audit. This is another reason to maintain accurate records and use EFD properly.

question_sw: Kampuni inayolipa gawio kwa wanahisa wa kigeni inakata WHT ya asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kampuni inayolipa gawio kwa wanahisa wasio wakazi (kigeni) inakata WHT ya asilimia 10. Kiwango hiki ni sawa na kwa wanahisa wakazi — asilimia 10 kwa wote. Baadhi ya mikataba ya kuepuka kodi mara mbili (DTA) inaweza kupunguza kiwango hiki kwa wanahisa wa nchi fulani.
question_en: A company paying dividends to foreign shareholders deducts WHT at what rate?
answer_en: A company paying dividends to non-resident (foreign) shareholders deducts WHT at 10%. This rate is the same as for resident shareholders — 10% for both. Some Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) may reduce this rate for shareholders from specific countries.

question_sw: Raia wa kigeni ana kibali cha kazi Class B — anaweza kufanya kazi katika duka la rejareja kama mwajiriwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — kama MWAJIRIWA. GN 487A inakataza KUMILIKI na KUENDESHA biashara — si kufanya kazi kama mwajiriwa. Raia wa kigeni mwenye Class B anaweza kufanya kazi kama mwajiriwa katika duka la rejareja bila kukiuka GN 487A. Tatizo linatokea tu akimiliki au akiendesha duka mwenyewe.
question_en: A non-citizen holds a Class B work permit — can they work in a retail shop as an employee?
answer_en: Yes — as an EMPLOYEE. GN 487A prohibits OWNING and OPERATING businesses — not working as an employee. A non-citizen with a Class B permit can work as an employee in a retail shop without violating GN 487A. The problem only arises if they own or operate the shop themselves.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: WHT kwa msaada wa kiufundi (technical assistance) kutoka kampuni ya kigeni ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: WHT kwa ada za msaada wa kiufundi na usimamizi kutoka kampuni ya kigeni (wasio wakazi) ni asilimia 15. Kwa kampuni ya ndani (wakazi), kiwango ni asilimia 5. Tofauti hii ni muhimu kwa makampuni yanayopanga mikataba ya ushauri wa kimataifa.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on technical assistance from a foreign company?
answer_en: WHT on technical assistance and management fees from a foreign (non-resident) company is 15%. For a domestic (resident) company the rate is 5%. This difference is important for companies contracting international advisory services.

question_sw: Mgeni ana kampuni iliyosajiliwa BRELA — hii inamlinda dhidi ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kuwa na kampuni iliyosajiliwa BRELA hakumlindi mgeni dhidi ya GN 487A kama kampuni hiyo inafanya biashara katika moja ya sekta 15 zilizozuiliwa. GN 487A inazuia watu wasio raia KUMILIKI na KUENDESHA biashara katika sekta hizi — na hilo linahusu hata kama wana kampuni iliyosajiliwa kisheria. BRELA inasajili kampuni lakini haina mamlaka ya kutoa ruhusa dhidi ya GN 487A. Usajili wa BRELA na ufuatamizi wa GN 487A ni mambo mawili tofauti ambayo lazima yashughulikiwe kwa wakati mmoja.
question_en: A non-citizen has a BRELA-registered company — does this protect them against GN 487A?
answer_en: No. Having a BRELA-registered company does not protect a non-citizen against GN 487A if that company operates in one of the 15 prohibited sectors. GN 487A prohibits non-citizens from OWNING and OPERATING businesses in these sectors — and this applies even with a legally registered company. BRELA registers companies but has no authority to grant exemption from GN 487A. BRELA registration and GN 487A compliance are two separate matters that must be addressed simultaneously.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Biashara yangu inafikia TZS 150M kwa miezi 6 — je, lazima nisajili VAT?
output: Ndiyo — kizingiti cha 6 miezi ni TZS 100M. Kwa biashara yako iliyofikia TZS 150M katika miezi 6, umepita kizingiti cha TZS 100M — lazima usajili VAT HARAKA (mara kizingiti kinapofikiwa). Usisubiri mwisho wa mwaka — usajili unatakiwa ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kufikia kizingiti. Kama ulifikia TZS 100M ndani ya miezi 6 lakini hukusajili — unaweza kukabiliwa na adhabu ya kuchelewa. Pia kumbuka kizingiti kingine: TZS 200M kwa miezi 12 — hata hii ikipitiwa kwa mwaka mzima lazima usajili. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa ni Shilingi ngapi?
answer_sw: Kwa sekta ya madini na nishati ya kimataifa, mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni karibu Shilingi 765,900 kwa mwezi — hii ndiyo kiwango cha juu zaidi katika agizo lote. Kiwango hiki kilianza kutumika Januari 2026.
question_en: What is the minimum wage for the international mining sector?
answer_en: For the international mining and energy sector the GN 605A minimum wage is approximately TZS 765,900 per month — the highest floor in the entire order, effective January 2026.

question_sw: Je, raia wa kigeni anaweza kufanya biashara ya jumla (wholesale) Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Biashara ya jumla (wholesale trade) ni mojawapo ya makundi 15 yaliyopigwa marufuku kwa raia wa kigeni chini ya GN 487A, kuanzia tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Raia wa kigeni anayeendelea kufanya biashara ya jumla baada ya tarehe hiyo anakabiliwa na adhabu kali: faini ya chini ya TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 gerezani, na kufutwa kwa visa yake. Thibitisha hali yako na wakili wa biashara au Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Can a non-citizen run a wholesale trade business in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Wholesale trade is one of the 15 business categories prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A, effective 28 July 2025. A non-citizen continuing to operate a wholesale business after that date faces severe penalties: a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. Confirm your situation with a business lawyer or the Immigration Services Department.

instruction: Mfanyabiashara anayouza bidhaa za chakula zilizo zero-rated anaweza kudai VAT aliyolipa kwenye manunuzi yake?
output: Ndiyo. Kwa kuwa bidhaa za chakula zilizo zero-rated bado ni usambazaji wa VAT (kwa kiwango cha asilimia 0), mfanyabiashara ANAWEZA kudai VAT ya pembejeo (input VAT) aliyolipa kwenye manunuzi ya bidhaa hizo. Hii ni faida ya msingi ya zero-rated dhidi ya exempt. Thibitisha orodha ya bidhaa za zero-rated na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Tanzania ina mikataba ya kuzuia kodi mara mbili (DTA) na nchi zipi?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa orodha kamili ya sasa ya mikataba ya DTA ya Tanzania. Kwa ujumla, Tanzania ina mikataba na nchi kadhaa — lakini orodha na masharti yao yanabadilika. Thibitisha orodha ya sasa ya mikataba ya DTA ya Tanzania na TRA au mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa.
question_en: Which countries does Tanzania have Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) with?
answer_en: I am not certain of the current complete list of Tanzania's DTA agreements. Generally, Tanzania has agreements with several countries — but the list and their terms change over time. Verify the current list of Tanzania's DTAs with TRA or an international tax advisor.

instruction: Kama msambazaji mdogo, withholding inanidhuru kiuchumi vipi?
output: Withholding inaweza kuathiri mtiririko wa fedha (cash flow) kwa sababu unapokea malipo kidogo kuliko invoice yako yote. Hata hivyo, VAT iliyokatwa si hasara — inaweza kudaiwa kama pembejeo kwenye VAT return yako kupitia certificate ya withholding. Tatizo la kweli ni delay ya pesa. Pangilia fedha zako kwa kuzingatia withholding.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni aliye na Class A work permit (investor) — analipa PAYE?
answer_sw: Class A work permit ni ya wawekezaji wanaojitegemea — si wafanyakazi waliohiriwa. Mmiliki wa Class A anayefanya kazi kama mwajiriwa (employed) katika kampuni yake anahitaji kutathmini hali yake ya kisheria. Lakini kama mtu ana mshahara kutoka kampuni, PAYE itatumika. Thibitisha muundo maalum na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: A foreign employee with a Class A work permit (investor) — do they pay PAYE?
answer_en: Class A is for self-employed investors — not hired employees. A Class A holder working as an employee in their own company needs to assess their legal status. But if a person receives a salary from a company, PAYE applies. Confirm the specific structure with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Mkurugenzi Mkurugenzi (MD) analipwa TZS 5,000,000 kwa mwezi. NSSF yake ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: NSSF ya MD: mshahara wa TZS 5,000,000 × 20% = TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi. Kampuni inalipa: TZS 5,000,000 × 10% = TZS 500,000. MD analipa (kutoka mshahara wake): TZS 5,000,000 × 10% = TZS 500,000. Msingi ni mshahara mkubwa wa jumla — si mshahara wa msingi. Wasilisha ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: The Managing Director is paid TZS 5,000,000 per month. How much is their NSSF?
answer_en: NSSF for the MD: salary TZS 5,000,000 × 20% = TZS 1,000,000 total per month. Company pays: TZS 5,000,000 × 10% = TZS 500,000. MD pays (from their salary): TZS 5,000,000 × 10% = TZS 500,000. Base is gross wage — not basic salary. Submit within one month after the salary month.

instruction: Niliuza hisa zangu katika kampuni — je, ninapaswa kulipa kodi yoyote kwa faida niliyopata?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi inayotokana na faida ya kuuza hisa (capital gains on share disposal) ni mada ya Income Tax Act ambayo iko nje ya wigo wangu wa mada. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Asha ni mfanyabiashara wa mpaka huko Tunduma — ana duka la vipande vya magari, si raia. Nini hatari yake?
answer_sw: Asha yuko katika hatari kubwa ya kisheria. Biashara ya vipande vya magari ni moja ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania chini ya GN 487A. Kama Asha si raia wa Tanzania na anaendesha duka hilo kama biashara yake, anakiuka amri hii. Adhabu ni: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 jela, na kufutwa kwa viza na kurushwa nchini kwake. Asha anahitaji ushauri wa wakili wa haraka na kufikiria kuhamisha biashara kwa raia wa Tanzania, au kuacha kabisa.
question_en: Asha is a cross-border trader at Tunduma — she has a spare parts shop and is not a citizen. What is her risk?
answer_en: Asha is at serious legal risk. Spare parts trade is one of the 15 categories prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens under GN 487A. If Asha is not a Tanzanian citizen and operates that shop as her own business, she is violating this Order. Penalties are: a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation with deportation. Asha urgently needs legal advice and should consider transferring the business to a Tanzanian citizen, or closing it entirely.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: NSSF inachukua hatua gani dhidi ya mwajiri asiyolipa michango ya wafanyakazi?
answer_sw: NSSF ina hatua kadhaa za utekelezaji dhidi ya waajiri wasiotii: kwanza, onyo rasmi na hati ya kudai malipo. Kama malipo hayafanyiki, NSSF inaweza: kutumia kisheria ili kunyang'anya mali za mwajiri, kutoa amri ya kushikilia akaunti za benki, kupeleka kesi mahakamani ya kazi au jinai, na kutoa faini ya 5% kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji wa michango isiyolipwa. Waajiri wanaohukumiwa wanaweza pia kupoteza haki ya kupata mikataba ya serikali.
answer_en: NSSF has several enforcement steps against non-compliant employers: first, a formal warning and demand notice for payment. If payment is not made, NSSF may: use legal process to seize employer assets, issue orders to freeze bank accounts, take the matter to a labour or criminal court, and impose a 5% penalty for each month of delay on unpaid contributions. Convicted employers may also lose the right to obtain government contracts.
question_en: What action does NSSF take against an employer who does not pay employee contributions?

instruction: TIN ya kampuni yangu — ninaitoa BRELA au TRA?
output: TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) inatoka TRA — si BRELA. BRELA inakupa nambari ya usajilishaji wa kampuni (Certificate of Incorporation). Baada ya kupata certificate ya BRELA, unapeleka TRA kupata TIN ya kampuni. Hatua ni tofauti: BRELA kwanza (usajilishaji wa kampuni), kisha TRA (usajilishaji wa kodi). Biashara zote lazima ziwe na TIN kutoka TRA kabla ya kufanya biashara.

question_sw: Je, biashara yangu yoyote lazima isajiliwe Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara yoyote inayofanya shughuli nchini Tanzania kwa mujibu wa sheria inahitajika kusajiliwa. Usajilishaji unategemea aina ya biashara: jina la biashara peke yako (sole trader/business name) — BRELA; kampuni yenye ukomo (limited company) — BRELA chini ya Companies Act; ushirikiano (partnership) — BRELA. Biashara isiyosajiliwa inakabiliwa na hatari za kisheria ikiwemo faini na kufungwa. Thibitisha mahitaji yako na BRELA kwenye brela.go.tz.
question_en: Does any business I run in Tanzania need to be registered?
answer_en: Yes. Any business conducting activities in Tanzania is legally required to be registered. The registration route depends on your business type: sole trader / business name — BRELA; limited liability company — BRELA under the Companies Act; partnership — BRELA. An unregistered business faces legal risks including fines and closure. Confirm your requirements with BRELA at brela.go.tz.
next_review_trigger: When Business Names Registration or Companies Act is amended

question_sw: Kampuni ya madini (mining company) inalipa kodi gani maalum Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kampuni za madini zina mfumo maalum wa kodi na vivutio vya uwekezaji tofauti na kampuni za kawaida. Kodi hizi zinasimamia na Sheria ya Madini na mikataba ya ubia wa serikali (mining agreements). Sina uhakika wa viwango vya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA, Wizara ya Madini, au mshauri wa kodi wa sekta ya madini.
question_en: What special taxes does a mining company pay in Tanzania?
answer_en: Mining companies have a specialized tax and investment incentive framework different from regular companies. These are governed by the Mining Act and government partnership agreements (mining agreements). I am not certain of current rates. Verify with TRA, the Ministry of Minerals, or a mining sector tax advisor.

question_sw: Je, kampuni inaweza kupata msamaha wa kodi Tanzania kupitia TIC?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) inatoa vivutio vya uwekezaji ikiwa ni pamoja na uwezekano wa msamaha au kupunguziwa kodi. Hata hivyo, vivutio maalum vinategemea aina ya uwekezaji, kiasi cha mtaji, na mikataba ya TIC. Sina uhakika wa vivutio vya sasa vinavyopatikana. Thibitisha na TIC moja kwa moja au mshauri wa uwekezaji.
question_en: Can a company obtain tax exemptions in Tanzania through TIC?
answer_en: Yes — TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) offers investment incentives including possible tax exemptions or reductions. However, specific incentives depend on the type of investment, capital amount, and TIC agreements. I am not certain of currently available incentives. Verify directly with TIC or an investment advisor.

question_sw: Mama ntilie anayeuza chakula kila siku mjini — anahitaji kusajili biashara?
answer_sw: Ndio, kwa kawaida. Hata mchuuzi wa chakula cha mitaani (mama ntilie) anafaa kusajili biashara yake na halmashauri ya mtaa/wilaya na kupata leseni ya biashara. Usajili wa TIN pia unashauriwa kama una mapato ya mara kwa mara. Kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka) kwa kawaida hakifiki kwa mama ntilie mdogo. NSSF haihitajiki kama huna wafanyakazi waliohiriwa.
question_en: A mama ntilie who sells food daily in town — does she need to register a business?
answer_en: Generally yes. Even a street food vendor (mama ntilie) should register their business with the local council/district and obtain a business licence. TIN registration is also advisable if you have regular income. The VAT threshold (TZS 200M/year) typically does not apply to a small mama ntilie. NSSF is not required if you have no hired employees.

question_sw: Hassan ni fundi wa umeme kutoka Msumbiji — ana uwezo wa kufanya kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kazi ya ufundi wa umeme (electrical contractor) haiko kati ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa wazi na GN 487A. Hassan anaweza kufanya kazi kama fundi wa umeme Tanzania, lakini lazima: (1) Awe na kibali sahihi cha kufanya kazi (work permit) kutoka Wizara ya Kazi, (2) Asajiliwe na Bodi ya Wahandisi (ERB — Engineers Registration Board) ikiwa atatoa huduma za uhandisi rasmi. Kama Hassan ataanzisha kampuni yake mwenyewe ya ufundi wa umeme na KUUZA bidhaa za umeme (rejareja), sehemu ya uuzaji inaweza kukiuka GN 487A. Kufanya kazi kama fundi wa mshahara au mkandarasi si tatizo kwa GN 487A.
question_en: Hassan is an electrician from Mozambique — can he work in Tanzania?
answer_en: Electrical contractor work is not among the 15 categories explicitly prohibited by GN 487A. Hassan can work as an electrician in Tanzania, but he must: (1) Have a valid work permit from the Ministry of Labour, (2) Register with the Engineers Registration Board (ERB) if providing formal engineering services. If Hassan establishes his own electrical company and SELLS electrical goods (retail), the selling aspect may violate GN 487A. Working as a salaried electrician or contractor is not a GN 487A issue.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: Hoteli ya nyota 5 — mshahara wa chini kwa wafanyakazi ni ngapi kulingana na GN605A?
output: Kulingana na GN605A, viwango vilivyothibitishwa kwa sekta ya hoteli ni: hoteli za nyota 5 na nyota 4: TZS 375,000 kwa mwezi; baa na mikahawa ya hoteli: TZS 195,000 kwa mwezi. Viwango hivi vilianza Januari 2026. Kama una wasiwasi kuhusu subsekta maalum ya hoteli yako, thibitisha na GN605A yenyewe kupitia tanzlii.org.

question_sw: GN 487A ilianza kutumika tarehe gani hasa — na operesheni ya utekelezaji ilifanyika lini?
answer_sw: GN 487A ilianza kutumika tarehe 28 Julai 2025 — siku hiyo hiyo ilitangazwa kwenye Gazeti la Serikali. Operesheni ya utekelezaji ilifanywa na Idara ya Uhamiaji katika miezi iliyofuata tarehe ya gazeti ya 28 Julai 2025. Thibitisha hali ya sasa ya utekelezaji na Idara ya Uhamiaji moja kwa moja. Jina kamili la amri: Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025. Kutaja mwaka mwingine wowote (2023 au 2024) ni kosa — amri hii ni ya 2025.
question_en: On exactly what date did GN 487A take effect — and when did the enforcement operation happen?
answer_en: GN 487A took effect on 28 July 2025 — the same day it was gazetted in the Government Gazette. An enforcement operation was conducted by the Immigration Department in the months following the gazette date of 28 July 2025. Verify current enforcement status with the Immigration Department directly. Full name of the order: Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025. Citing any other year (2023 or 2024) is an error — this order is from 2025.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: SDL ya mwezi huu — inawasilishwa tarehe 20 au tarehe 7 ya mwezi ujao?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Tarehe sahihi: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata — si tarehe 20. Tarehe 20 ni kwa VAT return — usifanye makosa kati ya SDL na VAT deadlines. SDL: tarehe 7 | VAT return: tarehe 20 | PAYE: tarehe 7.

question_sw: GN 487A na GN 605A — ni amri zinazohusiana au tofauti kabisa?
answer_sw: Ni amri mbili tofauti kabisa. GN 487A (28 Julai 2025): inazuia raia wa kigeni kufanya aina fulani za biashara. GN 605A (1 Januari 2026): inaweka mshahara wa chini kwa sekta mbalimbali — inaathiri waajiri WOTE, wakiwemo raia na wageni. Hazihusiani moja kwa moja.
question_en: GN 487A and GN 605A — are they related orders or completely different?
answer_en: They are two completely different orders. GN 487A (28 July 2025): prohibits non-citizens from engaging in certain business activities. GN 605A (1 January 2026): sets minimum wages across various sectors — affecting ALL employers, both citizens and non-citizens. They have no direct connection.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Annual return ya BRELA ni tofauti na taarifa ya mwaka wa TRA — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, ni tofauti. Annual return ya BRELA ni taarifa ya kisheria inayoidhibitisha muundo wa kampuni, wakurugenzi, na maelezo ya usajili — inawasilishwa BRELA. Taarifa ya mwaka ya TRA (income tax return) inahusu mapato na kodi — inawasilishwa TRA. Zote mbili zinahitajika lakini kwa mashirika tofauti na kwa madhumuni tofauti.
question_en: Is the BRELA annual return different from the TRA annual tax return — is this true?
answer_en: Yes, they are different. The BRELA annual return is a legal filing confirming company structure, directors, and registration details — submitted to BRELA. The TRA annual return (income tax return) concerns income and taxes — submitted to TRA. Both are required but to different agencies for different purposes.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Jirani yangu mgeni anauza mahindi na maharage sokoni — je, ana tatizo la sheria?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, labda ana tatizo. Chini ya GN 487A (2025), biashara ya rejareja — ikiwa ni pamoja na kuuza mazao ya kilimo sokoni — ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia wa Tanzania. Kama jirani yako mgeni anauza mahindi, maharage, au mazao mengine kama biashara yake binafsi, anakiuka GN 487A. Adhabu ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 na kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 jela. Unaweza kumwambia aone wakili au asilimame mpaka apate ushauri sahihi wa kisheria.
question_en: My foreign neighbour sells maize and beans at the market — do they have a legal problem?
answer_en: Yes, possibly. Under GN 487A (2025), retail trade — including selling agricultural produce at a market — is one of the 15 activities prohibited for non-Tanzanian citizens. If your neighbour is selling maize, beans, or other produce as their own business, they are violating GN 487A. Penalties are a minimum TZS 10 million fine and up to 6 months imprisonment. You can advise them to see a lawyer or stop until they get proper legal advice.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu aliumia kazini — OSHA, WCF, au NSSF ninaweza mdai nini?
output: Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). Ajali ya kazi — vitendo vinavyohitajika: (1) WCF: ripoti ajali ndani ya siku 7 za kazi kupitia portal.wcf.go.tz — WCF inalipa fidia. (2) OSHA: OSHA inaweza kufanya uchunguzi wa ajali. (3) NSSF: inahusika na pensheni/ulemavu wa muda mrefu, si ajali za muda mfupi. Fidia ya haraka kwa ajali: WCF.

question_sw: Je, biashara yangu inahitaji kusajiliwa na OSHA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kama una wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, biashara yako lazima isajiliwe na OSHA (Mamlaka ya Usalama na Afya Kazini). Usajili huu ni wa kila mwaka na unahitaji cheti cha OSHA kuonyeshwa mahali pa kazi.
question_en: Does my business need to register with OSHA?
answer_en: Yes. If you have 10 or more employees your workplace must register with OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority). Registration is annual and requires displaying the OSHA certificate at the workplace.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act amendment or threshold change

question_sw: Biashara yangu iko mpakani mwa Tanzania na Kenya — GN 487A inatumika pia maeneo ya mpakani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. GN 487A inatumika Tanzania Bara yote, ikiwa ni pamoja na maeneo ya mpakani kama Namanga, Holili, Tunduma, na Kabanga. Wafanyabiashara wa msalaba wa mpaka (cross-border traders) ambao si raia wa Tanzania bado wanazuiwa kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa nchini Tanzania. Soko la STR (Simplified Trade Regime) la EAC halitoi ulinzi dhidi ya GN 487A. Mfanyabiashara mgeni anayeuza moja kwa moja katika soko la Tanzania (rejareja au jumla) anakiuka GN 487A hata kama anapita mpakani kila siku.
question_en: My business is at the Tanzania-Kenya border — does GN 487A also apply in border areas?
answer_en: Yes. GN 487A applies throughout Tanzania Mainland, including border areas such as Namanga, Holili, Tunduma, and Kabanga. Cross-border traders who are not Tanzanian citizens are still prohibited from operating businesses in the 15 restricted categories within Tanzania. The EAC Simplified Trade Regime (STR) does not provide protection against GN 487A. A non-citizen trader who sells directly in Tanzanian markets (retail or wholesale) violates GN 487A even if they cross the border daily.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Tozo za TPA (Tanzania Ports Authority) kwa kontena moja — ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Tozo za TPA zinategemea aina ya mzigo, ukubwa wa kontena, na muda wa kuhifadhiwa bandarini. Sina uhakika wa tozo za sasa. Thibitisha na TPA moja kwa moja au wakala wa usafirishaji wako.
question_en: TPA (Tanzania Ports Authority) fees for one container — how much?
answer_en: TPA fees depend on cargo type, container size, and storage duration at the port. I am not certain of current rates. Verify directly with TPA or your shipping agent.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu analalamika kwamba SDL na WCF zinakatwa mshahara wake — hii ni kweli?
output:
Hapana — si kweli. SDL na WCF ni ushuru wa MWAJIRI peke yake — hazikuatwi mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Tofauti na NSSF (ambayo ina sehemu ya mfanyakazi 10% inayokatwa mshahara), SDL na WCF zinalipwa na mwajiri kutoka pesa zake mwenyewe:

SDL = 3.5% ya mwajiri peke yake — inalipwa TRA.
WCF = 0.5% ya mwajiri peke yake — inalipwa Mamlaka ya WCF.

Kukata SDL au WCF kwenye mshahara wa mfanyakazi ni kosa la kisheria. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni mpya inasajili NSSF lini?
answer_sw: Kampuni mpya inalazimika kusajili kwa NSSF ndani ya mwezi mmoja wa kuanza biashara au kuajiri mfanyakazi wa kwanza. Usajili wa mwajiri (employer registration) unatangulia usajili wa wafanyakazi. Kisha, kila mfanyakazi mpya anasajiliwa ndani ya mwezi wa kwanza wa ajira yake. Michango ya kwanza inaanza mara mfanyakazi anapopokea mshahara wa kwanza — kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla.
question_en: When does a new company register with NSSF?
answer_en: A new company must register with NSSF within one month of starting business or hiring the first employee. Employer registration comes first. Then each new employee is registered within the first month of their employment. First contributions start as soon as the employee receives their first salary — rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage.

instruction: Chips za kompyuta na semiconductors zinaingizwa Tanzania — je, zina ushuru wa forodha?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa bidhaa za teknolojia na semiconductors (technology import duty) unategemea msimbo wa HS Code na taratibu za EAC/COMESA — mada hii iko nje ya wigo wangu wa biashara ya ndani. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na sheria za biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na TRA Forodha na Ushuru kupitia tra.go.tz kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: Kampuni ya hisa inaweza kubadilishwa kuwa biashara ya jina au kinyume chake?
output: Kubadilisha muundo wa kisheria si rahisi kisheria — hii si 'kubadilisha' bali ni mchakato mpya: KAMPUNI → BIASHARA YA JINA: haiwezekani moja kwa moja. Unaweza kufuta kampuni na kuanzisha biashara ya jina — lakini mali, mikataba, na akaunti zinahitaji kuhamishwa rasmi. BIASHARA YA JINA → KAMPUNI: unaweza kuanzisha kampuni mpya na kuhamisha biashara (mali, wateja, mikataba) kwenye kampuni — lakini huhitaji 'kufuta' biashara ya jina kwanza. Mchakato mzima unahitaji msaada wa wakili na BRELA. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Rafiki yangu alisema kizingiti cha VAT cha miezi 6 pia ni TZS 200M — kweli au uwongo?
answer_sw: UWONGO — rafiki yako ana kosa. Kizingiti cha miezi 6 ni TZS 100,000,000 (milioni MIA), si TZS 200M. Kizingiti cha TZS 200M ni cha miezi 12 tu. Makosa kama haya yanaweza kusababisha biashara nyingi kukosa usajili wa VAT waliotakiwa — TRA inaweza kutoza adhabu za kodi na faida kwa kipindi chote ambacho biashara ilikimbia usajili.
question_en: My friend said the 6-month VAT threshold is also TZS 200M — true or false?
answer_en: FALSE — your friend is mistaken. The 6-month threshold is TZS 100,000,000 (one hundred million), not TZS 200M. The TZS 200M threshold applies only to the 12-month period. Errors like this can cause many businesses to miss required VAT registration — TRA may charge tax penalties and interest for the entire period during which the business evaded registration.

question_sw: Bendi ya pili ya PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 9 — ni kweli?
answer_sw: UWONGO — bendi ya pili ya PAYE ni asilimia 8, si 9. Bendi zote tano za PAYE kwa kipindi cha 2025/2026: Bendi 1: TZS 0-270,000 = 0%; Bendi 2: TZS 270,001-520,000 = 8%; Bendi 3: TZS 520,001-760,000 = 20%; Bendi 4: TZS 760,001-1,000,000 = 25%; Bendi 5: Zaidi ya TZS 1,000,000 = 30%. Kizingiti cha mapato yasiyotozwa kodi: TZS 3,240,000 kwa mwaka (TZS 270,000/mwezi kwa kiwango cha 0%, imejengwa ndani ya Bendi 1). Kumbuka: bendi ya 2 ni 8% — si 9% — kosa hili ni la kawaida.
question_en: The second PAYE band in Tanzania is 9% — is this true?
answer_en: FALSE — the second PAYE band is 8%, not 9%. All five PAYE bands for 2025/2026: Band 1: TZS 0-270,000 = 0%; Band 2: TZS 270,001-520,000 = 8%; Band 3: TZS 520,001-760,000 = 20%; Band 4: TZS 760,001-1,000,000 = 25%; Band 5: Above TZS 1,000,000 = 30%. Annual tax-free threshold: TZS 3,240,000 (TZS 270,000/month at 0%, built into Band 1). Remember: band 2 is 8% — not 9% — this error is very common.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands

question_sw: Je, kutolipa VAT kwa wakati kuna riba na adhabu — kiwango gani?
answer_sw: Kutolipa VAT kwa wakati kunaleta: (1) Adhabu ya marehemu (late payment penalty); (2) Riba ya kuendelea (interest) juu ya kiasi kilichocheleweshwa. Viwango maalum vya adhabu na riba vimewekwa na Sheria ya Usimamizi wa Kodi (Tax Administration Act). Lipa VAT kabla ya tarehe 20 kuepuka adhabu hizi.
question_en: Does failing to pay VAT on time attract interest and penalties — what rates?
answer_en: Failing to pay VAT on time attracts: (1) A late payment penalty; (2) Ongoing interest on the overdue amount. Specific penalty and interest rates are set by the Tax Administration Act. Pay VAT before the 20th to avoid these charges.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Withholding tax kwa royalties ni asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa royalties kwa wasio wakazi ni asilimia 15 — si asilimia 10. Kiwango hiki kinatumika kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi sawa. Kiwango cha asilimia 10 si sahihi kwa royalties Tanzania.
question_en: Withholding tax on royalties is 10% for non-residents — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The withholding tax rate on royalties for non-residents is 15% — not 10%. This rate applies equally to residents and non-residents. A rate of 10% is incorrect for royalties in Tanzania.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina mgogoro na msambazaji kuhusu malipo. Je, ninaweza kufanya nini kisheria?
answer_sw: Migogoro ya kibiashara (commercial disputes) ni nje ya upeo wangu — ninashughulikia kodi na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara, si ushauri wa kisheria wa jumla. Kwa migogoro ya kibiashara, wasiliana na: mwanasheria wa biashara aliyesajiliwa Tanzania, Tanzania Institute of Arbitration (TIA), au Commercial Court of Tanzania (Mahakama ya Biashara). Je, kuna swali la kodi la biashara ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: My company has a payment dispute with a supplier. What can I do legally?
answer_en: Commercial disputes are outside my scope — I handle Tanzania Mainland taxes and business registration, not general legal advice. For business disputes, contact: a registered Tanzanian commercial lawyer, the Tanzania Institute of Arbitration (TIA), or the Commercial Court of Tanzania. Is there a business tax question I can help with?

question_sw: Je, SDL ni kodi mpya iliyoanzishwa na Finance Act 2025?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — imekuwepo kwa miaka mingi Tanzania. Kilichobadilika katika Finance Act 2025 ni kiwango: kilishuka kutoka asilimia 4 hadi asilimia 3.5, kuanzia tarehe 1 Julai 2025. Kodi yenyewe si mpya.
question_en: Is SDL a new levy introduced by Finance Act 2025?
answer_en: No. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — has existed in Tanzania for many years. What changed in Finance Act 2025 is the rate: it was reduced from 4% to 3.5%, effective 1 July 2025. The levy itself is not new.

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji kujua gharama za uzingatiaji (compliance) za kila mfanyakazi mpya anayeajiri Tanzania — ni kiasi gani kwa mfanyakazi mmoja?
answer_sw: Gharama za uzingatiaji kwa kila mfanyakazi mpya Tanzania (mbali na mshahara) ni: NSSF mwajiri: asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa jumla kila mwezi (si ada ya usajili), WCF: asilimia 0.5 ya mshahara wa mwaka, SDL (ikiwa wafanyakazi 10+): asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla kila mwezi. Kwa mfano, mfanyakazi wa TZS 500,000/mwezi: NSSF TZS 50,000/mwezi + WCF TZS 2,500/mwezi + SDL TZS 17,500/mwezi (ikiwa ≥10) = TZS 70,000/mwezi ya ziada ya uzingatiaji.
question_en: What compliance costs per new employee does an employer need to know in Tanzania?
answer_en: Compliance costs per new Tanzania employee (beyond salary): NSSF employer: 10% of gross monthly wage (not a registration fee), WCF: 0.5% of annual wage, SDL (if 10+ employees): 3.5% of gross monthly wage. For example, an employee on TZS 500,000/month: NSSF TZS 50,000/month + WCF TZS 2,500/month + SDL TZS 17,500/month (if ≥10) = TZS 70,000/month extra compliance cost.

question_sw: GN 487A inawahusu Watanzania pia au wageni tu?
answer_sw: GN 487A inawahusu WAGENI (raia wa kigeni) TU — Watanzania hawakabiwi vikwazo vya GN 487A kwa biashara. Raia wa Tanzania wana uhuru wa kufanya biashara yoyote inayoruhusiwa kisheria nchini Tanzania bila kizuizi cha GN 487A. Adhabu ya GN 487A (faini ya TZS 10M+, kifungo, visa kufutwa) inatumika kwa wageni wanaovunja sheria hii — si kwa Watanzania.
question_en: Does GN 487A apply to Tanzanians too or only to non-citizens?
answer_en: GN 487A applies to NON-CITIZENS (foreign nationals) ONLY — Tanzanians are not subject to GN 487A business prohibitions. Tanzanian citizens are free to conduct any legally permitted business in Tanzania without GN 487A restrictions. GN 487A penalties (TZS 10M+ fine, imprisonment, visa revocation) apply to non-citizens who violate the law — not to Tanzanians.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu ana namba ya NSSF ya zamani asiyoijua. Je, tunafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa mfanyakazi hajui namba yake ya zamani ya NSSF, hatua ni: (1) Tembelea ofisi ya NSSF karibu nawe na kitambulisho cha taifa (NIDA) au pasipoti; (2) NSSF itafuta namba yake ya zamani kwa kutumia taarifa zake za kibinafsi; (3) Kama hakuna akaunti ya zamani, NSSF itasajili upya. Mwajiri asimwandikishe mfanyakazi kwa namba mpya bila kwanza kuthibitisha hali yake ya sasa na NSSF.
question_en: My employee has an old NSSF number they don't know. What do we do?
answer_en: If an employee doesn't know their old NSSF number, the steps are: (1) Visit the nearest NSSF office with a national ID (NIDA) or passport; (2) NSSF will search for their old number using their personal details; (3) If no old account exists, NSSF will register afresh. The employer should not register the employee with a new number without first confirming their status with NSSF.

question_sw: Sijui GN 487A inaathiri sekta yangu — nifanye nini?
answer_sw: Hatua bora ni: (1) Angalia orodha kamili ya makundi 15 ya shughuli zilizozuiliwa katika GN 487A kwenye TanzLII.org, (2) Linganisha sekta yako na orodha hiyo, (3) Kama sekta yako ipo kwenye orodha na wewe ni mgeni, wasiliana na wakili wa biashara au uhamiaji haraka, (4) Kama huna uhakika, pata ushauri wa kisheria kabla ya kuendelea na biashara. Usijaribu kujiamua mwenyewe bila ushauri wa kisheria — adhabu za GN 487A ni kali na zinafanya kazi mara moja. Biashara zinazoathiriwa zinapendekezwa kutathmini muundo wao wa umiliki na mshauri wa kisheria.
question_en: I am not sure if GN 487A affects my sector — what should I do?
answer_en: The best steps are: (1) Check the complete list of 15 prohibited activity categories in GN 487A at TanzLII.org, (2) Compare your sector against that list, (3) If your sector is on the list and you are a non-citizen, contact a business or immigration lawyer urgently, (4) If unsure, get legal advice before continuing to operate. Do not try to self-assess without legal advice — GN 487A penalties are severe and take immediate effect. Affected businesses are advised to review their ownership structure with a legal adviser.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Kampuni yangu imepata hasara kwa miaka 5 mfululizo — je, ninaweza kubeba hasara hizi mbele?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Sheria za kubeba hasara za kodi (tax loss carry-forward) Tanzania — pamoja na mabadiliko ya Finance Act 2024 kuhusu kampuni zenye hasara za mfululizo — ni mada ya Income Tax Act inayohitaji uchambuzi wa kina wa hali ya kodi ya biashara. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi wa biashara aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Ikiwa mfanyakazi ameumia kazini, mwajiri anamwarifu WCF ndani ya muda gani?
answer_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kumwarifu WCF kuhusu ajali ya kazi ndani ya siku saba (7) ZA KAZI baada ya ajali kutokea — kwa njia ya portal ya mtandao ya WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz). Kwa ajali kubwa au ya kifo, OSHA lazima iarifu ndani ya masaa 24. Kutokuripoti kwa wakati kunasababisha adhabu na inaweza kuathiri madai ya mfanyakazi.
question_en: If a worker is injured at work within what timeframe must the employer notify WCF?
answer_en: The employer must notify WCF of a workplace accident within 7 WORKING DAYS of it occurring — through the WCF online portal (portal.wcf.go.tz). For serious or fatal accidents OSHA must be notified within 24 hours. Failure to report on time results in penalties and may affect the worker's claim.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Kampuni inayopigwa kodi mara mbili (Tanzania na nchi nyingine) inafanya nini?
answer_sw: Tanzania ina Mikataba ya Kuepuka Kutozwa Kodi Mara Mbili (DTA) na nchi kadhaa. Ikiwa mbia wako wa biashara katika nchi yenye DTA na Tanzania, angalia masharti ya DTA kwa unafuu wa kodi. Ikiwa hakuna DTA, unaweza kudai mkopo wa kodi ya nje (foreign tax credit) dhidi ya kodi ya Tanzania kulingana na sheria ya kodi.
question_en: What should a company do if it is being taxed twice (Tanzania and another country)?
answer_en: Tanzania has Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) with several countries. If your business partner is in a country with a DTA with Tanzania, check the DTA terms for tax relief. If there is no DTA, you may claim a foreign tax credit against Tanzania tax under tax law.

instruction: Mgeni ana leseni yote za biashara kutoka Halmashauri — hii inamlinda dhidi ya GN 487A?
output: Hapana — leseni ya biashara ya Halmashauri ni idhini ya kufanya biashara katika eneo maalum — si idhini ya kufanya biashara yoyote bila kizuizi. GN 487A ni sheria ya kitaifa inayopita zaidi ya Halmashauri — Halmashauri haiwezi kutoa msamaha wa GN 487A. Hata kama Halmashauri imetoa leseni kwa mgeni kwa duka la rejareja — GN 487A bado inazuia. Leseni ya Halmashauri na GN 487A ni mifumo miwili inayofanya kazi kwa pamoja: lazima uzingatie ZOTE. Kwa hivyo leseni ya Halmashauri haitoshi kulinda dhidi ya GN 487A. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Kodi ya watu binafsi kwa mapato ya uvuvi (fishing income) Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya mapato ya uvuvi na sekta ya samaki ni eneo maalum la sheria ya mapato — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Sekta ya uvuvi inaweza kuathiriwa na msamaha maalum wa kodi, ushuru wa sekta, na sheria za uvuvi Tanzania. Wasiliana na TRA moja kwa moja au Wizara ya Mifugo na Uvuvi kwa mwongozo uliofaa.
question_en: What is the personal income tax rate on fishing income in Tanzania?
answer_en: Income tax on fishing and the fisheries sector is a specialised area of tax law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. The fisheries sector may be affected by special tax exemptions, sector levies, and Tanzanian fishing laws. Contact TRA directly or the Ministry of Livestock and Fisheries for appropriate guidance.

instruction: Mfanyakazi ana mshahara wa TZS 521,000 — PAYE inaongezeka kwa kiasi gani ikilinganishwa na TZS 520,000?
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 521,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 1,000 × 20% = TZS 200
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 20,200/mwezi
TZS 1,000 ya ziada (521,000 - 520,000) iko Bendi 3 (20%) = TZS 200 ya ziada ya PAYE.

instruction: Nimeuza duka langu — ni tofauti gani kati ya capital gains tax na kodi ya kawaida ya biashara (business income tax)?
output: Kwa ujumla, mapato ya biashara ya kawaida yanatozwa kodi tofauti na faida ya uuzaji wa mali (capital gains) — tofauti inategemea aina ya mali na jinsi ilivyotumiwa katika biashara. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa tofauti ya kisheria na jinsi ya kuripoti kwa TRA katika hali yako maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: VAT withholding inaathiri vipi msambazaji mdogo anayeuza bidhaa kwa taasisi ya serikali?
output: Msambazaji mdogo anayeuza bidhaa kwa taasisi ya serikali (mnunuzi anayehitimu) atapata malipo yake baada ya taasisi hiyo kukata sehemu ya VAT na kuipeleka TRA moja kwa moja. Msambazaji anapokea kiasi kilichobaki pamoja na certificate ya withholding. Anadai input VAT yake kwa kawaida. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Niliuza nyumba yangu kwa faida ya TZS 30M — je, kuna kodi ya mtaji?
answer_sw: Mauzo ya mali isiyohamishika (real property) na kodi inayohusiana yanazidi mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Mauzo ya nyumba yanaweza kuathiriwa na sheria ya Mapato ya Watu Binafsi — hali inategemea nyumba hiyo ilitumika kwa nini (makazi ya msingi au uwekezaji), muda wa umiliki, na mambo mengine. Wasiliana na mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA moja kwa moja.
question_en: I sold my house at a profit of TZS 30M — is there a capital gains tax?
answer_en: Property sales and related taxation are beyond my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. House sale tax may be affected by the Personal Income Tax Act — the situation depends on how the property was used (primary residence or investment), ownership period, and other factors. Contact a qualified tax accountant or TRA directly.

question_sw: Ada ya mkurugenzi asiye wa wakati kamili inalipwa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia ngapi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ada ya mkurugenzi asiye wa wakati kamili (non full-time director) inalipwa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 15 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What withholding tax rate applies to non-full-time director fees in Tanzania?
answer_en: Non-full-time director fees are subject to 15% withholding tax for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Nini kinatokea nikisairishwa kwa EFD na TRA?
answer_sw: Ikiwa EFD yako imesimamishwa na TRA: (1) Huwezi kutoa risiti za kisheria mpaka tatizo litatatuliwe; (2) Kufanya biashara bila EFD inayofanya kazi (kwa biashara ya VAT) ni kinyume cha sheria; (3) Wasiliana na TRA mara moja kujua sababu ya kusimamishwa; (4) Tatua tatizo (kulipa deni la kodi, kurekebisha EFD, n.k.) ili kurejesha EFD. Usiendelee kufanya biashara bila kurejesha EFD ya kisheria.
question_en: What happens if my EFD is suspended by TRA?
answer_en: If your EFD is suspended by TRA: (1) You cannot issue legal receipts until the issue is resolved; (2) Conducting business without a functioning EFD (for a VAT business) is unlawful; (3) Contact TRA immediately to find out the reason for suspension; (4) Resolve the issue (pay tax debt, repair EFD, etc.) to restore EFD. Do not continue business without restoring a legal EFD.

instruction: Ninataka kujua jinsi ya kukokotoa stamp duty kwenye ardhi yangu ya Zanzibar.
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Masuala ya ardhi na stamp duty ya Zanzibar yanasimamia na sheria za Zanzibar ambazo ni tofauti na Tanzania Bara. Ninapendekeza wasiliana na mshauri wa kisheria aliyesajiliwa Zanzibar au Mamlaka ya Mapato ya Zanzibar (ZRA) kwa maelezo sahihi ya stamp duty ya ardhi ya Zanzibar.

instruction: Nimepokea malipo kutoka serikalini lakini hawakutoa certificate ya withholding. Nifanye nini?
output: Omba withholding agent (serikali) akupe certificate haraka. Kisheria, withholding agent lazima atoe certificate si baadaye ya tarehe VAT inakuwa payable. Bila certificate hii, huwezi kudai pembejeo ya VAT kwenye VAT return yako. Kama hawatatoa baada ya kuomba, wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) kutoa malalamiko rasmi.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inaweza kubadilisha jina lake — mchakato ni gani?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni inaweza kubadilisha jina lake kwa: (1) kupita azimio la mkutano maalum wa wanahisa (special resolution), (2) kuwasilisha ombi la mabadiliko ya jina kwa BRELA pamoja na ada, (3) kupata Cheti kipya cha Uanzishwaji chenye jina jipya, na (4) kusasisha nyaraka zote, akaunti za benki, na hati za kisheria.
question_en: Can a Tanzania company change its name — what is the process?
answer_en: Yes. A company can change its name by: (1) passing a special resolution at a special general meeting of shareholders, (2) submitting a name change application to BRELA with the fee, (3) receiving a new Certificate of Incorporation with the new name, and (4) updating all documents, bank accounts, and legal instruments.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Nilitenga akaunti ya NSSF kwa mfanyakazi — hii inaniepushaje na WCF?
output: Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). NSSF na WCF ni tofauti kabisa — NSSF haikuepushaji WCF. NSSF = pensheni ya baadaye na usalama wa jamii. WCF = fidia ya ajali za kazi (hata kama mfanyakazi ana NSSF). Zote mbili zinahitajika: kulipa NSSF haiwezekani kubadilisha wajibu wa WCF.

question_sw: SDL inalipwa pamoja na PAYE au tofauti?
answer_sw: SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, lakini zinaweza kuwa na malipo tofauti au kwa fomu tofauti kupitia mfumo wa TRA. Kwa vitendo, mara nyingi zinalipwa pamoja kupitia mfumo wa TRA. Hakikisha kila moja inalipwa kwa mstari sahihi wa malipo.
question_en: Is SDL paid together with PAYE or separately?
answer_en: Both SDL and PAYE are due by the 7th of the following month, but they may be separate payments or forms through the TRA system. In practice, they are often paid together through the TRA system. Ensure each is credited to the correct payment line.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Muhtasari: biashara ya kidijitali Tanzania inahitaji kuzingatia kodi zipi?
answer_sw: Biashara ya kidijitali Tanzania inapaswa kuzingatia: (1) VAT 18% kwa bidhaa/huduma za kawaida (kizingiti TZS 200M/mwaka); (2) VAT 16% kwa B2C e-payments kuanzia 1 Sep 2025; (3) Withholding tax 3% kwa bidhaa za nje, 6% kwa huduma za nje (kuanzia 1 Jul 2025); (4) EFD inahitajika kwa mauzo yote — mtandaoni pia; (5) PAYE na SDL kwa wafanyakazi wa kudumu ≥10. Masharti ya utekelezaji wa baadhi ya mabadiliko mapya bado yanaandaliwa na TRA.
question_en: Summary: what taxes does a digital business in Tanzania need to consider?
answer_en: A digital business in Tanzania should consider: (1) 18% VAT on regular goods/services (TZS 200M/year threshold); (2) 16% VAT on B2C e-payments from 1 Sep 2025; (3) Withholding tax 3% on foreign goods, 6% on foreign services (from 1 Jul 2025); (4) EFD required for all sales — including online; (5) PAYE and SDL for permanent staff of 10+. Implementation rules for some new changes are still being finalized by TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

instruction: Kampuni yangu ya kawaida inanunua kutoka muuzaji mwingine — sisi pia tunaweza kuwa qualifying buyers wa VAT withholding?
output: Hapana — kampuni ya kawaida (private company) HAIWEZI kuwa qualifying buyer wa VAT withholding bila kuteuliwa maalum na Commissioner General (CG) wa TRA. Qualifying buyers ni aina tatu tu: (1) Wizara ya Fedha — moja kwa moja; (2) Taasisi za serikali zinazoweka mapato yao mwenyewe — moja kwa moja; (3) Mtu/taasisi iliyoteuliwa rasmi na CG wa TRA kwa tangazo rasmi. Kampuni ya kawaida ya kibinafsi — hata kubwa — haijateuliwa moja kwa moja. Kwa hivyo, kampuni yako ya kawaida HAICHUKUI VAT withholding kutoka kwa muuzaji wako. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Tamko la kodi ya kampuni linawasilishwa ndani ya miezi sita baada ya mwisho wa mwaka wa fedha — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni ya Tanzania lazima iwasilishe tamko la kodi ya kampuni (corporate income tax return) ndani ya miezi 6 kutoka mwisho wa mwaka wake wa fedha. Kwa kampuni inayotumia mwaka wa kalenda (Januari–Desemba), tarehe ya mwisho ni 30 Juni ya mwaka unaofuata. Kuchelewa kunaongeza adhabu ya kodi.
question_en: The corporate tax return is filed within six months after the end of the financial year — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes. A Tanzania company must file its corporate income tax return within 6 months from the end of its financial year. For a company using the calendar year (January–December), the deadline is 30 June of the following year. Late filing attracts penalties.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anamaliza kazi baada ya miaka 10. Kampuni inalipa TZS 5,000,000 kama mafao ya mwisho. Je, PAYE inatolewa kwenye malipo hayo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, malipo ya mwisho wa kazi kama vile mafao, gratuity na bonasi ya kustaafu yanajumuishwa kwenye mapato yanayotozwa kodi. Mwajiri lazima ahesabu PAYE kwenye malipo hayo na kuiwasilisha TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kiwango cha kodi kinatumika kulingana na jedwali la kawaida la PAYE — mapato ya mwezi huo yote pamoja. Unaweza kujua zaidi kwenye tra.go.tz.
answer_en: Yes. Under the Income Tax Act, employment termination benefits including gratuity, severance pay, and retirement bonuses are included in taxable employment income. The employer must calculate PAYE on these payments and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month. The normal PAYE tax bands apply — total income for that month is taxed. See tra.go.tz for details.
question_en: An employee completes 10 years of service. The company pays TZS 5,000,000 as terminal benefits. Is PAYE deducted from this payment?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332

instruction: Nikiwa na biashara yangu mwenyewe (self-employed), naweza kujisajili NSSF?
output: Ndiyo. Wajasiriamali wanaojitegemea (self-employed) wanaweza kujisajili NSSF kwa hiari. Hii inakupa mwenyewe ufikiaji wa mafao ya pensheni na ulinzi baadaye. Kwa taratibu za usajilishaji wa kujitegemea na viwango vya mchango, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz) moja kwa moja. Usajilishaji huu si wa lazima kwa self-employed, lakini unapendekezwa kwa usalama wa baadaye.
