instruction: BRELA inashughulikia nini — na COSOTA inashughulikia nini — tofauti ni nini?
output: BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) inashughulikia: usajili wa makampuni, biashara za jina, ubia, matawi ya kigeni, alama za biashara (trademarks), hataza (patents), na michoro ya viwanda (industrial designs). COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania) inashughulikia: haki za kimwandishi (copyrights) PEKE YAKE — vitabu, muziki, filamu, programu za kompyuta, kazi za kisanaa. Tofauti muhimu: kama unaandika kitabu au muziki — COSOTA. Kama unasajili kampuni, trademark, au patent — BRELA. TRA ni tofauti kabisa — inashughulikia kodi (TIN). Thibitisha na brela.go.tz au cosota.or.tz.

question_sw: Kuna viwango VIWILI vya usajili wa VAT Tanzania — taja vyote viwili kwa usahihi.
answer_sw: Viwango VYA LAZIMA vya usajili wa VAT Tanzania ni viwili: (1) Kizingiti cha MIEZI 12: mauzo yanayozidi TZS 200,000,000 katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 12 mfululizo; (2) Kizingiti cha MIEZI 6: mauzo yanayozidi TZS 100,000,000 katika kipindi chochote cha miezi 6 mfululizo. Kama kizingiti KIMOJA tu kati ya hivi viwili kimezidiwa, usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima mara moja — huhitajiki kuzidi vyote viwili.
question_en: There are TWO VAT registration thresholds in Tanzania — state both accurately.
answer_en: Tanzania's TWO mandatory VAT registration thresholds are: (1) 12-MONTH threshold: sales exceeding TZS 200,000,000 in any consecutive 12-month period; (2) 6-MONTH threshold: sales exceeding TZS 100,000,000 in any consecutive 6-month period. If EITHER ONE of these thresholds is exceeded, VAT registration is immediately mandatory — you do not need to exceed both.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT registration thresholds

question_sw: Mwajiri mpya — lini anapaswa kusajili NSSF?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mpya anapaswa kusajili NSSF mara tu anapoanza kuajiri wafanyakazi. Usajili unafanywa kupitia Lango la Huduma la NSSF (NSSF Self Service Portal) au ofisi yoyote ya NSSF. Thibitisha tarehe na mahitaji ya usajili na NSSF.
question_en: When must a new employer register with NSSF?
answer_en: A new employer must register with NSSF as soon as they start employing workers. Registration is done through the NSSF Self Service Portal or any NSSF office. Confirm the registration timeline and requirements with NSSF.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ETR, EFD, na VFD ni nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: ETR (Electronic Tax Register) ni kifaa cha zamani cha mauzo kinachotoa risiti za kawaida — mfumo wa zamani. EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) ni kifaa kipya cha mauzo chenye uhusiano wa moja kwa moja na seva ya TRA — kinatuma taarifa za kila muamala mara moja. VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device) ni programu ya kompyuta (software) inayofanya kazi ya EFD — inafaa kwa biashara zinazotumia mifumo ya ERP au mauzo ya mtandao. TRA inasimamia aina zote tatu.
question_en: What is the difference between ETR, EFD, and VFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: ETR (Electronic Tax Register) is the older cash register device issuing standard receipts — the old system. EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) is the newer device with a direct connection to TRA's server — it transmits data on every transaction in real time. VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device) is a software solution that performs the EFD function — suitable for businesses using ERP systems or online sales. TRA regulates all three types.

question_sw: Originating status inamaanisha bidhaa yote ya malighafi kutoka EAC au inatosha kuzalishwa EAC?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, 'originating status' inamaanisha bidhaa zimepitia mchakato wa kutosha wa uzalishaji ndani ya nchi wanachama — si lazima malighafi yote kutoka EAC. Kwa bidhaa za kilimo zinazopandwa na kuvunwa ndani ya nchi wanachama, hii ni rahisi kuthibitisha. Kwa bidhaa zilizosindikwa, kanuni za asili (rules of origin) za EAC zinatoa mwongozo zaidi.
question_en: Does originating status mean all raw materials from EAC or is it enough to be produced in EAC?
answer_en: Generally, 'originating status' means goods have undergone sufficient processing within member states — not necessarily that all raw materials are from EAC. For agricultural goods grown and harvested within member states, this is straightforward to demonstrate. For processed goods, EAC rules of origin provide further guidance.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Mwenye biashara ndogo anaweza kusajili biashara yake peke yake bila wakili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Usajili wa biashara Tanzania unaweza kufanywa na mwenye biashara mwenyewe bila wakili au mshauri. BRELA ina mfumo wa mtandaoni (brela.go.tz) na TRA ina mfumo wa mtandaoni (tra.go.tz) ambapo usajili unaweza kufanywa moja kwa moja. Hata hivyo, kwa muundo wa kampuni (limited company) na wanaohisa wengi, wakili anaweza kusaidia kuhakikisha nyaraka za msingi (Memorandum na Articles) zinafanya kazi vizuri kwa mahitaji yako.
question_en: Can a small business owner register their business themselves without a lawyer?
answer_en: Yes. Business registration in Tanzania can be done by the business owner themselves without a lawyer or consultant. BRELA has an online system (brela.go.tz) and TRA has an online system (tra.go.tz) where registration can be done directly. However, for a company structure (limited company) with multiple shareholders, a lawyer can help ensure the founding documents (Memorandum and Articles) work well for your specific needs.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mgeni anayemiliki hoteli Tanzania — je, GN 487A inaathiri hoteli?
answer_sw: Hoteli na huduma za malazi (hospitality/hotel industry) haziko kati ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa wazi na GN 487A. Kwa hiyo, mgeni anaweza kumiliki hoteli Tanzania bila kukiuka GN 487A moja kwa moja. Hata hivyo, anahitaji leseni za Tanzania Tourism Board (TTB), kuzingatia sheria za OSHA, kulipa kodi zote zinazohusika, na kuhakikisha wafanyakazi wa kigeni wana vibali vya kazi. Kama hoteli hiyo pia inaendesha duka la rejareja au huduma za mobile money kwa wateja, sehemu hizo zinaweza kuathiriwa na GN 487A.
question_en: A non-citizen owns a hotel in Tanzania — does GN 487A affect hotels?
answer_en: Hotels and hospitality/accommodation services are not among the 15 categories explicitly prohibited by GN 487A. Therefore, a non-citizen can own a hotel in Tanzania without directly violating GN 487A. However, they need Tanzania Tourism Board (TTB) licences, must comply with OSHA regulations, pay all relevant taxes, and ensure foreign staff have work permits. If the hotel also operates a retail shop or mobile money services for guests, those aspects may be affected by GN 487A.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kutumia michango ya NSSF iliyokatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi kwa matumizi ya kampuni kabla ya kuwasilisha — je, hii ni haramu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, hii ni HARAMU kabisa. Pesa iliyokatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi kama mchango wa NSSF ni pesa ya mfanyakazi iliyoshikiliwa na mwajiri kwa niaba ya mfanyakazi. Mwajiri HANA haki ya kutumia pesa hizi kwa madhumuni yoyote ya kampuni. Kutumia michango ya NSSF ya wafanyakazi ni wizi na ni kosa la jinai chini ya Sheria ya NSSF na sheria za kazi.
question_en: Can an employer use NSSF contributions deducted from employee wages for company use before remitting — is this illegal?
answer_en: Yes, this is completely ILLEGAL. Money deducted from an employee's wages as NSSF contributions is the employee's money held by the employer on the employee's behalf. The employer has NO right to use this money for any company purpose. Using workers' NSSF contributions is theft and is a criminal offence under the NSSF Act and labour laws.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act or criminal code amendment

question_sw: OSHA Tanzania inasimamia usalama wa mahali pa kazi tu — si afya ya wafanyakazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Jina kamili ni Mamlaka ya Usalama na Afya Mahali pa Kazi (Occupational Safety and HEALTH Authority). OSHA inasimamia ZOTE MBILI: usalama wa mazingira ya kazi (vifaa salama, miundo ya jengo, hatari za mashine) NA afya ya wafanyakazi (ugonjwa wa kazini, kemikali hatari, kelele, joto). Dhana kwamba OSHA ni ya 'usalama tu' ni kosa la kawaida.
question_en: OSHA Tanzania only supervises workplace safety — not worker health — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The full name is Occupational Safety and HEALTH Authority. OSHA supervises BOTH: workplace environment safety (safe equipment, building structure, machine hazards) AND worker health (occupational disease, hazardous chemicals, noise, heat). The notion that OSHA is 'only about safety' is a common error.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Nilizidi kizingiti cha VAT wiki hii — hatua ya KWANZA ninayopaswa kuchukua ni nini?
answer_sw: Hatua ya KWANZA ni KUWASILIANA NA TRA MARA MOJA na kuomba usajili wa VAT. Usiendelee kufanya biashara bila VAT baada ya kuzidi kizingiti — hii ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya kodi. USIFANYE: (1) usiwasilishe 'return ya mwisho' (final VAT return) — hii ni ya usimamizi wa VAT uliopo, si ya kuanza usajili mpya; (2) usisubiri mwezi mzima au mwaka — muda wa kuchelewa ni gharama ya adhabu. Nenda TRA leo.
question_en: I exceeded the VAT threshold this week — what is the FIRST step I should take?
answer_en: The FIRST step is to CONTACT TRA IMMEDIATELY and apply for VAT registration. Do not continue trading without VAT after exceeding the threshold — this is a tax law violation. DO NOT: (1) do not submit a 'final VAT return' — that is for winding up an existing VAT registration, not starting a new one; (2) do not wait a full month or year — delay time is penalty cost. Go to TRA today.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ya uuzaji wa pombe inahitaji nini zaidi ya leseni ya LGA?
answer_sw: Uuzaji wa pombe (mvinyo, bia, na vinywaji vikali) unahitaji leseni maalum ya vinywaji vikali (liquor licence) inayotolewa na Halmashauri husika. Tanzania ina kanuni kali za usalama wa vinywaji: uuzaji kwa watoto chini ya miaka 18 ni kosa la jinai. Muda wa kufungua duka la pombe pia udhibitiwa na Halmashauri. Zaidi ya hayo, biashara za kutengeneza pombe (breweries) zinahitaji leseni za ziada kutoka TRA (excise duty registration) na TMDA. Nenda Halmashauri yako kwa fomu za leseni ya vinywaji.
answer_en: Selling alcohol (wine, beer, and spirits) requires a special liquor licence issued by the relevant Council. Tanzania has strict alcohol safety regulations: selling to children under 18 is a criminal offence. Opening hours for alcohol outlets are also regulated by the Council. Additionally, businesses manufacturing alcohol (breweries) require additional licences from TRA (excise duty registration) and TMDA. Go to your Council for liquor licence application forms.
question_en: My alcohol sales business needs what beyond the standard LGA licence?
next_review_trigger: Liquor Act or LGA regulation amendment

question_sw: Mwajiri aliniambia: "tuna wafanyakazi 10 lakini mmoja yuko likizoni, kwa hivyo tumehesabu kwa 9." Je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mfanyakazi aliye likizoni bado ni mfanyakazi wako — anahesabika katika jumla ya wafanyakazi kwa SDL. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inategemea wafanyakazi wote wanaolipwa, ikiwemo wale wanaolipwa wakati wa likizo. Kampuni yenye wafanyakazi 10 (mmoja likizoni bado analipwa) inalazimika kulipa SDL kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
question_en: An employer told me: "we have 10 employees but one is on leave, so we calculated for 9." Is this correct?
answer_en: No. An employee on leave is still your employee — they count in the total for SDL purposes. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — depends on all employees on payroll, including those being paid while on leave. A company with 10 employees (one on paid leave still counted) is required to pay SDL at 3.5% of total gross payroll.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kike ana haki ya likizo ngapi ya uzazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kulingana na ELRA (Employment and Labour Relations Act) Tanzania, mfanyakazi wa kike ana haki ya likizo ya uzazi ya siku 84 (wiki 12) bila kupoteza mshahara. Wakati huu wote, NSSF inaendelea kulipwa kwa mshahara unaolipwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Tarehe ya mwisho wa malipo ya NSSF inabaki ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: How many days of maternity leave does a female employee have in Tanzania?
answer_en: Under Tanzania's ELRA (Employment and Labour Relations Act), a female employee is entitled to 84 days (12 weeks) of maternity leave without loss of pay. Throughout this period, NSSF continues to be paid on wages paid: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. The NSSF payment deadline remains within one month after the salary month.

instruction: EFD — ninaweza kuuza bidhaa kwa bei ya chini kuliko gharama (bia ya soko) na bado EFD inafanya kazi?
output: EFD inasajili muamala kama unavyouingiza — bei ya kuuza, kiasi, na aina ya bidhaa. Haisemi kama bei ni 'ya kawaida' au la. Hata hivyo, TRA inaweza kuangalia biashara inayouza kwa bei za chini sana kwa wakati mrefu — hii inaweza kuonyesha mapato yanayoficha. Maswali yanaweza kutokea kama: mauzo ya chini sana dhidi ya stoo kubwa; faida isiyo na mantiki. EFD yenyewe haizuii uuzaji kwa bei yoyote — lakini rekodi zote za EFD zinajilimbikizia na TRA inaweza kuzichunguza. Hakikisha bei zinazoingia kwenye EFD ni za kweli. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio kwenye pango la ardhi/mali isiyohamishika kwa mkazi Tanzania ni asilimia 15 — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kodi ya zuio kwenye pango la ardhi au mali isiyohamishika inayolipwa kwa mkazi Tanzania ni asilimia 10, si asilimia 15. Kwa asiye mkazi, kiwango ni asilimia 15. Hii ni sehemu ya jedwali la kodi ya zuio la Tanzania. Kampuni inayolipa pango kwa mkazi lazima ishikilie asilimia 10 na kuwasilisha ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa mwezi.
question_en: Withholding tax on land/real estate rent paid to a Tanzania resident is 15% — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Withholding tax on rent of land or real estate paid to a Tanzania resident is 10%, not 15%. For non-residents, the rate is 15%. This is part of Tanzania's withholding tax schedule. A company paying rent to a resident must withhold 10% and remit within 7 days after month end.

instruction: Mteja wangu alilipa kwa M-Pesa — nihitaji kutoa risiti ya EFD?
output: Malipo ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) yanahitaji risiti ya EFD kama malipo ya kawaida. Njia ya malipo haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti — kila muamala wa mauzo lazima upate risiti ya EFD. M-Pesa ni njia ya malipo tu — si msamaha wa risiti. Piga risiti ya EFD kwa kila mauzo, bila kujali kama mteja alilipa taslimu, M-Pesa, au kadi ya benki.

question_sw: Cheti cha OSHA kinaisha muda baada ya miaka 3 — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Cheti cha OSHA kinahuishwa KILA MWAKA — si baada ya miaka 3. Usajili wa kila mwaka unahitajika kudumisha utiifu wa kisheria. Cheti kilichoisha muda ni ukiukwaji wa OSHA.
question_en: An OSHA certificate expires after 3 years — is this true?
answer_en: No. An OSHA certificate is renewed ANNUALLY — not every 3 years. Annual registration is required to maintain legal compliance. An expired certificate is an OSHA violation.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Polisi wamesema mgeni atapewa 'faini ndogo ya kiutawala' badala ya kufikishwa mahakamani — hii inawezekana?
output: Hapana — GN 487A si sheria ya faini ya kiutawala inayoweza kutatuliwa nje ya mahakama. Hii ni kosa la jinai linalohitaji: (1) ukamataji au tuhuma rasmi; (2) kesi mahakamani; (3) hukumu ya korti — faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6; (4) kufutwa kwa visa na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Kama polisi wanapendekeza 'faini ndogo' bila mahakama, hii si mchakato halali. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

instruction: Kampuni ya mafuta inachimba gesi asilia Tanzania — royalties ni nini na zinalipiwa wapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Royalties za mafuta na gesi (petroleum royalties) zinaamuliwa na Sheria ya Mafuta (Petroleum Act), makubaliano ya PSA, na TPDC/TMSA — ni mada tofauti kabisa nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na TPDC, TRA, au mshauri wa kodi wa sekta ya nishati kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Niliuza bidhaa kwa shirika la serikali na wamenikatia kodi — ni kiwango gani cha VAT withholding kwenye bidhaa?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha VAT withholding kwenye bidhaa ni asilimia 3, kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Mnunuzi anayehitimu ni: (a) Wizara ya Fedha, (b) taasisi ya serikali inayorudisha mapato yake yenyewe, au (c) mtu aliosajiliwa aliyeteuliwa na Kamishna Mkuu. Hii inamaanisha mnunuzi hukata asilimia 3 kutoka malipo yako na kuipeleka TRA moja kwa moja. Kiasi hiki si VAT yote — bado unaweza kudai VAT ya pembejeo dhidi ya VAT ya matokeo. Thibitisha na TRA kwa maelezo kamili.
question_en: I sold goods to a government entity and they withheld tax — what is the VAT withholding rate on goods?
answer_en: Under Finance Act 2025, the VAT withholding rate on goods is 3%, effective 1 July 2025. A qualifying buyer means: (a) Ministry of Finance, (b) a government entity that retains its own collected revenue, or (c) a CG-appointed registered person. This means the qualifying buyer deducts 3% from your payment and remits it directly to TRA. This is not the full VAT — you can still claim input VAT credits against your output VAT. Confirm with TRA for full details.

question_sw: DTA (mkataba wa kuzuia kodi mara mbili) — inasaidiana jinsi gani na PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: DTA inaweza kuruhusu mfanyakazi mgeni kupata marekebisho au msamaha wa PAYE Tanzania ikiwa wanalipa kodi sawa katika nchi yao ya asili. Hata hivyo, mwajiri lazima bado ake PAYE ya kawaida Tanzania isipokuwa pale ambapo exemption rasmi ya DTA imeombiwa na kukubaliwa na TRA. Omba exemption ya DTA kabla ya kuanza kutoa marekebisho.
question_en: DTA (Double Taxation Agreement) — how does it interact with Tanzania PAYE?
answer_en: A DTA can allow a foreign employee to receive PAYE relief or exemption in Tanzania if they are paying equivalent taxes in their home country. However, the employer must still deduct standard PAYE unless a formal DTA exemption has been applied for and approved by TRA. Apply for DTA exemption before granting any relief.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: EFD ni nini na inatumika kwa nini Tanzania?
answer_sw: EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) ni mashine ya kielelezo cha fedha iliyoidhinishwa na TRA inayorekodia kila muamala wa mauzo moja kwa moja na kupeleka taarifa kwa TRA moja kwa moja. Inatumika kuhakikisha kwamba: (1) kila mauzo yanafuatiliwa kwa madhumuni ya VAT na kodi ya mapato, (2) risiti za EFD zinaotolewa kwa wateja, (3) TRA inapata data ya mauzo moja kwa moja bila kutegemea ripoti za mkono tu. EFD inabadilisha risiti za kawaida za mkono.
question_en: What is an EFD and what is it used for in Tanzania?
answer_en: An EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) is a TRA-approved fiscal recording machine that records every sales transaction directly and transmits data to TRA automatically. It is used to ensure: (1) every sale is tracked for VAT and income tax purposes, (2) EFD receipts are issued to customers, (3) TRA receives sales data directly without relying only on manual reports. EFDs replace ordinary handwritten receipts.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD mandate or technology update

question_sw: Bonasi ya mwisho wa mwaka — inajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa ujumla bonasi na malipo ya kipekee yanajumuishwa kwenye msingi wa SDL kwa mwezi yanalipwa. Ikiwa bonasi inalipwa Desemba, SDL inahesabiwa kwa jumla ya mishahara ya Desemba ikiwa ni pamoja na bonasi. Thibitisha muundo maalum na TRA au mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Year-end bonus — is it included in the SDL base?
answer_en: Yes, generally bonuses and one-time payments are included in the SDL base for the month they are paid. If a bonus is paid in December, SDL is calculated on the total December payroll including the bonus. Confirm specific structures with TRA or a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Ninataka kuwekeza katika Bitcoin Tanzania — je, Tanzania inalipa kodi kwa faida za crypto?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa fedha za kidijitali kama Bitcoin na cryptocurrency Tanzania bado uko katika hali ya maendeleo ya kisheria — BOT inaendelea na mfumo. Hii ni mada nje ya wigo wangu wa VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi wa kisasa au Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BoT) kupitia bot.go.tz kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: TRA inaweza kusamehe adhabu za kodi (penalty waiver)? Ninaomba vipi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRA ina nguvu ya kusamehe adhabu (penalty waiver) kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato chini ya masharti fulani. Vigezo vinavyozingatiwa: hali ya nguvu ya lazima iliyosababisha kuchelewa (maumivu, majanga ya asili), historia nzuri ya utii wa kodi, na nia njema ya kulipa. Hatua za kuomba: (1) Lipa kodi yote ya msingi na riba kwanza. (2) Wasilisha maombi rasmi ya maandishi kwa Kamishna wa TRA ukieleza sababu za kuchelewa na hati zinazothibitisha. (3) Subiri uamuzi. Samahani nyingi zinatolewa kwa walipa kodi wa mara ya kwanza wenye rekodi nzuri. Samahani haizuii riba — riba mara nyingi italipwa hata baada ya samahani ya adhabu.
answer_en: Yes. TRA has authority to waive penalties under the Income Tax Act under certain conditions. Factors considered: force majeure circumstances causing the delay (illness, natural disasters), good compliance history, and genuine intent to pay. Steps to apply: (1) First pay all principal tax owed and any interest. (2) File a formal written application to the TRA Commissioner General explaining the reasons for the delay with supporting documents. (3) Await the decision. Many waivers are granted to first-time offenders with good records. A waiver does not cover interest — interest typically remains payable even after a penalty waiver.
question_en: Can TRA waive tax penalties (penalty waiver)? How do I apply?

question_sw: Gharama yote ya mwajiri kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa chini wa wastani wa TZS 358,322/mwezi: NSSF ya mwajiri TZS 35,832 (10%); SDL TZS 12,541 (3.5%); WCF TZS 1,792 (0.5%). Jumla ya gharama ya ziada kwa mwajiri: TZS 50,165. Gharama yote ya mwajiri: TZS 358,322 + TZS 50,165 = TZS 408,487/mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA na NSSF.
question_en: What is the total employer cost for one employee at the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: On TZS 358,322/month minimum wage: employer NSSF TZS 35,832 (10%); SDL TZS 12,541 (3.5%); WCF TZS 1,792 (0.5%). Total employer add-on cost: TZS 50,165. Full employer cost: TZS 358,322 + TZS 50,165 = TZS 408,487/month. Confirm with TRA and NSSF.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or statutory rate change

question_sw: Mwajiri analipa PAYE ifikapo tarehe 20 ya kila mwezi unaofuata — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. PAYE inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya kila mwezi unaofuata — si tarehe 20. Tarehe 20 ni kwa VATreturn (si PAYE). Mwajiri analazimika kulipa PAYE ya mwezi uliopita ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kuchelewa kunaleta adhabu ya asilimia 2.5.
question_en: An employer pays PAYE by the 20th of each following month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. PAYE is remitted by the 7th of each following month — not the 20th. The 20th is the VAT return deadline (not PAYE). An employer must remit last month's PAYE by the 7th of the following month. Late payment attracts a 2.5% penalty.

question_sw: Tanzania inaweka kiwango cha chini cha mtaji wa kampuni (minimum share capital)?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania haina kiwango cha chini cha lazima cha mtaji wa hisa kwa kampuni za kikomo cha dhima. Kampuni inaweza kuanzishwa na mtaji mdogo tu — kwa mfano, hisa moja. Hata hivyo, benki na sekta fulani zinaweza kuwa na mahitaji yao ya mtaji wa chini kwa sababu za udhibiti.
question_en: Does Tanzania set a minimum share capital for companies?
answer_en: No. Tanzania has no mandatory minimum share capital requirement for limited companies. A company can be incorporated with very little capital — for example, one share. However, banks and certain regulated sectors may have their own minimum capital requirements for regulatory purposes.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Kampuni iliyofutwa orodha BRELA kwa kutokuwasilisha annual return — inaweza kufufuliwa?
output: Ndiyo — kampuni iliyofutwa orodha (deregistered) inaweza kuomba kufufuliwa (restoration) kwa BRELA, lakini mchakato huu unahusisha: (1) Kulipa faini zilizokusanyika zote; (2) Kuwasilisha annual returns zilizokosekana; (3) Kulipa ada ya kufufua kampuni; (4) Mchakato wa kisheria unaopitiwa na BRELA — unaweza kuchukua muda. Wakati kampuni imefutwa orodha, haiwezi kisheria kufanya biashara, kuingia mikataba, au kushikilia mali. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz kwa mchakato kamili wa kufufua.

question_sw: SDL "Short-term Disability Levy" — je, hii ni maana ya SDL?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL haifanyi kazi ya kulipa wafanyakazi wakati wa ulemavu wa muda mfupi. SDL ni Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi — inayofadhili mafunzo ya kitaaluma. Masuala ya ulemavu na magonjwa yanashughulikiwa na NSSF na Workers Compensation Fund (WCF) — si SDL. SDL: asilimia 3.5, mwajiri peke yake, wafanyakazi 10+, siku ya 7.
question_en: Is SDL a "Short-term Disability Levy"?
answer_en: No. SDL does not pay workers during short-term disability. SDL is the Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi — which funds vocational training. Disability and illness matters are handled by NSSF and the Workers Compensation Fund (WCF) — not SDL. SDL: 3.5%, employer only, 10+ employees, due 7th.

question_sw: Mgeni mwenye TIC certificate (cheti cha uwekezaji kutoka TIC) ana ulinzi dhidi ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Si kwa ujumla. TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) certificate inaruhusu uwekezaji wa kigeni katika sekta maalum za uwekezaji mkubwa — kama uzalishaji wa viwanda, madini, kilimo cha biashara kubwa. Hata hivyo, TIC certificate haizuii matumizi ya GN 487A kwa sekta zilizozuiliwa kama biashara ya rejareja, saluni, au ukarabati wa simu. Mwekezaji wa kigeni mwenye TIC certificate bado hawezi kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa. TIC na GN 487A ni mifumo tofauti — mshauri wa kisheria anaweza kusaidia kuelewa jinsi inavyoathiri uwekezaji wako mahususi.
question_en: A non-citizen with a TIC certificate (investment certificate from Tanzania Investment Centre) — are they protected from GN 487A?
answer_en: Not generally. A TIC (Tanzania Investment Centre) certificate permits foreign investment in specific large-scale investment sectors — such as industrial manufacturing, mining, large-scale commercial agriculture. However, a TIC certificate does not override GN 487A for the prohibited sectors such as retail trade, salons, or phone repair. A foreign investor with a TIC certificate still cannot operate businesses in the 15 prohibited categories. TIC and GN 487A are separate frameworks — a legal adviser can help understand how it affects your specific investment.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Je, GN 605A inashughulikia wafanyakazi wa kigeni wanaofanya kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. GN 605A inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wote wanaofanya kazi Tanzania, bila kujali uraia. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania ana haki ya kiwango cha chini kilichowekwa kwa sekta yake.
question_en: Does GN 605A apply to foreign workers working in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. GN 605A applies to all workers employed in Tanzania regardless of nationality. A foreign worker employed in Tanzania is entitled to the minimum wage set for their sector.

question_sw: Hisa za kampuni ya Tanzania zinaweza kumilikiwa na watu wa kigeni — je, kuna vizuizi?
answer_sw: Kwa kampuni za kawaida za Tanzania, watu wa kigeni wanaweza kumiliki hisa. Hata hivyo, kuna vizuizi katika sekta fulani kama: utalii wa mitaa (local tour operators lazima wamiliki wengi Tanzania), udanganyifu wa ardhi, na shughuli zilizoorodheshwa chini ya GN 487A. Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) inaweza kutoa mwongozo wa kwa uwekezaji wa kigeni.
question_en: Can shares in a Tanzania company be owned by foreigners — are there restrictions?
answer_en: For standard Tanzania companies foreigners can own shares. However there are restrictions in certain sectors such as: local tour operations (majority ownership must be Tanzanian), certain land activities, and activities listed under GN 487A. The Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) can provide guidance on foreign investment.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: STR ililenga kuwasaidia wafanyabiashara gani?
answer_sw: STR ililenga kuwasaidia wafanyabiashara wadogo wa mpakani — hasa wanawake wanaouza mazao, vyakula, na bidhaa ndogo ndogo kati ya nchi za EAC na COMESA. Biashara kubwa na makampuni makubwa yanayoagiza bidhaa kwa wingi bado yanatumia utaratibu wa kawaida wa forodha.
question_en: Who does STR aim to help?
answer_en: STR was designed to help small border traders — especially women selling produce, food, and small goods between EAC and COMESA countries. Large businesses and companies importing goods in large quantities still use the standard customs process.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Biashara yangu haisajiliwa kwa VAT — ninaweza kudai refund ya VAT nililolipa kwa wanaokulaz?
answer_sw: Hapana. Haki ya kudai input VAT inahitaji usajili wa VAT. Biashara isiyosajiliwa haiwezi kudai input VAT iliyolipwa kwa wanaokulaz. Hii ni sababu moja ya kwa nini kusajiliwa VAT na kununua kutoka wasambazaji waliosajilistwaa VAT ni muhimu kwa biashara zinazosajiliwa.
question_en: My business is not VAT-registered — can I claim back the VAT I paid to my suppliers?
answer_en: No. The right to claim input VAT requires VAT registration. An unregistered business cannot claim back the VAT it paid to suppliers. This is one reason why VAT registration and buying from VAT-registered suppliers matters for registered businesses.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: GN 605A na CBA (makubaliano ya pamoja ya mishahara) vinaendanaje?
answer_sw: GN 605A inaweka kiwango cha chini cha lazima cha kisheria. CBA inaweza kuweka viwango vya juu kuliko GN 605A — na hivyo inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wanaofunikwa na CBA hiyo. CBA haiwezi kuweka viwango vya chini kuliko GN 605A — hilo haliruhusiwi kisheria. GN 605A ni sakafu; CBA inaweza kuwa dari la juu.
question_en: How do GN 605A and a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) interact?
answer_en: GN 605A sets the mandatory legal floor. A CBA can set rates higher than GN 605A — and those higher rates apply to workers covered by that CBA. A CBA cannot set rates below GN 605A — that is legally prohibited. GN 605A is the floor; a CBA can be a higher ceiling.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ilifanya hasara mwaka huu — je, bado nalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. SDL inahesabiwa kwa mishahara (gross payroll) — si faida ya kampuni. Hata kampuni inayofanya hasara inalipa SDL kama ina wafanyakazi 10+ na inalipalipa mishahara. SDL si kodi ya mapato — ni ushuru wa mwajiri kulingana na mishahara.
question_en: My company made a loss this year — do I still pay SDL?
answer_en: Yes. SDL is calculated on payroll (gross salaries) — not company profit. Even a loss-making company pays SDL if it has 10+ employees and is paying salaries. SDL is not an income tax — it is an employer levy based on payroll.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya GN 487A (biashara) na sheria ya kazi (labor law) ni nini kwa mgeni?
answer_sw: Tofauti kuu kwa wageni: GN 487A (biashara): inazuia mgeni KUMILIKI au KUENDESHA biashara fulani. Ni kuhusu BIASHARA ya mgeni mwenyewe. Sheria ya kazi (Work Permit): inaruhusu mgeni kufanya KAZI ya AJIRA kwa kampuni ya Tanzania. Ni kuhusu mgeni kufanya kazi kwa MTU MWINGINE. Mgeni anaweza kuwa na kibali cha kazi halali cha kufanya kazi kama daktari mkuu — lakini akifungua kliniki yake binafsi, anakiuka GN 487A. Hizi ni mifumo miwili tofauti.
question_en: What is the difference between GN 487A (business) and labour law for a non-citizen?
answer_en: Key difference for non-citizens: GN 487A (business): prohibits a non-citizen from OWNING or RUNNING certain businesses. It is about the non-citizen's OWN BUSINESS. Labour law (Work Permit): permits a non-citizen to do EMPLOYED WORK for a Tanzanian company. It is about a non-citizen working for SOMEONE ELSE. A non-citizen may hold a valid work permit to work as a chief doctor — but if they open their own private clinic, they violate GN 487A. These are two different systems.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or immigration regulations

instruction: Ninalipa kwa muuzaji wa bidhaa TZS 1,000,000 — ni kiasi gani cha pesa anachopata baada ya withholding?
output: Kama wewe ni qualifying buyer wa VAT na unanunua bidhaa: Withholding ya VAT = 3% ya bei (kabla ya VAT au ya bei yenye VAT — mwongozo wa TRA unathibitisha) ya TZS 1,000,000. Withholding = 3% × 1,000,000 = TZS 30,000. Muuzaji anapata: TZS 1,000,000 − TZS 30,000 = TZS 970,000. Kiasi kilichokatwa (TZS 30,000) unatuma TRA pamoja na withholding certificate. Muuzaji bado analazimika kuwasilisha VAT return yake — lakini TZS 30,000 tayari ipo TRA kwa niaba yake. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa hesabu sahihi.

instruction: TRA inaweza kuniuliza kuhakikisha miamala yangu na kampuni mama ni ya 'arm's length' — hii inamaanisha nini kwa vitendo?
output: Kanuni ya msingi ya transfer pricing Tanzania ni arm's length principle katika Income Tax Act Sehemu 33 — miamala kati ya kampuni zinazohusiana lazima ifanane na bei za soko. Kwa uchambuzi wa kesi yako: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kanuni ya arm's length katika transfer pricing inahitaji tathmini ya miamala na kulinganisha na bei za soko — hii ni mada ya kodi ya kimataifa inayohitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Mpishi wangu wa nyumbani (house cook) anapaswa kuwa na NSSF?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Ndio — wafanyakazi wa nyumbani (domestic workers) wanastahili NSSF. Hii inajumuisha: mpishi, msafi wa nyumba, mlinzi wa nyumba, mtunza watoto. Hata kama wafanyakazi wako wa nyumbani ni wawili tu, una wajibu wa kisheria wa kuwaandikisha NSSF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu anakataa kuchangia NSSF — ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Mchango wa NSSF ni wa lazima kisheria kwa wafanyakazi wote. Mfanyakazi hawezi kukataa mchango wa NSSF — ni wajibu wa kisheria wa mwajiri KUKATA mchango wa mfanyakazi (asilimia 10) na KUONGEZA mchango wa mwajiri (asilimia 10) na kumpelekea NSSF. Mfanyakazi kukubali au la si sharti.
question_en: My employee refuses to contribute to NSSF — what do I do?
answer_en: NSSF contributions are legally mandatory for all employees. An employee cannot refuse NSSF contributions — it is the employer's legal obligation to DEDUCT the employee's contribution (10%) and ADD the employer's contribution (10%) and remit to NSSF. The employee's agreement is not a condition.

question_sw: Mchango wa WCF wa asilimia 0.5 unahesabiwa kwa mshahara wa msingi tu au mshahara wote?
answer_sw: Mchango wa WCF wa asilimia 0.5 unahesabiwa kwa MSHAHARA WOTE (gross emoluments) — si mshahara wa msingi tu. Mshahara wote unajumuisha mshahara wa msingi, posho, bonasi, na malipo mengine ya mwajiri. Hii ni sawa na msingi wa NSSF.
question_en: Is the 0.5% WCF contribution calculated on basic salary only or total wages?
answer_en: The 0.5% WCF contribution is calculated on TOTAL WAGES (gross emoluments) — not just basic salary. Total wages include basic salary, allowances, bonuses, and other employer payments. This is the same basis as NSSF.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Je, mauzo ya huduma nje ya nchi yana VAT 0% kama bidhaa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa ujumla — huduma zinazotolewa kwa wateja nje ya Tanzania kwa matumizi nje (exported services) zinaweza kustahili kiwango cha 0%. Hata hivyo, kanuni za 'place of supply' ni ngumu — kama huduma inatumika Tanzania hata kama mlipaji yuko nje, VAT ya kawaida inaweza kutumika. Thibitisha muundo wako maalum na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: Do exported services also carry 0% VAT like goods?
answer_en: Generally yes — services supplied to customers outside Tanzania for use outside (exported services) may qualify for the 0% rate. However, the rules on 'place of supply' are complex — if a service is used in Tanzania even if the payer is abroad, regular VAT may apply. Confirm your specific structure with a tax advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu yuko likizoni ya ugonjwa kwa miezi miwili bado analipwa mshahara. Je, ninalipia NSSF wakati huu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — wajibu wa NSSF unaendelea wakati wa likizo ya ugonjwa inayolipwa. Mwajiri analipa asilimia 10 na mfanyakazi analipa asilimia 10 ya mshahara wote unaolipwa wakati wa kipindi cha ugonjwa. Kama mfanyakazi yuko likizoni bila malipo (unpaid leave) hakuna mshahara kwa hiyo hakuna msingi wa NSSF. Lakini ukwa unamlipa mshahara wa sehemu au kamili wakati wa ugonjwa, NSSF inahesabiwa kwenye kiasi kinachopwa na inalipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa malipo.
question_en: My employee has been on sick leave for two months but is still receiving salary. Do I pay NSSF during this period?
answer_en: Yes — NSSF obligations continue during paid sick leave. The employer pays 10% and the employee pays 10% of all wages paid during the sick leave period. If the employee is on unpaid leave there is no wage and therefore no NSSF base. But if you pay partial or full salary during illness, NSSF is calculated on the amount actually paid and must be remitted within one month after the salary payment month.
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment changing contribution rules

question_sw: Jinsi ya kupata cheti cha kodi ya zuio (withholding tax certificate) Tanzania?
answer_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio kinapatikana kupitia mfumo wa malipo ya kodi (Tax Payment) kwenye Lango la Walipa Kodi (Taxpayer Portal) wa TRA. Kinachapishwa na wakala wa zuio au mtu aliyekatwa kodi (withholdee) baada ya malipo kukamilika. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How do you obtain a withholding tax certificate in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding tax certificate is obtained through the Tax Payment section of TRA's Taxpayer Portal. It can be printed by either the withholding agent or the withholdee after payment is completed. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mgeni Mreno anauza mboga na matunda sokoni Kariakoo. Hii inakiuka GN 487A?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — Kuuza mboga na matunda kwenye soko la rejareja kunaangukia chini ya Kategoria 1 ya GN 487A — 'Biashara ya kuuza bidhaa kwa jumla na rejareja' — ambayo IMEkatazwa wazi kwa wageni. Ingawa biashara ndogo ya soko (petty trade) haikutajwa kama kategoria tofauti, uuzaji wa bidhaa yoyote kwa njia ya rejareja sokoni umejumuishwa katika Kategoria 1. Mreno anayeuza mboga Kariakoo anakiuka GN 487A chini ya Kategoria 1. Mgeni Mreno (au mwingine yeyote asiye raia wa Tanzania) anayeuza mboga, matunda, au bidhaa nyingine za msingi sokoni Kariakoo au mahali popote Tanzania Bara anakiuka GN 487A.
question_en: A Portuguese non-citizen sells vegetables and fruits at Kariakoo market. Does this violate GN 487A?
answer_en: Yes — Selling vegetables and fruits at a market stall in retail format falls under Category 1 of GN 487A — 'The business of sale of goods on a wholesale and retail basis' — which is explicitly prohibited for non-citizens. While petty market vending is not named as a separate category, retail sale of any goods including produce at a market stall is covered by Category 1. A Portuguese national selling produce at Kariakoo market is violating GN 487A under Category 1. A Portuguese national (or any other non-Tanzanian citizen) selling vegetables, fruits, or other basic goods at Kariakoo or anywhere in Tanzania Mainland is violating GN 487A.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kusimama kidedea akiwa na bima binafsi ya wafanyakazi badala ya WCF — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Bima binafsi ya wafanyakazi haichukui nafasi ya usajili wa kisheria wa WCF. Waajiri wote Tanzania wanalazimika kusajiliwa WCF na kulipa mchango wake bila kujali kama wana bima binafsi nyingine. Hizi ni mahitaji tofauti ya kisheria.
question_en: An employer can substitute private employee insurance for WCF registration — is this true?
answer_en: No. Private employee insurance does not replace the statutory WCF registration. All employers in Tanzania must register with WCF and pay contributions regardless of whether they have additional private insurance. These are separate legal requirements.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Je, TRA inaweza kufunga biashara kwa kutotoa risiti za EFD mara kwa mara?
output: Ndiyo. TRA ina mamlaka ya kufunga biashara kwa kukiuka wajibu wa EFD mara kwa mara. Hatua za utekelezaji zinazofuatwa na TRA ni pamoja na: (1) onyo la maandishi, (2) ukaguzi wa mahali pa biashara, (3) kutoza faini, (4) kusimamisha leseni ya EFD, na (5) kufunga biashara. Kukosa kutoa risiti za EFD mara kwa mara kunaweza kuchukuliwa kama udanganyifu wa kodi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kupata ushauri wa bure wa kisheria Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa ushauri wa bure wa kisheria Tanzania, unaweza kuwasiliana na: (1) Tanzania Legal Aid Corporation (TLAG); (2) Chama cha Wanasheria Tanzania (TLS — Tanganyika Law Society) — wana mipango ya ushauri wa kisheria; (3) Legal Aid clinics za vyuo vikuu. Mimi ninashughulikia kodi na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara — si ushauri wa kisheria wa jumla. Je, kuna swali la kodi ninaweza kukusaidia?
question_en: Can I get free legal advice in Tanzania?
answer_en: For free legal advice in Tanzania, you can contact: (1) Tanzania Legal Aid Corporation (TLAG); (2) Tanganyika Law Society (TLS) — they have legal advice programmes; (3) University legal aid clinics. I handle Tanzania Mainland taxes and business registration — not general legal advice. Is there a tax question I can help with?

question_sw: Biashara inayopokea malipo ya awali (deposit/advance) inatoa risiti ya EFD wakati wa kupokea deposit au wakati wa kukamilisha mauzo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, risiti ya EFD inapaswa kutolewa WAKATI WA KUPOKEA malipo — ikiwa ni pamoja na deposit ya awali. Kila kiasi kinachoingia biashara kama malipo ya bidhaa au huduma kinapaswa kurekodiwa kwenye EFD wakati kinapopokelewa. Kusubiri mpaka kukamilisha mauzo yote kabla ya kutoa risiti ya EFD kunaweza kuwa kosa la muda wa risiti.
question_en: A business receiving advance payment (deposit) — is the EFD receipt issued at the time of receiving the deposit or at the time of completing the sale?
answer_en: Generally, an EFD receipt should be issued AT THE TIME OF RECEIVING payment — including an advance deposit. Every amount entering the business as payment for goods or services should be recorded on the EFD when received. Waiting until the full sale is complete before issuing an EFD receipt may be a receipt timing error.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD receipt timing guidance update

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya malipo ya bidhaa kwa serikali Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Malipo ya bidhaa zinazotolewa kwa serikali na taasisi zake yanastahili kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 2 ya malipo ghafi. Hii inashughulikia wazabuni wote wanaouza bidhaa kwa serikali. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What withholding tax applies to payments for goods supplied to the government in Tanzania?
answer_en: Payments for goods supplied to the government and its institutions are subject to 2% withholding tax on gross payment. This applies to all suppliers selling goods to government entities. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mgahawa wangu unahitaji leseni maalum zaidi ya leseni ya kawaida ya LGA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mgahawa na biashara za chakula zinahitaji leseni maalum za ziada, ambazo ni pamoja na: leseni ya chakula (food handling certificate) kutoka kwa Mamlaka ya Chakula na Dawa Tanzania (TMDA), cheti cha afya (health certificate) cha watumishi wote wanaoshughulikia chakula, ukaguzi wa mazingira na usafi wa mazingira (environmental health inspection) kutoka Halmashauri, na wakati mwingine leseni ya biashara ya vinywaji. Ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara hufanywa na maafisa wa afya wa Halmashauri.
answer_en: Yes. Restaurants and food businesses require additional special licences beyond the standard LGA licence, including: a food handling certificate from the Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority (TMDA), health certificates for all food handlers, an environmental and public health inspection from the Council, and sometimes a beverages business licence. Regular inspections are carried out by council health officers.
question_en: Does my restaurant need additional licences beyond the standard LGA licence?
next_review_trigger: TMDA Act amendment or LGA licence category change

instruction: SDL na PAYE zinawasilishwa TRA kwa wakati mmoja — au kuna tarehe tofauti mbili?
output: Zinawasilishwa KWA WAKATI MMOJA — si tarehe tofauti. SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinawasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfano: SDL na PAYE za Januari zinawasilishwa ifikapo 7 Februari. Hakuna siku tofauti kwa SDL na siku nyingine kwa PAYE — zinawasilishwa pamoja siku moja. Thibitisha tarehe hii na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz kwani inaweza kubadilika.

question_sw: Kampuni ya kilimo Tanzania yenye wafanyakazi wa msimu 50 — inahitaji kusajili OSHA na WCF kwa wafanyakazi hao?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa msimu wanaolipwa mishahara bado wanashughulikiwa na sheria za kazi Tanzania. WCF: mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi hata 1 (ikiwa ni pamoja na wa msimu) anahitaji WCF — bima ya ajali inashughulikia wafanyakazi wote. OSHA: ikiwa jumla ya wafanyakazi (ikiwa ni pamoja na wa msimu) inafika 10+, mwajiri analazimishwa kusajili OSHA. Kilimo kina hatari za maalum (kemikali, vifaa vya kulima) zinazofanya OSHA muhimu zaidi.
question_en: A farming company in Tanzania with 50 seasonal workers — does it need to register with OSHA and WCF for those workers?
answer_en: Seasonal workers receiving wages are still covered by Tanzania labour law. WCF: an employer with even 1 worker (including seasonal) needs WCF — accident insurance covers all workers. OSHA: if total worker count (including seasonal) reaches 10+, the employer is required to register with OSHA. Agriculture has specific hazards (chemicals, farming equipment) that make OSHA even more important.
next_review_trigger: Workers Compensation Act or OSHA Act amendment

question_sw: BRELA ina portal ya mtandaoni kwa ajili ya usajili? Ninawezaje kuitumia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. BRELA ina mfumo wa usajili wa mtandaoni unaoruhusu usajili na uwasilishaji wa hati bila kuhitaji kwenda ofisi. Unaweza kufikia portal kupitia tovuti ya brela.go.tz. Hatua za kimsingi ni: tengeneza akaunti ya mtumiaji, chagua aina ya usajili unaotaka (kampuni, jina la biashara, ushirika), jaza fomu za mtandaoni, pakia hati zinazohitajika, lipa ada kupitia GePG au mfumo wa malipo ulioungwa mkono. Usajili wa mtandaoni unaokoa muda na safari. Kwa msaada wa kina, BRELA ina ofisi kuu Dar es Salaam na ofisi za kanda.
answer_en: Yes. BRELA has an online registration system that allows registration and document submission without needing to visit the office. You can access the portal through the BRELA website at brela.go.tz. The basic steps are: create a user account, select the type of registration you want (company, business name, partnership), complete the online forms, upload required documents, pay the fee via GePG or the supported payment system. Online registration saves time and travel. For detailed assistance, BRELA has its main office in Dar es Salaam and regional offices.
question_en: Does BRELA have an online portal for registration? How can I use it?

question_sw: WHT kwa ada za mkurugenzi ni sawa kwa wakazi na wasio wakazi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ada za mkurugenzi (wasio mkurugenzi wa wakati wote) zinatoza WHT ya asilimia 15 kwa wakazi NA wasio wakazi — kiwango ni sawa kwa wote. TRA inatumia kiwango kimoja cha asilimia 15 bila kujali makao ya mkurugenzi. Hii ni tofauti na ada za usimamizi ambapo wakazi (5%) na wasio wakazi (15%) wana viwango tofauti.
question_en: WHT on director fees is the same rate for residents and non-residents — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. Director fees (non-full-time directors) attract 15% WHT for both RESIDENTS and NON-RESIDENTS — the rate is the same for all. TRA applies a single rate of 15% regardless of director residency. This differs from management fees where residents (5%) and non-residents (15%) have different rates.

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina VAT ya asilimia 5 kwa bidhaa zilizo 'essential'?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania haina kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 5 cha aina yoyote — including 'essential goods'. Bidhaa fulani za muhimu (kama nafaka, dawa, baadhi ya vifaa vya kilimo) zinaweza kuwa zero-rated (asilimia 0) au exempt, lakini asilimia 5 haipo. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT ni asilimia 18 tu.
question_en: Does Tanzania have 5% VAT on 'essential' goods?
answer_en: No. Tanzania does not have a 5% VAT rate of any kind — including for 'essential goods'. Some essential items (like certain grains, medicines, some agricultural inputs) may be zero-rated (0%) or exempt, but 5% does not exist. The standard VAT rate is 18% only.

question_sw: Hati ya kukopa (loan agreement) kati ya kampuni mbili za Tanzania ina ushuru wa stempu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mikataba ya mkopo na dhamana Tanzania kwa kawaida iko kwenye orodha ya Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu. Ushuru huu unahesabiwa kwa kuzingatia kiasi cha mkopo au thamani ya dhamana. Kampuni zinazofanya makubaliano ya mkopo zinapaswa kuhakikisha ushuru wa stempu umelipwa ili mkopo uwe na nguvu kamili ya kisheria.
question_en: Does a loan agreement between two Tanzania companies attract stamp duty?
answer_en: Yes. Loan agreements and security documents in Tanzania are generally listed in the Stamp Duty Act schedule. The duty is calculated based on the loan amount or security value. Companies entering loan agreements should ensure stamp duty is paid so the loan has full legal enforceability.

question_sw: Wakili mpya aliyeidhinishwa leo — anaweza kuanza kufanya kazi bila kusajili VAT kwanza?
answer_sw: Hapana — wakili aliyeidhinishwa hivi karibuni anapaswa kusajili VAT kama sehemu ya mahitaji ya kuweza kufanya mazoezi ya kisheria Tanzania. Ni vizuri kusajili VAT KABLA au WAKATI wa kuanza mazoezi — si baadaye. Kusimamia wateja bila usajili wa VAT unapoishia linapaswa kulipa inaweza kusababisha adhabu za kodi na matatizo na Tanganyika Law Society.
question_en: A newly admitted advocate today — can they start practising without first registering for VAT?
answer_en: No — a newly admitted advocate should register for VAT as part of the requirements to practise law in Tanzania. It is advisable to register for VAT BEFORE or AT THE TIME of starting practice — not later. Managing clients without VAT registration when you should be registered may result in tax penalties and complications with the Tanganyika Law Society.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi 55 — nahitaji afisa usalama (safety officer)?
output: Afisa usalama (safety officer) anahitajika: Sekta ya jumla: wafanyakazi 50 au zaidi. Sekta ya ujenzi: wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi. Kwa wafanyakazi 55 kwenye sekta ya jumla (si ujenzi): Ndio — lazima uwe na safety officer. Safety officer anaweza kuwa: mfanyakazi wa ndani aliyepata mafunzo, au mshauri wa nje aliyeidhinishwa na OSHA. Wajibu wa safety officer: ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara, ripoti za usalama, mafunzo ya wafanyakazi.

instruction: Nina mfanyakazi mmoja tu wa kujaribu (probation) — nimsajili NSSF?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Ndio — mfanyakazi wa kipindi cha majaribio (probation) bado ni mfanyakazi. Lazima usajili NSSF tangu siku ya kwanza ya kazi — hakuna msamaha wa kipindi cha majaribio. Kusajili mapema kunakuepusha faini na madai ya NSSF baadaye.

question_sw: NSSF inaendelea kukusanya michango ikiwa kampuni imefungwa kwa sababu ya COVID au dharura — je, kuna msamaha?
answer_sw: NSSF Tanzania haikutoa msamaha wa jumla wa michango wakati wa COVID-19 kwa biashara. Hata biashara zilizofungwa kwa amri ya serikali wakati wa janga, ikiwa zilikuwa bado na wafanyakazi walioendelea kulipwa mishahara, zililazimika kuendelea kuwasilisha michango ya NSSF. Biashara ambazo hazikuweza kulipa ziliweza kuwasiliana na NSSF kuhusu mpango wa malipo au hali yao. Angalia NSSF moja kwa moja kwa taarifa za hali maalum kama dharura za baadaye.
question_en: Does NSSF continue collecting contributions if a company closes due to COVID or emergency — is there an exemption?
answer_en: NSSF Tanzania did not provide a general COVID-19 contribution waiver for businesses. Even businesses closed by government order during the pandemic, if they still had employees who continued to be paid wages, were required to continue submitting NSSF contributions. Businesses that could not pay could contact NSSF about a payment plan or their situation. Check NSSF directly for information on specific situations like future emergencies.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inaweza kufanya biashara nje ya Tanzania bila leseni nyingine?
answer_sw: Kwa biashara nyingi, usajili wa Tanzania (BRELA + TRA) unaruhusu kufanya biashara kimataifa kwa mikataba ya kawaida ya nje. Hata hivyo, kufungua tawi nje ya Tanzania kunahitaji usajili katika nchi hiyo. Biashara fulani za udhibiti (fedha, bima) zinahitaji vibali maalum kwa shughuli za kimataifa.
question_en: Can a Tanzania company do business outside Tanzania without additional licences?
answer_en: For most businesses, Tanzania registration (BRELA + TRA) permits international trade through normal export contracts. However, opening a branch outside Tanzania requires registration in that country. Certain regulated businesses (finance, insurance) require special permits for international operations.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Bidhaa za zero-rated na bidhaa za exempt zote zinauzwa bila VAT kwa mteja -- je, mfanyabiashara anapaswa kujua tofauti yake?
output: Ndiyo, tofauti ni muhimu sana kwa mfanyabiashara. Zero-rated: anauza bila VAT kwa mteja NA ANAWEZA kudai input VAT kwenye manunuzi yake. Exempt: anauza bila VAT kwa mteja LAKINI HAIWEZI kudai input VAT kwenye manunuzi yake -- hii inaongeza gharama za uendeshaji wake. Thibitisha hali yako na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa TRA, mlipa kodi ana haki gani anayopaswa kujua?
answer_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa TRA, mlipa kodi ana haki zifuatazo: haki ya kupewa taarifa ya mapema ya ukaguzi (advance notice) isipokuwa ukaguzi wa ghafla ulioidhinishwa kisheria, haki ya kuomba nakala ya amri ya ukaguzi, haki ya kuwasiliana na mshauri wa kodi au wakili wakati wote wa ukaguzi, haki ya kujibu maswali kwa maandishi badala ya kwa mdomo, haki ya kupinga matokeo ya ukaguzi kabla ya tathmini ya mwisho, na haki ya kupata nakala ya ripoti ya ukaguzi. Msaada wa mshauri wa kodi uliosajiliwa unasaidia kulinda haki hizi.
answer_en: During a TRA audit, the taxpayer has the following rights: the right to receive advance notice of the audit (except for a court-authorised surprise audit), the right to request a copy of the audit order, the right to consult a tax adviser or lawyer at all times during the audit, the right to respond to questions in writing rather than verbally, the right to challenge audit findings before a final assessment is issued, and the right to receive a copy of the audit report. Support from a registered tax consultant helps protect these rights.
question_en: During a TRA audit, what rights does the taxpayer have that they should know?

question_sw: GN 487A ni tofauti na GN 605A — zinasemaje?
answer_sw: Ndio, hizi ni amri tofauti kabisa. GN 487A (Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025, inayofanya kazi kuanzia 28 Julai 2025) inazuia wageni kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 maalum. GN 605A (Wage Order 2025, iliyosajiliwa 13 Oktoba 2025, inayofanya kazi kuanzia 1 Januari 2026) inabainisha mishahara ya chini ya sekta mbalimbali kwa wafanyakazi wote Tanzania. GN 487A inahusu UMILIKI wa biashara; GN 605A inahusu MISHAHARA ya wafanyakazi. Kampuni inaweza kufuata GN 605A (kulipa mishahara sahihi) na bado kukiuka GN 487A (kama mmiliki ni mgeni katika sekta zilizozuiliwa).
question_en: GN 487A and GN 605A are different — what does each say?
answer_en: Yes, these are completely different Orders. GN 487A (Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, effective 28 July 2025) prohibits non-citizens from operating businesses in 15 specific categories. GN 605A (Wage Order 2025, gazetted 13 October 2025, effective 1 January 2026) sets minimum wages across various sectors for all workers in Tanzania. GN 487A concerns business OWNERSHIP; GN 605A concerns worker WAGES. A company can comply with GN 605A (paying correct wages) and still violate GN 487A (if the owner is a non-citizen in a prohibited sector).
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya pango la kibiashara (commercial rent) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya pango la kibiashara ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on commercial rent in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on commercial rent is 10% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Nchi gani ina mfumo bora wa kodi duniani — niwekeze wapi nje ya Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu. Ulinganisho wa mifumo ya kodi ya kimataifa na ushauri wa uwekezaji nje ya Tanzania ni nje ya wigo wangu wa utaalamu wa biashara na kodi za Tanzania. Kwa ushauri wa uwekezaji wa kimataifa, wasiliana na mshauri wa fedha aliyehitimu au shirika la ushauri la kimataifa linalofahamu mahitaji yako maalum.

instruction: Nimekuwa nikalipa VAT ya asilimia 5 kwa miaka miwili — hii ni sahihi?
output: Hapana — Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kama umelipa 5% kwa VAT, inawezekana kumekuwa na kosa katika mfumo wako wa akaunti. Hatua: (1) Angalia invoices zako na mwongozo wa TRA. (2) Wasiliana na TRA kujua kama unapaswa kurekebisha malipo ya zamani. (3) Sahihisha mfumo wako wa akaunti mara moja.

question_sw: Mshahara wa mfanyakazi mgeni unaopatikana nje ya Tanzania — PAYE Tanzania inatumika?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali ya usajili wa kazi. Ikiwa mfanyakazi anafanya kazi Tanzania kwa ajili ya mwajiri wa Tanzania na mshahara unalipwa nje ya nchi, TRA inaweza bado kuhitaji PAYE Tanzania. 'Shadow payroll' ni mfumo unaotumika katika hali kama hizi — mwajiri anahifadhi rekodi za PAYE Tanzania hata kama mshahara unalipwa nje. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: A foreign employee's salary paid outside Tanzania — does Tanzania PAYE apply?
answer_en: It depends on the employment arrangement. If the employee works in Tanzania for a Tanzanian employer and salary is paid outside the country, TRA may still require Tanzania PAYE. 'Shadow payroll' is a system used in such cases — the employer maintains Tanzania PAYE records even though salary is paid abroad. Verify with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Kampuni ya uwekezaji wa nje iliyopo kwenye SEZ (Special Economic Zone) — je, inalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Kampuni zilizo ndani ya Special Economic Zone (SEZ) — kama vile EPZ — zinaweza kupata msamaha wa SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) kama sehemu ya vivutio vya uwekezaji. Msamaha wa SEZ unathibitishwa na EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority). Omba barua ya uthibitisho wa msamaha kutoka EPZA na nakala ya uthibitisho kutoka TRA kabla ya kusimama kulipa SDL.
question_en: A foreign-invested company in a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) — does it pay SDL?
answer_en: Companies within a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) — such as EPZ — may be exempt from SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) as part of the investment incentives package. SEZ exemptions are confirmed by EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority). Obtain a written exemption letter from EPZA and a copy of TRA confirmation before stopping SDL payments.

instruction: Bidhaa za kilimo zina VAT ngapi Tanzania — 5%?
output: Tanzania haina VAT ya 5%. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Bidhaa nyingi za kilimo (mbolea, mbegu, zana za kilimo) zina VAT 0% (zero-rated) au zimesamehewa (exempt) — si 5%. Orodha kamili iko kwenye VAT Act na TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni aliyeajiriwa Tanzania anahitaji kusajiliwa NSSF na WCF — je, wana haki sawa na Watanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni aliyeajiriwa kisheria Tanzania (mwenye kibali halisi cha kazi) ana haki sawa za kisheria za NSSF na WCF kama mfanyakazi wa Kitanzania. Mwajiri lazima asajili mfanyakazi wa kigeni NSSF na WCF na kuwasilisha michango. Uraia wa mfanyakazi hauathiri wajibu wa mwajiri wa kuhifadhi bima na manufaa ya kijamii.
question_en: Is a foreign employee hired in Tanzania required to be registered with NSSF and WCF — do they have equal rights to Tanzanians?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign worker lawfully employed in Tanzania (with a valid work permit) has the same legal rights to NSSF and WCF as a Tanzanian employee. The employer must register the foreign worker with NSSF and WCF and remit contributions. The worker's citizenship does not affect the employer's obligation to maintain social security and insurance coverage.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Ninafanya biashara ya exempt — 'kwa ujumla' naweza kudai input VAT au si?
answer_sw: Hapana — si 'kwa ujumla' bali KAMWE. Kanuni ya exempt haibadiliki: kama biashara yako ina asili ya exempt, huwezi kudai input VAT inayohusiana na biashara hiyo. Lugha ya hedging kama 'kwa ujumla' au 'inategemea hali' si sahihi kwa kanuni hii — ni kanuni ngumu (hard rule) ya sheria ya VAT Tanzania. Ikiwa una biashara zote mbili (exempt na taxable), unaweza kudai input VAT ya sehemu ya taxable tu — si ya sehemu ya exempt.
question_en: I run an exempt business — 'in general' can I claim input VAT or not?
answer_en: No — not 'in general' but NEVER. The exempt rule does not change: if your business is exempt in nature, you cannot claim input VAT related to that business. Hedging language like 'in general' or 'it depends on the situation' is not accurate for this rule — it is a hard rule in Tanzanian VAT law. If you have both (exempt and taxable) activities, you may claim input VAT for the taxable portion only — not for the exempt portion.

instruction: Ni nani anachangia zaidi kwenye NSSF — mwajiri au mfanyakazi?
output: Kwa mgawanyo wa kawaida, wote wawili wanachangia kwa kiasi sawa — mwajiri anachangia asilimia 10 na mfanyakazi anachangia asilimia 10, jumla asilimia 20. Hata hivyo, mwajiri anaweza kuchagua kuchangia zaidi: mgawanyo wa 15+5 (mwajiri zaidi) au 20+0 (mwajiri analipa yote). Mfanyakazi hawezi kuchangia zaidi ya asilimia 10 — kikomo chake ni asilimia 10 tu. Kiasi kinachopelekwa NSSF daima ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa jumla.

instruction: Tofauti ya kimsingi kati ya biashara ya jina (sole trader) na kampuni ya hisa ni nini?
output: Tofauti kuu: BIASHARA YA JINA (sole trader/business name): mmiliki na biashara ni kitu kimoja kisheria — madeni ya biashara ni madeni ya mmiliki kibinafsi, mali ya kibinafsi inaweza kutwaliwa. Usajili ni rahisi (BRELA ada ndogo). KAMPUNI YA HISA (limited company): kampuni ni chombo cha kisheria tofauti — mmiliki anashikiliwa tu kwa kiasi cha hisa. Madeni ya kampuni si madeni ya mmiliki kibinafsi (isipokuwa na dhamana ya kibinafsi). Gharama zaidi: usajili min TZS 95,000, annual returns TZS 22,000/mwaka, akaunti za kila mwaka. Kampuni inabaki hata mmiliki akifariki. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz.

instruction: Je, VAT return ya kawaida inajumuisha mauzo ya bidhaa za zero-rated?
output: Ndiyo. Msambazaji anayesajiliwa VAT lazima aripoti mauzo ya bidhaa za zero-rated kwenye VAT return yake ya kawaida -- yanaonyeshwa kama mauzo ya kiwango cha asilimia 0. Pia anadai input VAT kwenye gharama zinazohusiana na mauzo hayo. Zero-rated iko ndani ya mfumo wa VAT, si nje yake. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Ninachimba almasi kidogo kidogo kama mchimbaji mdogo (artisanal miner) — royalty yangu ni ngapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Royalty ya madini kwa wachimbaji wadogo (artisanal and small-scale miners) inashughulikiwa chini ya Mining Act na kanuni maalum za TMAA — kiwango kinatofautiana na cha wachimbaji wakubwa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Ninataka kusajili biashara ya sole trader (mfanyabiashara mmoja). Nianze wapi?
output: Usajilishaji wa sole trader (business name) unafanywa na BRELA. Hatua: (1) angalia upatikanaji wa jina la biashara kwenye mfumo wa ORS (ors.brela.go.tz); (2) hifadhi jina ukilipenda; (3) jaza fomu za usajilishaji wa jina la biashara; (4) lipa ada husika; (5) pokea hati ya usajilishaji. Kwa ada za sasa na fomu maalum, angalia brela.go.tz au mfumo wa ORS — ada zinaweza kubadilika.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kusimamisha michango ya NSSF kwa miezi 3 bila adhabu ikiwa ana tatizo la mtiririko wa pesa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. NSSF haiku na utaratibu rasmi wa 'kusimamisha michango' bila adhabu. Michango ya NSSF lazima iwasilishwe ifikapo tarehe 10 ya kila mwezi bila kujali matatizo ya mtiririko wa pesa. Kuchelewa kunasababisha adhabu ya asilimia 5 kwa mwezi. Mwajiri mwenye matatizo ya kweli ya fedha anaweza kuwasiliana na NSSF kuomba mpango wa malipo wa awamu — lakini hii si kusimamisha na bado riba inajilimbikiza.
question_en: Can an employer suspend NSSF contributions for 3 months without penalty if they have a cash flow problem in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. NSSF does not have a formal 'suspend contributions' procedure without penalty. NSSF contributions must be submitted by the 10th of each month regardless of cash flow problems. Late payment attracts a 5% penalty per month. An employer with genuine financial difficulties can contact NSSF to request an instalment payment plan — but this is not a suspension and interest still accrues.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Nikiwa msaidizi, nikiri kosa — adhabu yangu itapungua?
answer_sw: Kukiri kosa (guilty plea) kunaweza kupunguza adhabu katika mfumo wa mahakama Tanzania — korti inazingatia ushirikiano na ukweli wa kustahimili. Lakini adhabu ya msaidizi ina kikwazo cha juu cha TZS 5M AU miezi 3 jela — kukiri kosa kunaweza kusaidia kupata adhabu ndogo ndani ya mipaka hii, si kuvuka mipaka. Wasiliana na wakili kabla ya kutoa jibu lolote mahakamani.
question_en: If I am a facilitator and plead guilty — will my penalty be reduced?
answer_en: A guilty plea may reduce a penalty in Tanzania's court system — courts take cooperation and honest admission into account. However the facilitator's penalty already has a ceiling of TZS 5M OR 3 months' imprisonment — a guilty plea may help obtain a penalty at the lower end within those limits, not below them. Consult a lawyer before giving any answer in court.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Biashara ndogo Tanzania inapaswa kutenganisha akaunti ya biashara na akaunti ya mwenye biashara — serikali inaweza kukagua akaunti yake binafsi?
answer_sw: TRA inaweza kuomba mahakama ruhusa ya kukagua akaunti za benki za mshukiwa wa ukwepaji wa kodi — ikiwa ni pamoja na akaunti za kibinafsi zikionekana kuwa biashara inafanya shughuli kupitia akaunti binafsi. Hii ni sababu nzuri zaidi ya kuhifadhi biashara na fedha za kibinafsi tofauti. Akaunti tofauti za benki zinazuia uchunguzi usiohitajika na zinahifadhi faragha ya kibinafsi.
question_en: Should a small Tanzania business separate the business account from the owner's personal account — can the government audit the personal account?
answer_en: TRA can seek court authorisation to examine bank accounts of a tax evasion suspect — including personal accounts if the business appears to be operating through personal accounts. This is another strong reason to keep business and personal funds separate. Separate bank accounts prevent unnecessary scrutiny and protect personal privacy.

instruction: Je, ninaweza kufanya ukaguzi wa OSHA peke yangu au lazima niombe OSHA ifanye?
output: OSHA ndiyo inayofanya ukaguzi rasmi wa kila mwaka wa mahali pa kazi -- si mwajiri peke yake. Mwajiri anaombwa kujiandaa kwa ukaguzi kwa kuhakikisha viwango vya usalama vinakidhiwa, kuhifadhi rekodi za ajali na mafunzo ya usalama, na kuwa na vifaa sahihi vya usalama. Thibitisha utaratibu wa ukaguzi na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, Bitcoin inalipwa kodi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kanuni za kodi za cryptocurrency (Bitcoin na sarafu za kidijitali) Tanzania bado ziko katika hatua za awali za uandishi wa sera. Bank of Tanzania (BoT) na TRA hazijatoa mwongozo kamili wa kodi za crypto hadi sasa (Juni 2026). Kwa maswali ya hali ya sasa ya crypto Tanzania, wasiliana na TRA moja kwa moja au angalia tangazo za hivi karibuni la BoT. Ninashughulikia kodi zilizo wazi: VAT (18%), PAYE, SDL, NSSF.
question_en: Is Bitcoin taxed in Tanzania?
answer_en: Cryptocurrency tax rules (Bitcoin and digital currencies) in Tanzania are still in early policy development stages. Bank of Tanzania (BoT) and TRA have not issued comprehensive crypto tax guidance as of June 2026. For the current status of crypto in Tanzania, contact TRA directly or check recent BoT announcements. I handle established taxes: VAT (18%), PAYE, SDL, NSSF.

question_sw: Kampuni inapoteza haki ya kubeba hasara mbele ikiwa haijatoa tamko la kodi kwa mwaka wa hasara — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kushindwa kuwasilisha tamko la kodi kwa mwaka wa hasara kunaweza kuathiri haki ya kubeba hasara mbele. TRA inaweza kupinga udai wa hasara ambao haujathbitishwa na tamko la kodi lililothibitishwa. Daima wasilisha tamko hata katika miaka ya hasara ili kuhifadhi haki ya carry-forward.
question_en: A company loses its right to carry losses forward if it does not file a tax return for the loss year — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. Failing to file a tax return for a loss year can compromise the right to carry that loss forward. TRA may challenge loss claims not substantiated by a confirmed tax return. Always file a return even in loss years to preserve the carry-forward right.

instruction: NSSF inapaswa kulipwa tarehe ngapi kila mwezi?
output: NSSF lazima iwasilishwe ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwisho wa mwezi wa malipo ya wafanyakazi — kwa kawaida ifikapo tarehe ya mwisho wa mwezi unaofuata. Kwa mfano: mishahara ya Januari → NSSF iwasilishwe kabla ya mwisho wa Februari. Thibitisha tarehe halisi ya sasa na nssf.go.tz — tarehe inaweza kubadilika. Muhimu: usisubiri mpaka mwisho — lipa mapema kuepuka mkusanyiko wa faini ya 5%/mwezi. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz kwa tarehe halisi ya sasa.

instruction: Mwajiri lazima afanye nini ukaguzi wa OSHA anapotembelea biashara?
output: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa OSHA: (1) karibishe mkaguzi — kukataa ukaguzi ni ukiukwaji wa ziada; (2) toa nyaraka zote zinazohusiana na usalama — cheti cha OSHA, rekodi za tathmini ya hatari, mafunzo ya wafanyakazi; (3) onyesha mkaguzi mahali pote pa kazi anapoomba; (4) jibu maswali ya mkaguzi kwa uaminifu; (5) kama mkaguzi anatoa maelekezo ya kurekebisha, ufuate kwa wakati. Ushirikiano kamili na OSHA ni faida yako mwenyewe.

question_sw: Biashara yangu inafanya mauzo ya VAT (taxable) na mauzo yasiyobeba VAT (exempt) — jinsi ya kudai input VAT?
answer_sw: Kama biashara inafanya mauzo ya aina mbili — yenye VAT (taxable) na yasio na VAT (exempt) — input VAT inagawanywa (apportioned). Gawanya input VAT kulingana na uwiano wa mauzo ya taxable kwa mauzo yote. Sehemu ya input VAT inayohusiana na mauzo ya taxable inaweza kudaiwa; sehemu inayohusiana na exempt haiwezi. Utaratibu huu unaitwa 'partial exemption' au 'apportionment'.
question_en: My business makes both VAT-taxable sales and VAT-exempt sales — how do I claim input VAT?
answer_en: When a business makes two types of sales — taxable (with VAT) and exempt (no VAT) — input VAT must be apportioned. Divide input VAT in proportion to taxable sales over total sales. The portion of input VAT relating to taxable sales can be claimed; the portion relating to exempt sales cannot. This process is called 'partial exemption' or 'apportionment'.
