instruction: Input VAT maana yake nini na ninaweza kudai lini?
output: Input VAT: VAT unayolipa wakati unaponunua bidhaa au huduma kwa biashara yako. Output VAT: VAT unayokusanya kutoka kwa wateja wako. Unapaswa kulipa TRA: Output VAT MINUS Input VAT. Unaweza kudai input VAT ukiwa umesajiliwa VAT na una invoice halisi ya VAT kutoka kwa wazabuni. Kama output VAT ni ndogo kuliko input VAT: unastahili rejareja ya VAT kutoka TRA.

instruction: Mteja anakuwa na haraka na atasema 'sitaki risiti' — ninaweza kumpa bila risiti?
output: Hapana — wewe kama mmiliki wa biashara una WAJIBU wa kutoa risiti ya EFD bila kujali kama mteja anataka au la. Sheria haimpi mteja haki ya kuomba asilipwe risiti. Kama mteja atakata risiti, hifadhi risiti ya EFD kwa rekodi zako — ushahidi wa muamala bado unahitajika. TRA inaweza kufanya ukaguzi wa siri (secret shoppers) ambapo wanunuzi wanaojifanya wateja wanakuja na kupima kama risiti inatoka. Kama ukaguzi huo unaonyesha risiti haitolewa — faini na hatua za kisheria zinafuata bila kujali mteja alitaka risiti au la. Thibitisha na TRA.

question_sw: WCF inafidia tu ajali za mahali pa kazi — si magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) Tanzania inashughulikia ZOTE MBILI: (1) ajali za mahali pa kazi (workplace accidents) — majeraha ya haraka kama kuanguka, kuumwa na mashine, na (2) magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi (occupational diseases) — magonjwa yanayoendelea kwa muda mrefu kutokana na mazingira ya kazi kama ugonjwa wa mapafu kwa uchimbaji madini, upotezaji wa kusikia kwa kelele. Mwajiri anaweza kulipwa fidia kwa aina zote mbili.
question_en: WCF only covers workplace accidents — not work-related diseases — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Tanzania's WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) covers BOTH: (1) workplace accidents — immediate injuries like falls, machine injuries, and (2) occupational diseases — long-term illnesses arising from work environment such as lung disease from mining, hearing loss from noise. A worker can claim compensation for both types.

instruction: Kampeni ya utekelezaji wa GN 487A ilikuwa ni ya mwezi mmoja tu — je, sheria imeisha?
output: Hapana — kampeni ya utekelezaji (11 Sep–8 Oct 2025) ilikuwa ni harakati maalum ya kwanza ya kukagua na kutekeleza GN 487A kwa nguvu — si mwisho wa sheria. GN 487A yenyewe ni sheria ya kudumu (permanent law) iliyoanzishwa tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Kampeni iliisha lakini utekelezaji wa kawaida wa sheria unaendelea kila wakati. Idara ya Uhamiaji, polisi, na mahakama zinaweza kushughulikia ukiukwaji wowote wa GN 487A wakati wowote — bila kuhitaji kampeni maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mteja wangu alilipa kupitia uhamisho wa benki (bank transfer) — si pesa taslimu. Je, bado ninahitaji kutoa risiti ya EFD?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — njia ya malipo haibadilishi wajibu wa EFD. Iwe ni pesa taslimu, uhamisho wa benki, malipo ya simu (mobile money), au kadi ya mkopo — biashara yoyote inayohitajika kutumia EFD lazima itoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila mauzo. EFD inarekodi muamala wa mauzo, si njia ya malipo. Kushindwa kutoa risiti ya EFD kunakufanya upate adhabu za TRA hata kama mteja alilipa kupitia benki.
question_en: My customer paid via bank transfer, not cash. Do I still need to issue an EFD receipt?
answer_en: Yes — the payment method does not change the EFD obligation. Whether payment is cash, bank transfer, mobile money, or credit card — any business required to use EFD must issue an EFD receipt for every sale. The EFD records the sale transaction, not the payment channel. Failing to issue an EFD receipt attracts TRA penalties even when the customer paid by bank transfer.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya ada za huduma (service fees) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya ada za huduma (service fees) ni asilimia 5 kwa wakazi na asilimia 15 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on service fees in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on service fees is 5% for residents and 15% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Kama ninatumia jina langu halisi tu — kwa mfano 'Hassan Mwakasege' — bado nihitaji BRELA?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Hata ukitumia jina lako kamili bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria ya Tanzania Bara inakuhitaji kusajili biashara yako kwa BRELA. Usajili unakupa haki ya kisheria ya kuingia mikataba na kufungua akaunti ya benki kwa jina la biashara.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni (expatriate) Tanzania analipa PAYE kama Mtanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. PAYE inatumika kwa wafanyakazi WOTE wanaofanya kazi Tanzania — wakiwemo wageni na wasio na makazi ya kudumu. Mwajiri analazimika kukata PAYE kutoka kwa mshahara wa mfanyakazi mgeni na kulipa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, kama ilivyo kwa wafanyakazi wote wengine.
question_en: Does a foreign (expatriate) employee in Tanzania pay PAYE like a Tanzanian?
answer_en: Yes. PAYE applies to ALL employees working in Tanzania — including foreigners and non-permanent residents. The employer is required to deduct PAYE from a foreign employee's salary and remit to TRA by the 7th of the following month, just as with all other employees.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri anaweza kulipa NSSF ya mfanyakazi pia (kulipa 20% yote)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri anaweza kuchagua kulipa 20% yote ya NSSF (sehemu ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi) kama faida ya ziada kwa mfanyakazi — bila kukata kitu kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Hii ni maamuzi ya biashara na inaweza kuwa na athari za kodi (PAYE) kwa mfanyakazi kama inachukuliwa kama faida inayolipwa. Wasiliana na TRA/mshauri wa kodi kwa athari za kodi. Kiwango cha lazima kwa mwajiri ni asilimia 10 tu.
question_en: Can the employer pay the employee's NSSF share too (paying all 20%)?
answer_en: Yes. An employer can choose to pay all 20% of NSSF (both employer and employee shares) as an additional benefit to the employee — without deducting anything from the employee's salary. This is a business decision and may have tax implications (PAYE) for the employee if treated as a taxable benefit. Contact TRA/a tax adviser for tax implications. The mandatory minimum for the employer is 10% only.

instruction: NSSF inalipwa tarehe ngapi kwa mwezi?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. NSSF inapaswa kulipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara — yaani kabla ya mwisho wa mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha tarehe halisi ya sasa na NSSF (nssf.go.tz) kwani inaweza kubainishwa zaidi na ofisi yako ya NSSF. Kuchelewa kulipa NSSF kunasababisha faini — lipa mapema.

question_sw: Mgeni anayefanya biashara iliyokatazwa anapaswa kufanya nini sasa hivi?
answer_sw: Mgeni anapaswa: (1) Kuacha uendeshaji wa moja kwa moja wa biashara iliyokatazwa haraka iwezekanavyo. (2) Kushauriana na mwanasheria wa biashara kuhusu chaguzi za kisheria — ikiwemo kuhamisha biashara kwa raia wa Tanzania au kufunga kabisa. (3) Kuhakikisha kampuni au biashara inasajiliwa vizuri chini ya mmiliki raia wa Tanzania. Kuendelea bila kuchukua hatua ni hatari kubwa.
question_en: What should a non-citizen currently operating a prohibited business do right now?
answer_en: The non-citizen should: (1) Immediately stop directly operating the prohibited business as soon as possible. (2) Consult a business lawyer about legal options — including transferring the business to a Tanzanian citizen or closing entirely. (3) Ensure the company or business is properly registered under a Tanzanian citizen owner. Continuing without action carries significant risk.
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Ubia (joint venture) kati ya mgeni na Mtanzania — GN 487A inazuiwa?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ubia (joint venture au partnership) hauzui GN 487A. Raia wa kigeni ndani ya ubia bado hawezi kufanya kazi za biashara zilizo kwenye orodha ya 15 kwa niaba yake mwenyewe. Mtanzania ndiye anapaswa kuwa mmiliki mkuu na meneja wa shughuli zilizokatazwa. Muundo wa kisheria sahihi unahitajika.
question_en: A joint venture between a non-citizen and a Tanzanian — does this bypass GN 487A?
answer_en: No. A joint venture or partnership does not bypass GN 487A. The non-citizen within the partnership still cannot perform business activities on the list of 15 on their own behalf. The Tanzanian must be the primary owner and manager of the prohibited activities. Correct legal structuring is required.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Kama mfanyakazi wa muda (casual worker) — mwajiri wake anahitajika kumlipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Hii ni eneo lenye utata na linalohitaji uthibitisho wa hivi karibuni na NSSF. Kwa mujibu wa sheria ya NSSF Tanzania, wafanyakazi wa aina mbalimbali — ikiwa ni pamoja na wale wa mkataba wa muda mfupi — wanaweza kuhitimu ufikiwa wa NSSF. Hata hivyo, sheria inaweza kutofautisha kati ya 'casual' na 'mfanyakazi wa kudumu'. Usifanye uamuzi bila kuuliza NSSF moja kwa moja. Wasiliana na NSSF kwenye nssf.go.tz kwa mwongozo wa hali yako maalum.
question_en: If I hire casual (temporary) workers — must I pay NSSF for them?
answer_en: This is an area that requires up-to-date confirmation directly from NSSF. Under Tanzania's NSSF Act, various categories of workers — including those on short-term contracts — may qualify for NSSF coverage. However, the law may distinguish between 'casual' and 'permanent' employees. Do not make assumptions — ask NSSF directly. Contact NSSF at nssf.go.tz for guidance on your specific situation.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.go.tz before training

question_sw: Kampuni yenye wakurugenzi wote wa kigeni inaweza kusajiliwa BRELA — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa kampuni nyingi. Tanzania haikuweka kikwazo cha lazima kinachohitaji mkurugenzi mkazi Tanzania kwa kampuni za kawaida (ingawa sheria inaweza kutofautiana kwa sekta zilizodhibitiwa). Hata hivyo, kwa usajili wa TRA na BRELA, anwani ya ndani ya Tanzania inahitajika, na makampuni mengi yanashauriwa kuwa na mwakilishi wa ndani.
question_en: Can a company with all foreign directors be registered with BRELA — is this true?
answer_en: Yes for most companies. Tanzania does not impose a mandatory requirement for a resident Tanzania director for standard companies (though law may differ for regulated sectors). However for TRA and BRELA registration a local Tanzania address is required, and most companies are advised to have a local representative.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Unaweza kupinga tathmini ya kodi hata kama umekubali awali — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida hapana. Ukisha kukubali tathmini na kuisaini, inakuwa ya mwisho. Kupinga baadaye ni ngumu isipokuwa kama kuna ushahidi wa udanganyifu, makosa ya wazi ya kisheria, au hali nyingine maalum. Ni muhimu kusoma na kuelewa tathmini yoyote kabla ya kuisaini au kukubali.
question_en: Can you dispute a tax assessment even after initially accepting it — is this true?
answer_en: Generally no. Once you have accepted and signed an assessment it becomes final. Challenging it later is difficult unless there is evidence of fraud, clear legal error, or other special circumstances. It is critical to read and understand any assessment before signing or accepting it.

question_sw: Je, biashara ya jumla (wholesale) imekatazwa kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: NDIYO — biashara ya jumla (wholesale) iko katika orodha ya biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A. Mgeni anayeendesha biashara ya jumla — kuuza bidhaa kwa maduka, wafanyabiashara wengine, au kwa wingi — anakiuka GN 487A na anastahili adhabu kamili: faini ya angalau TZS 10M, kifungo, na visa kufutwa.
question_en: Is wholesale trade prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: YES — wholesale trade is on the list of 15 business categories prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A. A non-citizen running a wholesale business — selling goods to shops, other traders, or in bulk — is violating GN 487A and is subject to the full penalty: fine of at least TZS 10M, imprisonment, and visa revocation.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A prohibited category list

question_sw: Mkono mrefu wa Idara ya Uhamiaji unafika hadi vijiji — wanaweza kufuatilia biashara za mgeni?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Idara ya Uhamiaji ina mamlaka ya kufanya ukaguzi na operesheni za utekelezaji kote nchini, ikiwa ni pamoja na maeneo ya vijijini. Operesheni ya kwanza ya GN 487A (Septemba-Oktoba 2025) iliendelea maeneo mengi ya Tanzania Bara. Biashara za wageni katika maeneo ya vijijini zinaathiriwa sawa na maeneo ya mijini. Mkakati bora ni kuhakikisha biashara zote za wageni zinakubaliana na GN 487A kabla ya utekelezaji kufikia eneo lako.
question_en: Can the Immigration Department reach villages to monitor foreign-owned businesses?
answer_en: Yes. The Immigration Department has authority to conduct inspections and enforcement operations across the country, including rural areas. The first GN 487A enforcement exercise (September-October 2025) covered many areas of Tanzania Mainland. Foreign businesses in rural areas are affected equally to urban areas. The best approach is to ensure all foreign-owned businesses comply with GN 487A before enforcement reaches your area.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: EFD receipt na VAT invoice — ni hati moja au mbili tofauti?
answer_sw: Ni hati MBILI TOFAUTI. VAT invoice: hati rasmi ya kibiashara inayotolewa na msambazaji kwa mnunuzi ikiwa na maelezo kamili ya VAT (jina, TIN, kiasi, kiwango). EFD receipt: hati inayotolewa na mashine ya EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) inayothibitisha mauzo ya biashara — mara nyingi inajumuisha maelezo ya VAT pia. Kwa biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT, EFD receipt ndiyo nyaraka inayothibitishwa na TRA. Zote mbili zinaweza kuhitajika katika hali tofauti.
question_en: EFD receipt and VAT invoice — are they one document or two different ones?
answer_en: They are TWO DIFFERENT documents. VAT invoice: a formal commercial document issued by a supplier to a buyer with full VAT details (name, TIN, amount, rate). EFD receipt: a document issued by an EFD machine (Electronic Fiscal Device) confirming a business sale — often includes VAT details too. For VAT-registered businesses, the EFD receipt is TRA's verified document. Both may be required in different situations.

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara mdogo anayekusanya pesa za kikundi kwa biashara (VICOBA leader) — ana wajibu wa kodi?
answer_sw: Kiongozi wa VICOBA anayekusanya na kusimamia pesa za kikundi kwa niaba ya wanachama — si mfanyabiashara peke yake. Pesa za kikundi si mapato yake ya kibinafsi. Hata hivyo, kama kiongozi ana mshahara au posho kutoka kwa kikundi, hiyo inaweza kuwa mapato yanayolazimika kodi. Fanya ufafanuzi wa kisheria kwa kiongozi anayekusudia kupata malipo.
question_en: A small business person collecting group savings as VICOBA leader — do they have tax obligations?
answer_en: A VICOBA leader collecting and managing group funds on behalf of members — is not themselves running a business. Group funds are not their personal income. However, if the leader receives a salary or allowance from the group, that may be taxable income. Seek legal clarity for a leader intending to receive payment.

question_sw: Mgeni wa China ana duka la simu (ukarabati) na duka la rejareja — ni moja au yote mawili yanabeba tatizo la GN 487A?
answer_sw: Yote MAWILI yanabeba tatizo. Ukarabati wa simu NA biashara ya rejareja — zote mbili ziko kwenye orodha ya biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A. Mgeni anayeendesha duka moja au duka mbili za aina hizi anakiuka GN 487A. Kila kesi ni ukiukaji tofauti unaostahili adhabu.
question_en: A Chinese non-citizen has a phone repair shop and a retail shop — does only one or do both carry a GN 487A problem?
answer_en: BOTH carry a problem. Phone repair AND retail trade — both are on the list of 15 prohibited business categories for non-citizens under GN 487A. A non-citizen running one or both shops of these types is violating GN 487A. Each case is a separate violation that deserves a penalty.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mwombaji wa kibali cha kazi (Class C) Tanzania anahitaji hati gani?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, mwombaji wa Class C anahitaji: passport inayotumika, barua ya mwajiri, mkataba wa kazi, vyeti vya elimu/uzoefu, picha za pasipoti, fomu ya TRA (TIN), na ada ya maombi. Mahitaji yanaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha orodha kamili na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What documents does a Class C work permit applicant in Tanzania need?
answer_en: Typically, a Class C applicant needs: a valid passport, employer letter, employment contract, educational/experience certificates, passport photos, TRA form (TIN), and application fee. Requirements may vary — confirm the full list with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri anaweza kupunguza gharama za NSSF kutoka kodi ya mapato ya makampuni?
answer_sw: Michango ya NSSF ya mwajiri kwa kawaida inaweza kuchukuliwa kama gharama inayopunguzwa kwa kodi ya mapato ya makampuni — lakini masharti maalum yanategemea sheria ya kodi ya Tanzania na muundo wa malipo. Thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi wa kodi ya makampuni au TRA.
question_en: Can an employer deduct NSSF contributions from corporate income tax?
answer_en: Employer NSSF contributions can generally be treated as a deductible expense for corporate income tax purposes — but specific conditions depend on Tanzania's corporate tax law and payment structure. Verify with a corporate tax advisor or TRA.

question_sw: Muda wa pingamizi ni siku 90 — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Muda wa kuwasilisha pingamizi kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ni siku 30 — si siku 90. Kama unachanganya muda huu na muda mwingine (kama miezi 6 ya uamuzi wa Kamishna au siku 45 za rufaa ya TRAB), ni muhimu kuzingatia muda sahihi kwa kila hatua.
question_en: The objection period is 90 days — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The objection filing period with the TRA Commissioner General is 30 DAYS — not 90 days. If you are confusing this with other timeframes (such as the Commissioner's 6-month decision window or TRAB's 45-day appeal window), each step has its own specific deadline.

instruction: Z-Report lazima ipigwe lini — usiku au asubuhi ya siku inayofuata?
output: Z-Report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU YA BIASHARA — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Z-Report inafanya muhtasari wa mauzo yote ya siku na kufunga siku ya biashara kwenye mfumo wa EFD. Baada ya Z-Report kupigwa, EFD inaanza akaunti mpya ya siku inayofuata. Kama hukupiga Z-Report usiku wa siku moja na ukajaribu kupiga asubuhi ya siku inayofuata kabla ya mauzo ya asubuhi — rekodi zitachanganyika. TRA inakagua wakati wa Z-Reports — kuchelewa kila wakati kunaweza kuuliza maswali. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, ninapouza hisa zangu kampunini, nalipa kodi ngapi?
answer_sw: Kodi kwa uuzaji wa hisa ni suala la kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) — ambalo ni eneo maalum zaidi ya mipaka ya msaada wangu wa sasa. Ninashughulikia kodi za uendeshaji wa biashara za kila siku: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF. Kwa maswali ya capital gains na uuzaji wa hisa, wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyesajiliwa (TRA tax consultant) au TRA moja kwa moja. Tatizo hili linahitaji ushauri wa kitaalamu.
question_en: When I sell my company shares, what tax do I pay?
answer_en: Taxation on share sales is a capital gains tax matter — which is a more specialised area beyond my current scope. I handle day-to-day business operation taxes: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF. For capital gains and share sale questions, contact a registered tax consultant or TRA directly. This issue requires professional advice.

question_sw: Posho ya chakula (meal allowance) haikodiwi PAYE ikiwa inatolewa kila siku — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. Posho ya chakula inayolipwa kwa pesa moja kwa moja kwa mfanyakazi kwa kawaida inajumuishwa kama mapato yanayotoza PAYE. Chakula kinachotolewa mahali pa kazi moja kwa moja (kama canteen au mlo wa bure) kinaweza kuwa na matibabu tofauti. Mazingira ya kila kampuni yanaweza kutofautiana — tathmini na mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: A daily meal allowance paid in cash is not subject to PAYE — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. A meal allowance paid as cash directly to the employee is generally included as PAYE-taxable income. Meals provided in-kind at the workplace (such as a canteen or free meal) may have different treatment. Each company's specific circumstances may vary — assess with a tax adviser.

question_sw: Je, dawa za malaria za Tanzania zinalipwa VAT?
answer_sw: Dawa nyingi za binadamu Tanzania — ikiwemo dawa za malaria — ziko kwenye orodha ya zero-rated ya VAT, yaani hazilipwi VAT (asilimia 0). Hata hivyo, kwa orodha kamili ya dawa zero-rated na dawa zinazotozwa VAT ya asilimia 18, angalia orodha rasmi ya TRA kwenye tra.go.tz au sheria ya VAT. Kwa maswali ya kimatibabu kuhusu malaria yenyewe, wasiliana na Wizara ya Afya au daktari.
question_en: Are malaria medicines in Tanzania subject to VAT?
answer_en: Most human medicines in Tanzania — including malaria medicines — are on the zero-rated VAT list, meaning no VAT is charged (0%). However, for the complete list of zero-rated medicines versus those subject to 18% VAT, check the official TRA list at tra.go.tz or the VAT Act. For medical questions about malaria itself, contact the Ministry of Health or a doctor.

question_sw: Je, kuna kiwango cha juu cha mshahara kinachohesabiwaje kwa NSSF?
answer_sw: Sheria ya NSSF ya Tanzania haiweki kiwango cha juu cha mshahara (contribution ceiling) ambacho kinaathiri hesabu ya NSSF. Yaani: NSSF inahesabiwaje kwa msingi wa mshahara mkubwa wa jumla wote, bila kikomo cha juu. Kwa mfano: MD analipwa TZS 20,000,000 — NSSF = TZS 20,000,000 × 20% = TZS 4,000,000 kwa mwezi. Hakuna kiwango cha juu cha kupunguza msingi huu kwa sasa.
question_en: Is there an upper salary limit (contribution ceiling) for NSSF calculation?
answer_en: Tanzania's NSSF Act does not set an upper salary contribution ceiling that limits the NSSF calculation base. That is: NSSF is calculated on the full gross wage, with no upper limit. Example: an MD paid TZS 20,000,000 — NSSF = TZS 20,000,000 × 20% = TZS 4,000,000 per month. There is no ceiling to cap this base at present.

question_sw: Kampuni inampa mfanyakazi gari la kampuni kutumia nyumbani na kazini. Je, thamani ya gari hilo inatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Matumizi ya kibinafsi ya gari la kampuni yanachukuliwa kama faida ya ajira (benefit in kind) na yanajumuishwa kwenye mapato yanayotozwa PAYE. TRA inakadiri thamani ya matumizi ya kibinafsi kulingana na kanuni. Mwajiri lazima aongeze thamani hiyo kwenye mshahara wa mwezi wakati anahesabu PAYE. Hoja kwamba gari ni la kazi peke yake haipokewi bila ushahidi wa kutosha.
answer_en: Yes. Personal use of a company car is treated as a benefit in kind and is included in taxable employment income subject to PAYE. TRA estimates the value of private use according to prescribed rules. The employer must add this deemed value to the employee's monthly salary when calculating PAYE. A claim that the car is used purely for business purposes requires sufficient evidence.
question_en: A company provides an employee with a company car for both home and work use. Is the value of the car use subject to PAYE?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — Income Tax Act Cap.332 s.7

question_sw: Mauzo ya bidhaa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii (Facebook, Instagram) hayalipishi kodi Tanzania kwa sababu ni biashara ya mtandaoni tu — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mauzo ya bidhaa au huduma kupitia mitandao ya kijamii bado yana kodi ya Tanzania ikiwa biashara ipo Tanzania au bidhaa/huduma zinauzwa kwa wateja wa Tanzania. Kodi ya mapato ya biashara, VAT (ikiwa mauzo yanazidi kizingiti), na EFD (kama unaomba) zinatumika bila kujali iwapo mauzo yanafanywa mtandaoni au mwili kwa mwili.
question_en: Sales via social media (Facebook, Instagram) are not taxed in Tanzania because it is online business only — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Sales of goods or services via social media are still subject to Tanzania tax if the business is based in Tanzania or the goods/services are sold to Tanzania customers. Business income tax, VAT (if sales exceed the threshold), and EFD (if applicable) apply regardless of whether sales are made online or in person.

question_sw: Je, kila mpaka wa Tanzania una uwezo wa kushughulikia STR?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa orodha kamili ya mipaka yote inayoshughulikia STR Tanzania. Mipaka mikubwa kama Namanga (Kenya), Mutukula (Uganda), na Tunduma (Zambia) kwa ujumla ina mfumo wa STR. Lakini mipaka midogo au ya mbali inaweza kuwa na uwezo tofauti. Thibitisha na Tanzania Revenue Authority (TRA) au ofisi ya forodha ya mpaka unaolengwa.
question_en: Does every Tanzanian border crossing have STR capacity?
answer_en: I am not certain of the complete list of Tanzania border crossings with STR capacity. Major crossings like Namanga (Kenya), Mutukula (Uganda), and Tunduma (Zambia) generally have STR systems in place. But smaller or remote crossings may have different capacity. Verify with TRA or the specific border's customs office.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 300,000 kwa mwezi — inakokotolewa vipi?
output: Mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 300,000/mwezi: Band 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 → kodi = TZS 0. Ziada: TZS 300,000 − TZS 270,000 = TZS 30,000. Band 2 (8%): TZS 30,000 × 8% = TZS 2,400. PAYE ya mwezi = TZS 2,400. Hakuna punguzo la kibinafsi (personal relief) tofauti — kizingiti cha 0% (TZS 270,000) NDIYO punguzo la ufanisi. Kwa hivyo mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 300,000 analipa PAYE ya TZS 2,400/mwezi tu — kiasi kidogo kwa sababu ana mshahara mdogo unaopita kidogo mstari wa TZS 270,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Msimbo wa QR code kwenye risiti ya EFD Tanzania — inamaanisha nini na inatumikaje?
answer_sw: Risiti za EFD za Tanzania zinaweza kuwa na msimbo wa QR code unaomruhusu mteja au mkaguzi wa TRA kuthibitisha uhalali wa risiti moja kwa moja. Kwa kutumia simu ya mkononi au programu ya TRA, unaweza kuscan QR code na kupata: taarifa za muamala, TIN ya biashara, tarehe na kiasi, na uthibitisho kwamba risiti imesajiliwa kwenye mfumo wa TRA. Hii inasaidia kupambana na risiti za bandia.
question_en: The QR code on a Tanzania EFD receipt — what does it mean and how is it used?
answer_en: Tanzania EFD receipts can have a QR code that allows a customer or TRA inspector to verify the receipt's authenticity directly. Using a mobile phone or TRA app, you can scan the QR code to get: transaction details, business TIN, date and amount, and confirmation that the receipt is registered in TRA's system. This helps combat fake receipts.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD QR code or verification system update

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya tathmini (assessment) na ukaguzi (audit) ya TRA ni nini?
answer_sw: Ukaguzi (audit) ni mchakato wa TRA wa kuchunguza rekodi za kodi za mlipaji kodi. Tathmini (assessment) ni uamuzi rasmi wa TRA unaosema kiasi cha kodi kinachostahili. Ukaguzi unaweza kusababisha tathmini ikiwa makosa yatapatikana. Tathmini ndiyo hati rasmi ambayo inaweza kupingwa ndani ya siku 30.
question_en: What is the difference between a TRA assessment and an audit?
answer_en: An audit is TRA's process of examining a taxpayer's tax records. An assessment is TRA's formal decision stating the amount of tax owed. An audit can lead to an assessment if errors are found. An assessment is the formal document that can be objected to within 30 days.

question_sw: Z-report ya EFD ni nini na inahitajika kila siku?
answer_sw: Z-report (au Z-reading) ni taarifa ya mwisho wa siku inayotolewa na EFD baada ya shughuli za biashara kuisha. Inaonyesha: jumla ya mauzo ya siku, jumla ya VAT iliyokusanywa, na namba ya risiti za kwanza na za mwisho za siku. Z-report lazima itolewe kila siku ya biashara na kupelekwa kwenye seva ya TRA. Kutotoa Z-report ni ukiukaji wa kanuni za EFD.
question_en: What is a Z-report on EFD and is it required daily?
answer_en: A Z-report (or Z-reading) is the end-of-day report generated by the EFD after business activity closes. It shows: total daily sales, total VAT collected, and the first and last receipt numbers of the day. A Z-report must be generated every business day and transmitted to TRA's server. Failure to generate a Z-report is a violation of EFD regulations.

instruction: GN 487A — mgeni ambaye tayari ana biashara iliyosajiliwa anafanya nini?
output: GN 487A ya 28 Julai 2025 ina kipengele cha mpito (transitional provision): mgeni aliyekuwa na leseni halisi kabla ya tarehe ya kufanya kazi ya GN 487A anaweza kuendelea na shughuli hiyo hadi leseni yake inaisha — lakini hawezi kuomba upya (renewal) wa leseni hiyo. Wafanyabiashara wageni waliopo: Leseni iliyopo na bado halisi → endelea hadi leseni inaisha (bila renewal). Leseni iliyokwisha muda → shughuli hiyo imekwishakatazwa. Biashara iliyosajiliwa bila leseni maalum → wasiliana na wakili wa uhamiaji haraka. Adhabu za GN 487A ni kali: faini ya TZS 10M au zaidi na kifungo cha miezi 6.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kuhesabu mshahara wa mikono (net salary) mfanyakazi anapopata baada ya PAYE na NSSF kukatwa — mfano wa TZS 800,000.
answer_sw: Mahesabu ya mshahara wa mikono (take-home) kwa mshahara ghafi TZS 800,000/mwezi: PAYE = TZS 52,000 (kama ilivyohesabiwa). NSSF ya mfanyakazi (10%) = TZS 80,000. Jumla ya makato = TZS 132,000. Mshahara wa mikono = TZS 800,000 − TZS 132,000 = TZS 668,000. Kumbuka: WCF na SDL ni gharama za mwajiri peke yake — hazikatwi kwa mfanyakazi. NSSF ya mwajiri (10%) inalipwa tena juu ya mshahara na mwajiri.
answer_en: Take-home salary calculation for gross salary TZS 800,000/month: PAYE = TZS 52,000 (as calculated). Employee NSSF (10%) = TZS 80,000. Total deductions = TZS 132,000. Take-home salary = TZS 800,000 − TZS 132,000 = TZS 668,000. Note: WCF and SDL are employer-only costs — not deducted from the employee. The employer's NSSF share (10%) is paid additionally on top of the salary by the employer.
question_en: How do you calculate an employee's take-home (net) salary after PAYE and NSSF deductions — example with TZS 800,000.
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE + NSSF — net salary calculation
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or NSSF rate amendment

question_sw: Ninajua biashara yangu itafika kizingiti cha VAT mwezi ujao. Ninaweza kusajili leo kabla ya kufika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — unaweza kusajili VAT kwa HIARI kabla ya kufika kizingiti. Hii inaitwa usajili wa hiari (voluntary registration). Faida: unaweza kuanza kudai mkopo wa VAT ya pembejeo mara moja, na wateja wako wa biashara wanaweza kudai input VAT kutoka kwa mahesabu yako. Usajili wa hiari unakufanya uanze kupeleka return ya kila mwezi na kukusanya VAT tangu tarehe ya usajili — si kipindi cha nyuma.
question_en: I know my business will reach the VAT threshold next month. Can I register today before reaching it?
answer_en: Yes — you can register for VAT VOLUNTARILY before reaching the threshold. This is called voluntary registration. Benefit: you can start claiming input VAT credits immediately, and your business clients can claim input VAT from your invoices. Voluntary registration means you start submitting monthly returns and collecting VAT from the registration date — not for any past period.

question_sw: SDL na NSSF — zote zinalipwa tarehe 7 — je, kwa akaunti moja au tofauti?
answer_sw: SDL na NSSF zinazalipwa tarehe 7 lakini kwa taasisi TOFAUTI. SDL inalipwa TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority) kwa akaunti ya TRA. NSSF inalipwa NSSF (National Social Security Fund) kwa akaunti ya NSSF. Lipia kwa akaunti sahihi — kulipa SDL kwa akaunti ya NSSF au kinyume chake kutasababisha matatizo ya upatanisho.
question_en: SDL and NSSF — both due on the 7th — do they go to one account or different ones?
answer_en: SDL and NSSF are both due on the 7th but go to DIFFERENT institutions. SDL is paid to TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority) to the TRA account. NSSF is paid to NSSF (National Social Security Fund) to the NSSF account. Pay to the correct account — paying SDL to the NSSF account or vice versa will cause reconciliation problems.

question_sw: Sheria ya kazi ya Zanzibar ni sawa na Tanzania Bara?
answer_sw: Hapana. Zanzibar ina sheria zake za kazi tofauti na Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) ya Tanzania Bara. Ninashughulikia sheria za kazi za Tanzania Bara peke yake — ELRA, GN 605A (kiwango cha chini cha mshahara), NSSF, SDL. Kwa sheria za kazi za Zanzibar, wasiliana na ofisi za kazi Zanzibar au mshauri wa sheria wa Zanzibar. Je, kuna swali la kazi Tanzania Bara?
question_en: Is Zanzibar labour law the same as Mainland Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Zanzibar has its own labour laws separate from the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA) of Mainland Tanzania. I handle Mainland Tanzania labour law only — ELRA, GN 605A (minimum wage), NSSF, SDL. For Zanzibar labour law, contact the Zanzibar labour office or a Zanzibar legal adviser. Is there a Mainland Tanzania labour question?

question_sw: Ombi la kibali cha makazi Tanzania linafanywa wapi mtandaoni?
answer_sw: Maombi ya vibali vya makazi (daraja A, B, C) yanafanywa mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa e-services wa Idara ya Uhamiaji kwenye tovuti immigration.go.tz. Mwombaji anatakiwa kuunda akaunti, kujaza fomu, na kupakia hati zinazohitajika. Thibitisha mahitaji ya sasa na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Where is a Tanzania residence permit application submitted online?
answer_en: Applications for residence permits (Class A, B, C) are submitted online through the Immigration Department's e-services system at immigration.go.tz. The applicant creates an account, completes the form, and uploads required documents. Confirm current requirements with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Je, risiti ya EFD ni lazima itolewe kwa kila mauzo — hata TZS 1,000?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kwa biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT na EFD, kila muamala wa mauzo unastahili risiti ya EFD — bila kujali kiasi. Hata mauzo ya TZS 1,000 yanahitaji risiti ya EFD. Kutotoa risiti ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya VAT na EFD. TRA inaweza kufanya ukaguzi na kusimamisha EFD au kutoza adhabu kwa kutokutoa risiti.
question_en: Must an EFD receipt be issued for every sale — even TZS 1,000?
answer_en: Yes. For a VAT-registered business with EFD, every sales transaction requires an EFD receipt — regardless of amount. Even a TZS 1,000 sale requires an EFD receipt. Failure to issue a receipt is a violation of VAT and EFD regulations. TRA may conduct inspections and suspend EFD or impose penalties for non-issuance.

instruction: Je, hataza (patent) na alama ya biashara (trademark) zinasajilishwa mahali pamoja Tanzania?
output: Ndiyo -- zote mbili zinasajilishwa na BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency). BRELA inashughulikia: alama za biashara (trademarks), hataza (patents), na miundo ya viwanda (industrial designs). COSOTA inashughulikia hakimiliki (copyright) peke yake -- si hataza wala alama za biashara. Wasiliana na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa usajili wa hataza au alama.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: EFD imesaidia kuongeza makusanyo ya VAT Tanzania kwa kiasi gani?
answer_sw: TRA imerekodia ongezeko kubwa la makusanyo ya kodi tangu kuanzishwa kwa mfumo wa EFD. EFD imesaidia kupunguza ukwepaji wa VAT kwa kurekodi mauzo moja kwa moja, kupunguza utegemezi wa ripoti za mkono peke yake, na kuruhusu ukaguzi wa data kwa wakati halisi. Nchi kama Kenya (ETR) na Tanzania zimeweka mifumo ya EFD kwa sababu ya ushahidi wa kuongeza makusanyo ya VAT. Takwimu mahususi zinatoka kwenye ripoti za kila mwaka za TRA.
question_en: By how much has an EFD helped increase VAT collections in Tanzania?
answer_en: TRA has recorded significant increases in tax collections since the introduction of the EFD system. EFDs have helped reduce VAT evasion by recording sales directly, reducing reliance on manual reports alone, and enabling real-time data auditing. Countries like Kenya (ETR) and Tanzania have implemented EFD systems based on evidence of increased VAT collection. Specific figures come from TRA's annual reports.

question_sw: Mshahara wa chini bado ni Shilingi 275,060 kwa mwezi kwa sekta binafsi — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana, hii si kweli. Shilingi 275,060 ilikuwa kiwango cha agizo la 2022 ambalo LILIFUTWA. Kiwango kipya chini ya GN 605A ni Shilingi 358,322 kwa mwezi (wastani) kuanzia 1 Januari 2026. Kutumia viwango vya 2022 ni ukiukwaji wa kisheria.
question_en: The minimum wage is still TZS 275,060 per month for the private sector — is this correct?
answer_en: No, this is incorrect. TZS 275,060 was the 2022 order rate which was REVOKED. The new rate under GN 605A is TZS 358,322 per month (average) effective 1 January 2026. Using 2022 rates is a legal breach.

question_sw: Nilinunua Bitcoin kwa TZS 2M na kuiuza kwa TZS 5M — ni kodi gani ninastahili kulipa?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa mapato ya cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, USDT, nk) ni mada inayohitaji uelewa wa hivi karibuni wa miongozo ya TRA — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Tanzania bado inaendelea kuweka sera yake ya kodi ya cryptocurrency. Muona TRA moja kwa moja au mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu kwa mwongozo wa hivi karibuni. Epuka kutoa maelezo ya kodi yanayoweza kukusababishia matatizo ya kisheria.
question_en: I bought Bitcoin for TZS 2M and sold it for TZS 5M — what tax do I owe?
answer_en: Tax on cryptocurrency income (Bitcoin, USDT, etc.) requires current knowledge of TRA guidelines — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Tanzania is still developing its cryptocurrency tax policy. Consult TRA directly or a qualified tax accountant for the most current guidance. Avoid acting on tax advice that could cause you legal problems.

question_sw: NSSF na PPSMB (PPF) — ni mifumo sawa ya pensheni Tanzania — je, mwajiri anachagua mmoja tu?
answer_sw: NSSF na PPF (Parastatal Pension Fund, inayoitwa pia PPSMB) ni mifumo TOFAUTI ya pensheni Tanzania. NSSF inahudumia wafanyakazi wa sekta ya kibinafsi hasa. PPF inahudumia wafanyakazi wa mashirika ya umma na baadhi ya mashirika ya kibinafsi. Kwa kawaida, mwajiri hawana chaguo — mfumo unategemea aina ya mwajiri (sekta ya umma vs kibinafsi). Angalia mwongozo wa serikali kwa biashara yako maalum.
question_en: NSSF and PPSMB (PPF) — are they the same pension system in Tanzania — does the employer just choose one?
answer_en: NSSF and PPF (Parastatal Pension Fund, also called PPSMB) are DIFFERENT pension systems in Tanzania. NSSF primarily serves private sector employees. PPF serves employees of public institutions and some private ones. Generally, an employer does not have a choice — the system depends on the type of employer (public vs private sector). Check government guidance for your specific type of business.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Ni wizara gani au idara gani inayotekeleza GN 487A?
answer_sw: GN 487A inatekelezwa na Idara ya Uhamiaji (Immigration Services Department) chini ya Wizara inayohusiana na uhamiaji. Operesheni ya utekelezaji wa kwanza rasmi ilifanywa na Idara ya Uhamiaji kati ya tarehe 11 Septemba 2025 hadi 8 Oktoba 2025. Wakati wa operesheni hii, wageni waliokutwa wakifanya biashara zilizozuiliwa walifungiwa biashara na kushuguhuliwa kisheria. Pia BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) inaweza kushiriki katika utekelezaji kwa upande wa leseni za biashara.
question_en: Which ministry or department enforces GN 487A?
answer_en: GN 487A is enforced by the Immigration Services Department under the relevant Ministry. The first official enforcement exercise was conducted by the Immigration Department between 11 September 2025 and 8 October 2025. During this exercise, non-citizens found operating prohibited businesses had their businesses closed and were dealt with legally. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) may also be involved in enforcement on the business licensing side.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Mtu anayeuza nyumba yake ya makazi Tanzania (si ya biashara) analipa kodi gani?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, mauzo ya nyumba ya makazi (residential property) na mmiliki anayeishi humo kwa muda mrefu inaweza kusamehewa kodi ya faida ya mtaji Tanzania — lakini masharti yanashikilia: iwe nyumba ya msingi ya makazi, mmiliki ameishi humo kwa muda wa kutosha. Ikiwa nyumba ni ya biashara au ni miongoni mwa mali nyingi za uwekezaji, faida ya mtaji inaweza kulipishwa kodi. Omba ushauri wa mwanasheria wa kodi kwa hali yako mahususi.
question_en: A person selling their residential home in Tanzania (not a business property) — what tax do they pay?
answer_en: Generally, the sale of a residential home by an owner who has lived there for a long period may be exempt from capital gains tax in Tanzania — but conditions apply: it must be a primary residence and the owner must have lived there for a sufficient period. If the home is a business property or one of many investment properties, capital gains may be taxed. Seek advice from a tax lawyer for your specific situation.

instruction: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi 60 -- ninahitaji kufanya nini zaidi ya usajili wa kawaida wa OSHA?
output: Usajili wa OSHA ni wa lazima kwa biashara yote. Kuhusu kama biashara yako ina wafanyakazi 60 inahitaji afisa maalum wa usalama -- thibitisha mahitaji haya moja kwa moja na OSHA (osha.go.tz) kwani kizingiti maalum cha wafanyakazi hakithibitishwi kutoka chanzo cha msingi. OSHA itakuelekeza mahitaji yanayotumika kwa ukubwa wa biashara yako.

question_sw: Riba na adhabu zinaendelea kukusanyika wakati wa mchakato wa pingamizi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Riba ya kisheria ya TRA na adhabu za ucheleweshaji zinaendelea kukusanyika kwenye kiasi kisicholipwa hata wakati pingamizi linaendelea. Hii inamaanisha kwamba hata kama pingamizi linashindwa, jumla ya deni linaweza kuwa kubwa zaidi kuliko tathmini ya awali kutokana na riba iliyokusanyika.
question_en: Do interest and penalties continue to accrue during the objection process — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. TRA statutory interest and late payment penalties continue to accrue on the unpaid amount even while an objection is in progress. This means that even if an objection eventually fails, the total debt may be significantly larger than the original assessment due to accrued interest.

question_sw: Kampuni iliyosimamishwa shughuli (dormant company) bado inalipa ada za kila mwaka kwa BRELA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni iliyosajiliwa Tanzania — hata kama haifanyi shughuli yoyote — bado inalazimika kuwasilisha ripoti ya kila mwaka (annual return) kwa BRELA ndani ya siku 42 baada ya siku ya kumbukumbu ya usajili. Kushindwa kuwasilisha kunaweza kusababisha adhabu au kampuni kufutwa orodha. Ikiwa huhitaji kampuni tena, ni bora kufuata mchakato rasmi wa kufuta (deregistration).
question_en: Does a dormant company still need to pay annual fees to BRELA?
answer_en: Yes. A registered Tanzania company — even if it conducts no activities — is still required to file an annual return to BRELA within 42 days of the anniversary of its registration date. Failure to file can result in penalties or the company being struck off the register. If you no longer need the company, it is better to follow the formal deregistration process.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Input VAT yangu ya mwezi ni TZS 2,000,000 na output VAT ni TZS 1,500,000 — nifanye nini?
output: Una hali ya VAT refund: output VAT (TZS 1,500,000) ni ndogo kuliko input VAT (TZS 2,000,000). Tofauti ya TZS 500,000 ni refund inayostahiki kutoka TRA. Jinsi ya kufanya: (1) Wasilisha VAT return yako ya kawaida tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata ukionyesha tofauti ya refund; (2) Omba rasmi refund au uomba izidishiwe kwa miezi ijayo; (3) TRA itakagua madai — kuna taratibu za ukaguzi. Biashara za exports (zero-rated) mara nyingi zina input VAT zaidi — refund ni haki ya kawaida ya kisheria. TRA ina muda wa miezi 6 wa kisheria kukusaidia. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: WHT inatekelezwa vipi kwenye makubaliano ya DTA (Double Taxation Agreement)?
answer_sw: Mikataba ya DTA inaweza kupunguza kiwango cha WHT kwa malipo kati ya nchi mbili zilizoingia mkataba. Tanzania ina DTA na nchi kadhaa. Kampuni inayofanya malipo kwa mpokeaji katika nchi yenye DTA na Tanzania inaweza kutumia kiwango cha chini cha DTA badala ya kiwango cha kawaida cha Tanzania — ikiwa hali zote za DTA zinatimizwa.
question_en: How does a Double Taxation Agreement (DTA) affect WHT?
answer_en: A DTA can reduce the WHT rate on payments between two treaty countries. Tanzania has DTAs with several countries. A company making payments to a recipient in a country that has a DTA with Tanzania may apply the lower DTA rate instead of Tanzania's standard rate — provided all DTA conditions are met.

instruction: Kufunga kampuni Tanzania — mchakato ni upi?
output: Kufunga kampuni rasmi (winding up/striking off) ni mchakato rasmi kupitia BRELA. Aina mbili: (1) Striking off — kampuni ndogo isiyofanya biashara inaweza kuomba kufutwa na BRELA; (2) Winding up — kufunga kampuni yenye madeni au michakato ya kibiashara, inayohitaji mwanasheria. Katika hali zote mbili, lazima kodi zote zilipwe kwanza na TRA ithibitishe kutokuwa na madeni ya kodi. Wasiliana na mwanasheria na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa utaratibu kamili.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kulipa mshahara wa chini mdogo kama mfanyakazi amekubali maandikoni?
answer_sw: Hapana. Makubaliano ya maandishi hayawezi kupunguza haki ya kisheria ya mshahara wa chini. GN 605A ni sheria ya lazima — hata kama mfanyakazi ametia sahihi makubaliano ya kulipwa kidogo, makubaliano hayo si ya kisheria. Mwajiri bado ana wajibu wa kisheria.
question_en: Can an employer pay below minimum wage if the employee agreed in writing?
answer_en: No. A written agreement cannot waive the statutory minimum wage entitlement. GN 605A is mandatory law — even if an employee has signed an agreement to receive less, that agreement is void. The employer still has a legal obligation.

question_sw: EFD inaathiriwa na mabadiliko ya VAT ya asilimia 16 ya mauzo ya kidijitali B2C iliyoanza Septemba 2025 Tanzania?
answer_sw: B2C e-payment VAT ya asilimia 16 (ikilinganishwa na kiwango cha kawaida cha 18%) ni utaratibu tofauti unaohusiana na mauzo ya kidijitali. Sheria za utekelezaji bado zinasubiriwa kutoka kwa Kamishna Mkuu. Biashara za mtandaoni zinazotumia EFD lazima zifuate mwongozo wa TRA mara utakapotolewa kuhusu jinsi EFD itakavyo kushughulikia kiwango kipya cha asilimia 16 kwa muamala wa B2C.
question_en: Is an EFD affected by the 16% B2C digital sales VAT that started in September 2025 in Tanzania?
answer_en: The B2C e-payment VAT at 16% (compared to the standard 18%) is a separate arrangement related to digital sales. Implementation rules are still awaited from the Commissioner General. Online businesses using EFDs must follow TRA guidance when issued on how the EFD will handle the new 16% rate for B2C transactions.
next_review_trigger: TRA B2C e-payment VAT implementation update

question_sw: Biashara ya usafirishaji wa Uber/Bolt Tanzania — VAT inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Huduma za usafirishaji wa kidijitali kama Uber na Bolt zinachukuliwa kama huduma za biashara zinazostahili VAT Tanzania. Kama mtoaji wa huduma amefika kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6), lazima asajiliwe na ikusanye VAT. Hata hivyo, masharti maalum ya makampuni ya kidijitali ya kimataifa yanategemea muundo wao wa biashara Tanzania.
question_en: Ride-hailing business like Uber/Bolt in Tanzania — does VAT apply?
answer_en: Yes. Digital transport services like Uber and Bolt are treated as business services subject to Tanzania VAT. If the service provider has reached the VAT registration threshold (TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6 months), they must register and collect VAT. However, specific requirements for international digital companies depend on their Tanzania business structure.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

instruction: VAT ya Tanzania ni 18% au kuna viwango vingine?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kwa manunuzi ya kawaida ya biashara yako: 18%. Kwa mauzo yako ya nje (exports): 0% — unaweza kudai rejareja ya VAT uliyo nayo. Kwa malipo ya kidijitali ya B2C kuanzia Sep 2025: 16% — kanuni za utekelezaji zinasubiriwa.

question_sw: Je, 'gross wage' kwa NSSF ni sawa na 'gross salary' kwenye payslip?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla ndiyo — mshahara mkubwa wa jumla (gross wage) kwa NSSF ni jumla ya malipo yote ya mfanyakazi kabla ya makato: mshahara wa msingi, posho za kawaida, overtime, na malipo mengine yanayolipwa kawaida. Si jumla ya aina yoyote ya malipo ya pekee au reimbursements. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya gross wage. Msingi huu ni tofauti na 'basic salary' — NSSF haihesabiwi kwa mshahara wa msingi peke yake.
question_en: Is 'gross wage' for NSSF the same as 'gross salary' on the payslip?
answer_en: Generally yes — gross wage for NSSF is the total of all regular employee payments before deductions: basic salary, regular allowances, overtime, and other regularly paid components. It does not include one-off special payments or reimbursements. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. This base differs from 'basic salary' — NSSF is not calculated on basic salary alone.

question_sw: Mtu anasema SDL ni 4% ya mishahara — ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha SDL ni 3.5% — si 4%. Angalau hadi Sheria ya Fedha inayofuata kuibadilisha, mwajiri analipa asilimia tatu nukta tano (3.5%) ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi wake.
question_en: Someone says SDL is 4% of payroll — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The SDL rate is 3.5% — not 4%. At least until the next Finance Act changes it, the employer pays three point five percent (3.5%) of total employee payroll.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Je, elimu Tanzania inalipwa VAT?
answer_sw: Huduma za elimu rasmi (shule, vyuo) nyingi Tanzania zimesamehewa VAT (VAT exempt). Hii inamaanisha hazilipwi VAT, lakini taasisi ya elimu haiwezi kudai input VAT kwenye gharama zake. Mafunzo ya biashara ya biashara (commercial training) yanaweza kutozwa VAT ya asilimia 18. Angalia hali ya kila aina ya huduma ya elimu na TRA. Hakuna kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 5 kwa elimu.
question_en: Are educational services subject to VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: Most formal educational services (schools, colleges) in Tanzania are VAT exempt. This means they are not subject to VAT, but the institution cannot claim input VAT on its costs. Commercial training services may be subject to standard 18% VAT. Check the status of each type of educational service with TRA. There is no 5% VAT rate for education.

instruction: Naweza kuondoa mfanyakazi kwenye NSSF kama ameomba?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hapana — mfanyakazi hawezi kuomba kutokuwa na NSSF. NSSF ni ya lazima (mandatory) kwa wafanyakazi wote. Hata kama mfanyakazi ana pension nyingine ya kibinafsi, bado analipa NSSF. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kuripoti na kulipa NSSF kwa kila mfanyakazi.

question_sw: Je, Tanzania ina kodi ya urithi (inheritance tax)?
answer_sw: Kodi ya urithi (inheritance tax) ni suala maalum la kisheria na kodi linalozidi upeo wangu wa sasa. Ninashughulikia kodi za kawaida za biashara: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD. Kwa maswali ya kodi ya urithi au kodi za mali zilizopitishwa, wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyesajiliwa au TRA moja kwa moja. Hili linahitaji ushauri wa kitaalamu.
question_en: Does Tanzania have an inheritance tax?
answer_en: Inheritance tax is a specialised legal and tax matter beyond my current scope. I handle routine business taxes: VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, EFD. For inheritance tax or estate transfer tax questions, contact a registered tax consultant or TRA directly. This requires professional advice.

question_sw: Viwango vya mchango wa NSSF kwa mwajiri na mfanyakazi ni vipi?
answer_sw: Viwango vya NSSF nchini Tanzania ni: Mwajiri: asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa jumla (gross salary) wa mfanyakazi. Mfanyakazi: asilimia 10 ya mshahara wake wa jumla. Jumla ya mchango: asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa jumla kila mwezi. Mwajiri anakata mchango wa mfanyakazi kutoka mshahara na anachangia sehemu yake mwenyewe, kisha anapeleka jumla (asilimia 20) kwa NSSF. Thibitisha viwango vya sasa na NSSF kwenye nssf.go.tz.
question_en: What are the NSSF contribution rates for employer and employee?
answer_en: NSSF contribution rates in Tanzania are: Employer: 10% of the employee's gross salary. Employee: 10% of their own gross salary. Total contribution: 20% of gross salary per month. The employer deducts the employee's share from their salary and adds their own contribution, then remits the combined 20% to NSSF. Confirm current rates with NSSF at nssf.go.tz.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.go.tz before training

question_sw: Annual return ya BRELA inawasilishwa kila mwaka hata kama kampuni haifanyi biashara?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Annual return ya BRELA inawasilishwa KILA MWAKA bila kujali kama kampuni inafanya biashara au la — hata kama iko dormant. Kampuni dormant inaweza kutangaza hali yake lakini bado ina wajibu wa kuwasilisha annual return. Kutofanya hivyo kunasababisha faini na hatimaye kufutwa.
question_en: Is the BRELA annual return filed every year even if the company is not trading?
answer_en: Yes. The BRELA annual return is filed EVERY YEAR regardless of whether the company is trading or not — even if dormant. A dormant company can declare its status but still has an obligation to file an annual return. Failure to do so results in penalties and eventual strike off.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Wateja wangu wanalipa kwa njia nyingi — taslimu, M-Pesa, na kadi. EFD inavyofanya kazi kwa kila moja?
output: Malipo ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) yanahitaji risiti ya EFD kama malipo ya kawaida. Njia ya malipo haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti — kila muamala wa mauzo lazima upate risiti ya EFD. EFD ya kisasa inasaidia kurekodi aina tofauti za malipo: Taslimu → chagua 'Cash' kwenye EFD. M-Pesa/Tigo Pesa/Airtel Money → chagua 'Mobile Money'. Kadi ya benki → chagua 'Card/Electronic'. Kila aina inapata risiti yake ya EFD inayoonyesha njia ya malipo.

question_sw: Kwa nini lazima nilipe 1/3 ya kodi inayodaiwa kabla ya pingamizi kukubaliwa?
answer_sw: Malipo ya 1/3 ni sharti la kisheria linalozuia matumizi mabaya ya mchakato wa pingamizi. Inahakikisha kwamba wadai wa kodi wana nia ya kweli na wanaweza kulipa sehemu ya deni lao. Sehemu iliyolipwa inaweza kurudishwa ikiwa pingamizi linafanikiwa au inakuwa mkopo dhidi ya tathmini iliyorekebishwa.
question_en: Why must I pay 1/3 of the disputed tax before an objection is accepted?
answer_en: The 1/3 payment is a legal requirement that prevents abuse of the objection process. It ensures that tax disputers have genuine intent and ability to pay part of their liability. The amount paid can be refunded if the objection succeeds or credited against a revised assessment.

question_sw: Mapato ya kilimo ya mkulima binafsi — yanalazimu kodi ya mapato Tanzania?
answer_sw: Matibabu ya kodi ya mapato ya kilimo Tanzania ni ngumu na yanategemea kiwango cha mapato na muundo wa biashara. Wakulima wadogo wanaweza kuwa na hali tofauti na wazalishaji wakubwa wa kibiashara. Sina uhakika wa masharti ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA kuhusu hali yako maalum ya kilimo.
question_en: Does a private farmer's agricultural income require income tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: The income tax treatment of agricultural income in Tanzania is complex and depends on income levels and business structure. Smallholder farmers may have different treatment than large commercial producers. I am not certain of current rules. Verify with TRA about your specific farming situation.

question_sw: Mhandisi ana ofisi ya kibinafsi na pia ana kazi ya mshahara serikalini. Je, anahitaji kusajili VAT kwa ofisi yake binafsi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — hata kama mhandisi ana kazi ya mshahara serikalini, ofisi yake ya kibinafsi (consultancy) inastahili usajili wa VAT kwa sababu ana leseni ya kitaalamu ya ERB. Shughuli mbili tofauti: kazi ya mshahara (kodi inazingatiwa na mwajiri) na ofisi binafsi (lazima asimamie mwenyewe kodi ikiwa ni pamoja na VAT). Mapato yote ya ofisi binafsi lazima yaorodheshwe kwa TRA.
question_en: An engineer has a private office and also salaried government employment. Do they need to register for VAT for their private office?
answer_en: Yes — even if an engineer is salaried in government, their private office (consultancy) requires VAT registration because they hold an ERB professional licence. Two separate activities: salaried employment (tax managed by employer) and private office (must manage own taxes including VAT). All private office income must be declared to TRA.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kulipa kodi zangu za TRA kwa Bitcoin?
answer_sw: Hapana. TRA haipokei malipo kwa Bitcoin au sarafu zingine za kidijitali hadi Juni 2026. Malipo ya kodi ya TRA yanakubaliwa kwa: akaunti ya benki (TISS), simu za mkononi (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa), au duka la benki/TRA. Kwa maswali ya jinsi ya kulipa kodi za TRA, tembelea tra.go.tz au ofisi yoyote ya TRA.
question_en: Can I pay my TRA taxes using Bitcoin?
answer_en: No. TRA does not accept Bitcoin or other digital currencies as payment as of June 2026. TRA tax payments are accepted via: bank account (TISS), mobile money (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa), or bank/TRA branch. For information on how to pay TRA taxes, visit tra.go.tz or any TRA office.

question_sw: SDL inahusu nini hasa? Niambie wazi.
answer_sw: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — ni kodi inayolipwa na waajiri kwa TRA kwa lengo la kufadhili mafunzo ya kitaaluma na ukuzaji wa ujuzi nchini Tanzania. Si likizo ya ulemavu, si huduma ya utoaji, si kitu kingine chochote zaidi ya kodi ya kukuza ujuzi. Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla.
question_en: What exactly is SDL? Tell me clearly.
answer_en: SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is a levy paid by employers to TRA to fund vocational training and skills development in Tanzania. It is not disability leave, not service delivery, not anything else — it is strictly a skills development levy. Rate: 3.5% of gross payroll.

question_sw: Ninauza mchanga na mawe kwa ajili ya ujenzi — kuna kodi maalum ya rasilimali za ardhi?
answer_sw: Kodi na tozo zinazohusiana na uchimbaji na uuzaji wa rasilimali za ardhi (mchanga, mawe, kokoto) ni eneo la kisheria la madini na mazingira — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Shughuli hizi zinasimamiwa na Wizara ya Madini, NEMC (National Environment Management Council), na serikali za mitaa ambazo zinaweza kutoza ada na ushuru maalum. Wasiliana na mamlaka hizi moja kwa moja.
question_en: I sell sand and stones for construction — is there a special natural resources tax?
answer_en: Taxes and levies related to extraction and sale of natural resources (sand, stones, gravel) are a legal area of mining and environment law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. These activities are regulated by the Ministry of Minerals, NEMC (National Environment Management Council), and local governments which may charge special fees and levies. Contact these authorities directly.
next_review_trigger: Mining or natural resources regulation changes

question_sw: Mfanyakazi alifanya kazi Tanzania, kisha Kenya, kisha Tanzania tena — akaunti ya NSSF inafanya kazi vipi?
answer_sw: Akaunti ya NSSF ya Tanzania inabaki pale mfanyakazi anapoondoka Tanzania. Michango iliyolipwa kabla ya kuondoka inabaki. Wakati mfanyakazi anarudi Tanzania na kuajiriwa tena, anaendelea na namba ile ile ya NSSF na akaunti yake ya awali. Hata hivyo, miezi ya kufanya kazi Kenya haijumuishwi katika hesabu ya miezi ya michango ya NSSF ya Tanzania. Kwa mwongozo wa hali hii, wasiliana na NSSF.
question_en: An employee worked in Tanzania, then Kenya, then Tanzania again — how does the NSSF account work?
answer_en: The Tanzania NSSF account remains when an employee leaves Tanzania. Contributions made before leaving remain in the account. When the employee returns to Tanzania and is re-employed, they continue with the same NSSF number and their original account. However, months worked in Kenya do not count towards Tanzania NSSF contribution months. For guidance on this situation, contact NSSF.

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya malipo ya bidhaa kwa serikali Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Malipo ya bidhaa zinazotolewa kwa serikali na taasisi zake yanastahili kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 2 ya malipo ghafi. Hii inashughulikia wazabuni wote wanaouza bidhaa kwa serikali. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What withholding tax applies to payments for goods supplied to the government in Tanzania?
answer_en: Payments for goods supplied to the government and its institutions are subject to 2% withholding tax on gross payment. This applies to all suppliers selling goods to government entities. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni anapata mshahara wa USD 5,000 kwa mwezi — PAYE inahesabiwa kwa USD au TZS?
answer_sw: PAYE inahesabiwa na kulipwa TRA kwa Shilingi za Tanzania (TZS). Mshahara wa USD lazima ubadilishwe kuwa TZS kwa kiwango cha ubadilishaji cha siku ya malipo (au kiwango kilichoidhinishwa na TRA). Kisha viwango vya PAYE vya Tanzania vinatumika kwa kiasi cha TZS.
question_en: A foreign employee receives a salary of USD 5,000 per month — is PAYE calculated in USD or TZS?
answer_en: PAYE is calculated and paid to TRA in Tanzanian Shillings (TZS). A USD salary must be converted to TZS at the exchange rate on the payment date (or a TRA-approved rate). Tanzania's PAYE bands are then applied to the TZS amount.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: mfanyakazi analipa TZS 35,832; mwajiri analipa TZS 35,832 pia. Jumlisha: mchango wote wa NSSF ni TZS 71,664 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF calculated on the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated at 20% of gross wage (10% employer + 10% employee). On the TZS 358,322 average minimum wage: employee pays TZS 35,832; employer pays TZS 35,832. Total NSSF contribution: TZS 71,664 per month. Confirm with NSSF.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or NSSF Act amendment

question_sw: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta ngapi?
answer_sw: GN 605A inashughulikia sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46 za sekta ya faragha Tanzania Bara. Kila sekta ina kiwango chake cha mshahara wa chini kulingana na mazingira ya kazi. Thibitisha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: How many sectors does GN 605A cover?
answer_en: GN 605A covers 16 sectors and 46 sub-sectors of the private sector in Tanzania Mainland. Each sector has its own minimum wage level based on working conditions. Confirm your sector with MLYWF.

question_sw: NSSF inanipatia nini mimi kama mfanyakazi baadaye?
answer_sw: NSSF inatoa mafao (benefits) mbalimbali kwa wanachama wake: Pensheni ya uzee (retirement pension) — ukifikia umri wa kustaafu. Mafao ya ulemavu (invalidity pension) — ukiwa huwezi kufanya kazi kwa ulemavu. Mafao ya mlezi (survivors pension) — kwa familia yako ukifa. Mafao ya mazishi (funeral grant) — msaada wa mazishi. Mafao ya uzazi (maternity benefit) — kwa wanawake wajawazito wanaohitimu. Kiasi cha mafao kinategemea michango yako na muda wa uanachama wako. Thibitisha mafao ya sasa na NSSF kwenye nssf.go.tz.
question_en: What benefits does NSSF give me as an employee in the future?
answer_en: NSSF provides various benefits to its members: Retirement pension — when you reach retirement age. Invalidity pension — if you become unable to work due to disability. Survivors pension — for your family if you pass away. Funeral grant — assistance with burial costs. Maternity benefit — for qualifying pregnant women members. The amount of benefits depends on your contributions and length of membership. Confirm current benefits with NSSF at nssf.go.tz.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.go.tz before training

question_sw: Wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi (casual workers) wanalipa NSSF Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wanaolipwa mishahara, ikiwemo casual workers, wanastahili kulipa NSSF. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Msingi wa hesabu ni mshahara mkubwa wa jumla (gross wage) — si mshahara wa msingi (basic salary). Tarehe ya mwisho wa malipo: ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwezi wa mshahara.
question_en: Do casual workers pay NSSF in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Workers who receive wages, including casual workers, are eligible to contribute to NSSF. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. The calculation base is total gross wage — not basic salary. Payment deadline: within one month after the salary month.

instruction: Nafanya biashara ya kuuza nguo kwa jina langu mwenyewe — nihitaji kusajili BRELA?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Ada ya usajili wa biashara ya jina (business name) ni ndogo — tembelea brela.go.tz kwa ada na fomu sahihi.

instruction: Pension yangu kutoka Uingereza — inalipiwa kodi Tanzania ikiwa ninaishi hapa?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi ya pensheni inayotoka nje ya nchi kwa mtu anayeishi Tanzania ni mada inayohusisha DTA, hali ya ukazi (residency status), na Income Tax Act — hizi ni nyanja za kisheria za kodi ya kimataifa nje ya wigo wangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA kwa biashara za kawaida. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi wa kimataifa au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Safety officer anafanya nini hasa na ana sifa gani?
output: Afisa usalama (safety officer) anahitajika: Sekta ya jumla: wafanyakazi 50 au zaidi. Sekta ya ujenzi: wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi. Majukumu ya safety officer: (1) Ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara wa mahali pa kazi. (2) Kutoa mafunzo ya usalama kwa wafanyakazi. (3) Kuandika na kusambaza ripoti za ajali na hatari. (4) Kuhakikisha vifaa vya usalama (PPE) vinatumika. (5) Kuwasiliana na OSHA kuhusu ukaguzi na taarifa. Sifa: mafunzo ya usalama na afya mahali pa kazi (yanatolewa na OSHA na taasisi zilizoidhinishwa).

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa ndani ya muda gani baada ya mwisho wa mwezi?
answer_sw: Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12, mchango wa NSSF unapaswa kulipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja (within one month) baada ya mwisho wa mwezi husika. Thibitisha tarehe halisi na NSSF kwani sheria inaweza kusomwa tofauti na mazoea ya vitendo.
question_en: Within what period must NSSF contributions be paid after the end of the month?
answer_en: Under the NSSF Act Section 12, contributions must be paid within one month after the end of the relevant month. Confirm the exact deadline with NSSF as the law may be interpreted differently from practical arrangements.

question_sw: Adhabu ya mwajiri asiyekata PAYE ya mfanyakazi mgeni ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri asiyekata PAYE ya mfanyakazi (raia au mgeni) anakabiliwa na: (1) Adhabu ya 2.5% ya kila mwezi juu ya kiasi kilichokosekana; (2) Riba inayoendelea; (3) TRA inaweza kufanya ukaguzi na kudai PAYE na adhabu zote. Mwajiri anaweza pia kuwa liable kibinafsi kwa PAYE isiyolipwa — hata kama mfanyakazi ameshaacha kazi.
question_en: What is the penalty for an employer who fails to deduct PAYE for a foreign employee?
answer_en: An employer who fails to deduct PAYE for any employee (citizen or foreign) faces: (1) A 2.5% penalty per month on the shortfall; (2) Ongoing interest; (3) TRA may audit and claim all PAYE and penalties due. The employer can also be personally liable for unpaid PAYE — even after the employee has left.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

instruction: Ninataka kuuza jengo langu la biashara Tanzania — capital gains tax inahesabiwaje?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa mali kama ardhi, hisa, au majengo inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania. Hesabu halisi inategemea thamani ya ununuzi (cost base), thamani ya uuzaji, na hali yako kama mkazi au asiye mkazi. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Uhesabuji wa capital gains tax kwa mali za biashara unashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act na unahitaji tathmini maalum ya thamani ya mali na gharama za msingi. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Wateja wangu wanakataa risiti ya EFD. Je, lazima nitoe hata hivyo?
output: Ndiyo, lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala, hata kama mteja anakataa au haipendi. Wajibu wa kutoa risiti ni wa biashara — si wa mteja kukubali. Kama mteja atakataa, bado rekodi ya muamala lazima ibaki kwenye mfumo wa EFD. TRA haikusamehe kwa msingi wa mteja kukataa. Toa risiti na ieleze mteja umuhimu wake.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Ninaweza kukataa ombi la mteja kuzuia VAT kwenye invoice yangu?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali ya mteja wako. Kama mteja ni 'qualifying buyer' (serikali, taasisi ya serikali, au wakala aliyeteuliwa na TRA) — hana chaguo: wana wajibu wa kisheria wa kuzuia VAT. Huwezi kuwakatalia kisheria kuzuia VAT wanapostahili kufanya hivyo. Kama mteja ni kampuni ya kawaida isiyokuwa 'qualifying buyer' — hawana haki ya kuzuia VAT na unaomba kwamba walipe VAT kamili.
question_en: Can I refuse a client's request to withhold VAT on my invoice?
answer_en: It depends on your client's status. If the client is a 'qualifying buyer' (government, government institution, or TRA-designated agent) — there is no choice: they have a legal obligation to withhold VAT. You cannot legally prevent them from withholding VAT when they are required to do so. If the client is an ordinary company that is not a 'qualifying buyer' — they have no right to withhold VAT and you should ask them to pay VAT in full.

question_sw: Gari la biashara lililonunuliwa kampuni — input VAT yake inaweza kudaiwa?
answer_sw: Inategemea matumizi ya gari. Magari yanayotumika kwa biashara (transport ya biashara, delivery vans, lorries) — input VAT yake kwa ujumla inaweza kudaiwa. Magari ya abiria (passenger cars) yanayotumika kwa wasimamizi binafsi — mara nyingi hayadaiwi input VAT Tanzania. TRA ina kanuni maalum kuhusu madai ya input VAT kwa magari — thibitisha na mshauri.
question_en: A company car purchased by the company — can input VAT be claimed?
answer_en: It depends on the vehicle's use. Vehicles used for business purposes (business transport, delivery vans, lorries) — input VAT can generally be claimed. Passenger cars used by individual executives — often input VAT is not claimable in Tanzania. TRA has specific rules on vehicle input VAT claims — verify with an advisor.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: EFD machine inanunuliwa wapi Tanzania — mwajiri ananunua wenyewe au TRA inatoa?
answer_sw: MWAJIRI (biashara) ndiye anayenunua EFD — TRA haitoi mashine bure. Mashine lazima inunuliwe kutoka kwa wasambazaji wa EFD walioidhinishwa na TRA. Wasambazaji walioidhinishwa wanajulikana kwenye tovuti ya TRA. Kununua EFD kutoka chanzo kisichoidhinishwa ni kosa — mashine lazima iwe kwenye mfumo wa TRA na iwe imesajiliwa ipasavyo kabla ya kuanza kutumia.
question_en: Where is an EFD machine purchased in Tanzania — does the employer buy it or does TRA provide it?
answer_en: The EMPLOYER (business) buys the EFD — TRA does not provide machines for free. The machine must be purchased from TRA-approved EFD suppliers. Approved suppliers are listed on the TRA website. Buying an EFD from an unapproved source is an offence — the machine must be on the TRA system and properly registered before starting to use it.

question_sw: NSSF inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: NSSF inacheswa kwa asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: mfanyakazi analipa TZS 35,832; mwajiri analipa TZS 35,832 pia. Jumlisha: mchango wote wa NSSF ni TZS 71,664 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF calculated on the GN 605A average minimum wage?
answer_en: NSSF is calculated at 20% of gross wage (10% employer + 10% employee). On the TZS 358,322 average minimum wage: employee pays TZS 35,832; employer pays TZS 35,832. Total NSSF contribution: TZS 71,664 per month. Confirm with NSSF.
next_review_trigger: New wage order or NSSF Act amendment

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi anaweza kuondoa mchangoa wake wa NSSF kabla ya kustaafu?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla hapana — michango ya NSSF haiwezi kuondolewa kabla ya kustaafu. Hata hivyo, kuna hali chache za kisheria ambazo zinaweza kuruhusu madai kabla ya wakati: kuwa na ulemavu mkubwa wa kudumu (permanent total disability), kifo cha mwanachama (ambapo mzigo unalipwa kwa wategemezi), au kuacha Tanzania kwa muda wa kudumu. Madai ya kawaida ya uchovu, msongo wa maisha, au tatizo la fedha hayatoi haki ya kuondoa kabla ya wakati. NSSF ni mfumo wa akiba ya muda mrefu — si akaunti ya benki inayoweza kufunguliwa wakati wowote.
answer_en: Generally no — NSSF contributions cannot be withdrawn before retirement. However, there are a few statutory circumstances that may allow early claims: permanent total disability, death of the member (in which case a survivor benefit is paid), or permanently leaving Tanzania. Ordinary claims of financial hardship, life pressures, or personal financial problems do not give a right to early withdrawal. NSSF is a long-term savings system — not a bank account that can be accessed at any time.
question_en: Can an employee withdraw their NSSF contributions before retirement?

instruction: TZS 200M kwa mwaka maana yake ni mauzaji mazuri — kama sijafika, sina wajibu?

question_sw: Mkurugenzi wa kampuni analazimika kulipa NSSF Tanzania?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali yake: mkurugenzi aliyeajiriwa rasmi (anayepokea mshahara wa mwezi) — NSSF inalazimika, asilimia 10 mwajiri + asilimia 10 mfanyakazi. Mkurugenzi asiye mfanyakazi wa wakati kamili (anapokea ada za mkurugenzi tu, si mshahara) — hapaswi NSSF; ada zake zinakata kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 15 badala yake. Thibitisha hali ya mkurugenzi wako na NSSF na TRA.
question_en: Is a company director required to pay NSSF contributions in Tanzania?
answer_en: It depends on their status: a director who is formally employed (receiving a monthly salary) — NSSF is mandatory, 10% employer + 10% employee. A non-full-time director (receiving only director fees, not a salary) — NSSF does not apply; their fees are subject to 15% withholding tax instead. Confirm your director classification with NSSF and TRA.

instruction: Nikiwa kumwajiri wafanyakazi, OSHA inataka nini kutoka kwangu mara tu?

Usisalie bila usajilishaji wa OSHA — adhabu zinaanza tangu siku ya kwanza ya ukiukwaji.
