question_sw: CPA wangu alisema hakuhitaji kusajili VAT kwa sababu ana wateja wachache. Anasema ukweli?
answer_sw: Hapana — CPA wako ana kosa. Kama CPA aliyesajiliwa na NBAA Tanzania, anahitajika kusajili VAT BILA KUJALI idadi ya wateja au kiasi cha mapato. Kizingiti cha TZS 200M kinachukulia biashara za kawaida — si fani zilizodhibitiwa kama uhasibu wa kitaalamu. CPA asiyesajili VAT anaweza kukabiliwa na adhabu za kodi na kupoteza leseni yake ya kitaalamu.
question_en: My CPA told me they don't need to register for VAT because they have few clients. Is that true?
answer_en: No — your CPA is mistaken. As a CPA registered with NBAA Tanzania, they are required to register for VAT REGARDLESS of the number of clients or amount of income. The TZS 200M threshold is for ordinary businesses — not for regulated professions like professional accounting. A CPA who fails to register for VAT may face tax penalties and risk losing their professional licence.

question_sw: Biashara inaweza kutumia programu ya kompyuta (software POS) badala ya EFD machine Tanzania?
answer_sw: TRA Tanzania inazidi kukubali mifumo ya software ya POS (Virtual EFD/Electronic Fiscal Receipt) kama mbadala wa EFD za kawaida za vifaa (hardware) katika hali fulani. Mfumo wa software lazima uidhiniwe na TRA na uunganishwe na mfumo wa TRA moja kwa moja. Usitumie programu yoyote ya POS bila uthibitisho kwamba imeidhinishwa na TRA — angalia TRA kwa hali ya sasa ya mifumo iliyoidhinishwa.
question_en: Can a business use a computer software (POS system) instead of an EFD machine in Tanzania?
answer_en: TRA Tanzania is increasingly accepting software POS systems (Virtual EFD/Electronic Fiscal Receipt) as alternatives to traditional hardware EFDs in certain situations. The software system must be TRA-approved and connected directly to TRA's system. Do not use any POS software without confirming it is TRA-approved — check TRA for the current list of approved systems.
next_review_trigger: TRA virtual EFD or software POS approval update

question_sw: Kiwango cha WHT kwa gawio (dividends) kwa wakazi ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa gawio kwa wakazi wa Tanzania ni asilimia 10. Kwa wasio wakazi, kiwango pia ni asilimia 10. Mwajiri au kampuni inayotoa gawio inalazimika kukata WHT kabla ya kulipa mpokeaji.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on dividends for residents?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on dividends for Tanzania residents is 10%. For non-residents the rate is also 10%. The paying company must deduct WHT before remitting dividends to the recipient.

question_sw: Kiwango cha VAT nchini Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT nchini Tanzania ni asilimia 18, kulingana na TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority). Kama biashara yako inauza bidhaa au kutoa huduma zinazolipwa VAT, lazima uongeze asilimia 18 juu ya bei ya mauzo yako na ukusanye kodi hiyo kwa niaba ya serikali. Kumbuka: Kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025, kiwango cha VAT kwa malipo ya kidijitali ya B2C ni asilimia 16, lakini bado linasubiri tangazo rasmi la Kamishna Mkuu. Thibitisha na TRA kwa sababu kiwango cha VAT kinaweza kubadilika baada ya Finance Act ya kila mwaka.
question_en: What is the VAT rate in Tanzania?
answer_en: The standard VAT rate in Tanzania is 18%, as set by the Tanzania Revenue Authority (TRA). If your business sells goods or provides services subject to VAT, you must add 18% on top of your sale price and collect that tax on behalf of the government. Note: From 1 September 2025, the B2C digital payment VAT rate is 16%, pending CG implementation notice. Confirm with TRA for the latest information.

question_sw: Je, TZS 10M (mgeni) au TZS 5M (msaidizi) zinahusu kila mwaka au mara moja tu?
answer_sw: Faini zinazotolewa na GN 487A ni kwa KESI MOJA — si kila mwaka. Kila wakati mgeni anapokamatwa na kupatikana na hatia, analipa faini ya angalau TZS 10M kwa kesi hiyo. Biashara haramu inayoendelea bila kukaguliwa haiongezi faini kiotomatiki — lakini kila kamatwa na hukumu ni adhabu mpya tofauti.
question_en: Are the TZS 10M (non-citizen) or TZS 5M (facilitator) penalties charged annually or just once?
answer_en: The GN 487A penalties are per CASE — not annually. Each time a non-citizen is arrested and found guilty they pay a fine of at least TZS 10M for that case. A prohibited business continuing to operate without being caught does not automatically accumulate fines — but each arrest and conviction is a fresh separate penalty.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Je, mwajiri analazimika kusajili mfanyakazi mpya kwa NSSF mara moja?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mwajiri analazimika kusajili mfanyakazi mpya kwa NSSF ndani ya mwezi wa kwanza wa ajira. Usajili wa NSSF lazima ufanyike kabla au wakati wa malipo ya kwanza ya mshahara. Kuchelewa kusajili kunaweza kusababisha adhabu. Mfanyakazi mpya anapewa namba ya NSSF ambayo inatumika kwa ajira zake zote za baadaye Tanzania.
question_en: Is an employer required to register a new employee with NSSF immediately?
answer_en: Yes. An employer must register a new employee with NSSF within the first month of employment. NSSF registration must occur before or at the time of the first salary payment. Delayed registration may result in penalties. The new employee is given an NSSF number that is used for all their future employment in Tanzania.

question_sw: Kiwango cha chini cha SDL ni wafanyakazi wangapi? Na Zanzibar inajumuishwa?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha chini cha SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi kwenye Tanzania Bara (Mainland Tanzania). Zanzibar ina mamlaka yake ya ushuru na sheria tofauti. SDL ya TRA (Mainland) haitumiki kwa Zanzibar. Waajiri wa Zanzibar wanahitaji kushauriana na Zanzibar Revenue Authority (ZRA).
question_en: What is the minimum employee threshold for SDL? And is Zanzibar included?
answer_en: The minimum threshold for SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — is 10 or more employees on Mainland Tanzania. Zanzibar has its own tax authority and different laws. TRA's SDL (Mainland) does not apply to Zanzibar. Zanzibar-based employers should consult the Zanzibar Revenue Authority (ZRA).

instruction: Mgeni anaweza kufanya biashara ya uchapishaji (printing business) Tanzania?
output: GN 487A inakataza shughuli 15 kwa wasio raia Tanzania. Uchapishaji (printing) ni moja ya shughuli zilizoorodheshwa kwenye marufuku ya GN 487A. Mgeni hawezi kuendesha biashara ya uchapishaji Tanzania Bara. Chaguzi: mwekezaji mgeni anaweza kuweka mtaji na kushirikiana na raia wa Tanzania ambaye ndiye mwendeshaji rasmi wa biashara ya uchapishaji. Adhabu: faini ya TZS 10M na/au kifungo cha miezi 6, pamoja na kufutwa kwa visa.

question_sw: Mgeni anafanya biashara ya kuuza bidhaa za mikono ya pili (second-hand goods). Je, hii imekatazwa?
answer_sw: Biashara ya bidhaa za mitumba haikutajwa moja kwa moja kama kategoria tofauti katika Ratiba ya GN 487A. Hata hivyo, kuuza bidhaa za mitumba madukani au masokoni kwa njia ya rejareja au jumla kunaweza kuangukia chini ya Kategoria 1 'Biashara ya kuuza bidhaa kwa jumla na rejareja' — ambayo IMEkatazwa wazi. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa hali yako mahususi. Wageni wanaouza nguo za pili mkono, vifaa vya nyumbani vya pili mkono, au bidhaa nyingine za pili kwenye masoko au madukani wanakiuka GN 487A. Thibitisha kategoria kamili kwenye tovuti ya TanzLII au Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: A non-citizen trades second-hand goods. Is this prohibited?
answer_en: Second-hand goods trading is not explicitly named as a separate category in the GN 487A Schedule. However, selling second-hand goods in retail stores or wholesale may fall under Category 1 'The business of sale of goods on a wholesale and retail basis' — which IS explicitly prohibited. If you are selling used goods in a shop or market stall in retail or wholesale format, this is likely covered under Category 1. Verify with the Immigration Department for your specific situation. Non-citizens selling second-hand clothes, second-hand household goods, or other used items at markets or shops are violating GN 487A. Verify the complete category list at TanzLII or the Immigration Department website.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A prohibited category list

question_sw: Ninaajiri watu 5 wa nusu muda. Je, NSSF inatumika kwao?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi 5 wa nusu muda wanaolipwa mishahara wanalazimika kulipwa NSSF. Kiwango: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla wa kila mfanyakazi. Hata hivyo, kama wote 5 ni wa nusu muda na hauna wafanyakazi wengine, huhitajiwi SDL kwa sababu una wafanyakazi chini ya 10 (SDL inahitaji wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi). NSSF inatumika bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi.
question_en: I employ 5 part-time workers. Does NSSF apply to them?
answer_en: Yes. 5 part-time workers who receive wages must have NSSF paid for them. Rate: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of each employee's gross wage. However, if all 5 are part-time and you have no other employees, you are not required to pay SDL because you have fewer than 10 employees (SDL requires 10 or more). NSSF applies regardless of the number of employees.

question_sw: OSHA na WCF — vinahusu usalama wa kazi lakini ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): inasimamia USALAMA mahali pa kazi — ukaguzi wa mahali pa kazi, mafunzo ya usalama, usajili wa mwajiri wa OSHA. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): inatoa FIDIA ya pesa kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini. OSHA = kuzuia ajali; WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali. Ni taasisi mbili tofauti lakini zinafanya kazi pamoja katika kuzuia na kukabiliana na ajali za kazi.
question_en: OSHA and WCF — both related to workplace safety but what is the difference?
answer_en: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): oversees WORKPLACE SAFETY — workplace inspections, safety training, employer OSHA registration. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): provides CASH COMPENSATION to injured workers. OSHA = accident prevention; WCF = paying compensation after an accident. They are two different institutions that work together in preventing and responding to workplace accidents.

question_sw: PAYE inarudishwa TRA kwa njia gani?
answer_sw: PAYE inarudishwa kupitia mfumo wa IDRAS (TRA Taxpayer Portal) mtandaoni. Mwajiri anaingiza return ya mwezi na kisha kulipa kupitia GePG au benki iliyoidhinishwa. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: How is PAYE remitted to TRA?
answer_en: PAYE is remitted through the IDRAS (TRA Taxpayer Portal) online system. The employer files a monthly return and pays through GePG or an approved bank. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Wakala wa zuio (withholding agent) ni nani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Wakala wa zuio ni mtu anayehitajika kisheria kukata kodi ya zuio kutoka kwa malipo anayofanya. Wakala wa zuio ni: serikali na taasisi zake, makampuni, na watu binafsi waliotajwa na sheria. Wakala anapaswa kusajiliwa TRA na kulipa ndani ya siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Who is a withholding agent in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding agent is a person legally required to deduct withholding tax from payments they make. Withholding agents include: government and its institutions, companies, and specified individuals. The agent must be registered with TRA and pay within 7 days. Confirm with TRA.

instruction: Kiwango cha SDL ni asilimia ngapi na WCF ni asilimia ngapi — na zinalipwa wapi?
output:
Viwango na mahali pa kulipa:

SDL: asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya fedha — inalipwa TRA.
WCF: asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya fedha — inalipwa Mamlaka ya WCF (si TRA).

Zote mbili ni za mwajiri peke yake — hazikuatwi mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Kumbuka: kulipa WCF kwa TRA badala ya Mamlaka ya WCF hakukuridhisha wajibu wako wa WCF. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na Mamlaka ya WCF.

question_sw: Biashara ya kuhamisha pesa (money transfer) inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara ya kuhamisha pesa inahitaji leseni ya maalum kutoka Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BoT) chini ya Sheria ya Huduma za Malipo ya Mwaka 2015. Hii ni pamoja na: wakala wa kampuni kubwa ya pesa kama M-Pesa au Airtel Money (wanayohitaji idhini ya kampuni mama), au mwenye leseni wa kujitegemea wa huduma za malipo. Leseni za BoT ni za aina nyingi — thibitisha aina ya huduma unayotaka kutoa. GN 487A (Julai 2025) pia inapiga marufuku raia wasio Watanzania kufanya biashara ya kuhamisha pesa.
answer_en: A money transfer business requires a special licence from the Bank of Tanzania (BoT) under the Payment Services Act 2015. This includes: being an agent of a large money company like M-Pesa or Airtel Money (requiring parent company authorisation), or being an independent licensed payment service provider. BoT licences come in multiple categories — confirm the type of service you wish to provide. GN 487A (July 2025) also prohibits non-Tanzanian citizens from conducting money transfer business.
question_en: What licence does a money transfer business need in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: BoT Payment Services Act amendment or GN 487A revision

question_sw: Kampuni ya Kiingereza yenye ofisi ndogo Tanzania (branch) inalipa kodi ya kampuni Tanzania tu kwa faida inayotokana Tanzania — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa ujumla. Tawi (branch) la kampuni ya kigeni Tanzania linalipishwa kodi ya kampuni kwa faida inayohusishwa na shughuli za tawi hilo Tanzania. Kiwango cha kodi ya tawi (branch profits tax) ni asilimia 30. Faida inayobaki baada ya kodi ya kampuni na kuhamishwa nje ya nchi inaweza pia kuwa na kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 10.
question_en: A British company with a small branch in Tanzania pays Tanzania corporate tax only on profits arising in Tanzania — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes, generally. A foreign company branch in Tanzania is taxed on profits attributable to the branch's Tanzania activities. The branch profits tax rate is 30%. Profits remaining after corporate tax and repatriated abroad may also attract a 10% withholding tax.

question_sw: Ninaweza kusajili jina la biashara (business name) bila kuunda kampuni?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Unaweza kusajili jina la biashara (sole proprietorship au partnership) bila kuunda kampuni ya kikomo cha dhima (limited company). Usajili wa jina la biashara unaruhusu kufanya biashara chini ya jina linalotambuliwa kisheria bila gharama za kuanzisha kampuni kamili.
question_en: Can I register a business name without incorporating a company?
answer_en: Yes. You can register a business name (sole proprietorship or partnership) without incorporating a limited liability company. Business name registration allows trading under a legally recognised name without the cost of full company incorporation.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Je, SDL inaathiri PAYE ya mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL (Skills and Development Levy) inalipwa na mwajiri kutoka mfuko wake mwenyewe — haikimuzi mfanyakazi. SDL haifanyi mabadiliko kwenye msingi wa PAYE wa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Does SDL affect an employee's PAYE calculation?
answer_en: No. SDL (Skills and Development Levy) is paid by the employer from their own funds — it is not deducted from the employee. SDL does not change the employee's PAYE base. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni ndogo yenye mauzo ya TZS 100M kwa mwaka inalipa kodi ya mapato ya kawaida ya asilimia 30 — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si lazima. Kampuni ndogo yenye mauzo chini ya kizingiti fulani inaweza kulipa kodi ya mapato ya chini (minimum turnover tax) badala ya kodi ya kawaida ya asilimia 30, ikiwa kodi ya asilimia 30 kwenye faida ingewa ndogo zaidi kuliko kodi ya chini ya mauzo. Kodi ya chini ya mauzo ni asilimia 1 ya mauzo ya jumla (wef 1 Julai 2025). Kampuni inalipa KIWANGO KIKUBWA ZAIDI kati ya kodi ya mapato ya kawaida na kodi ya chini.
question_en: A small company with TZS 100M annual turnover pays the standard 30% income tax — is this correct?
answer_en: Not necessarily. A small company below a certain threshold may pay minimum turnover tax instead of standard 30% if the 30% on profit would be less than the minimum tax. Minimum turnover tax is 1% of gross turnover (effective 1 July 2025). A company pays the HIGHER of: standard income tax OR minimum turnover tax.

question_sw: Mgeni anayeomba kuhamia Tanzania anaweza kufungua duka — amri ya GN 487A inasemaje?
answer_sw: GN 487A inamzuia mgeni yeyote asiye raia wa Tanzania kufungua duka la rejareja au biashara nyingine yoyote katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa — bila kujali kama ana kibali cha makazi au la, au kama ameomba uhalisi wa kudumu au la. Hali ya uhamiaji (immigraiton status) haibadilishi uhalali wa kumiliki biashara katika sekta hizi. Duka la rejareja ni miongoni mwa shughuli zilizozuiliwa wazi. Mtu huyu anapaswa kupata ushauri wa kisheria kabla ya kufanya maamuzi ya biashara nchini Tanzania.
question_en: A foreigner applying to move to Tanzania wants to open a shop — what does GN 487A say?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits any non-Tanzanian citizen from opening a retail shop or any other business in the 15 prohibited categories — regardless of whether they have a residence permit, have applied for permanent residency, or are in any immigration status. Immigration status does not change the legality of owning a business in these sectors. A retail shop is explicitly among the prohibited activities. This person should get legal advice before making any business decisions in Tanzania.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Malipo gani yanastahili PAYE Tanzania?
answer_sw: PAYE inakata: mshahara wa msingi, ujira wa ziada (overtime), posho (allowances — nyumba, usafiri, chakula), bonasi, motisha, na thamani ya manufaa kama vile gari la kampuni au nyumba ya kampuni. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What payments are subject to PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE applies to: basic salary, overtime pay, allowances (housing, transport, meals), bonuses, incentives, and the value of benefits such as company car or company housing. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Uhusiano kati ya EFD na VAT ni nini?
answer_sw: EFD ni chombo cha utekelezaji wa VAT. Biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT inatozea wateja VAT ya asilimia 18 kwenye kila muamala — na risiti ya EFD ndiyo hati rasmi inayoonyesha VAT hiyo. Bila EFD, hakuna uthibitisho wa kisheria wa VAT. Seva ya TRA inakusanya taarifa za EFD na TRA inazitumia kulinganisha na VAT returns. EFD + VAT return + malipo ya VAT ndio 'mzunguko kamili' wa wajibu wa VAT.
question_en: What is the relationship between EFD and VAT?
answer_en: EFD is the enforcement tool for VAT. A VAT-registered business charges customers 18% VAT on every transaction — and the EFD receipt is the official document evidencing that VAT. Without EFD, there is no official proof of VAT. TRA's server collects EFD data and TRA uses it to verify against VAT returns. EFD + VAT return + VAT payment is the 'complete cycle' of VAT obligation.

instruction: Kiwanda kidogo chenye wafanyakazi 12 kinahitaji OSHA inspection?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Ndio — kiwanda chochote kinashughulikiwa na OSHA, bila kujali ukubwa. Kwa kiwanda: mahitaji ya OSHA yanaweza kuwa makali zaidi — hasa kama kuna: mitambo, kemikali, vifaa vya joto, au hatari za kimwili. OSHA inspection inaweza kufanyika mara kwa mara au baada ya taarifa ya ajali. Sajili kiwanda chako na OSHA mara utakapofungua.

question_sw: Biashara gani zimepigwa marufuku kwa raia wa kigeni chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: GN 487A inapiga marufuku raia wa kigeni kufanya shughuli 15 ambazo zimehifadhiwa kwa raia wa Tanzania. Baadhi ya shughuli zinazojulikana ni: biashara ya jumla (wholesale trade), biashara ya rejareja (retail trade), uhamishaji wa pesa za simu (mobile money transfers), ukarabati wa simu (phone repair), na biashara ya urembo/saluni (salon/beauty business). Orodha kamili ina makundi 15 — tazama GN 487A kwenye Gazeti Rasmi la Serikali au wasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa orodha kamili na hivi karibuni.
question_en: Which businesses are prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits non-citizens from conducting 15 business activities reserved exclusively for Tanzanian citizens. Known categories include: wholesale trade, retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, and salon/beauty business. The full list contains 15 categories — see GN 487A in the Official Government Gazette or contact the Immigration Services Department for the complete and current list.
next_review_trigger: When GN 487A is amended or new prohibited categories added

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa kupitia wakala wa ajira (labour contractor) ana haki ya GN 605A?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa kupitia wakala wa ajira ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A. Mwajiri wa mwisho (principal employer) na wakala wanaweza kubeba wajibu wa pamoja kuhakikisha mshahara huu unalipwa.
question_en: Does a worker employed through a labour contractor have GN 605A rights?
answer_en: Yes. A worker employed through a labour contractor is entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage. The principal employer and contractor may share joint liability for ensuring payment.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: TIN ya TRA inagharimu kiasi gani na inachukua muda gani kupata?
answer_sw: TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) ya TRA Tanzania inapatikana BURE — hakuna ada. Unaweza kuomba mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa TRA (tra.go.tz) au ofisini. Kawaida inachukua siku 1-3 za kazi. Unahitaji: hati ya utambulisho (NIDA/passport), ushahidi wa anwani, na kwa kampuni, hati za BRELA. TIN inahitajika kwa kila mwanahisa na mkurugenzi wa kampuni pia.
question_en: How much does a TRA TIN cost and how long does it take to obtain?
answer_en: A TRA TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) in Tanzania is FREE — no fee. You can apply online through the TRA system (tra.go.tz) or in person. It typically takes 1-3 working days. You need: ID document (NIDA/passport), proof of address, and for a company, BRELA documents. A TIN is also required for each shareholder and director of the company.

instruction: Mimi ni mgeni (non-resident) ninayeishi Uingereza lakini nina ardhi Tanzania — nikiuza ardhi hiyo, capital gains tax inanishughulikia vipi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Hali ya capital gains tax kwa wasio wakazi (non-residents) inashughulikiwa tofauti chini ya Income Tax Act na mikataba ya kuzuia kodi mara mbili (DTAs) — inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa kodi ya kimataifa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Kampuni limited by shares Tanzania — mchakato wa usajilishaji ni upi?
output: Usajilishaji wa kampuni limited by shares kupitia BRELA: (1) angalia na hifadhi jina la kampuni (ORS); (2) andaa Memorandum na Articles of Association; (3) jaza fomu za kuanzisha kampuni; (4) lipa ada za usajilishaji; (5) pokea Certificate of Incorporation. Kwa ada za sasa, hatua kamili, na fomu maalum, angalia brela.go.tz au mfumo wa ORS (ors.brela.go.tz) — usitegemee taarifa za zamani za ada kwani zinaweza kubadilika.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Je, kuwa na EFD machine inayofanya kazi ni ya kutosha -- au kuna mahitaji mengine?
output: Kuwa na EFD machine si ya kutosha peke yake -- lazima: (1) utoe risiti ya EFD kwa KILA muamala wa mauzo bila kujali kiasi, (2) uhakikishe machine imewashwa na inafanya kazi wakati wote wa biashara, (3) uhifadhi rekodi za EFD kwa miaka ya ukaguzi, (4) uripoti TRA haraka kama machine inaharibika. Kushindwa kutoa risiti licha ya kuwa na machine ni ukiukwaji. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Muda wa usajili wa BRELA unachukua muda gani?
answer_sw: Usajili wa BRELA mara nyingi unachukua siku 3 hadi 5 za kazi ikiwa nyaraka zote ziko sahihi. BRELA inafanya usajili wa haraka (express registration) ndani ya siku 1-2 kwa ada ya ziada. Usajili wa online kupitia mfumo wa BRELA unaweza kuwa haraka zaidi. Kuchelewa kunaweza kutokea kama nyaraka zina makosa.
question_en: How long does BRELA registration take?
answer_en: BRELA registration typically takes 3 to 5 working days if all documents are correct. BRELA offers express registration within 1-2 days for an additional fee. Online registration through the BRELA system may be faster. Delays can occur if documents have errors.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania unafunika mikataba ya usimamizi (management agreements) ya muda mrefu — je, ipo?
answer_sw: Mikataba ya usimamizi ya muda mrefu Tanzania inaweza kuhitaji ushuru wa stempu ikiwa inafanana na muundo wa makubaliano ya kukodisha au ikiwa imeorodheshwa kwenye Jedwali la Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu. Mikataba ya kawaida ya huduma za usimamizi inaweza isihusike. Angalia mwanasheria wa kodi kwa aina yako mahususi ya mkataba wa usimamizi.
question_en: Does Tanzania stamp duty cover long-term management agreements?
answer_en: Long-term management agreements in Tanzania may require stamp duty if they resemble lease structures or are listed in the Stamp Duty Act schedule. Ordinary management service contracts may not be covered. Check a tax lawyer for your specific type of management agreement.

instruction: Biashara yangu ya rejareja ndogo — ninahitaji kampuni ya hisa au biashara ya jina?
output: Kwa biashara ndogo ya rejareja, mambo muhimu ya kuzingatia: BIASHARA YA JINA: rahisi na nafuu kuanzisha (BRELA ada ndogo), lakini mmiliki anashikiliwa kibinafsi kwa madeni. Inafaa kwa biashara ndogo sana zenye hatari ndogo za madeni. KAMPUNI YA HISA: inahitaji mtaji wa usajili (min TZS 95,000 kwa BRELA), annual returns, na akaunti rasmi — lakini inalinda mali za kibinafsi. Inafaa ukipanga kukua, kutaka mkopo wa benki, au kufanya mikataba mikubwa. Maamuzi inategemea ukubwa wa hatari, mipango ya ukuaji, na mahitaji ya wadau wako. Thibitisha na wakili au mshauri wa biashara.

instruction: Niliuza bidhaa leo — risiti ya EFD ninaitoa siku ile ile au siku inayofuata?
output: Risiti ya EFD inapaswa kutolewa SIKU ILE ILE ya muamala — si siku inayofuata. Hii ni kanuni ya msingi ya EFD: kila mauzo yanafuatwa na risiti mara moja. Kutoa risiti siku inayofuata kunaweza kuonekana kama kuchelewa kurekodi muamala — ambayo ni tatizo la kodi. Pia: Z-Report inayohitajika mwishoni mwa siku itaonyesha tofauti kati ya muamala wa siku hiyo na risiti zilizotolewa. Kwa biashara inayofanya kazi usiku: risiti ya muamala wa usiku wa mwisho inatoka siku ile ile — si asubuhi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Ninaingia mkataba wa kukodisha ofisi kwa miaka 3 — stamp duty inatumika na inahesabiwaje?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Stamp duty kwa mikataba ya kukodisha (lease agreements) inashughulikiwa chini ya Stamp Duty Act — hesabu inategemea thamani ya kodi ya jumla ya mkataba wote. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Fundi wa seremala (carpenter) anayefanya kazi peke yake — anahitaji NSSF?
answer_sw: Fundi anayejitegemea (mwenye biashara yake mwenyewe, hana wafanyakazi) hajalazimishwa kwa NSSF ya wafanyakazi. Hata hivyo, NSSF inatoa programu ya michango ya hiari (voluntary contribution) kwa wajitegemea wanaotaka usalama wa pensheni. Kama fundi ataanza kuwa na wafanyakazi waliohiriwa, NSSF itakuwa lazima.
question_en: A self-employed carpenter — do they need NSSF?
answer_en: A self-employed carpenter (running their own business, no hired workers) is not required to contribute to NSSF for employees. However, NSSF offers a voluntary contribution programme for self-employed persons who want pension security. If the carpenter starts hiring employees, NSSF becomes mandatory for those employees.

question_sw: Ardhi inayohamishwa kwa sababu ya talaka (divorce) Tanzania — ina ushuru wa stempu?
answer_sw: Uhamishaji wa ardhi kati ya wanandoa kama sehemu ya mgawanyo wa mali wa talaka unaweza kuwa na masharti maalum ya ushuru chini ya Sheria ya Ndoa Tanzania na Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu. Inaweza kuwa na msamaha au kupunguzwa kwa ushuru katika hali za talaka. Angalia mwanasheria wa familia na kodi kwa hali yako mahususi.
question_en: Land transferred as part of a divorce settlement in Tanzania — does it attract stamp duty?
answer_en: Transfer of land between spouses as part of a divorce asset division may have special tax treatment under the Tanzania Law of Marriage Act and the Stamp Duty Act. There may be an exemption or reduction in divorce situations. Consult a family and tax lawyer for your specific situation.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or family law update

instruction: Niliuza ardhi yangu Tanzania na kupata faida — lazima nilipe kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax)? Kiasi gani?
output: Faida inayotokana na uuzaji wa mali kama ardhi, hisa, au majengo inaweza kuwa taxable chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania. Hesabu halisi inategemea thamani ya ununuzi (cost base), thamani ya uuzaji, na hali yako kama mkazi au asiye mkazi. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) kwa mauzo ya ardhi inashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act — ni mada tofauti inayohitaji utaalamu maalum wa kodi ya mapato. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Annual return ya BRELA inapaswa kuwasilishwa kabla ya tarehe gani kila mwaka?
output: Hakuna tarehe maalum ya 30 Septemba kwa annual returns za BRELA — tarehe inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni yako. Annual return inapaswa kuwasilishwa kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni yako (anniversary date) — si lazima mwaka wa kifedha. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa tarehe yako halisi. Kanuni ya jumla: wasilisha annual return ndani ya miezi 12 ya mwisho wa mwaka wa biashara wako. Thibitisha tarehe yako halisi kupitia akaunti yako ya BRELA online.

instruction: Kampuni yaliyofutwa BRELA inaweza kufanya nini kisheria?
output: Kampuni iliyofutwa orodha (deregistered) na BRELA haina uwezo wa kisheria: haiwezi kuingia mikataba mipya, haiwezi kufungua akaunti mpya ya benki, haiwezi kushiriki zabuni za serikali, na kawaida haiwezi kuanzisha kesi mpya mahakamani bila kurejesha usajili wake kwanza — urejesho unawezekana lakini ni ghali. Kuna faini ya kuchelewa kwa kila mwezi bila kuwasilisha annual return — thibitisha kiasi halisi na BRELA (brela.go.tz) au angalia Companies Act Cap.212. Miaka 2 ya kuchelewa inaweza kusababisha kufutwa orodha. Kampuni iliyofutwa haiwezi kufanya mikataba mipya kisheria. Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return inatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni — angalia ratiba rasmi ya ada kwenye brela.go.tz — gharama ya kuchelewa ni kubwa zaidi kuliko ada yenyewe. Urejesho wa kampuni uliyofutwa unachukua muda na gharama zaidi ya kuwasilisha kwa wakati.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi aliye kwenye probation (muda wa majaribio) analipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi aliye kwenye muda wa majaribio (probationary period) analipa NSSF kama mfanyakazi yeyote mwingine — mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Hali ya probation haiathiri wajibu wa NSSF. Muda wa probation unahesabiwaje kama miezi ya mchango wa NSSF ikiwa mfanyakazi ataendelea kufanya kazi.
question_en: Does a probationary employee pay NSSF?
answer_en: Yes. An employee on probation pays NSSF like any other employee — employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. Probationary status does not affect the NSSF obligation. The probationary period counts as NSSF contribution months if the employee continues in employment.

instruction: Je, Finance Act 2025 ilianzisha mfumo mpya wa VAT withholding Tanzania?
output: Ndiyo. Finance Act 2025 ilianzisha mfumo huu wa VAT withholding Tanzania Bara kwa mara ya kwanza, ukianza tarehe 1 Julai 2025. Viwango ni asilimia 3 kwa bidhaa na asilimia 6 kwa huduma. Kabla ya Finance Act 2025, mfumo huu haukuwepo Tanzania Bara. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi na kinaanza kutumika kwenye mshahara gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 30, kinatumika kwenye sehemu ya mshahara inayozidi TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi. Sehemu yoyote ya mshahara juu ya TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi inatozwa 30%. Kwa mfano, mfanyakazi anayepata TZS 2,000,000: sehemu ya TZS 1,000,000 ya ziada (1,000,001–2,000,000) inatozwa 30% = TZS 300,000 ya kodi kwenye sehemu hiyo peke yake. PAYE yote kabla ya punguzo la kibinafsi itakuwa TZS 128,000 + TZS 300,000 = TZS 428,000.
answer_en: The highest PAYE rate in Tanzania is 30%, applied on the portion of salary exceeding TZS 1,000,000 per month. Any part of salary above TZS 1,000,000 per month is taxed at 30%. For example, an employee earning TZS 2,000,000: the extra TZS 1,000,000 portion (1,000,001–2,000,000) is taxed at 30% = TZS 300,000 tax on that portion alone. Total PAYE before personal relief will be TZS 128,000 + TZS 300,000 = TZS 428,000.
question_en: What is the maximum PAYE rate in Tanzania and at what salary does it start?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — top rate ITA Cap.332 Finance Act 2025

instruction: Biashara ya jina la familia — kama baba anafariki, mtoto anaweza kuendelea?
output: Biashara ya jina (sole trader) iliyosajiliwa kwa jina la baba inakufa kisheria anapokufa baba — mtoto hawezi kurithi usajili wa BRELA moja kwa moja. Mtoto anahitaji: (1) Kuanzisha usajili mpya wa biashara kwa jina lake au jina jipya; (2) Kuwasilisha hati za urithi (probate) na usajili mpya. Njia nzuri zaidi kwa biashara za familia: kuanzisha kampuni ya hisa — kampuni inaendelea hata mwanachama mmoja akifariki, hisa zinaweza kuhamishwa. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anabadilisha kazi kutoka kampuni A hadi kampuni B. Michango yake ya NSSF inahamia vipi?
answer_sw: Michango ya NSSF haihitajiki 'kuhamia' — inabaki kwenye akaunti ya NSSF ya mwanachama na inaendelea kujengwa bila kujali mabadiliko ya mwajiri. Nambari ya NSSF ya mwanachama inabaki ile ile, na mwajiri mpya anaendelea kuchangia kwenye nambari hiyo ile. Mfanyakazi anapaswa kumwarifu mwajiri mpya nambari yake ya NSSF mara anapokuwa ameajiriwa. Kama mwajiri mpya hajui nambari yako ya NSSF, unaweza kuomba nambari kutoka ofisi yoyote ya NSSF au kwa kutumia portal ya mtandaoni.
answer_en: NSSF contributions do not need to 'transfer' — they remain in the member's NSSF account and continue to accumulate regardless of employer changes. The member's NSSF number stays the same, and the new employer continues contributing to that same number. The employee should inform the new employer of their NSSF number when they start work. If the new employer does not know your NSSF number, you can request it from any NSSF office or through the online portal.
question_en: An employee changes jobs from Company A to Company B. How do their NSSF contributions transfer?

question_sw: Kampuni ya kimataifa ya IT (teknolojia ya habari) inaweza kumilikiwa na mgeni Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa ujumla inaweza. Huduma za teknolojia ya habari (IT), ubunifu wa programu (software development), na huduma za kielektroniki haziko kati ya makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa wazi na GN 487A. Kampuni ya IT inayomilikiwa na mgeni inaweza kufanya kazi Tanzania mradi inazingatia sheria nyingine za biashara, kama usajili wa BRELA, ulipaji wa kodi, na vibali sahihi vya kazi kwa wafanyakazi. Hata hivyo, kama kampuni hiyo pia inaendesha duka la rejareja la bidhaa za IT (kuuza vifaa moja kwa moja kwa wateja), sehemu hiyo ya biashara inaweza kuathiriwa na GN 487A.
question_en: Can an international IT (information technology) company be owned by a non-citizen in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes, generally it can. Information technology services, software development, and electronic services are not among the 15 explicitly prohibited categories under GN 487A. A non-citizen-owned IT company can operate in Tanzania provided it complies with other business laws, such as BRELA registration, tax payment, and valid work permits for employees. However, if that company also operates a retail shop selling IT goods (selling hardware directly to customers), that aspect of the business may be affected by GN 487A.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: TRA inajuaje kama ninatoa risiti za EFD au la — jinsi gani wanakagua?
output: TRA ina mbinu nyingi za kukagua utiifu wa EFD: (1) Ukaguzi wa moja kwa moja (physical inspection) wa duka — wakaguzi wanakuja bila taarifa; (2) Secret shoppers — wanunuzi wa siri wanaojifanya wateja wa kawaida kujaribu kama risiti inatoka; (3) Data ya EFD — EFD zote zinazotumia TIMS (Tax Invoice Management System) zinatuma data TRA moja kwa moja kwa wakati halisi; (4) Malalamiko ya wateja — mteja yeyote anaweza ripoti biashara isiyotoa risiti; (5) Kulinganisha rekodi za M-Pesa/benki na rekodi za EFD. Kosa moja la ukaguzi wa siri linaweza kusababisha ukaguzi mkubwa wa nyuma. Thibitisha na TRA.

question_sw: TRAB inaweza kuamua dhidi ya TRA na kumpa mlipaji kodi ushindi kamili — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. TRAB ni bodi huru ambayo inaweza kuamua dhidi ya TRA na kutoa ushindi kamili au sehemu ya ushindi kwa mlipaji kodi. Ikiwa TRAB ikitoa ushindi kamili, TRA inaweza kurudisha kiasi kilicholipwa na kufuta tathmini. TRAB ni njia muhimu ya kupata haki kwa mlipaji kodi.
question_en: Can TRAB decide against TRA and give the taxpayer a complete win — is this true?
answer_en: Yes. TRAB is an independent board that can decide against TRA and award a complete or partial win to the taxpayer. If TRAB grants a complete win, TRA must refund amounts paid and cancel the assessment. TRAB is an important avenue for taxpayer justice.

instruction: Tofauti kati ya SDL na WCF ni nini?
output: SDL = asilimia 3.5 → TRA → waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. WCF = asilimia 0.5 → Mamlaka ya WCF → WAAJIRI WOTE (hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi 1). Tofauti kubwa: WCF haina kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi — mwajiri yeyote analipa. SDL inakwenda TRA → inatumika kwa mafunzo ya nguvu kazi Tanzania. WCF inakwenda Mamlaka ya WCF → inatumika kulipa fidia za ajali za kazi.

question_sw: GN 605A ilianza tarehe ngapi?
answer_sw: GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Ilisainiwa mnamo Oktoba 2025. Amri ya zamani ya mshahara wa mwaka 2022 ilifutwa rasmi kuanzia tarehe hiyo hiyo. Thibitisha na TanzLII.
question_en: When did GN 605A come into effect?
answer_en: GN 605A came into effect on 1 January 2026. It was gazetted in October 2025. The 2022 wage order was formally revoked from the same date. Confirm with TanzLII.

question_sw: Kiwango cha PAYE cha asilimia 25 kinatumika kwa mapato kati ya Shilingi 700,001 na 1,000,000 kwa mwezi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kanda ya asilimia 25 inaanza kwa Shilingi 760,001 — si Shilingi 700,001. Kanda ya asilimia 20 inaisha kwa Shilingi 760,000 (si 700,000). Kanda kamili za PAYE za kila mwezi ni: 0% (hadi 270k), 8% (270k–520k), 20% (520k–760k), 25% (760k–1M), 30% (zaidi ya 1M). Shilingi 700,001 iko bado katika kanda ya asilimia 20.
question_en: The 25% PAYE band applies to income between TZS 700,001 and 1,000,000 per month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The 25% band starts at TZS 760,001 — not TZS 700,001. The 20% band ends at TZS 760,000 (not 700,000). The full monthly PAYE bands are: 0% (up to 270k), 8% (270k–520k), 20% (520k–760k), 25% (760k–1M), 30% (above 1M). TZS 700,001 is still within the 20% band.

question_sw: Msanifu majengo (architect) mpya — anaweza kusubiri hadi mauzo yake yafike TZS 200M kwanza?
answer_sw: Hapana — msanifu majengo aliyesajiliwa (registered architect) hawezi kusubiri kizingiti cha TZS 200M. Kama daktari, wakili, na mhandisi, msanifu majengo lazima asajili VAT kama sehemu ya mahitaji ya kupata na kudumisha leseni yake ya kitaalamu. Kutosajili VAT wakati ukiendesha biashara ya kitaalamu kama msanifu majengo aliyeidhinishwa ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya kodi.
question_en: A new architect — can they wait until their fees reach TZS 200M first?
answer_en: No — a registered architect cannot wait for the TZS 200M threshold. Like doctors, lawyers, and engineers, an architect must register for VAT as part of the requirements to obtain and maintain their professional licence. Failing to register for VAT while operating as a licensed professional architect is a violation of tax law.

question_sw: Sekta ya umma inalipwa mshahara gani Tanzania tangu Julai 2025?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa serikali (sekta ya umma) Tanzania Bara wanalipwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 500,000 kwa mwezi, kuanzia Julai 2025, kufuatia tangazo la Rais Samia. GN 605A inashughulikia sekta ya faragha peke yake. Thibitisha na Hazina.
question_en: What is the public sector minimum wage in Tanzania since July 2025?
answer_en: Government employees (public sector) in Tanzania Mainland receive a minimum wage of TZS 500,000 per month from July 2025, following President Samia's announcement. GN 605A covers the private sector only. Confirm with the Treasury.

question_sw: Makosa ya kawaida yanayosababisha kukataliwa kwa madai ya VAT refund?
answer_sw: Makosa ya kawaida ni: (1) Kudai input VAT bila risiti ya EFD au invoice ya VAT halali; (2) Kudai VAT kutoka wasambazaji wasiosajiliwa VAT; (3) Kudai input VAT kwa ununuzi wa kibinafsi; (4) Hati zisizokamilika au zenye tofauti; (5) Kutofanya VAT returns za kila mwezi kwa wakati; (6) Kutodai input VAT kwa wakati (kuiacha muda kupita). Weka kumbukumbu nzuri kuepuka makosa haya.
question_en: Common mistakes that cause VAT refund claims to be rejected?
answer_en: Common mistakes include: (1) Claiming input VAT without a valid EFD receipt or VAT invoice; (2) Claiming VAT from non-VAT-registered suppliers; (3) Claiming input VAT on personal purchases; (4) Incomplete or inconsistent documents; (5) Not filing monthly VAT returns on time; (6) Not claiming input VAT on time (letting the period expire). Maintain good records to avoid these errors.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Ikiwa nilikataa kulipa NSSF kwa miezi mitatu — adhabu ni gani?
answer_sw: Kutolipa NSSF ni ukiukwaji mkubwa wa sheria ya Tanzania. NSSF ina mamlaka ya kutoza riba kwenye michango iliyochelewa, na inaweza kufungua kesi ya kisheria dhidi ya mwajiri asiyetii. Katika hali mbaya, mkurugenzi wa kampuni binafsi anaweza kuwajibika kisheria. Usifike hapo — lipa NSSF kwa wakati kila mwezi. Kama una matatizo ya kifedha, wasiliana na NSSF mapema ili kujadili mpango wa malipo. Thibitisha adhabu halisi na NSSF kwenye nssf.go.tz.
question_en: If I have not paid NSSF for three months — what is the penalty?
answer_en: Failing to pay NSSF is a serious violation of Tanzanian law. NSSF has the authority to charge interest on overdue contributions, and can take legal action against a non-compliant employer. In serious cases, company directors may be personally liable. Avoid reaching that point — pay NSSF on time every month. If you are facing financial difficulties, contact NSSF early to discuss a payment plan. Confirm the specific penalties with NSSF at nssf.go.tz.
next_review_trigger: When NSSF Act is amended — VERIFY exact effective date from nssf.go.tz before training

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu hulipwa na nani — mnunuzi au muuzaji?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida Tanzania, ushuru wa stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa ardhi hulipwa na MNUNUZI (mpokeaji wa hati). Hata hivyo, pande zote mbili zinaweza kukubaliana juu ya mgawanyo wa gharama hii katika mkataba wa mauzo. TRA inatazamia kwamba ushuru umelipwa kabla ya hati kusajiliwa au kutumika kisheria.
question_en: Who pays stamp duty — the buyer or the seller?
answer_en: Generally in Tanzania, stamp duty on land transfer is paid by the BUYER (the recipient of the instrument). However, both parties can agree on how to share this cost in the sale agreement. TRA expects the duty to be paid before the instrument is registered or used legally.

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi Tanzania kinahuisha kiotomatiki kila mwaka — mwajiri hahitaji kufanya chochote — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kibali cha kazi HAIJUISHI kiotomatiki. Mwajiri lazima AOMBE uhuishaji kikamilifu angalau miezi 3 kabla ya kumalizika kwa kibali. Kutoomba kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha mfanyakazi wa kigeni kuwa na hali ya haramu. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kufuatilia tarehe za mwisho za vibali vyote vya wafanyakazi wake.
question_en: A Tanzania work permit auto-renews every year — the employer doesn't need to do anything — is this true?
answer_en: No. Work permits do NOT auto-renew. The employer must ACTIVELY APPLY for renewal at least 3 months before the permit expires. Failing to apply on time can leave the foreign worker in an unlawful status. The employer has a responsibility to track all their workers' permit expiry dates.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya NSSF ya Tanzania na PSSSF (Public Service Social Security Fund) ni nini?
answer_sw: NSSF (National Social Security Fund) na PSSSF (Public Service Social Security Fund) ni mifumo miwili tofauti ya hifadhi ya jamii Tanzania: NSSF inahudumia wafanyakazi wa SEKTA YA KIBINAFSI hasa. PSSSF inahudumia wafanyakazi wa SEKTA YA UMMA (watumishi wa serikali, mashirika ya umma). Viwango vya michango na manufaa yanaweza kutofautiana. Biashara ya kibinafsi haisajili PSSSF — inasajili NSSF.
question_en: What is the difference between NSSF Tanzania and PSSSF (Public Service Social Security Fund)?
answer_en: NSSF (National Social Security Fund) and PSSSF (Public Service Social Security Fund) are two different social security systems in Tanzania: NSSF primarily serves PRIVATE SECTOR employees. PSSSF serves PUBLIC SECTOR employees (government workers, public corporations). Contribution rates and benefits may differ. A private business registers with NSSF — not PSSSF.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Kampuni iliyosajiliwa BRELA inahitaji leseni nyingine pia au BRELA peke yake inatosha?
answer_sw: Usajili wa BRELA unatoa uhalali wa kisheria wa kampuni au biashara, lakini si leseni za sekta maalum. Biashara nyingi zinahitaji leseni za ziada kama: leseni ya biashara ya manispaa, leseni za TRA (TIN, VAT), vibali vya mazingira (NEMC), leseni za sekta maalum (TFDA/TMDA kwa dawa, NBS kwa viwango), na nyingine.
question_en: Does a BRELA-registered company need other licences too or is BRELA registration alone enough?
answer_en: BRELA registration gives a company its legal existence, but not sector-specific licences. Most businesses need additional licences including: municipal trading licence, TRA registrations (TIN, VAT), environmental permit (NEMC), sector licences (TMDA for medicines, TBS for standards), and others.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mwajiri wa Tanzania anahitaji kuwapa vifaa vya usalama (PPE) wafanyakazi wake — au wafanyakazi wanunue wenyewe?
answer_sw: MWAJIRI ndiye analazimika kuwapa wafanyakazi vifaa vya usalama (PPE — Personal Protective Equipment) BURE kwa gharama za mwajiri. Hii ni wajibu wa kisheria chini ya OSHA Act. Mwajiri HAWEZI kumtaka mfanyakazi anunue vifaa vya usalama kwa pesa zake mwenyewe. Pia mwajiri lazima ahakikishe vifaa vipo katika hali nzuri na wafanyakazi wanajua kutumia PPE ipasavyo.
question_en: Is a Tanzania employer required to provide safety equipment (PPE) to workers — or do workers buy their own?
answer_en: The EMPLOYER is required to provide workers with personal protective equipment (PPE) FREE of charge at the employer's expense. This is a legal obligation under the OSHA Act. An employer CANNOT require a worker to buy their own safety equipment. The employer must also ensure equipment is in good condition and workers know how to use PPE properly.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

instruction: EFD mandatory kwa kila biashara au kuna msamaha?
output: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Msamaha: biashara zenye mauzo chini ya TZS 11M kwa mwaka na ambazo hazijasajiliwa VAT hazihitajiki kiautomatiki. Lakini: TRA inaweza kuhitaji EFD kwa biashara yoyote inayochukuliwa kwa hatari ya kodi. Mauzo ya TZS 11M+ au usajili wa VAT → EFD ni lazima.

question_sw: Je, kila mfanyabiashara aliyesajiliwa VAT anaweza kudai refund?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — mfanyabiashara YEYOTE aliyesajiliwa VAT ambaye ana ziada ya input VAT juu ya output VAT ana haki ya kudai refund. Hii si haki maalum kwa makampuni makubwa peke yake. Biashara ndogo pia zinaweza kudai kama zinaonyesha input VAT inayostahili iliyolipwa.
question_en: Can every VAT-registered business claim a refund?
answer_en: Yes — ANY VAT-registered business that has excess input VAT over output VAT is entitled to claim a refund. This is not a special right for large companies alone. Small businesses can also claim if they demonstrate eligible paid input VAT.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya WHT na PAYE ni nini?
answer_sw: WHT (Withholding Tax) inahusu MALIPO YANAYOTOKA KWA BIASHARA — kama gawio, riba, royalties, na ada za huduma. PAYE (Pay As You Earn) inahusu MISHAHARA YA WAFANYAKAZI. WHT inakataolewa na mlipaji kabla ya kutoa malipo. PAYE inakataolewa na mwajiri kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Zote mbili zinawasilishwa TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between WHT and PAYE?
answer_en: WHT (Withholding Tax) applies to BUSINESS PAYMENTS — such as dividends, interest, royalties, and service fees. PAYE (Pay As You Earn) applies to EMPLOYEE SALARIES. WHT is deducted by the payer before making the payment. PAYE is deducted by the employer from the employee's salary. Both are remitted to TRA.

instruction: Mgeni anayetoa huduma ya kusafisha nyumba MARA MOJA kwa mtu wa karibu — je, bado ni ukiukwaji wa GN 487A?
output: GN 487A inazuia kufanya biashara ya huduma za usafi, si usaidizi wa kawaida kati ya marafiki. Tofauti muhimu ni biashara vs usaidizi wa kibinafsi: kama ni huduma ya kijamii au usaidizi bila malipo ya biashara, GN 487A haihusiki moja kwa moja. Lakini kama kuna malipo ya pesa, mara nyingi, kwa watu tofauti — hii ni biashara na GN 487A inatumika. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara ili kujua hali yako maalum.

instruction: Kama mwagizaji mali Tanzania ninataka kujua haki zangu chini ya AGOA -- unajua?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya kina kuhusu mkataba wa AGOA (African Growth and Opportunity Act). AGOA ni makubaliano ya kibiashara kati ya Tanzania na Marekani yanayohusu bidhaa za kuuza Marekani bila ushuru. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Biashara na Viwanda (MIT) au shirika la kukuza biashara TanTrade kwa maelezo ya AGOA yanayohusiana na biashara yako.

question_sw: Bidhaa zangu zina thamani ya USD 2,500 — naweza kutumia STR?
answer_sw: Hapana. STR inatumika tu kama thamani ya msafara wako haitazidi USD 2,000. Kwa msafara wenye thamani ya USD 2,500, lazima utumie utaratibu wa kawaida wa forodha ukijumuisha ushuru wa kawaida wa bidhaa hizo. Njia moja ya kisheria ni kugawanya msafara kwenye safari mbili tofauti — lakini thibitisha na ofisa wa forodha.
question_en: My goods are worth USD 2,500 — can I use STR?
answer_en: No. STR applies only if your consignment value does not exceed USD 2,000. For a consignment worth USD 2,500, you must use the standard customs process including regular customs duties. One legal approach is splitting into two separate trips — but verify with a customs officer.

instruction: OSHA inasimamia maeneo yote ya kazi au sekta fulani peke yake?
output: OSHA inasimamia mahali pote pa kazi Tanzania Bara — hakuna sekta au ukubwa wa biashara unaoweza kusamehewa. Hata biashara ndogo mwenye mfanyakazi 1 analazimika kuzingatia mahitaji ya OSHA. Sheria ya Usalama na Afya Mahali pa Kazi (OHS Act No. 5 of 2003) inatumika kwa wote. Kusajili mahali pa kazi na kupata cheti cha usajilishaji wa OSHA ni wajibu wa kila mwajiri.

instruction: Kwa nini Z-report lazima ipigwe mwishoni mwa siku na si kesho asubuhi?
output: Z-report lazima ipigwe MWISHONI MWA SIKU ya biashara — si asubuhi ya siku inayofuata. Sababu ya kisheria: Z-report inafunga data ya mauzo ya siku hiyo kwenye EFD — ikichelewa, data ya siku hiyo inabaki 'wazi' kwenye EFD, ambayo ni ukiukaji wa kanuni za TIMS. TRA inaweza kuona vipindi vya Z-report vilivyokosekana au vilivyochelewa kupitia TIMS.

question_sw: 'Isiyopungua TZS 10M' inamaanisha nini kwa vitendo — korti inaweza kutoza zaidi ya 10M?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — 'isiyopungua TZS 10,000,000' inamaanisha TZS 10M ni KIWANGO CHA CHINI. Korti inaweza kutoza 10M, 15M, 20M au zaidi kulingana na hali ya kesi — lakini haiwezi kutoza chini ya 10M. Hii ni tofauti na 'hadi TZS 10M' (yaani huwezi kutoza zaidi ya 10M). Lugha ya kisheria inabainisha: 'not less than' = minimum; 'not exceeding' = maximum.
question_en: What does 'not less than TZS 10M' mean in practice — can the court impose more than 10M?
answer_en: Yes — 'not less than TZS 10,000,000' means TZS 10M is the MINIMUM. A court may impose 10M, 15M, 20M or more depending on the circumstances — but it cannot impose less than 10M. This differs from 'up to TZS 10M' (meaning you cannot impose more than 10M). Legal language: 'not less than' = minimum floor; 'not exceeding' = maximum ceiling.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya WCF na NSSF ni nini — wote wawili wanahusiana na manufaa ya wafanyakazi?
answer_sw: WCF inashughulikia MAJERAHA NA MAGONJWA ya kazi peke yake — ajali za kazini na magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi. NSSF inashughulikia USALAMA WA JAMII kwa ujumla — pensheni ya uzee, manufaa ya mama na mtoto, na manufaa ya ulemavu usio wa kazi. Waajiri wanawajibika kwa zote mbili, na wajibu wao ni tofauti.
question_en: What is the difference between WCF and NSSF — both relate to employee benefits?
answer_en: WCF covers WORK INJURIES AND DISEASES only — workplace accidents and occupational diseases. NSSF covers GENERAL SOCIAL SECURITY — retirement pension, maternity benefits, and non-work disability. Employers are obligated to both, with separate obligations.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Biashara ndogo inayofanya mauzo ya TZS 20M kwa mwaka inahitaji kusajili VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT Tanzania ni TZS 200,000,000 (TZS 200M) kwa miezi 12, au TZS 100,000,000 (TZS 100M) kwa miezi 6. Biashara yenye mauzo ya TZS 20M kwa mwaka iko mbali sana chini ya kizingiti hiki na HAIHITAJIKI kusajili VAT. Hata hivyo, inaweza kusajili hiari (voluntary registration) ikiwa inataka kudai VAT kwenye manunuzi ya biashara.
question_en: Does a small business making TZS 20M annual sales need to register for VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. The VAT registration threshold in Tanzania is TZS 200,000,000 (TZS 200M) per 12 months, or TZS 100,000,000 (TZS 100M) per 6 months. A business with TZS 20M annual sales is far below this threshold and is NOT required to register for VAT. However, it can voluntarily register if it wishes to reclaim VAT on business purchases.

instruction: Mchanga wa bahari unauchimbwa pwani — royalty ya nini Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Royalties za rasilimali asilia (madini, mchanga, mawe, na kadhalika) zinaamuliwa na Sheria ya Madini na mfumo wa kisheria wa Wizara ya Madini — nje ya wigo wangu wa compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na sheria za biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Madini au mshauri maalum kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana haki ya kudai mshahara wake wa nyuma ikiwa alidanganywa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi ambaye alipiwa chini ya mshahara wa chini ana haki ya kudai tofauti yote ya nyuma. Anaweza kufungua kesi mbele ya Kamati ya Usuluhishi wa Migogoro ya Kazi (CMA) au Mahakama ya Kazi. Muda wa madai ni miaka mitatu kutoka tarehe ya ukiukwaji.
question_en: Can an employee claim back pay if underpaid below minimum wage?
answer_en: Yes. An employee paid below minimum wage can claim the full shortfall in back pay. They can file at the Commission for Mediation and Arbitration (CMA) or the Labour Court. The limitation period for claims is three years from the date of the breach.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Wafanyabiashara wa mpakani (cross-border traders) Tunduma wana mahitaji gani ya uzingatiaji Tanzania?
answer_sw: Mfanyabiashara wa mpakani Tunduma-Nakonde anahitaji kuzingatia: (1) TIN ya TRA kwa biashara yake Tanzania, (2) Hati za forodha (customs documentation) za TANZRA/TRA — ikiwa ni pamoja na invoice ya biashara, packing list, na hati ya asili ya bidhaa, (3) EAC STR (Simplified Trade Regime) inaweza kutumika ikiwa bidhaa ziko kwenye orodha ya kawaida na kiasi ni chini ya USD 2,000, (4) Leseni ya biashara ya LGA ya Tunduma. Angalia KRA/ZRA kwa biashara ya upande wa Kenya/Zambia.
question_en: What compliance requirements do cross-border traders at Tunduma have in Tanzania?
answer_en: A Tunduma-Nakonde cross-border trader needs to comply with: (1) TRA TIN for their Tanzania business, (2) customs documentation for TANZRA/TRA — including commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin, (3) EAC STR (Simplified Trade Regime) may apply if goods are on the common list and amount is below USD 2,000, (4) Tunduma LGA business licence. Check KRA/ZRA for Kenya/Zambia side requirements.
next_review_trigger: EAC STR or customs procedure update

question_sw: EFD machine ni nini na inafanya kazi gani?
answer_sw: EFD ni mashine ya Electronic Fiscal Device — chombo cha kielektroniki kilichoidhinishwa na TRA kinachotumika kutoa risiti za kielektroniki (fiscal receipts) kwa wateja. Mashine hii imeunganishwa na mfumo wa TRA moja kwa moja, na inasajili kila muamala wa biashara na kutuma taarifa kwa TRA. Madhumuni yake ni kuhakikisha ukweli wa mauzo na kukusanya VAT kwa usahihi. Biashara zote zilizosajiliwa VAT zinahitajika kuwa na EFD. Thibitisha na TRA kwa sababu kanuni za EFD zinaweza kusasishwa.
question_en: What is an EFD machine and what does it do?
answer_en: EFD stands for Electronic Fiscal Device — a TRA-approved electronic device used to issue fiscal receipts to customers. The machine is directly connected to TRA's system and records every business transaction, transmitting data to TRA automatically. Its purpose is to ensure sales accuracy and correct VAT collection. All VAT-registered businesses are required to have an EFD.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kuhesabu gross-up ya PAYE — mfano rahisi.
answer_sw: Mfano rahisi: Mfanyakazi anahitaji net TZS 1,000,000 baada ya PAYE ya 25%. Gross-up = Net ÷ (1 - kiwango cha kodi) = TZS 1,000,000 ÷ 0.75 = TZS 1,333,333 gross. PAYE = TZS 1,333,333 × 25% = TZS 333,333. Net = TZS 1,333,333 - TZS 333,333 = TZS 1,000,000. Kwa viwango vya Tanzania vya juu, mahesabu yanakuwa ngumu zaidi kwa sababu ya viwango vya kujiendelea (progressive bands). Tumia mshauri wa kodi.
question_en: How to calculate PAYE gross-up — a simple example.
answer_en: Simple example: Employee needs net TZS 1,000,000 after 25% PAYE. Gross-up = Net ÷ (1 - tax rate) = TZS 1,000,000 ÷ 0.75 = TZS 1,333,333 gross. PAYE = TZS 1,333,333 × 25% = TZS 333,333. Net = TZS 1,333,333 - TZS 333,333 = TZS 1,000,000. For Tanzania's higher progressive bands, calculations become more complex. Use a tax advisor.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu wa hati ya uhamishaji wa hisa katika sekta ya madini Tanzania ni sawa na hati ya ardhi ya kawaida?
answer_sw: Uhamishaji wa hisa katika sekta ya madini Tanzania unaweza kuwa na masharti maalum ya ushuru chini ya Sheria ya Madini na mfumo wake wa ushuru. Viwango au exemptions zinaweza kutofautiana na uhamishaji wa ardhi wa kawaida. Ni muhimu kupata ushauri maalum wa mwanasheria wa madini na kodi kwa aina hii ya muamala.
question_en: Is stamp duty on a mining sector share transfer the same as a regular land transfer in Tanzania?
answer_en: Mining sector share transfers in Tanzania may have special tax provisions under the Mining Act and its fiscal regime. Rates or exemptions may differ from regular land transfers. It is important to obtain specialist advice from a mining and tax lawyer for this type of transaction.
next_review_trigger: Mining Act or Stamp Duty Act amendment

question_sw: BRELA ni nini na inafanya nini?
answer_sw: BRELA ni Business Registrations and Licensing Agency — shirika la serikali la Tanzania linalosimamia usajilishaji wa biashara, ikiwa ni pamoja na makampuni (companies), majina ya biashara, ushirikiano (partnerships), na haki za miliki ya akili (intellectual property). Ili biashara yako iwe halali kisheria Tanzania, lazima isajiliwe na BRELA au mamlaka nyingine inayohusika. Tovuti yao ni brela.go.tz.
question_en: What is BRELA and what does it do?
answer_en: BRELA is the Business Registrations and Licensing Agency — the Tanzanian government body that oversees business registration, including companies, business names, partnerships, and intellectual property rights. For your business to be legally recognised in Tanzania, it must be registered with BRELA or the relevant authority. Their website is brela.go.tz.

question_sw: Kifupi: GN 487A ni nini, inazuia nini, na adhabu ni zipi — jibu kwa sentensi tatu tu?
answer_sw: GN 487A ni Amri ya Leseni za Biashara (2025) inayozuia watu WASIO RAIA wa Tanzania kumiliki biashara katika makundi 15 maalum — hii ni AMRI YA BIASHARA, si ya makazi. Makundi yaliyozuiliwa yanajumuisha: rejareja, jumla, pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, saluni, forex, vituo vya mafuta, madalali, usafirishaji wa forodha, utalii, ajira, courier, vipande, kusaga unga, na nyingine 2. Adhabu kwa mgeni anayevunja amri ni: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 (si zaidi), na kufutwa kwa viza; Mtanzania anayemsaidia anaweza kupata faini ya TZS milioni 5 au miezi 3 jela.
question_en: Summary: what is GN 487A, what does it prohibit, and what are the penalties — answer in three sentences only?
answer_en: GN 487A is a Business Licensing Order (2025) that prohibits NON-TANZANIAN CITIZENS from owning businesses in 15 specific categories — it is a BUSINESS ORDER, not an immigration or residence permit order. Prohibited categories include: retail, wholesale, mobile money, phone repair, salons, forex bureaus, petrol stations, brokerage, clearing and forwarding, travel agencies, employment bureaus, courier, spare parts, flour milling, and one other. Penalties for a non-citizen violating the Order are: a minimum TZS 10 million fine, up to 6 months imprisonment (not exceeding), and visa revocation; a Tanzanian who assists may face a TZS 5 million fine or 3 months imprisonment.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Adhabu gani inatumika kwa hati isiyopigwa stempu inayowasilishwa mahakamani?
answer_sw: Hati isiyopigwa stempu haiwezi kukubalika kama ushahidi mahakamani bila kwanza kulipa kodi ya stempu inayostahili pamoja na adhabu inayotozwa na Mahakama. Pia, mtu anayetumia hati isiyo na stempu kama ushahidi anaweza kulazimishwa kulipa kodi ya stempu yenyewe. Zaidi ya hayo, Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu ina adhabu za jinai kwa kukwepa kwa makusudi. Daima piga stempu hati ndani ya siku 30 kuepuka matatizo makubwa mahakamani.
answer_en: A document without stamp duty cannot be admitted as evidence in court without first paying the applicable stamp duty plus a penalty imposed by the Court. Additionally, a person seeking to use an unstamped document as evidence may be ordered to pay the stamp duty themselves. Furthermore, the Stamp Duty Act carries criminal penalties for deliberate evasion. Always stamp documents within 30 days to avoid major problems in court.
question_en: What penalty applies to an unstamped document submitted as evidence in court?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — penalties for unstamped instruments

question_sw: Kampuni ilinunua jengo kwa biashara na kulipa VAT — inaweza kudai refund?
answer_sw: Ununuzi wa mali isiyohamishika (jengo) unaweza kuzalisha input VAT kama muuzaji alikuwa amesajiliwa VAT na shughuli inastahili. Hata hivyo, mauzo ya ardhi na majengo kwa kawaida yana matibabu maalum ya VAT Tanzania. Thibitisha hali ya VAT ya ununuzi maalum wa jengo lako na mshauri wa kodi au TRA.
question_en: A company bought a building for business and paid VAT — can it claim a refund?
answer_en: Purchasing immovable property (a building) can generate input VAT if the seller was VAT-registered and the supply qualifies. However, sales of land and buildings generally have special VAT treatment in Tanzania. Confirm the VAT status of your specific building purchase with a tax advisor or TRA.

instruction: Mteja akiripoti biashara yangu kwa TRA kwa kutotoa risiti za EFD -- TRA inaweza kufanya nini?
output: TRA inaweza kufanya yafuatayo: (1) kufanya ukaguzi wa ghafla wa biashara yako bila taarifa ya kabla, (2) kuamuru uwasilishaji wa rekodi za mauzo, (3) kutoza faini kwa kila risiti iliyokosekana, na (4) katika hali mbaya, kufunga biashara. Ripoti moja ya mteja inaweza kuchochea ukaguzi kamili. Thibitisha hatua za TRA na tra.go.tz.

instruction: Mbia wa serikali anakata VAT yangu. Niandikaje kwenye VAT return yangu?
output: Kwenye VAT return yako, ripoti VAT iliyokatwa kama pembejeo (input VAT credit). Tumia certificate ya withholding iliyotolewa na serikali (mnunuzi anayehitimu) kama ushahidi. Hakikisha certificate ina TIN yako, maelezo ya bidhaa, kiwango kilichotumika, na kiasi kilichokatwa. Ikiwa certificate haipo, omba kabla ya kuwasilisha return ifikapo tarehe 20.

question_sw: Biashara inaweza kukata mwajiriwa wake kama msimamizi wa EFD — mwajiriwa huyo atawajibika kwa makosa ya EFD?
answer_sw: Mwajiri ana jukumu kuu la kisheria la kuhakikisha EFD inatumika vizuri — jukumu hili haliwezi kuhamishwa kabisa kwa mwajiriwa. Hata kama mwajiriwa fulani ameteuliwa kusimamia EFD, adhabu za TRA kwa makosa ya EFD zinaelekezwa kwa BIASHARA (mwajiri) si mwajiriwa mmoja mmoja. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kuhakikisha mafunzo mazuri ya wafanyakazi na mifumo ya ufuatiliaji wa ndani.
question_en: A business can appoint an employee as EFD supervisor — will that employee be responsible for EFD errors?
answer_en: The employer has the primary legal responsibility to ensure the EFD is used correctly — this responsibility cannot be fully transferred to an employee. Even if a specific employee is appointed to supervise the EFD, TRA penalties for EFD violations are directed at the BUSINESS (employer) not an individual employee. The employer has a duty to ensure proper staff training and internal monitoring systems.

question_sw: Wakati kampuni mpya inaandikishwa, Hati ya Kuasisi Ushirika (Memorandum of Association) inahitaji kodi ya stempu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Memorandum of Association ya kampuni inahitaji kodi ya stempu ya TZS 10,000 kulingana na jedwali la Sheria ya Kodi ya Stempu. Hati hii lazima ipigwe stempu wakati wa usajili wa kampuni au kabla ya hapo. Kwa ushirika (partnership), ada ya kodi ya stempu inategemea mtaji wa ushirika: TZS 1,000 kama mtaji hauzidi TZS 10,000; TZS 5,000 kama mtaji kati ya TZS 100,000 na TZS 1,000,000; na TZS 10,000 katika hali nyingine.
answer_en: Yes. A company's Memorandum of Association requires stamp duty of TZS 10,000 under the schedule of the Stamp Duty Act. This document must be stamped at the time of company registration or earlier. For a partnership deed, the stamp duty depends on the partnership capital: TZS 1,000 if capital does not exceed TZS 10,000; TZS 5,000 if capital is between TZS 100,000 and TZS 1,000,000; and TZS 10,000 in other cases.
question_en: When a new company is registered, does the Memorandum of Association require stamp duty?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — MoA and partnership schedule

instruction: Wanunuzi wanaohitimu wangu hawajui wana jukumu la withholding. Niwasaiduje?
output: Waambie: wanunuzi wanaohitimu (qualifying buyers) wana wajibu wa kisheria wa kukata VAT. Wizara, benki, na makampuni ya simu yaliyoteuliwa ni mifano. Wajibu wao: (1) kutoa certificate ya withholding kwa kila msambazaji; (2) kupeleka VAT iliyokatwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 20; (3) kuwasilisha VAT return yao wenyewe. Kama hawajui, waelekeze TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

question_sw: 'Mnunuzi anayehitimu' (qualifying buyer) kwa VAT withholding ni nani hasa — ni mtu yeyote aliyesajili VAT?
answer_sw: Hapana — 'mnunuzi anayehitimu' (qualifying buyer) si mtu yeyote aliyesajili VAT. Qualifying buyer ni: (a) Wizara za Serikali na taasisi za serikali; (b) taasisi zinazohifadhi mapato yake mwenyewe (self-accounting entities); au (c) mtu aliyeteuliwa rasmi na Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA kama wakala wa zuio la VAT (designated VAT withholding agent). Kampuni ya kawaida iliyosajili VAT si qualifying buyer — haiwezi kuzuia VAT ya wasambazaji wake bila uteuzi maalum wa TRA.
question_en: Who exactly is a 'qualifying buyer' for VAT withholding — is it anyone who has registered for VAT?
answer_en: No — a 'qualifying buyer' is not anyone who has registered for VAT. A qualifying buyer is: (a) Government ministries and government institutions; (b) self-accounting entities; or (c) a person formally designated by the TRA Commissioner General as a designated VAT withholding agent. An ordinary company that has registered for VAT is NOT a qualifying buyer — it cannot withhold VAT from its suppliers without a specific TRA designation.

instruction: Kampuni ya Kichina inayomilikiwa na Wachina lakini imesajiliwa Tanzania kama kampuni ya Tanzania — je, GN 487A inaitumia?
output: GN 487A inazingatia uraia wa wamiliki/wadhibiti halisi, si tu usajili wa kisheria. Kampuni iliyosajiliwa Tanzania lakini inayomilikiwa na raia wa kigeni (wamiliki wa hisa, wakurugenzi wanaodhibiti) inaweza bado kukiuka GN 487A kwa shughuli zilizo katika orodha ya 15. Hii inaitwa 'shell company' au kampuni ya kimwamba. Mahakama na Idara ya Uhamiaji wanaweza kuchunguza zaidi ya jina la kisheria. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje (foreign company) inaweza kumiliki duka la reja reja Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana chini ya GN 487A. Biashara ya reja reja ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni. Kampuni inayomilikiwa na wageni haiwezi kufanya biashara ya reja reja Tanzania Bara. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na TIC.
question_en: Can a foreign-owned company own a retail shop in Tanzania?
answer_en: No under GN 487A. Retail trade is one of the 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens. A company owned by foreigners cannot conduct retail business in Tanzania Mainland. Confirm with the Immigration Department and TIC.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

question_sw: Biashara yangu inatoa huduma za usafi (cleaning services). Je, EFD inahitajika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — huduma za usafi zilizo na usajili wa VAT zinahitaji EFD au VFD. Sheria ya EFD inatumika kwa biashara zote za VAT bila kujali aina ya huduma. Ukisajiliwa kwa VAT, lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala wa huduma. Kama mauzo yako ni chini ya kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka), huhitajiwi kujisajili kwa VAT na kwa hivyo EFD haikuhusu.
question_en: My business provides cleaning services. Is EFD required?
answer_en: Yes — cleaning services that are VAT-registered require EFD or VFD. EFD law applies to all VAT businesses regardless of service type. Once VAT-registered, you must issue an EFD receipt for every service transaction. If your sales are below the VAT threshold (TZS 200M/year), you are not required to register for VAT and therefore EFD does not apply.

instruction: Mtunza watoto wangu (babysitter) analipwa mara kwa mara — NSSF inahitajika?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Hata babysitter anayefanya kazi mara kwa mara kama mfanyakazi wako wa kawaida anaweza kustahili NSSF kulingana na hali ya mkataba. Mfanyakazi wa kawaida (regular employee): NSSF inahitajika. Kazi ya mara moja tu (one-off task): inaweza kuwa mikataba ya huduma, si employment. Thibitisha hali ya mkataba na mwanasheria wa kazi au NSSF.

instruction: Tofauti kati ya bidhaa zero-rated na exempt kwa VAT ni nini?
output: Zero-rated: bidhaa zinazolipiwa VAT ya 0% — biashara inaweza kudai pembejeo ya VAT (input VAT) kwenye ununuzi. Exempt: bidhaa ambazo haziko ndani ya mfumo wa VAT kabisa — biashara haiwezi kudai pembejeo. Tofauti hii ni muhimu sana kwa biashara zinazonunua vifaa: kama unauza bidhaa exempt pekee, huwezi kudai input VAT. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi au TRA kujua kundi la bidhaa zako.

instruction: Nina duka la nguo lenye wafanyakazi 4 — OSHA inashughulikia duka langu?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Duka lako lenye wafanyakazi 4 linashughulikiwa na OSHA — hakuna kizingiti cha ukubwa. Mahitaji yako: (1) Sajili eneo lako la kazi na OSHA. (2) Hakikisha mazingira ya kazi ni salama (mwanga, hewa, usafi). (3) Weka mipango ya dharura (emergency plan). Ukaguzi wa OSHA unaweza kufanyika wakati wowote bila taarifa.

instruction: Nataka kuanzisha biashara ya utalii Zanzibar -- BRELA Bara inatosha?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kuhusu usajili wa biashara Zanzibar. Zanzibar ina mfumo wake wa usajili wa biashara tofauti na BRELA Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na Zanzibar Business and Property Centre (ZBPC) au mshauri wa kisheria aliyesajiliwa Zanzibar kwa usajili wa biashara ya utalii Zanzibar.
