question_sw: WHT ya asilimia 5 inatumika kwa malipo ya mtu binafsi wa Tanzania wa huduma za kitaalamu — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Malipo ya ada za usimamizi na huduma za kitaalamu kwa mtu binafsi MKAZI wa Tanzania yanakatwa WHT ya asilimia 5. Kwa wasio wakazi (non-resident consultants), kiwango ni asilimia 15. Mwajiri anayemkabidhi mshauri Tanzania mtu binafsi atakata asilimia 5 kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: WHT of 5% applies to payments to a Tanzanian individual for professional services — is this correct?
answer_en: Yes. Management and professional service fee payments to a RESIDENT individual in Tanzania attract 5% WHT. For non-resident consultants the rate is 15%. An employer engaging a Tanzanian individual consultant will deduct 5% before payment.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kuomba kibali cha kazi kwa mgeni kabla ya kumwajiri rasmi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mara nyingi mwajiri anaomba kibali cha kazi kabla ya mfanyakazi kufika Tanzania ili mfanyakazi aweze kuja na kujiunga mara moja. Hii inaitwa ombi la kibali kabla ya kufika. Mkataba wa ajira uliosainwa unahitajika kama sehemu ya ombi, lakini mfanyakazi anaweza bado kuwa nje ya Tanzania wakati ombi linashughulikiwa.
question_en: Can a company apply for a work permit for a foreigner before officially hiring them?
answer_en: Yes. Often an employer applies for a work permit before the employee arrives in Tanzania so the worker can join immediately on arrival. This is called a pre-arrival permit application. A signed employment contract is required as part of the application but the worker may still be outside Tanzania while the application is processed.

question_sw: Tax clearance certificate na TIN certificate — ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: TIN certificate: hati inayothibitisha una TIN (Tax Identification Number) — inathibitisha umesajiliwa na TRA. Inatolewa baada ya usajili wa TIN. Tax clearance certificate: hati inayothibitisha huna deni la kodi lililolipwa — inaonyesha una hali nzuri ya kodi. Inatolewa baada ya kulipa kodi zote zinazodaiwa. TIN = utambulisho; Tax clearance = uthibitisho wa uzuri wa kodi.
question_en: Tax clearance certificate and TIN certificate — what is the difference?
answer_en: TIN certificate: a document confirming you have a TIN (Tax Identification Number) — it confirms you are registered with TRA. Issued after TIN registration. Tax clearance certificate: a document confirming you have no outstanding tax debt — it shows your tax standing is clean. Issued after paying all owed taxes. TIN = identity; Tax clearance = confirmation of good tax standing.

question_sw: Malipo ya mwisho ya kazi (gratuity/terminal benefits) yanastahili PAYE?
answer_sw: Malipo ya mwisho wa kazi kama vile malipo ya likizo yasiyotumika, mafao ya kujitenga (gratuity), na malipo ya fidia yanaweza kustahili PAYE kulingana na sheria ya kodi. Sehemu fulani inaweza kuwa huru — thibitisha hesabu halisi na TRA kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: Are terminal benefits and gratuity subject to PAYE?
answer_en: Terminal payments such as unused leave pay-out, gratuity, and severance may be subject to PAYE depending on the tax rules. Certain portions may be exempt — confirm the exact calculation with TRA before payment.

instruction: Kampuni ya SEZ Tanzania inasamehewa VAT kwenye manunuzi yake yote?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara kwa biashara za kawaida. Msamaha wa VAT kwa kampuni za SEZ (Special Economic Zones) inashughulikiwa na EPZA na inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa sheria za uwekezaji. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au EPZA kupitia epza.go.tz.

question_sw: Maana ya SDL ni "Skills Delivery Levy" — je, ni hivyo?
answer_sw: Hapana. Jina sahihi ni Skills Development Levy — si "Skills Delivery Levy". Kwa Kiswahili: Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi. Neno muhimu ni "Development" (Kukuza) — kodi hii inafadhili ukuzaji wa ujuzi wa wafanyakazi. Kiwango: asilimia 3.5, mwajiri peke yake, wafanyakazi 10+, siku 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: SDL means "Skills Delivery Levy" — is that right?
answer_en: No. The correct name is Skills Development Levy — not "Skills Delivery Levy". In Swahili: Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi. The key word is "Development" (Kukuza) — this levy funds skills development for workers. Rate: 3.5%, employer only, 10+ employees, due 7th of following month.

question_sw: Biashara iliyosajili VAT lazima iwasilishe tamko la VAT hata kama haikufanya mauzo mwezi huo Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara iliyosajili VAT Tanzania lazima iwasilishe tamko la VAT kwa TRA kila mwezi bila kujali kama ilifanya mauzo au la. Tamko la sifuri (nil return) linawasilishwa ikiwa hakuna mauzo. Tarehe ya mwisho ni tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kushindwa kuwasilisha nil return kunasababisha adhabu kama vile kutokufanya mauzo hakumaanishi tamko halikuhitajika.
question_en: Must a VAT-registered business file a VAT return even if it made no sales that month in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. A VAT-registered business in Tanzania must file a VAT return with TRA every month regardless of whether it made sales or not. A nil return is filed if there were no sales. The deadline is the 20th of the following month. Failing to file a nil return attracts penalties just as if sales had been made but not reported.
next_review_trigger: Tax Administration Act VAT filing update

question_sw: VAT inalipwa kwa muda gani na msajiliwa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Msajiliwa wa VAT analipa VAT kupitia return ya VAT ya kila mwezi. Return na malipo yanatolewa ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa biashara. Thibitisha tarehe na TRA.
question_en: When does a VAT registrant file and pay VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: A VAT registrant pays VAT through a monthly VAT return. The return and payment are due by the 20th of the month following the trading month. Confirm the deadline with TRA.

question_sw: Muhtasari: GN 487A inamaanisha nini kwa mfanyabiashara mgeni Tanzania?
answer_sw: GN 487A (28 Julai 2025) inamaanisha: (1) Shughuli 15 zimefungwa kwa umiliki na uendeshaji wa raia wa kigeni — biashara ya jumla, rejareja, mobile money, salon, ukarabati wa simu na nyingine. (2) Ukikiuka: faini ya angalau TZS 10M, hadi miezi 6 gerezani, visa inafutwa. (3) Mtanzania anayekusaidia kukiuka: faini ya TZS 5M au miezi 3. (4) Utekelezaji: Idara ya Uhamiaji. (5) Kigezo: uraia — si muda wa makazi, si utaifa, si leseni ya zamani.
question_en: Summary: what does GN 487A mean for a non-citizen business operator in Tanzania?
answer_en: GN 487A (28 July 2025) means: (1) 15 activities are closed to ownership and operation by non-citizens — wholesale, retail, mobile money, salon, phone repair and others. (2) If you violate: minimum TZS 10M fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, visa revoked. (3) Tanzanian who helps you violate: TZS 5M fine or 3 months. (4) Enforcement: Immigration Services Department. (5) Criterion: citizenship — not length of residence, not nationality, not a prior licence.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Je, ushuru wa stempu unaweza kuepukwa kwa kuandika mkataba nje ya Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kufanya au kusaini mkataba nje ya Tanzania HAKUEPUSHI ushuru wa stempu Tanzania ikiwa mkataba unatumika au unatekelezwa Tanzania. Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu Tanzania inashughulikia nyaraka zinazohusiana na mali au biashara Tanzania bila kujali mahali ziliposainiwa.
question_en: Can stamp duty be avoided by writing a contract outside Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Signing or drafting a contract outside Tanzania does NOT avoid Tanzania stamp duty if the contract is used or executed in Tanzania. The Tanzania Stamp Duty Act covers instruments relating to Tanzania property or business regardless of where they were signed.

question_sw: Adhabu ya kulipa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A ni nini?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anayolipa chini ya mshahara wa chini anaweza kukabiliwa na malimbikizo ya malipo tofauti kwa mfanyakazi, faini chini ya Sheria ya Ajira na Mahusiano ya Kazini (ELRA), na mashitaka ya jinai. Inspekta wa Kazi ana mamlaka ya kukagua na kuagiza malipo ya nyuma.
question_en: What is the penalty for paying below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: An employer paying below the minimum wage faces back-pay liability to the employee, fines under the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA), and possible criminal prosecution. A Labour Officer can inspect and order back payment.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Mgeni anaweza kuanza kufanya kazi Tanzania kabla ya kupata kibali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mgeni lazima apate kibali cha makazi (Class C) kabla ya kuanza kufanya kazi. Kufanya kazi kabla ya kibali ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya uhamiaji na unaweza kusababisha kufukuzwa nchini. Mwajiri pia anachukuliwa na jukumu. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Can a non-citizen start working in Tanzania before receiving their permit?
answer_en: No. A non-citizen must obtain a Class C residence permit before starting work. Working before a permit is an immigration law violation and can result in deportation. The employer also bears liability. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Mwanandoa wa kigeni ana uraia wa nchi mbili — Tanzania na nchi yake ya asili. Je, ana tatizo la GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana — mtu mwenye uraia wa Tanzania (hata kama pia ana uraia wa nchi nyingine) hana matatizo ya GN 487A kwa biashara. GN 487A inaangalia kama mtu ni 'raia wa Tanzania' kwa maana ya BRELA, TRA, na Idara ya Uhamiaji. Mtu mwenye pasipoti ya Tanzania na TIN ya Tanzania anachukuliwa raia kwa madhumuni haya hata kama ana uraia mwingine pia.
question_en: A foreign-born spouse has dual citizenship — Tanzania and their country of origin. Do they have a GN 487A problem?
answer_en: No — a person with Tanzanian citizenship (even if they also hold another country's citizenship) has no GN 487A problem for business. GN 487A looks at whether a person is a 'Tanzanian citizen' in the sense recognised by BRELA, TRA, and the Immigration Department. A person with a Tanzanian passport and Tanzanian TIN is treated as a citizen for these purposes even if they also hold another citizenship.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A or citizenship law changes

question_sw: Mfuko wangu wa pensheni (pension fund) — kodi yake inakuwaje wakati wa kustaafu?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa mafao ya pensheni na mifuko ya pensheni wakati wa kustaafu ni eneo maalum la sheria ya jamii na kodi — hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Kodi ya mafao ya pensheni inategemea mfuko (NSSF, PSPF, GEPF, nk), aina ya malipo (mkupuo au malipo ya kila mwezi), na sheria inayosimamia mfuko huo. Wasiliana na msimamizi wa mfuko wako au mhesabu wa kodi aliyehitimu.
question_en: My pension fund — how is it taxed when I retire?
answer_en: Taxation of pension benefits and pension funds at retirement is a specialised area of social security and tax law — this is outside my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Pension benefit taxation depends on the fund (NSSF, PSPF, GEPF, etc.), type of payment (lump sum or monthly), and the law governing that fund. Contact your fund administrator or a qualified tax accountant.
next_review_trigger: Pension fund or income tax legislation changes

instruction: Nimeona bei ya bidhaa ikiwa VAT 5% — je Tanzania ina hii?
output: Hapana — Tanzania haina kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 5. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kama umeona 5% kwenye risiti au invoice, inaweza kuwa kosa la mfanyabiashara au bidhaa kutoka nchi nyingine (kama Kenya ina VAT 16% na Uingereza 20%). Tanzania: 18%, 16% (B2C digital), au 0% (zero-rated — mauzo ya nje/exports; exempt ni hali tofauti: haziruhusu kudai input VAT) peke yake.

instruction: NSSF faini ya kuchelewa ni ngapi — na riba pia?
output: NSSF ina adhabu mbili kwa kuchelewa: (1) FAINI ya 5% ya kiasi kisicholipwa kwa kila mwezi wa kuchelewa — inakusanyika kila mwezi. Mfano: NSSF TZS 100,000 haijalipwa kwa miezi 3 → faini = 5% × 100,000 × 3 = TZS 15,000. (2) RIBA ya kuchelewa — inaongezeka pia (kiwango kinabadilika kwa maamuzi ya NSSF). Kwa miezi mingi ya kuchelewa, deni linakuwa kubwa haraka. Mwajiri anashauriwa kulipa ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya mwisho wa mwezi wa malipo ya wafanyakazi. Thibitisha na nssf.go.tz kwa viwango vya sasa vya riba.

question_sw: Biashara yangu inafanywa mtandaoni tu — siuzi bidhaa za kimwili, ninauza huduma za kidijitali. Je, ninahitaji leseni yoyote?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara za mtandaoni (online businesses) Tanzania zinahitaji usajili wa kawaida wa biashara: usajili wa BRELA kama jina la biashara au kampuni, TIN kutoka TRA, na leseni ya LGA ikiwa una ofisi au anwani ya biashara. Pia, tangu Sheria ya Fedha 2022, huduma za kidijitali zinazotolewa nchini Tanzania zinatozwa Kodi ya Huduma za Kidijitali (Digital Service Tax — DST) ya asilimia 2 ya mapato ghafi. Ikiwa mapato yako yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT, lazima usajili VAT pia.
answer_en: Yes. Online businesses in Tanzania require standard business registration: BRELA registration as a business name or company, a TIN from TRA, and an LGA licence if you have an office or business address. Also, since the Finance Act 2022, digital services provided in Tanzania are subject to Digital Service Tax (DST) of 2% of gross revenue. If your income exceeds the VAT threshold, VAT registration is also required.
question_en: My business operates online only — I don't sell physical goods, just digital services. Do I need any licence?

question_sw: Cheti cha utiifu (Certificate of Compliance / Form 23) kinatumika kwa nini?
answer_sw: Cheti cha utiifu (Form 23) kinathibitisha kwamba kampuni ipo katika hali nzuri ya kisheria na imefuata mahitaji ya BRELA. Kinahitajika kwa shughuli nyingi kama: kufungua akaunti ya benki, kutuma zabuni za serikali, na mikataba ya aina fulani. MUHIMU: Cheti hiki kinathibitisha uandikishwaji tu — BRELA inashauriwa kwamba usahihi wa maelezo ndani ya hati za kampuni haujathibitishwa.
question_en: What is a Certificate of Compliance (Form 23) used for?
answer_en: A Certificate of Compliance (Form 23) confirms that a company is in good legal standing and has met BRELA requirements. It is required for many activities such as: opening a bank account, submitting government tenders, and certain contracts. IMPORTANT: This certificate only confirms registration — BRELA advises that the accuracy of content in company documents has not been verified.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Mtu anayetoa taarifa (whistleblower) kuhusu mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A — ana ulinzi wowote?
output: GN 487A haisemi wazi juu ya ulinzi wa whistleblowers. Hata hivyo, Tanzania ina sheria ya jumla ya ulinzi wa whistleblowers katika mazingira fulani. Mtu anayetoa taarifa kuhusu ukiukwaji wa GN 487A kwa Idara ya Uhamiaji au polisi anaweza: (1) Kutoa taarifa kwa siri (anonymous tip) kwa polisi au Idara ya Uhamiaji; (2) Kuthibitisha kwa maandishi kwa Idara ya Uhamiaji. Hata hivyo, ulinzi rasmi wa kisheria dhidi ya kulipizwa kisasi kwa GN 487A peke yake haujabainishwa wazi. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa kisheria kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kufutwa (struck off) kwenye rejesta ya BRELA ikiwa haitofanya nini?
answer_sw: Kampuni inaweza kufutwa kwenye rejesta ya BRELA ikiwa: (1) haikuwasilisha annual return kwa miaka miwili au zaidi, (2) iliomba kufutwa mwenyewe (voluntary strike off), au (3) ikiwa kuna ushahidi kwamba haifanyi biashara. Kufutwa hakumaanisha kuondoa wajibu wote wa kisheria wa kampuni.
question_en: A company can be struck off the BRELA register if it fails to do what?
answer_en: A company can be struck off the BRELA register if: (1) it has not filed annual returns for two or more years, (2) it applies for voluntary strike off, or (3) there is evidence that it is not carrying on business. Strike off does not remove all legal liabilities of the company.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: SDL inahitajika kuanzia wafanyakazi wangapi — 5 au 10?
answer_sw: SDL inahitajika kuanzia wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi — si 5. Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 9 au chini yake hajalazimishwa kulipa SDL. Ukifika wafanyakazi 10, SDL inakuwa lazima tangu mwezi huo huo.
question_en: SDL is required from how many employees — 5 or 10?
answer_en: SDL is required from 10 or more employees — not 5. An employer with 9 or fewer employees is not required to pay SDL. Once you reach 10 employees, SDL becomes mandatory from that same month.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: WCF inacheswa vipi kwa mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ghafi — inalipwa na mwajiri peke yake. Kwa mshahara wa chini wa TZS 358,322: WCF = TZS 1,792 kwa mfanyakazi kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na WCF.
question_en: How is WCF calculated on the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) is 0.5% of total gross wages — paid by the employer only. On TZS 358,322 minimum wage: WCF = TZS 1,792 per employee per month. Confirm with WCF.

question_sw: Biashara ndogo yenye wafanyakazi 5 Tanzania inahitaji kulipa mchango wa SDL?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL (Skills Development Levy) inatumika kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 AU ZAIDI kwenye Mainland Tanzania. Biashara yenye wafanyakazi 5 tu HAIHITAJIKI kulipa SDL. Ikiwa biashara itakua na kufikia wafanyakazi 10, basi itaanza kulipa SDL ya asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara kila mwezi.
question_en: Does a small business with 5 employees in Tanzania need to pay SDL?
answer_en: No. SDL (Skills Development Levy) applies to employers with 10 OR MORE employees on Mainland Tanzania. A business with only 5 employees is NOT required to pay SDL. Once the business grows to reach 10 employees, it then starts paying SDL at 3.5% of total gross payroll monthly.

instruction: BRELA inaweza kufuta kampuni bila taarifa ya awali?
output: BRELA hufuata mchakato wa kisheria kabla ya kufuta orodha kampuni: (1) Kutuma notisi rasmi kwa kampuni (barua au gazeti rasmi); (2) Kutoa muda wa kujibu au kuwasilisha annual returns zilizokosekana; (3) Kama hakuna jibu — kufuta orodha rasmi. Kampuni zinapaswa kuhakikisha BRELA ina anwani sahihi ya mawasiliano — kama anwani imebadilika na kampuni haijapokea notisi, kufutwa kunaweza kutokea bila ujuzi wa kampuni. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz mara kwa mara.

question_sw: WCF na NSSF ni sawa — ni shirika moja tu — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. WCF na NSSF ni mashirika tofauti yanayofanya kazi tofauti. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) inashughulikia BIMA ya AJALI za kazi peke yake. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) inashughulikia USALAMA WA JAMII kwa upana zaidi — pensheni, matibabu, mama na mtoto. Waajiri lazima wasajiliwe na ZOTE MBILI tofauti.
question_en: WCF and NSSF are the same — they are just one organisation — is this true?
answer_en: No. WCF and NSSF are separate organisations with different functions. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) handles WORKPLACE ACCIDENT INSURANCE only. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) handles BROADER SOCIAL SECURITY — pensions, medical, maternity. Employers must register with BOTH separately.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Ushuru wa insurance premium levy — kampuni ya bima ndiyo inayolipa au mwananchi anayenunua bima?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Hali ya ulipaji wa insurance premium levy inashughulikiwa chini ya sheria ya bima na TIRA — inahitaji utaalamu maalum wa sekta ya bima. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TIRA kupitia tira.go.tz.

instruction: Biashara imesajiliwa kwa jina la mwanachama wa kwanza wa SACCOS — mgeni anayenufaika ni tatizo la GN 487A?
output: Ndiyo — GN 487A inazingatia MNUFAIKA (beneficiary) wa kweli wa biashara, si tu jina katika hati za kisheria. Kama mgeni anatonufaika na biashara, kupokea faida, au kudhibiti maamuzi — hata kama biashara imesajiliwa chini ya jina la mwanachama wa SACCOS au mtu mwingine — hii inaweza kuonekana kama ukiukwaji. Idara ya Uhamiaji na mahakama wanaweza kuchunguza 'beneficial ownership' — nani anafaidika kweli kweli. Hii inaitwa ukiukwaji wa 'substantive' bila kujali 'formal structure'. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Jinsi ya kuhesabu PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa Shilingi 600,000 kwa mwezi?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 600,000: Kanda ya 0%: Shilingi 270,000 → kodi sifuri. Kanda ya 8%: Shilingi 270,001–520,000 = Shilingi 250,000 × 8% = Shilingi 20,000. Kanda ya 20%: Shilingi 520,001–600,000 = Shilingi 80,000 × 20% = Shilingi 16,000. Jumla ya PAYE = Shilingi 36,000 kwa mwezi.
question_en: How to calculate PAYE for an employee earning TZS 600,000 per month?
answer_en: For a salary of TZS 600,000: 0% band: TZS 270,000 → zero tax. 8% band: TZS 270,001–520,000 = TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000. 20% band: TZS 520,001–600,000 = TZS 80,000 × 20% = TZS 16,000. Total PAYE = TZS 36,000 per month.

question_sw: PAYE haihusishi posho za usafiri — hizi zote zimefutwa kodi — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Posho nyingi zinazolipwa na mwajiri zinazidi mstari wa kisheria ZINATOZA PAYE. Posho za usafiri zinaweza kuwa exempt kama zinahusiana moja kwa moja na safari halisi za kazi na zina kiwango cha kawaida. Posho za jumla za usafiri zinazolipwa kila mwezi bila uhusiano na safari maalum za kazi zinatoza PAYE.
question_en: PAYE does not apply to transport allowances — these are all tax-free — is this true?
answer_en: No. Many employer-paid allowances above the statutory threshold ARE subject to PAYE. Transport allowances may be exempt if directly linked to actual work travel and at a reasonable rate. General monthly transport allowances paid without linkage to specific work trips are subject to PAYE.

question_sw: Usajili wa NSSF unagharimu kiasi gani na unachukua muda gani?
answer_sw: Usajili wa NSSF (National Social Security Fund) hauna ada ya usajili — ni BURE. Mwajiri anasajili kampuni yake na NSSF na kisha anasajili wafanyakazi wake. Mchakato unachukua siku 1-5 za kazi. Mara baada ya usajili, mwajiri anaanza kukatia na kuwasilisha michango ya NSSF kila mwezi (mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara wa jumla) ifikapo tarehe 10 ya mwezi unaofuata.
question_en: How much does NSSF registration cost and how long does it take?
answer_en: NSSF (National Social Security Fund) registration has no registration fee — it is FREE. An employer registers their company with NSSF and then registers their employees. The process takes 1-5 working days. Once registered, the employer begins deducting and remitting NSSF contributions monthly (employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage) by the 10th of the following month.
next_review_trigger: NSSF Act amendment or registration process update

instruction: Msafi wa ofisi yangu analipwa na kampuni nyingine ya usafi — mimi ninalipia NSSF yake?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Msafi wa kampuni nyingine: unayemlipia ni kampuni ya usafi — kampuni hiyo ndiyo mwajiri wake. Mwajiri halisi ndiye analipa NSSF. Kama unalipa mtu binafsi moja kwa moja (mkataba wako binafsi): wewe ndiyo mwajiri — una wajibu wa NSSF. Angalia mkataba wako kujua nani ni mwajiri rasmi.

question_sw: Kampuni ya media (radio, televisheni, au gazeti) inahitaji leseni gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kampuni za media Tanzania zinahitaji leseni kutoka Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano Tanzania (TCRA — Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority). Redio na televisheni zinahitaji leseni ya utangazaji (broadcasting licence) na leseni ya maudhui (content licence). Magazeti yanahitaji usajili wa chapisho (publication registration) kutoka Wizara ya Habari. Yote yanahitaji pia: usajili wa BRELA, TIN, na leseni ya LGA. Leseni ya TCRA ina ada na masharti ya kufuata kanuni za utangazaji.
answer_en: Media companies in Tanzania require a licence from the Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority (TCRA). Radio and television stations need a broadcasting licence and a content licence. Newspapers require publication registration from the Ministry of Information. All also require: BRELA registration, TIN, and an LGA licence. The TCRA licence has fees and conditions to comply with broadcasting regulations.
question_en: What licence does a media company (radio, television, or newspaper) need in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: Electronic and Postal Communications Act amendment

instruction: Mkanda wa biashara kwenye mtandao (online store) unaomilikiwa na mgeni — GN 487A inasema nini?
output: Online store ya rejareja inayomilikiwa na mgeni Tanzania inakabiliwa na GN 487A kwa sababu: (1) Biashara ya rejareja (orodha ya 1) imezuiwa kwa wageni — nje ya mtandao au mtandaoni; (2) GN 487A inazingatia MMILIKI wa biashara, si eneo la biashara au njia ya kuuza. Online store inayofikia wateja wa Tanzania na inayomilikiwa na mgeni anayeishi Tanzania inaweza kukiuka GN 487A — lakini hii ni tafsiri ya kisheria kwani GN 487A haisemi wazi kuhusu biashara za mtandaoni. Kama mmiliki yuko nje ya Tanzania kabisa na hafikii Tanzania moja kwa moja — hali inaweza kuwa ngumu kisheria. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji TIN kabla ya kumwomba mfanyakazi mgeni kibali cha kazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni lazima iwe na TIN iliyotolewa na TRA na iwe imesajiliwa kisheria Tanzania kabla ya kuomba kibali cha kazi kwa mfanyakazi mgeni. Idara ya Uhamiaji inataka uthibitisho wa usajili wa kampuni na hali ya kodi. Thibitisha na TRA na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Does an employer need a TIN before sponsoring a foreign work permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. The company must have a TRA-issued TIN and be legally registered in Tanzania before applying for a work permit for a foreign employee. The Immigration Department requires proof of company registration and tax compliance. Confirm with TRA and the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Je, EFD inatoa taarifa za input VAT pia?
answer_sw: EFD ya biashara yako inaandika OUTPUT VAT (VAT unayokusanya kutoka kwa wateja). INPUT VAT (VAT unayolipa kwa manunuzi wako) inajumuishwa kwenye VAT return yako kwa msingi wa invoices/risiti za EFD ulizopokea kutoka kwa wasambazaji wako walioidhinishwa. Tofauti kati ya output VAT na input VAT ndiyo inayolipwa TRA au kurejeshwa kwako (refund). EFD yako inahusika na output VAT tu.
question_en: Does EFD also record input VAT?
answer_en: Your business's EFD records OUTPUT VAT (VAT you collect from customers). INPUT VAT (VAT you pay to your suppliers) is included in your VAT return based on EFD receipts/invoices you receive from your approved suppliers. The difference between output VAT and input VAT is what gets paid to TRA or refunded to you. Your EFD is concerned with output VAT only.

question_sw: Ardhi inayohamishiwa na serikali (compulsory acquisition) ina ushuru wa stempu?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, uhamishaji wa ardhi kupitia unyakuzi wa lazima na serikali (compulsory acquisition) umeweza kusamehewa ushuru wa stempu Tanzania. Hata hivyo, masharti maalum ya kisheria yanatumika na inashauriwa kutafuta ushauri wa kisheria kwa hali yako. Fidia inayolipwa na serikali kwa ardhi iliyonyakuliwa inaweza pia kuwa na matokeo ya kodi mengine.
question_en: Does land transferred through government compulsory acquisition attract stamp duty?
answer_en: Generally, land transfer through compulsory government acquisition may be exempt from stamp duty in Tanzania. However, specific legal conditions apply and it is advisable to seek legal advice for your situation. Compensation paid by the government for acquired land may also have other tax implications.
next_review_trigger: Land Acquisition Act or Stamp Duty Act amendment

instruction: Kampuni yangu mama nje ya Tanzania inatoa dhamana (guarantee) kwa mkopo wangu — TRA inaona dhamana hii vipi?
output: Dhamana ya kampuni mama (parent guarantee) kwa mikopo ya kampuni tanzu inaweza kuathiri tathmini ya transfer pricing chini ya kanuni za TRA. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa jinsi ya kuweka thamani ya dhamana na nyaraka zinazohitajika kwa TRA. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kama TRA haikujibu pingamizi langu baada ya miezi 6, ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA hajatoa uamuzi ndani ya miezi 6, pingamizi linachukuliwa kama limekataliwa kisheria. Unaweza basi kukata rufaa moja kwa moja kwa TRAB ndani ya siku 45. Hakuna haja ya kusubiri muda zaidi — tuma rufaa yako kwa TRAB haraka.
question_en: If TRA does not respond to my objection after 6 months what do I do?
answer_en: If the TRA Commissioner General has not issued a decision within 6 months, the objection is deemed rejected by law. You can then appeal directly to TRAB within 45 days. There is no need to wait longer — file your TRAB appeal promptly.

question_sw: Improvement notice na prohibition notice kutoka OSHA ni tofauti vipi?
answer_sw: Improvement notice (notisi ya uboreshaji): OSHA inakupa muda maalum kurekebisha tatizo. Prohibition notice (amri ya kuzuia): shughuli lazima zisimame MARA MOJA kwa sababu kuna hatari ya haraka ya kifo au majeraha makubwa. Prohibition ni hatua kali zaidi inayohitaji kusimamisha kazi bila kucheleweshwa.
question_en: How do an improvement notice and a prohibition notice from OSHA differ?
answer_en: Improvement notice: OSHA gives you a set time to fix a problem. Prohibition notice: operations must stop IMMEDIATELY because there is imminent risk of death or serious injury. A prohibition is the more serious step requiring an instant work stoppage with no delay.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi (casual worker) ana haki ya WCF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi na wa msimu wana haki ya WCF kwa majeraha yanayotokana na kazi wakati wa muda wao wa kufanya kazi. Waajiri wanalazimika kusajili pia wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi kwa WCF au kuhakikisha wanafunikwa chini ya orodha ya jumla ya ajira.
question_en: Does a casual (short-term) worker have WCF rights?
answer_en: Yes. Casual and seasonal workers are entitled to WCF for work-related injuries during their period of employment. Employers must also register casual workers with WCF or ensure they are covered under the general employment list.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Wastani wa mshahara wa chini wa sekta binafsi Tanzania BAADA ya GN 605A ni TZS ngapi?
output: Wastani wa mshahara wa chini wa sekta binafsi baada ya GN 605A ni TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi. Hii ni WASTANI kwa sekta zote 16 — si kiwango cha juu kabisa. Kiwango cha juu kabisa (maximum) chini ya GN 605A ni karibu TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi, kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Kiwango cha chini kabisa ni karibu TZS 175,000. Thibitisha kiwango halisi cha sekta yako na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya mwisho (final withholding tax) na isiyo ya mwisho (non-final) ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya mwisho: mpokeaji haawezi kudai mkopo wa kodi — kodi hiyo ndiyo ya mwisho kabisa kwa mapato hayo. Kodi ya zuio isiyo ya mwisho: mpokeaji anaweza kudai mkopo dhidi ya kodi yake ya mwaka. Thibitisha hali ya malipo yako na TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between final and non-final withholding tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: Final withholding tax: the recipient cannot claim a tax credit — it is the final tax on that income. Non-final withholding tax: the recipient can claim a credit against their annual tax liability. Confirm your payment classification with TRA.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri analazimika kulipa NSSF ya sehemu ya mwajiri wakati mfanyakazi yuko likizoni?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — mchango wa mwajiri (employer contribution) wa NSSF ni wajibu wa mwajiri, si mfanyakazi. Wakati mfanyakazi yuko likizo yoyote inayolipwa (maternity, sick leave, annual leave), mwajiri anaendelea kulipa NSSF ya sehemu yake (10%) na kukata mchango wa mfanyakazi (10%) kutoka mshahara unaolipwa. Mwajiri hawezi kusimamisha mchango wake wa 10% kwa sababu mfanyakazi yuko likizoni.
question_en: Is the employer required to pay their NSSF portion while an employee is on leave?
answer_en: Yes — the employer's NSSF contribution is the employer's obligation, not the employee's. While an employee is on any paid leave (maternity, sick leave, annual leave), the employer continues to pay their share (10%) and deduct the employee's share (10%) from wages paid. The employer cannot suspend their 10% contribution because the employee is on leave.

question_sw: Kwa muhtasari: SDL inamaanisha nini kwa mwajiri wa kawaida Tanzania?
answer_sw: SDL (Skills Development Levy) kwa mwajiri: (1) Jina kamili: Skills Development Levy — si disability leave wala aina yoyote ya likizo; (2) Kiwango: 3.5% ya gross payroll; (3) Kizingiti: wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi; (4) Analipa: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi); (5) Kwenda: TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata; (6) Lengo: kufadhili mafunzo ya ufundi (VETA).
question_en: Summary: what does SDL mean for a typical employer in Tanzania?
answer_en: SDL (Skills Development Levy) for the employer: (1) Full name: Skills Development Levy — not disability leave or any type of leave; (2) Rate: 3.5% of gross payroll; (3) Threshold: 10 or more employees; (4) Payer: employer only (not the employee); (5) Destination: TRA by the 7th of the following month; (6) Purpose: to fund vocational training (VETA).
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

instruction: Je, kampuni ya hisa ya Tanzania inaweza kumilikiwa 100% na mgeni?
output: Ndiyo — sheria za uwekezaji Tanzania zinamlruhusu mgeni kumiliki hisa 100% katika kampuni nyingi za sekta. Hata hivyo, kuna vikwazo: (1) GN 487A inazuia shughuli katika orodha ya 15 — hata kama kampuni imesajiliwa Tanzania na kumilikiwa 100% na mgeni, kufanya shughuli hizo bado ni marufuku; (2) Sekta fulani (madini, ardhi, media) zina vikwazo vya umiliki wa kigeni; (3) Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) inasimamia uwekezaji wa kigeni. Kwa sekta zilizoruhusiwa (viwanda, kilimo, utalii), umiliki 100% wa kigeni unawezekana. Thibitisha na TIC (tic.go.tz) na wakili wa biashara.

question_sw: Jumla ya mishahara ya kampuni ni TZS 25,000,000 kwa mwezi. SDL ni TZS ngapi? Na ikiwa tungepoteza wafanyakazi 2 na kubaki na 9, SDL itabadilika vipi?
answer_sw: Sasa hivi (25 wafanyakazi, TZS 25,000,000): SDL = TZS 25,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 875,000. Ikiwa utabaki na wafanyakazi 9 (chini ya 10): haulazimiki tena kulipa SDL — kiwango cha chini ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. SDL itakuwa sifuri. Hata hivyo, thibisha na TRA kwamba idadi ya wafanyakazi imepungua kabla ya kusimamisha malipo.
question_en: Total company payroll is TZS 25,000,000 per month. What is the SDL? And if we lose 2 employees and are left with 9, how does SDL change?
answer_en: Currently (25 employees, TZS 25,000,000): SDL = TZS 25,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 875,000. If you are left with 9 employees (below 10): you are no longer required to pay SDL — the threshold is 10 or more employees. SDL becomes zero. However, confirm with TRA that your employee count has decreased before stopping payments.

instruction: Nimelipa VAT yangu yote TRA lakini serikali pia ilikata. Je, nitalipa mara mbili?
output: Hapana, hili si tatizo ikiwa umefuata utaratibu. Serikali ilikata VAT kwa niaba yako (withholding). Kiasi hicho hakihitajiki kulipwa tena nawe. Kwenye VAT return yako, ripoti kiasi kilichokatwa kama pembejeo (input VAT) na tumia certificate ya withholding kama ushahidi. TRA itarekebisha hesabu yako. Kama una mashaka, wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Common List ya STR ina bidhaa ngapi na ina bidhaa gani?
answer_sw: Common List ya STR ina takriban bidhaa 370 zilizoidhinishwa. Inajumuisha hasa: mazao ya kilimo (mahindi, viazi, mboga, matunda), vyakula vya kaya, nguo za kawaida, na bidhaa ndogo ndogo za kila siku. Orodha kamili inapatikana kwenye ofisi za forodha au tovuti za EAC/COMESA.
question_en: How many products are on the STR Common List and what does it include?
answer_en: The STR Common List has approximately 370 approved products. It mainly includes: agricultural produce (maize, potatoes, vegetables, fruits), household food items, everyday clothing, and small everyday goods. The full list is available at customs offices or on EAC/COMESA websites.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: Kwa nini watu wanasema VAT 5% Tanzania — inakuja wapi nambari hii?
output: Nambari ya 5% inaweza kutoka: (1) Makosa ya mtandaoni au vyanzo visivyo sahihi. (2) Mfumo wa kodi wa nchi nyingine (VAT ya Kenya ilikuwa na 8% kwa vitu fulani). (3) SDL (Skills Development Levy) ya 3.5% inayoweza kuchanganywa na VAT. Ukweli: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania.

question_sw: Leseni ya halmashauri (LGA) iliyotolewa 2024 inalinda mgeni dhidi ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. Leseni za halmashauri zinahusu kufuata kanuni za biashara za eneo — si uraia wa mmiliki. GN 487A ni amri ya kitaifa inayozidi leseni za halmashauri. Hata leseni kamili ya 2024 hailindi mgeni dhidi ya GN 487A baada ya 28 Julai 2025.
question_en: Does an LGA business licence issued in 2024 protect a non-citizen from GN 487A?
answer_en: No. LGA licences address local business compliance — not the owner's citizenship. GN 487A is a national order that supersedes LGA licences. Even a complete 2024 licence does not protect a non-citizen from GN 487A after 28 July 2025.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Mtu mmoja ana nyumba za kupangisha na anapata kodi ya TZS 2,000,000 kwa mwezi. Atalipa kodi ya mapato vipi?
answer_sw: Mapato ya kodi ya nyumba (rental income) yanapaswa kutangazwa kwenye return ya kodi ya mtu binafsi kila mwaka. Kiwango cha kodi ya makisio kwa mapato ya kodi ni asilimia 15 ya mapato ghafi ya kodi bila gharama kukatwa — hii ni kodi ya mwisho (final withholding). Kama mpangaji ni shirika au biashara iliyosajiliwa, lazima wakatae kodi ya kizuizi ya 15% wakati wanapomlipia mwenye nyumba na kuiwasilisha TRA. Mwenye nyumba binafsi lazima aandikishe mapato hayo kwenye TIN na system ya TRA.
answer_en: Rental income must be declared in the individual income tax return each year. The withholding tax rate on rental income is 15% of gross rental receipts without deducting expenses — this is a final tax. If the tenant is a registered company or business, they must withhold 15% at the time of paying the landlord and remit it to TRA. The individual landlord must register this income with their TIN in the TRA system.
question_en: An individual owns rental properties and receives rent of TZS 2,000,000 per month. How do they pay income tax?

question_sw: Hati ya ukodishaji (tenancy agreement) ya nyumba ya kawaida ya kaya inahitaji ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Makubaliano ya ukodishaji wa nyumba ya makazi (residential tenancy) ya muda mfupi kwa kawaida yanaweza yasiwe kwenye orodha ya nyaraka zinazohitaji ushuru wa stempu au yawe na ushuru mdogo Tanzania. Hata hivyo, mikataba ya kukodisha ya muda mrefu ya mali za kibiashara kwa kawaida ina ushuru wa stempu. Angalia Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu au TRA kwa mwongozo wa hali yako.
question_en: Does a regular residential tenancy agreement require stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Short-term residential tenancy agreements may not be listed in the stamp duty schedule or may attract minimal duty in Tanzania. However, long-term commercial property leases typically carry stamp duty. Check the Stamp Duty Act or TRA for guidance on your specific situation.

question_sw: Je, kiwango cha VAT withholding kilikuwa tofauti kabla ya Finance Act 2025?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kabla ya Finance Act 2025, kiwango cha VAT withholding kilikuwa: asilimia 2 kwa bidhaa na asilimia 5 kwa huduma (kwa baadhi ya makampuni) au viwango tofauti. Finance Act 2025 ilipanga upya: asilimia 3 kwa bidhaa na asilimia 6 kwa huduma, kuanzia 1 Julai 2025. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT kilibaki asilimia 18 — hakikubadilika.
question_en: Was the VAT withholding rate different before Finance Act 2025?
answer_en: Yes. Before Finance Act 2025, the VAT withholding rate was different. Finance Act 2025 standardised it at: 3% on goods and 6% on services, effective 1 July 2025. The standard VAT rate remained at 18% — it did not change.

instruction: Ninaanza biashara — EFD niihitajiwaje?
output: EFD inahitajika kulingana na kizingiti cha mauzo kilichowekwa na TRA — thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz). VAT registered businesses ZOTE lazima zitumie EFD bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo. Mpya wa biashara: (1) Chini ya TZS 11M kwa mwaka — EFD haihitajiki bado (endelea kufuatilia mauzo yako). (2) TZS 11M hadi TZS 200M kwa mwaka — EFD inaweza kuhitajika. (3) TZS 200M+ (au TZS 100M/miezi 6) — lazima usajili VAT na utumie EFD. Nunua EFD kupitia wasambazaji walioidhinishwa na TRA.

instruction: Ninataka kuuza hisa zangu zote katika kampuni ya sekta ya utalii Tanzania — capital gains tax inakuja namna gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kodi ya mapato ya mtaji (capital gains tax) kwa mauzo ya hisa katika kampuni za Tanzania inashughulikiwa chini ya Income Tax Act na inategemea hali ya mkazi au asiye mkazi. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Niambie kuhusu kodi ya VAT nchini Kenya.
answer_sw: Samahani — ninasaidia tu na maswali ya biashara na kodi nchini Tanzania Bara. Kwa maswali ya Kenya tafadhali wasiliana na Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) kwa kra.go.ke. Je, una swali kuhusu VAT Tanzania? Kiwango cha VAT Tanzania ni asilimia 18.
question_en: Tell me about VAT in Kenya.
answer_en: I am sorry — I only assist with business and tax questions for Mainland Tanzania. For Kenya tax questions please contact Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) at kra.go.ke. Do you have a question about Tanzania VAT? The Tanzania VAT rate is 18%.

question_sw: Nani anawajibika kuhakikisha waajiri wanafuata GN 605A?
answer_sw: Wizara ya Kazi, Vijana, Wanawake na Makundi Maalum (MLYWF) kupitia Inspekta wa Kazi ndio wenye jukumu la kuhakikisha utekelezaji wa GN 605A. Inspekta wana mamlaka ya kuingia mahali pa kazi, kukagua rekodi za mishahara, na kutoa amri za kulipa.
question_en: Who is responsible for enforcing GN 605A compliance?
answer_en: The Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups (MLYWF) through Labour Inspectors is responsible for enforcing GN 605A. Inspectors have authority to enter workplaces, examine payroll records, and issue payment orders.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Mteja ana haki ya kudai risiti ya EFD Tanzania — je, biashara inaweza kukataa?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kila mteja ana haki ya kupewa risiti ya EFD kwa kila nunuzi wanaofanya. Biashara iliyolazimika kutumia EFD HAIWEZI kukataa kutoa risiti ya EFD. Kutotoa risiti ya EFD ni kosa la kisheria chini ya Sheria ya TRA na inaweza kusababisha faini au kufungwa kwa biashara. Wateja wanashauriwa kudai risiti za EFD na kuripoti biashara zisizozipatia.
question_en: Does a customer have the right to demand an EFD receipt in Tanzania — can a business refuse?
answer_en: No. Every customer has the right to receive an EFD receipt for every purchase they make. A business required to use an EFD CANNOT refuse to issue an EFD receipt. Not issuing an EFD receipt is a legal offence under TRA law and can result in fines or business closure. Customers are encouraged to demand EFD receipts and report businesses that do not provide them.

question_sw: Ninatoa huduma za ushauri wa mtandaoni kwa wateja wa Tanzania. Je, VFD inahitajika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — ikiwa mauzo yako ya huduma za ushauri wa mtandaoni yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6) na umesajiliwa kwa VAT, unahitaji VFD. VFD itazalisha risiti ya kidijitali kwa kila muamala wa huduma, itapeleka taarifa kwa seva ya TRA, na itakusaidia kutunza rekodi za VAT sahihi. Kiwango cha VAT kwenye huduma za ushauri ni asilimia 18.
question_en: I provide online consultancy services to Tanzanian clients. Is VFD required?
answer_en: Yes — if your online consultancy sales exceed the VAT threshold (TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6 months) and you are VAT-registered, you need a VFD. The VFD will generate a digital receipt for each service transaction, transmit data to TRA's server, and help you maintain accurate VAT records. The VAT rate on consultancy services is 18%.

question_sw: Ninashiriki mauzo pamoja na mwangu (joint business) — mauzo ya kila mmoja wetu yanashughulikiwa tofauti kwa VAT?
answer_sw: Inategemea muundo wa kisheria wa biashara. Kama mnafanya kazi kama biashara MOJA iliyosajiliwa pamoja — mauzo yanaunganishwa na kizingiti kinahesabiwa kwa biashara nzima. Kama kila mmoja ana biashara YAKE iliyosajiliwa tofauti (kwa TIN tofauti) — kizingiti kinachaguliwa kwa kila biashara tofauti. Mgawanyo bandia wa biashara moja kuepuka VAT ni haramu — TRA inaweza kuunganisha biashara kama ikiamua mfumo wa mgawanyo ni wa kubuni.
question_en: I share a business with my son (joint business) — are each of our sales treated separately for VAT?
answer_en: It depends on the legal structure of the business. If you operate as ONE jointly registered business — sales are combined and the threshold is calculated for the whole business. If each has their OWN separately registered business (with different TINs) — the threshold is assessed for each business separately. Artificial splitting of one business to avoid VAT is illegal — TRA may consolidate businesses if it determines the split is fabricated.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni anaishi Tanzania na anafanya kazi Tanzania — anakuwa mkazi wa kodi (tax resident)?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, mtu aliyekaa Tanzania kwa siku 183 au zaidi katika mwaka wa kodi anakuwa mkazi wa kodi Tanzania. Hali ya mkazi wa kodi inaathiri jinsi mapato yake yoyote nje ya Tanzania yanavyoshughulikiwa. Kwa PAYE ya mfanyakazi, mwajiri anakata kwa kiwango cha kawaida bila kujali hali ya makazi — thibitisha tofauti za non-resident na TRA.
question_en: A foreign employee living and working in Tanzania — do they become a tax resident?
answer_en: Generally, a person who has stayed in Tanzania for 183 or more days in a tax year becomes a Tanzania tax resident. Tax residency affects how their worldwide income is treated. For employee PAYE, the employer deducts at standard rates regardless of residence status — verify non-resident differences with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, thamani ya msafara USD 2,000 hasa — STR inatumika au haitumiki?
answer_sw: Kizingiti ni 'haitazidi USD 2,000' — kwa hivyo bidhaa zenye thamani ya USD 2,000 hasa (si zaidi ya) zinastahili STR kama masharti mengine yanakidhiwa. Thamani ya USD 2,001 inatosha kuvuka kizingiti na kusababisha utaratibu wa kawaida.
question_en: If consignment value is exactly USD 2,000 — does STR apply or not?
answer_en: The threshold is 'does not exceed USD 2,000' — so goods valued at exactly USD 2,000 (not more) qualify for STR if other conditions are met. A value of USD 2,001 is enough to exceed the threshold and trigger the standard customs process.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: Mfanyabiashara mmoja asiye na wafanyakazi — bado anahitaji kusajili BRELA?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Idadi ya wafanyakazi haibadilishi wajibu wa kusajili BRELA. Hata mfanyabiashara peke yake bila mfanyakazi yeyote lazima asajili biashara yake. Usajili ndio msingi wa uhalali wa biashara Tanzania.

question_sw: Muda wa kuwasilisha pingamizi kwa TRA ni siku ngapi baada ya kupokea tathmini?
answer_sw: Muda wa kuwasilisha pingamizi kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ni siku 30 baada ya kupokea tathmini ya kodi. Ikiwa muda huu umepita bila pingamizi, tathmini inakuwa ya mwisho kisheria. Katika hali fulani za kipekee inaweza kuomba muda wa ziada, lakini hii si ya kawaida.
question_en: Within how many days of receiving a tax assessment must an objection to TRA be filed?
answer_en: An objection to the TRA Commissioner General must be filed within 30 days of receiving the tax assessment. If this period passes without an objection the assessment becomes final in law. In exceptional circumstances an extension may be requested, but this is not guaranteed.

question_sw: VAT refund na VAT compliance — jinsi zinavyohusiana?
answer_sw: Compliance na VAT (kuwasilisha returns kwa wakati, kulipa VAT, kuhifadhi kumbukumbu) ndiyo msingi wa haki ya kudai VAT refund. TRA inachunguza historia ya compliance wakati inashughulikia madai ya refund. Biashara yenye historia nzuri ya compliance (returns zote za wakati, hakuna deni la VAT) ina nafasi nzuri zaidi ya kupata refund yake haraka.
question_en: VAT refund and VAT compliance — how are they related?
answer_en: VAT compliance (filing returns on time, paying VAT, keeping records) is the foundation of the right to claim a VAT refund. TRA examines compliance history when processing refund claims. A business with a good compliance record (all returns on time, no VAT debt) has a much better chance of receiving its refund quickly.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Biashara ya Tanzania iliyo kwenye eneo la EPZ (Export Processing Zone) ina msamaha wa kodi gani?
answer_sw: Kampuni zilizo kwenye EPZ (Export Processing Zone) Tanzania zinaweza kupata vivutio maalum vya kodi kutoka EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority): msamaha wa kodi ya kampuni kwa miaka 10 ya kwanza, msamaha wa VAT na ushuru wa forodha kwenye vifaa vya uzalishaji, na vivutio vingine. Vivutio hivi ni vya kipekee kwa EPZ — HAVIHUSU biashara za nje ya EPZ. Biashara lazima isajiliwe rasmi na EPZA kupata vivutio hivi.
question_en: What tax exemptions does a Tanzania business in an EPZ (Export Processing Zone) have?
answer_en: Companies in Tanzania's EPZ (Export Processing Zone) may receive special tax incentives from EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority): 10-year corporate tax holiday, VAT and customs duty exemption on production equipment, and other incentives. These incentives are unique to EPZ — they DO NOT apply to businesses outside EPZ. A business must be formally registered with EPZA to access these incentives.
next_review_trigger: EPZA incentives or Finance Act update

instruction: Msambazaji wangu anasema si lazima nitoe certificate kwa sababu tutawasiliana na TRA moja kwa moja. Ni kweli?
output: Hapana, hii si kweli. Kisheria, mnunuzi anayehitimu LAZIMA atoe certificate ya withholding kwa msambazaji. Hii si chaguo — ni wajibu wa kisheria wa VAT Act. Msambazaji anahitaji certificate kudai pembejeo ya VAT yake. Kama utatoa hoja hii, utakabiliwa na adhabu. Toa certificate kwa wakati sahihi.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: WHT inalipwa TRA tarehe ngapi baada ya kukata?
answer_sw: WHT inalipwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata baada ya kukata. Kwa mfano, WHT iliyokatwa Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Cheti cha WHT (withholding tax certificate) hutolewa kwa mlipwaji ndani ya siku 30 za kukata.
question_en: By what date is WHT remitted to TRA after deduction?
answer_en: WHT is remitted to TRA by the 7th of the following month after deduction. For example, WHT deducted in January is paid by 7 February. A WHT certificate is issued to the payee within 30 days of deduction.

question_sw: Mtu asiye raia anayefanya biashara bila kibali Tanzania anakabili adhabu gani?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A (iliyoanza Julai 2025): faini ya chini ya TZS 10,000,000 na/au kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 na kufutwa kwa viza. Sheria hii inashughulikia shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni — ikiwemo biashara ya jumla/reja reja, uhamishaji wa pesa za simu, ukarabati wa simu, na saluni. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: What penalty does a non-citizen face for doing business without a permit in Tanzania?
answer_en: Under GN 487A (effective July 2025): a minimum fine of TZS 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 6 months plus visa revocation. This order covers 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens — including wholesale/retail trade, mobile money transfers, phone repair, and salons. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya usajili wa biashara (BRELA) na leseni ya biashara (LGA) ni nini?
answer_sw: Hizi ni hatua mbili tofauti za kufuata sheria. Usajili wa BRELA unasajili JINA au MUUNDO wa biashara yako (kampuni au biashara ya mtu mmoja) kwenye rejista ya kitaifa — ni mara moja tu. Leseni ya biashara ya LGA inakupa RUHUSA ya kufanya shughuli za biashara katika eneo maalum la kijiografia la LGA — inarudiwa kila mwaka. Unahitaji zote mbili: BRELA kwa uhalali wa kisheria wa biashara yako, LGA kwa ruhusa ya eneo.
question_en: What is the difference between business registration (BRELA) and a business licence (LGA)?
answer_en: These are two separate compliance steps. BRELA registration registers the NAME or STRUCTURE of your business (company or sole proprietorship) in the national registry — done once. An LGA business licence gives you PERMISSION to conduct business activities in a specific geographic area of the LGA — renewed annually. You need both: BRELA for the legal existence of your business, LGA for area permission.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
next_review_trigger: Business registration or licensing framework update

instruction: Mgeni anajenga nyumba na kuuza (real estate developer) — je, GN 487A inamzuia?
output: Ujenzi na uuzaji wa mali isiyohamika (real estate development) haujaorodheshwa wazi katika orodha ya 15 za GN 487A. Orodha ya 15 ni: rejareja, jumla, saluni, ukarabati simu, uhamishaji pesa, usafi, ushonaji, upigaji picha, usafirishaji mdogo, delivery, uchapishaji, udhibiti wadudu, mitumba, machinga, na boda boda/bajaj. Kwa hivyo real estate development haizuiwi moja kwa moja na GN 487A. Hata hivyo, sheria nyingine za ardhi na uwekezaji wa kigeni zinaweza kutumika. Thibitisha na wakili wa ardhi na Idara ya Uhamiaji kuhusu hali yako maalum.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania analipa NSSF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania Bara na kupokea mshahara analazimika kulipa NSSF. Kiwango ni sawa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% = 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla. Raia wa kigeni wanaofanya kazi Tanzania wanastahili faida za NSSF baada ya kukusanya michango ya kutosha. Tofauti pekee inaweza kuwa katika mazingira ya makubaliano ya pande mbili ya hifadhi ya jamii — wasiliana na NSSF.
question_en: Does a foreign employee working in Tanzania pay NSSF?
answer_en: Yes. A foreign employee working on Mainland Tanzania and receiving wages is required to contribute to NSSF. The rate is the same: employer 10% + employee 10% = 20% of gross wage. Foreign nationals working in Tanzania are entitled to NSSF benefits after accumulating sufficient contributions. The only difference may be in the context of bilateral social security agreements — contact NSSF.

question_sw: Je, mkaguzi (contractor) anayefanya kazi ofisini kwangu anahitaji OSHA?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mkuu (principal employer) anabeba wajibu wa usalama wa kila mtu mahali pa kazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na wakandarasi. Kama mkandarasi anafanya kazi yenye hatari katika eneo lako, lazima uhakikishe anafuata viwango vya usalama vya OSHA na ana bima ya WCF.
question_en: Does a contractor working on my premises need OSHA coverage?
answer_en: The principal employer bears safety responsibility for everyone on the premises, including contractors. If a contractor performs hazardous work at your site you must ensure they meet OSHA safety standards and have WCF insurance.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Je, malipo ya simu za mkononi yanahitaji risiti ya EFD tofauti au pamoja na malipo mengine?
answer_sw: Kila muamala wa mauzo unahitaji risiti yake ya EFD — bila kujali ikiwa malipo ni ya M-Pesa, pesa taslimu, au kadi. Unaweza kuwasilisha risiti moja ya EFD kwa muamala mmoja unaojumuisha malipo ya aina mbalimbali. Hakuna haja ya risiti mbili — EFD moja inaweza kushughulikia malipo ya njia yoyote. Wajibu ni risiti moja ya EFD kwa kila muamala wa mauzo.
question_en: Do mobile money payments require a separate EFD receipt or combined with other payments?
answer_en: Each sales transaction requires its own EFD receipt — regardless of whether payment is M-Pesa, cash, or card. You can issue one EFD receipt for one transaction involving multiple payment methods. There is no need for two receipts — one EFD can handle any payment method. The obligation is one EFD receipt per sales transaction.

question_sw: Usajili wa OSHA unagharimu kiasi gani kwa biashara ndogo?
answer_sw: Ada ya usajili wa OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inategemea ukubwa wa biashara — idadi ya wafanyakazi na aina ya biashara. Kwa biashara ndogo zenye wafanyakazi chache (kama 10), ada inaweza kuwa TZS 50,000-150,000 kwa mwaka. Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 10+ kwenye Mainland Tanzania analazimika kusajili OSHA. Angalia osha.go.tz kwa jedwali la ada la hali ya sasa.
question_en: How much does OSHA registration cost for a small business?
answer_en: The OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) registration fee depends on business size — number of employees and type of business. For small businesses with few workers (say 10), fees can range from TZS 50,000-150,000 per year. Employers with 10+ workers on Mainland Tanzania are required to register with OSHA. Check osha.go.tz for the current fee schedule.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu Tanzania ni mkubwa kiasi gani kwa uhamishaji wa ardhi wa TZS 500M?
answer_sw: Kwa uhamishaji wa ardhi wenye thamani ya TZS 500,000,000, ushuru wa stempu wa asilimia 1 ni TZS 5,000,000. Hii ni hesabu rahisi: thamani × asilimia 1 = TZS 500,000,000 × 0.01 = TZS 5,000,000. Ikiwa thamani ya soko ni zaidi ya bei ya mauzo iliyoandikwa, ushuru unahesabiwa kwa thamani ya soko.
question_en: How large is Tanzania stamp duty for a land transfer worth TZS 500M?
answer_en: For a land transfer worth TZS 500,000,000, the 1% stamp duty is TZS 5,000,000. This is a simple calculation: value × 1% = TZS 500,000,000 × 0.01 = TZS 5,000,000. If the market value exceeds the stated sale price, the duty is calculated on the market value.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or Stamp Duty Act amendment

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi wa serikali analipa NSSF au PPF?
answer_sw: Wafanyakazi wa serikali kwa ujumla wanachangia PPF (Public Service Pension Fund) badala ya NSSF. NSSF inashughulikia hasa sekta ya binafsi. PPF ni mfuko wa pensheni wa wafanyakazi wa umma. Hata hivyo, wafanyakazi wa mashirika ya serikali (parastatal organizations) wanaweza kuchangia NSSF kulingana na makubaliano ya ajira. Kwa kuthibitisha mfuko sahihi kwa aina yako ya kazi, wasiliana na mwajiri wako au SSRA.
question_en: Does a government employee pay NSSF or PPF?
answer_en: Government employees generally contribute to PPF (Public Service Pension Fund) rather than NSSF. NSSF primarily covers the private sector. PPF is the pension fund for public service employees. However, employees of parastatal organisations may contribute to NSSF depending on their employment terms. To confirm the correct fund for your type of work, contact your employer or SSRA.

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kulipa PAYE TRA ni ipi?
answer_sw: PAYE lazima ilipwe TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kwa mfano, PAYE ya Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the PAYE remittance deadline in Tanzania?
answer_en: PAYE must be remitted to TRA by the 7th of the following month. For example, January PAYE is due by 7 February. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni ya nje (foreign company) inaweza kusajili tawi lake (branch) Tanzania vipi?
answer_sw: Kampuni ya kigeni inayotaka kusajili tawi Tanzania lazima iwasilishe kwa BRELA: hati za shirika la kampuni mama (Memorandum and Articles ya nchi ya asili), uthibitisho wa uhalali wa kampuni mama nchini yake, majina na anwani za wakurugenzi wa kampuni mama, jina la mwakilishi wa tawi Tanzania, na ada ya usajili. Tawi lazima pia lipate TIN, leseni ya LGA, na vibali vingine vinavyohusiana na biashara inayofanywa. GN 487A (Julai 2025) inazuia raia wasio Watanzania kufanya biashara fulani maalum.
answer_en: A foreign company wishing to register a branch in Tanzania must submit to BRELA: the parent company incorporation documents (Memorandum and Articles from the country of origin), proof of the parent company's legal existence in its home country, names and addresses of the parent company's directors, the name of the branch representative in Tanzania, and a registration fee. The branch must also obtain a TIN, an LGA licence, and other permits relevant to the business. GN 487A (July 2025) prohibits non-Tanzanian citizens from conducting certain specified businesses.
question_en: How can a foreign company register its branch in Tanzania?
next_review_trigger: Companies Act amendment or GN 487A revision

question_sw: Kampuni inanunua mashine mpya ya TZS 50,000,000. Je, inaweza kudai punguzo la mwaka wa kwanza (first year allowance) la 50%?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Tanzania ina kifungu cha punguzo la uwekezaji (investment deduction) ambacho kinaruhusu kampuni kudai 50% ya gharama ya mali mpya ya kustahili katika mwaka wa kwanza wa ununuzi, badala ya uchakavu wa kawaida. Kwa mashine ya TZS 50,000,000: punguzo la mwaka wa kwanza = 50% × 50,000,000 = TZS 25,000,000 inayokatwa mwaka wa kwanza. Kiasi kilichobaki (TZS 25,000,000) kinaendelea kukatwa kwa kiwango cha uchakavu cha kawaida katika miaka inayofuata. Thibitisha kama mali yako inastahili chaguo hili na mshauri wa kodi.
answer_en: Yes. Tanzania's Income Tax Act has an investment deduction provision that allows a company to claim 50% of the cost of qualifying new assets in the first year of purchase, instead of the normal depreciation. For machinery costing TZS 50,000,000: first year allowance = 50% × 50,000,000 = TZS 25,000,000 deducted in year one. The remaining balance (TZS 25,000,000) continues to be depreciated at the normal rate in subsequent years. Confirm whether your asset qualifies for this option with a tax consultant.
question_en: A company buys new machinery for TZS 50,000,000. Can it claim a 50% first year allowance?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — investment deduction ITA Cap.332

question_sw: Mauzo yangu yalifika TZS 201M kwa miezi 12 — hatua yangu ya kwanza ni nini?
answer_sw: Hatua ya KWANZA mara moja: WASILIANA NA TRA na anza mchakato wa usajili wa VAT. Usiendelee kufanya biashara bila VAT ukisha kuzidi kizingiti — kila siku ya kuchelewa ni siku ya kukiuka sheria. TRA inaweza kutoza adhabu za VAT yote iliyopaswa kulipwa tangu ulipozidi kizingiti, pamoja na faida ya kuchelewa. Usisubiri mwisho wa mwezi au mwaka — hatua ya kwanza ni kuwasiliana na TRA MARA MOJA.
question_en: My sales have reached TZS 201M over 12 months — what is my first step?
answer_en: Your FIRST step immediately: CONTACT TRA and start the VAT registration process. Do not continue trading without VAT once you have exceeded the threshold — every day of delay is a day of violating the law. TRA may charge penalties for all VAT that should have been paid since you crossed the threshold, plus late payment interest. Do not wait until end of month or year — the first step is to contact TRA IMMEDIATELY.

question_sw: Wafanyakazi wa kampuni za NGO za kigeni hawalazimiki kulipa PAYE kwa sababu NGO imepewa msamaha — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Msamaha wa kodi wa NGO unahusu MAPATO ya NGO — si mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Wafanyakazi wa NGO za kigeni wanaofanya kazi Tanzania wanajumuishwa na PAYE kwa mishahara wanayopata. NGO bado inalazimika kukata na kulipa PAYE kwa wafanyakazi wake.
question_en: Employees of foreign NGOs don't need to pay PAYE because the NGO has a tax exemption — is this true?
answer_en: No. An NGO's tax exemption covers the NGO's OWN INCOME — not employees' salaries. Employees of foreign NGOs working in Tanzania are subject to PAYE on their earnings. The NGO still must deduct and remit PAYE for its employees.

instruction: Ninafungua tawi la biashara yangu katika mji mwingine — ninahitaji EFD mpya au moja inatosha?
output: Kwa kawaida, kila eneo la biashara (tawi tofauti) linahitaji EFD yake mwenyewe inayosajiliwa kwa TIN na anwani ya tawi hilo. Tawi moja haliwezi kutumia EFD ya tawi lingine — kwa sababu: (1) EFD imesajiliwa kwa anwani maalum; (2) Rekodi za TIMS zinahusiana na eneo; (3) Wakaguzi wa TRA wanaweza kukagua kila eneo tofauti. Hivyo kwa kila tawi linalofanya mauzo ya bidhaa au huduma zinazohitaji EFD — inahitaji EFD yake mwenyewe iliyosajiliwa na TRA. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na muuzaji wa EFD.

question_sw: Je, mauzo ya bidhaa ndogo ndogo kwa watembezi wa kigeni (tourists) yana VAT 0%?
answer_sw: Kwa kawaida, mauzo ya rejareja kwa watembezi (watu binafsi) ndani ya Tanzania yanabeba VAT ya kawaida (18%) hata kama mnunuzi ni mgeni. Mauzo ya zero-rated yanategemea bidhaa kuondoka Tanzania rasmi (export) — si ununuzi wa kibinafsi wa mtalii. Tanzania ina mfumo wa VAT refund kwa watalii (tourist VAT refund) lakini masharti yake maalum yanahitaji kuthibitishwa na TRA.
question_en: Do small sales to foreign tourists carry 0% VAT?
answer_en: Generally, retail sales to tourists (individuals) within Tanzania carry regular VAT (18%) even if the buyer is foreign. Zero-rated sales depend on goods physically leaving Tanzania officially (export) — not a tourist's personal purchase. Tanzania has a tourist VAT refund scheme but its specific conditions need to be verified with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: OSHA na ELRA (Sheria ya Ajira) zinahusiana vipi?
answer_sw: OSHA inashughulikia USALAMA na AFYA mahali pa kazi — viwango vya mazingira ya kazi na ukaguzi. ELRA (Employment and Labour Relations Act) inashughulikia MAHUSIANO YA AJIRA — mikataba, masaa ya kazi, malipo, na masharti ya ajira. Zote mbili zinatumika pamoja — mwajiri lazima afuate OSHA na ELRA.
question_en: How are OSHA and ELRA (Employment Act) related?
answer_en: OSHA deals with workplace SAFETY and HEALTH — working environment standards and inspections. ELRA (Employment and Labour Relations Act) deals with EMPLOYMENT RELATIONS — contracts, working hours, pay, and terms of employment. Both apply together — an employer must comply with both OSHA and ELRA.

question_sw: Tarehe ya mwisho ya kulipa kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) TRA ni ipi?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio lazima ilipwe TRA ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa kila mwezi wa kalenda. Kwa mfano, kodi ya zuio iliyokatwa Januari inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 Februari. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax remittance deadline in Tanzania?
answer_en: Withholding tax must be remitted to TRA within 7 days after the end of each calendar month. For example, withholding tax deducted in January is due by 7 February. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Manufaa ya WCF yanajumuisha nini kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia?
answer_sw: Manufaa ya WCF kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia yanajumuisha: gharama za matibabu (hospitali, dawa, upasuaji), posho ya ulemavu wa muda (wakati wa kupumzika kutokana na majeraha), fidia ya ulemavu wa kudumu, na manufaa ya kifo (kwa familia ikiwa mfanyakazi amefariki). WCF haifuniki hasara za mali.
question_en: What benefits does WCF include for an injured worker?
answer_en: WCF benefits for an injured worker include: medical expenses (hospital, medicine, surgery), temporary disability allowance (during recovery from injury), permanent disability compensation, and death benefits (to family if the worker dies). WCF does not cover property losses.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: WHT ya asilimia 10 inatumika kwa malipo ya riba na gawio — je, mwajiri anapaswa kukata kiasi kimoja kwa aina zote mbili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa kiwango — WHT ya asilimia 10 inatumika kwa riba na gawio zote mbili. Hata hivyo, zinawasilishwa kwa mstari tofauti katika fomu ya WHT return ili TRA iweze kufuatilia kila aina. Mwajiri atakata asilimia 10 kwa kila malipo lakini ataripoti kila aina tofauti.
question_en: WHT of 10% applies to both interest and dividend payments — should an employer deduct the same amount for both types?
answer_en: Yes on the rate — 10% WHT applies to both interest and dividends. However, they are reported on separate lines in the WHT return form so TRA can track each type. The employer deducts 10% on each payment but reports each category separately.

question_sw: Kizingiti cha USD 2,000 ni kwa safari moja au kwa mwezi?
answer_sw: Kizingiti cha USD 2,000 ni kwa MSAFARA MMOJA (per consignment) — si kwa wiki au mwezi. Kila wakati unapovuka mpaka na bidhaa, thamani yake hiyo inazingatiwa. Mfanyabiashara anaweza kufanya safari nyingi, lakini kila safari lazima iwe chini ya USD 2,000.
question_en: Is the USD 2,000 threshold per trip or per month?
answer_en: The USD 2,000 threshold is per CONSIGNMENT — not per week or month. Each time you cross the border with goods, that value is assessed. A trader can make multiple trips, but each trip must be below USD 2,000.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

instruction: Kuna training levy ya Tanzania — tofauti na SDL?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Kama kuna ushuru wa mafunzo maalum zaidi ya SDL (Skills Development Levy ya 3.5%) Tanzania, au kama maana yako ni SDL yenyewe, ninahitaji uthibitisho zaidi kutoka chanzo cha msingi. Kwa SDL ninajua vizuri: ni 3.5% ya malipo ya wafanyakazi, kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi, inalipwa TRA. Lakini kama una ushuru mwingine maalum akilini, tafadhali wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa kwa njia gani Tanzania?
answer_sw: NSSF inalipwa kupitia mfumo wa GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway). Mwajiri analazimika pia kutoa nyaraka za usaidizi (fomu NSSF/CON.05) kwenye ofisi ya NSSF mara tu baada ya malipo — kwa utoaji wa kimwili au njia ya kielektroniki. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: How is NSSF paid in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF is paid through the GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) system. The employer must also submit supporting documents (NSSF/CON.05 form) to the NSSF office immediately after payment — by physical delivery or electronic means. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Kiwango cha pili cha PAYE ni asilimia 9 kwa mapato kati ya Shilingi 270,001 na 520,000 kwa mwezi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha pili cha PAYE ni asilimia 8 — si asilimia 9. Kanda za PAYE kwa mwezi ni: asilimia sifuri (hadi Shilingi 270,000), asilimia 8 (Shilingi 270,001 hadi 520,000), asilimia 20 (Shilingi 520,001 hadi 760,000), asilimia 25 (Shilingi 760,001 hadi 1,000,000), na asilimia 30 (zaidi ya Shilingi 1,000,000).
question_en: The second PAYE band is 9% on income between TZS 270,001 and 520,000 per month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The second PAYE band is 8% — not 9%. The monthly PAYE bands are: 0% (up to TZS 270,000), 8% (TZS 270,001–520,000), 20% (TZS 520,001–760,000), 25% (TZS 760,001–1,000,000), and 30% (above TZS 1,000,000).
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to PAYE bands

question_sw: Risiti ya EFD lazima iwe na taarifa gani?
answer_sw: Risiti ya EFD lazima iwe na: (1) Jina la biashara na anwani; (2) Namba ya TIN ya mwenye biashara; (3) Tarehe na saa ya muamala; (4) Maelezo ya bidhaa/huduma; (5) Bei ya kila bidhaa; (6) Jumla ya mauzo kabla ya VAT; (7) Kiasi cha VAT (kwa kiwango cha asilimia 18); (8) Jumla ya jumla ikiwa na VAT; (9) Namba ya serial ya EFD na Fiscal Receipt Number (namba ya kipekee ya risiti); (10) Msimbo wa QR (katika EFD za kisasa).
question_en: What information must an EFD receipt contain?
answer_en: An EFD receipt must contain: (1) Business name and address; (2) Business owner's TIN; (3) Date and time of transaction; (4) Description of goods/services; (5) Price per item; (6) Total sales before VAT; (7) VAT amount (at 18%); (8) Grand total including VAT; (9) EFD serial number and Fiscal Receipt Number (unique receipt number); (10) QR code (on modern EFDs).

question_sw: Ikiwa TRAB imeniamua vibaya, hii ni uamuzi wa mwisho kabisa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Uamuzi wa TRAB unaweza kupingwa kwa rufaa mbele ya TRAT (Tax Revenue Appeals Tribunal). Kutoka TRAT, rufaa ya mwisho ipo mbele ya Mahakama ya Rufaa (Court of Appeal). Kila hatua inahitaji sababu za kisheria za kutosha na gharama za ziada za kisheria.
question_en: If TRAB decides against me this is the absolute final decision — is this true?
answer_en: No. A TRAB decision can be challenged by appeal before the TRAT (Tax Revenue Appeals Tribunal). From TRAT the final appeal lies before the Court of Appeal. Each step requires sufficient legal grounds and additional legal costs.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu alitoa risiti ya EFD lakini kwa kiasi tofauti na muamala halisi — hii ni tatizo?
output: Ndiyo, hii ni tatizo zito. Kutoza kiasi tofauti kwenye EFD ni ukiukwaji wa sheria na inaweza kuainishwa kama udanganyifu wa kodi. Hatua za haraka: (1) rekebisha mara moja kwa kutoa risiti sahihi ya marekebisho (credit note/debit note); (2) thibitisha mfanyakazi amefunzwa vizuri matumizi ya EFD; (3) hakikisha hesabu za EFD zinaoanisha na vitabu vyako. Kama utakutana na ukaguzi wa TRA, tofauti hizi zitaonekana.

question_sw: Je, VAT refund inaweza kupatikana kwa biashara za kilimo?
answer_sw: Inategemea aina ya biashara ya kilimo. Biashara ya kilimo inayofanya mauzo ya zero-rated (exports za mazao) au inayonunua vifaa vya kilimo vinavyobeba input VAT — inaweza kudai input VAT. Hata hivyo, mauzo ya ndani ya mazao yanaweza kuwa exempt au zero-rated kulingana na aina ya mazao. Thibitisha hali ya VAT ya biashara yako ya kilimo na TRA.
question_en: Can VAT refunds be obtained for agricultural businesses?
answer_en: It depends on the type of agricultural business. Agricultural businesses making zero-rated sales (exports of produce) or purchasing agricultural inputs that carry input VAT — can claim input VAT. However, domestic sales of produce may be exempt or zero-rated depending on the produce type. Verify the VAT status of your agricultural business with TRA.
