question_sw: Usajili wa OSHA na usajili wa WCF — lazima usajilishe wote wawili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — ni usajili MBILI TOFAUTI kwa taasisi tofauti. Usajili wa OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): mwajiri lazima asajilishe mahali pa kazi kwa OSHA na kufuata kanuni za usalama. Usajili wa WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): mwajiri lazima asajilishe wafanyakazi kwa WCF na kulipa michango ya bima ya ajali. Usajilishe ZOTE MBILI — hazibadilishani.
question_en: OSHA registration and WCF registration — must you register for both?
answer_en: Yes — they are TWO SEPARATE registrations with different institutions. OSHA registration (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): an employer must register the workplace with OSHA and comply with safety standards. WCF registration (Workers Compensation Fund): an employer must register employees with WCF and pay accident insurance contributions. Register for BOTH — they are not interchangeable.

question_sw: Je, duka la kutengeneza simu linamilikiwa na mgeni ni tatizo gani?
answer_sw: Ukarabati wa simu (phone repair) umekatazwa wazi na GN 487A. Raia wa kigeni hawezi kumiliki au kuendesha duka la ukarabati wa simu Tanzania Bara. Ikiwa ataendelea, anakabiliwa na faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa.
question_en: What problem does a non-citizen owning a phone repair shop face?
answer_en: Phone repair is explicitly prohibited under GN 487A. A non-citizen cannot own or operate a phone repair shop in Mainland Tanzania. If they continue, they face a fine of at least TZS 10 million, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Boss wangu analipa chini ya GN 605A — ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ukijua mshahara wako uko chini ya kiwango cha GN 605A, una haki ya kudai tofauti. Kwanza, zungumza na mwajiri wako kwa amani. Kama hajabadilisha hali, unaweza kwenda Ofisi ya Kazi ya karibu nawe (Labour Office) au Kamati ya Usuluhishi wa Migogoro ya Kazi (CMA) kudai malipo yako. Huna haja ya wakili.
question_en: My employer is paying below GN 605A — what do I do?
answer_en: If you know your salary is below the GN 605A rate, you have the right to claim the shortfall. First, speak with your employer peacefully. If they don't change, you can go to the nearest Labour Office or the Commission for Mediation and Arbitration (CMA) to claim your pay. You don't need a lawyer.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: SDL (Skills Development Levy) iko chini ya sheria gani Tanzania?
output: SDL iko chini ya Kifungu cha 14 cha Sheria ya Mafunzo ya Ufundi (Vocational Education Training Act, Cap.82) -- si Sheria ya VAT wala Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato. SDL inakusanywa na TRA kwa niaba ya Mamlaka ya Mafunzo ya Ufundi. Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya malipo ya fedha ya jumla kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inaweza kufanya biashara kwa jina tofauti na jina lililosaili BRELA?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni inaweza kufanya biashara kwa jina la biashara (trading name) tofauti na jina lake rasmi la kampuni iliyosajiliwa BRELA, ikiwa jina la biashara pia limesajiliwa. Kwa mfano, kampuni iliyosajiliwa kama 'ABC Holdings Limited' inaweza kufanya biashara kama 'QuickShop'. Jina la biashara lazima lisajiliwe BRELA pia.
question_en: Can a Tanzania company trade under a different name from the one registered with BRELA?
answer_en: Yes. A company can trade under a different trading name from its formal BRELA-registered company name, provided the trading name is also registered. For example, a company registered as 'ABC Holdings Limited' can trade as 'QuickShop'. The trading name must also be registered with BRELA.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Serikali ya Kenya inazuia nini kwa wafanyabiashara wa Tanzania wanaouza Kenya?
answer_sw: Sheria za biashara na kodi za Kenya ziko nje ya mipaka yangu kabisa — ninashughulikia Tanzania Bara tu. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Kwa maswali ya biashara nchini Kenya: wasiliana na Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) au biashara.go.ke. Ninaweza kukusaidia kuhusu mahitaji ya Tanzania kwa bidhaa zinazotoka Tanzania kwenda Kenya (kama export procedures, EAC STR, nk).
question_en: What does the Kenyan government restrict for Tanzanian traders selling in Kenya?
answer_en: Kenyan trade laws and taxes are completely outside my scope — I cover Tanzania Mainland only. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. For Kenya business questions: contact Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) or biashara.go.ke. I can help you with Tanzania-side requirements for goods moving from Tanzania to Kenya (such as export procedures, EAC STR, etc.).

instruction: EFD na TIMS (Tax Invoice Management System) — tofauti ni nini?
output: EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) ni kifaa (hardware) cha kutoa risiti za kodi — kama ECR (Electronic Cash Register) au POS system. TIMS (Tax Invoice Management System) ni mfumo wa kidijitali wa TRA unaopokea data kutoka EFD moja kwa moja kwa wakati halisi — ni backend ya TRA. EFD yako inaunganishwa na TIMS ya TRA — kila risiti unayotoa inaenda TRA mara moja. Hii inamaanisha TRA inajua mauzo yako ya wakati halisi bila ukaguzi wa mwili. Kwa hivyo kukosa kutoa risiti au kutoa risiti bandia ni hatarishi sana kwa sababu rekodi zinaonekana moja kwa moja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Mke wangu anataka kunioa talaka — nifanye nini kisheria?
output: Sina uhakika ni mshauri sahihi kwa swali hili. Maswali ya talaka na familia ni nje ya maarifa yangu — mimi ni mshauri wa biashara na kodi. Kwa msaada wa kisheria wa mambo ya ndoa na familia, tafadhali wasiliana na mwanasheria aliyehitimu katika sheria ya familia au Mahakama ya Wilaya yako.

question_sw: NSSF inaweza kukagua rekodi za mishahara za kampuni yangu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. NSSF ina mamlaka ya kisheria ya kukagua rekodi za mishahara (payroll inspection) za mwajiri yeyote aliyesajiliwa. Wakaguzi wa NSSF wanaweza kutembelea mahali pa biashara na kuomba: orodha za mishahara, slips za malipo, rekodi za benki za malipo ya mshahara, mikataba ya ajira, na rekodi za michango ya NSSF iliyolipwa. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kutoa nyaraka hizi kwa wakaguzi wa NSSF. Kukosa kushirikiana na ukaguzi ni kosa la kisheria.
answer_en: Yes. NSSF has the legal authority to inspect the payroll records of any registered employer. NSSF inspectors may visit the business premises and request: payroll lists, payslips, bank records of salary payments, employment contracts, and records of NSSF contributions paid. An employer has a legal obligation to provide these documents to NSSF inspectors. Failure to cooperate with an inspection is a legal offence.
question_en: Can NSSF inspect my company's payroll records?

instruction: Mwajiri hana WCF — mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini anafanyaje?
output: Kama mwajiri hakusajili WCF (ukiukwaji wa sheria), mfanyakazi aliyeumia ana haki za kisheria bado: (1) Anapaswa kutoa taarifa kwa WCF moja kwa moja (WCF inaweza kuchunguza na kumfuatilia mwajiri); (2) WCF ina uwezo wa kudai fidia kutoka kwa mwajiri moja kwa moja hata kama mwajiri hakusajili — mwajiri anaweza kulazimishwa kulipa; (3) Mfanyakazi anaweza kufungua kesi ya kisheria kwa Mahakama ya Kazi dhidi ya mwajiri kwa kutofuata sheria ya WCF. Mwajiri asiyesajili WCF ana hatari ya: madai ya fidia, faini, na mashtaka ya kisheria. Thibitisha na wcf.go.tz na Mahakama ya Kazi.

instruction: Mnunuzi wa kawaida (asiye anayehitimu) ana wajibu wa kukata VAT withholding?
output: Hapana. Wajibu wa kukata VAT withholding una mnunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying buyer) peke yake -- si mnunuzi wa kawaida. Mnunuzi wa kawaida analipa VAT yote na msambazaji ndiye anayewasilisha TRA kupitia return yake ya kawaida. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Ninachanganya wastani na kiwango cha juu cha mshahara chini ya GN 605A — unaweza kufafanua tofauti?
output:
Kuna tofauti muhimu mbili za kuelewa:

WASTANI (average): TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi — wastani wa sekta zote 16 za GN 605A.
KIWANGO CHA JUU KABISA (maximum): TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi — kiwango cha sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati peke yake.

Makosa ya kawaida: kutumia TZS 358,322 kama kiwango cha juu kabisa — hii ni kosa. TZS 358,322 ni WASTANI, si maximum. Wafanyakazi wa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa wana haki ya TZS 765,900. Thibitisha kiwango halisi cha sekta yako na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: Wataalamu wa hesabu (wahasibu) na mawakili — lazima wasajiliwe VAT?
output: Ndiyo, wataalamu wa hesabu (wahasibu), mawakili, na watoa huduma za kitaalamu wanaofanya biashara Tanzania wanalazimika kusajiliwa VAT kama mapato yao yanafika kizingiti. Zaidi ya hayo, TRA inaweza kuwataka wasajiliwe hata kabla ya kizingiti kama aina ya biashara yao inabainishwa. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) ili kujua kama kazi yako maalum ina masharti ya ziada.
